translations.translation: Ba nomi Khudovandi bakhshandai mekh'rubon.
Sipos makhsusi Allokh' taolo-Parvardigori ch'akh'oniion ast.
Bakhshandai mekh'rubon ast.
Moliki ruzi ch'azost.
[Parvardigoro] Tankh'o Turo meparastem va tankh'o az Tu iori mech'uem.
Moro ba rokh'i rost kh'idoiat farmo [va kh'amvora sobitk'adam bigardon].
Rokh'i kasone [kh'amchun paiombaron, shakh'idon, rostguion va nakukoron], ki ba onon ne'mat dodai va dar zumrai g'azabshudagon [iakh'udiion] va gumrokh'on [masekh'iion] nestand.
Alif, lom, mim.
In kitobest, ki kh'ech' tardide [shakku gumone] dar [kitobi ilokh'i budani] on nest va moiai kh'idoiati parkh'ezgoron ast.
On kasone, ki [dar nikh'onu oshkor] ba g'aib imon dorand va namoz barpo medorand va az on chi ba eshon ruzi dodaem, infok' [sarfu kharch' va khair] mekunand.
Va onkh'oe, ki ba on chi bar tu va [bar paiombaroni] pesh az tu nozil shudaast, imon meovarand va bar ruzi rastokhez iak'in dorand.
Onkh'o az ch'onibi Parvardigorashon az kh'idoiat barkhurdorand va ononad, ki rastagorand.
Bar kasone, ki kofir shudaand, barobar ast, ki oio bimashon dodai, io nadodai, imon nakhokh'and ovard.
Allokh' taolo bar dilkh'o va gushkh'oiashon mukh'r [-i g'aflat] zadaast va bar chashmkh'oiashon pardaest va baroiashon azobi buzurge [dar pesh] ast
Barkhe az mardum meguiand: "Ba Allokh' taolo va ruzi k'iiomat imon ovardaem", dar kh'ole ki imon nadorand
Onon [gumon mekunand] Allokh' taolo va mu'minonro fireb medikh'and, dar kh'ole ki fak'at khudro fireb medikh'and, vale namefakh'mand.
Dar dilkh'oiashon bemori ast va Allokh' taolo bar bemorii onon afzudaast va ba khotiri durug'kh'oe, ki meguftand, azobi dardnoke [dar pesh] khokh'and dosht
Kh'ar gokh' ba onon gufta shavad: "Dar zamin fasod nakuned", [ba durug'] meguiand: "Mo albatta khud islokh'garem"
Ogokh' boshed! Onon [tabakh'kor va] mufsidand, vale namefakh'mand

Va vak'te ba onon gufta shavad: "Shumo niz kh'amchun mardum [-i munsif va vok'e'bin] imon ovared", meguiand: "Oio [intizor dored] kh'amchun kamkhiradon imon ovarem"? Ogokh' boshed! [Makh'z khudi] Ononand, ki kamkhirad kh'astand, vale namedonand

Va kh'angome ki mu'minonro mulok'ot mekunand, meguiand: "Mo [niz kh'amchun shumo] imon ovardaem" va kh'angome ki bo buzurgoni shaitonsifati khud khilvat mekunand [dar tankh'oi iakch'o meshavand], meguiand: "Mo bo shumo kh'astem va fak'at [onkh'oro] maskhara mekunem"
Allokh' taolo tamaskhurashon mekunad va dar tug'ionashon sargashta nigakh' medorad
Onon kasone kh'astand, ki gumrokh'iro ba [bakh'oi] kh'idoiat kharidand, pas, tich'oratashon sude nadorad va kh'idoiatiofta nabudand.

Dostoni inon [munofik'on] kh'ammonandi dostoni kasest, ki otashe afrukht, pas, chun otash peromunashro ravshan sokht, Allokh' taolo nurashonro bigirift va dar torikikh'oe, ki namebinand, rakh'oiashon kard
Karu lolu kurand va [az gumrokh'ii khud] boznamegardand

Io [misolashon] kh'amchun [giriftoroni] boroni sakht (sel) ast, ki az osmon [furu merezad] va dar on torikikh'o va ra'du bark' boshad va onon az tarsi marg angushtoni khudro dar gushkh'oiashon furu mebarand, to sadoi soik'a [otashak]-ro nashnavand va Allokh' taolo ba kofiron ikh'ota dorad

Nazdik ast, ki bark' chashmonashonro biraboiad, kh'ar gokh' ki [bark' mezanad va rokh'ro] bar onon ravshan mesozad, gome dar [partavi] on barmedorand va chun toriki ononro faro girad, [kh'airatzada] bozmeistand; va agar Allokh' taolo bikhokh'ad, shunavoi va binoiashonro az bain mebarad, zero Allokh' taolo bar kh'ar kore tavonost
Ei mardum, Parvardigori khudro parastish kuned; on kase, ki shumo va peshiniioni shumoro ofarid. Boshad, ki parkh'ezgor shaved.

On, ki zaminro baroi shumo bigusturd va osmonro [kh'amchun sak'fe] boloi saraton k'aror dod va az osmon obe furu firistod va ba vasilai on anvoi mevakh'oro ba vuch'ud ovard, to ruzii shumo boshad. Binobar in baroi Allokh' taolo kh'amtoione k'aror nadikh'ed, dar kh'ole ki [kh'ak'ik'atro] medoned.

Va agar dar borai on chi bar bandai khud [Mukh'ammad] nozil kardaem, dar shakku tardid kh'asted, agar rost megued, surae kh'ammonandi on biiovared va guvokh'oni khudro - g'air az Allokh' taolo - faro khoned.
Pas, agar chunin nakarded - va kh'argiz natavoned kard - az otashe bitarsed, ki kh'ezumi on mardumu sangkh'o kh'astand va baroi kofiron omoda shudaast.

[Ei paiombar] Ba kasone, ki imon ovarda va korkh'oi shoista anch'om dodaand, muzhda bidekh', ki bog'kh'oe [az bikh'isht] baroiashon [dar pesh] ast, ki az zeri [darakhtoni] on ch'uiborkh'o ch'ori ast. Kh'ar zamon, ki mevae az on ba eshon doda shavad, meguiand: "In kh'amon ast, ki pesh az in [dar dunio] ruzii mo shuda bud; dar kh'ole ki shabekh'i on ba eshon doda shuda bud [na khudi on] va [dar on ch'o] kh'amsaroni poke dorand va ch'ovidona dar on khokh'and bud"

Allokh' taolo az in, ki ba pashshae-io bolotar az on-masal bizanad, sharm namekunad. Onon, ki imon ovardaand, medonand, ki on [masal] kh'ak' ast az tarafi Parvardigorashon [va az on pand megirand] va ammo onkh'oe, ki kofirand, meguiand: "Allokh' taolo az in masal chi khostaast?" Allokh' taolo [bo baioni in amsol] gurukh'i bisiorero [ki mustavch'ibi onand kh'airon va] gumrokh' va gurukh'i bisiorero kh'idoiat mekunad; va tankh'o [munofik'on va] fosik'onro bo on gumrokh' mesozad

[Kh'amon] kasone, ki paimoni Allokh'ro - pas az makh'kam sokhtanash - meshikanand va ravobiti [nakui kheshovandi]-ro, ki Allokh' taolo ba bark'arorii on farmon dodaast, k'at' va dar zamin fasod mekunand. Inon [dar dunio va okhirat] ziiondidagonand.

Chi guna [iaktoii] Allokh'ro inkor mekuned, dar kh'ole ki moddai bech'on buded va U shumoro kh'aiot bakhshid. Boz shumoro memironad va ba'd az on zinda khokh'ad kard, ba'd az on [baroi bozpursi] ba peshgokh'ash boz gardonda meshaved.
Ust, ki kh'amai on chiro, ki dar zamin ast, baroiaton ofarid, Pas az on ba sui osmon rui va onkh'oro ba surati kh'aft osmon somon dod va U ba kh'ar chiz donost.

Va [iod kun] kh'angome ki Parvardigorat ba farishtagon guft: "Man dar zamin [baroi bashari nomas'ulu beikhtiior] ch'onishine khokh'am gumosht [ki mas'ulu mukallaf ast]. Onon guftand: Oio kasero dar on ch'o megumori, ki tabakh'kori va khunrezi kunad, dar kh'ole ki mo Turo bo sipos ba poki mesitoem va tak'dis mekunem? Allokh' taolo guft: "Man [dar borai kh'adafu maslikh'ati ofarinishi u] chizkh'oe medonam, ki shumo namedoned"
On gokh' kh'amai nomkh'o [-i ashio va mavch'udot]-ro ba Odam omukht. Sipas onkh'oro ba farishtagon arza dosht va farmud: "Agar rost megued, az nomkh'oi inkh'o ba man khabar dikh'ed"
[Farishtagon] Guftand: "Munazzakh'i [poki], Tu! Mo chize ch'uz on chi ba mo omukhtai namedonem. Tu donoi kh'akimi"

Farmud: "Ei Odam, ononro az nomkh'oiashon ogokh' kun". Kh'angome ki vai ononro ogokh' kard, [Allokh' taolo] farmud: "Oio ba shumo naguftam, ki man asrori osmonkh'ovu zaminro medonam va az on chi, ki oshkor mekuned va pinkh'on medoshted, ogokh'am"?

[Iod kun] Kh'angome ki ba farishtagon guftem: "Baroi [buzurgdoshtu ekh'tirom bar] Odam sach'da kuned"! Pas, [kh'amagi] sach'da kardand, ba ch'uz iblis, ki khuddori kard va takabbur varzid va az kofiron shud.

Guftem: "Ei Odam, tu va kh'amsarat [Kh'avo] dar bikh'isht sukunat kuned va az [ne'matkh'oi] on - az kh'ar ch'o, ki mekhokh'ed - guvoro bikhured, ammo ba in darakht nazdik nashaved, ki [ba khotiri sarpechii farmoni ilokh'i] dar zumrai sitamgoron khokh'ed bud"

Pas, shaiton much'ibi lag'zhish [va sarpechii] on du shud. Sipas Allokh' taolo onkh'oro az on chi dar on budand [bikh'isht] berun kard va [ba on du va shaiton] guftem: "Kh'amagi [ba zamin] furud oed, dar kh'ole ki dushmani iakdigar khokh'ed bud va baroiaton dar zamin to muddati muaiian k'arorgokh' va vasilai bakh'rabardori vuch'ud khokh'ad dosht"
On gokh' Odam az Parvardigorash kalimote faro girift [va darkhosti bakhshoish namud] va Allokh' taolo tavbai uro paziruft, charo ki Allokh' taolo tavbapaziru mekh'rubon ast

Guftem: "Kh'amagi az on [bikh'isht] furud oed va kh'ar gokh' az ch'onibi Man rakh'namude baroiaton omad, kasone, ki az on [kh'idoiat] pairavi kunand, na tarse khokh'and dosht va na andukh'gin meshavand"
Va kasone, ki kofir shudand va nishonakh'oi [k'udratu iaktoii] moro durug' pindoshtand, onon akh'li duzakhand va kh'amesha dar on khokh'and bud

Ei Bani Isroil [farzandoni Ia'k'ub], ne'matkh'oero, ki ba shumo arzoni doshtam, ba iod ovared va ba paimone, ki bo man bastaed, vafo kuned, to Man niz ba paimoni [khud bo] shumo [dar borai ne'matkh'oi dunio va okhirat] vafo kunam va tankh'o az man bitarsed
Va ba on chi nozil kardaam [K'ur'on] imon biiovared, ki tasdik'kunandai chizest, ki bo shumost va nakhustin kofir ba on naboshed va oioti maro ba bakh'oi nochiz nafurushed va tankh'o az Man bitarsed
Va, dar kh'ole ki [kh'ak'ik'atro] medoned, kh'ak'ro bo botil naiomezed va onro kitmon [pinkh'on] nakuned
Va namoz barpo dored va zakot bipardozed va bo namozguzoron namoz bikhoned
Oio, dar kh'ole ki kitobi [Tavrot] - ro mekhoned, mardumro ba neki farmon medikh'edu khudro faromush mekuned? Oio nameandeshed?
Va az shikeboivu namoz iori ch'ued; va ba rosti, ki on [namoz] ch'uz ba furutanon dushvoru garon ast
Kh'amon kasone, ki iak'in dorand, ki ba didori Parvardigori khesh noil khokh'and shud va ba peshgokh'i U bozmegardand
Ei Bani Isroil, ne'matkh'oero, ki ba shumo arzoni doshtam, ba iod ovared va [niz] in ki shumoro [ba daleli barkhurdori az kh'idoiat] ba ch'akh'oniion bartari dodam
Va az ruze bitarsed, ki kase chize [az azobi Allokh' taolo] - ro az kase daf' namekunad va az u shafoat pazirufta nameshavad va na g'aromatu fidiae girifta meshavad va na iori meshavand

Va [ba iod ovared] kh'angome ki shumoro az changoli fir'avniion nach'ot dodem. [Onon] Badtarin azobro bar saraton meovardand: Pisaronatonro mekushtand va zanonatonro [baroi kanizi] zinda nigakh' medoshtand va dar inkh'o ozmoishi buzurge az ch'onibi Parvardigoraton baroi shumo bud
Va [ba iod ovared] kh'angome ki darioro baroiaton shikoftem va shumoro nach'ot dodem va fir'avniionro, dar kh'ole ki [ba azobi onkh'o bo chashmi khud] menigaristed, g'ark' sokhtem

Va [ba iod ovared] kh'angomero ki [baroi nuzuli Tavrot] chikh'il shab bo Muso va'da guzoridem, on gokh' shumo ba'd az u gusolaro [ba parastish] girifted, dar kh'ole ki [nisbat ba kheshtan] sitamgor buded
Sipas shumoro ba'd az on [gunokh'] bakhshidem; boshad, ki siposguzori kuned
Va [niz ba iod ovared] kh'angome ki ba Muso kitobi [Tavrot] - ro, ki ch'udokunanda [-i kh'ak' az botil] ast, ato kardem; boshad, ki kh'idoiat shaved

Va [ba iod ovared] zamonero, ki Muso ba k'avmi khud guft: "Ei k'avmi man, shumo bo intikhobi gusola [baroi parastish] ba khud sitam kardaed, pas, ba suii Ofaridgori khud bozgarded va tavba kuned va [khatokoroni] khudro bikushed. In kor baroi shumo dar peshgokh'i Parvardigoraton bekh'tar ast". On gokh' Allokh' taolo tavbai shumoro paziruft. Ba rosti, ki U tavbapaziru mekh'rubon ast

Va [ba iod ovared] kh'angomero ki gufted: "Ei Muso, mo kh'argiz ba tu imon nameovarem, magar in ki Allokh'ro oshkoro bubinem". Pas, soik'a [otashak] shumoro dar kh'ole girift, ki [azobi khudro bo chashmi khesh] menigaristed
Sipas shumoro pas az margaton barangekhtem, boshad, ki siposguzori kuned

Va abrro bar shumo soiabon k'aror dodem va mannu salvo [shakh'du bedona] baroiaton furu firistodem [va guftem]: "Az ne'matkh'oi pokizae, ki ba shumo ruzi dodaem, bikhured" [vale kufr varzided]. Onon [bo nosiposivu nofarmoni] ba mo sitam nakardand, balki ba khud sitam ravo doshtand

Va [ba iod ovared] kh'angomero, ki guftem: "Ba in shakh'r [Bait-ul-muk'addas] vorid shaved va az [ne'matkh'oi] on, az kh'ar ch'o [va kh'ar vak't], ki khosted, bikhured va bo furutani az darvoza vorid shaved va bigued: "[Parvardigoro, gunokh'onamonro] furu rez". [Chunin bigued] To gunokh'onatonro biiomurzem va [iak'inan] bar [podoshi] nakukoron khokh'em afzud

On gokh' sitamgaron in sukhanro, ki ba onkh'o gufta shuda bud, tag'iir dodand [va ba ch'oiash kalimoti maskharaomeze guftand]. Az in ru, bar sitamgaron, ba sazoi in nofarmoniashon, azobe az osmon nozil kardem

Va [ba iod ovared] kh'angomero, ki Muso baroi k'avmi khesh ob khost, pas, guftem: "Asoi khudro bar sang bizan". On gokh' duvozdakh' chashma az on ch'ushid va kh'ar gurukh'e obnushgokh'i khudro donist [va guftem]: "Az ruzii Allokh' taolo bikhured va biioshomed va dar zamin ba fasod [va tabokh'i] nakushed"

Va [ba iod ovared] zamonero, ki gufted: "Ei Muso, mo kh'argiz tobi takh'ammuli iak nav' g'izoro nadorem, pas, Parvardigori kheshro bikhon, to az ruidanikh'oi zamin, az sabzivu bodiring va gandumu nask va piioz baroiamon biruionad". [Muso] Guft: "Oio chizero, ki pasttar ast, bo chizi bekh'tar ch'oiguzin mekuned? Ba shakh're furud oed; zero on chi ki khosted, dar on ch'o baroiaton vuch'ud dorad" va [chunin shud, ki mukh'ri] zillatu benavoi bar onon zada shud va sazovori khashmi Allokh' taolo gardidand, charo ki onon ba oioti Allokh' taolo kufr mevarzidand va paiombaronro ba nokh'ak' mekushtand. Inkh'o ba khotiri on bud, ki gunakh'goru mutach'oviz budand

Dar kh'ak'ik'at kasone, ki [kholisona ba islom] imon ovardaand va onon, ki iakh'udi shudand va masekh'iionu sobeon [fitratgaroion], kh'ar, ki ba Allokh' taolo va ruzi k'iiomat imon biiovarad va kori shoistae anch'om dikh'ad, podoshashon nazdi Parvardigorashon ast; na tarse khokh'and dosht va na andukh'gin meshavand

Va [ba iod ovared] zamonero, ki az shumo paimon giriftem va [kukh'i] Turro boloi saraton barafroshtem [va guftem]: "On chi [az akh'komi Tavrot] ba shumo dodaem, bo ch'iddiiat bigired va onchiro, ki dar on ast, iod kuned, boshad, ki parkh'ezkor shaved"
Vale ba'd [az on kh'ama akh'du paimon] az in [farmon] rui bartofted va agar fazlu bakhshishi Allokh' taolo bar shumo namebud, iak'inan dar zumrai ziionkoron buded

Musallaman az [sharkh'i kh'oli] kasone az khudaton ogokh' shudaed, ki dar [mavridi kh'ukmi kh'urmati saidi mokh'i dar ruzkh'oi] shanbe tach'ovuz kardand. Pas, ba onkh'o guftem: "Buzinakh'oi khoru rondashuda boshed"!
Pas, on [kaifar] - ro ibrate baroi mardumi on zamon va naslkh'oi pas az eshon va [kh'amchunin] pandu andarze baroi parkh'ezgoron k'aror dodem

Va [ba iod ovared] kh'angome ki Muso ba k'avmi khud guft: "Allokh' taolo ba shumo dastur medikh'ad, ki modagovero zabkh' kuned". Onon guftand: "Oio moro maskhara mekuni"? [Muso] guft: "[Tamaskhur kori ch'okh'ilon ast va] Ba Allokh' taolo panokh' mebaram, az in ki dar zumrai ch'okh'ilon bosham"

Guftand: "Az Parvardigorat bikhokh', to baroi mo ravshan kunad, ki on chi guna [gove] ast"? [Muso] Guft: [Allokh' taolo] Mefarmoiad: "On gove ast na pir va na ch'avon, balki miionasoli baini in du boshad. Pas, [aknun] on chiro, ki dastur ioftaed, anch'om dikh'ed"
Guftand: "Az Parvardigorat bikhokh', to baroi mo ravshan sozad, ki rangash chi guna ast"? [Muso] Guft: [Allokh' taolo] Mefarmoiad: "On gov zardi purrangest, ki [rangash] binandagonro shod mekunad"

Guftand: "Az Parvardigorat [boz kh'am] bikhokh', to chigunagii on govro [az kh'ar ch'ikh'at] baroi mo ravshan sozad, zero [vizhagikh'oi] in gov kh'anuz baroiamon mubkh'am ast va inshoallokh' [bo tavzekh'oti tu] kh'idoiat khokh'em shud"

[Muso] guft: "Vai mefarmoiad: "On gove ast na chunon rom, ki zaminro ch'uft kunad va io kishtzorro ob dikh'ad, [ammo] beaib astu iakrang va dar on kh'ech' rangi digare nest". Onon guftand: "Inak sukhani durust ovardi". Sipas [chunon govero paido kardand va] onro sar buridandu [albatta] nazdik bud, ki in korro nakunand
Va [ba iod ovared] kh'angome ki fardero kushted va dar borai [k'otili] u ba nizo' pardokhted va Allokh' taolo chizero, ki pinkh'on mekarded, oshkor namud

Pas guftem: "Porae az [badani] govro ba mak'tul bizaned [to zinda shavad va k'otili kheshro muarrifi kunad]. Allokh' taolo murdagonro kh'amin guna zinda mekunad va nishonakh'oi [oshkori k'udrati] kheshro ba shumo nishon medikh'ad, boshad, ki biiandeshed"

Pas az on [bo vuch'udi in mu'ch'izai buzurg] dilkh'oi shumo sakht shud, kh'amchun sang, io sakhttar, zero [kh'oli dilkh'oiaton kh'argiz tag'iir namekunad, ammo sangkh'o duchori tag'iiru takh'avvul meshavand, chunon ki] barkhe az sangkh'o meshikofand va az onkh'o ch'uiborkh'oe ch'ori meshavand va barkhe meshikofandu [chashmakh'oi] ob az onkh'o mech'ushad va barkhe az tarsi Allokh' taolo [az farozi kukh'kh'o] furu meaftand. Va Allokh' taolo az on chi mekuned, g'ofil nest

[Ei mu'minon, kh'olo ki kh'ak'ik'ati dushmanii iakh'udiion baroiaton oshkor gardid] Oio umed dored, ki ba [oini] shumo imon biiovarand, bo in ki gurukh'e az [ulamoi] onon sukhanoni Allokh'ro [dar Tavrot] meshunidand va pas az fakh'midanash [alfozu maonii] onro takh'rif mekardand, kh'ol on ki [az buzurgii gunokh'i khesh] ittilo' doshtand

Va [iake az firebkorikh'oiashon in ast, ki] vak'te bo mu'minon rubaru meshavand meguiand: "[Mo kh'am] imon ovardaem", vale kh'angome ki bo iakdigar khilvat mekunand, meguiand: "Charo matolibero, ki [dar borai vizhagikh'oi paiombar va kh'ak'k'oniiati islom dar Tavrot omadaast va] Allokh' taolo baroi shumo baion kardaast, baroi musulmonon bozgu mekuned, to [ruzi k'iiomat] dar peshgokh'i Parvardigoraton alaikh'i [bar ziddi] shumo ba on istidlol kunand? Oio namefakh'med"?
Oio namedonand, ki Allokh' taolo on chiro, ki pinkh'on medorand va oshkor mesozand, [kh'amaro] medonad?!

Va barkhe az onon besavodone kh'astand, ki [fak'at ba tilovati sodai Tavrot dilkhushand] va kitobi Allokh'ro ch'uz mushti khaioloti khom namedonand va tankh'o ba pindorkh'oi khesh [ki az buzurgonashon faro giriftaand] dil bastaand

Pas, voi bar kasone, ki bo dasti khud menavisand, sipas meguiand: "In az ch'onibi Allokh' taolo ast", to onro ba bakh'oi andak bifurushand! Pas, voi bar onkh'o az on chi dastkh'oiashon navishtaast va voi bar onon az on chi [az in rokh'] ba dast meovarand!

Va [iakh'udiion] guftand: "Otashi duzakh ch'uz chand ruzi makh'dude kh'argiz ba mo nakhokh'ad rasid". Bigu: "Oio az nazdi Allokh' taolo paimone giriftaed, ki Allokh' taolo kh'argiz khilofi paimonash nakunad? Io chizero, ki namedoned, ba Allokh' taolo nisbat medikh'ed"?!
Ore, kh'ar ki murtakibi gunokh'e shavad va gunokh'onash uro ikh'ota kunad, onon akh'li otashand va ch'ovidona dar on khokh'and bud
Va kasone, ki imon ovarand va korkh'oi shoista anch'om dikh'and, onon akh'li bikh'ishtand va ch'ovidona dar on khokh'and mond

Va [ba iod ovared] kh'angome ki az Bani Isroil paimon giriftem, ki: "Ch'uz Allokh'i iagonaro parastish nakuned va ba padaru modaru nazdikonu iatimon va benavoion neki kuned va ba mardum [sukhani] nek biguedu namoz barpo dored va zakot bipardozed", vale kh'amai shumo, ch'uz iddai kame pusht gardonided va ruigardon shuded

Va [ba iod ovared] kh'angome ki az shumo paimon giriftem, ki khuni iakdigarro narezed va kh'amdigarro az sarzaminaton berun nakuned; sipas shumo ik'ror karded va khud [bar on paimon] guvokh'i medikh'ed

Pas az on, kh'amin shumo kh'asted, ki iakdigarro mekushed va gurukh'e az khudatonro az sarzaminashon berun mekuned va ba gunokh'u sitam alaikh'i onon ba iakdigar kumak mekuned va agar [ba'ze az onon dar ch'ang bo kh'ampaimononi arabi shumo giriftor shavand va ba surati] asir nazdaton biioiand [bo on ki kh'amdini shumo kh'astand, dar barobari ozodiashon] fidia megired, kh'ol on ki ikhroch'i onon [az kh'amon og'oz] bar shumo kh'arom bud. Oio ba bakhshe az [dasturoti] kitob [-i osmoni dar mavridi fidia giriftan] imon meovared va ba bakhshe [ki shumoro dar borai kh'amdinonaton suporish mekunad] kofir meshaved? Pas, ch'azoi kh'ar kase az shumo, ki chunin kunad, ch'uz rasvoi va khori dar in ch'akh'on nakhokh'ad bud va dar ruzi k'iiomat ba shadidtarin azob giriftor meshavand; va [iak'in bidoned, ki] Allokh' taolo az on chi anch'om medikh'ed, g'ofil nest
Inon kasone kh'astand, ki zindagonii dunioro ba bakh'oi okhirat kharidand, pas, azobi onkh'o takhfif doda nameshavad va kase ioriashon nakhokh'ad kard

Kh'amono ba Muso kitobi [Tavrot] dodem va pas az u paiombaroni paidarpai firistodem; va ba Iso pisari Mariam mu'ch'izotu daloili ravshan dodem va uro ba vasilai Rukh'ulk'udus [Ch'abrail] tak'viiat kardem. Oio chunin nest, ki kh'ar gokh' paiombare chize barkhilofi kh'avoi nafsaton ovarad, dar barobarash takabbur namuded va gurukh'ero takzib karded va gurukh'ero kushted

Va [iakh'udiion baroi pairavi nakardan az Mukh'ammad (s) az ruii tamaskhur] guftand: "Dilkh'oi mo pushida va dar g'ilof ast", [chunin nest] balki Allokh' taolo onro ba sazoi kufrashon la'nat kardaast, pas, [ba kh'amin dalel ast, ki] bisior kam imon meovarand

Va kh'angome ki az tarafi Allokh' taolo kitobe [K'ur'on] baroi onon omad, ki tasdik'kunandai matolibe bud, ki bo khud doshtand [Tavrot] va [ba intizor rasidani in kitob] az k'abl ba khud navidi piruzi bar kofironro medodand, bo in kh'ama vak'te on kasero, ki az pesh shinokhta budand [Mukh'ammad], nazdashon omad, inkorash kardand. La'nati Allokh' taolo bar kofiron bod!

Ba chi bakh'oi bade khudro furukhtand, ki az ruii kh'asad [va bartarikhokh'i] ba on chi Allokh' taolo firistoda bud, kofir shudand, ki charo Allokh' taolo az fazli khesh bar kh'ar kas az bandagonash, ki mekhokh'ad [vakh'i] nozil mekunad. Pas, [ba khotiri in kh'asodat] besh az pesh ba khashmi [ilokh'i] giriftor shudand va baroi kofiron azobi khorkunandae [dar pesh] ast

Va chun ba onon gufta shavad: "Ba on chi Allokh' taolo nozil kardaast, imon biiovared", meguiand: "Mo ba chize imon meovarem, ki bar khudi mo nozil shudaast" va ba g'airi on kofir meshavand, dar kh'ole ki on [K'ur'on sukhani] kh'ak' va tasdik'kunandai matolibe ast, ki bo khud dorand. [Ei paiombar, ba onon] Bigu: "Agar [rost megued va] mu'mined, pas, charo paiombaroni Allokh'ro pesh az in mekushted"?!

Va ba rosti, Muso mu'ch'izakh'ovu nishonakh'oi ravshane baroiaton ovard, on gokh' shumo pas az vai dar kh'ole gusolaro [baroi parastish] barguzided, ki [ba khotiri in shirkvarzi nisbat ba khud] sitamgor buded

Va [ba iod ovared] kh'angomero, ki az shumo paimon giriftem [ki az farmudakh'oi ilokh'i va rakh'namudkh'oi Muso pairavi kuned] va [kukh'i] Turro boloi saraton barafroshtem [va guftem]: "On chi [az akh'komi Tavrot] ba shumo dodaem, makh'kam bigired va [ba kalomi Allokh' taolo] gush faro dikh'ed". Guftand: "[Bo gushkh'oiamon] Shunidem, [vale bo raftoramon] nofarmoni kardem"; va ba sababi kufrashon bo [mukh'abbati] gusola dar dilkh'oiashon ch'oi girift. [Ei paiombar, ba onon] Bigu: "Agar [vok'ean] mu'min kh'asted, imonaton chi farmoni bade ba shumo medikh'ad"
Bigu: "[Ei k'avmi iakh'ud] Agar nazdi Allokh' taolo saroi okhirat vizhai shumost na baroi digar mardum, pas, agar rost megued, orzui marg kuned [to kh'ar chi zudtar ba in ch'oigokh' dast iobed]"
Vale onon ba khotiri on chi [az kufru takzib va takh'rif] pesh firistodaand, kh'argiz orzui marg nakhokh'and kard va Allokh' taolo ba [akh'voli] sitamgoron donost

[Ei paiombar] Kh'atman, eshon [iakh'udiion]-ro kh'aristarini mardum bar zindagi khokh'i ioft, [kh'atto] kh'aristar az mushrikon. Kh'ar iak az onon dust dorad, ki kh'azor sol umr binad, dar kh'ole ki [kh'atto] agar in umr [-i daroz] ba u doda shavad, [boz kh'am tuli umrash] uro az azob dur namekunad va Allokh' taolo ba on chi mekunand, binost

Bigu: "Kase, ki dushmani Ch'abrail boshad, [dar kh'ak'ik'at dushmani Allokh' taolo ast, zero] u ba farmoni Allokh' taolo K'ur'onro bar k'albi tu nozil kardaast, ki kitobkh'oi osmonii pesh az khudro tasdik' mekunad va baroi mu'minon kh'idoiatu bashorat ast"
Kh'ar ki dushmani Allokh' taolo va farishtagoni U va paiombaronash va Ch'abrailu Mikoil boshad, [bidonad, ki] Allokh' taolo dushmani kofiron ast
[Ei paiombar] Ba rosti, ki mo nishonakh'oi ravshane bar tu nozil kardem va ch'uz munkh'arifon [az din] kase ba onkh'o kufr namevarzad
Oio chunin nest, ki kh'ar gokh' onon paimone [bo Allokh' taolo va Rasul] bastand, gurukh'e az eshon onro dur afkandand [va paimon shikastand]?! Ore beshtarashon imon nameovarand

Va kh'angome ki firistodae az suii Allokh' taolo ba surog'ashon omad, ki bo nishonakh'oe, ki [dar Tavrot] nazdi onon bud mutobik'at dosht, gurukh'e az eshon, ki ba onkh'o kitobi [Tavrot] doda shuda bud, kitobi Allokh'ro pushti sar afkandand, gui [az on nishonakh'o] kh'ech' namedonand

Va az on chi shaiotin dar [akh'di] farmonravoii Sulaimon [bar mardum] mekhondand, pairavi kardand [va muddai shudand, ki Sulaimon podshokh'ii kheshro bo sekh'r ustuvor kardaast] va [kh'ol on ki] Sulaimon [kh'argiz dast ba sekh'r naolud] va kofir nashud, vale shaiotin [ki] kufr varzidand ba mardum sekh'r meomukhtand va [niz] az on chi bar du farishta: Kh'orut va Morut dar Bobul nozil shuda bud, [pairavi kardand, vale on du farishta] ba kh'ech' kas chize iod namedodand, magar in ki [k'ablan az ruii khairkhokh'i ba u] meguftand: "Mo vasilai ozmoish kh'astem, pas, [bo istifoda burdani sekh'r] kofir nashav". Onon [iakh'udiion] az on du [farishta] chizkh'oe meomukhtand, ki [bitavonand] tavassuti on miioni mardu kh'amsarash ch'udoi afkanand, kh'ol on ki biduni ich'ozatti Allokh' taolo nametavonistand ba vasilai on ba kase ziione birasonand va chize meomukhtand, ki [fak'at] ba onon ziion merasonad va sude namedod va kh'atman medonistand, ki kh'ar kas [mushtok'u] kharidori on [ch'odukh'o] boshad, dar okhirat bakh'rae nakhokh'ad dosht. Agar [kh'ak'ik'atro] medonistand [mutavach'ch'ekh' meshudand, ki] chi badu zisht bud on chi khudro ba on furukhtand!
Va agar onkh'o imon meovardand va parkh'ezgori mekardand, agar ogakh'i doshtand [darmeioftand, ki] podoshe, ki nazdi Allokh' taolo ast baroiashon bekh'tar bud

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, [kh'angome ki az paiombar baroi darki oioti K'ur'on darkhosti mukh'lat mekuned] nagued: "Ro'ino" [Zero ta'biri mazkur ilova bar ma'noi asli mafkh'umi tavkh'inomeze kh'amguni "nodoni"-ro ba zekh'n merasonad], balki bigued: "Unzurno" [kame ba mo fursat bidekh'] va [on gokh' ba oioti K'ur'on] gush kuned va [iak'in bidoned, ki] kofiron [va tamaskhurkunandagoni paiombar] azobi dardnok [dar pesh] dorand

Kofiron - az akh'li kitob va mushrikon - dust namedorand, ki az ch'onibi Parvardigoraton khairu barakate bar shumo nozil gardad, dar kh'ole ki Allokh' taolo rakh'mati khudro ba kh'ar kas, ki bikhokh'ad, ikhtisos medikh'ad va Allokh' taolo doroi fazli buzurg ast
Kh'ar oiatero naskh kunem io [az dili mardum bizudoem va] faromushash gardonem, bekh'tar az on io kh'ammonandashro meovarem. [Ei paiombar] Oio namedoni, ki Allokh' taolo bar kh'ar chiz tavonost
Oio namedoni, ki farmonravoii osmonkh'o va zamin az oni Allokh' taolo ast va shumo ba ch'uz Allokh' taolo [kh'ech'] dustu iovare nadored [ki korsozaton boshad]

[Ei mu'minon] Oio mekhokh'ed az paiombari khud [mavoridi noma'k'ule kh'amchun didori Allokh'ro] darkhost kuned, ki pesh az in az Muso khosta shuda bud? Kase, ki kufrro ba [ch'oii] imon barguzinad, musallaman rokh'i rostro gum kardaast

Bisiore az akh'li kitob pas az in, ki kh'ak' baroiashon oshkor gardid, ba khotiri kh'asodate, ki dar vuch'udashon ast, orzu dorand, ki shumoro ba'd az imonaton ba kh'oli kufr bozgardonand. Pas, shumo avf kuned va [az eshon] darguzared, to Allokh' taolo farmoni kheshro [baroi ch'ikh'od bo onon] sodir namoiad. Kh'amono Allokh' taolo bar kh'ar chize tavonost

Va namoz barpo dored va zakot bipardozed va [bidoned, ki] kh'ar kori neke, ki baroi khud pesh mefiristed, [podoshi] onro nazdi Allokh' taolo khokh'ed ioft. Iak'inan Allokh' taolo ba on chi mekuned, binost

[Akh'li kitob] Guftand: "Ch'uz iakh'udi io masekh'i [kh'ech' kas] kh'argiz dokhili bikh'isht nakhokh'ad shud. In orzukh'oi [botili] onkh'ost." [Ei paiombar ba onon] Bigu: "Agar rost megued, daleli khudro biiovared"

Ore, kase, ki mukhlisona ruii khudro taslimi Allokh' taolo kunad va nakukor boshad, podoshash nazdi Parvardigorash [makh'fuz] ast va [chunin kasone] na tarse khokh'and dosht va na andukh'gin meshavand

Iakh'udiion guftand: "Masekh'iion barkh'ak' [va oini sakh'ekh'e] nestand" va masekh'iion [niz] guftand: "Iakh'udiion barkh'ak' [va oini sakh'ekh'e] nestand", dar kh'ole ki [kh'ar du gurukh'i] onon kitob [-i osmoni]-ro mekhonand. Kh'amchunin, kasone [monandi mushrikon], ki [az paiomi ilokh'i kh'ech'] namedonand [sukhane] kh'ammonandi onon guftand. Pas, Allokh' taolo ruzi k'iiomat dar mavridi on chi bo kh'am ikhtilof doshtand, miionashon dovari khokh'ad kard

Kist sitamgortar az on, ki az burdani nomi Allokh' taolo dar masoch'id ch'ilavgiri kunad va dar vaironii onkh'o bikushad?! Shoista nest, ki onon ch'uz bo kh'oli vakh'shatu tars voridi in masoch'id shavand. Bakh'rai onon dar dunio khori va rasvoi ast va dar okhirat [niz] azobi buzurge [dar pesh] dorand
Mashrik'u mag'rib az oni Allokh' taolo ast, pas, ba kh'ar suie ru kuned, ru [ba] Allokh' taolo ast. Kh'amono Allokh' taolo kushoishgari donost

[Akh'li kitob va mushrikon] Guftand: "Allokh' taolo [baroi khud] farzande barguzidaast". U [az chunin nisbatkh'oe] munazzakh' [-u pok] ast. [Allokh' taolo na tankh'o niioze ba farzand nadorad, balki] On chi dar osmonkh'o va zamin ast, mutaallik' ba Ust, [va] kh'ama farmondardori U kh'astand
[U] padidovarandai osmonkh'o va zamin ast va chun ba kore iroda farmoiad, tankh'o ba on meguiad: "Bosh", pas, meshavad

Onon, ki [az akh'li kitob va mushrikon kh'astand va az oini ilokh'i chize] namedonand guftand: "Charo Allokh' taolo bo mo sukhan nameguiad? Io [charo] mu'ch'iza va nishonae baroi mo nameoiad"? Kasone, ki pesh az eshon budand, kh'amin guna sukhan meguftand. [Afkor va] Dilkh'oiashon kh'ammonandi iakdigar ast. Be tardid mo nishonakh'o [-i iaktoi va k'udrati khesh]-ro baroi gurukh'e, ki iak'in dorand, oshkor va ravshan sokhtaem
[Ei paiombar] Mo turo ba kh'ak' firistodem, to bashoratbakhshu bimdikh'anda boshi va [tu kh'argiz dar okhirat] dar borai [kufru bedinii] duzakhiion bozkhost nakhokh'i shud

Iakh'udiion va masekh'iion kh'argiz az tu khushnud nakhokh'and shud, magar in ki az oini onon pairavi kuni. Bigu: "Be tardid kh'idoiat [-i rostin] kh'idoiati Allokh' taolo ast" va [iak'in bidon] agar pas az donishe, ki ba tu rasidaast, az kh'avaskh'oi onon pairavi kuni, dar barobari Allokh' taolo kh'ech' dustu iovare nakhokh'i dosht

Kasone, ki kitobi osmoni [Tavrot va Inch'il] ba onkh'o dodaem [va] onro chunon, ki shoistaast mekhonand, ba [matolibi] on [ki dar borai kh'ak'k'oniiati Mukh'ammad va risolatash meboshad] imon meovarand; va kasone, ki ba u [va oinash] kofir shavand, onon ziiondidagonand
Ei Bani Isroil, ne'matkh'oero, ki ba shumo arzoni doshtam, ba iod ovared va [niz] in ki shumoro [ba daleli barkhurdori az kh'idoiat] ba ch'akh'oniion bartari dodam
Az ruze bitarsed, ki kh'ech' kas az digare difo' namekunad va kh'ech' tovonu fidiae az u pazirufta nameshavad va shafoat baroiash sude nadorad va [insonkh'o] iori nameshavand

Va [ei paiombar, iod kun az] kh'angome ki Allokh' taolo Ibrokh'imro bo sukhanon [-i farogir bar akh'komu takolifi shar'i] ozmud va u kh'amaro ba khubi ba anch'om rasond. [Allokh' taolo ba vai] Farmud: "Man turo peshvoi mardum k'aror medikh'am". [Ibrokh'im] guft: "[Parvardigoro] Az farzandonam [niz peshvoione k'aror bidekh', to mardum ba onon ik'tido kunand]". [Allokh' taolo] Farmud: "Akh'du paimoni Man [bo tu dar mavridi peshvoi din] ba sitamgoron namerasad"

Va [iod kun az] kh'angome ki khonai [Ka'ba] - ro makh'alli bozgasht [-i kh'och'iioni mushtok'] va [ch'oii] amne baroi mardum k'aror dodem va [muk'arrar kardem, ki] mak'omi Ibrokh'imro namozgokh'e baroi khesh intikhob kuned va mo ba Ibrokh'im va Ismoil vakh'i kardem, ki: "Khonai maro baroi tavofkunandagonu mu'takifon va ruku'u such'udkunandagon [namozguzoron] poku pokiza kuned"

Va [iod kun az] kh'angome ki Ibrokh'im guft: "Parvardigoro, in [sarzamini Makka]-ro shakh'ri amn bigardon va akh'li onro - [ia'ne] kasone az eshonro, ki ba Allokh' taolo va ruzi k'iiomat imon ovardaand - az mevakh'oi [gunogun] ruzi bidekh'". [Allokh' taolo] farmud: "Kh'ar ki kofir shavad, andake bakh'ramandash mesozam, sipas uro ba azobi otash mekashonam va chi bad saranch'ome ast"!

Va [iod kun az] kh'angome ki Ibrokh'im va Ismoil poiakh'oi khonai [Ka'ba] - ro bolo meburdand [va meguftand]:"Parvardigoro, [a'moli neki mo, az ch'umla binoi in khonai muk'addasro] az mo bipazir, ki be tardid Tu shunavovu donoi"

Parvardigoro, moro [taslim va] farmonbardori khud k'aror bidekh' va az farzandonamon [niz] ummate farmonbardori khud [padid ovar] va odobi ibodatamonro ba mo nishon bidekh' va tavbai moro bipazir. Kh'ak'k'o, ki Tu tavbapaziru mekh'ruboni

Parvardigoro, dar miioni onon [mardumi Makka] paiombare az khudashon [az nasli Ismoil] barangez, to oioti Turo bar onon bikhonad va ba eshon kitobu kh'ikmate biiomuzadu [az shirku nodoni] pokiza gardonad. Kh'amono ki Tu piruzmandu kh'akimi

Va chi kase ch'uz on ki khudro ba [sabuksarivu] nodoni meandozad az oini Ibrokh'im ruigardon megardad? Va ba rosti, ki mo uro dar dunio barguzidem va be tardid dar okhirat [niz] az shoistagon khokh'ad bud
On gokh', ki Parvardigorash ba u farmud: "[Kholisona] Taslim shav" [va u dar posukh] guft: "Taslimi Parvardigori ch'akh'oniion shudam"

Va Ibrokh'imu Iak'ub farzandoni khudro ba in oin suporish kardand [va kh'ar iak ba onon meguftand]: "Ei farzandoni man, Allokh' taolo in oinro baroi shumo barguzida ast [pas, ba on bigaraved] va az dunio naraved, magar in ki taslimi [farmoni Kh'ak'] boshed"

Oio kh'angome ki margi Iak'ub faro rasid, shumo kh'ozir buded? On gokh', ki ba farzandoni khud guft: "Ba'd az man chi chizro meparasted"? Guftand: "Ma'budi tu va ma'budi padaronat - Ibrokh'im va Ismoilu Iskh'ok' - Allokh'i iaktoro meparastem va mo taslimi U kh'astem"

Onon ummate budand, ki darguzashtand, on chi ki [az natich'ai a'molashon] kasb kardaand, baroi onkh'ost va on chi shumo kasb kardaed, baroi shumost va shumo dar borai on chi [onon] mekardand, bozkhost nakhokh'ed shud

Va [akh'li kitob] guftand: "Iakh'udi io masekh'i shaved, to kh'idoiat iobed". [Ei paiombar ba onon] Bigu: "[Na az oini shumo] Balki az oini Ibrokh'im [pairavi mekunem], ki kh'ak'garo bud va kh'argiz dar zumrai mushrikon nabud"

[Ei mu'minon ba akh'li kitob] bigued: "Mo ba Allokh' taolo imon ovardaem va ba on chi bar mo nozil shudaast va ba on chi, ki bar Ibrokh'imu Ismoil va Iskh'ok'u Ia'k'ub va navodagon [-i Ia'k'ub] nozil gardid va [kh'amchunin] ba on chi, ki ba Muso va Iso doda shudaast va ba on chi, ki ba paiombaroni [digar] az tarafi Parvardigorashon doda shudaast [ore, ba kh'amai onon imon meovarem] va miioni kh'ech' iak az eshon tafovut nameguzorem va mo [kh'amagi] taslimi Allokh' taolo kh'astem"

Pas, agar onon [niz] ba on chi shumo imon ovardaed, imon ovarand, kh'atman, kh'idoiat ioftaand va agar pusht gardonand, pas, ch'uz in nest, ki kh'atman sari sitez [va ch'udoi] dorand, pas, [ei paiombar, Parvardigori iakto baroi kh'imoiati tu kofi ast va] ba zudi Allokh' taolo [sharri] onkh'oro az tu daf' khokh'ad namud va U shunavovu donost
Rangi ilokh'i [va dini Uro bipazired va ba on poiband boshed] va chi kase khushnigortar az Allokh' taolo ast! Va mo tankh'o Uro meparastem

[Ei paiombar ba akh'li kitob] Bigu: "Oio dar borai Allokh' taolo bo mo much'odala mekuned, dar kh'ole ki U parvardigori mo va shumost va kirdori mo az oni mo va kirdori shumo az oni shumost va mo Uro bo ikhlos parastish mekunem"

[Oio] Megued: "Ibrokh'imu Ismoil va Iskh'ok'u Ia'k'ub va navodagon [-i u] iakh'udi io masekh'i budand [dar kh'ole ki Tavrot va Inch'il pas az in paiombaron nozil shudaast]"? Bigu: "Shumo donotared io Allokh' taolo"? Va kist sitamgortar az on, ki shakh'odatero, ki az [ch'onibi] Allokh' taolo [dar kitobkh'oi osmoni dar borai in paiombaron omada va] nazdi Ust, kitmon mekunad? Va [iak'in bidoned, ki] Allokh' taolo az on chi mekuned, g'ofil nest

Onon ummate budand, ki darguzashtand, on chi ki [az natich'ai a'molashon] kasb kardaand, baroi onkh'ost va on chi shumo kasb kardaed, baroi shumost va shumo dar borai on chi [onon] mekardand, bozkhost nakhokh'ed shud

Ba zudi gurukh'e az mardumi kamkhirad [iakh'udi] khokh'and guft: "Chi chize onkh'o [musulmonon]-ro az k'iblaashon [Bait-ul-muk'addas], ki bar on budand, [ba suii Ka'ba] bozgardond"? [Ei paiombar] Bigu: "Mashrik'u mag'rib az oni Allokh' taolo ast, kh'ar kasro bikhokh'ad ba rokh'i rost kh'idoiat mekunad"

Kh'amon guna [ki k'iblai shumo iak k'iblai miiona ast] shumoro niz ummati miiona [va akh'li e'tidol] k'aror dodem to [dar ruzi k'iiomat] bar mardum guvokh' boshed [ki paiombaroni ilokh'i paiomashonro ba durusti rasonidaand] va paiombar bar shumo guvokh' boshad [ki kalomi Allokh'ro ba shumo rasonidaast] va mo k'iblaero, ki beshtar bar on budi [Bait-ul-muk'addas], k'aror nadodem, magar baroi in ki kasero, ki az paiombar pairavi mekunad, az kase, ki ba ak'ib bozmegardad [va az itoati Allokh' taolo va rasulash ruigardon meshavad], bozshinosem. Musallaman in [kh'ukm] ch'uz bar kasone, ki Allokh' taolo kh'idoiatashon karda boshad, sanginu dushvor ast. Allokh' taolo kh'argiz imon [va namoz]-i shumoro zoe' namegardonad. Ba rosti, ki Allokh' taolo nisbat ba mardum dilsuzu mekh'rubon ast

[Ei paiombar] Ba rosti, ki mo gardondani ruiatro ba [suii] osmon [ki dar intizori vakh'ii ilokh'i baroi tag'iiri k'ibla kh'asti] mebinem. Aknun turo ba [suii] k'iblae bozmegardonem, ki ba on khushnud meshavi, pas, ruii khudro ba suii Masch'id-ul-kh'arom kun va [shumo niz, ei mu'minon, baroi adoi namoz] kh'ar ch'o buded, ruii khudro ba suii on bigardoned. Kasone, ki kitobi [osmoni] ba onkh'o doda shud, ba khubi medonand, ki in [tag'iiri k'ibla farmoni] kh'ak' ast [va] az ch'onibi Parvardigorashon meboshad va Allokh' taolo az on chi mekunand, g'ofil nest

Agar baroi onon, ki kitobi [osmoni] ba eshon doda shudaast, kh'ar nishona [va dalele baroi kh'ak'k'oniiati tag'iiri k'ibla] biiovari, [boz kh'am] az k'iblai tu pairavi namekunand va tu [niz] az k'iblai onon pairavi nakhokh'i kard va barkhe az onon niz az k'iblai barkhe digar pairavi namekunand va agar pas az on ki ilmu donish ba tu rasidaast, az khostakh'oi [nafsonii] onon [dar mavridi k'ibla va digar akh'kom] pairavi kuni, dar in surat musallaman az sitamgoron khokh'i bud

Kasone, ki ba onon kitobi [osmoni] dodaem, [Mukh'ammad]-ro chunon meshinosand, ki farzandoni khudro meshinosand [va medonand, ki sukhanash barkh'ak' ast], vale gurukh'e az onon, dar kh'ole ki khud niz medonand, kh'ak'ro kitmon mekunand
[Ei paiombar on chi bar tu nozil megardad, kh'ukmi] Kh'ak' az ch'onibi Parvardigori tust, pas, kh'argiz az tardidkunandagon mabosh

Kh'ar iake [az ummatkh'o] ch'ikh'ate dorand, ki [kh'angomi namoz] bad-on ru mekunand, pas, [shumo ei mu'minon] dar nekikh'o [bar iakdigar] sabk'at bigired. Kh'ar ch'o ki boshed, Allokh' taolo [dar ruzi k'iiomat] kh'amai shumoro kh'ozir mekunad. Kh'amono Allokh' taolo bar kh'ar chize tavonost

[Ei paiombar] Az kh'ar ch'o ki [ba k'asdi safar] khorich' shudi, pas, [ba kh'angomi namoz] ruii khudro ba suii Masch'id-ul-kh'arom kun va ba durusti, ki in [ru kardanat] kh'ak'k'e az ch'onibi Parvardigorat ast va Allokh' taolo az on chi mekuned, g'ofil nest

Va az kh'ar ch'o, ki berun shudi, pas, [dar kh'angomi namoz] ruii khudro ba suii Masch'id-ul-kh'arom kun va [shumo, ei mu'minon] kh'ar ch'o ki boshed, ruii khudro ba suii on [masch'id] kuned, to mardum alaikh'i shumo kh'uch'ch'ate nadoshta boshand [to bo istinod ba onkh'o bakh'onataroshi kunand], magar kasone az eshon, ki sitam kardand [va kh'amvora dushmanaton khokh'and bud]. Pas, az onkh'o natarsed va az man bitarsed [in tag'iiri k'ibla baroi on bud], ki ne'matamro bar shumo tamom kunam [va shumoro mutamoiz sozam], boshad, ki kh'idoiat shaved

Kh'amchunon ki [ne'mati digare niz ba shumo arzoni doshtem va] paiombare az khudaton ba miionaton firistodem, ki oioti moro bar shumo mekhonad va shumoro [bo amri ma'ruf va nakh'ii munkar az palidikh'o] pok megardonad va ba shumo kitobi [K'ur'on] va kh'ikmate meomuzad va on chiro [ki az umuri dinu dunioiaton] namedonisted, ba shumo omuzish medikh'ad
Pas, Maro iod kuned, to shumoro iod kunam va Maro sipos gued va ba Man nosiposi nakuned
Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, az shikeboivu namoz iori bich'ued [ki] be tardid Allokh' taolo bo sabrkunandagon ast
Va ba onkh'o, ki dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo kushta meshavand, murda nagued, balki onon [nazdi Parvardigorashon] zindaand, vale shumo namefakh'med

Va kh'atman shumoro bo chize az [k'abili] tarsu gurusnagi [k'akh'ti] va ziioni moli [nobudi io dushvorii kasbi on] va ch'oni [margu mir io shakh'odat] va ziioni makh'sulot [-i kishovarzi] meozmoem va [ei paiombar] sabrkunandagonro [ba on chi dar dunio va okhirat baroiashon farokh'am meoiad] bashorat bidekh'
Onon, ki kh'ar gokh' musibate ba eshon merasad, [az ruii rizoiiat va taslim] meguiand: "Ba rosti, ki mo az oni Allokh' taolo kh'astem va ba suii U bozmegardem"
Inkh'o kh'astand, ki durudkh'o va rakh'mate az Parvardigorashon bar eshon ast va makh'z inkh'o kh'idoiatioftagonand

"Safo" va "Marva" az nishonakh'oi [zokh'iri shariati] Allokh' taolo ast. Pas, kh'ar ki kh'ach'ch'i khona [-i Ka'ba] io umra ba ch'oi meovarad, bar u gunokh'e nest, ki tavofi [sa'i] baini on duro [niz] anch'om dikh'ad [va in kor az raftorkh'oi ch'okh'iliiat shumorida nameshavad] va kase, ki ba maili khud kori neke anch'om dikh'ad, pas, [bidonad, ki] be tardid Allokh' taolo siposguzori donost

Kasone, ki on chiro az daloili ravshan va kh'idoiat nozil kardaem - pas az on, ki dar kitobi [Tavrot va Inch'il] baroi mardum baionash namudem - pinkh'on medorand, Allokh' taolo ononro la'nat mekunad va la'natkunandagon [az farishtagonu mu'minon] la'natashon mekunand
Magar kasone, ki tavba kunand va [korkh'oi noshoistai khudro] islokh' namoiand va [kh'ak'ik'atro] oshkor sozand. Inon kh'astand, ki tavbaashonro mepaziram va Man tavbapaziru mekh'rubonam
Kasone, ki kufr varzidand [va ba inkori kh'ak' kushidand] va dar kh'oli kufr murdand, la'nati Allokh' taolo va farishtagon va kh'amai mardum bar onkh'o khokh'ad bud
Dar on [la'nat va azobi onon] ch'ovidona bok'i memonand va na az azobashon kosta meshavad va na mukh'lat [-i uzrkhokh'i] meioband
[Ei mardum] ma'budi shumo ma'budi iagona ast [ki] ba ch'uz U [kh'ech'] ma'bude [ba kh'ak'] nest; bakhshandavu mekh'rubon ast

Ba rosti dar ofarinishi osmonkh'o va zaminu guzari shabu ruz va kishtikh'oe, ki baroi bakh'rabardorii mardum dar dario ravonand va obe, ki Allokh' taolo az osmon nozil namudaast, ki bo on zaminro pas az khushki va khazonash zinda karda va anvoi ch'unbandagonro dar on parokanda ast va [kh'amchunin] dar tag'iiri masiri bodkh'o va abrkh'oe, ki dar miioni osmon va zamin ba khidmat [-i inson] gumoshta shudaand, baroi kasone, ki meandeshand, nishonakh'oe [az k'udrati Parvardigor] ast

[Bo vuch'udi in oioti ravshan] barkhe az mardum kh'amtoioni g'air az Allokh'ro [baroi parastish] barmeguzinand va onkh'oro kh'amchun Allokh' taolo dust medorand, vale kasone, ki imon ovardaand, Allokh'ro beshtar dust dorand va onon, ki [bo shirku irtikobi gunokh'on] sitam kardand, kh'angome ki azobi [k'iiomat] - ro bubinand, [khokh'and donist], ki tamomi k'udrat az oni Allokh' taolo ast va in ki Allokh' taolo sakhtkaifar ast
On gokh', ki rakh'baron [-i gumrokh'gar] az pairavoni khud bezori mech'uiand va azobro mebinand va asbob [-u ravobite, ki much'ibi nach'otashon meshud, kh'amagi] gusasta megardad

Va [dar in kh'angom] kasone, ki [dar dunio az rakh'baroni gumrokh'gar] pairavi karda budand, meguiand: "Kosh baroi mo bozgashte [ba dunio] bud, to kh'amon guna, ki onon az mo bezori ch'ustand, [mo niz] az onkh'o bezori ch'uem. Allokh' taolo chunin raftori eshonro, ki moiai kh'asratashon ast, ba onkh'o nishon medikh'ad va kh'argiz az otashi [duzakh] berun nakhokh'and omad

Ei mardum, az on chi dar zamin ast kh'alolu pokiza bikhured va az [rokh'kh'o va] gomkh'oi shaiton [ki ba vasilai onkh'o ba tadrich' shumoro ba suii azob mekashad], pairavi nakuned, ki ba rosti u dushmani oshkori shumost
[U] Shumoro fak'at ba badi va zishti farmon medikh'ad va [bar on medorad, to] on chiro, ki namedoned, ba Allokh' taolo nisbat dikh'ed

Va kh'angome ki ba onon [kofiron] gufta shavad: "Az on chi Allokh' taolo nozil kardaast, pairavi kuned", meguiand: [Na] Balki mo az chize pairavi mekunem, ki padaroni khudro bar on ioftaem. Oio agar padaronashon [az kh'ak'ik'at] chize nafakh'midavu kh'idoiat naiofta boshand [boz kh'am kur - kurona az onon pairavi mekunand]!?

Masali [da'vati tu - ei Mukh'ammad - baroi kh'idoiati in] kofiron kh'amchun kasest, ki chakh'orpoero sado mezanad, ki ch'uz sado va ovoze nameshunavad. [In kofiron dar ruiorui bo kh'ak'] karu lolu kur kh'astand, az in ru, nameandeshand
Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, az chizkh'oi pokizae, ki ruzii shumo kardaem, bikhured va shukri Allokh'ro ba ch'o ovared, agar tankh'o Uro meparasted

[Allokh' taolo] Tankh'o murdor va khunu gushti khuk va on chiro, ki [kh'angomi zabkh'] nomi g'airi Allokh' taolo bar on burda shavad, bar shumo kh'arom kardaast. Pas, kh'ar ki [ baroi kh'ifzi ch'oni khud ba khurdani onkh'o] nochor shavad [va] sarkashu ziiodakhokh' naboshad, bar u gunokh'e nest. Ba rosti, ki Allokh' taolo omurzandavu mekh'rubon ast

Kasone, ki on chiro Allokh' taolo dar kitobi [Tavrot dar borai nubuvvati Mukh'ammad] nozil kardaast, kitmon mekunand va onro [baroi kasbi molu mak'omi dunio] ba bakh'oi andake mefurushand [dar kh'ak'ik'at] ch'uz otash dar shikamkh'oiashon furu namebarand va Allokh' taolo ruzi k'iiomat bo onon sukhan nameguiad va [az palidii gunokh'] pokashon namekunad va azobi dardnoke khokh'and dosht
Inon kasone kh'astand, ki gumrokh'iro ba [bakh'oi] kh'idoiat va azobro ba [bakh'oi] omurzish kharidand, pas, bar otashi [duzakh] chi shikebo kh'astand!
In [much'ozot bar kitmoni kh'ak'] ba khotiri on ast, ki Allokh' taolo kitob [-kh'oi osmoni]-ro ba kh'ak' nozil kardaast va kasone, ki dar on ikhtilof kardand, [az kh'ak'ik'at] bisior durand

Neki [fak'at] in nest, ki [baroi namoz] ruii khudro ba suii mashrik' va [io] mag'rib kuned, balki neki [raftori] on kase ast, ki ba Allokh' taolo va ruzi k'iiomat va farishtagonu kitobi [osmoni] va paiombaron imon ovarda boshad va moli [khud]-ro, bo vuch'udi dust doshtanash, ba kheshovandonu iatimon va mustamandon va dar rokh'mondagonu darkhostkunandagon [gadoion] va dar [rokh'i ozodii] bardagon bibakhshad va namoz bar poi dorad va zakot bipardozad va [niz] onon, ki chun akh'd mebandand, ba paimonashon vafo mekunand va [kasone, ki] dar fak'ru sakhti va ziionu bemori va ba kh'angomi [shiddat giriftani] nabard, [poidori va] shikeboi mekunand, onon [ki ba in vizhagikh'o orostaand], kasone kh'astand, ki rost guftand va onon parkh'ezgoronand

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, dar [mavridi] kushtagon [ki bark'asdona ba k'atl rasidaand, kh'ukmi] k'asos bar shumo muk'arrar gashtaast: Ozod dar barobari ozod va barda dar barobari barda va zan dar barobari zan. Pas, agar kase [valii dam] dar kh'ak'k'i barodar [-i dini]-ash [k'otil] bakhshish namoiad, boiad [az azobu ozorash biparkh'ezad va bo u] khushraftori namoiad va [k'otil niz boiad mutak'obilan diia-khunbakh'oro] ba neki ba u bipardozad. In [kh'ukm] takhfifu rakh'mate ast az suii Parvardigoraton. Pas, agar kase ba'd az on [guzashtu k'abuli diia] tach'ovuz kunad, azobi dardnok [dar intizor] dorad
Ei khiradmandon, dar [in] k'asos baroi shumo [tadovumi] zindagi ast, boshad, ki tak'vo pesha kuned

Bar shumo muk'arrar shudaast, ki kh'ar gokh' zamoni margi iake az shumo faro rasad, agar mole az khud ba ch'oi guzoshtaast, baroi padaru modar va kheshovandon ba shevai shoista vasiiat kunad. In [kor] kh'ak'k'e ast bar parkh'ezkoron [ki boiad anch'om dikh'and]
Pas, kh'ar ki on [vasiiat]-ro pas az shunidanash tag'iir dikh'ad, gunokh'ash tankh'o bar [ukh'dai] kasonest, ki onro tag'iir medikh'and. Ba rosti, ki Allokh' taolo shunavovu donost

Pas, kase, ki az beadolati [va maili bech'oii] vasiiatkunanda [nisbat ba vorison] io az gunokh'i u [dar vasiiat ba kori khilof] bitarsad va [bo islokh'i vasiiat] miioni onon [vorison]-ro sozish dikh'ad, bar u gunokh'e nest, [ki] kh'amono Allokh' taolo omurzandai mekh'rubon ast
Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, ruza bar shumo voch'ib shudaast, kh'amon guna ki bar kasone, ki pesh az shumo budand, niz voch'ib shuda bud; boshad, ki parkh'ezkor shaved

Ruzkh'oi muaiian [-ro ruzadori kuned], pas, kh'ar kas az shumo, ki bemor io musofir boshad, [ba andozai on ruzkh'oe, ki natavonistaast ruza bigirad] te'dode az ruzkh'oi digar [-ro ruza bigirad] va bar kasone, ki tavonoii onro nadorand, lozim ast kaffora bidikh'and [va on ba barobari kh'ar ruz] khurok dodan ba iak tikh'idast ast va kh'ar ki ba maili khud [beshtar] nakui kunad, on [afzunbakhshi ba sudi ust va] baroiash bekh'tar ast va agar [fazilati ruzadoriro] bidoned, ruza baroiaton bekh'tar [az iftor va pardokhti kaffora] ast

Mokh'i ramazon [mokh'e] ast, ki K'ur'on dar on nozil shudaast; [kitobe,] ki rokh'namoi mardum ast va daloili oshkore az kh'idoiat [bo khud dorad] va ch'udokunanda [-i kh'ak' az botil] ast. Pas, kh'ar iake az shumo [ki muk'imu solim ast] in mokh'ro dariobad, boiad onro ruza bidorad va kh'ar ki bemor io dar safar boshad, [boiad ba te'dodi ruzkh'oe, ki ruza nagiriftaast] ruzkh'oi digare [-ro ruza bigirad]. Allokh' taolo [bo baioni in akh'kom] baroiaton osoni mekhokh'ad va dushvori namekhokh'ad, to [bitavoned ruzadori dar mokh'i ramazon]-ro komil kuned va Allokh'ro baroi on ki kh'idoiataton kardaast, ba buzurgi iod kuned; boshad, ki shukr guzored

Va [ei paiombar] chun bandagonam dar borai Man az tu bipursand, [ba onon] bigu: Man nazdikam va duoi duokunandaro - kh'angome ki maro bikhonad - ich'obat mekunam, pas, [onon fak'at] boiad da'vati Maro bipazarand va ba Man imon biiovarand; boshad, ki rokh' ioband

[Ei mu'minon] Omezish bo kh'amsaronaton dar shab [-kh'oi] ruza bar shumo kh'alol gardidaast. Onon libosi shumo kh'astand va shumo libosi eshon. Allokh' taolo medonist, ki shumo bar khud khiionat mekarded [va bo on ki dar avoili islom omezish dar mokh'i ramazon kh'arom bud, shumo bar on betavach'ch'ukh' buded], pas, tavbaatonro paziruftu az shumo darguzasht. Pas, aknun [dar shabkh'oi ramazon metavoned] bo onon omezish kuned va on chiro, ki Allokh' taolo baroiaton muk'arrar doshtaast [az eshon] talab kuned. Bikhured va bioshomed, to rishtai sapedi subkh' [fach'ri sodik'] az rishtai siiokh' [shab] baroiaton oshkor gardad, on gokh' ruzaro to shab ba poion birasoned va, dar kh'ole ki dar masoch'id mu'takif kh'asted, bo zanon omezish nakuned. In marzkh'o [-i akh'kom]-i ilokh'i ast, pas, ba onkh'o nazdik nashaved. Allokh' taolo chunin oiot [va akh'kom]-i khudro baroi mardum ravshan mesozad, boshad, ki parkh'ezkor shavand

Va amvolatonro baini khud ba botil [va nokh'ak'] nakhured va baroi on, ki bakhshe az moli mardumro ba gunokh' bikhured, k'aziiaro ba kh'okimon nakashoned, dar kh'ole ki medoned [ki in kor gunokh' ast]

[Ei paiombar] Az tu dar borai kh'ilolkh'o [-i mokh'] mepursand, bigu: "Onkh'o baioni avk'ot [va gokh'shumorii tabii] baroi mardum va [vasilai ta'iini vak'ti] kh'ach' kh'astand". Nakukori on nest, ki [monandi davroni ch'okh'iliiat dar kh'oli ekh'rom] az pushti khonakh'o vorid shaved, balki nakukor kasest, ki tak'vo pesha kunad [pas, parkh'ezkor boshed] va ba khonakh'o az darkh'oiashon vorid shaved va az Allokh' taolo bitarsed, boshad, ki rastagor shaved

Va dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo bo kasone, ki bo shumo mech'angand, bich'anged [vale bo musla kardan va kushtani kudakonu zanon va pironsolon] az kh'ad tach'ovuz nakuned, [ki] ba rosti Allokh' taolo tach'ovuzgaronro dust namedorad

Va onon [mushrikon]-ro kh'ar kuch'o iofted, bikushed va az on ch'o [Makka], ki shumoro berun kardaand, berun kuned va fitna [kufru shirk] badtar az k'atl ast va bo onkh'o dar kanori Masch'id-ul-kh'arom paikor nakuned, magar in ki bo shumo dar on ch'o bich'angand. Pas, agar [dar on ch'o] bo shumo ch'angidand, eshonro bikushed, [ki] sazoi kofiron chunin ast
Pas, agar [az kufrashon] dast bardoshtand [az nabard dast bikashed, ki] be gumon Allokh' taolo omurzandai mekh'rubon ast
Va bo onkh'o bich'anged, to fitnai [shirk] bok'i namonad va din [kholisona] az oni Allokh' taolo gardad. Pas, agar dast bardoshtand, [sitam nakuned, ki] sitam ch'uz bar sitamgoron ravo nest

[In] Mokh'i kh'arom [soli kh'aftumi kh'ich'ri, ki imkoni umra guzoridan iofted] dar barobari mokh'i kh'arom [-i soli guzashta] ast [ki mushrikon shumoro az adoi kh'ach' bozdoshta budand] va [tach'ovuzi] kh'urmatkh'o [-i sarzaminu mokh'i kh'arom] k'asos dorad; pas, kh'ar ki sitam kard, ba kh'amon guna ki bar shumo sitam kardaast, bar u sitam ravo dored va az Allokh' taolo parvo kuned va bidoned, ki Allokh' taolo bo parkh'ezkoron ast

Va dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo infok' kuned va [bo firor az maidoni ch'ikh'od va tarki infok'] khudro bo dasti kheshtan ba kh'alokat naafkaned va neki kuned, [ki] ba rosti Allokh' taolo nakukoronro dust medorad

Va kh'ach'ch'u umraro baroi Allokh' taolo ba poion rasoned va agar [ba vasilai dushman io bemori az in kor] bozmoned, on chi az k'urboni [khokh' az shuturu gov io gusfand] farokh'am shavad [zabkh' kuned va on gokh' az ekh'rom khorich' shaved] va sarkh'oi khudro nataroshed, to k'urboni ba ch'oigokh'ash [dar k'urbongokh'] birasad va agar kase az shumo bemor budu io norokh'atie dar sar dosht [ki nochor bud bad-on khotir dar kh'oli ekh'rom sari khudro bitaroshad], pas, fidia dikh'ad, az [k'abili se ruz] ruza io sadak'a [taom dodani shash tikh'idasti kh'aram] io k'urboni kardani gusfande [ki miioni tikh'idastoni kh'aram tak'sim shavad]. Pas, kh'angome ki dar amon buded, kh'ar ki az umra bakh'ramand gardid va sipas [a'moli] kh'ach'ro og'oz kard, on chi az k'urboni [baroiash] muiassar shud [zabkh' kunad] va kh'ar ki [k'urboni] naioft, se ruz dar [aiiomi] kh'ach' va kh'aft ruz kh'angome ki [ba khona] bozgashted, ruza bigired. In dakh' [ruzi] komil ast. In [kh'ukmi kh'ach'ch'i tamattu'] baroi kasest, ki khonavodaash sokini Masch'id-ul-kh'arom [Makka va atrofi on] naboshad va az Allokh' taolo parvo kuned va bidoned, ki Allokh' taolo sakhtkaifar ast

[Mavsimi] kh'ach' dar mokh'kh'oi mushakhkhase ast [az og'ozi Shavvol to dakh'umi Zulkh'ich'ch'a]; pas, kase, ki dar in mokh'kh'o kh'ach'ro [bar khud] voch'ib gardonad, [boiad bidonad, ki] dar kh'ach', omezishi ch'insi va [irtikobi] gunokh' va dargiri [va ch'idol ravo] nest va on chi az korkh'oi nek anch'om medikh'ed, Allokh' taolo onro medonad; va [khuroku pushoki mavridi niiozi kh'ach'ro baroi khud farokh'am kuned va] tusha bargired, [vale ba iod doshta boshed, ki] ba rosti, bekh'tarin tusha parkh'ezkorist va, ei khiradmandon, az man parvo kuned

Gunokh'e bar shumo nest, ki [dar aiiomi kh'ach' bo kharidu furush] az fazli Parvardigoraton [manfiat va ruzi] talab kuned va kh'angome ki [ruzi nukh'um pas az vuk'uf] az Arafot kuch karded, Allokh'ro dar "Mash'ar-ul-kh'arom" iod kuned; va Uro iod kuned, charo ki shumoro, ki peshtar az gumrokh'on buded, [ba adoi manosiki kh'ach'ch'u digar a'moli ibodi] kh'idoiat kard

Pas, az kh'amon ch'o, ki mardum [pairavoni Ibrokh'im] ravona meshavand, [shumo niz az Arafot ba suii Mino] kharakat kuned va az Allokh' taolo omurzish bikhokh'ed, [charo ki] be tardid Allokh' taolo omurzandavu mekh'rubon ast

Pas, chun manosiki [kh'ach'ch'i] khudro ba ch'oi ovarded, kh'amon guna, ki padaronatonro [bo fakhru g'urur] iod mekarded, balki [bekh'tar va] beshtar az on Allokh'ro iod kuned; va barkhe az mardum [kofirone] kh'astand, ki meguiand: "Parvardigoro, ba mo dar dunio [molu farzand] ato kun". In shakhs dar okhirat bakh'rae [az ne'matkh'oi ilokh'i] nadorad

Va barkhe [digar] az eshon [mu'minone] kh'astand, ki meguiand: "Parvardigoro, ba mo dar dunio neki [ruzi, salomati, donish va imon] ato kun va dar okhirat [niz] neki [ato farmo] va moro az azobi otash nigakh' dor"
Inkh'oand, ki az dastovardashon bakh'rae dorand va Allokh' taolo dar kh'isobrasi sare' ast

Allokh'ro dar ruzkh'oi muaiian [se ruzi aiiomi tashrik' iozdakh'um to senzdakh'umi Zulkh'ich'ch'a] iod kuned; pas, kase, ki shitob kunad va taii du ruz [a'molro anch'om dikh'ad], gunokh'e bar u nest; va kase, ki ta'khir kunad [va a'molro dar se ruz anch'om dikh'ad], gunokh'e bar u nest. [In fursat] Baroi kase ast, ki tak'vo pesha kunad; va [ei mu'minon] az Allokh' taolo parvo kuned va bidoned, ki ba suii U kh'ashr khokh'ed shud

Va [ei paiombar], az mardum kase ast, ki guftorash dar [mavridi] zindagii dunio turo ba shigift meandozad va Allokh'ro bar [imoni k'albi va] on chi dar dilash dorad, guvokh' megirad [to ch'oie, ki uro rostgu mepindori] va kh'ol on ki u [dar zumrai] sarsakhttarin dushmanon [va badkhokh'oni islomu muslimin] ast

U kh'angome ki [az tu] rui barmegardonad va [az nazdat] meravad [io ba raiosate merasad], dar rokh'i fasod dar zamin mekushad va [makh'suloti] kishovarzi va chakh'orpoionro nobud mesozad; va Allokh' taolo fasodu [tabokh'kori]-ro dust nadorad

Va kh'angome ki ba u gufta meshavad: "Az Allokh' taolo bitars", khudbuzurgbini [va g'ururash] uro ba [idoma dodan bar anch'omi] gunokh' mekashonad; pas, [otashi] ch'akh'annam baroiash kofi ast va chi bad ch'oigokh'e ast!
Va az mardum kase [niz] kh'ast, ki ch'oni khudro baroi kasbi khushnudii Allokh' taolo dareg' namedorad; va Allokh' taolo nisbat ba bandagon mekh'rubon ast
Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, kh'amagi ba islom [va itoati Allokh' taolo] daroed va az [rokh'kh'ovu] gomkh'oi shaiton pairavi nakuned. Ba rosti, ki u dushmani oshkori shumost
Pas, agar ba'd az on ki nishonakh'oi ravshanu oshkor baroiaton omad, lag'zhish karded va [munkh'arif shuded], bidoned, ki Allokh' taolo shikastnopaziru kh'akim ast

Oio intizori [-i onon, ki pairavi shaitonand] g'air az in ast, ki Allokh' taolo [dar ruzi k'iiomat baroi dovari] dar soiakh'oe az abrkh'o ba suiashon biioiad va farishtagon [niz baroi ich'roi azobi ilokh'i ononro ikh'ota kunand] va kor iaksara shavad? Va [ogokh' boshed, ki kh'amai] korkh'o ba suii Allokh' taolo bozgardonda meshavad

[Ei paiombar], az Bani Isroil bipurs, [ki] chi andoza nishonakh'oi oshkor ba onkh'o dodaem; va kase, ki ne'mati Allokh'ro pas az on ki nasibash shud, [ba kufru nosiposi] tabdil kunad, [azobi sakhte khokh'ad dosht va boiad bidonad, ki] Allokh' taolo sakhtkaifar ast

Zindagii dunio baroi kofiron orosta shudaast va mu'minonro maskhara mekunand, kh'ol on ki parkh'ezkoron dar ruzi k'iiomat bolotar az onon kh'astand; [zero dar bikh'isht ch'ovidonand] va Allokh' taolo kh'ar kiro bikhokh'ad, beshumor ruzi medikh'ad

[Dar og'oz] mardum iak ummat budand [ammo dar amri din ikhtilof kardand]; on gokh' Allokh' taolo paiombaronro bashoratbakhshu bimdikh'anda barangekht va kh'amrokh' bo onon kitob [-i osmoni]-ro ba kh'ak' nozil kard, to miioni mardum dar on chi ikhtilof doshtand, dovari kunand; va fak'at kasone, ki Tavrot] ba onon doda shuda bud - pas az on ki nishonakh'oi ravshan ba onkh'o rasid - ba khotiri sitam va kh'asodate, ki bainashon bud, dar mavridi on ikhtilof kardand; pas, Allokh' taolo ba farmoni khesh kasonero, ki imon ovarda budand, ba kh'ak'ik'ate, ki dar on ikhtilof doshtand, kh'idoiat namud; va Allokh' taolo kh'ar kiro bikhokh'ad, ba rokh'i rost kh'idoiat mekunad

[Ei mu'minon] Oio pindoshtaed, ki voridi bikh'isht meshaved, kh'ol on ki kh'anuz monandi on chi bar [sari] peshiniioni shumo omad, bar [sari] shumo naomadaast? Dushvori va ziion ba eshon rasid va [on chunon sakhti kashidand va] ba larza aftodand, ki paiombar va kasone, ki bo u imon ovarda budand, guftand: "Iorii Allokh' taolo kai faro khokh'ad rasid"? Ogokh' boshed! Be tardid iorii Allokh' taolo nazdik ast

[Ei paiombar, ioronat] Az tu mepursand, chi chize infok' kunand, bigu: "Kh'ar mole, ki infok' karded, baroi padaru modaru nazdikon va iatimonu tikh'idaston va darrokh'mondagon ast va kh'ar kori neke, ki anch'om dikh'ed, Allokh' taolo ba on donost"

[Ei mu'minon] Ch'ikh'od [dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo] bar shumo voch'ib shudaast, dar kh'ole ki baroi shumo nokhushoiand ast [zero kharch'i moli va ch'oni dorad]. Chi baso chizero khush nadoshta boshed, kh'ol on ki baroiaton bekh'tar ast va chi baso chizero dust doshta boshed, kh'ol on ki baroiaton bad ast; va Allokh' taolo [khairu sharri korkh'oro] medonad va shumo namedoned

[Ei paiombar] Az tu dar borai ch'ang dar mokh'i kh'arom [Mukh'arram, Rach'ab, Zulk'a'da va Zulkh'ich'ch'a] mepursand, bigu: "Ch'ang dar on [mokh'kh'o gunokh'i] buzurg ast va bozdoshtan az rokh'i Allokh' taolo va kufr varzidan ba U va [ch'ilavgiri az vurudi mardum ba] Masch'id-ul-kh'arom va berun rondani akh'lash az on ch'o nazdi Allokh' taolo [gunokh'i] buzurgtar ast va fitna [-i shirk] az k'atl buzurgtar ast". Va [ei mu'minon, mushrikon] kh'amvora bo shumo mech'angand, to agar bitavonand shumoro az dinaton bargardonand; va kh'ar iak az shumo, ki az dinash bozgardad va dar kh'oli kufr bimirad, a'molash dar dunio va okhirat tabokh' megardad va onon akh'li otashand va kh'amesha dar on khokh'and bud

Kasone, ki imon ovardand va kasone, ki [baroi barpoii dini kh'ak'] kh'ich'rat namudand va dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo ch'ikh'od kardand, onon ba rakh'mati Allokh' taolo umedvorand va Allokh' taolo [nisbat ba eshon] omurzandai mekh'rubon ast

[Ei paiombar, askh'obat] az tu dar borai sharob va k'imor mepursand, bigu: "Dar on du gunokh'i buzurg va [niz] sudkh'oe baroi mardum vuch'ud dorad, vale gunokh'i on du az sudashon [beshtar va] buzurgtar ast"; va az tu mepursand, chi chize infok' kunand, bigu: "On chi afzun oiad [az niiozmandii khud]. Allokh' taolo oiotro inchunin baroi shumo ravshan mesozad; boshad, ki biiandeshed"

Dar borai dunio va okhirat [biiandeshed]; va [ei paiombar] az tu dar mavridi [chigunagii sarparastiashon bar] iatimon mepursand; bigu: "Islokh'i [koru parkh'ez az daromekhtan dar amvoli] onon bekh'tar ast; va agar bo [ch'am' kardani amvoli onon bo doroii khud dar nafak'akh'oi zindagi va maskan bo] onon kh'amzisti kuned, [erode dar in kor nest; zero] onkh'o barodaroni [dinii] shumo kh'astand". Va Allokh' taolo tabakh'korro az durustkor bozmeshinosad; va agar Allokh' taolo mekhost, [dar mavridi iatimon sakhtgiri mekard va] shumoro ba zakh'mat meandokht. Ba rosti, ki Allokh' taolo shikastnopaziru kh'akim ast

Va [ei mu'minon] bo zanoni mushrik to imon naiovardaand, izdivoch' nakuned; va be gumon kanizi mu'min, az zani [ozodi] mushrik bekh'tar ast; agarchi [zeboi io doroiash] mavridi pisandaton vok'e' gardad; va [zanoni musulmonro] ba izdivoch'i mardoni mushrik darnaiovared, magar on ki imon biiovarand; va kh'atman bardai mu'min az mardi [ozodi] mushrik bekh'tar ast; agarchi sheftai [doroi va mavk'eiiati] u shuda boshed. Onon ba suii otash [-i duzakh] da'vat mekunand va Allokh' taolo ba farmon [va tavfik']-i khesh ba suii bikh'isht va omurzish da'vat mekunand va oiot [-u akh'komi] khudro baroi mardum ravshan mesozad; boshad, ki pand girand

Va [ei paiombar] az tu dar borai kh'aiz [odati mokh'onai zanon] mepursand, bigu: "On [kh'olat] nav'i norokh'ati ast; pas, dar kh'olati k'oidagi az zanon kanoragiri kuned va bo onon nazdiki nakuned, to pok shavand. Pas, kh'angome ki pok shudand [va g'usl kardand], az kh'amon ch'oie, ki Allokh' taolo ba shumo farmon dodaast, bo eshon omezish kuned. Ba rosti, ki Allokh' taolo tavbakunandagonro dust medorad va pokizagonro [niz] dust medorad"

Zanoni shumo [dar kh'ukmi] kishtzore baroi shumo kh'astand, pas, kh'ar guna ki mekhokh'ed ba kishtzori khud daroed va [tushae kh'amchun farzandi solekh'] baroi khud pesh bifiristed va az Allokh' taolo parvo kuned va bidoned, ki Uro mulok'ot khokh'ed kard va [ei paiombar, dar borai ne'matkh'oi ilokh'i] ba mu'minon bashorat bidekh'
Va Allokh'ro dastovezi savgandkh'oi khud k'aror nadikh'ed, to [ba in bakh'ona] az nakukori va parkh'ezkorivu oshti dodan miioni mardum [dast bardored]; va [bidoned, ki] Allokh' taolo shunavovu donost

Allokh' taolo shumoro ba khotiri savgandkh'oe, ki bekh'uda va biduni kasd iod mekuned, bozpursi namekunad, vale ba khotiri on chi dilkh'oiaton [amdan] kasb kardaast [va savgandkh'oi durug'e, ki ogokh'ona bar zabon ovardaed] bozkhost mekunad va [agar tavba kuned] Allokh' taolo omurzandai burdbor ast

Baroi kasone, ki [ba rasmi ch'okh'iliiat] bar tarki omezish bo zanoni khud savgand iod kunand, chakh'or mokh' intizor [va mukh'lat] ast. Pas, agar [dar muddati chakh'or mokh' io kamtar pushaimon shudand va ba zanonashon] bozgashtand, [bidonand, ki] Allokh' taolo omurzandai mekh'rubon ast
Va agar [bar tarki zanonashon pofishori kunand va] tasmim ba talok' giriftand, [bidonand, ki] kh'amono Allokh' taolo shunavovu donost

Zanoni talok'shuda [pesh az izdivoch'i much'addad] boiad ba muddati se bor poki [didani se bor odati mokh'ona] intizor bikashand; va agar ba Allokh' taolo va ruzi k'iiomat imon dorand, bar onon ravo nest, ki on chiro Allokh' taolo dar rakh'imkh'oiashon ofaridaast, kitmon kunand; va agar shavkh'aronashon khokh'oni oshti kh'astand, baroi bozgardondani onon [ba zindagii zanoshui] dar in [muddat az digaron] sazovortarand; va zanon kh'uk'uk'i shoistae dorand, kh'ammonand [-u kh'amsangii vazoife], ki bar ukh'da dorand va mardon [dar sarparastivu amri talok'] bar onon bartari dorand; va Allokh' taolo shikastnopaziru kh'akim ast

Talok' [-i rach''i] du bor ast; pas, [az on mard io boiad kh'amsarashro] ba tarzi shoista nigokh' dorad, io ba neki rakh'o kunad; va [ei mardoni musulmon] baroiaton kh'alol nest, ki [zarrae] az on chiro ba onon dodaed [makh'riia va monandi on] pas bigired, magar on ki [zanu shavkh'ar] bitarsand, ki natavonand [kh'uk'uk'i zanoshuivu] kh'ududi ilokh'iro barpo dorand; pas, [kh'alli ikhtilofro ba kheshovandon io dustoni khud mesuporand; va shumo ei mu'minon] agar tarsided, ki [mumkin ast zavch'ain] kh'ududi ilokh'iro barpo nadorand, gunokh'e bar on du nest, ki zan [baroi rozi kardani mard ba talok' makh'riiaashro bibakhshad io ba u] fidiae bipardozad [va talok'i khul' bigirad]. Inkh'o kh'ududi [akh'komi] ilokh'i ast; pas, az onkh'o tach'ovuz nakuned; va kh'ar ki az kh'ududi Allokh' taolo tach'ovuz kunad, pas chunin odamon, beshak, sitamgoronand.

Agar [shavkh'ar baroi bori savum] uro talok' dod, pas az on [zan] baroiash kh'alol nest; magar in ki [bo k'asdi izdivoch'i kh'ak'ik'i va na baroi kh'alol shudan] bo shavkh'ari g'air az u izdivoch' kunad [va bo vai kh'ambistar shavad. Dar in surat] Agar [shavkh'ari ba'di favt kard io] uro talok' dod, agar [du kh'amsari sobik'] mepindorand, ki kh'ududi [akh'komi] Allokh'ro barpo medorand, gunokh'e bar on du nest, ki [bo izdivoch'i much'addad] ba iakdigar bozgardand. Inkh'o kh'ududi Allokh' taolo ast, ki onkh'oro baroi mardume, ki ogokh'and [va ba islom imon dorand], baion mekunad

Va kh'angome ki zanonro talok' [-i rach''i] doded va ba poioni [ruzkh'oi] iddai khesh rasidand, ba shoistagi ononro nigakh' dored va io ba nekivu khubi rakh'oiashon sozed; va [kh'amchun davroni ch'okh'iliiat] ononro ba khotiri [ozoru] ziion rasondan nigakh' nadored, to [ba kh'uk'uk'ashon] tach'ovuz kuned; va kh'ar ki chunin kunad, kh'atman ba khud sitam kardaast; va oioti Allokh'ro ba sukhra [lakh'vu la'b] nagired va ne'mati Allokh'ro bar khud va on chiro, ki az kitob [K'ur'on] va kh'ikmat bar shumo nozil kardaast va shumoro bo on pand medikh'ad, ba iod biiovared va az Allokh' taolo parvo kuned va bidoned, ki Allokh' taolo ba kh'ama chiz donost

Va kh'angome ki zanonro talok' doded va [muddate] iddai khudro ba poion rasondand, [shumo, ei sarparaston] ononro boz nadored, ki agar [bar asosi me'iorkh'oi shar'i] ba tarzi pisandidae baini khesh ba tavofuk' rasida budand, bo shavkh'aroni [sobik'i] khud izdivoch' kunand. In [dasture ast], ki kh'ar iake az shumo, ki ba Allokh' taolo va ruzi k'iiomat imon dorad, ba on [kh'ukm] pand doda meshavad; va in [dastur] baroiaton purbarakattar va pokizatar ast; va Allokh' taolo [khairu salokh'i shumoro] medonad va shumo namedoned

Va modaron [boiad] farzandoni khudro du soli tamom shir dikh'and. [In dastur] Baroi kasest, ki bikhokh'ad davroni shirkhoragi [-i farzandash]-ro takmil kunad; va bar sokh'ibi farzand [padar] lozim ast khuroku pushoki onon [modaron]-ro [dar muddati shir dodan] ba tavri shoista [farokh'am kunad]. Kh'ech' kas ch'uz ba andozai tavonoiash mukallaf nameshavad; na modar boiad ba khotiri farzandash ziion bubinad va na padar ba sababi farzandash. [Agar padari kudak favt karda bud va mole kh'am nadosht] Monandi kh'amin [taakh'kh'udoti padar] bar voris [niz] lozim ast; pas, agar on du [padaru modar] bo rizoiatu mashvarati iakdigar bikhokh'and [kudakro zudtar] az shir bozgirand, gunokh'e bar onkh'o nest; va agar khosted, ki baroi farzandaton doiae bigired, gunokh'e bar shumo nest; ba sharte ki on chi [az kh'uk'uk'u dastmuzd] muk'arrar kardaed, ba tavri shoista bipardozed; va az Allokh' taolo parvo kuned va bidoned, ki Allokh' taolo ba on chi anch'om medikh'ed binost

Va afrode az shumo, ki memirand va kh'amsaron [-i g'airi bordor az khud] bok'i meguzorand, [on zanon baroi izdivoch'i much'addad] boiad chakh'or mokh' va dakh' ruz intizor bikashand [va idda nigakh' dorand] va kh'angome ki muddati iddai khudro ba poion rasonidand, dar mavridi on chi onon ba tavri shoista [va mashru'] dar borai [zindagii] khud anch'om dikh'and, gunokh'e bar shumo [sarparaston] nest; va Allokh' taolo ba on chi mekuned, ogokh' ast

Va gunokh'e bar shumo nest, ki ba tavri kinoia az zanoni [beva io talok'shudae, ki idda nigakh' doshtaand] khostgori kuned va io dar dil tasmim bar in kor bigired [biduni in ki onro baion kuned]. Allokh' taolo medonist, ki shumo ba zudi ba iodi onon khokh'ed aftod; vale pinkh'oni ba onkh'o va'da [-i zanoshui] nadikh'ed, magar in ki [ba kinoia] sukhani pisandida bigued va [kh'amchunin] tasmim ba ak'di izdivoch' nagired, to muddati muk'arrar [idda] ba sar oiad; va bidoned, ki Allokh' taolo on chiro, ki dar dilkh'oi shumost, medonad; pas, az [mukholifat bo] U parvo kuned va bidoned, ki ba rosti Allokh' taolo omurzandai burdbor ast

Agar zanonro pesh az omezish va ta'iini makh'riia [ba daloile] talok' dikh'ed, gunokh'e bar shumo nest va [dar in surat dilch'ui kuned va] ononro [bo kh'adiai munosib] bakh'ramand sozed; tavongar ba andozai tavonash va tangdast ba andozai tavonash. [Ich'roi in kh'ukm] Bar nakukoron [kh'ak'k'i sobit va] ilzomist

Agar pesh az nazdiki bo onon khosted talok'ashon bidikh'ed va makh'riiae baroiashon ta'iin karda buded, nisfi on chiro, ki ta'iin kardaed [ba onon bipardozed]; magar in ki [kh'ak'k'i khudro] bibakhshand io [shavkh'ar, ia'ne] kase, ki [tasmimgiri dar mavridi] paivandi izdivoch' bo ust, guzasht kunad [va tamomi makh'riiaro bipardozad]. Guzasht kardani shumo [va bakhshidani tamomi makh'riia ba zanon] ba parkh'ezkori nazdiktar ast. [Ei mu'minon, kh'angomi pardokhti kh'uk'uk', osongiri va] nekiro miioni khud faromush nakuned [va bidoned, ki] ba rosti Allokh' taolo ba on chi mekuned binost
[Ei musulmonon] bar [anch'omi] kh'ama namozkh'o va [ba khusus] namozi asr kusho boshed [sa'iu talosh kuned] va bo furutanivu farmonbardori baroi Allokh' taolo ba po khezed

Agar [az khatar] tarsided, dar kh'oli piioda io savora [io kh'atto bo imo va ishora namozro ba ch'oi ovared] va chun emin shuded, Allokh'ro [chunonki ba shumo omukhtaast] iod kuned [va shukrashro ba ch'o ovared], ki on chiro namedonisted ba shumo iod dod

Kasone az shumo, ki margashon faro merasad va kh'amsarone [az khud] ba ch'o meguzorand, boiad baroi kh'amsaronashon vasiiat kunand, ki [vorison] to iak sol ononro [bo pardokhtani kharch'i zindagi] bakh'ramand sozand, biduni on ki [az khonai shavkh'ar] berun kunand. Pas, agar [ba maili khud pesh az poioni iak sol khonaro tark kunand va] berun biravand, dar borai on chi, ki nisbat ba [zokh'ir va zindagii] khud ba tavri shoista [va mashru'] anch'om medikh'and [az k'abili zinat kardan va izdivoch'i much'addad] gunokh'e bar shumo nest; va Allokh' taolo shikastnopaziru kh'akim ast

Va baroi zanoni talok'shuda kh'adiai munosibu shoista lozim ast [ki az tarafi shavkh'ar pardokhta shavad, to dilshikastagiash ch'ubron gardad. Ich'roi in kh'ukm], kh'ak'k'e ast bar mardoni parkh'ezkor
[Ei mu'minon] Allokh' taolo oioti khudro [ki mushtamal bar kh'udud va akh'kom ast] inchunin baroiaton ba ravshani baion mekunad; boshad, ki biiandeshed

[Ei paiombar] Oio namedoni, [dostoni] afrode [az bani Isroil]-ro, ki kh'azoron nafar budand, ki az tarsi [bemori va] marg az khonakh'oiashon firor kardand? Allokh' taolo ba onon guft: Bimired [pas murdand]. Sipas Allokh' taolo onkh'oro zinda kard [to baroiashon ravshan gardonad, ki tamomi korkh'o ba dasti Ust]. Ba rosti, ki Allokh' taolo nisbat ba bandagonash bakhshoish dorad, vale beshtari mardum shukr [-i ne'matkh'o] -ashro ba ch'oi nameovarand
Va [ei mu'minon] dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo bich'anged va bidoned, ki be tardid Allokh' taolo shunavovu donost

Kist, ki ba Allokh' taolo k'arz dikh'ad; k'arzi naku [va az amvolash dar rokh'i khushnudii Parvardigor infok' kunad], to [Allokh' taolo] onro baroiash chandin barobar kunad? Va Allokh' taolo ast, ki [az ruii kh'ikmat va adolat, dar ruzii bandagonash] tangi va kushoish padid meovarad va [kh'amagi dar okhirat] ba suii U bozgardonda meshaved

[Ei paiombar] Oio [az dostoni] gurukh'e az [ashrofu buzurgoni] Bani Isroil khabar dori, ki ba'd az Muso ba paiombari khud guftand: "Farmonravoe baroiamon intikhob kun, to [ba dasturash] dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo bich'angem"? [Paiombarashon] Guft: "Shoiad agar ch'ikh'od bar shumo muk'arrar shavad, [sarpechi kuned va] ch'ikh'od nakuned". Guftand: "Charo dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo ch'ikh'od nakunem, dar kh'ole ki az khonakh'oiamon ronda shudaem va pisaronamon [-ro kushtaand io ba asorat burdaand]"? Pas, kh'angome ki ch'ang bar eshon muk'arrar shud - ch'uz iddai kame az onon - [kh'amagi] sarpechi kardand; va Allokh' taolo ba [kh'oli paimonshikanon va] sitamgoron donost

Paiombarashon ba onon guft: "Allokh' taolo Tolutro ba farmonravoii shumo barguzidaast". [Onon] guftand: "Chi guna u bar mo farmonravoi mekunad, dar kh'ole ki mo ba farmonravoi az u sazovortarem va az mol [-i dunio niz] bakh'rai chandone [ba vai] doda nashudaast"? U guft: "Ba rosti, ki Allokh' taolo uro bar shumo barguzida va donishu nerui ch'ismiashro vus'at bakhshidaast; va Allokh' taolo farmonravoii khudro ba kh'ar ki bikhokh'ad medikh'ad va Allokh' taolo kushoishgaru donost"

Paiombarashon ba onkh'o guft: Nishonai [rosti va durustii] farmonravoii u, in ast, ki tobuti akh'd baroiaton merasad, ki moiai oromishe az suii Parvardigoraton meboshad va darunash bozmondai merosi khonadoni Muso va Kh'orun [kh'amchun aso va barkhe alvokh'i Tavrot] k'aror dorad va dar kh'ole merasad, ki farishtagon onro bardoshtaand. Agar mu'min boshed, musallaman dar in [amr] nishonae [dar mavridi kh'ak'k'oniiati Tolut] baroiaton vuch'ud dorad

Pas, kh'angome ki Tolut bo lashkariion rakh'sipor shud, ba onon guft: "Allokh' taolo [shikeboii] shumoro ba vasilai iak nakh'r [ob] ozmoish mekunad; kh'ar ki az on binushad, az [ioroni] man nest va kh'ar ki az on nanushad, kh'atman az [ioroni] man ast; magar kase, ki bo dasti khud mushte [az on ob] bargirad [va ba andozai kafi daste bioshomad]". Pas, ch'uz iddai kame kh'amagi az on [ob] nushidand; va kh'angome ki u va kasone, ki bo u imon ovarda budand, az on [nakh'r] guzashtand, [az kamii afrodi khud norokh'at shudand va barkhe] guftand: "Imruz mo tavonoii [muk'obiliiat] bo Ch'olut va sipokh'iionashro nadorem". [Dar in kh'angom kasone, ki ba didori Allokh' taolo [dar okhirat] iak'in doshtand, guftand: "Chi baso gurukh'i kuchake, ki ba farmoni Allokh' taolo bar gurukh'i bisior piruz shudand va [bidoned, ki kh'amvora] Allokh' taolo kh'amrokh'i sabrkunandagon ast"

Va kh'angome ki [Tolut va kh'amrokh'onash] baroi [muboriza] bo Ch'olut va sipokh'iionash ba maidon omadand, guftand: "Parvardigoro, bar [dilkh'oi] mo sabru shikeboi furu rez va gomkh'oiamonro ustuvor bidor va moro bar gurukh'i kofiron piruz gardon"

Pas, ba farmoni Allokh' taolo, onkh'oro shikast dodand va Dovud [ch'avoni nerumandu shuch'oe, ki dar lashkari Tolut bud] Ch'olutro kusht va Allokh' taolo farmonravoivu nubuvvatro ba u bakhshid va az on chi mekhost, ba u omukht; va agar Allokh' taolo [fitnai] barkhe az mardumro tavassuti barkhi digar [dur namekard] namerond, kh'atman zamin tabokh' megardid; vale Allokh' taolo bar ch'akh'oniion bakhshish dorad
[Ei paiombar] Inkh'o oioti Allokh' taolo ast, ki onro ba kh'ak' bar tu mekhonem va ba rosti, tu az paiombaron kh'asti

In paiombaron [ki nomi barkhe az onon guzasht] barkhe az eshonro [dar dariofti vakh'i va te'dodi pairavon] bar barkhe digar bartari dodem. Az [miioni] eshon kase [kh'amchun] bud, ki Allokh' taolo bo u sukhan guft va darach'oti barkhe [digar] az ononro bolo burd; va ba Iso pisari Mariam nishonakh'oi ravshane [bar isboti nubuvvatash] dodem va uro tavassuti Rukh'ulk'udus [Ch'abrail] ta'iid [va tak'viiat] kardem; va agar Allokh' taolo mekhost, kasone, ki ba'd az onkh'o budand, pas az on [kh'ama] nishonakh'oi ravshane, ki baroiashon omad, bo iakdigar ch'ang namekardand; vale [bo kh'am] ikhtilof kardand va barkhe az onon imon ovardand va barkhe kufr varzidand; va agar Allokh' taolo mekhost, [kh'argiz] bo kh'am namech'angidand; vale Allokh' taolo on chiro mekhokh'ad, anch'om medikh'ad

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, az on chi ba shumo ruzi dodaem, infok' kuned, pesh az on ki ruze faro rasad, ki dar on na kharidu furushe kh'ast va na dustivu shafoate; va kofiron [ba sababi kufrashon] kh'amon sitamgoronand

Allokh' taolo [ma'budi rostin ast] kh'ech' ma'bude [ba kh'ak'] ch'uz U nest; zindai poianda [va k'oim ba zot] ast; na khobi sabuk [g'anav, pinak] Uro faro megirad va na khobi sangin; on chi dar osmonkh'o va zamin ast, az oni Ust. Kist, ki dar nazdi U ch'uz ba farmonash shafoat kunad?! Guzashta va oiandai eshon [bandagon]-ro medonad va [onon] ba chize az ilmi U ikh'ota [va ogokh'i] nameioband, magar on chi khud bikhokh'ad. Kursii U osmonkh'o va zaminro dar bar giriftaast va nigakh' doshtani onkh'o bar U [sanginu] dushvor nest va U balandmartaba [va] buzurg ast

Dar [pazirishi] din, kh'ech' ich'bore nest; ba rosti, ki rokh'i rost [va kh'idoiat] az rokh'i inkh'irof [va gumrokh'i] ravshan shudaast; pas, kh'ar kas ba tog'ut [on chi ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo parastish meshavad] kufr bivarzad va ba Allokh' taolo imon ovarad, kh'atman, ba makh'kamtarin dastovez chang zadaast, ki kh'argiz nakhokh'ad gusast; va Allokh' taolo shunavovu donost

Allokh' taolo iovar [va korsozi] kasone ast, ki imon ovardaand; ononro az torikikh'o ba suii nur berun mebarad; va kasone, ki kofir shudand, [korsoz va] iovarashon tog'ut ast, [ki] ononro az nur [-i imon va ilm] ba suii torikikh'o [-i kufru nodoni] berun mebarad. Onon akh'li otashand [va] dar on ch'ovidonand

[Ei paiombar], oio [dostoni] on shakhsro nadonistai, ki az [sari masti] on ki Allokh' taolo bar u farmonravoi bakhshida bud bo Ibrokh'im dar borai Parvardigorash much'odala mekard? Kh'angome ki Ibrokh'im guft: "Parvardigori man kase ast, ki zinda mekunad va memironad". [Namrud] Guft: "Man [niz] zinda mekunam va memironam". Ibrokh'im guft: "Allokh' taolo khurshedro az mashrik' [berun] meovarad, pas, tu onro az mag'rib biiovar". [Dar in ch'o] On ki kufr varzida bud, mabkh'ut shud; va Allokh' taolo sitamgoronro kh'idoiat namekunad

Io kh'amchun on, ki az shakh'r [-i vaironu matruk] guzasht, ki sak'fkh'o va devorkh'oiash furu rekhta bud. [U bo khud] Guft: "Chi guna Allokh' taolo [akh'li] in [diior] - ro pas az margashon zinda mekunad"? Pas Allokh' taolo uro [ba muddati] sad sol mironid, [va] sipas zinda kard [va ba u] guft: "Chand muddat [dar in kh'ol] mondai"? Guft: "Iak ruz io bakhshe az iak ruz [dar in kh'ol] mondaam". Farmud: "Chunin nest; sad sol [dar chunin kh'ole] mondai. Ba khurdanivu nushidaniat bingar, ki bo guzashti zamon digargun nashudaast va ba darozgushi khud bingar [ki chi guna mutaloshi shudaast. Mo chunin kardem to ba suolat posukh guem] va turo baroi mardum nishonae [dar mavridi k'iiomat] k'aror dikh'em. [Aknun] Ba ustukhonkh'oi on [kh'aivon] nigokh' kun, ki chi guna onkh'oro ba kh'am paivand medikh'em va sipas gushte bar on mepushonem". Pas, kh'angome ki [k'udrati ilokh'i bar zinda kardani murdagon] baroiash oshkor shud, guft: "[Ba iak'in] Medonam, ki Allokh' taolo bar kh'ar kore tavonost"

Va [Ei paiombar, iod kun az] kh'angome ki Ibrokh'im guft: "Parvardigoro, ba man nishon bidekh', chi guna murdagonro zinda mekuni"? [Allokh' taolo] Farmud: "Magar imon naiovardai"? Guft: "Bale, vale [mekhokh'am] k'albam orom bigirad". Farmud: "Pas, chakh'or parranda bigir [va bikush] va pora - pora kun [va dar kh'am biiomez], sipas bar kh'ar kukh'e porae az onkh'oro bigzor, [va] ongokh' onkh'oro [ba suii khud] faro khon; [khokh'i did, ki zinda meshavand va] shitobon ba suii tu meoiand; va [ei Ibrokh'im], bidon, ki Allokh' taolo shikastnopaziru kh'akim ast"
