Masali [ach'ru savobi] kasone, ki amvoli khudro dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo infok' mekunand, kh'ammonandi donaest, ki kh'aft khusha meruionad, ki dar kh'ar khusha sad dona ast; va Allokh' taolo baroi kh'ar ki bikhokh'ad, [podoshashro] chand barobar mekunad va Allokh' taolo kushoishgaru donost

Kasone, ki amvolashonro dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo mebakhshand va dar paii bakhshishi khud minnatu ozor ravo namedorand, podoshashon nazdi Parvardigorashon [makh'fuz] ast; na tarse khokh'and dosht va na andukh'gin meshavand
Sukhani pisandida [dar barkhurd bo niiozmandon] va guzasht [az isroru tundii onon], bekh'tar az sadak'ae ast, ki ozore ba dunbolash boshad; va Allokh' taolo beniiozu burdbor ast

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, sadak'akh'oi khudro bo minnatu ozor botil nakuned, kh'amchun kase, ki moli khudro baroi namoish dodan ba mardum infok' mekunad va ba Allokh'u ruzi k'iiomat imon nadorad; pas, masali u kh'amchun masali sangi sofest, ki ruii on [andake] khok nishastaast; on gokh' boroni tunde bar on mezanad [va kh'amai khokkh'oro az sang meshuiad] va onro sof [-u biduni khok] rakh'o mekunad. Onon [riiokoron] az on chi, ki anch'om dodaand, chize ba dast nameovarand; va Allokh' taolo gurukh'i kofironro kh'idoiat namekunad

Va masali kasone, ki amvoli khudro baroi talabi khushnudii Allokh' taolo va ba khotiri bovare, ki dar dilkh'oiashon [ba podoshi Allokh' taolo] dorand, infok' mekunand, kh'amchun bustone bar teppae ast, ki boroni tunde bar on borad va mevakh'oiashro duchandon ba bor ovarad; va agar boroni tunde kh'am ba on narasad, boroni sabuk [niz zamini pokashro pursamar mesozad]; va Allokh' taolo az on chi mekuned, ogokh' ast

Oio kh'ech' iak az shumo dust dorad, ki bog'e az darakhtoni khurmo va angur doshta boshad, ki az zeri onkh'o ch'uiborkh'o [-i guvoro] ravon ast va kh'ar guna meva baroiash ba bor meovarad va [ammo] dar kh'ole ki ba sinni piri rasida va farzandon [-i khurdsol] va notavon dorad, nogakh'on girdbodi otashin dar on zanadu [kh'amai bog'] bisuzad? [Kh'oli kasone, ki sadak'akh'oi khudro bo minnatu ozor va riio botil mekunand niz chunin ast]. Allokh' taolo bad-in guna oiot [-i khud]-ro baroi shumo ravshan mesozad; boshad, ki biandeshed

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, az chizkh'oi pokizae, ki ba dast ovardaed va az on chi az zamin baroi shumo barovardaem, infok' kuned; va ba surog' [-i moli] nopok naraved, ki az on infok' namoed; dar kh'ole ki khudaton kh'ozir ba paziruftanash nested, magar bo chashmpushi [va bemaili] nisbat ba on; [pas, chi guna chizero, ki baroi khud namepisanded, baroi Allokh' taolo ravo medored]? Va bidoned, ki Allokh' taolo beniiozu sutuda ast

Shaiton shumoro [ba kh'angomi infok' metarsonad va] va'dai tikh'idasti medikh'ad va shumoro ba zishtikh'o [gunokh' namudan] amr mekunad; vale Allokh' taolo az ch'onibi khud ba shumo va'dai omurzish va afzuni [-i ne'mat] medikh'ad va Allokh' taolo kushoishgaru donost

[Allokh' taolo] Ba kh'ar ki bikhokh'ad, kh'ikmat [rosti dar guftor va kirdor] medikh'ad va be tardid, ba kh'ar ki kh'ikmat doda shavad, khairi farovone ato shudaast; va ba ch'uz khiradmandon [az oioti ilokh'i] pand namegirand

Kh'ar chize, ki infok' kuned io kh'ar nazre, ki [bo khud] akh'd kuned, kh'atman, Allokh' taolo onro medonad [Kh'ar ki az ich'roi farmudakh'oi ilokh'i ch'ilavgiri kunad, sitamgor ast] va sitamgoron [dar okhirat] kh'ech' iovare nadorand

Agar sadak'akh'oro oshkor kuned, chi nakust! Va agar onkhoro pinkh'on dored va ba tikh'idaston bidikh'ed, baroiaton bekh'tar ast va [in guna sadak'ai kholisona va pinkh'oni] az gunokh'onaton mezudoiad; va [bidoned, ki dar kh'ama surat] Allokh' taolo ba on chi mekuned, ogokh' ast

[Ei paiombar] Kh'idoiati onon bar ukh'dai tu nest; balki Allokh' taolo kh'ar kiro bikhokh'ad kh'idoiat mekunad; va [ei mu'minon] on chi az moli [khud] infok' mekuned, ba sudi khudaton ast va [ba iod doshta boshed, ki] ch'uz baroi khushnudii Allokh' taolo infok' nakuned; va on chi az mol infok' mekuned, [podoshash] ba tavri komil va tamom ba shumo doda meshavad va [kh'argiz] sitam nakhokh'ed did

[Sadak'oti shumo] Baroi afrodi tangdaste ast, ki khudro vak'f [-i ch'ikh'od] dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo kardaand va nametavonand [baroi ta'mini kharch'kh'oi zindagi] dar zamin safar kunand. Az shiddati [nach'obat va] kheshtandori afrodi noogokh' ononro beniioz mepindorand. Eshonro az nishonakh'oiashon [ki dar libosu vaz'iiati zokh'iriashon oshkor ast, ba tavri oshkor] meshinosi [va onon kh'argiz] bo isror chize az mardum namekhokh'and; va on chi az mol infok' mekuned, kh'atman, Allokh' taolo az on ogokh' ast
Kasone, ki amvoli khudro dar shabu ruz, pinkh'onu oshkor infok' mekunand, podoshashon nazdi Parvardigorashon [makh'fuz] ast; na tarse khokh'and dosht va na andukh'gin meshavand

Kasone, ki ribo mekhurand, [ruzi k'iiomat az k'abr] barnamekhezand; magar monandi barkhostani kase, ki bar asari tamosi shaiton devona shudaast va [nametavonad taoduli khudro kh'ifz kunad]. In bad-on sabab ast, ki onon [ribokhoron] guftand: "Dodu sitad niz monandi ribost [va in kh'ar du molro afzun mekunad]"; dar kh'ole ki Allokh' taolo, dodu sitadro kh'alol va riboro kh'arom namudaast. Pas, kh'ar ki az [ch'onibi] Parvardigorash pande ba u birasad va [az ribokhori] dast bardorad, on chi guzashta va [sudkh'oe, ki k'abl az nuzuli kh'ukmi ribo darioft kardaast] az oni ust va [dar mavridi oianda niz] korash ba Allokh' taolo voguzor meshavad; va [ammo] kasone, ki [ba ribokhori] bozmegardand, akh'li otashand va dar on ch'ovidonand

Allokh' taolo riboro nobud [va bebarakat] megardonad va sadak'otro [bo izofa kardan bar savobash] afzoish [va barakat] medikh'ad; va Allokh' taolo kh'ech' kofiri lach'uch'u gunakh'gorero dust namedorad

Kasone, ki imon ovardaand va korkh'oi shoista anch'om dodaand va namoz barpo doshtaand va zakot pardokhtaand, podoshashon nazdi Parvardigorashon [makh'fuz] ast; na tarse khokh'and dosht va na andukh'gin meshavand
Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, az Allokh' taolo parvo kuned [bitarsed] va agar mu'min kh'asted, on chiro, ki az [mutoliboti] ribo bok'i mondaast, rakh'o kuned

Agar [chunin] nakarded, bidoned, ki Allokh' taolo va rasulash bo shumo paikor khokh'and kard; va agar tavba karded, asli sarmoiakh'oiaton az oni shumost; na [bo giriftani sudi sarmoiaaton ba kase] sitam mekuned va na [bo chashmpushi az on sudi kh'arom] bar shumo sitam meravad

Va agar [shakhsi k'arzdor] tangdast buvad, to [kh'angomi] kushoish [va tavonoii bozpardokht ba u] mukh'lat dikh'ed va [agar tavonoii pardokht nadosht], bakhshidani on [k'arz] baroiaton bekh'tar ast, agar [savobi in korro] bidoned
Va az [azobi] ruze bitarsed, ki dar on ba suii Allokh' taolo bozgardonda meshaved; sipas ba kh'ar kas [podoshi] on chi anch'om dodaast, ba tavri komil doda meshavad va ba onon sitam nakhokh'ad shud

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, agar ba kh'amdigar vome [pardokhted io muomilai nasiiae anch'om] doded, ki sarrasidi muaiiane dosht, onro binavised; va boiad navisanda [k'arordodi in korro] bar asosi adolat baini shumo binavisad va kh'ech' navisandae naboiad az navishtanash khuddori kunad, kh'amon guna [va ba shukronai on], ki Allokh' taolo ba u omuzish dodaast; va kase, ki vom bar ukh'dai ust [k'arzdor] boiad imlo kunad va u [navisanda] binavisad; va boiad az Allokh' taolo, ki Parvardigori ust, biparkh'ezad va az [mablag' va muddati] on [vom] chize nakokh'ad. Agar kase, ki vom bar ukh'dai ust, safekh' [kudak io devona] io notavon ast io khud nametavonad imlo kunad, boiad sarparasti u bo [rioiati] adolat imlo kunad va du shokh'id az mardonatonro [bar on k'arordod] guvokh' bigired. Agar du mard naboshad, iak mardu du zan az miioni guvokh'one, ki [ba adolati onon] rizoiiat dored [guvokh' bigired], to agar iake az on du [zan] faromush kard, digare ba u iodovari kunad; va kh'angome ki guvokh'on [baroi adoi shakh'odat] da'vat shavand, naboiad [az omadan] khuddori kunand. Va az navishtani [k'arz] to sarrasidash [ozurda va] dilgir nashaved, khokh' [mablag'ash] kam boshad khokh' ziiod. In [kor] dar nazdi Allokh' taolo ba adolat nazdiktar va baroi guvokh'i dodan ustuvortar va baroi on, ki [dar mik'dor va muddati vom] duchori tardid nashaved, [ba adolat] nazdiktar ast; magar in ki dodu sitadi nak'di boshad, ki baini khud dast ba dast mekuned. Dar in surat gunokh'e bar shumo nest, ki onro nanavised; va kh'angome ki dodu sitad [-i nak'di] karded, guvokh' bigired va [dar in miion] naboiad ba navisanda va guvokh' [kh'ech'] ranch'u ziione birasad; va agar [chunin] kuned; be shak [baiongari] nofarmonii shumo khokh'ad bud; va [ei mu'minon], az Allokh' taolo parvo kuned [va muomilotro ba kh'amon shakle, ki amr mekunad, anch'om dikh'ed]. Allokh' taolo [on chiro, ki baroi dunio va okhirataton sudmand ast] ba shumo omuzish medikh'ad va Allokh' taolo ba kh'ar chiz donost

Agar dar safar buded va navisandae naiofted [ki sanadi vomro binavisad, chize] garav bigired va agar iake az shumo digarero amin donist [va chize garav nagirift va navishtavu guvokh'e niz nadosht], on ki amin shumurda shudaast, boiad amonat [va k'arzi] khudro bozpas dikh'ad va boiad az Allokh' taolo, ki Parvardigori ust, parvo kunad; va shakh'odatro kitmon nakuned va [bidoned, ki] kh'ar kase onro kitmon kunad, be shak, k'albash gunakh'kor ast; va Allokh' taolo ba on chi mekuned, donost

On chi dar osmonkh'o va zamin ast, az oni Allokh' taolo ast. Agar on chiro dar dili khud dored, oshkor kuned io pinkh'onash namoed, Allokh' taolo shumoro bar [asosi] on mukh'osiba [bozpursi] mekunad; pas, [bar asosi bakhshish va rakh'mati khesh] kh'ar kiro bikhokh'ad, mebakhshad va [az ruii adolat va kh'ikmatash niz] kh'ar kiro bikhokh'ad, azob mekunad; va Allokh' taolo bar [anch'omi] kh'ar kore tavonost

Rasul [-i Allokh' taolo] ba on chi az [suii] Parvardigorash bar u nozil shuda, imon ovardaast va mu'minon [niz] kh'amagi ba Allokh' taolo va farishtagonu kitobkh'o va paiombaronash imon ovardaand; [va sukhanashon in ast, ki]: "Miioni kh'ech' iak az paiombaronash [dar imon ba eshon] tafovute nameguzorem" va guftand: "Shunidem va itoat kardem. Parvardigoro, omurzishi Turo [khokh'onem] va bozgashti [tamomi umur] ba suii Tust"

Allokh' taolo kh'ech' kasro ch'uz ba andozai tavonash taklif [ukh'dador] namekunad. On chi [az khubi] ba dast ovardaast ba sudi ust va on chi [az badi] kasb kardaast, ba ziioni ust. [Paiombaron va mu'minon guftand:] "Parvardigoro, agar faromush io khato kardem, moro bozkhost makun. Parvardigoro, bori garon [va taklifi sangin] bar [dushi] mo magzor; chunon ki onro [ba much'ozoti gunokh' va sarkashi] bar [dushi] kasone, ki pesh az mo budand [iakh'udiion] nikh'odi. Parvardigoro, on chi, ki tobi takh'ammulashro nadorem, bar [dushi] mo magzor va moro biiomurz va ba mo rakh'm kun. Tu ior [-u korsozi] moi; pas, moro bar gurukh'i kofiron piruz gardon"
ALM [Alif, Lom, Mim]
Allokh' taolo [ma'budi rostin] ast, ki kh'ech' ma'bude [ba kh'ak'] ch'uz U nest; zindai poianda [va k'oim ba zot] ast
In kitob [K'ur'on]-ro, ki ta'iidkunandai kitobkh'oi [osmonii] peshin ast, ba durusti bar tu nozil kard va Tavrotu Inch'ilro...

Pesh az on [Tavrotu Inch'ilro] baroi kh'idoiati mardum nozil kard; va [niz] Furk'onro [K'ur'on, ki ch'udokunandai kh'ak' az botil ast] nozil namud. Kasone, ki ba oioti Allokh' taolo kofir shudand, azobi sakhte [dar pesh] dorand; va Allokh' taolo shikastnopazir [-u] intik'omgiranda ast
Be tardid, kh'ech' chiz - [na] dar zamin va na dar osmon - az Allokh' taolo pushida namemonad
Ust, ki shumoro kh'ar guna ki bikhokh'ad dar rakh'imkh'o shakl medikh'ad. Kh'ech' ma'bude [ba kh'ak'] ch'uz U shikastnopaziru kh'akim nest

[Ei paiombar] Ust, ki kitob [-i K'ur'on]-ro bar tu nozil kard. Bakhshe az on oioti mukh'kam [sarekh'u ravshan] ast, ki onkh'o asosi kitobandu [bakhshi] digar mutashobekh'ot ast [ki ta'vilpazirand]; ammo kasone, ki dar dilkh'oiashon inkh'irof ast, baroi fitnach'ui [va gumrokh' kardani mardum] va ba khotiri ta'vili on [ba dilkhokh'i khud], az mutashobekh'i on pairavi mekunand; kh'ol on ki ta'vilashro [kase] ch'uz Allokh' taolo namedonad; va rosikhoni dar ilm [ulamoi din] meguiand: "Mo ba kh'amai on [oiot, chi mukh'kamu chi mutashobekh'] imon ovardem; kh'ama az tarafi Parvardigori most"; va ch'uz khiradmandon kase pand namegirad

Onon meguiand: "Parvardigoro, dilkh'oi moro - ba'd az on, ki kh'idoiatamon kardi - [az rokh'i kh'ak'] munkh'arif magardon va az suii khud rakh'mate ba mo arzoni dor, [ki] be tardid, Tu bisior bakhshandai
Parvardigoro, beshak, Tu mardumro baroi ruze, ki dar [omadani] on tardid nest, ch'am' khokh'i kard. Kh'atman, Allokh' taolo dar va'dai [khud] khilof namekunad"
Dar kh'ak'ik'at, kasone, ki kufr varzidand, amvolu farzandonashon chize az [azobi] Allokh'ro az onon dur nakhokh'ad kard va onon khud kh'ezumi otash [-i duzakh] kh'astand

[Shevai in kofiron] Kh'amchun shevai khonadoni Fir'avn va [ravishi] kasonest, ki pesh az onkh'o budand: Oioti moro takzib kardand; pas, Allokh' taolo ononro ba [sazoi] gunokh'onashon azob kard; va Allokh' taolo [nisbat ba kofiron] sakhtkaifar ast
Ba kasone, ki kufr varzidand, bigu: "Ba zudi [az mu'minon] shikast khokh'ed khurd va [on gokh' dar k'iiomat] ba suii ch'akh'annam makh'shur meshaved; va chi bad ch'oigokh'e ast"!

Kh'atman, dar [ruioruii] du gurukh'e, ki [dar Badr] bo kh'am rubaru shudand, nishona [va ibrat]-e baroi shumo bud; iak gurukh' dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo mech'angid va [gurukh'i] digar kofiron budand. Onkh'o ba chashmi khud [mu'minonro] du barobari on chi budand, medidand; va Allokh' taolo kh'ar kiro bikhokh'ad, bo iorii khud ta'iid mekunad. Ba rosti, dar in [moch'aro] baroi akh'li binish, ibrate ast

Ishk' ba khostanikh'o [-i moddi], az [ch'umla] zanonu farzandon va amvoli kh'anguft - az tillo va nuk'ra va aspkh'oi nishondor va domkh'ovu kishtzor [kh'o] - baroi mardum orosta shudaast. In [kh'ama, lazzatkh'o va] koloi [zudguzari] zindagii duniost va [kh'ol on ki] saranch'omi nek nazdi Allokh' taolo ast

[Ei paiombar, ba onon] Bigu: "Oio [mekhokh'ed] shumoro az chize ogokh' kunam, ki az in [doroikh'o va lazzatkh'oi moddi] bekh'tar boshad"? Kasone, ki tak'vo pesha kardaand, nazdi Parvardigorashon bog'kh'oe dorand, ki az zeri [darakhtoni] on ch'uiborkh'o ravon ast; ch'ovidona dar on khokh'and bud va kh'amsaroni pokiza [va beaib dorand] va [kh'amchunin] az khushnudii Allokh' taolo [barkhurdorand]; va Allokh' taolo ba [akh'voli] bandagon binost
[In bikh'ishtiion] Kasone [kh'astand], ki meguiand: "Parvardigoro, ba rosti, ki mo imon ovardaem; pas, gunokh'onamonro biiomurz va moro az azobi otash nigakh' dor"

Onon [dar barobari mushkilot va dar rokh'i itoat va tarki gunokh'] shikeboi mevarzand va [dar guftoru raftorashon] rostgu kh'astand va [dar barobari farmudakh'oi ilokh'i] farmonbardorand va [baroi khushnudii Bori taolo] infok' mekunand va dar sakh'argokh'on omurzish metalaband

Allokh' taolo, ki [dar ch'akh'oni kh'asti] barpodorandai adl ast, guvokh'i dodaast, ki ma'bude [ba kh'ak'] ch'uz U nest va farishtagonu ulamo [niz bar iagonagi va adolati ilokh'i guvokh'i medikh'and]. Ma'bude [ba kh'ak'] ch'uz U nest, [ki] shikastnopaziru kh'akim ast

Dar kh'ak'ik'at, dini [pisandida] nazdi Allokh' taolo kh'amon islom ast; va kasone, ki kitobi [osmoni] ba onon doda shudaast, bo iakdigar ba ikhtilof napardokhtand, magar pas az on, ki ilm baroiashon [kh'osil] omad [va kh'uch'ch'at baroiashon tamom shud]. On [ikhtilof va tafrik'a] kh'am ba khotiri sarkashi va kh'asade [bud], ki miionashon vuch'ud dosht; va kh'ar ki ba oioti Allokh' taolo kufr bivarzad, [bidonad, ki] Allokh' taolo dar kh'isobrasi sare' ast

[Ei paiombar] Agar [dar borai islom va tavkh'id] bo tu much'odala kardand, bigu: "Man dar barobari Allokh' taolo [va avomiru akh'komash] taslim shudaam va pairavonam [niz chunin kh'astand]"; va ba akh'li kitob [iakh'udiion va masekh'iion] va mushrikon bigu: "Oio shumo kh'am taslim shudaed"? Agar taslim shavand, kh'atman kh'idoiat ioftaand va agar ruigardon shudand [va sarpechi kardand, g'amgin mashav, zero] tu vazifae ch'uz rasondan [-i vakh'i] nadori; va Allokh' taolo ba [akh'voli] bandagon binost

Ba rosti, kasone, ki ba oioti Allokh' taolo kufr mevarzand va paiombaronro ba nokh'ak' [va fak'at az ruii sitamu dushmani] mekushand va [niz] kasonero, ki ba adolat amr mekunand, ba k'atl merasonand, ononro ba azobi dardnok bashorat dekh'!
Onon kasone kh'astand, ki a'molashon dar dunio va okhirat tabokh' shudaast va [dar okhirat] kh'ech' iovare nadorand

[Ei paiombar] Oio dostoni kasonero, ki bakh'rae az kitob [-i Tavrot] ioftaand, nadonistai, ki chun ba [bozgasht ba] suii kitobi Allokh' taolo faro khonda meshavand, to miionashon kh'ukm kunad, gurukh'e az [ulamovu buzurgoni] onon [ki kh'ak'ik'atro khilofi mailu manfiati khud mebinand] ba kh'oli sarpechi ru barmetoband?

In [ruigardoni az kh'ak'], bad-on sabab ast, ki guftand: "Otash [-i duzakh] ch'uz chand ruze ba mo nakhokh'ad rasid"; va in [iftirokh'o] va durug'kh'oe, ki meboftand, ononro dar dinashon firefta sokht

Pas, [kh'oli pushaimoniashon] chi guna khokh'ad bud? [Ore, dar badtarin kh'ol khokh'and bud] On gokh' ki ononro baroi ruze, ki [kh'ech'] tardide dar on nest, gird ovarem va ba kh'ar kas [podoshi] on chi, ki farokh'am kardaast, ba tamom va kamol doda shavad va ba eshon sitam nakhokh'ad shud

[Ei paiombar] Bigu: "Bor Ilokh'o, ei Farmonravoi kh'asti, kh'ar kiro bikhokh'i, kh'ukumat mebakhshi va az kh'ar ki bikhokh'i, kh'ukumatro bozpas megiri; va ba kh'ar ki bikhokh'i, izzat [-u k'udrat] medikh'i va kh'ar kiro bikhokh'i, khor medori. [Parvardigoro] Khubi ba dasti Tust va be gumon, Tu bar kh'ar chize tavonoi

Shabro ba ruz darmeovari va ruzro ba shab darmeovari [va az tuli iake mekokh'i va bar digare meafzoi] va [mavch'udi] zindaro az [moddai] bech'on berun meovari [ruiishi giiokh' az dona] va [moddai] bech'onro az [mavch'udi] zinda khorich' mesozi [berun omadani tukhm az parrandagon] va ba kh'ar ki bikhokh'i, beshumor ruzi medikh'i"

Mu'minon naboiad kofironro ba ch'oii mu'minon dusti khud bigirand; va kh'ar ki chunin kunad, bo Allokh' taolo kh'ech' paivande nadorad va [Allokh' taolo az u bezori mech'uiad]; magar on ki [nochor shaved bo narmi dar guftoru raftor] kheshro az [ozori] eshon dar amon dored [va ba khotiri kh'ifzi ch'onaton ekh'tiiot kuned]; va Allokh' taolo shumoro az [kaifari] khesh barkh'azar medorad; va bozgasht [-i kh'ama] ba suii Allokh' taolo ast

[Ei paiombar] Bigu: "Agar kh'ar on chi [az dusti va mukh'abbati kofiron, ki] dar dilkh'oiaton ast, pinkh'on dored, io oshkorash kuned, Allokh' taolo onro medonad, [va niz] on chiro, ki dar osmonkh'o va zamin ast, medonad; va Allokh' taolo bar kh'ar chize tavonost"

[Ruzi k'iiomat] Ruze [ast], ki kh'ar kas on chiro az kori nek [va bad] anch'om dodaast, kh'ozir mebinad va orzu mekunad miioni u va a'moli bade, ki anch'om dodaast, fosilai bisiore boshad; va Allokh' taolo shumoro az [nofarmoni va kaifari] khud barkh'azar medorad; va Allokh' taolo nisbat ba bandagon [-i khud] dilsuz ast
[Ei paiombar] Bigu: "Agar Allokh'ro dust medored, az man pairavi kuned, to Allokh' taolo shumoro dust bidorad va gunokh'onatonro biiomurzad; va Allokh' taolo omurzandai mekh'rubon ast"
[Ei paiombar] Bigu: "Allokh' taolo va paiombar [-i U]-ro itoat kuned"; pas, agar pusht kardand [va sarpechi namudand], kh'atman, Allokh' taolo kofironro dust nadorad
Ba rosti, ki Allokh' taolo Odamu Nukh' va khonadoni Ibrokh'imu khonadoni Imronro bar ch'akh'oniion [bartari dod va] barguzid
Farzandone, ki barkhe az onon [dar tavkh'idu ibodat] az [paii] barkhi digarand; va Allokh' taolo shunavovu donost

[Ei paiombar, iod kun az] Kh'angome ki kh'amsari Imron guft: "Parvardigoro, man on chiro dar shikam doram, baroi Tu nazr kardam, ki ozod [az kh'ar chiz dar khidmati Bait-ul-muk'addas va parastishgari Tu] boshad; pas, az man bipazir, ki Tu khud shunavovu donoi"

Pas, kh'angome ki uro bizod, guft: "Parvardigoro, man uro dukhtar zodaam - vale Allokh' taolo ba on chi u ba dunio ovarda bud, donotar bud - va pisar kh'ammonandi dukhtar nest va man uro Mariam nom nikh'odam va uvu farzandonashro az [sharri] shaitoni rondashuda dar panokh'i Tu k'aror medikh'am"

On gokh' Parvardigorash u [Mariam]-ro ba nakui paziruft va [nikh'oli vuch'udashro] ba shevai shoistae parvarish dod va sarparastiashro ba Zakariio supurd. Kh'ar gokh' Zakariio voridi ibodatgokh' [-i u] meshud, nazdash g'izoe meioft [pas, bo shigifti] meguft: "Ei Mariam, in [g'izo] az kuch'o baroiat omadaast"? [Mariam] Meguft: "In [g'izo] az ch'onibi Allokh' taolo ast. Be gumon, Allokh' taolo ba kh'ar ki bikhokh'ad, beshumor ruzi medikh'ad"
On ch'o [bud, ki] Zakariio Parvardigorashro khond [va] guft: "Parvardigoro, az ch'onibi khesh farzandi poku pisandida ba man ato kun, [ki] be tardid, Tu shunavandai duoi"

Pas, dar kh'ole ki u [Zakariio] istoda dar ibodatgokh' namoz mekhond, farishtagon nidoiash dodand, ki: "Allokh' taolo turo ba [vilodati] Iakh'io bashorat medikh'ad, [ki] tasdik'kunandai kalimai Allokh' taolo [Iso] ast va [dar ilmu ibodat, bar k'avmi khesh] sarvar ast va porsost [ba shakh'avot tavach'ch'ukh'e nadorad] va paiombare az shoistagon ast"

[Zakariio] Guft: "Parvardigoro, chi guna maro farzande khokh'ad bud, kh'ol on ki piri ba surog'am omadavu kh'amsaram nozost"? [Allokh' taolo] Guft: "[amri ofarinish] Chunin ast, [ki] Allokh' taolo kh'ar chi bikhokh'ad anch'om medikh'ad"

[Zakariio] Guft: "Parvardigoro, baroiam nishonae k'aror bidekh'"; [Allokh' taolo] Farmud: "Nishonaat in ast, ki se [shabona] ruz [biduni in ki bemor boshi] ch'uz bo ishora k'odir ba sukhan guftan bo mardum nesti [pas, sabur bosh] va Parvardigoratro bisior iod kun va shomgokh'onu subkh'gokh'on [Uro] tasbekh' bigu"
Va [Ei paiombar, iod kun az] kh'angome ki farishtagon guftand: "Ei Mariam, Allokh' taolo turo barguzida va pok sokhta va turo [dar asri khud] bar zanoni ch'akh'on bartari dodaast"
Ei Mariam, [kh'amvora] ibodatgari Parvardigori khesh boshu [va baroi U] sach'da bigzor va kh'amrokh'i ruku'kunandagon ruku' kun"

[Ei paiombar] In [khabar] az khabarkh'oi g'aibest, ki ba tu vakh'i mekunem va tu kh'angome ki [ulamoi mazkh'abi iakh'ud] k'alamkh'oi khudro [baroi k'ur'akashi ba ob] meafkandand, to [ta'iin kunand, ki] kadom iak sarparastii Mariamro ba ukh'da girad, nazdashon nabudi; va [niz] vak'te ki [ba sari in mavzu'] bo iakdigar kashmakash mekardand, kanorashon kh'uzur nadoshti

Va [Ei paiombar, iod kun az] kh'angome ki farishtagon guftand: "Ei Mariam, Allokh' taolo turo ba kalimae az ch'onibi khesh bashorat medikh'ad, ki nomash Masekh' - Iso ibni Mariam - ast; dar kh'ole ki [u] dar dunio va okhirat obrumand va az nazdikoni [dargokh'i ilokh'i] ast"
U dar gakh'vora [ba e'ch'oz] va dar kukh'ansoli [ba vakh'ii ilokh'i] bo mardum sukhan meguiad va az shoistagon ast"

[Mariam] Guft: "Parvardigoro, chi guna farzande khokh'am dosht, dar kh'ole [kh'ech'] bashare ba man dast nazadaast"? [Farishta] Guft: "Allokh' taolo bad-in son kh'ar chiro bikhokh'ad, meofarinad, [va] kh'ar gokh', ki irodai chize kunad, fak'at ba on meguiad: "Bosh", pas, on [bedirang] mavch'ud meshavad"
Va [niz bashorat dod, ki Allokh' taolo] ba u kitobu kh'ikmat va Tavrotu Inch'il meomuzad

Va paiombare ba suii Bani Isroil ast, ki [ba onon meguiad]: "Man az suii Parvardigoraton baroi shumo nishonae ovardaam: Man az gil baroiaton [chize] ba shakli parranda mesozam; on gokh' dar on medamam va ba farmoni Allokh' taolo [on gili bech'on tabdil ba] parrandae meshavad; va [kh'amchunin] ba farmoni Allokh' taolo kuri modarzod va mubtaloion ba pesiro bekh'budi mebakhsham va murdagonro zinda mekunam va az on chi mekhured va dar khonakh'oiaton zakhira mekuned, ba shumo khabar medikh'am. Musallaman, agar imon doshta boshed, dar inkh'o nishonae baroi shumost [ki nubuvvatamro bovar kuned]

Va [meguiad: "Omadaam to] tasdik'kunandai Tavrot bosham, ki pesh az man [nozil shuda] ast; va [firistoda shudaam] to barkhe az chizkh'oero, ki bar shumo kh'arom shuda bud, kh'alol kunam; va nishonae az tarafi Parvardigoraton baroi shumo ovardaam; pas, az Allokh' taolo parvo (va tak'vo) doshta boshed va maro itoat kuned
Ba rosti, ki Allokh' taolo, Parvardigori manu Parvardigori shumost; pas, Uro biparasted, [ki] rokh'i rost in ast"

Sipas chun Iso ba kufri onon pai burd, guft: "Chi kasone iovaroni man [dar rokh'i da'vat] ba suii Allokh' taolo kh'astand"? Kh'avoriiun guftand: "Mo iovaroni [dini] Allokh' taolo kh'astem; ba Allokh' taolo imon ovardaem va [tu niz, ei Iso] guvokh' bosh, ki mo taslim [-i U] kh'astem
Parvardigoro, ba on chi nozil kardai, imon ovardem va az firistoda [-i Tu] pairavi namudem; pas, moro dar zumrai guvokh'on [ba kh'ak' va mu'minon ba paiombarat] binavis"
[Pas az muddate kofironi Bani Isroil baroi kushtani Iso] Makr varzidand va Allokh' taolo [niz dar posukhashon] makr namud va Allokh' taolo bekhtarin makrangezon ast

[Iod kun az] Kh'angome ki Allokh' taolo [ba Iso] farmud: "Ei Iso, man turo barmegiram va ba suii khesh bolo mebaram va turo az [oloishu tukh'mati] kasone, ki kufr varzidand, pok megardonam va to ruzi rastokhez kasonero, ki az tu pairavi kardand [va ba Mukh'ammad imon ovardand], bartar az kasone k'aror medikh'am, ki kufr varzidand. Sipas bozgashtaton ba suii man ast; on gokh' dar [mavridi] on chi dar on ikhtilof mekarded, miionaton dovari mekunam
Ammo kasone, ki kufr varzidand, dar dunio va okhirat ba azobi sakht much'ozotashon mekunam va iovarone nakhokh'and dosht
Va ammo kasone, ki imon ovardand va korkh'oi shoista anch'om dodand, [Allokh' taolo] podoshashonro ba tavri komil ba eshon khokh'ad dod; va Allokh' taolo sitamgoronro dust namedorad
[Ei paiombar] Inkh'o, ki [az moch'aroi Iso] bar tu mekhonem, az nishonakh'o [-i ravshan ast dalolatkunanda bar rostguii tu va durustii in] andarzi kh'ikmatomez [K'ur'on]
Dar kh'ak'ik'at, masali Iso nazdi Allokh' taolo kh'amchun masali [ofarinishi] Odam ast, [ki] uro az khok ofaridu sipas ba u farmud: "Bosh"; pas, [bedirang] mavch'ud shud
[On chi dar borai Iso baion kardem] Kh'ak'ik'ate az ch'onibi Parvardigori tust; pas, kh'argiz az tardidkunandagon mabosh

Pas, [ei paiombar] kh'ar ki [az masekh'iioni Nach'ron] pas az on donishe, ki dar borai u [Iso] baroiat [kh'osil] omadaast, bo tu bakh'su ch'adal kunad, [ba onkh'o] bigu: "Biioed [kh'amagiro] faro bikhonem: pisaroni movu pisaroni shumo va zanoni movu zanoni shumo va khudi movu shumo [niz kh'ozir shavem]; sipas ba [dargokh'i ilokh'i tazarru' va] duo kunem va la'nati Allokh'ro bar durug'guion k'aror dikh'em"
In kh'amon dostoni kh'ak'ik'i [-i Masekh'] ast va kh'ech' ma'bude [ba kh'ak'] ch'uz Allokh' taolo nest va be gumon, Allokh' taolo ast, ki shikastnopazir [va] kh'akim ast
Pas, agar [az sukhani kh'ak'] rui gardonand, [bidon, ki] Allokh' taolo az [kh'oli] mufsidon ogokh' ast

[Ei paiombar] Bigu: "Ei akh'li kitob, ba suii sukhane biioed, ki miioni mo va shumo odilona ast [va inkh'irofe az kh'ak' dar on nest]: ki ch'uz Allokh'ro naparastem va chizero [dar k'udratu tadbir] bo U sharik nasozem va barkhe az mo barkhi digarro ba ch'oi Allokh' taolo [ba parastish] nagirand". Agar onon [az in da'vat] rui gardonand, pas, [ei mu'minon, ba eshon] bigued: "Guvokh' boshed, ki mo taslim [-i avomiri ilokh'i] kh'astem"
Ei akh'li kitob, charo dar borai Ibrokh'im much'odila mekuned; dar kh'ole ki Tavrot va Inch'il ba'd az u nozil shudaast? Oio nameandeshed?

Kh'on! Shumo [akh'li kitob] kasone kh'asted, ki dar borai on chi nisbat ba on ogokh'i va ilm doshted, bakh'su sitez mekarded; pas, charo [inak] dar mavridi chize, ki bad-on ilm nadored [va dar kitobkh'oiaton naiomadaast], bakh'su sitez mekuned? Dar kh'ole ki Allokh' taolo [kh'ak'oik'i umurro] medonad va shumo namedoned
Ibrokh'im na iakh'udi bud va na masekh'i; balki kh'ak'garoi musulmon bud va kh'argiz dar zumrai mushrikon nabud

Ba rosti, sazovortarin mardum ba Ibrokh'im kh'amon kasone kh'astand, ki az u pairavi kardaand; va [az ch'umla] in paiombar [-i shumo-Mukh'ammad] va kasone, ki [musulmonand va ba u] imon ovardaand; va Allokh' taolo [ioru] korsozi mu'minon ast
[Ei mu'minon] Gurukh'e az akh'li kitob orzu mekardand, kosh shumoro gumrokh' mekardand; dar kh'ole ki ch'uz khudashon [kase]-ro gumrokh' namekunand va [ammo] namefakh'mand
Ei akh'li kitob, charo ba oioti Allokh' taolo kofir meshaved, dar kh'ole ki khud [ba durustii on] guvokh'i medikh'ed?
Ei akh'li kitob, charo kh'ak'ro ba botil meomezed va kh'ak'ik'at [-i paiombarii Mukh'ammad]-ro pinkh'on mekuned, dar kh'ole ki khud medoned?

Gurukh'e az [ulamoi] akh'li kitob [ba kh'amdigar] guftand: "Dar og'ozi ruz ba on chi ba mu'minon nozil shudaast, imon biiovared va dar poion [-i ruz] kofir shaved; shoiad onon [niz tardid kunand va az islom] bargardand

Va [in ki] imon naiovared magar ba kase, ki az dini shumo pairavi mekunad". [Ei paiombar, ba onon] Bigu: "Dar kh'ak'ik'at, kh'idoiat kh'idoiati Allokh' taolo ast. [Boz guftand: "Kh'argiz chize ba musulmonon naiomuzed va ich'ozat nadikh'ed] ba kasi on chi ba shumo dodaast, doda shavad io [dalele dar ikhtiiorashon naguzored, ki bitvonand] dar peshgokh'i Parvardigoraton bo shumo bakh's kunand". [Ei paiombar] Bigu: "Be tardid, fazl [-u bartari] ba dasti Allokh' taolo ast; onro ba kh'ar ki bikhokh'ad, mebakhshad; va Allokh' taolo kushoishgari donost
Rakh'mati kheshro ba kh'ar ki bikhokh'ad, ikhtisos medikh'ad; va Allokh' taolo doroi bakhshishi buzurg [va beandoza] ast"

Az akh'li kitob kase kh'ast, ki agar moli farovone ba u amonat dikh'i, onro ba tu bozmegardonad; va az [miioni] onon kase kh'ast, ki agar uro bar dinore amin bishumori, onro ba tu boznamegardonad; magar on ki paivasta bar [dariofti] on istodagi kuni. In bad-on khotir ast, ki onon meguiand: "Dar mavridi [khurdani amvoli] k'avmi arab, gunokh'e bar mo nest"; va [bad-in guna onon] dar kh'ole ki [kh'ak'ik'atro] medonand, bar Allokh' taolo durug' mebandand
Ore, [in kor gunokh' ast; ammo] kh'ar ki ba paimoni khud vafo kunad va parkh'ezgori namoiad, [bidonad, ki] be tardid, Allokh' taolo parkh'ezgoronro dust medorad

Kasone, ki paimoni Allokh' taolo [dar borai ich'roi akh'kom] va savgandkh'oi khud [dar borai pairavi az Mukh'ammad]-ro ba bakh'oi nochize mefurushand, iak'inan bakh'rae dar okhirat nakhokh'and dosht va Allokh' taolo ruzi k'iiomat bo onon sukhan nameguiad va ba eshon namenigarad va onkh'oro [az gunokh'] pok namesozad va azobi dardnoke [dar pesh] dorand

Va gurukh'e az onon [iakh'udiion] kh'astand, ki zaboni khudro ba [kh'angomi tilovati] kitobi [Tavrot] chunon megardonand, ki gumon mekuned, [on chi mekhonand, vok'ean,] az [matolibi on] kitob ast, dar kh'ole ki az on kitob nest; va [boz ba durug'] meguiand: "On [ch'umalot] az ch'onibi Allokh' taolo ast"; dar surate ki az ch'onibi Allokh' taolo nest va bar Allokh' taolo durug' mebandand, dar kh'ole ki khud [niz kh'ak'ik'atro] medonand

Baroi kh'ech' bashare sazovor nest, ki Allokh' taolo ba u kitob va kh'ukm [donishu fakh'm] va paiombari dikh'ad, sipas u ba mardum biguiad: "Ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo, bandagoni man boshed". Balki [sazovor ast, ki paiombaron ba mardum biguiand]: "Ba khotiri on, ki kitob [-i Tavrot]-ro omuzish medoded va az on ch'o, ki [ak'oidu akh'komi onro ba digaron] dars medoded, [fak'ekh'onu donishmandoni] ilokh'i boshed"

Va na in ki ba shumo farmon dikh'ad, ki farishtagon va paiombaronro [ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo] sokh'ibikhtiior [ba parastish] bigired. Oio [in shakhs] shumoro pas az on, ki musulmon shuded, ba kufr farmon medikh'ad?

Va [ei paiombar, iod kun az] kh'angome ki Allokh' taolo az paiombaron paimon girift [va farmud]: "Kh'ar gokh' ba shumo kitobu kh'ikmate dodam, on gokh' firistodae [Mukh'ammad] ba suiaton omad, ki on chiro bo shumost, tasdik' kard, boiad ba u imon ovared va ioriash kuned". [On gokh'] Farmud: "Oio ik'ror karded va paimoni mukh'kami maro dar in bora pazirufted"? [Onon] Guftand: "Ik'ror kardem". [Allokh' taolo] Farmud: "Pas, [bar khudu ummatkh'oiaton] guvokh' boshed va man [niz] bo shumo az guvokh'onam"
Pas, kh'ar ki ba'd az in [paimon, az akh'di khesh] rui bigardonad, ononand, ki fosik'and

Oio [kofiron, oine] ba ch'uz dini Allokh'ro mech'uiand? Kh'ol on ki kh'ar ki [va kh'ar chi] dar osmonkh'o va zamin ast - khokh' nokh'okh' - sar ba farmoni U nikh'odaast va [kh'amagi] ba suii U bozgardonda meshavand

[Ei paiombar] Bigu: "Ba Allokh' taolo va on chi bar mo nozil shudaast, imon ovardem va [kh'amchunin ba] on chi bar Ibrokh'im va Ismoil va Iskh'ok'u Ia'k'ub va [paiombarone, ki az] navodagon [-i Iak'ub budand] nozil gardidaast va on chi ba Muso va Iso va [digar] paiombaron az ch'onibi Parvardigorashon doda shudaast; miioni kh'ech' iak az onon fark'e nameguzorem va taslimi U kh'astem"
Kh'ar ki dine g'air az islom barguzinad, kh'argiz az u pazirufta nakhokh'ad shud va dar okhirat az ziionkoron ast

Chi guna Allokh' taolo k'avmero kh'idoiat mekunad, ki ba'd az imonashon va [pas az on ki] guvokh'i dodand ba in ki paiombar [-i islom] barkh'ak' ast, baroiashon daloili ravshan omad, kofir shudand? Va, albatta, Allokh' taolo k'avmi sitamgorro kh'idoiat namekunad
Ch'azoiashon in ast, ki la'nati Allokh' taolo va farishtagonu mardum kh'amagi bar onkh'ost
Dar on [la'nat va azobi onon] ch'ovidona bok'i memonand va na az azobashon kosta meshavad va na mukh'lat [-i uzrkhokh'i] meioband
Magar kasone, ki pas az on tavba kardand va [bo durustkori, raftorashonro] islokh' namudand; pas, be gumon, Allokh' taolo omurzandai mekh'rubon ast
Ba rosti kasone, ki pas az imoni khud kofir shudand va bar kufr [-i khesh] afzudand, kh'argiz tavbai onon pazirufta nakhokh'ad shud va ononand, ki gumrokh'and

Kasone, ki kufr varzidand va dar kh'oli kufr az dunio raftand, agarchi ruii zamin pur az tillo boshad va onro ba unvoni fidia [va kafforai a'moli badi khesh] bipardozand, kh'argiz az kh'ech' iak az onkh'o pazirufta nakhokh'ad shud va much'ozoti dardnok [dar pesh] dorand va iovarone nakhokh'and dosht
[Ei mu'minon] Kh'argiz ba [manzalatu savobi] nakukori dast nameiobed, magar on ki az on chi dust medored, infok' kuned; va be tardid, Allokh' taolo ba on chi infok' mekuned, donost

Kh'ama g'izokh'o baroi Bani Isroil kh'alol bud, magar on chi Isroil (Ia'k'ub) pesh az nuzuli Tavrot bar khud kh'arom karda bud. [Ei paiombar, ba iakh'udiion] Bigu: "Agar rost megued [va sukhanamro bovar nadored], Tavrotro biiovared va onro bikhoned"
Pas, kh'ar ki pas az on bar Allokh' taolo durug' bandad, ononand, ki sitamgorand
[Ei paimbar] Bigu: "Allokh' taolo [dar mavridi Ia'k'ub va kh'ar chi nozil farmudaast] rost guft; pas, az oini Ibrokh'im pairavi kuned, ki kh'ak'garo bud va kh'argiz dar zumrai mushrikon nabud"
Dar kh'ak'ik'at, nakhustin khonae, ki baroi [ibodati] mardum k'aror doda shud, kh'amonest, ki dar Makka k'aror dorad, ki purbarakat va [moiai] kh'idoiati ch'akh'oniion ast

Dar on [khona], nishonakh'oi ravshan, [az ch'umla] mak'omi Ibrokh'im ast va [digar in ki] kh'ar ki dokhili on [kh'aram] shavad, dar amon khokh'ad bud; va bar mardum [voch'ib] ast, ki baroi [ibodati] Allokh' taolo k'asdi on khona kunand [albatta, baroi] kase, ki tavonoii [moli va ch'ismi] raftan ba suii onro dorad; va kh'ar ki [ba farizai kh'ach'] kufr varzad, be tardid, Allokh' taolo az ch'akh'oniion beniioz ast
[Ei paiombar] Bigu: "Ei akh'li kitob, charo ba Allokh' taolo kufr mevarzed? Kh'ol on ki Allokh' taolo bar on chi mekuned, guvokh' ast"

Bigu: "Ei akh'li kitob, charo kasero, ki imon ovardaast, az rokh'i Allokh' taolo bozmedored va onro munkh'arif [rakh'gumzadavu gumrokh'shuda] mekhokh'ed? Dar kh'ole ki shumo [khud ba durustii on] guvokh'ed; va Allokh' taolo az on chi mekuned, g'ofil nest"
Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, agar az gurukh'e az akh'li kitob itoat kuned, shumoro pas az imonaton ba kufr bozmegardonand

Va chi guna shumo kofir meshaved, dar kh'ole ki oioti Allokh' taolo bar shumo khonda meshavad va paiombarash miioni shumost? Va kh'ar ki ba [kitobi] Allokh' taolo [va sunnati paiombarash] tamassuk ch'uiad, kh'atman, ba rokh'i rost kh'idoiat shudaast
Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, az Allokh' taolo - on guna ki shoistai parvo kardan [tarsidan] az Ust - parvo kuned [bitarsed] va ch'uz dar musulmoni namired

Va kh'amagi ba resmoni Allokh' taolo [K'ur'onu Sunnat] chang zaned va parokanda nashaved; va ne'mati [buzurgi] Allokh'ro bar khud ba iod ored, ki chi guna dushmani iakdigar buded va u miioni dilkh'oiaton ulfat ech'od kard va ba [lutfu barakati] ne'matash barodar shuded; va [pesh az on ba khotiri kufraton] bar ostonai partgokh'i otash buded, [ki] Allokh' taolo shumoro az on nach'ot dod. Allokh' taolo, inchunin, oioti khudro baroiaton oshkor mesozad; boshad, ki kh'idoiat iobed
Va [ei mu'minon] boiad guvokh'e az shumo boshand, ki [mardumro] ba kor [-kh'oi] shoista [ki ak'lu din mepisandad] vodorand va az zishti bozdorand; va ononand, ki rastagorand
Va monandi kasone naboshed, ki pas az on ki daloili ravshan baroiashon omad, parokanda shudand va ikhtilof kardand. Onon azobi buzurg [dar pesh] dorand

Ruze, ki chekh'rakh'oe saped va chekh'rakh'oe siiokh' megardad; ammo [ba] onon, ki chekh'rakh'oiashon siiokh' shudaast [gufta meshavad]: "Oio ba'd az imonaton kofir shuded? Pas, ba sababi on chi kufr mevarzided, azobro bichashed"
Va ammo onon, ki chekh'rakh'oiashon saped gashtaast, dar rakh'mati Allokh' taolo [dar bikh'ishti barin] ch'oi megirand va dar on ch'ovidonand
[Ei paiombar] Inkh'o oioti Allokh' taolo ast, ki onro ba kh'ak' bar tu mekhonem; va Allokh' taolo [kh'ech' gokh'] sitame baroi ch'akh'oniion namekhokh'ad
Va kh'ar chi dar osmonkh'o va zamin ast, az oni Allokh' taolo ast va [kh'ama] korkh'o ba suii Allokh' taolo bozgardonda meshavad

[Ei ummati Mukh'ammad] Shumo bekh'tarin ummate kh'asted, ki baroi mardum padidor shudaed: Ba kori nek farmon medikh'ed va az kori nopisand bozmedored va ba Allokh' taolo imon dored; va agar akh'li kitob [niz] imon meovardand, kh'atman, baroiashon bekh'tar bud; barkhe az onon mu'minand va [ammo] beshtarashon [fosik'u] nofarmonand

[Fosik'oni akh'li kitob] Ch'uz ozori andak [kh'amchun ta'na va tamaskhur] kh'argiz ziione ba shumo nakhokh'and rasond va agar bo shumo bich'angand, [shikast mekhurand va] ba shumo pusht mekunand; on gokh' [niz az suii kh'ech' kas] iori nameshavand

[Iakh'udiion] Kh'ar kuch'o ioft shavand, [dog'i nangu] khori bar onon zada shudaast; magar on ki dar panokh'i amoni Allokh' taolo va mardum boshand; va onon ba khashme az Allokh' taolo giriftor shudaand va [dog'i] darmondagi bar onon zada shudaast. In bad-on sabab bud, ki ba oioti Allokh' taolo kufr mevarzidand va paiombaronro ba nokh'ak' mekushtand; [va niz] in [sazo] ba khotiri on bud, ki nofarmoni kardand va az kh'udud [-i ilokh'i] tach'ovuz menamudand
[Vale kh'amai onon] Iakson nestand. Gurukh'e az akh'li kitob kh'astand, ki durustkorand, [va] dar dili shab, dar kh'ole ki ba namoz istodaand, oioti Allokh'ro mekhonand
[Barkhe az] Onon ba Allokh' taolo va ruzi k'iiomat imon dorand va [mardumro] ba neki amr mekunand va az badi bozmedorand va dar [anch'omi] korkh'oi nek meshitoband va ononand, ki az shoistagonand
Va kh'ar kori neke, ki anch'om dikh'and, kh'argiz dar borai on nosiposi nakhokh'and did; va Allokh' taolo ba [kh'oli] parkh'ezgoron donost
Be gumon kasone, ki kufr varzidand, kh'argiz amvolu farzandonashon chize az [azobi] Allokh'ro az eshon daf' nakhokh'ad kard va onon akh'li otashand [va] ch'ovidona dar on memonand

Masali on chi [kofiron] dar in zindagii dunio infok' mekunand, kh'ammonandi bode ast, ki sarmoi sakhte bo khud dorad va ba kishtzori k'avme, ki bar khud sitam kardaand, merasad va nobudashon mesozad. Allokh' taolo ba onon sitam nakardaast, balki eshon khud bar kheshtan sitam kardaand

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, az g'airi khudaton [dustu] kh'amroz nagired. Onon az kh'ech' nobakori [va sharre] dar kh'ak'k'i shumo kutokh'i namekunand [va] dust dorand, ki shumo dar ranch'u zakh'mat boshed. Dar kh'ak'ik'at, [nishonakh'oi] dushmani az guftorashon oshkor ast va on chi dar dilkh'oiashon pinkh'on medorand buzurgtar ast. Agar biiandeshed, kh'atman, [khokh'ed donist, ki] mo nishonakh'o [-i pandomuz va rokh'i saodati dunio va okhirat]-ro baroiaton ba ravshani baion kardaem

Kh'on! Shumo [ei mu'minon] kasone kh'asted, ki ononro dust dored, dar kh'ole ki onkh'o shumoro dust nadorand va shumo ba kh'ama kitob [-kh'oi osmoni] imon dored [vale onon ba K'ur'on imon nadorand]; va chun bo shumo mulok'ot mekunand, meguiand: "Imon ovardaem" va chun tankh'o meshavand, az shiddati khashm bar shumo sarangushton [-i khud]-ro ba dandon megazand. [Ei paiombar, ba onon] Bigu: "Ba khashmi khud bimired". Be gumon, Allokh' taolo ba [rozi] daruni sinakh'o donost

[Ei mu'minon] Agar ba shumo neki [va khushi] rasad, ononro andukh'gin mesozad va agar ba shumo badi [va gazande] rasad, bad-on shodmon meshavand; va agar [bar tak'diri ilokh'i] sabru parkh'ezgori namoed, makru nairangashon kh'ech' ziione ba shumo namerasonad, [charo ki] be tardid, Allokh' taolo ba on chi mekunand, ikh'ota dorad

Va [ei paiombar, ba iod ovar] zamone, ki [dar ch'angi Ukh'ud] bomdodon az khona va koshonaat berun omadi, [va] mu'minonro baroi ch'angidan dar mavozei khud megumoridi; va Allokh' taolo shunavovu donost

Va [ba iod ovar] kh'angome ki du gurukh' az shumo [Bani Salama va Bani Kh'orisa] khostand susti varzand [va kh'amrokh'i munofik'on ba Madina bozgardand]; vale Allokh' taolo iovar [-u nigakh'dor]-i onon bud; va mu'minon boiad tankh'o bar Allokh' taolo tavakkal kunand

Va [ei mu'minon] be gumon, Allokh' taolo shumoro dar [ch'angi] Badr dar kh'ole iori kard, ki [ba sababi kambudi afrod va aslikh'a] notavon buded; pas, az Allokh' taolo parvo kuned; boshad, ki sipos guzored
[Ei paiombar, ba iod ovar] on gokh' ki ba mu'minon megufti: "Oio baroiaton kofi nest, ki Parvardigoraton shumoro bo se kh'azor farishta, ki [az osmon] furud meoiand, iori kunad"
Ore, agar shikeboivu porsoi kuned va dushmanon dar in [kh'aiach'on va] shitobi khesh bar shumo bitozand, Parvardigoraton shumoro bo panch' kh'azor farishtai nishondor iori khokh'ad kard

Va Allokh' taolo on [iori]-ro ch'uz bashorate baroi [piruzii] shumo k'aror nadod, to [bad-in vasila] dilkh'oiaton bad-on oromish girad; va [-garna] piruzi ch'uz az ch'onibi Allokh'i shikastnopaziru kh'akim nest
[In piruzi baroi on bud] To [Allokh' taolo] gurukh'e az kasonero, ki kufr varzidand, kh'alok sozad, io khoru mag'lubashon namoiad, to ma'ius [va khor ba Makka] bozgardand

[Ei paiombar] Kh'ech' chize az kor [-i bandagon] dar dasti tu nest; io [Allokh' taolo] tavbai onon [mushrikon]-ro mepazirad [va az gunokh'ashon darmeguzarad] io azobashon mekunad; zero onon sitamgorand

On chi dar osmonkh'o va zamin ast, az oni Allokh' taolo ast. U kh'ar kiro, ki bikhokh'ad [ba rakh'mat] meomurzad va kh'ar kiro bikhokh'ad [ba adolat] azob mekunad; va Allokh' taolo omurzandai mekh'rubon ast
Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, riboro [bo sudi] chand barobar nakhured va az Allokh' taolo parvo kuned; boshad, ki rastagor shaved
Va az otashe, ki baroi kofiron omoda shudaast, biparkh'ezed
Va az Allokh'u paiombar itoat kuned; boshad, ki mavridi rakh'mat [-i Allokh' taolo] k'aror gired
Va ba suii omurzishi Parvardigoraton va bikh'ishte bishitobed, ki gustura [pakh'no]-i on [ba andozai] osmonkh'o va zamin ast [va] baroi parkh'ezgoron mukh'aiio shudaast
On kasone, ki dar [kh'angomi] tavongari va tangdasti infok' mekunand va khashmi khudro furu mebarand va az mardum darmeguzarand; va Allokh' taolo nakukoronro dust medorad

Va [kh'amon] kasone, ki chun murtakib [-i gunokh'i buzurg va] kori zishte shudand io [bo anch'omi digar gunokh'on] bar khud sitam kardand, Allokh'ro ba iod meovarand va baroi gunokh'onashon omurzish mekhokh'and - va ch'uz Allokh' taolo chi kase gunokh'onro meomurzad? - Va bar on chi kardaand pofishori namekunand, dar kh'ole ki medonand [gunakh'korand va Allokh' taolo bakhshoianda va tavbapazir ast]

Podoshi eshon omurzishe az [ch'onibi] Parvardigorashon ast va bog'kh'oe, ki az zeri [darakhtoni] on ch'uiborkh'o ch'ori ast; ch'ovidona dar on memonand; va podoshi [nakukoron va] akh'li amal chi nakust!

[Ei osebdidagoni Ukh'ud] Be tardid pesh az shumo [niz mu'minone budaand, ki ranch' kashidand va] sunnatkh'oe guzashtaast; pas, dar zamin bigarded va bingared, ki saranch'omi takzibkunandagon [-i oioti ilokh'i] chi guna budaast
In [K'ur'on] baioni oshkor baroi mardum va kh'idoiatu andarze baroi parkh'ezgoron ast
Va [ei mu'minon, az ch'ikh'od dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo] sust nashaved va andukh'gin nagarded; va [bidoned, ki] agar imon doshta boshed, shumo bartared

Agar [dar Ukh'ud] ba shumo gazande rasid, ba dushmanoni shumo niz [dar ch'angi Badr ba kh'amon shakl] oseb rasid [pas, muk'ovimat kuned]. Mo in ruzkh'o [-i shikastu piruzi]-ro miioni mardum megardonem, to Allokh' taolo, mu'minon [-i vok'ei]-ro ma'lum dorad va az shumo mu'minon [onero, ki sobitk'adam ast] bar digaron guvokh' girad; va Allokh' taolo sitamgoronro dust namedorad
Va [moch'aroi Ukh'ud vasilai imtikh'on bud] to Allokh' taolo kasonero, ki imon ovardaand [az gunokh'onashon pok kunad] va kholis gardonad va kofironro nobud sozad
[Ei askh'obi Mukh'ammad], oio pindoshtaed, ki [tankh'o bo iddaoi imon] ba bikh'isht meraved, kh'ol on ki Allokh' taolo kh'anuz ch'ikh'odgaronu shikeboioni shumoro ma'lum nadoshtaast?
Va [ei mu'minon] ba rosti, ki pesh az ruioru shudan bo marg [dar g'azvai Ukh'ud] orzui shakh'odat doshted. Saranch'om on [ma'rakai ch'ang]-ro dided va [aknun peshoruii shumost va] ba on menigared

Va Mukh'ammad ch'uz firistodae nest, ki pesh az u [niz] firistodagone [budand va] guzashtand. Oio agar u bimirad io kushta shavad, ba ak'ib bozmegarded [va dini khudro rakh'o mekuned]? Va kh'ar ki [az ak'idai rostini khud] bozgardad, [bidonad, ki] kh'argiz ba Allokh' taolo ziione namerasonad va [ba zudi] Allokh' taolo siposguzoronro podosh khokh'ad dod

Va kh'ech' kase ch'uz ba farmoni Allokh' taolo namemirad, [charo ki marg] sarnavishte ast zamondor [va muaiian]; va kh'ar ki podoshi in dunioro bikhokh'ad, nasibash mekunem va kh'ar ki podoshi okhiratro bikhokh'ad [niz] nasibash khokh'em kard va [ba zudi] siposguzoronro podosh khokh'em dod

Va chi bisior paiombarone, ki tudakh'oi anbukh'e kh'amrokh'ashon nabard kardand; onon kh'ech' gokh' dar barobari [sakhtikh'o va] on chi, ki dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo ba eshon rasid, susti navarzidand va [dar muk'obili dushman] darmonda nashudand; va Allokh' taolo shikeboionro dust medorad
Va sukhanashon tankh'o in bud, ki: "Parvardigoro, gunokh'onamonro biiomurz va az ziiodaravii mo dar koramon [darguzar] va gomkh'oiamonro ustuvor bidor va moro bar gurukh'i kofiron piruz gardon"
Pas Allokh' taolo, podoshi in dunio va podoshi neki okhiratro ba onon ato kard; va Allokh' taolo nakukoronro dust medorad
Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, agar az kasone, ki kufr varzidaand, itoat kuned, shumoro [ba kufr] bozmegardonand, ongokh' [dar dunio va okhirat] ziiondida megarded
[Bar kofiron takia nakuned], balki Allokh' taolo [ioru] korsozi shumost va U bekh'tarin iorigaron ast

Ba zudi dar dilkh'oi kasone, ki kufr varzidand, bimu kh'aros khokh'em afkand; bad-in khotir, ki chizero shariki Allokh' taolo k'aror dodaand, ki kh'ech' dalele bar [kh'ak'k'oniiati] on nozil nakardaast; va ch'oigokh'ashon otash ast va ch'oigokh'i sitamgoron chi bad ast!

Va on gokh' ki [dar og'ozi ch'angi Ukh'ud] ba farmoni U onon [kofiron]-ro mekushted, ba rosti, Allokh' taolo va'dai khudro ba shumo takh'ak'k'uk' bakhshid, to [tarsided va dar kh'ifzi mavk'eiiati khud] sust shuded va dar kor [-i ch'angu ch'am'ovarii g'animat] bo iakdigar ba nizo' pardokhted; va pas az on ki [Allokh' taolo] on chiro dust medoshted [piruzi], ba shumo nishon dod, [az dasturi paiombar] sarpechi karded; barkhe az shumo khokh'oni dunio budand va barkhe khokh'oni okhirat. Sipas [Allokh' taolo] baroi on ki shumoro biiozmoiad, az [ta'k'ibi] onon munsarifaton kard [va piruziiaton ba shikast anch'omid] va [chun az gunokh' va kutokh'ii khud dar nofarmoni az rasul pushaimon shuded] az shumo darguzasht; va Allokh' taolo nisbat ba mu'minon bakhshish [-i bisior] dorad

Va [ei mu'minon, ba iod ovared] kh'angome ki [dar kh'oli gurez az kukh'] bolo merafted va [chunon tarsida buded, ki] ba kh'ech' kas tavach'ch'ukh' namekarded va paiombar [ki dar maidoni ch'ang muk'ovimat mekard] az pushti saraton shumoro sado mezad [ki: "Ei bandagoni Allokh' taolo, ba suii man bishitobed"; vale shumo tavach'ch'ukh' namekarded]; pas, [Allokh' taolo niz] bo andukh'e dar paii andukh'i [digar] much'ozotaton kard. In bad-in khotir bud, ki bar on chi az dast dodaed [piruzi va g'animat] va on chi bar saraton omadaast [shikastu tars], andukh'gin nashaved va [bidoned, ki] Allokh' taolo ba on chi mekuned, ogokh' ast

Sipas [Allokh' taolo] ba'd az on andukh' oromishe bar shumo furu firistod, [ba gunae] ki gurukh'e az shumoro [ba sababi itminonu oromishe, ki dar dilkh'oiashon bud] khobi sabuk faro girift va gurukh'i digar [munofik'in] tankh'o dar fikri ch'oni khud budand va dar borai Allokh' taolo gumonkh'oi noravo [va botile] kh'amchun gumonkh'oi [davroni] ch'okh'iliiat doshtand. Onon meguftand: "Oio mo dar in kor ikhtiiore dorem"? [Ei paiombar, ba onon] Bigu: "Kh'amai korkh'o [va shikastu piruzi] ba dasti Allokh' taolo ast". Onkh'o chizero dar dilkh'oiashon pinkh'on medorand, ki baroi tu oshkor namesozand, [va] meguiand: "Agar dar in kor ikhtiior doshtem, dar in ch'o kushta nameshudem". Bigu: "Agar shumo dar khonakh'oi khud niz buded, kasone, ki kushta shudan bar onon muk'arrar shuda bud, kh'atman, [bo poii khud] ba suii k'atlgokh'kh'oi khesh meraftand". Va [in ruidodkh'o] baroi on ast, ki Allokh' taolo on chiro dar sinakh'oiaton [pinkh'on] dored [dar amal] biiozmoiad va on chiro dar dilkh'oiaton ast, pok gardonad; va Allokh' taolo ba [rozi] daruni sinakh'o donost

[Ei askh'obi paiombar] Afrode az shumo, ki dar ruzi barkhurdi du gurukh' [musulmonon va kofiron dar ch'angi Ukh'ud] firor kardand, dar kh'ak'ik'at shaiton ononro ba sababi ba'ze az kirdor [va gunokh'on]-e, ki murtakib shuda budand, ba inkh'irof kashond va, kh'atman, Allokh' taolo az onon darguzasht. Be gumon, Allokh' taolo omurzandai burdbor ast

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, monandi afrode naboshed, ki kufr varzidand va dar borai barodaronashon - kh'angome ki [dar paii kasbi ruzi] ba safar raftand [va murdand] io dar ch'ang shirkat kardand [va kushta shudand] - guftand: "Agar onon nazdi mo budand, namemurdand va kushta nameshudand". [In e'tik'od dar vuch'udashon nikh'oda shud] To Allokh' taolo [bad-in guna andukh' va] kh'asrate dar dilkh'oiashon karor dikh'ad; va Allokh' taolo [ast, ki] zinda mekunad va memironad; va Allokh' taolo ba on chi mekuned, binost
Va agar dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo kushta shaved io bimired, kh'atman, omurzish va rakh'mati Allokh' taolo bekh'tar ast az chize [ki] onon [dunioduston] ch'am' mekunand
Va agar bimired io [dar arsai ch'ikh'od] kushta shaved, iak'inan ba suii Allokh' taolo makh'shur meshaved

[Ei paiombar] Ba [sababi] rakh'mati ilokh'i ast, ki tu bo onon [askh'ob] narmkhu [va mekh'rubon] shudi; va agar tundkhu va sangdil budi, kh'atman, az atrofat parokanda meshudand; pas, az eshon darguzar va baroiashon omurzish bikhokh' va dar korkh'o bo onon mashvarat kun va on gokh' ki tasmim [bar anch'omi kore] girifti, bar Allokh' taolo tavakkal kun; [charo ki] be tardid, Allokh' taolo tavakkalkunandagonro dust medorad

Agar Allokh' taolo shumoro iori kunad, kh'ech' kas bar shumo piruz nakhokh'ad shud va [ammo] agar shumoro ba khud voguzorad, kist, ki pas az U ioriaton kunad? Va mu'minon boiad tankh'o bar Allokh' taolo tavakkal kunand

Va sazovor nest kh'ech' paiombare [bo giriftani sakh'mi izofi az g'anoim ba askh'obash] khiionat kunad; va kh'ar ki khiionat kunad, ruzi k'iiomat, bo on chi [dar on] khiionat kardaast, meoiad; sipas ba kh'ar kas podoshi kh'ar chi [az neku bad] kardaast, ba tavri komil doda meshavad va ba onon sitam nakhokh'ad shud
Oio kase, ki khushnudii Allokh'ro metalabad, kh'ammonandi kasest, ki ba khashme az Allokh' taolo duchor shuda va ch'oigokh'ash duzakh ast? Va [duzakh] chi bad ch'oigokh'est!
[Kh'ar iak az] Eshon darach'ot [-i mutafovit]-e nazdi Allokh' taolo dorand va Allokh' taolo ba on chi mekunand, binost

Ba rosti, Allokh' taolo bar mu'minon minnat nikh'od, ki miioni onon paiombare az khudashon barangekht, to oioti U [K'ur'on]-ro bar eshon bikhonad va [az gunokh'] pokashon gardonad va ba onon kitobi [K'ur'on] va kh'ikmat [sunnat] biiomurzad; dar kh'ole ki dar guzashta dar gumrokh'ii oshkore budand

[Ei mu'minon] Oio chun ba shumo [dar ch'angi Ukh'ud] musibate rasid - [bo on ki dar ch'angi Badr] du barobarashro [ba dushmanoni khud] rasonded - gufted: "In [musibat] az kuch'o [ba mo] rasid"? [Ei paiombar] Bigu: "On [shikast] az ch'onibi khudaton [va natich'ai nofarmoni az dasturi paiombar] ast". Be gumon, Allokh' taolo ba kh'ar kore tavonost
Va ruze, ki [dar ch'angi Ukh'ud] du gurukh' [mu'minon va kofiron] bo kh'am barkhurd kardand, on chi ba shumo rasid, ba farmoni Allokh' taolo bud [to shumoro biiozmoiad] va mu'minonro ma'lum dorad

Va kasonero, ki nifok' varzidand [niz] ma'lum dorad, ki [chun] ba eshon gufta shud: "Biioed, dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo bich'anged io [az khonavoda va k'abilaaton] difo' kuned". Guftand: "Agar medonistem, ch'ange rui khokh'ad dod, kh'atman, az shumo pairavi mekardem". Onon dar on kh'angom ba kufr nazdiktar budand to imon; ba zaboni khesh chize meguiand, ki dar dilkh'oiashon nest va Allokh' taolo ba on chi [dar dil] pinkh'on mekunand, ogokh'tar ast

Kasone, ki [khud dar khona] nishastand [az ch'ikh'od sar boz zadand] va dar borai barodaroni khud guftand: "Agar onkh'o az mo pairavi mekardand, kushta nameshudand". [Ei paiombar, ba in munofik'on] Bigu: "Agar rost megued, pas, margro az khud dur sozed"
Kh'argiz kasonero, ki dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo kushta shudaand, murda mapindor; balki zindaand va nazdi Parvardigorashon ruzi doda meshavand

Onon ba on chi Allokh' taolo az fazli khud ba eshon dodaast, shodmonand va baroi [saranch'omi neki] kasone, ki [rokh'i] ononro pai giriftaand va [kh'anuz] ba onon napaivastaand, shodi mekunand; charo ki [kh'ech' iak az] eshon tarsu andukh'e nakhokh'and dosht
[Kh'amchunin] Ba ne'matu fazli Allokh' taolo shodmonand va in ki [mebinand] Allokh' taolo podoshi mu'minonro zoe' namekunad

Kasone, ki da'vati Allokh' taolo va paiombarro - pas az on ki [dar g'azvai Ukh'ud] ba onon ch'arokh'at [va sakhtii bisior] rasid - ich'obat kardand [va baroi ta'k'ibi mushrikon ba suii "Kh'amro-ul-asad" raftand], baroi [on idda az] eshon, ki neki va parkh'ezkori kardand, podoshi buzurge [dar pesh] ast

Kh'amon kasone, ki barkhe [az mushrikon] ba onon guftand: "Mardum [-i Makka] baroi [ch'ang bo] shumo gird omadaand; pas, az onkh'o bitarsed" va [ammo in sukhan] bar imonashon afzud va guftand: "Allokh' taolo baroi [mukh'ofizat az] mo bas ast va [U] bekh'tarin [murok'ib va] korguzor ast"

Pas ba ne'matu fazli Allokh' taolo [az Kh'amro-ul-asad ba Madina] bozgashtand, dar kh'ole ki kh'ech' osebe ba onon narasida bud va kh'amchunon dar paii [kasbi] khushnudii Allokh' taolo budand; va Allokh' taolo fazlu bakhshishi buzurge dorad
Dar kh'ak'ik'at, in shaiton ast, ki [shumoro az kh'aibati] dustonash metarsonad, pas, agar imon dored, az onon [mushrikon] natarsed va az man bitarsed

Va [ei paiombar] kasone, ki dar [iori kardani] kufr meshitoband, turo andukh'gin nasozand. Iak'inan, onon kh'argiz ziione ba Allokh' taolo namerasonand. Allokh' taolo mekhokh'ad, ki bakh'rae baroiashon dar okhirat k'aror nadikh'ad va azobi buzurg [dar pesh] dorand
Ba rosti, kasone, ki kufrro ba [bakh'oi] imon kharidand, kh'argiz ba Allokh' taolo ziione namerasonand va azobi dardnoke [dar pesh] dorand

Va kasone, ki kofir shudand, mapindorand, ki chun ba onon mukh'lat medikh'em ba sudashon ast. Ch'uz in nest, ki ba onon mukh'lat medikh'em, to bar gunokh'i [khud] biiafzoiand va azobi khorkunandae [purdarde dar pesh] dorand

[Ei mu'minon] Chunin nabud [va az kh'ikmati ilokh'i nest], ki Allokh' taolo mu'minonro bar in kh'ol, ki shumo kh'asted [vo guzorad va mu'minu munofik'ro dar kanori iakdigar] rakh'o sozad, [balki shumoro bo takolifu ozmoishkh'oi gunogun meozmoiad] to palidro az pok ch'udo kuned; va chunin nabud, ki Allokh' taolo [baroi bozshinosii mu'minon az munofik'on] shumoro az [asrori] g'aib ogokh' kunad; vale Allokh' taolo az miioni firistodagonash kh'ar kiro bikhokh'ad, barmeguzinad [va uro bar bakhshe az g'aib ogokh' mekunad]; pas, ba Allokh' taolo va firistodagonash imon biiovared; va agar imon biiovared va tak'vo pesha kuned, podoshi buzurge baroiaton [dar pesh] ast

Va kasone, ki ba on chi Allokh' taolo az fazli khesh ba onon dodaast, bukhl mevarzand, gumon nakunand, ki on [bukhl] baroiashon khair ast; balki baroiashon shar ast. Dar ruzi k'iiomat on chi ba on bukhl mevarzidand, tavk'i gardanashon khokh'ad shud [va bo on azob meshavand]; va merosi osmonkh'ovu zamin az oni Allokh' taolo ast va Allokh' taolo ba on chi mekuned, ogokh' ast

Be tardid, Allokh' taolo sukhani kasonero shunid, ki guftand: "Allokh' taolo fak'ir ast va [az mo k'arz mekhokh'ad va] mo beniiozem". [Mo in] Guftorashon va [niz] k'atli nokh'ak'k'i paiombaronro khokh'em navisht va ruzi k'iiomat ba [onon] meguem: "Azobi suzon [-i duzakh]-ro bichashed"
[Ei iakh'udiion] In [much'ozot] ba khotiri kirdori peshini shumost; va [-garna] Allokh' taolo kh'argiz ba bandagoni [khud] sitamgor nest

[In iakh'udiion kh'amon] Kasone kh'astand, ki guftand: "Allokh' taolo bo mo akh'du paimon bastaast, ki ba kh'ech' paiombare imon naiovarem, to [firistodae kh'amrokh'i khud] baroiamon k'urbonie biiovarad, ki otash [-i az soik'a barkhosta] onro [ba nishonai pazirish] bisuzonad". [Ei paiombar, ba onon] Bigu: "Kh'atman, pesh az man paiombarone budand, ki daloili oshkorro kh'amrokh'i on chi gufted, baroiaton ovardand. Agar rost megued, pas, charo ononro kushted"?

Pas, agar [iakh'udiion va kofiron] takzibat kardand, [g'amgin mabosh va bidon] paiombarone, ki pesh az tu budand va mu'ch'izotu navishtakh'o va kitobkh'oi ravshangar ovarda budand, [niz] takzib shudand

Kh'ar kase chashandai [ta'mi] marg ast va iak'inan ruzi k'iiomat podoshkh'oiatonro ba tamomi khokh'ed girift; pas, kh'ar kiro az otash dur dorand va dar bikh'isht darovarand, kh'atman, rastagor shudaast; va zindagii dunio chize ch'uz moiai fireb nest

[Ei mu'minon] Be tardid shumo dar [mavridi bazli] amvolu ch'onkh'oiaton ozmoish meshaved va [kh'amchunin] az kasone, ki pesh az shumo ba onon kitobi [osmoni] doda shudaast [iakh'udiion va masekh'iion] va [niz] az kasone, ki shirk varzidand, sukhanoni ozordikh'andai bisiore khokh'ed shunid; va [ammo] agar sabr kuned va tak'vo pesha sozed, [shoistatar ast; zero] in [istodagi] baiongari azmi ustuvor [-i shumo] dar korkh'ost

Va [ei paiombar, iod kun] kh'angome ki Allokh' taolo az kasone, ki kitobi [osmoni] ba onon doda shuda bud, paimon girift, ki: "Kh'atman, [omuzakh'oi kh'idoiatbakhshi] onro baroi mardum baion namoed va [on chiro, ki nubuvvati Mukh'ammad khabar medikh'ad] kitmonash nakuned"; va [-le] on [akh'd]-ro pushti sari khesh andokhtand [bad-on tavach'ch'ukh'e nakardand] va ba bakh'oi andake [kh'amchun molu mak'om] furukhtand. Chi bad ast, on chi mekharand!

Kasone, ki az a'moli [zishti] khud khushnud megardand va dust dorand dar muk'obili kor [-i nek] -e, ki anch'om nadodaand, mavridi sitoish k'aror girand, gumon mabar, ki az azob [-i ilokh'i] barkanorand; [balki] baroi onon azobi dardnoke [dar pesh] ast
Farmonravoii osmonkh'o va zamin az oni Allokh' taolo ast va Allokh' taolo ba kh'ar chize tavonost
Ba rosti, dar ofarinishi osmonkh'o va zamin va omadushudi shabu ruz nishonakh'o [i oshkor]-e baroi khiradmandon ast

[Kh'amon] Kasone, ki Allokh'ro [dar kh'amai akh'vol] istoda va nishasta va bar pakh'lu oramida, iod mekunand va dar ofarinishi osmonkh'o va zamin meandeshand [va meguiand]: "Parvardigoro, inkh'oro bekh'uda naofaridai; munazzakh'i Tu. Pas, moro az azobi otash [-i duzakh] nigakh' dor
Parvardigoro, kasero, ki Tu ba otash [-i duzakh] darovari, iak'inan, khoru rasvoiash kardai va sitamgoron [kh'ech'] iovare nadorand

Parvardigoro, mo shunidem, da'vatgare ba imon faro mekhonad, ki: "Ba Parvardigori khud imon ovared". Pas, mo imon ovardem. Parvardigoro, pas, gunokh'onamonro bibakhsh va badikh'oiamonro bipushon va moro dar zumrai nekon bimiron
Parvardigoro, on chiro, ki ba vasilai firistodagonat ba mo va'da dodai, ba mo ato kun va dar ruzi k'iiomat rasvoiamon magardon. Be tardid, Tu khilofi va'da namekuni"

Pas, Parvardigorashon duoi ononro ich'obat kard [va farmud]: "Man [podoshi] amali kh'ech' sokh'ibamale az shumoro - az mard io zan - ki kh'amnav'i iakdigared, tabokh' namekunam; pas, kasone, ki [az vatani khud] kh'ich'rat kardaand va [io] az khonakh'oi khud ronda shudaand va dar rokh'i man ozor didaand va ch'angidaand va kushta shudaand, kh'atman, badikh'oiashonro az onon mezudoiam va [ba unvoni] podoshe az ch'onibi Allokh' taolo eshonro dar bog'kh'oe darmeovaram, ki az zeri [darakhtoni] on ch'uiborkh'o ch'orist va Allokh' taolo ast, ki podoshi naku nazdi Ust
[Ei paiombar] Raftuomadi kofiron [baroi tich'orat] dar shakh'rkh'o [va molu mak'omi onon] turo nafirebad
[In] Bakh'ramandii nochizest; sipas ch'oigokh'ashon duzakh ast va chi bad ch'oigokh'e ast!

Ammo kasone, ki tak'voi Parvardigorashonro namudaand, [dar bikh'isht] bog'kh'oe dorand, ki az zeri [darakhtoni] on ch'uiborkh'o ch'orist [va] ch'ovidona dar on memonand. [In] Paziroi az ch'onibi Allokh' taolo [mukh'aiio shuda] ast va on chi nazdi Allokh' taolo ast, baroi nakukoron bekh'tar ast

Va kasone az akh'li kitob kh'astand, ki ba Allokh' taolo va on chi bar shumo nozil shuda va on chi bar khudashon nozil shudaast, imon dorand; dar barobari Allokh' taolo furutan kh'astand va oioti Allokh'ro ba bakh'oi nochize namefurushand. Inonand, ki podoshashon nazdi Parvardigorashon [makh'fuz] ast. Ba rosti, ki Allokh' taolo dar kh'isobrasi sare' ast
Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, [bar takolifi dini va ranch'kh'oi duniavi] shikeboi varzed va [dar barobari dushmanon] poidor boshed va parkh'ezgori pesha kuned; boshad, ki rastagor shaved

Ei mardum, az Parvardigoraton parvo kuned [bitarsed], [kh'amon zote] ki shumoro az iak tan ofarid va kh'amsarashro [niz] az u ofarid va az [nasli] on du mardonu zanoni bisiore parokand. Va az Parvardigore, ki ba [nomi] U az iakdigar darkhost mekuned, parvo [tak'vo] namoed va az [gusastani] paivandi kheshovandi biparkh'ezed. Be gumon, Allokh' taolo kh'amvora murok'ib [-u nigakh'boni] shumost

Va [ei sarparaston] amvoli iatimonro [pas az bulug'u rushd] ba eshon bozgardoned va [moli kamarzishu] nomarg'ub [-i khud]-ro bo [moli arzishmandu] marg'ub [-i onon] ivaz nakuned va amvoli eshonro kh'amrokh'i amvoli khud nakhured. Ba rosti, ki in [kor] gunokh'i buzurge ast

Va agar tarsided, ki [ba khotiri kostan az makh'riia io badraftori] natavoned adolatro dar kh'ak'k'i dukhtaroni iatim rioia namoed, [az izdivoch' bo onon sarfi nazar kuned va] az zanon [-i digar]-e, ki mavridi pisandi shumost, [iak io] du va [io] se va [io] chakh'or tanro ba kh'amsari darovared. Pas, agar bim dored, ki natavoned adolat kuned, ba iak [zan] io ba on chi [az kanizon], ki moliki onkh'oed [iktifo namoed]. In [kor] nazdiktar ast ba in, ki sitam nakuned
Va makh'riiai zanonro ba unvoni kh'adia [va farizai ilokh'i] bo khushdili ba onon bidikh'ed. Pas, agar onon chize az onro bo rizoiiati khotir ba shumo bakhshidand, onro khushu guvoro bikhured
Va ba kamkhiradone, ki Allokh' taolo shumoro ba sarparastii onon gumoshtaast, amvolashonro nadikh'ed va az [daromadi] on ba eshon khuroku pushok dikh'ed va bo onon ba shoistagi sukhan bigued

Va iatimonro [az likh'ozi tavonoi bar murok'ibat az amvolashon] biiozmoed to vak'te ba [sinni] izdivoch' birasand, pas, agar dar eshon rushd [-i fikrii kofi] iofted, amvolashonro ba onon bidikh'ed va onro [az bimi on ki mabodo] buzurg shavand [va az shumo pas bigirand], ba isrofu shitob makhured. Va kh'ar ki beniioz ast, boiad [az giriftani uch'ratu muzdi sarparasti] khuddori kunad va kh'ar ki niiozmand ast, boiad ba tarzi shoista [va mutobik'i urf az on] bikhurad. Pas, kh'ar gokh' amvolashonro ba onon boz gardonded, bar eshon guvokh' bigired va [bidoned] Allokh' taolo baroi kh'isobrasi kofi ast

Mardon az on chi padaru modar va kheshovandon [ba unvoni irs] bar ch'oi guzoshtaand, sakh'me dorand va zanon [niz] az on chi padaru modar va kheshovandon bar ch'oi guzoshtaand, sakh'me dorand - khokh' on [mol] kam boshad io ziiod. [Chunin] Bakh'rae [az ch'onibi Allokh' taolo] muaiian [va muk'arrar shuda] ast

Va kh'ar gokh' kheshovandon [-i g'airi voris] va iatimonu tikh'idaston bar tak'simi [meros] kh'ozir shavand, [pesh az tak'sim chize] az on [amvolro az bobi istikh'bob] ba onon bidikh'ed va ba shoistagi bo eshon sukhan bigued

Va kasone, ki agar farzandoni notavone az khud bar ch'oi bigzorand, bar [oiandai] onon bim dorand, boiad [az sitam dar borai iatimoni mardum niz] bitarsand. Pas, boiad az Allokh' taolo parvo kunand [bitarsand] va sukhani [sanch'ida va] durust biguiand
Dar kh'ak'ik'at, kasone, ki amvoli iatimonro ba sitam mekhurand, ch'uz in nest, ki otash dar shikami khesh furu mebarand va ba zudi ba otashe barafrukhta darmeoiand

Allokh' taolo dar borai farzandonaton ba shumo suporish mekunad: Sakh'mi pisar monandi sakh'mi du dukhtar ast. Va agar [vorison du dukhtar io] beshtar az du dukhtar boshad, sakh'mi onon du savumi taraka ast. Va agar fak'at iak dukhtar boshad, sakh'mi u nisfi taraka ast. Agar [maiit] farzand doshta boshad, baroi kh'ar iak az padaru modarash, iak shashumi taraka ast va agar farzand nadoshta boshad va [tankh'o] padaru modarash az u irs bibarand, dar in surat, baroi modarash iak savum [seiak] ast [va baroi padar du savum] va agar u [maiit] barodarone doshta boshad, sakh'mi modarash iak shashum [shashiak] ast. [In tak'simi meros] Pas az amal ba vasiiatest, ki karda va io [pardokhti] vome [ki dorad anch'om megirad]. Shumo namedoned, ki padaronaton va [io] farzandonaton, kadom iak baroiaton sudmandtar ast. [In akh'kom] Fariza [-i muaiian va muk'arrar] az ch'onibi Allokh' taolo ast. Ba rosti, ki Allokh' taolo donoi kh'akim ast

Va [ei shavkh'aron] agar kh'amsaronaton farzande nadoshta boshand, nime az taraka baroi shumost va agar farzande doshta boshand, iak chakh'orumi [chakh'oriak] taraka az oni shumost. [Albatta] Pas az [amal ba] vasiiate, ki kardaand io [pardokhti] vome, ki dorand. Va agar shumo farzande nadoshta boshed, iak chakh'orumi tarakai shumo baroi zanonaton ast va agar farzande doshta boshed, iak kh'ashtumi tarakai shumo az oni eshon ast. [Albatta] Pas az amal ba vasiiate, ki kardaed va [pardokhti] vome [ki dored]. Va agar mard io zane, ki az u irs mebarand, padar io farzand nadoshta boshad [kalola boshad] va barodar io khokh'ar doshta boshad, pas, baroi kh'ar iak az onon iak shashumi [taraka] ast. Va agar [kheshovandoni chunin shakhse] besh az in [du nafar] boshand, dar in surat, dar iak savum [az taraka] sharikand. [Albatta] Pas az anch'omi vasiiate, ki bad-on suporish shuda io vome, ki [boiad pardokht gardad, ba sharti on ki az in tarik'], ziione [ba vorison] narasonad. [In kh'ukm] Suporishi Allokh' taolo ast va Allokh' taolo donoi burdbor ast

Inkh'o kh'ududi ilokh'i ast va kh'ar ki az Allokh' taolo va paiombarash itoat kunad, vairo ba bog'kh'oe darmeovarad, ki az zeri [darakhtoni] on ch'uiborkh'o ch'ori ast, dar on ch'ovidonaand va in kh'amon komiobii buzurg ast

Va kh'ar ki az Allokh' taolo va paiombarash nofarmoni namoiad va az kh'ududi U tach'ovuz kunad, vairo dar otashe vorid mekunad, ki ch'ovidona dar on khokh'ad mond va baroiash azobi khorkunanda [dar pesh] ast

Va kasone az zanoni shumo, ki murtakibi zino meshavand, chakh'or nafar [mardi odil] az khudatonro bar onon guvokh' gired. Pas, agar guvokh'e dodand, on zanonro dar khonakh'o nigakh' dored, to margashon faro rasad io Allokh' taolo rokh'e baroiashon k'aror dikh'ad

Az miioni shumo on mardu zane, ki murtakibi on [amali zisht] meshavand, [bo tanbekh'u tavbikh] ozorashon dikh'ed. Pas, agar tavba kardand va durustkor shudand, az eshon sarfi nazar kuned, [charo ki] be tardid, Allokh' taolo tavbapaziri mekh'rubon ast

Ch'uz in nest, ki [pazirishi] tavba az suii Allokh' taolo baroi kasonest, ki az ruii nodoni kori noshoistae anch'om medikh'and, on gokh' ba zudi [va pesh az faro rasidani marg] tavba mekunand. Inonand, ki Allokh' taolo tavbaashonro mepazirad va Allokh' taolo donoi kh'akim ast

Va baroi kasone, ki [to poioni umr kh'amvora] murtakibi korkh'oi noshoista meshavand va kh'angome ki margi iake az onon faro merasad meguiad: "Aknun tavba kardam" [kh'ech'] tavba [va bakhshishe dar kor] nest va na baroi kasone, ki dar kh'oli kufr memirand. Inon kh'astand, ki baroiashon azobi dardnoke mukh'aiio sokhtaem

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, baroi shumo kh'alol nest, ki zanon [-i padaronaton]-ro bar khilofi mailashon ba irs bared [io mach'bur ba izdivoch' bo digaron kuned] va [dar mavridi kh'amsaroni khudaton niz kh'ukm in ast, ki] ononro zeri fishor k'aror nadikh'ed, to barkhe az on chiro, ki [ba unvoni makh'riia] ba eshon dodaed, pas bigired, magar in ki murtakibi amali noshoistai oshkore [monandi zino] shavand. [Ammo dar mavridi zanoni pokdomani khud nakuguftor boshed] Va bo onkh'o ba tavri shoista raftor kuned va agar az onon [khushaton naiomad va] karokh'at doshted, pas, [shikeboi kuned]. Chi baso chizero khush namedored va Allokh' taolo khairi bisiore dar on k'aror medikh'ad

Agar khosted kh'amsar [-i digare] ba ch'oii kh'amsar [-i peshini khud] barguzined va ba iake az onon moli farovone [ba unvoni makh'riia] pardokhtaed, chize az onro pas nagired. Oio mekhokh'ed on [mol]-ro ba bukh'ton va gunokh'i oshkor bozpas bigired?

Va chi guna on [makh'riia]-ro bozpas megired, dar kh'ole ki az iakdigar bakh'ramand shudaed [va az asrori iakdigar ogokh'ed] va onon [kh'angomi ak'di izdivoch'] az shumo paimoni makh'kamu ustuvor giriftaand

Va bo zanone, ki padaronaton [bo onkh'o] izdivoch' kardaand, [pas az margi padar] izdivoch' nakuned, magar on chi [az in nav' izdivoch', ki dar zamoni ch'okh'iliiat rukh doda va] bakhshida shudaast, [charo ki] be tardid, in kor amali zishtu tanaffurangez va rokh'i nodurust ast

[Izdivoch' bo in afrod] Bar shumo kh'arom shudaast: modaru dukhtar va khokh'aru amma va kholavu dukhtari barodaru dukhtari khokh'ar, modare, ki ba shumo shir dodaast va khokh'ari razoi va modari zanu dukhtari kh'amsare, ki [on dukhtar] dar khonai shumo parvarish ioftaast va bo on kh'amsar kh'ambistar shudaed - vale agar bo on zan omezish nakardaed, gunokh'e nest [ki bo dukhtarash izdivoch' kuned] - kh'amchunin, kh'amsari pisaraton, ki az pushti khudaton ast va izdivoch' bo du khokh'ar [niz bar shumo kh'arom ast], magar on chi [az in nav' izdivoch', ki dar zamoni ch'okh'iliiat rukh doda va] bakhshida shudaast, [charo ki] be tardid, Allokh' taolo omurzandai mekh'rubon ast

Zanoni shavkh'ardor [bar shumo kh'aromand], magar zanone, ki [kanizaton kh'astand va shumo] moliki onkh'o shudaed. [In] Farizai ilokh'ist, ki bar shumo muk'arrar doshtaast va g'air az inkh'o [ki gufta shud], baroiaton kh'alol ast, dar kh'ole ki pokdomani mevarzed va zinokor nested, bo amvoli khud [zanoni digarro] talab kuned. Pas, on zanone, ki [ba izdivoch' darovarded va] az onon kom girifted, boiad makh'riiaashonro ba unvoni farizae ba onon bidikh'ed va dar mavridi on chi ba'd az ta'iini makh'riia [dar mavridi beshu kami on] bo iakdigar tavofuk' mekuned, gunokh'e bar shumo nest. Be gumon, Allokh' taolo donoi kh'akim ast

Va kh'ar iak az shumo az likh'ozi moli tavonoii izdivoch' bo zanoni ozodai mu'minro nadorad, pas, bo kanizakoni boimone, ki dar ikhtiiori shumo [io digar musulmonon] kh'astand [izdivoch' kunad]. Va Allokh' taolo ba imonaton donotar ast. [Shumo va onon] Kh'amagi az ch'insi iakdigared [va bo iakdigar barobared], pas, bo ich'ozati sarparastashon bo onon izdivoch' kuned va makh'riiakh'oiashonro ba tavri pisandida ba eshon bidikh'ed, [ba sharti on ki] pokdoman boshand na zinokor va na [dar zumrai] kasone, ki pinkh'oni [baroi khud] dust megirand. On gokh' chun izdivoch' kardand, agar murtakibi zino shudand, pas, much'ozotashon [panch'okh' toziiona, ia'ne] nisfi much'ozoti zanoni ozod ast. In [ich'ozati izdivoch' bo kanizon] baroi kase az shumost, ki az oloish ba gunokh' bitarsad, va [-le dar mavridi izdivoch' bo kanizon] agar shikeboi [va pokdomani] pesha kuned, baroiaton bekh'tar ast va Allokh' taolo omurzandai mekh'rubon ast
Allokh' taolo mekhokh'ad, ki [akh'komi kheshro] baroiaton ravshan sozad va shumoro ba rokh'u ravishi kasone, ki pesh az shumo budand, rokh'namoi kunad va Allokh' taolo donoi kh'akim ast

Va Allokh' taolo mekhokh'ad tavbai shumoro bipazirad [va az oludagii gunokh' pokaton namoiad], va [-le] kasone, ki pairavi shakh'avot kh'astand, mekhokh'and, ki shumo dastkhushi inkh'irofi buzurge shaved
Allokh' taolo [bo tashre'i in akh'kom] mekhokh'ad bar shumo oson girad. Va inson notavon ofarida shudaast

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, amvoli iakdigarro ba botil [va az rokh'kh'oi nomashru'e kh'amchun g'asbu duzdi va rishva] nakhured, magar in ki tich'orate bo rizoiiati shumo [anch'om girifta] boshad; va [kh'amchunin] iakdigarro nakushed va khudkushi nakuned; kh'amono Allokh' taolo [nisbat] ba shumo mekh'rubon ast [va shumoro az in korkh'o boz medorad]
Va kh'ar ki [ogokh'ona va] az ruii tach'ovuz va sitam chunin kunad, pas, ba zudi uro dar otash [-i suzon] darmeovarem va in [kor] baroi Allokh' taolo oson ast
[Ei mu'minon] Agar az gunokh'oni buzurge, ki az on nakh'i shudaed, duri kuned, gunokh'on [-i sag'iraton]-ro az shumo mezudoem va shumoro dar ch'oigokh'i shoistai [bikh'isht] vorid mekunem

[Ei mu'minon] On chiro, ki Allokh' taolo ba vasilai on barkhe az shumoro bar barkhe digar bartari dodaast, orzu makuned [to duchori kh'asad nashaved]. Mardon az on chi ba dast ovardaand, [podoshu] bakh'rae dorand va zanon [niz] az on chi ba dast ovardaand, [ach'ru] bakh'rae dorand va az bakhshishi Allokh' taolo [chize] bikhokh'ed. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo ba kh'ar chize donost

Mo baroi kh'ar kas vorisone k'aror dodaem, ki az on chi padaru modar va kheshovandon bar ch'oi guzoshtaand, irs bibarand va [niz] ba kasone, ki [bo onon] paimoni [barodari va iori] bastaed, sakh'mashonro [az irs] bidikh'ed. Be gumon, Allokh' taolo bar kh'ar chize guvokh' ast

Mardon bar zanon sarparastu nigakh'bonand, ba khotiri on ki Allokh' taolo barkhe az eshonro bar barkhe bartari dodaast va [niz] ba khotiri on ki az amvoli khesh [baroi zanon] kharch' mekunand. Pas, zanoni solekh', [ononad, ki kh'am az Allokh' taolo va kh'am az shavkh'aronashon] farmonbardorand [va] ba posi on chi Allokh' taolo [baroiashon] kh'ifz kardaast [asroru kh'uk'uk'i shavkh'aroni khudro] dar g'aibi [onon] kh'ifz mekunand. Va [ei shavkh'aron] ba zanone, ki az nofarmoniashon bim dored, pandu andarz dikh'ed, [agar farmonbardor nashudand] dar bistar az eshon duri kuned [va agar ta'sir nakard], ononro [tavre, ki ozor nabinand] bizaned. Pas, agar az shumo itoat kardand, kh'ech' rokh'e [baroi bakh'onach'ui va sarzanish] bar onkh'o mach'ued [va bidoned, ki] ba rosti, Allokh' taolo balandmartabai buzurg ast

Va [shumo, ei sarparastoni zanu mard] agar az ikhtilofu ch'udoi miioni on du [zanu shavkh'ar] bim doshted, pas, iak dovar az khonavodai shavkh'ar va iak dovar az khonavodai zan [ta'iin kuned va baroi tasmimgiri] bifiristed. Agar in du [dovar] k'asdi islokh' [va oshti baini zavch'ain] doshta boshand, Allokh' taolo miioni on du [zanu shavkh'ar] sozgori khokh'ad dod. Be gumon, Allokh' taolo donoi ogokh' ast

Va Allokh'ro biparasted va chizero bo U sharik nagardoned va ba padaru modar neki kuned va [niz] ba kheshovandonu iatimon va tikh'idastonu kh'amsoiai kheshovand va kh'amsoiai g'airi kheshovand va kh'amnishinu [musofiri] dar rokh'monda va [kanizonu] bardagone, ki moliki onkh'o kh'asted [neki kuned va bidoned, ki] iak'inan, Allokh' taolo kasero, ki mutakabbir va fakhrfurush boshad, dust namedorad

[Kh'amon] Kasone, ki bukhl mevarzand va mardumro ba bukhl vomedorand va on chi [az sarvatu donish]-ro, ki Allokh' taolo az fazli khesh ba onon bakhshidaast, pinkh'on mekunand. Va mo baroi kofiron [va nosiposon] azobi khorkunanda mukh'aiio kardaem

Va [niz baroi] kasone, ki amvolashonro baroi [khudnamoi va] nishon dodan ba mardum infok' mekunand va ba Allokh' taolo va ruzi okhirat imon nadorand [chunin shakhse iori shaiton ast] va kase,ki shaiton kh'amdamash boshad, chi bad kh'amdame dorad!

Va baroi onon chi ziione dosht, agar ba Allokh' taolo va ruzi okhirat imon meovardand va az on chi Allokh' taolo ba onon ruzi dodaast, infok' mekardand? Va Allokh' taolo ba [kh'olu a'moli] eshon donost
Be gumon, Allokh' taolo ba andozai zarrae [ba bandagonash] sitam namekunad va agar kori neke boshad, onro duchandon mekunad va az peshgokh'i khud [ba onon] podoshi buzurge ato mekunad

Va kh'ol [-u ruzi nobovaron] chi guna boshad, on gokh', ki az kh'ar ummate shokh'idero [ki paiombari kh'amon ummat boshad] ba miion meovarem va turo [niz ei paiombar, dar borai iblog'i paiomi ilokh'i] bar inon guvokh' meovarem
On ruz kasone, ki kofir shudand va az paiombar nofarmoni kardand, orzu mekunand, ki ei kosh, bo khok iakson meshudand va kh'ech' sukhanero nametavonand az Allokh' taolo pinkh'on kunand

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, dar kh'oli masti ba namoz naisted, to zamone, ki bidoned chi megued va [kh'amchunin] kh'angome ki ch'unub kh'asted, to g'usl nakardaed, ba namoz [va masch'id] nazdik nashaved, magar on ki rakh'guzar boshed. Va agar bemor io musofir buded, io iake az shumo az makoni k'azoi kh'och'at omad io bo zanon omezish karded va [baroi vuzu io g'usl] ob naioftaed, pas, [boiad] bo khoki pok taiammum kuned, [ba in ravish, ki] chekh'ra va dastkh'oiatonro [bo on] makh's namoed. Be gumon, Allokh' taolo bakhshoiandai omurzgor ast

[Ei paiombar] Oio kasone [az iakh'udiion]-ro, ki bakh'rae az kitob ba onkh'o doda shudaast, nadidai [ki chi guna] gumrokh'iro mekharand va mekhokh'and shumo [mu'minon niz monandi eshon] gumrokh' shaved
Va [ei mu'minon] Allokh' taolo ba dushmanoni shumo donotar ast va kofi ast, ki Allokh' taolo ior [-u korsozaton] boshad va kofist, ki Allokh' taolo iovar [-u madadgoraton] boshad

Barkhe az iakh'udiion, kalimoti [Allokh' taolo]-ro az ch'oii khud takh'rif mekunand va bo pechondani zaboni khud va ba k'asdi ta'na zadan dar din [bo daromekhtani zaboni ibri bo arabi ba paiombar] meguiand: "Shunidem va nofarmoni kardem" va "Bishnav, ki [kosh] noshunavo gardi"! Va [niz ba tamaskhur meguiand]: "Ro'ino" [ki dar ibri mafkh'umi tavkh'inomeze dorad]. Vale agar onon meguftand: "Shunidem va itoat kardem" va "[sukhanoni moro] bishnav va ba mo mukh'lat bidekh'", kh'atman, baroiashon bekh'tar va durusttar bud. Vale Allokh' taolo ononro ba khotiri kufrashon la'nat kardaast. Pas, ch'uz [gurukh'i] andak imon nameovarand

Ei akh'li kitob, ba on chi ki [bar Mukh'ammad] nozil kardem va kitobi osmoni shumoro tasdik' mekunad, imon biiovared, pesh az on ki chekh'rakh'oro makh'v kunem va onkh'oro [kh'amchun] pushti sarashon [sofu zisht] bigardonem, io eshonro kh'amchun askh'obi sabt [iakh'udiioni nofarmone, ki ruzi shanbe mokh'i giriftand] la'nat kunem [va ba shakli maimun darovarem] va [bidoned, ki] farmoni Allokh' taolo, kh'atman, ba vuk'u' mepaivandad

Be gumon, Allokh' taolo in gunokh'ro, ki ba U shirk ovarda shavad, namebakhshad va g'air az onro - baroi kh'ar ki bikhokh'ad - mebakhshad; va kh'ar ki ba Allokh' taolo shirk varzad, iak'inan, gunokh'i buzurg ba gardan giriftaast

[Ei paiombar] Oio nadidi kasonero, ki kheshtanro pok meshumorand [va khudsitoi mekunand? Chunin nest], balki Allokh' taolo kh'ar kiro bikhokh'ad pok megardonad va ba eshon ba andozai zarrai nochiz [kh'atto ba andozai nakhi ruii kh'astai khurmo] sitam nameshavad
[Ei paiombar] Bingar, ki chi guna bar Allokh' taolo durug' mebandand! Va kh'amin [amal ba unvoni] gunokh'i oshkor kofi ast

Oio afrode [az k'avmi iakh'ud]-ro, ki bakh'rae az kitobi [osmoni] ba onon doda shudaast, nadidai [ki chi guna] ba butkh'o va ma'budoni botil imon meovarand? [In afrod az ruii dusti va madoro] Dar borai kasone, ki kufr varzidaand, meguiand: "Inon az kasone, ki imon ovardaand, kh'idoiatioftatarand"
Onon kasone kh'astand, ki Allokh' taolo la'natashon kardaast va kh'ar kiro Allokh' taolo la'nat kunad, kh'argiz baroiash iovare nakhokh'i ioft
Oio onon bakh'rae az kh'ukumat dorand? [Agar kh'am doshtand] Kamtarin chize ba mardum namedodand

Oio ba mardum [Mukh'ammad va ioronash] ba khotiri on chi Allokh' taolo az fazli khesh ba onon bakhshida kardaast, kh'asad mevarzand? Dar kh'ak'ik'at, Mo [peshtar niz] ba khonadoni Ibrokh'im kitobu kh'ikmat dodem va ba onon farmonravoii buzurge bakhshidem
