Pas, barkhe az onon ba vai imon ovardand va barkhe az onon az u rui gardondand [pas, nisbat ba da'vati Mukh'ammad niz chunin kardand] va [baroi in kofiron] otashi afrukhtai duzakh kofist

Be gumon, kasonero, ki ba oioti mo kufr varzidand, dar otash [-i suzon] vorid khokh'em kard, ki kh'ar chi pustashon birion gardad, pustkh'oi digare ba ch'oiash k'aror medikh'em, to [ta'mi] azobro bichashand. Ba rosti, ki Allokh' taolo shikastnopaziri kh'akim ast

Va kasonero, ki imon ovardaand va korkh'oi shoista anch'om dodaand, ba bog'kh'oe [az bikh'isht] vorid khokh'em namud, ki az zeri [darakhtoni] on ch'uiborkh'o ch'ori ast; kh'amvora dar on khokh'and mond va dar on ch'o kh'amsaroni pokiza dorand va ononro zeri soiakh'oi gusturda [va anbukh'] ch'oi medikh'em

Allokh' taolo ba shumo farmon medikh'ad, ki amonatkh'oro [ba tavri komil] ba sokh'ibonashon bozgardoned va kh'angome ki miioni mardum dovari mekuned, ba adolat dovari kuned. Allokh' taolo ba amri nek pandaton medikh'ad. Ba rosti, ki Allokh' taolo shunavoi binost

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, az Allokh' taolo va paiombar va korguzoron [-u farmondekh'oni musulmoni khud] itoat kuned va agar dar chize ikhtilof karded, onro ba [Kitobi] Allokh' taolo va [Sunnati] paiombar bozgardoned. Agar ba Allokh' taolo va ruzi k'iiomat imon dored, [iak'in doshta boshed, ki] in [bozgasht va K'ur'onu Sunnat baroiaton] bekh'tar va khushfarch'omtar ast

[Ei paiombar] Oio afrode [az iakh'udiion]-ro nadidai, ki gumon mekunand, ba on chi bar tu nozil shuda va on chi pesh az tu nozil shuda imon ovardaand, va [-le] mekhokh'and baroi dovari nazdi Tog'ut [va kh'okimoni khudkoma] ravand? Bo on ki ba eshon dastur doda shudaast, ki ba u kufr varzand, va [-le] shaiton mekhokh'ad ononro dar gumrokh'ii duru daroze k'aror dikh'ad
Va chun ba onon gufta shavad: "Ba suii on chi Allokh' taolo nozil kardaast [K'ur'on] va ba suii paiombari [U] biioed", munofik'onro mebini, ki az tu sakht rui megardonand

Pas, chi guna ast, ki vak'te ba [sazoi] korkh'oi badashon musibate ba onon merasad, nazdi tu meoiand va ba Allokh' taolo savgand iod mekunand, ki: "Manzuri mo [az dodkhokh'i nazdi digaron chize] ch'uz neki va tavofuk' [miioni tarafain] nabudaast"?

Inon kh'amon kasone kh'astand, ki Allokh' taolo medonad, ki chi dar dil dorand. Pas, [ei paiombar] az onon rui bigardon va andarzashon bidekh' va bo baioni raso [natoich'i] kirdorashonro ba eshon gushzad kun

Va kh'ech' paiombarero nafiristodem, magar baroi in ki ba farmoni Allokh' taolo [mardum az vai] itoat kunand va agar kh'angome ki onon [bo gunokh'u nofarmoni] bar kheshtan sitam mekardand, [to zinda kh'asti] nazdat meomadand va az Allokh' taolo omurzish mekhostand, be tardid Allokh'ro tavbapaziri mekh'rubon meioftand

Na! Savgand ba Parvardigorat, [ei Mukh'ammad] ki onon imon nameovarand, magar in ki dar ikhtilofotashon turo dovar k'aror dikh'and va az dovarii tu dar dili khesh ekh'sosi norokh'ati nakunand va komilan taslim boshand

Va agar [monandi Bani Isroil] bar onon muk'arrar mekardem, ki "[nofarmononi] khudro bikushed io az khonavu shakh'raton berun biraved", ch'uz andake az eshon [ba on dasturkh'o] amal namekardand. Va agar ba on chi andarz doda shudand, amal mekardand, be tardid baroiashon bekh'tar va dar poidorishon [bar din] muassirtar bud
Va dar in surat, az peshgokh'i khud podoshi buzurge ba onon medodem
Va ba rokh'i rost kh'idoiatashon mekardem

Va kase, ki Allokh' taolo va paiombarro itoat kunad, [ruzi k'iiomat] kh'amnishini kasone khokh'ad bud, ki Allokh' taolo eshonro giromi doshtaast, [ia'ne] bo paiombaronu siddik'on [tasdik'kunandagoni paiombar] va shakh'idonu solekh'on. Va inon chi naku rafik'one kh'astand!
In fazlu bakhshish az ch'onibi Allokh' taolo ast va kh'amin bas, ki Allokh' taolo [ba akh'voli bandagon] donost
Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, silokh'i khudro bargired, sipas gurukh'-gurukh' io iak porcha [baroi ch'ikh'od bo dushman] rakh'sipor garded

Va [ei musulmonon] be tardid, az [miioni] shumo kase kh'ast, ki [ba khotiri tars az shirkat dar maidoni ch'ikh'od] susti mevarzad va agar musibate ba shumo birasad, meguiad: "Allokh' taolo ba man lutf kard, ki kh'amrokh'i onon [dar ch'ang] kh'ozir nabudam"

Va [-le] agar bakhshishu g'animate az ch'onibi Allokh' taolo ba shumo rasad, chunonki guio kh'argiz miioni shumo va u [robitai] dusti nabudaast, [bo kh'asrat] meguiad: "Ei kosh, man niz kh'amrokh'i onon budam va ba komiobii buzurge merasidam"

Pas, kasone, ki zindagii dunioro ba okhirat furukhtaand,boiad dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo paikor kunand va ba kh'ar kase, ki dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo paikor kunad, khokh' kushta shavad io piruz gardad, ba zudi podoshi buzurge khokh'em dod

Va [ei mu'minon] shumoro chi shudaast, ki dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo va [baroi iorii] mardonu zanon va kudakoni sitamdida paikor namekuned? Kh'amon kasone, ki meguiand: "Parvardigoro, moro az in shakh'r [-i Makka], ki akh'lash sitamgorand, berun bibar va az suii khesh baroi mo ioru korsoze k'aror bidekh' va az ch'onibi khud iovaru madadgore baroiamon bigumor"

Onon, ki imon ovardaand, dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo paikor mekunand va onon, ki kofirand, dar rokh'i Tog'ut [va kh'okimoni khudkoma] mech'angand. Pas, bo ioroni shaiton bich'anged, ki kh'atman, nairang [va nak'shai] shaiton zaif ast

[Ei paiombar] Oio kasonero nadidi, ki [dar Makka] ba onkh'o gufta shud: "[Aknun] Dast az ch'ang bardored va namoz barpo dored va zakot bipardozed", va [-le] chun [dar Madina] ch'ikh'od bar onon muk'arrar shud, on gokh' gurukh'e az eshon az mardum [-i mushriki Makka] tarsidand, monandi tars az Allokh' taolo io [kh'atto] beshtar va guftand: "Parvardigoro, charo ch'ikh'odro bar mo muk'arrar namudi? Charo ba mo to muddati kutokh'e mukh'lat nadodi [to az ne'matkh'oi duniavi bakh'ramand gardem]"? [Ba onon] Bigu: "Barkhurdori [az lazzatkh'oi in] dunio nochiz ast va baroi kase, ki parkh'ezkor boshad, saroi okhirat bekh'tar ast va [dar on ch'o] kuchaktarin sitame ba shumo nakhokh'ad shud

Kh'ar kuch'o boshed, marg shumoro darmeiobad, kh'archand dar burch'kh'oi ustuvor boshed. Va agar ba onon [munofik'on] khaire [kh'amchun farzand va moli farovon] birasad, meguiand: "In az ch'onibi Allokh' taolo ast" va agar sharre [kh'amchun margu ziioni moli] ba eshon birasad, [rasuli Allokh'ro badnom medonand va ba u] meguiand: "In az ch'onibi tust". [Ei paiombar, ba onon] Bigu: "Kh'ama [chiz] az ch'onibi Allokh' taolo ast". Charo in k'avm kh'ozir nestand, ki sukhanero dark kunand

[Ei inson] On chi az nekikh'o ba tu merasad, az ch'onibi Allokh' taolo ast va on chi az badikh'o ba tu merasad, az ch'onibi khudi tust. Va [ei paiombar] Mo turo baroi [kh'idoiati] mardum firistodem va guvokh'ii Allokh' taolo [dar in bora] kofi ast

Kh'ar ki az paiombar itoat kunad, dar khak'ik'at, az Allokh' taolo itoat kardaast va kh'ar ki ruigardon shavad, [az u andukh'gin mabosh, ei paiombar, zero Mo kh'argiz] turo bar onon nigakh'bon [-u murok'ib] nafiristodaem

Onon [nazdi tu] meguiand: "Farmonbardorem", vale chun az kh'uzurat berun meravand, gurukh'e az onon shabona chize ch'uz on chi tu guftai, tadbir mekunand va Allokh' taolo kh'ar chiro, ki shabona dar sar meparvarand, sabt mekunad. Pas, az onon rui bigardon va bar Allokh' taolo tavakkal kun va kh'amin bas, ki Allokh' taolo [murok'ibu] korguzor [-i tu] boshad
Oio dar K'ur'on nameandeshand, ki agar az suii [kase] g'air az Allokh' taolo bud, kh'atman, ikhtilof [va tanok'uzi] bisiore dar on meioftand?

Kh'angome ki khabare az emini [va piruzi] io tars [va shikast] ba onon merasad, [biduni kh'ech' takh'k'ik'e] onro fosh mesozand, va [-le] agar onro ba paiombar va farmondekh'onashon bozgardonand, afrode az onon, ki akh'li [fakh'mu] istinbot kh'astand, kh'atman, [maslikh'ati e'lom io kitmoni akhborro bekh'tar] medonand. Va [ei mu'minon] agar fazlu rakh'mati Allokh' taolo bar shumo nabud, ch'uz andake [kh'amagi] az shaiton pairavi mekarded

Pas, [ei paiombar] dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo paikor kun. Tu ukh'dadori kase ch'uz khud nesti, va [-le] mu'minonro [niz ba ch'ikh'od] tashvik' kun. Umed ast, ki Allokh' taolo osebi kofironro az shumo bozdorad va Allokh' taolo k'udratash beshtar va kaifarash sakhttar ast

Kase, ki shafoati pisandidae kunad, az [khairi] on nasibe khokh'ad dosht va kase, ki shafoati nopisande kunad, az [sharri] on nasibe khokh'ad dosht. Va Allokh' taolo kh'amvora bar kh'ar chize murok'ib ast
[Ei mu'minon] Kh'ar gokh' bo durudi samimona ba shumo salom guiand, shumo posukhi bekh'tar va io kh'amonandi on bigued, [charo ki] be tardid, Allokh' taolo kh'amvora bar kh'ar chize kh'isobgar ast

Allokh' taolo [ki ma'budi rostin ast va] kh'ech' ma'bude ch'uz U nest, iak'inan, kh'amagi shumoro ruzi k'iiomat, ki tardide dar [vuk'ui] on nest, ch'am' mekunad. Va kist, ki az Allokh' taolo rostguitar boshad?

[Ei mu'minon] Shumoro chi pesh omadaast, ki dar mavridi [tarzi raftor bo] munofik'on du gurukh' shudaed, kh'ol on ki Allokh' taolo ononro ba khotiri on chi anch'om dodaand, sarnagun sokhta [va ba kufru gumrokh'i bozgardonda] ast? Oio mekhokh'ed, kasero, ki Allokh' taolo gumrokh' kardaast, kh'idoiat kuned? Va [-le] kh'ar kiro Allokh' taolo gumrokh' kunad, rokh'e [ba suii kh'idoiat] baroiash nakhokh'i ioft

Onon [munofik'on] orzu mekunand, ki shumo niz kh'amchun eshon kufr bivarzed, to bo kh'am barobar shaved. Pas, kh'ech' iak az ononro ba dusti nagired, magar on ki [musulmon shavand va] dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo kh'ich'rat kunand. Pas, agar az [islom va kh'ich'rat] rui bartoftand [va raftorashonro idoma dodand], kh'ar ch'o ki onkh'oro iofted, dastgirashon kuned va bikushedashon va az onon dustu iovare ikhtiior nakuned

Magar onkh'oe, ki bo kh'ampaimononi shumo paimon bastaand io onkh'oe, ki nazdaton meoiand va az ch'ang bo shumo io k'avmi khud ba tang omadaand. Va agar Allokh' taolo mekhost, ononro bar shumo musallat mekard, ki bo shumo bich'angand, pas, agar az shumo kanoragiri kardand va bo shumo nach'angidand va taslim [-u farmonbardor]-i shumo shudand, [bidoned, ki digar] Allokh' taolo baroi shumo rokh'e [baroi tach'ovuz] bar onon k'aror nadodaast

[Ei mu'minon] Ba zudi [gurukh'i] digare [az munofik'on]-ro khokh'ed ioft, ki [zokh'iran] mekhokh'and az shumo va k'avmi khud dar amon boshand, va [-le] kh'ar gokh' ba fitnai [shirk] bozgardonda shavand, dar on furu meravand. Pas, agar az shumo kanora nagiriftand va az dari sulkh'u oshti vorid nashudand va dast az [ch'ang bo] shumo barnadoshtand, on gokh' ononro kh'ar kuch'o iofted, dastgirashon kuned va bikushedashon. Onon kh'astand, ki mo baroi shumo alaikh'i eshon daleli oshkor [baroi dastgiri va k'atlashon] k'aror dodaem

Kh'ech' mu'mine much'oz nest [ich'ozat nadorad], ki mu'minero bikushad, magar ba ishtibokh' [va bek'asd]. Va kase, ki mu'minero ba ishtibokh' bikushad, boiad iak bardai mu'min ozod kunad va khunbakh'oe ba khonavodai u [ba vorisoni mak'tul] bipardozad, magar in ki onkh'o guzasht kunand. Va agar [mak'tul] az k'avme boshad, ki dushmanoni shumo kh'astand va [khudi] u mu'min ast, ozod kardani iak bardai mu'min [ba unvoni kaffora kofi ast, zero kofir az mu'min irs namebarad] va agar [mak'tul mu'min naboshad, vale] az k'avme boshad, ki miioni shumo va eshon paimone bark'aror ast, boiad khunbakh'oe ba khonavodai u bipardozad va iak bardai mu'minro [niz] ozod kunad. Va kh'ar ki [tavoni moli nadosht io bardae baroi ozod kardan] naioft, pas, [boiad] ba unvoni tavbae ba dargokh'i Allokh' taolo du mokh' paiopai ruza bigirad. Va kh'amvora Allokh' taolo donoi kh'akim ast

Va kh'ar kas mu'minero amdan ba k'atl birasonad, kaifarash duzakh ast, [ki] dar on ch'ovidona memonad va Allokh' taolo bar vai g'azab mekunad va uro az rakh'mati khesh dur mesozad va azobi buzurge baroiash omoda sokhtaast

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, kh'angome ki dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo [baroi ch'ikh'od] rakh'sipor shuded, [pakh'lukh'oi korro khub] barrasi kuned va ba kase, ki izkh'ori sulkh'u islom namud, nagued: "Tu mu'min nesti", to [bitavoned uro bikushed va g'anoimu] sarmoiai nopoidori dunioro ba dast ovared, zero g'animatkh'oi bisiore [baroi shumo] nazdi Allokh' taolo ast. Shumo niz k'ablan in chunin buded [va imonatonro pinkh'on mekarded], sipas Allokh' taolo bar shumo minnat nikh'od [va kh'idoiat shuded]. Binobar in, ba durusti barrasi kuned, [charo ki] be tardid, Allokh' taolo ba on chi anch'om medikh'ed, ogokh' ast

On mu'minon [-i khonanishin]-e, ki biduni kh'ech' bemori va ranch'e az ch'ikh'od boznishastand, bo much'okh'idone, ki dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo bo molu ch'oni khud ch'ikh'od kardand, [kh'argiz] iakson nestand. Allokh' taolo kasonero, ki bo molu ch'onashon ch'ikh'od kardand, bar khonanishinon ba martabai [buzurg] bartari bakhshidaast va Allokh' taolo bar kh'ar iak [az much'okh'idon io khonanishinoni ma'zur] va'dai naku dodaast, va [-le] Allokh' taolo much'okh'idonro bar khonanishinon bo podoshi buzurg bartari dodaast
[Podoshe, ki] Ba unvoni darach'otu omurzish va rakh'mate az [peshgokh'i] U [nasibashon megardad] va Allokh' taolo omurzandai mekh'rubon ast

Kasone, ki [bo mondan dar sarzamini kufr] nisbat ba khesh sitamgor budand, [vak'te] farishtagon ch'onashonro megirand, [ba onon] meguiand: "Dar chi [kh'ol] buded"? Posukh medikh'and: "Mo dar zamin az sitamdidagon budem". [Farishtagon] Meguiand: "Oio zamini Allokh' taolo gusturda nabud, to dar on mukh'och'irat kuned [va imonatonro kh'ifz namoed]"? Pas, ch'oigokh'ashon duzakh ast va chi bad saranch'omest!
Magar mardonu zanon va kudakoni sitamdidae, ki nametavonand chorae biiandeshand va rokh' ba ch'oie namebarand
Pas, onon [ki uzre dorand] umed ast, ki Allokh' taolo az eshon darguzarad va kh'amvora Allokh' taolo bakhshoiandai omurzgor ast

Va kh'ar ki dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo kh'ich'rat kunad, dar zamin sarpanokh'i bisior va kushoishe [dar ruzi va kor] meiobad va kase, ki ba k'asdi kh'ich'rat ba suii Allokh' taolo va paiombarash az khonaash khorich' shavad va on gokh' margash faro rasad, kh'atman, podoshash bar [ukh'dai] Allokh' taolo ast va Allokh' taolo omurzandai mekh'rubon ast

Va [ei mu'minon] kh'ar gokh' dar zamin safar kuned, agar tarsided, onon, ki kufr varzidand, bar shumo ziione birasonand, gunokh'e bar shumo nest, ki az [rakaoti] namoz bikokh'ed [va onro shikasta bikhoned], zero kofiron kh'amvora baroiaton dushmani oshkore kh'astand

Va [ei paiombar] chun [vak'ti ch'ang] dar miioni onon budi va baroiashon namoz barpo doshti, pas, boiad gurukh'e az onon bo tu [ba namoz] istand va [kh'amchunin] boiad ch'angafzorkh'oiashonro bo khud bargirand [va iak rakaatro kh'amrokh'i tu bikhonand va namozro ba surati furodo (tankh'o) idoma dikh'and] va chun sach'da kardand [va namozashon tamom shud], boiad pushti saraton k'aror girand va boiad on dastae, ki namoz nakhondaand, biioiand va [iak rak'at] bo tu namoz bikhonand [va pas az in ki namozat ba poion rasid, idomai namozashonro komil kunand] va [onon niz] boiad ekh'tiiot kunand va ch'angafzorkh'oiashonro [dar namoz bo khud] bargirand, [zero] kofiron umed dorand, ki shumo az ch'angafzorkh'o va tach'kh'izoti khud g'ofil shaved, to iakbora bar shumo bitozand. Va agar az boron [io moneakh'oi digar] dar ranch' buded va [io] bemor [va mach'rukh'] buded, gunokh'e bar shumo nest, ki ch'angafzorkh'oi khudro [bar zamin] bigzored, vale ch'onibi ekh'tiiotro rioia kuned. Ba rosti, ki Allokh' taolo baroi kofiron azobi khorkunanda mukh'aiio kardaast

Pas, chun namozro ba poion rasonided, Allokh'ro [dar kh'ama kh'ol] istoda va nishasta va bar pakh'lu khufta [khobida] iod kuned; va kh'ar gokh' oromish iofted [va tars az bain raft], namozro [komil] barpo dored, [charo ki] be tardid, namoz [farizaest, ki] dar avk'oti muaiiane bar mu'minon voch'ib shudaast

Va [ei mu'minon] dar ta'k'ibi on gurukh' [dushman] susti nakuned. Agar shumo [az khastagi va ch'arokh'at] ranch' mebared, onon niz chunon ki shumo ranch' mebared, ranch' burdaand, vale shumo umede ba Allokh' taolo dored, ki onon nadorand. Va Allokh' taolo donoi kh'akim ast
[Ei paiombar] Mo [in] kitobro ba kh'ak' bar tu nozil kardaem, to ba [much'ibi] on chi Allokh' taolo ba tu omukhtaast, dar miioni mardum dovari kuni va mudofei khiionatkoron mabosh
Va az Allokh' taolo omurzish bikhokh'. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo omurzandai mekh'rubon ast
Va az kasone, ki [bo irtikobi gunokh'] ba khud khiionat mekunand, difo' nakun, [charo ki] be gumon, Allokh' taolo kh'ar kiro khiionatkor [va] gunakh'gor boshad, dust namedorad

Onkh'o [zishtkorikh'oi khudro] az mardum pinkh'on medorand, vale nametavonand, chizero az Allokh' taolo pinkh'on kunand va [kh'ol on ki] U kh'amrokh'ashon ast, on gokh', ki shabona choraandeshi mekunand va [az sari durug'u iftiro] sukhanone meguiand, ki U namepisandad va Allokh' taolo kh'amvora ba on chi mekunand, ikh'ota dorad

Kh'on! Shumo kasone kh'asted, ki dar zindagii dunio az onon difo' karded. Pas, kist, ki ruzi k'iiomat dar barobari Allokh' taolo az onon difo' kunad? Io chi kasest, ki [murok'ibu] korguzorashon boshad?

Va kh'ar ki amali noshoistae murtakib shavad io [bo nofarmoni az dasturi Allokh' taolo va rasulash] ba khud sitam kunad, [va] sipas az Allokh' taolo omurzish bikhokh'ad, Allokh'ro omurzandai mekh'rubon khokh'ad ioft
Va kh'ar ki gunokh'e murtakib shavad, pas, tankh'o ba ziioni khesh [chunin] mekunad va Allokh' taolo kh'amvora donoi kh'akim ast
Va kh'ar ki khato io gunokh'e murtakib shavad, sipas onro bar gardani begunokh'e biiandozad, kh'atman, [bori] bukh'ton va gunokh'i oshkorero bar dush giriftaast

Va [ei paiombar] agar fazli Allokh'u rakh'matash bar tu nabud, gurukh'e az onon k'asd doshtand, ki turo gumrokh' kunand [to noodilona k'azovat kuni], va [-le] ch'uz khudashon [kase]-ro gumrokh' namesozand va kh'ech' ziione ba tu namerasonand. Va Allokh' taolo kitob [K'ur'on] va kh'ikmat [Sunnat]-ro bar tu nozil kard va on chiro namedonisti, ba tu omukht va kh'amvora fazli Allokh' taolo bar tu buzurg [-u bisior] budaast

Dar bisiore az rozguikh'oi onon [mardum] khaire nest, magar [dar guftori] kase, ki ba [dodani] sadak'ae io kore pisandida io sozishe miioni mardum farmon dikh'ad. Va kh'ar ki baroi khushnudii Allokh' taolo chunin kunad, ba zudi podoshi buzurge ba vai khokh'em dod

Va kh'ar kas pas az on ki [rokh'i kh'ak' va] kh'idoiat baroiash ravshan shud, bo paiombar mukholifat kunad va az rokh'e ch'uz rokh'i mu'minon pairavi kunad, uro ba on chi [baroi khud barguzida va az on] pairavi kardaast, vomeguzorem va ba duzakh mekashonem. Va [kh'ak'k'o, ki duzakh] chi bad ch'oigokh'est!

Allokh' taolo [in] gunokh'ro, ki ba u shirk ovarda shavad, kh'atman, nameomurzad va ba ch'uz on [kh'ar gunokh'e]-ro baroi kh'ar ki bikhokh'ad, meomurzad va kh'ar ki ba Allokh' taolo shirk ovarad, pas, be tardid, dar gumrokh'ii duru daroze aftodaast
[Mushrikon] Ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo butkh'oi modinae [kh'amchun Lotu Uzzo]-ro mekhonand va [dar kh'ak'ik'at] ch'uz shaitoni sarkashro namekhonand
[Kh'amon ki] Allokh' taolo uro az rakh'mati khesh dur sokht va u guft: "Az bandagoni Tu sakh'mi muaiian barkhokh'am girift

Va musallaman, ononro gumrokh' mekunam va ba orzukh'oi botil meafkanam va ba eshon dastur medikh'am, ki gushi chakh'orpoionro bishkofand va vodorashon mekunam, to ofarinishi Allokh'ro tag'iir dikh'and". Va kh'ar ki shaitonro ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo dust [-u korsozi] khud girad, kh'atman, ziioni oshkor kardaast
[Ore] Shaiton ba onon va'da medikh'ad va dar [domi] orzukh'o meandozadashon va ba onon va'dae ch'uz fireb namedikh'ad
Onon [pairavoni shaiton] ch'oigokh'ashon duzakh ast va az on kh'ech' rokh'i firore nameioband

Va kasone, ki imon ovardaand va korkh'oi shoista anch'om dodaand, ba zudi ononro dar bog'kh'oe [az bikh'isht] vorid mekunem, ki ch'uiborkh'o az zeri [darakhtoni] on ch'orist, ch'ovidona dar on khokh'and mond, va'dai Allokh' taolo kh'ak' ast va kist, ki dar guftor [-u va'dakh'oiash] az Allokh' taolo rostguitar boshad?!

[Ei musulmonon, nach'otu rastagori vobasta] Ba orzukh'oi shumo va orzukh'oi akh'li kitob nest. Kh'ar kas kori noshoistae anch'om dikh'ad, ba kaifarash khokh'ad rasid va ch'uz Allokh' taolo baroi khud dustu iovare nakhokh'ad ioft

Va kh'ar kas, az zanu mard, ki korkh'oi shoista kunad va mu'min boshad, [kh'amai] onon voridi bikh'isht meshavand va ba andozai zarrai nochize [kh'atto ba andozai shikofi kh'astai khurmo niz] ba eshon sitam nakhokh'ad shud
Va chi kase nekointar az kasest, ki khudro taslimi Allokh' taolo karda va nakukor ast va az oini Ibrokh'imi kh'ak'garo pairavi namudaast? Va Allokh' taolo Ibrokh'imro ba dustii khud barguzid
Va on chi dar osmonkh'o va zamin ast, az oni Allokh' taolo ast va Allokh' taolo kh'amvora ba kh'ar chize ikh'ota dorad

Va [ei paiombar, musulmonon] az tu dar borai zanon nazarkhokh'i mekunand; Bigu: "Allokh' taolo dar borai onon fatvo medikh'ad va dar on chi az kitob [K'ur'on] bar shumo khonda meshavad, [niz] omadaast, ki [kh'ukmi U] dar borai dukhtaroni iatime, ki kh'ak'k'i muk'arrarashon [az makh'riiai voris]-ro namepardozed va mail ba izdivoch' bo onon nadored [va az ruii tama' dar amvolashon ononro az izdivoch' man' mekuned] va [kh'amchunin, dasturash dar mavridi] kudakoni notavon [in ast], ki: "Dar kh'ak'k'i iatimon ba adlu insof bikushed" va kh'ar on chi az nekikh'o, ki anch'om medikh'ed, Allokh' taolo ba on ogokh' ast

Va agar zane az nosozgori io ruigardonii shavkh'arash bim dosht, pas, bar on du nafar gunokh'e nest, ki bo [sarfi nazar az barkhe kh'uk'uk' va vazoif] bo iakdigar oshti kunand. Va oshti bekh'tar [az talok'] ast va [-le tama' va] bukhl nafskh'oro faro giriftaast [va kh'ech' kas az kh'ak'k'i khesh nameguzarad] va agar neki kuned va parkh'ezkori pesha sozed, kh'atman, Allokh' taolo ba on chi anch'om medikh'ed, ogokh' ast

Va [shumo mardon] kh'archand bikushed, kh'argiz nametavoned [az nazari mukh'abbati k'albi] miioni zanon adolat bark'aror kuned, pas, iaksara [ba iake mail nakuned va] az iake ru nagardoned, ki uro bilotaklif rakh'o kuned. Va agar sozish namoed va parkh'ezgori kuned, be tardid, Allokh' taolo omurzandai mekh'rubon ast
Va agar on du [zanu shavkh'ar] az iakdigar ch'udo shavand, Allokh' taolo kh'ar iake az ononro az kushoish [va bakhshishi] khesh beniioz mesozad va Allokh' taolo kh'amvora kushoishgaru kh'akim ast

Va on chi dar osmonkh'o va zamin ast az oni Allokh' taolo ast va mo ba kasone, ki pesh az shumo ba onon kitob [-i osmoni] doda shud va [kh'amchunin] ba shumo suporish kardem, ki: "Az Allokh' taolo parvo kuned [bitarsed]" va agar kofir shuded, [bidoned, ki] on chi dar osmonkh'o va zamin ast, az oni Allokh' taolo ast va Allokh' taolo beniiozi sutuda ast
Va on chi dar osmonkh'o va zamin ast, az oni Allokh' taolo ast va kh'amin bas, ki Allokh' taolo [murok'ibu] korguzor [-i bandagon] boshad
Ei mardum, agar U bikhokh'ad, shumoro az miion mebarad va digaronro meovarad va Allokh' taolo kh'amvora bar in [kor] tavonost
Kh'ar ki [dar k'iboli korkh'oiash] podoshi dunioro mekhokh'ad, pas, [bidonad, ki] podoshi dunio va okhirat nazdi Allokh' taolo ast va Allokh' taolo kh'amvora shunavovu binost

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, barpodorandai adolat boshed [va] baroi Allokh' taolo shakh'odat dikh'ed, agarchi ba ziioni khudaton io padaru modar va nazdikon [-i shumo] boshad. Agar [iake az du tarafi da'vo] tavongar io niiozmand boshad, [boz kh'am] Allokh' taolo [az shumo] ba on du nafar sazovortar ast, pas, az kh'avoi nafs pairavi nakuned, ki [az kh'ak'] munkh'arif meshaved. Va agar zabonro bigardoned, [va kh'ak'ro takh'rif kuned] io [az izkh'ori on] khuddori namoed, musallaman, Allokh' taolo ba on chi anch'om medikh'ed, ogokh' ast

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, ba Allokh' taolo va paiombarash va kitobe, ki bar u nozil kardaast va [ba kh'ar] kitobe, ki pesh az in firistodaast, imon biiovared [va bar on poidor boshed] va kh'ar, ki ba Allokh' taolo va farishtagoni U va kitobkh'ovu paiombaronash va ruzi k'iiomat kufr bivarzad, be tardid, dar gumrokh'ii duru daroze aftodaast

Be tardid, kasone ki imon ovardand, sipas kofir shudand va pas az on imon ovardand va boz kofir shudand va on gokh' bar kufri [khud] afzudand, Allokh' taolo kh'argiz bar on nest, ki ononro bibakhshoiad va ba rokh' [-i rost, ki ba saodati abadi khatm megardad] kh'idoiatashon kunad
[Ei paiombar] Ba munofik'on khabar bidekh', ki azobi dardnok baroiashon [dar pesh] ast
[Kh'amon] Kasone, ki kofironro ba ch'oii mu'minon ba dusti barmeguzinand. Oio sarbalandiro nazdi onon mech'uiand? Pas, [boiad bidonand, ki] kh'amai sarbalandi az oni Allokh' taolo ast

Va [ei mu'minon] musallaman, [Allokh' taolo in kh'ukmro] dar in kitob [K'ur'on] bar shumo nozil kardaast, ki: "Chun shunided [afrode] oioti Allokh'ro inkor mekunand va onro ba tamaskhur megirand, bo onon nanishined, to ba sukhani digar bipardozand. [Agar bo onon binshined] Dar in surat, kh'atman, shumo [niz] kh'ammonandi onon khokh'ed bud". Be tardid, Allokh' taolo kh'amai munofik'on va kofironro dar duzakh gird meovarad

[Kh'amon] Kasone, ki [az sari badkhokh'i kh'amvora] shumoro zeri nazar dorand, agar piruzi va kushoishe az ch'onibi Allokh' taolo nasibaton gardad, meguiand: "Magar mo bo shumo nabudem"? Va agar bakh'rae nasibi kofiron gardad, [ba onon] meguiand: "Magar mo pushtibonaton nabudem va shumoro az [gazandi] mu'minon boz nadoshtem"? Pas, Allokh' taolo ruzi k'iiomat miioni shumo dovari mekunad va Allokh' taolo kh'argiz baroi kofiron rokh'e [baroi tasallut] bar mu'minon k'aror nadodaast

Be tardid, munofik'on [bo durug'gui va tazokh'urashon] bo Allokh' taolo firebkori mekunand [va kh'ol on ki ba sazoi raftorashon] Allokh' taolo firebdikh'andai ononast; va chun ba namoz barkhezand, bo susti va kokh'ili barmekhezand [va] bo mardum riiokori mekunand va Allokh'ro ch'uz andake iod namekunand
[Munofik'on] Baini in du [gurukh': mu'minon va kofiron] sargashtaand, na bo inonand va na bo onon. Va [ei paiombar] kh'ar kiro Allokh' taolo gumrokh' kunad, rokh'e baroi [kh'idoiati] u nakhokh'i ioft
Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, kofironro ba ch'oii mu'minon, dustoni [khud] nagired. Oio mekhokh'ed, baroi Allokh' taolo daleli oshkore ba ziioni khud [baroi azob] padid ovared?
Kh'amono munofik'on dar furutarin darach'oti duzakhand va kh'argiz iovare baroiashon nakhokh'i ioft

Magar onon, ki tavba kardand va [botini kheshro] islokh' namudand va ba [kitobi] Allokh' taolo tamassuk ch'ustand va dini khudro baroi Allokh' taolo kholis gardondand. Pas, inon bo mu'minonand va Allokh' taolo ba mu'minon podoshi buzurge khokh'ad dod
Agar shukr kuned va imon ovared, Allokh' taolo chi niioze ba much'ozoti shumo dorad? Va Allokh' taolo kh'amvora shukrguzori donost
Allokh' taolo badguii oshkorro dust namedorad, magar az ch'onibi kase, ki ba u sitam shudaast [va nochor zabon ba shikoiatu nafrin mekushoiad]. Va Allokh' taolo kh'amvora shunavovu donost
Agar kori nekro oshkor kuned io onro pinkh'on dored io az badi [va sitame, ki ba shumo rasidaast] darguzared, pas, [bidoned, ki] be tardid, Allokh' taolo kh'amvora omurzandai tavonost

Kasone, ki ba Allokh' taolo va paiombaronash kufr mevarzand va mekhokh'and miioni Allokh' taolo va paiombaronash ch'udoi andozand va meguiand: "Mo ba ba'ze imon dorem va ba'zero inkor mekunem" va mekhokh'and dar in [miion baini kufru imon baroi khud] rokh'e barguzinand
Ononand, ki ba rosti, kofirand va mo baroi kofiron azobi khorkunandae mukh'aiio kardaem

Va kasone, ki ba Allokh' taolo va paiombaronash imon ovardand va miioni kh'ech' kadom az onon fark' nameguzorand, ba zudi [Allokh' taolo] podoshashonro ato mekunad va Allokh' taolo kh'amvora omurzandai mekh'rubon ast

[Ei paiombar] Akh'li kitob az tu mekhokh'and, ki [ba nishonai rostgui] baroiashon kitobe az osmon nozil kuni. [In darkhostashonro buzurg mashmor, zero onon] Az Muso [chizi buzurgtar va] ach'ibtar az in khostand va guftand: "Allokh'ro oshkoro ba mo nishon bidekh'". On gokh' ba khotiri darkhosti nokh'ak'ashon, soik'a [io marge] ononro furu girift, on gokh' [chun Allokh' taolo ononro dubora zinda kard] pas az on ki nishonakh'oi oshkor baroiashon omad, gusolaparasti kardand, va [-le mo pas az on ki tavba kardand] az on [gunokh'ashon niz] darguzashtem va ba Muso daleli oshkor bakhshidem

Va ba sababi paimon [giriftan az] onon [kukh'i] Turro boloi sarashon barafroshtem va ba eshon guftem: "Bo furutani az darvoza [-i Bait-ul-muk'addas] vorid shaved" va [kh'amchunin] ba onon guftem: "Kh'urmati shanbero nashkaned [va az saidi mokh'i dast bikashed]" va az onon paimoni sakhtu ustuvor giriftem

Pas, ba [sazoi] paimonshikanishon va inkorashon nisbat ba oioti Allokh' taolo va kushtori nokh'ak'k'i onon [az] paiombaron [la'natashon kardem] va [ba khotiri in] sukhanashon, ki: "Dilkh'oi mo [ch'oii sukhani kh'ak' nest va] pushida ast", balki Allokh' taolo ba khotiri kufrashon bar dilkh'oiashon mukh'r zadast. Binobar in ch'uz andake imon nameovarand
Va [niz] ba sazoi kufrashon va on tukh'mati buzurge, ki ba Mariam zadand

Va [ononro la'nat kardaem ba khotiri in] sukhanashon, ki: "Mo Masekh' - Iso pisari Mariam - paiombari Allokh'ro kushtem", dar kh'ole ki na uro kushtand va na ba dor ovekhtand, vale [amr] bar onon mushtabakh' shud [va mardero, ki shabekh'i Iso bud, ba dor kashidand] va kasone, ki dar borai u ikhtilof kardand, kh'atman, dar boraash duchori tardidand va kh'ech' ilme bad-on nadorand, magar on ki az gumon pairavi mekunand va iak'inan, uro nakushtand
Balki Allokh' taolo uro ba suii Khesh bolo burd. Va Allokh' taolo shikastnopaziri kh'akim ast
Va [kase] az akh'li kitob nest, magar in ki pesh az margash, kh'atman, ba u [Iso] imon meovarad va ruzi k'iiomat [niz] vai bar [kufru imoni] onon guvokh' khokh'ad bud
Pas, ba sazoi sitame, ki az iakh'udiion sar zad va ba sababi bozdoshtani bisiore [az mardum] az rokh'i Allokh' taolo, [mo niz] chizkh'oi pokizaero, ki baroiashon kh'alol bud, bar onon kh'arom kardem
Va [niz ba sababi] ribo giriftanashon, bo on ki az on nakh'i shuda budand va in ki moli mardumro ba noravo mekhurdand. Va mo baroi kofironashon azobi dardnok mukh'aiio kardaem

Vale az miioni onon rosikhoni dar ilm [ulamoi iakh'ud] va mu'minon [ia'ne onon, ki] ba on chi bar tu nozil shudaast va on chi ki pesh az tu nozil shudaast, imon meovarand va [kh'amchunin] namozguzoronu zakotdikh'andagon va imonovarandagon ba Allokh' taolo va ruzi bozpasin, ba [kh'amai] inkh'o podoshi buzurge khokh'em dod

[Ei paiombar] Be tardid mo ba tu vakh'i firistodem; kh'amon guna, ki ba Nukh'u paiombaroni ba'd az u vakh'i firistodem va [niz] ba Ibrokh'imu Ismoil va Iskh'ok'u Ia'k'ub va navodagon [-i Ia'k'ub] va Isovu Aiub va Iunusu Kh'orun va Sulaimon vakh'i firistodem va ba Dovud Zabur dodem

Va paiombarone [firistodem], ki dar kh'ak'ik'at, [sarguzashti] ononro pesh az in baroi tu kh'ikoiat namudem va paiombarone [-ro niz barangekhtaem], ki [dostoni] eshonro baroiat baion nakardaem. Va Allokh' taolo bo Muso oshkor [va bevosita] sukhan guft

Paiombarone [firistodem], ki bashoratbakhshu bimdikh'anda budand, to baroi mardum pas az [bi'sati] paiombaron dar muk'obili Allokh' taolo [kh'ech' bakh'ona va] kh'uch'ch'ate naboshad. Va Allokh' taolo kh'amvora shikastnopaziri kh'akim ast

[Ei paiombar, kofiron paiomatro inkor mekunand] Vale Allokh' taolo ba [durustii] on chi bar tu nozil kardaast, shakh'odat medikh'ad. Onro ba ilmi khesh nozil kardaast va farishtagon niz shakh'odat medikh'and. Va [baroi kh'ak'k'oniiati K'ur'on] kofist, ki Allokh' taolo guvokh' boshad
Be tardid, kasone, ki kufr varzidand va [mardumro] az rokh'i Allokh' taolo bozdoshtand, ba gumrokh'ii duru daroze aftodaand
Be tardid, kasone, ki kufr varzidand va [bo in kor bar khud] sitam kardand, Allokh' taolo kh'argiz bar on nest, ki biiomurzadashon va ba rokh' [-i durust niz] kh'idoiatashon namekunad
Magar rokh'i ch'akh'annam, ki ch'ovidona dar on memonand va in [kor] bar Allokh' taolo oson ast

Ei mardum, in paiombar az ch'onibi Parvardigoraton [kh'idoiatu dini] kh'ak'ro baroiaton ovardaast, pas, imon biiovared, ki ba khair [-u salokh']-i shumost. Va agar [sukhanashro napazired va] kufr bivarzed, [bidoned, ki] on chi dar osmonkh'o va zamin ast, az oni Allokh' taolo ast [va kufri shumo bar U ziione namerasonad] va Allokh' taolo kh'amvora donoi kh'akim ast

Ei [masekh'iioni] akh'li kitob, dar dini khud g'uluv nakuned va dar borai Allokh' taolo ch'uz [sukhani] kh'ak' nagued. Be tardid, Masekh' - Iso pisari Mariam - firistodai Allokh' taolo va kalimai Ust, ki [amr kard: "Bosh", pas, bedirang mavch'ud shud va bad-in surat ba amri Allokh' taolo [Ch'abrail] vairo ba Mariam ilk'o kard va [Iso] rukh'e az ch'onibi Ust. Pas, ba Allokh' taolo va paiombaronash imon biiovared va nagued: "[Ma'bud] Segona ast". [Az in sukhan] Bozisted, ki baroi shumo bekh'tar ast. Allokh' taolo tankh'o ma'budi iagona ast [va] az in ki farzande doshta boshad, pok [-u munazzakh'] ast. On chi dar osmonkh'o va zamin ast, az oni Ust va kh'amin bas ast, ki Allokh' taolo korguzor [-u murok'ibi makhluk'ot] boshad

Masekh' va farishtagoni muk'arrab kh'argiz [sar namepechand va] ibo nadorand, az in ki bandai Allokh' taolo boshand. Va kh'ar ki az parastishi U sarpechi kunad va takabbur varzad, kh'amai ononro [baroi kh'isobrasi] nazdi khesh ch'am' khokh'ad kard

Ammo onon, ki imon ovardaand va korkh'oi shoista anch'om dodaand, [Allokh' taolo] podoshkh'oiashonro ba tavri komil medikh'ad va az fazli khesh bar onkh'o meafzoiad. Va ammo onon, ki ibo kardand va takabbur varzidand, ba azobi dardnok azobashon mekunad va baroi khud g'air az Allokh' taolo dustu iovare nameioband
Ei mardum, ba rosti, ki baroi shumo az ch'onibi Parvardigoraton daleli ravshan [Mukh'ammad] omad va nuri oshkor [K'ur'on] ba suiaton nozil kardem
Ammo onon, ki ba Allokh' taolo imon ovardand va ba on [K'ur'on] tamassuk ch'ustand, kh'amaro dar rakh'matu fazli khud vorid khokh'ad kard va ba rokh'i rost ba suii khesh rakh'namun megardonad

[Ei paiombar, dar borai chigunagii tak'simi irs baini barodaru khokh'ari on maiite, ki padaru modar va farzand nadorad] az tu mepursand. Bigu: "Allokh' taolo dar [mavridi] kalola baroiaton kh'ukm sodir mekunad: Agar marde, ki [padaru modar va] farzande nadorad, favt kunad va khokh'are doshta boshad, nisfi taraka az oni ust. [Va agar zane favt kunad va barodare doshta boshad] Dar surate ki farzand nadoshta boshad, on mard [kh'amai tarakaro] az u ba irs mebarad. Va agar du khokh'ar [io beshtar az maiit] bok'i bimonad, du savumi taraka baroi onkh'ost. Va agar barodaronu khokh'aron [bo kh'am] boshand, kh'ar marde [muodili] sakh'mi du zanro dorad. Allokh' taolo [in akh'komro] baroiaton ravshan mesozad, to gumrokh' nashaved [va dar tak'simi irs ba rokh'i khato naraved] va Allokh' taolo ba kh'ar chize donost"

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, ba paimonkh'o [-i khud] vafo kuned. [Khurdani gushti] Chakh'orpoion bar shumo kh'alol ast, magar on chi [kh'ukmash] bar shumo khonda shavad va [ba sharti on ki] dar kh'oli ekh'rom [kh'ach' io umra] shikorro kh'alol nashumored. Kh'amono Allokh' taolo kh'ar chi bikhokh'ad kh'ukm mekunad

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, [kh'urmati] shaoiri ilokh'i va mokh'i kh'arom [-ro nigakh' dored] va [kh'amchunin, kh'urmati] k'urbonii benishon va k'urbonikh'oi k'alodador (gardandbanddor) va rokh'iioni Bait-ul-kh'arom, ki fazlu khushnudii Parvardigorashonro metalaband. Va chun az ekh'rom khorich' shuded, [metavoned ozodona] ba shikor bipardozed va [mabodo] dushmanii gurukh'e, ki shumoro az masch'idulkh'arom boz doshtand, ba taaddi va tach'ovuz vodoraton kunad. Va dar nakukori va parkh'ezgori bo iakdigar iori kuned va dar gunokh'u tach'ovuz dastiori kh'am nashaved va az Allokh' taolo parvo kuned [bitarsed, charo ki] be tardid, Allokh' taolo sakhtkaifar ast

[Inkh'o kh'ama] Bar shumo kh'arom shudaast: [Gushti] Murdor va khunu gushti khuk va on chi [kh'angomi zabkh'] nomi g'airi Allokh' taolo bar on burda shavad va [kh'aivoni kh'alolgushti] khafashuda va ba zarbi [chubu sang] murda va azbalandiaftoda va shokhkhurdavu nimkhurdai [kh'aivonoti] darranda - magar on chi [pesh az murdan] zabkh' [-i shar'i] karda boshed - va [kh'amchunin] on chi dar barobari butkh'o zabkh' meshavad va on chi bo chubkh'oi k'ur'a tak'sim mekuned. Va [ba iak'in bidoned, ki rui ovardan ba tamomi] inkh'o nofarmoni ast. Imruz kofiron az dini shumo [va bozgashtaton ba kufr] noumed shudaand, pas, az onon natarsed va az man bitarsed. Imruz dinatonro komil kardam va ne'matro bar shumo tamom namudam va islomro [ba unvoni bekh'tarin] din baroiaton barguzidam. Pas, kh'ar ki [baroi kh'ifzi ch'oni khud va] biduni on ki ba gunokh'e mutamoil boshad, nochor [ba khurdani gushtkh'oi man'shuda] shavad [bar u gunokh'e nest]. Ba rosti, ki Allokh' taolo omurzandai mekh'rubon ast

[Ei paiombar, askh'obat] Az tu mepursand, chi chiz baroiashon kh'alol shudaast. Bigu: "Chizkh'oi pokiza baroiaton kh'alol gashtaast va [kh'amchunin] on chi ba kumaki kh'aivonoti shikori [ba dast meovared, charo], ki onkh'oro bo on chi Allokh' taolo ba shumo omukhtaast, dastomuz mekuned. Pas, az on chi [khud nakhurdaand va] baroi shumo giriftaand, bikhured va [ba kh'angomi zabkh' io firistodani kh'aivonoti shikori] nomi Allokh'ro bar on bibared va az Allokh' taolo parvo kuned [bitarsed]. Be gumon, Allokh' taolo dar kh'isobrasi sare' ast"

[Ei musulmonon] Imruz khurokkh'oi pokiza baroiaton kh'alol shudaast va [zaboikh'u] g'izoi akh'li kitob baroi shumo kh'alol ast va g'izoi shumo [niz] baroi onon kh'alol ast va [kh'amchunin izdivoch' bo] zanoni pokdomani musulmon va zanoni pokdoman az [akh'li kitob, ia'ne] kasone, ki pesh az shumo ba onon kitob [-i osmoni] doda shudaast [kh'alol meboshad], ba sharti on ki makh'riiakh'oi ononro bipardozed, dar kh'ole ki khud pokdoman boshed, na zinokor boshed va na [zanonro] pinkh'oni ba dusti bigired. Va kh'ar ki ba [arkoni] imon kufr bivarzad, kh'atman, amalash tabokh' shudaast va dar okhirat az ziiondidagon khokh'ad bud

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed chun ba [k'asdi] namoz barkhosted, ruii khud va dastkh'oiatonro to orinch' bishued va saratonro maskh' kuned va poikh'oiatonro to du shitoling [buch'ulak bishued] va agar ch'unub buded, khudro [bo g'usl kardan] pok sozed va agar bemor io musofired io kh'ar iak az shumo az makh'alli k'azoi kh'och'at omadaast io bo zanon omezish kardaed va ob nameiobed, pas, ba khoki pok taiammum kuned va az on bar suratu dastkh'oiaton bikashed. Allokh' taolo namekhokh'ad shumoro ba sakhti biiandozad, balki mekhokh'ad shumoro pok sozad va ne'mati kheshro bar shumo tamom kunad, boshad, ki shukr guzored

Va ba iod ovared ne'mati Allokh'ro bar khesh va [niz] paimone, ki shumoro ba [anch'omi] on muvazzaf gardondaast, on gokh' ki [dar borai da'vat ba farmonbardori ba paiombar] gufted: "Shunidem va itoat kardem". Va az Allokh' taolo parvo kuned [bitarsed], [ki] be tardid, Allokh' taolo ba on chi daruni sinakh'ost, donost

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, baroi Allokh' taolo ba adl barkhezed, [va] ba adolat shakh'odat dikh'ed. Va albatta, naboiad dushmanii iak gurukh' shumoro bar on dorad, ki adolat nakuned. Adolat kuned, ki in [kor] ba parkh'ezkori nazdiktar ast va az Allokh' taolo parvo kuned [bitarsed], [ki] be tardid, Allokh' taolo ba on chi anch'om medikh'ed, ogokh' ast
Allokh' taolo ba onon, ki imon ovardaand va korkh'oi shoista anch'om dodaand, va'dai omurzish va podoshi buzurge dodaast
Va kasone, ki kufr varzidand va oioti moro takzib kardand, onon akh'li duzakhand

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, ne'mati Allokh'ro bar khud ba iod ovared, on gokh' ki gurukh'e [az dushmanon] k'asd kardand, ki ba suiaton dast daroz kunand, pas, [Allokh' taolo] dastashonro az shumo bozdosht. Va az Allokh' taolo parvo kuned [bitarsed]. Va mu'minon boiad tankh'o bar Allokh' taolo tavakkal kunand

Va be tardid, Allokh' taolo az Bani Isroil paimon girift va az miioni onon [ba te'dodi k'aboilashon] duvozdakh' solor bargumoshtem va Allokh' taolo guft: "Man bo shumo kh'astam. Agar namoz barpo dored va zakot bipardozed va ba paiombaroni man imon biiovared va ononro giromi dored va dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo vomi naku dikh'ed, gunokh'onatonro mezudoiam va shumoro ba bog'kh'oe [az bikh'isht] vorid mekunam, ki ch'uiborkh'o az zeri [darakhtoni] on ch'ori ast. Pas, kh'ar iak az shumo, ki ba'd az in kofir shavad, musallaman, rokh'i rostro gum kardaast"

Pas, ba [sazoi] paimonshikaniashon ononro az rakh'mati khesh dur sokhtem va dilkh'oiashonro sakht gardondem, [zero bo tag'iiri lafzu ta'vili ma'no] sukhanon [-i Allokh' taolo]-ro az ch'oigokh'ash takh'rif mekunand va bakhshe az on chiro bad-on pand doda shudand, faromush kardand. Va [ei paiombar] tu paivasta dar borai khiionate az suii onon ogokh' meshavi, magar [shumori] andak az eshon [ki khiionatkor nestand]. Pas, az onon darguzar va chashmpushi kun, [ki] be tardid, Allokh' taolo nakukoronro dust medorad

Va [kh'amchunin] az kasone, ki guftand: "Mo masekh'i kh'astem", paimon giriftem, [ki pairavi K'ur'on va rasuli Allokh' taolo boshand] va [-le dinashonro takh'rif namudand va] bakhshe az on chiro, ki bad-on pand doda shudand, faromush kardand va mo [niz] to ruzi k'iiomat miionashon dushmanivu kina afkandem va [dar on ruz] Allokh' taolo ononro [az natich'ai] on chi kardaand, ogokh' khokh'ad sokht

Ei akh'li kitob, kh'amono paiombari mo ba suii shumo omadaast, ki bisiore az [matolibu omuzakh'oi] kitob [-i osmonii khud]-ro, ki pinkh'on mekarded, baroiaton ba ravshani baion kunad va az bisiore [az matolibu akh'komi on] darguzarad. Kh'atman, az ch'onibi Allokh' taolo baroiaton nuru kitobi ravshangar omadaast

Allokh' taolo ba vasilai in [kitob] kasonero, ki az khushnudii U pairavi kunand, ba rokh'kh'oi salomat kh'idoiat mekunad va ba farmoni Khesh ononro az torikikh'o ba suii rushnoi mebarad va ba rokh'i rost kh'idoiatashon mekunad

Kasone, ki guftand: "Allokh' taolo kh'amon Masekh' - pisari Mariam - ast", iak'inan, kofir shudand. [Ei paiombar, ba onon] Bigu: "Agar Allokh' taolo bikhokh'ad, ki Masekh' - pisari Mariam - va modarash va kh'amai kasonero, ki ruii zamin kh'astand, nobud kunad, chi kase dar barobari Allokh' taolo ikhtiiore dorad, ki mone' shavad? Farmonravoii osmonkh'o va zamin va on chi miioni on du k'aror dorad, az oni Allokh' taolo ast; kh'ar chi bikhokh'ad meofarinad va Allokh' taolo bar kh'ar chize tavonost"

Iakh'udiion va masekh'iion guftand: "Mo farzandoni Allokh' taolo va dustoni U kh'astem". [Ei paiombar, dar posukhashon] Bigu: "Pas, charo U shumoro ba kaifari gunokh'onaton azob mekunad? Balki shumo [niz] bashar va az ch'umlai afrode kh'asted, ki ofaridaast. Kh'ar kiro bikhokh'ad, meomurzad va kh'ar kiro bikhokh'ad, azob mekunad va farmonravoii osmonkh'o va zamin va on chi miioni on du k'aror dorad, az oni Allokh' taolo ast va bozgasht [-i kh'ama] ba suii Ust"

Ei akh'li kitob, paiombari mo ba suii shumo omad, to dar davrai fatrati paiombaron [fosila baini bi'sati Iso va Mukh'ammad] [akh'komu omuzakh'oi ilokh'iro] ba ravshani baroiaton baion kunad, ki mabodo [ruzi k'iiomat] bigued: "Na bashoratbakhshe ba surog'amon omad, na bimdikh'andae". Pas, iak'inan, [inak] paiombari bashoratbakhsh va bimdikh'anda ba suiaton omadaast va Allokh' taolo bar kh'ama chiz tavonost

Va [ei paiombar, iod kun az] Kh'angome ki Muso ba k'avmash guft: "Ei k'avmi man, ne'mati Allokh'ro bar khud ba iod ovared, on gokh' ki baini shumo paiombarone barangekht va [pas az bardagii Fir'avn afrode az] shumoro farmonravoion [-i khudaton] sokht va chizkh'oe ba shumo bakhshid, ki ba kh'ech' iak az ch'akh'oniion [-i muosiraton] nadoda bud
Ei k'avm, ba sarzamini muk'addase, ki Allokh' taolo baroiaton muk'arrar namudaast, vorid shaved va ba ak'ib boznagarded [va az dinaton dast nakashed], ki ziiondida khokh'ed shud"

[Onon] Guftand: "Ei Muso, be gumon on ch'o k'avmi zurmand kh'astand, [va] to onon az on ch'o berun naravand, mo kh'argiz voridi on nameshavem. Pas, agar az on ch'o berun biravand, mo vorid khokh'em shud"

Du tan az mardone, ki [az nofarmoni va azobi ilokh'i] metarsidand va Allokh' taolo ba onon ne'mat [-i itoat va bandagi] doda bud, guftand: "Az on darvoza bar eshon [kh'uch'um bared va] vorid shaved, ki agar az on daromaded, kh'atman, piruz khokh'ed shud va agar mu'mined, bar Allokh' taolo tavakkal kuned"
[Bani Isroil] Guftand: "Ei Muso, to zamone ki onon dar on ch'o khastand, mo kh'argiz vorid nameshavem. Tu va Parvardigorat biraved va bich'anged. Mo kh'amin ch'o menishinem"
[Muso] Guft: "Parvardigoro, man ch'uz ikhtiiori khudam va barodaram [ikhtiiori shakhsi digarero] nadoram, pas, miioni mo va in gurukh'i nofarmon ch'udoi biiafkan"

[Allokh' taolo] Farmud: "Dar in surat [vurud ba] on [sarzamini muk'addas] to chikh'il sol bar onon kh'arom shudaast, [va paivasta] dar zamin sargardon khokh'and bud. Pas, ba khotiri [raftori] in gurukh'i nofarmon afsus makhur"

Va [ei paiombar] dostoni du pisari Odam [Kh'obil va K'obil]-ro ba kh'ak' bar eshon bikhon: kh'angome ki [kh'ar kadom] baroi tak'arrub [ba dargokh'i Allokh' taolo] iak k'urboni tak'dim kardand, az iake pazirufta shud va az digare pazirufta nashud. [K'obil ba Kh'obil] Guft: "Kh'atman, turo khokh'am kusht". [Kh'obil] Guft: "Allokh' taolo [k'urboniro] fak'at az parkh'ezkoron mepazirad
Agar tu dastro baroi kushtani man daroz kuni, man kh'argiz dastamro baroi kushtan ba suiat daroz nakhokh'am kard, [zero] be tardid, man az Allokh' taolo - Parvardigori ch'akh'oniion - metarsam

[On gokh' baroi on ki uro bitarsonad guft] "Man mekhokh'am, ki tu bo gunokh'i [k'atli] man va gunokh'i [a'moli] khudat [ba suii Allokh' taolo] bozgardi va az akh'li duzakh boshi. Va in ast sazoi sitamgoron"
Pas, nafsi [sarkashi] u kushtani barodarashro baroiash orost [va muvach'ch'akh'u oson ch'ilva dod]. Pas, uro kusht va az ziionkoron shud

On gokh' Allokh' taolo kalog' [zog']-ero firistod, ki dar zamin ch'ustuch'u [va kovish] mekard, to [kalog'i murdaero dafn kunad va in guna] ba vai nishon dikh'ad, ki chi guna ch'asadi barodarashro bipushonad. [K'obil] Guft: "Voi bar man! Oio notavon budam az in ki kh'amchun in kalog' bosham va ch'asadi barodaramro bipushonam"? On gokh' [ba sakhti az kori zishti khesh] pushaimon shud

Ba kh'amin sabab, bar Bani Isroil muk'arrar doshtem, ki kh'ar kas insonero ch'uz baroi [k'asosi] kase io fasode [ki] dar zamin [murtakib shudaast] ba k'atl birasonad, chunon ast, ki gui kh'amai mardumro kushtaast va kh'ar kas [bo khuddori az k'atlkh'oi khudsarona va bekh'uda] insonero zinda bidorad, chunon ast, ki kh'amai mardumro zinda kardaast. Va be gumon, paiombaroni mo bo daloili ravshan baroi onon [Bani Isroil] omadand, [vale] boz kh'am bisiore az eshon pas az on [bo irtikobi gunokh'] dar zamin [po az kh'ududi ilokh'i farotar guzoshtand va] ziiodaravi kardand

Sazoi kasone, ki bo Allokh' taolo va paiombarash mech'angand va [bo k'atlu duzdi va fakh'sho] dar zamin ba fasod mekushand, ch'uz in nest, ki kushta shavand io ba dor ovekhta shavand io dast [-i rost] va poi [-i chapi] onkh'o dar khilof [ch'ikh'ati iakdigar] k'at' shavad io az sarzamin [-i khud] tab'id gardand. In [much'ozot moiai] rasvoii onkh'o dar duniost va dar okhirat [niz] azobi buzurg [dar pesh] dorand
Magar kasone, ki [shumo kh'okimon] pesh az on ki bar onon dast iobed, tavba kunand. Pas, [agar chunin kardand, az onon darguzared va] bidoned, ki Allokh' taolo omurzandai mekh'rubon ast

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, az Allokh' taolo parvo kuned [bitarsed] va [bo anch'omi korkh'oi nek, baroi tak'arrub] ba suii U vasila bich'ued va dar rokh'ash ch'ikh'od kuned, boshad, ki rastagor shaved

Dar kh'ak'ik'at kasone, ki kufr varzidand, agar tamomi on chi dar zamin ast, baroi onon boshad va kh'ammonandash [niz] bo on [dar ikhtiiorashon boshad va bikhokh'and], to ba bad-on vasila khudro az azobi ruzi k'iiomat bozkharand, az eshon pazirufta nameshavad va azobi dardnok [dar pesh] dorand
Mekhokh'and az otash [-i duzakh] berun ravand, va [-le] az on [azob] nametavonand khorich' shavand va baroiashon azobi poidor [mukh'aiio] ast

[Ei kh'okimoni musulmon] Dasti mardu zani duzdro ba sazoi amale, ki murtakib shudaand, ba unvoni much'ozote az ch'onibi Allokh' taolo k'at' kuned va [bidoned, ki] Allokh' taolo shikastnopaziru kh'akim ast

Pas, kh'ar ki ba'd az [gunokh' va] sitam kardanash tavba kunad va [a'moli khudro ch'ubron va] islokh' namoiad, be tardid, Allokh' taolo tavbaashro mepazirad. Ba rosti, ki Allokh' taolo omurzandai mekh'rubon ast
Oio namedoni, ki farmonravoii osmonkh'o va zamin az oni Allokh' taolo ast, [va] kh'ar kiro bikhokh'ad azob mekunad va kh'ar kiro bikhokh'ad mebakhshad? Va Allokh' taolo bar kh'ar chize tavonost

Ei paiombar, kasone, ki dar [rokh'i] kufr shitob mekunand, turo g'amgin nasozad - [khokh'] az kasone, ki ba zabonashon meguiand: "Imon ovardem" va k'albashon imon naovardaast va [khokh'] az iakh'udiion [boshand, kh'amon kasone, ki ba sukhanoni peshvoionu buzurgonashon] gush mesuporand, [ore, onon fak'at] shunavandai [durug'kh'o va muk'allidi dasturkh'oi] gurukh'i digare [az ulamoiashon] kh'astand, ki [turo bovar nadorand va kh'argiz] nazdat naomadaand. Onon sukhanon [-i Allokh' taolo]-ro [bar asosi mailu manfiati khud] az ch'oigokh'ashon takh'rif mekunand va [ba iakdigar] meguiand: "Agar in [kh'ukm az suii Mukh'ammad] ba shumo doda shud, pas, [az u] bipazired va agar on [chizi dilkhokh'aton ast] ba shumo doda nashud, [az u] duri kuned". Va [ei paiombar] kh'ar ki Allokh' taolo gumrokh'iashro khosta boshad, tu kh'argiz dar barobari Allokh' taolo baroiash ikhtiior nadori [va nametavoni az u difo' kuni]. Onon [iakh'udiion va munofik'on] kasone kh'astand, ki Allokh' taolo nakhostaast dilkh'oiashonro [az palidii kufr] pok kunad. Onon dar dunio rasvoi [va khori dar intizor] dorand va dar okhirat baroiashon azobi buzurge [dar pesh] ast

Onon [iakh'udiion] bisior gush ba durug' mesuporand, [va] moli kh'aromi farovon mekhurand. Pas, [ei paiombar] agar [baroi dodkhokh'i] nazdat omadand, miionashon dovari kun io az eshon rui bigardon. Va [iak'in bidon, ki] agar az onon rui bigardoni, ba tu kh'ech' ziione namerasonand, va [-le] agar dovari kardi, bo adolat miionashon dovari kun. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo dodgaronro dust medorad

Va onon chi guna turo ba dovari metalaband, dar kh'ole ki Tavrot nazdashon ast, [va] kh'ukmi Allokh' taolo dar on vuch'ud dorad? Sipas ba'd az on [dodkhokh'i, agar sukhane khilofi mailashon bigui, az dasturi Tavrot va kh'ukmi tu] rui megardonand va inon mu'min nestand

Ba rosti, Mo Tavrotro nozil kardem, ki dar on kh'idoiat va nur ast. Paiombarone, ki [dar barobari farmoni Allokh' taolo] taslim budand, bar asosi [omuzakh'oi] on baroi iakh'udiion dovari mekardand va donishmandonu fak'ekh'on [-i iakh'udi], ki posdori az kitobi Allokh' taolo [va ch'ilavgiri az takh'rifi Tavrot] ba onon supurda shuda bud va bar [kh'ak'k'oniiati] on guvokh' budand [va bino ba dasturkh'oiash kh'ukm mekardand]. Pas, [ei iakh'udiion, dar ich'roi akh'komi ilokh'i] az mardum natarsed va az Man bitarsed va oiotamro ba bakh'oi nochiz nafurushed. Va kh'ar kas ba akh'kome, ki Allokh' taolo nozil kardaast, dovari nakunad, kofir ast

Va dar on [Tavrot] baroi eshon [Bani Isroil] muk'arrar doshtem, ki: "Ch'on dar barobari ch'onu chashm dar barobari chashm va bini dar barobari bini va gush dar barobari gush va dandon dar barobari dandon ast va [kh'atto] zakhmkh'o k'asos dorand". Pas, kh'ar ki az on guzasht namoiad, on [bakhshish] kafforai [gunokh'oni] ust. Va kh'ar kas ba akh'kome, ki Allokh' taolo nozil kardaast, kh'ukm nakunad, [az kh'ududi ilokh'i farotar raftaast va] sitamgor ast

Va ba dunboli onon [paiombaroni Bani Isroil] Iso pisari Mariamro firistodem, ki tasdik'kunandai Tavrot bud, ki pesh az u firistoda budem va Inch'ilro, ki dar on kh'idoiat va nur bud, ba u dodem, ki tasdik'kunandai Tavroti pesh az vai bud va kh'idoiatu andarze bud baroi parkh'ezkoron
Va akh'li Inch'il boiad ba on chi Allokh' taolo dar on [kitob] nozil kardaast, kh'ukm kunand. Va kh'ar ki ba on chi Allokh' taolo nozil kardaast, kh'ukm nakunad, nofarmon ast

Va [ei paiombar, mo in] kitobro ba kh'ak' bar tu nozil kardem, [ki] tasdik'kunandai kitobkh'oi peshin ast va mavridi e'timod [-i kitobkh'oi osmoni ba unvoni me'iore baroi kh'ak' va botil] ast. Pas, baini onon bar asosi on chi Allokh' taolo nozil kardaast, kh'ukm kun va ba ch'oii kh'ak'ik'ate, ki [az ch'onibi K'ur'on] ba tu raisdaast, az kh'avaskh'oi onon pairavi makun. [Ei mardum] Mo baroi kh'ar iake az shumo oinu rokh'i ravshan karor dodem va agar Allokh' taolo mekhost, kh'amai shumoro ummati vokh'id karor medod, vale [Allokh' taolo mekhokh'ad] shumoro dar [mavridi] on chi ba shumo bakhshidaast, biozmoiad, pas, dar nekikh'o bar iakdigar peshi gired. Bozgashti kh'amai shumo ba suii Allokh' taolo ast. On gokh' U az on chi dar on ikhtilof mekarded, ogokh'aton mesozad

Va [ei paiombar] miioni onon [iakh'ud] bar asosi on chi Allokh' taolo [dar K'ur'on] nozil kardaast, kh'ukm kun va az kh'avaskh'oiashon pairavi makun va bar kh'azar bosh az in ki turo az barkhe az on chi Allokh' taolo bar tu nozil kardaast, munkh'arif kunand. Pas, agar [az pazirishi dovarii tu] rui gardonand, bidon, ki Allokh' taolo mekhokh'ad ononro ba [khotiri] barkhe az gunokh'onashon much'ozot kunad. Va ba rosti, ki bisiore az mardum nofarmonand
Oio onon dovarii [bar asosi chenakkh'oi] ch'okh'iliiatro mekhokh'and? Va baroi akh'li iak'in, dovarii chi kase bekh'tar az Allokh' taolo ast?

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, iakh'udiion va masekh'iionro ba dusti nagired. Onon dustoni iakdigarand va kh'ar ki az shumo, ki bo eshon dusti kunad, kh'atman, az onkh'ost. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo gurukh'i sitamgoronro [ba khotiri dusti bo kofiron] kh'idoiat namekunad

Pas, [ei paiombar] kasonero, ki dar dilkh'oiashon bemori [nifok'] ast, mebini, ki dar [dusti bo] onon meshitoband, [va] meguiand: "Metarsem, ki [agar piruz shavand, az ch'onibi onon] osebe ba mo birasad". Umed ast, ki Allokh' taolo [baroi musulmonon] az ch'onibi Khud piruzi [va kushoishe] pesh ovarad, on gokh' [in munofik'on] az on chi dar dili khud pinkh'on medoshtand, pushaimon shavand

Va onon, ki imon ovardaand meguiand: "Oio inkh'o [munofik'on] kh'amon kasone kh'astand, ki ba Allokh' taolo savgandkh'oi sakht mekhurdand, ki bo shumo kh'astand"? A'molashon tabokh' gasht va ziionkor shudand

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, kh'ar kase az shumo, ki az dini khud bargardad [ba Allokh' taolo ziione namerasonad], Allokh' taolo ba zudi gurukh'ero meovarad, ki ononro dust medorad va onkh'o [niz] Uro dust medorand, [onon] nisbat ba mu'minon furutan va dar barobari kofiron sarsakht kh'astand, dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo ch'ikh'od mekunand va az sarzanishi kh'ech' malomatgare namekh'arosand. In fazli Allokh' taolo ast, ki ba kh'ar kas bikhokh'ad medikh'ad va Allokh' taolo kushoishgari donost

[Ei mu'minon] Be tardid, [iovaru] dusti shumo fak'at Allokh' taolo va paiombarash va [kh'amchunin] afrode kh'astand, ki imon ovardaand. [Kh'amon] Kasone, ki namoz barpo medorand va bo furutani [va rizoiati komil] zakot mepardozand
Va kh'ar ki Allokh' taolo va paiombarash va mu'minonro ba dusti bigirad, [az gurukh'i Allokh' taolo ast va] iak'inan, gurukh'i Allokh' taolo piruzand

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, kasonero, ki dinatonro ba tamaskhur va bozi giriftaand, dust [-oni khud] nagired, [khokh'] az kasone [boshand], ki pesh az shumo ba onon kitob doda shudaast va [khokh' az] kofiron. Va agar imon dored, az Allokh' taolo parvo kuned [bitarsed]
Va [in afrod kasone kh'astand, ki] vak'te [tavassuti azon mardumro] ba namoz mekhoned, onro ba maskhara va bozi megirand, zero onon gurukh'e kh'astand, ki nameandeshand

[Ei paiombar] Bigu: "Ei akh'li kitob, oio [illati in ki] bar mo khurda megired, ch'uz in ast, ki mo ba Allokh' taolo va on chi bar mo nozil shuda va [ba] on chi pesh az mo nozil gardidaast, imon ovardaem va [kh'amchunin bar in bovarem, ki] ag'labi shumo nofarmoned"

Bigu: "Oio [mekhokh'ed] shumoro az [kh'oli] kasone ogokh' kunam, ki nazdi Allokh' taolo ch'azoe az in badtar dorand? [Onon] Kasone [kh'astand], ki Allokh' taolo la'natashon kard va bar eshon khashm girift va barkhe az ononro [maskh namud va ba shakli] buzina va khuk darovard va [niz] kasone, ki [ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo] tog'ut [va kh'okimoni khudkoma]-ro bandagi kardand. Inon [az kh'ama] badmak'omtar va az rokh'i rost gumgashtatarand

Va [ei paiombar] vak'te [iakh'udiioni munofik'] nazdaton meoiand, meguiand: "Imon ovardaem", kh'ol on ki bo kufr vorid shudand va bo kh'amon [kufr] berun raftaand; va Allokh' taolo ba on chi pinkh'on mekardand, donotar ast
Va bisiore az ononro mebini, ki dar gunokh' va tach'ovuz [ba kh'uk'uk'i digaron] va kh'aromkhuri shitob mekunand. Chi bad ast, on chi mekunand!
Charo donishmandon va fak'ekh'on [-i iakh'ud] ononro az guftori gunokh' [-olud] va kh'aromkhoragiashon boznamedorand? Rosti, chi bad ast, on chi anch'om medikh'and!

Va iakh'udiion [kh'angomi sakhti va tangdasti] guftand: "Dasti Allokh' taolo [az khairu bakhshish] bastaast". Dastkh'oiashon basta bod va ba sazoi on chi guftand la'nat bar onon bod! [Kh'argiz chunin nest] Balki kh'ar du dasti U kushodaast [va] kh'ar guna ki bikhokh'ad, mebakhshad. [Ei paiombar] In oiot, ki az tarafi Parvardigorat bar tu nozil shudaast, bar sarkashi va kufri bisiore az onon meafzoiad. Mo miionashon to ruzi k'iiomat dushmani va kina afkandem. Kh'ar zamon otashi ch'ang barafrukhtand, Allokh' taolo onro khomush kard. Onon [paivasta] dar zamin ba tabakh'kori [va fasod] mekushand va Allokh' taolo tabakh'koronro dust namedorad
Va agar akh'li kitob imon meovardand va parkh'ezkori mekardand, iak'inan, gunokh'onashonro mezududem va ononro ba bog'kh'oi purne'mat [-i bikh'isht] vorid mekardem

Va agar onon ba Tavrot va Inch'il va on chi az suii Parvardigorashon bar onkh'o nozil shudaast [K'ur'on] amal mekardand, kh'atman, az [barakoti osmoni] boloi sarashon va az [ne'matkh'oi zamini] zeri poiashon barkhurdor meshudand. Barkhe az onon miionarav kh'astand, va [-le] bisiore az eshon [ba sababi beimoni] korkh'oi bade anch'om medikh'and

Ei paiombar, on chiro az tarafi Parvardigorat bar tu nozil shudaast, [ba tavri komil ba mardum] iblog' kun va agar [chunin] nakuni, risolati Uro [ba anch'om] narasondai va Allokh' taolo turo az [gazandi] mardum kh'ifz mekunad. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo gurukh'i kofironro kh'idoiat namekunad

Bigu: "Ei akh'li kitob, shumo bar kh'ech' [oini duruste] nested, magar in ki Tavrot va Inch'il va on chiro, ki az tarafi Parvardigoraton bar shumo nozil shudaast, barpo dored". Va [ei paiombar] be tardid, on chi az suii Parvardigorat bar tu nozil shudaast, bar sarkashi va kufri bisiore az onon meafzoiad, pas, bar [in] gurukh'i kofir afsus makhur

Be gumon, kasone, ki imon ovardaand va kasone, ki iakh'udi va soibi [fitratgaro] va masekh'i kh'astand, kh'ar ki ba Allokh' taolo va ruzi k'iiomat imon ovarad va korkh'oi shoista anch'om dikh'ad, na tarse khokh'and dosht va na andukh'gin meshavand

Iak'inan, mo az Bani Isroil [dar mavridi itoat az farmoni kh'ak'] paimon giriftem va paiombarone ba suiashon firistodem. Kh'ar gokh' paiombare chize ovard, ki kh'avoi nafsashon namepisandad, gurukh'ero durug'gu khondand va gurukh'ero kushtand

[Ore, iakh'udiion paimon shikastand] Va pindoshtand, ki much'ozote dar kor nest, pas, kur gashtand [va kh'ak'ro nadidand] va kar shudand [va kh'ak'ro nashunidand]. On gokh' [tavba kardand va] Allokh' taolo tavbai eshonro paziruft. Sipas bisiore az eshon [boz kh'am dar barobari kh'idoiat] kuru kar shudand va Allokh' taolo ba on chi anch'om medikh'and, binost

Onon, ki guftand: "Allokh' taolo kh'amon Masekh' pisari Mariam ast", iak'inan kofir shudand, dar kh'ole ki [khudi] Masekh' guft: "Ei Bani Isroil, Allokh'ro biparasted, ki Parvardigori manu Parvadigori shumost. Be tardid, kh'ar ki ba Allokh' taolo shirk ovarad, Allokh' taolo bikh'ishtro bar u kh'arom kardaast va ch'oigokh'ash duzakh ast va sitamgoron kh'ech' iovare nadorand"

Kasone, ki [ma'budi kh'ak'ik'iro mach'muai padar, pisar va Rukh'-ul-k'udus donistand va] guftand: "Allokh' taolo savumin [nafar az] se [ma'bud] ast", kh'atman, kofir shudand. Ma'bude [ba kh'ak'] ch'uz ma'budi iagona nest. Va agar az on chi meguiand, boznaistand, kh'atman, ba afrode az eshon, ki kufr varzidand, azobi dardnoke khokh'ad rasid
Oio ba suii Allokh' taolo boznamegardand va az U talabi omurzish namekunand? Va Allokh' taolo omurzandai mekh'rubon ast

Masekh' pisari Mariam ch'uz paiombare nest, ki pesh az u [niz] paiombaroni digare budand va modarash zani rostgu bud. Kh'ar du [monandi insonkh'oi digar] g'izo mekhurdand. [Ei paiombar] Bingar, ki chi guna oiot [-i khud]-ro baroiashon ravshan mesozem va boz bingar, ki chi guna ruigardon meshavand
[Ei paiombar] Bigu: "Oio chizero ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo meparasted, ki sudu ziione baroiaton nadorad? Va [kh'ol on ki] Allokh' taolo shunavovu donost"

Bigu: "Ei akh'li kitob, dar dini khud ba nokh'ak' g'uluv [va ziiodaravi] nakuned va az kh'avaskh'oi gurukh'e pairavi nakuned, ki peshtar gumrokh' shudand va bisiore [az pairavonashon]-ro gumrokh' kardand va az rokh'i rost munkh'arif gashtaand"

[Afrode] Az Bani Isroil, ki kufr varzidand, az zaboni Dovud [dar Zabur] va [az k'avli] Iso pisari Mariam [dar Inch'il] mavridi la'nat k'aror giriftand. In [nafrin] ba khotiri on bud, ki nofarmoni kardand va [az kh'ududi ilokh'i] tach'ovuz menamudand
Onon iakdigarro az [gunokh'onu] kor [-kh'oi] zishte, ki anch'om medodand, nakh'i namekardand. Ba rosti, chi bad bud on chi mekardand!

[Ei paiombar] Bisiore az ononro mebini, ki bo kofiron dusti mekunand. Ba rosti, chi zisht ast, on chi baroi khud pesh firistodand, ki [dar natich'ai on niz] Allokh' taolo bar onon khashm girift va ch'ovidona dar azob memonand
Va agar [iakh'udiion] ba Allokh' taolo va paiombar va on chi bar u nozil shudaast, imon meovardand, onon [kofiron]-ro ba dusti namegiriftand, vale bisiore az onon nofarmonand

[Ei paiombar] Iak'inan, iakh'udiion va kasonero, ki shirk varzidand, dushmantarini mardum nisbat ba mu'minon khokh'i ioft va nazdiktarin duston ba mu'minonro kasone khokh'i ioft, ki meguiand: "Mo masekh'i kh'astem". In ba khotiri on ast, ki miioni eshon kashishon va rokh'ibon [-i kh'ak'parast] kh'astand va [niz] az on rust, ki takabbur namevarzand

Va chun oiotero, ki bar paiombar nozil shudaast, meshunavand, mebini bar asari on chi az kh'ak' shinokhtaand, chashmonashon ashk meborad va meguiand: "Parvardigoro, imon ovardem, pas, moro dar zumrai [musulmonon va] guvokh'on binavis
Charo ba Allokh' taolo va on chi az kh'ak' ba mo rasidaast, imon naiovarem, kh'ol on ki umed dorem, ki Parvardigoramon moro bo gurukh'i shoistagon [ba bikh'isht] darovarad"?

Pas, Allokh' taolo ba posi on chi guftand, ba onon bog'kh'oe [az bikh'isht] podosh dod, ki az zeri [darakhtoni] on ch'uiborkh'o ch'ori ast va ch'ovidona dar on khokh'and mond. Va in ast ch'azoi nakukoron
Va kasone, ki kufr varzidand va oioti moro takzib kardand, onon akh'li duzakhand

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, chizkh'oi pokizaero, ki Allokh' taolo baroi [istifodai] shumo kh'alol kardaast, [ba bakh'onai zukh'du dindori bar khud] kh'arom nakuned va [az kh'ad] tach'ovuz nanamoed. Ba rosti, ki Allokh' taolo mutach'ovizon [-i kh'ududi ilokh'i]-ro dust namedorad
Va az chizkh'oi kh'alol [va] pokizae, ki Allokh' taolo bar shumo ruzi dodaast, bikhured va az Allokh' taolo, ki ba U imon dored, parvo kuned

Allokh' taolo shumoro ba khotiri savgandkh'oi bekh'uda [va beikhtiioraton] bozkhost namekunad, vale dar savgandkh'oe, ki [ogokh'ona] mekhured [va meshkaned], muokhaza mekunad. Pas, kafforai on, khurok dodan ba dakh' tikh'idast az g'izokh'oi [ma'muli va] mutavassiti shakh'raton ast io libos dodan ba dakh' nafar [az mustamandon] io ozod kardani iak barda. Agar kase [tavonoii moli nadorad io kh'ech' iak az inkh'oro] nameiobad, pas, se ruz ruza [bigirad]. In kafforai savgandkh'oi shumost, [baroi] kh'ar zamon, ki savgand iod karded [va onro shikasted]. Va savgandkh'oi khudro kh'ifz kuned [va nashkaned]. Allokh' taolo in chunin oioti khudro baroi shumo baion mekunad, boshad, ki sipos guzored
Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, be tardid, sharobu k'imor va butkh'ovu tirkh'oi k'ur'akashi palid [va] az kor [-kh'oi] shaiton kh'astand, pas, az onkh'o duri kuned, boshad, ki rastagor shaved

Dar kh'ak'ik'at, shaiton mekhokh'ad bo sharobu k'imor, miionaton dushmani va kina ech'od kunad va shumoro az iodi Allokh' taolo va az namoz bozdorad, pas, [ei mu'minon, kh'olo ki kh'ak'ik'atro donisted] oio az onkh'o dast barmedored?
Va az Allokh' taolo itoat kuned va farmonbari paiombar boshed va [az gunokh'u nofarmoni] kh'azar kuned. Pas, agar rui gardonded, bidoned, ki vazifai paiombari Mo [chize] ch'uz iblog'i oshkor nest

Bar kasone, ki imon ovardaand va korkh'oi shoista anch'om dodaand, gunokh'e dar on chi [pesh az kh'ukmi takh'rimi sharob] khurdaand, nest, [albatta] dar surate ki [az mukh'arramot] parkh'ez kunand va imon biovarand va korkh'oi shoista anch'om dikh'and, sipas parkh'ezkori kunad va imon biovarand, on gokh' [besh az pesh] parkh'ezkori kunand va neki namoiand. Va Allokh' taolo nakukoronro dust medorad

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, Allokh' taolo shumoro [dar kh'ole ki mukh'rim kh'asted] ba chize az shikori [sakh'roi], ki dar dastrasi shumo va naizakh'oiaton boshad, meozmoiad, to ma'lum dorad, chi kase dar nikh'on az U metarsad. Pas, kh'ar ki ba'd az in [ozmun] az kh'ad darguzarad [va dar kh'oli kh'ach' io umra shikor kunad], azobi dardnok [dar pesh] dorad

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, dar kh'oli ekh'rom, shikorro nakushed va kh'ar kase az shumo, ki k'asdan onro bikushad, boiad kh'ammonandi on chi ki kushtaast, kafforae az chakh'orpoion bidikh'ad, [ba sharte] ki du nafari odil az shumo [barobararzishii] onro ta'iid kunand va [on gokh' on kafforaro ba surati] k'urboni [ba mustamandoni peromuni] Ka'ba birasonad io [muodili bakh'oi onro] ba tikh'idastoni [Kh'aram] g'izo dikh'ad io [agar tavoni moli nadosht] muodili onro [dar muk'obili kh'ar fak'ir iak] ruza bigirad, to kaifari amali khudro bichashad. Allokh' taolo on chiro, ki [pesh az in takh'rim] guzashtaast, avf namud va kh'ar ki [ba in gunokh'] bozgardad, [bidonad, ki] Allokh' taolo az u intik'om megirad va Allokh' taolo shikastnopaziri dodsiton ast

[Ei musulmonon, dar kh'oli ekh'rom] Saidi darioi va khuroki on baroi shumo kh'alol shudaast, to shumo [ki dar Makka muk'im kh'asted] va korvoniion [ki musofirand, kh'amagi] az on barkhurdor shaved, va [-le] to zamone ki mukh'rim kh'asted, saidi sakh'roi bar shumo kh'arom ast va az Allokh' taolo, ki [ruzi k'iiomat] nazdi U ch'am' meshaved, parvo kuned

Allokh' taolo Ka'bai Bait-ul-kh'aromro vasilae baroi ustuvori [va somon bakhshidan ba kori] mardum k'aror dod va [kh'amchunin, kh'urmati ch'angu dargiri dar] mokh'i kh'arom va [kushtani] k'urboni [-i benishon] va k'urbonii k'alodador [-ro baroi osoishi mardum vaz' kard]. In [guna akh'kom] baroi on ast, ki bidoned Allokh' taolo on chiro, ki dar osmonkh'o va zamin ast medonad va in ki Allokh' taolo ba kh'ar chize donost
[Ei mardum] Bidoned, ki Allokh' taolo sakhtkaifar ast va [dar aini kh'ol] Allokh' taolo omurzandai mekh'rubon ast
Paiombar vazifae ch'uz rasondani [vakh'i] nadorad va Allokh' taolo on chiro, ki oshkor mekuned va pinkh'on medored, [kh'amaro] medonad
[Ei paiombar] Bigu: "Palid va pok iakson nestand, kh'archand farovonii palid [i] turo ba shigift ovarad. Pas, ei khiradmandon, az Allokh' taolo parvo kuned, boshad, ki rastagor shaved"

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, az chizkh'oe napursed, ki agar [posukhi kh'ak'ik'iash] baroiaton oshkor gardad, andukh'ginaton mekunad va agar zamone, ki K'ur'on nozil megardad, pursuch'u kuned, [kh'ukmu posukhi pursishkh'oiaton] bar shumo oshkor megardad. Allokh' taolo az on [masoil va baioni onkh'o] darguzasht va Allokh' taolo omurzandai burdbor ast
Dar kh'ak'ik'at, gurukh'e [ki] pesh az shumo [budand niz] az in [guna] pursishkh'o kardand, sipas [vak'te ki ch'avobi noguvor baroiashon omad], ba on [amal nakardand va] kufr varzidand

Allokh' taolo kh'ech' guna "bakh'ira" va "soiba" va "vasila" va "kh'om" [anvoi shuturkh'oi mukhtalife, ki mushrikon vak'fi butkh'oiashon mekardand]-ro [baroi khud] k'aror nadodaast, vale kasone, ki kufr varzidand, [bo iddaoi kh'urmati in kh'aivonot] bar Allokh' taolo durug' mebandand va beshtarashon darnameioband

Va kh'angome ki ba onon gufta shavad: "Ba suii on chi Allokh' taolo nozil kardaast va ba suii paiombar biioed", meguiand: "On chi niiogonamonro bar on ioftaem, baroiamon kofist". Oio agar niiogonashon chize namedonistand va kh'idoiat naiofta budand [boz kh'am az onon pairavi mekardand]?

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, murok'ibi [imon va toati] khud boshed. Agar kh'idoiat iofta boshed, gumrokh'ii kasone, ki gumrokh' shudaand, ba shumo ziione namerasonad. Bozgashti kh'amai shumo ba suii Allokh' taolo ast, on gokh' shumoro az on chi mekarded, ogokh' mesozad

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, kh'angome ki [nishonakh'oi] margi iake az shumo faro rasid, kh'angomi vasiiat boiad az miionaton du nafari odilro guvokh' bigired io agar musofirat karded va peshomadi marg ba shumo rasid [va musulmonero naiofted], du nafar az g'airi khud [g'airi musulmon]-ro ba guvokh'i bitalabed va agar [dar rostguii onkh'o] tardid doshted, on duro ba'd az namoz nigokh' dored, to ba Allokh' taolo savgand bikhurand, ki: "Mo kh'ozir nestem on [vasiiat]-ro ba chize furushem, agarchi [ba sudi] kheshonamon boshad. Va shakh'odati Allokh'ro kitmon namekunem, ki dar in surat, kh'atman, az gunakh'goron khokh'em bud"

Pas, agar ma'lum shud, ki on du murtakibi gunokh' [khiionat va durug'gui] shudaand, du tan az kasone, ki mavridi ch'afoi guvokh'on k'aror giriftaand va az nazdikon [-i maiit] kh'astand, ba ch'oii onon barkhezand va ba Allokh' taolo savgand bikhurand, ki: "Guvokh'ii mo az guvokh'ii on du durustar ast va mo [az kh'ak'] tach'ovuz namekunem va dar g'airi in surat, az sitamgoron khokh'em bud"

In [ravish] nazdiktar ast ba on ki shakh'odat ba surati durustash ado shavad io shokh'idon bitarsand, ki pas az savgandi onon [vorison] savgandkh'oiashon rad shavad [va khiionatashon oshkor gardad] va az Allokh' taolo parvo kuned va [in pandkh'oro] bishnaved va [bidoned, ki] Allokh' taolo mardumi [badkor va] nofarmonro kh'idoiat namekunad

Ruze [khokh'ad rasid], ki Allokh' taolo paiombaronro gird meovarad va mepursad: "[Ummatkh'oiaton] Chi posukhe ba [da'vati] shumo dodand"? Onon guiand: "Mo donishe [ba kh'ak'ik'ati amr] nadorem. Be tardid, Tui, ki donoi rozkh'oi nikh'oni"

[Ei paiombar, iod kun az] Kh'angome ki Allokh' taolo farmud: "Ei Iso - pisari Mariam, ne'mati maro bar khud va bar modarat ba iod ovar, on gokh' ki turo bo Rukh'-ul-k'udus [Ch'abrail] ta'iid kardam, ki dar gakh'vora [ba e'ch'oz] va dar miionsoli [ba vakh'i] bo mardum sukhan megufti va on gokh' ki ba tu kitobu kh'ikmat va Tavrotu Inch'il omukhtam va on gokh' ki ba farmoni Man az gil [chize] ba shakli paranda mesokhti va dar on medamidi va ba farmoni Man parrandae meshud va kuri modarzodu bemorii mubtalo ba pesiro ba farmoni Man shifo medodi va on gokh' ki murdagonro ba farmoni Man [zinda az k'abr] berun meovardi va on gokh' ki [ozori] Bani Isroilro - on gokh' ki mu'ch'izoti oshkor baroiashon ovarda budi - az tu bozdoshtam. Pas, kasone az onon, ki kufr varzida budand, guftand: "In [korkh'o chize] nest magar afsuni oshkor"
Va [Ei Iso, ba iod ovar] Zamone, ki ba kh'avoriion vakh'i firistodam, ki: "Ba Man va ba firistodaam imon biiovared". Onon guftand: "Imon ovardem va guvokh' bosh, ki mo taslim [-i farmonat] shudaem"

[Va iod kun az] On gokh' ki kh'avoriion guftand: "Ei Iso - pisari Mariam, oio Parvardigorat metavonad sufrae [pur az g'izo] az osmon bar mo nozil kunad"? [Iso dar posukh] Guft: "Agar mu'min kh'asted, az Allokh' taolo parvo kuned"
Onon guftand: "Mekhokh'em az on bikhurem va dilkh'oiamon [ba risolati tu] itminon iobad va bidonem, ki ba mo rost guftai va khud az guvokh'oni on boshem"

Iso - pisari Mariam - [duo kard va] guft: "Bor Ilokh'o, Parvardigoro, sufrai [purg'izo] az osmon bar mo bifrist, to ide boshad baroi imruziion va oiandagonamon va [kh'amchunin] mu'ch'izae az [ch'onibi Tu] boshad va ba mo ruzi dekh', ki Tu bekh'tarin ruzidikh'andai"

Allokh' taolo [duoi uro ich'obat kard va] farmud: "Man onro bar shumo nozil mekunam, ammo kh'ar kase az shumo, ki pas az on kufr bivarzad, uro ba chunon azob [-i sakht] duchor mekunam, ki kh'ech' iak az ch'akh'oniionro onchunon azob nakarda bosham"

Va [iod kun az] kh'angome ki [ruzi k'iiomat] Allokh' taolo mefarmoiad: "Ei Iso - pisari Mariam, oio tu ba mardum gufti, ki: "Manu modaramro [kh'amchun] du ma'bud ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo barguzined"? [Iso] meguiad: "[Bor Ilokh'o] Tu munazzakh'i, shoista nest, ki man [dar borai kheshtan] chize, ki kh'ak'k'am nest biguiam. Agar chunin [sukhanero] gufta bosham, be gumon, Tu medoni. Tu on chiro, ki dar nafsi man ast, medoni va [-le] man on chiro, ki dar zoti [poki] Tust namedonam. Be tardid, Tu khud donoi rozkh'oi nikh'oni

Ch'uz on chi maro ba on farmon dodi, chize ba onon naguftam. [Guftam, ki] "Allokh'ro biparasted, ki Parvardigori manu shumost". Va to zamone, ki miionashon ba sar meburdam, bar [sukhanoni] onon guvokh' budam va chun maro [ba suii Khesh] bargirifti, Tu khud murok'ibashon budi va Tu bar kh'ar chize guvokh'i
Agar ononro [bo adolatat] azob kuni, bandagoni Tu kh'astand va agar ononro [bo rakh'matat] bubakhshoi, Tui, ki shikastnopaziri kh'akimi"

Allokh' taolo mefarmoiad: "Imruz ruzest, ki rostii rostguion ba onon sud mebakhshad. Onon bog'kh'oe [dar bikh'isht] dorand, ki ch'uiborkh'o az zeri [darakhtoni] on ch'ori ast va to abad ch'ovidona dar on memonand. Allokh' taolo az [a'moli] onon khushnud ast va onon [niz] az [podoshi] U khushnudand. In kh'amon rastagorii buzurg ast"
Farmonravoii osmonkh'o va zamin va on chi dar onkh'ost, az oni Allokh' taolo ast va U bar kh'ar chize tavonost

Sitoish Allokh' taolorost, ki osmonkh'o va zaminro ofarid va torikikh'o va rushnoi [shabu ruz]-ro padid ovard. Bo in kh'ama, kasone, ki kufr varzidaand, [digaronro dar tavonu tadbir] bo Parvardigori khud barobar medonand
Ust, ki shumoro az gil ofarid, on gokh' muddatero [baroi kh'aiotaton] muk'arrar dosht va ach'al, kh'atman, nazdi Ust. Bo in kh'ama shumo [dar k'udrati U baroi barpo shudani k'iiomat] tardid mekuned
Va Ust Allokh' taolo [Ma'budi iagona] dar osmonkh'o va zamin, nikh'onu oshkoratonro medonad va on chiro ba dast meovared,[va anch'om medikh'ed niz] medonad
Va kh'ech' nishonae az nishonakh'oi Parvardigorashon ba inon [kofiron] nameoiad, magar in ki az on ruigardon meshavand
Kh'amono onon kh'ak'ro, kh'angome ki ba suiashon omad, durug' shumurdand, pas, ba zudi khabarkh'oi on chiro, ki maskharaash mekardand, ba onon khokh'ad rasid

Oio [kofiron] nadidand, ki pesh az onon chi [bisior] gurukh'kh'oe az mardumro nobud kardem? [Ummatkh'oe] Ki dar zamin ba eshon chunon ik'tidor [va nerue] doda budem, ki [kh'argiz] ba shumo chunon imkonote nadodaem va boroni osmonro paiopai bar onon firistodem va nakh'rkh'o padid ovardem, ki zeri [khonakh'oi] onon ch'ori bud. Pas, [kh'angome ki nosiposi kardand, Mo] eshonro ba [sazoi] gunokh'kh'oiashon nobud kardem va pas az onkh'o gurukh'i digare padid ovardem

Va [ei paiombar, kh'atto] agar kitobe [navishta] bar kog'az bar tu nozil mekardem va eshon on [kitob]-ro bo dastoni khesh lams mekardand, kh'atman, kasone, ki kufr varzidaand meguftand: <<In [kitob chize] nest, magar ch'odui oshkor>>

Va [kofiron] guftand: <<Charo farishtae ba u nozil nashudaast [to guvokh'i rostguiiash boshad]>>? Va agar farishtae mefiristodem [va imon nameovardand], kh'atman, kor ba poion merasid va mukh'late [baroi tavba] nameioftand [va kh'alok meshudand]

Va agar on [firistoda]-ro farishtae k'aror medodem, kh'atman, vairo ba shakli marde darmeovardem [to bitavonand uro bubinand va sukhanonashro bifakh'mand] va iak'inan, ononro duchori kh'amon ishtibokh'e mekardem, ki k'ablan dar on budand [zero u niz surati inson dosht]
[Ei paiombar] Kh'atman, paiombarone pesh az tu [niz az suii kofiron] mavridi tamaskhur vok'e' shudand, pas, on chi ki maskharaash mekardand, domonashonro girift [va giriftori azob shudand]
[Ei paiombar, ba kofiron] Bigu: <<Dar zamin gardish kuned va bingared, ki saranch'omi takzibkunandagon [-i oioti ilokh'i] chiguna budaast>>

Bigu: <<On chi dar osmonkh'o va zamin ast, az oni kist>>? Bigu: <<Az oni Allokh'i mutaol ast, ki rakh'matro bar khesh voch'ib gardonidaast, [va] kh'atman, shumoro dar ruzi k'iiomat, ki dar on shakke nest, [nazdi khud] ch'am' khokh'ad kard. Va kasone, ki ba khesh ziion rasonidaand, imon nameovarand
Va kh'archi dar shabu ruz orom [-u k'aror] dorad az oni Ust va U shunovovu donost

Bigu: <<Oio g'airi Allokh'i mutaolro [baroi khud dust va] korsoz giram? [Parvardigore] Ki padidovarandai osmonkh'o va zamin ast va Ust, ki ruzi medikh'ad va khud ruzi doda nameshavad>>. Bigu: <<Man farmon ioftaam, ki nakhustin kase [az in ummat] bosham, ki taslim [-i amri ilokh'i] shudaast va [Allokh' taolo bar man farmon dod, ki]: "Kh'argiz az mushrikon nabosham"
Bigu: <<Agar man az [kh'ukmi] parvardigoram nofarmoni kunam, be tardid az azobi ruzi buzurg metarsam>>
Kh'ar ki dar on ruz ba vai azob narasad, kh'atman, [Allokh' taolo] ba u rakh'm kardaast va in kh'amon piruzii oshkor ast

[Ei inson] Agar Allokh' taolo [bikhokh'ad] ziione ba tu rasonad, kh'ech' kase ch'uz U bartarafkunandai on nest; va agar [iroda kunad, ki] khaire ba tu rasonad, [kase bozdorandai on nest] pas, U bar kh'ama chiz tavonost
Va Ust, ki bar bandagoni khud chira [va musallat] ast va U kh'akimi ogokh' ast

[Ei paiombar, bar mushrikon] Bigu: <<Guvokh'ii chi kase az kh'ama bekh'tar ast>>? Bigu: <<Allokh' taolo [ki] miioni manu shumo guvokh' ast va in K'ur'on [az ch'onibi U] bar man vakh'i shudaast, to ba vasilai on ba shumo va kh'ar ki [in paiom ba u] merasad, kh'ushdor dikh'am. Oio shumo ba rosti guvokh'i medikh'ed, ki bo Allokh' taolo ma'budoni digare kh'ast?>> Bigu: <<Man [kh'argiz ba chunin chize] guvokh'i namedikh'am>>. Bigu: <<Iak'inan U tankh'o ma'budi iagona ast va man az on chi [bo U] sharik k'aror medikh'ed, bezoram>>
Kasone, ki ba onon kitob [-i osmoni] dodaem, kh'amon guna ki pisaroni khudro meshinosand, [paiombar]-ro meshinosand. Onon ki [bo pairavi az kh'avoi nafs] ba khesh ziion rasonidaand, imon nameovarand
Va kist sitamgortar az on ki bar Allokh' taolo durug' mebandad [va baroiash sharik mepindorad] io oiotashro durug' meangorad? Iak'inan, sitamgoroni [mushrik] rastagor nameshavand
Va [iod kun az k'iiomat] ruze, ki kh'amai ononro ch'am' mekunem va ba kasone, ki shirk varzidaand, meguem: <<Ma'budonaton, ki [shariki Allokh' taolo] mepindoshted, kuch'o kh'astand>>?
Ongokh' [posukh va] uzrashon ch'uz in nest, ki meguiand: <<Ba Allokh' taolo -Parvardigoramon- savgand, ki mo mushrik nabudem>>
[Ei paiombar] Bingar,chiguna bar khud durug' bastand va on chi [dar mavridi shafoati ma'budonashon] ba durug' meguftand, [kh'ama] makh'vu nobud shud

Va afrode az onon [mushrikon] kh'astand, ki [kh'angomi tilovati K'ur'on] ba tu gush mesuporand va [-le] mo bar dilkh'oiashon parda afkandaem, to onro nafakh'mand va dar gushkh'oiashon sangini [k'aror dodaem] va agar tamomi mu'ch'izot [va daloili tavkh'id]-ro bubinand, [boz kh'am] ba on imon nameovarand, to nazdat biioiand va bo tu much'odala kunand. Kasone, ki kufr varzidaand, meguiand: <<In [K'ur'on, chize] Nest magar afsonakh'oi peshiniion>>
Va onon [mardum]-ro az pairavii u [paiombar] bozmedorand va khud [niz] az u dur meshavand va [kase] ch'uz kheshtanro kh'alok namekunand va [-le] namedonand

Va agar [ononro] kh'angome ki dar barobari otash [-i duzakh] nigakh' doshtaand, bubini, [az kh'olashon shigiftzada meshavi, ki] meguiand: <<Ei kosh, [ba dunio] bozgardonda meshudem va oioti Parvardigoramonro takzib namekardem va az mu'minon budem>>!

[Chunin nest, ki meguiand] Balki on chi pesh az in pinkh'on mekardand, baroiashon oshkor shudaast va agar [kh'am ba dunio] bozgardonda shavand, be tardid ba on chi az on nakh'i shuda budand, bozmegardand va inon durug'gu kh'astand
Va [mushrikon] guftand: <<Ch'uz zindagii mo dar dunio kh'ech' [zindagii digare] nest va kh'argiz barangekhta nakhokh'em shud>>

Va agar ononro kh'angome ki dar peshgokh'i Parvardigorashon nigokh' doshta meshavand, bubini, [shigiftzada meshavi. Allokh' taolo ba onon] meguiad: <<Oio in [zindagii pas az marg] kh'ak' nest?>> Onon meguiand: <<Bale, k'asam ba Parvardigoramon [ki kh'ak' ast]. [Allokh' taolo] meguiad: <<Pas, ba sazoi on ki kufr mevarzided, in azobro bichashed>>

Kasone, ki didori Parvardigorro durug' angoshtaand, kh'atman, ziion didand, [pas] kh'angome ki nogakh'on k'iiomat bar onon faro rasad, dar kh'ole ki bori [sangini] gunokh'kh'oni kheshro bar pushtashon kh'aml mekunandu meguiand: <<Ei dareg', bar mo az on chi dar borai on [dar dunio] kutokh'i kardem>>! Kh'on! Chi bad ast bore, ki [bar dush] mekashand!
