Zindagii dunio [chize] ch'uz bozicha va sargarmi nest, va kh'atman, saroi okhirat baroi kasone, ki parvo pesha mekunand, bekh'tar ast. Oio nameandeshed?

[Ei paiombar] ba iak'in mo medonem, ki onchi [mushrikon] meguiand, turo sakht g'amgin mekunad. Dar vok'e', onon turo[dar dil] takzib namekunand, balki sitamgoron [bo on ki kh'ak'ik'atro medonand] oioti Allokh' taoloro inkor mekunand

Va pesh az tu niz paiombarone takzib shudaand, vale bar on chi takzib shudand va ozor didand, shikeboi kardand, to [saranch'om] iorii mo bar onon faro rasid va sukhanoni Allokh' taolo [dar mavridi piruzii paiombaronash]-ro kh'ech' tag'iirdikh'andae nest [ki mone' gardad] va musallaman, akhbori paiombaroni [peshin va dostoni shikasti dushmanonashon] ba tu rasidaast

Va [ei paiombar] agar ruigardonii onon [az K'ur'on] bar tu noguvor [va dushvor] ast, agar metavoni nak'be (tunel) dar zamin io nardbone dar osmon bich'ui, to mu'ch'iza [digar] baroiashon biiovari [pas, chunon kun, vale sude nadorad].Va agar Allokh' taolo mekhost, kh'atman, ononro bar [masiri] kh'idoiat ch'am' mekard, pas, kh'argiz az nodonon mabosh
Ba rosti, tankh'o kasone [da'vati kh'ak'ro] mepazirand, ki meshunavand [va dark mekunand] va Allokh' taolo murdagonro [ruzi k'iiomat] barmeangezad, sipas ba suii U bozgardonda meshavand

Va [mushrikon] guftand: <<Charo nishonae [dar borai kh'ak'k'oniiati Mukh'ammad] az tarafi Parvardigorash bar u nozil nashudaast?>> [Ei paiombar] bigu: <<Be gumon, Allokh' taolo tavonost, ki nishonae [mutobik'i khosti onon] nozil kunad>>, vale beshtarashon namedonand, [ki nuzuli vakh'i, bar asosi kh'ikmatu tadbir ast]

Va kh'ech' ch'unbandae dar zamin nest va na kh'ech' parandae, ki bo bolkh'oi khud parvoz mekunad, magar on ki onkh'o [niz dar ofarinish va zindagi] gurukh'kh'oe monandi shumo kh'astand. Mo kh'ech' chizero dar kitob [Lavkh'i makh'fuz] furuguzor nakardaem, sipas [kh'amaro ruzi k'iiomat] nazdi Parvardigorashon gird meovarand

Va kasone, ki oioti moro durug' angoshtaand, karu gung va dar torikikh'o[-i ch'akh'l sargashta] kh'astand. Allokh'i mutaol kh'arkiro bikhokh'ad, gumrokh' mekunad va kh'arkiro bikhokh'ad, bar rokh'i rost k'arorash medikh'ad

[Ei paiombar, ba mushrikon] Bigu: <<Agar rost megued, ba man khabar dikh'ed, ki agar azobi Allokh'i mutaol ba surog'aton bioiad io [nogakh'on] k'iiomat barpo shavad, oio g'air az Allokh' taoloro [ba iori] mekhoned?>>
Ore, tankh'o Uro [ba duo] mekhoned va agar U bikhokh'ad, on chiro ki ba khotirash uro faro mekhoned, az bain mebarad va shumo [niz az tarsi azob] sharikero, ki baroiash k'oil shudaed, az iod mebared

[Ei paiombar] Be tardid, pesh az tu [niz paiombarone] ba suii ummatkh'o[-i peshin] firistodem va ononro ba tangdasti va nokhushi duchor sokhtem, boshad, ki [ba dargokh'i ilokh'i furutani va] tazarru' kunand
Pas, charo kh'angome ki azobi mo ba onon rasid, tazarru' nakardand? Vale [dar kh'ak'ik'at] dilkh'oiashon sakht shudaast va shaiton on chiro anch'om medodand, baroiashon orostaast

Pas, vak'te [mushrikon] onchiro, ki ba on pand doda shuda budand, faromush kardand, darkh'oi kh'ar chize [az ne'matkh'oi ilokh'i]-ro bar onon kushudem, to ba on chi ba eshon doda shuda bud, shod gardidand. Nogakh'on ononro [ba kufr] giriftem, pas, kh'amon dam [kh'amagi az nach'otu rakh'mat] ma'ius shudand
Pas, reshai on gurukh'e, ki sitam kardand, barkanda shud va sitoish makhsusi Allokh' taolo -Parvardigori ch'akh'oniion- ast

[Ei paiombar, ba mushrikon] Bigu: <<Ba man khabar dikh'ed, agar Allokh' taolo gushu chashmkh'oiatonro bigirad va bar dilkh'oiaton mukh'r bizanad, kadom ma'bude ba ch'uz Allokh' taolo [metavonad] onkh'oro ba shumo bozgardonad?>> Bubin, chiguna oiotro [ba shevakh'oi] gunogun [baion] mekunem, ongokh' onon rui megardonand
Bigu: <<Biandeshed, agar azobi ilokh'i ba nogokh' io oshkoro ba surog'aton bioiad, oio ch'uz gurukh'i sitamgoron [kase] nobud meshavad?>>
Va mo paiombaronro ch'uz bashoratgar va bimdikh'anda namefiristem, pas, kh'ar ki imon biovarad va [kheshtanro] islokh' kunad, na tarse bar onon ast va na andukh'gin meshavand
Va kasone, ki oioti moro durug' shumoridaand, ba [sazoi] on ki nofarmoni mekardand, azob [-i ilokh'i] domangirashon khokh'ad shud

[Ei paiombar, ba mushrikon] Bigu: <<Man nameguiam, ki ganch'inakh'oi Allokh' taolo nazdi man ast va g'aib [niz] namedonam va ba shumo nameguiam, ki man farishtaam. Man az chize pairavi namekunam magar az on chi ki ba man vakh'i megardad>>. Bigu: <<Oio nobino va bino [kofir va mu'min] iaksonand? Oio nameandeshed>>?

Va [ei paiombar] bo in [K'ur'on] ba onon, ki metarsand, ba suii Parvardigorashon [barangekhta] va gird ovarda shavand, kh'ushdor dekh', [charo] ki ba ch'uz U baroiashon na [dustu] korsoze kh'ast va na shafoatgare, boshad, ki parvo kunand

Va kasonero, ki [fak'irand va ] bomdodu shomgokh' Parvardigorashonro mekhonand [va] khushnudii Uro metalaband [az mach'olisi khud] tard nakun [ki ba buzurgoni mushrikin tavach'ch'ukh' kuni], na chize az kh'isobi onkh'o bar tust va na chize az kh'isobi tu bar onkh'ost, ki [bikhokh'i az peromunat] tardashon kuni va az sitamgoron shavi

Va in chunin barkhe az ishonro ba barkhe digar ozmudem, to [kofironi sarvatmand dar borai mu'minoni mustamand] biguiand: <<Oio az miioni mo inkh'o kh'astand, ki Allokh'i taolo [bo bakhshishi tavfik'i imon] bar onon minnat nikh'odaast?>> Oio Allokh'i mutaol ba [kh'oli] siposguzoron donotar nest?

Va [ei Paiombar] kh'ar gokh' kasone, ki ba oioti Mo imon dorand, nazdi tu oiand, bigu: <<Salom bar shumo. Parvardigoraton [dar kh'ak'k'i shumo bakhshoish va] rakh'matro bar khud muk'arrar doshtaast. Kh'ar kase az shumo, ki ba nodoni kori bade anch'om dikh'ad va ongokh' tavba namoiad va [guzashtai kheshro] islokh' kunad, pas, [bidon, ki] iak'inan, U omurzandai mekh'rubon ast>>
Va inchunin oioti [khud]-ro sharkh' medikh'em, to rokh'i gunakh'koron ravshan shavad [va shumo az on duri kuned]

[Ei paiombar, ba mushrikon] Bigu: <<Man nakh'i shudaam az in ki kasonero biparastam, ki shumo ba ch'oii Allokh'i mutaol mekhoned>>. Bigu: <<Man az kh'avaskh'oiaton pairavi namekunam, ki [agar chunin kunam] kh'atman, gumrokh' shudaam va az kh'idoiatioftagon nakhokh'am bud>>

Bigu: <<Man daleli ravshane az Parvardigoram doram, va [-le] shumo onro durug' pindoshted.Va on chi ba shitob khostorash kh'asted, [azobi ilokh'i] nazdi man nest. Farmon, tankh'o az oni Allokh' taolost, [ki] kh'ak'ro baion mekunad va U bekh'tarin ch'udokunanda[-i kh'ak' az botil] ast>>

[Ei paiombar, ba mushrikon] Bigu: <<Agar on chi ki ba shitob khostorash kh'asted, nazdi man bud, [bar saraton furud meovardam va] kori miioni manu shumo ba poion merasid, va [-le] Allokh' taolo ba [kh'oli] sitamgoron donotar ast [va ba onon mukh'lat medikh'ad]>>

Va kalidkh'o [ganch'inakh'o]-i nikh'on nazdi Ust [va] ch'uz U [kh'ech' kas] onro namedonad va [Ust, ki] on chiro dar khushki va dariost medonad va kh'ech' barge [az darakht] nameaftad, magar in ki onro medonad va kh'ech' donae dar torikikh'oi zamin va kh'ech' taru khushke nest, magar in ki dar kitobi ravshan [Lavkh'i makh'fuz] k'aror dorad

Va Ust, ki shabongokh' rukh'atonro [kh'angomi khob] megirad va [kh'am Ust, ki] onchiro dar ruz ba dast ovardaed, medonad. Sipas shumoro dar on [ruz] bedor mekunad, to on ki zamoni muaiiane sipari gardad,; ongokh' [ki vafot karded, dar k'iiomat] bozgashtaton ba suii Ust. Sipas shumoro az onchi anch'om medoded, ogokh' mekunad

Va U bar bandagonash chira ast va nigakh'bonone [az farishtagon] bar shumo mefiristad, to zamone, ki margi iake az shumo faro rasad, firistodagoni mo [bo kh'amrokh'i farishtai marg] ch'onashro megirand va onon [dar ma'muriiati khud] kutokh'i namekunand
On gokh' ba suii Allokh' taolo, ki [ioru] korsozi rostinashon ast, bozgardonda meshavand. Ogokh' boshed! Kh'ukm az oni Ust va U sare'tarin kh'isobras ast

[Ei paiombar, ba mushrikon] Bigu: <<Kist, ki shumoro az torikikh'o [va sakhtikh'oi] khushki va dario nach'ot medikh'ad? [Dar kh'ole ki] Uro ba zori va pinkh'oni mekhoned [va megued] "Agar moro az in [vartai marg] nach'ot dikh'ad, kh'atman, az siposguzoron khokh'em bud">>
Bigu: <<Allokh'i mutaol shumoro az inkh'o va az tamomi sakhtikh'o nach'ot medikh'ad,on gokh' shumo [boz kh'am] shirk mevarzed>>

Bigu: <<U tavonost, ki bar shumo azobe [kh'amchun soik'a va tufon] az boloi saraton io [kh'amchun khushksoli va zilzila] az zeri poikh'oiaton bifiristad io shumoro ba surati gurukh'kh'oi parokanda [va ch'udo az kh'am] darovarad va azobi barkhe az shumoro ba barkhe [digar] bichashonad>>. Bingar chiguna oiot [-i khud]-ro gunogun baion mekunem, boshad, ki darioband
[Ei paiombar] K'avmi tu on [K'ur'on]-ro durug' shumurdand, dar kh'ole ki on [kitob] kh'ak' ast. [Ba kofironi k'avmat] Bigu: <<Man [murok'ibu] korguzori shumo nestam>>
Kh'ar khabare sarraside [baroi vuk'u'] dorad va [ba zudi] khokh'ed donist [ki saranch'omaton chiguna ast]>>

Va kh'argokh' kasonero didi, ki dar oioti Mo [bo dushmani va tamaskhur] guftugu mekunand, az onon ru bigardon, to ba sukhani digare bipardozand.Va agar shaiton turo ba faromushi andokht, pas, az on ki iod ovardi, bo k'avmi sitamgor [mushrik] manishin
Va [kh'archand] chize az kh'isob [ va gunokh'i] onon bar [ukh'dai] parkh'ezgoron nest, vale iodovari [va irshod lozim] ast, boshad, ki parvo kunand

Va kasonero, ki dinashonro ba bozi va sargarmi giriftaand va zindagii dunio ononro fireftaast, rakh'o kun va [mardumro] bo in [K'ur'on] andarz dekh', to mabodo kase ba [kaifari] onchi ba dast ovardaast, ba kh'alokat biaftad, dar kh'ole ki dar barobari Allokh'i mutaol baroi [rakh'oi az azobi] on na [dust va] korsoze dorad va na shafoatgare.Va[kh'atto] agar [bikhokh'ad baroi nach'oti khesh] kh'ar fidiae dikh'ad, az u pazirufta nameshavad. Inkh'o kh'astand, ki ba [kaifari] on chi ba dast ovardaand, kh'alok gashtaand va ba [sazoi] on ki kufr mevarzidand, sharobe az obi ch'ushon va azobe purdard [dar pesh] dorand

[Ei paiombar] Bigu: <<Oio ba ch'oii Allokh'i mutaol chizero bikhonem, ki na ba mo sud medikh'ad va na ziion merasonad? Va oio pas az on ki Allokh' taolo moro kh'idoiat kardaast, [ba suii gumrokh'i] ba ak'ib bozgardem? Kh'amchun kase, ki shaiotin uro [fireb doda va az rokh'i rost] badar burdaand va u dar zamin kh'aironu sargashta mondaast, dar kh'ole ki u ioron [-i dilsuz] dorad, ki ba kh'idoiat da'vatash mekunand [va meguiand]: "Ba suii mo biio">>!Bigu: <<Be tardid, kh'idoiati [rostin] kh'idoiati Allokh' taolost va mo farmon ioftaem, ki taslimi Parvardigori ch'akh'oniion boshem
Va in ki namoz barpo dored va az u parvo kuned va Ust, ki ba peshgokh'ash kh'ashr khokh'ed shud>>

Va Ust, ki osmonkh'o va zaminro ba kh'ak' ofarid va ruze, ki [Allokh' taolo ba kh'ar chize] biguiad: <<Mavch'ud shav>>, pas, bedirang mavch'ud meshavad. Sukhani U kh'ak' ast. Va ruze, ki dar sur damida meshavad, farmonravoi az oni Ust. U donoi pinkh'onu paidost va Ust, ki kh'akimi ogokh' ast
Va [iod kun az] kh'angome ki Ibrokh'im ba padarash -Ozar- guft: <<Oio butkh'oro ma'budi [khesh] megiri? Ba rosti, ki man tu va k'avmatro dar gumrokh'ii oshkore mebinam>>
Va in guna farmondikh'ii [shukukh'mandi] osmonkh'o va zaminro ba Ibrokh'im nishon dodem, to [iagonagii Allokh' taolo va gumrokh'ii Ozar va k'avmashro dariobad va] az akh'li iak'in boshad
Pas, kh'angome ki [torikii] shab Uro darbar girift, sitorae did, [va] guft: <<In Parvardigori man ast>>.Va chun g'urub kard, guft: <<G'urubkunandagonro dust nadoram>>
Pas, kh'angome ki mokh'ro tobanda did, guft: <<In Parvardigori man ast>>.Va chun g'urub kard, guft: <<Agar Parvardigoram maro kh'idoiat nakarda bud, kh'atman, az gumrokh'on budam>>

Pas, kh'angome ki khurshedro durakhshanda did, guft: <<In Parvardigori man ast. In buzurgtar ast>>. On gokh' vak'te ki g'urub kard, guft: <<Ei k'avm, man az on chi [baroi Allokh' taolo] sharik k'aror medikh'ed, bezoram>>
Ba rosti, ki man kh'ak'garoiona din [-u ibodat]-i kheshro baroi kase kholis kardam, ki osmonkh'o va zaminro padid ovardaast va kh'argiz dar zumrai mushrikon nestam>>

Va k'avmi u bo vai ba much'odala pardokhtand, [va uro az khashmi butkh'o tarsondand. Ibrokh'im] guft: <<Oio dar borai Allokh'i mutaol bo man much'odala mekuned, dar kh'ole ki U maro [ba rokh'i rost] kh'idoiat kardaast va az on chi bo U sharik mepindored, kh'ech' nametarsam, magar on ki Parvardigoram chize [az sud va ziion baroiam] khosta boshad. Ilmi Parvardigoram kh'ama chizro faro giriftaast. Oio pand namegired?

Va chiguna az on chi sharik [-i Allokh' taolo] mepindored bitarsam bo on ki shumo khud namekh'arosed az in ki chizero shariki Allokh'i mutaol sokhtaed, ki U [kh'ech'] dalele dar borai [kh'ak'k'oniiati] on bar shumo nozil nakardaast? Pas, agar medoned, [bigued] kadom iak az in du gurukh' [muvakh'kh'id va mushrik] ba amniiat [va duri az azob] sazovortar ast?
Kasone, ki imon ovardaand va imonashonro ba [kh'ech'] shirke naoludaand, ononand, ki amn [-u oromish] dorand va rokh'ioftagonand>>

Va in [istidlol] kh'uch'ch'ati mo bud, ki ba Ibrokh'im dar barobari k'avmash dodem. [Dar dunio va okhirat mak'omi] Kh'ar kiro, ki bikh'okh'em, ba darach'oti boloe mebarem. [Ei paiombar] Be tardid, Parvardigorat kh'akimu donost

Va ba u [Ibrokh'im] Iskh'ok' va Ia'k'ubro bakhshidem va kh'amaro [ba rokh'i rost] kh'idoiat kardem.Va peshtar Nukh'ro [niz] kh'idoiat karda budem va az nasli u Dovud, Sulaimon, Aiub, Iusuf, Muso va Kh'orunro [ba rokh'i kh'ak' rakh'namun gashtem] va nakukoronro inguna podosh medikh'em
Va [kh'amchunin] Zakariio, Iakh'io, Iso va Ilios[-ro rokh' namudem, ki] kh'ama az shoistagon budand
Va Ismoil, Iasa', Iunus va Lut[-ro niz kh'idoiat kardem] va ch'umlagiro bar ch'akh'oniion bartari dodem
Va [niz] az padaron va farzandonu barodaronashon [barkhero bartari dodem va] ononro barguzidem va ba rokh'i rost kh'idoiatashon kardem
In kh'idoiati Allokh'i mutaol ast, ki kh'ar kase az bandagonashro, ki bikhokh'ad, bo on kh'idoiat mekunad va agar shirk mevarzidand, on chi [az a'moli nek] ki anch'om doda budand, tabokh' meshud

Inon kasone kh'astand, ki ba eshon kitobu kh'ikmat va nubuvvat bakhshidem. Pas, [ei paiombar] agar inon [ mushrikon] ba in [paiombaron va kitobkh'oi ilokh'i] kufr bivarzand, kh'atman, gurukh' [-i mukh'och'irin va ansor va tobein]-ro bar [kh'ifzu nigakh'bonii] on [usulu ak'oid] megumorem, ki nisbat ba on kofir naboshand

Onon kasone kh'astand, ki Allokh' taolo kh'idoiatashon kardaast, pas, [ei paiombar] az kh'idoiat [-u rokh'i rost]-i eshon pairavi kun, [va ba k'avmat] bigu: <<Man dar barobari in [risolat] podoshe az shumo namekhokh'am. In [K'ur'on chize] nest, magar [iodovari va] pande baroi ch'akh'oniion>>

Va [mushrikon buzurgi va mak'omi] Allokh' taoloro chunon ki sazovori Ust nashinokhtand, charo ki guftand: <<Allokh' taolo bar [kh'ech'] bashare chize nozil nakardaast>>. [Ei paiombar] Bigu: <<On kitobero, ki Muso ovard, chi kase nozil kardaast? [Kh'amon kitobe, ki] baroi mardum rushnoi va rakh'namude bud [va shumo iakh'udiion] onro ba surati [parokanda bar] tumorkh'o darmeovared [va kh'ar chiro ki mekhokh'ed] az on oshkor mesozed va bisiorero pinkh'on mekuned.Va [aknun, ei k'avmi arab] chizkh'oe [az oiot va akhbori K'ur'on] ba shumo omukhta shud, ki na khud medonisted va na padaronaton>>. [Ei paiombar] Bigu: <<Allokh' taolo [onro nozil kardaast>>. Ongokh' [dar ch'akh'lu gumrokh'i] rakh'oiashon kun, to dar zharfo [-i ak'oidi botil]-i khud sargarmi bozi boshand

Va in [K'ur'on] kitobi muborake ast, ki onro nozil kardem, [to] tasdik'kunandai chize boshad, ki pesh az on nozil shudaast va [kh'amchunin] baroi on ast, ki ba [sokinoni] Ummu-l-k'uro [Makka] va [mardumi] peromunash kh'ushdor dikh'i.Va kasone, ki ba okhirat imon meovarand, ba in [kitob] niz imon meovarand va bar namozi khesh muvozibat mekunand

Va kist sitamgortar az on ki durug'e ba Allokh' taolo bibandad io biguiad: <<Ba man [niz] vakh'i shudaast>>, dar kh'ole ki kh'ech' vakh'ie ba u narasidaast va [io] kase, ki biguiad: <<Man [kh'am] monandi on chi ki Allokh' taolo nozil kardaast, [baroiaton] nozil mekunam>>? Va [ei paiombar, sakh'nai kh'avlnoke ast] agar kh'angomero bubini, ki [in] sitamgoron dar [tarsu] sakhtikh'oi marg furu raftaand va farishtagon [-i k'abzi rukh'] dastkh'oiashonro [ba suii onon] kushudaand [va fariod mezanand]: <<Ch'onkh'oi kheshro [az badan] berun dikh'ed. Imruz ba [sazoi] on chi ba nokh'ak' bar Allokh' taolo durug' mebasted va dar barobari oiotash takabbur mekarded, ba azobi khorkunanda much'ozot meshaved>>

Va [ruzi k'iiomat Allokh'i mutaol mefarmoiad] <<kh'amon guna ki shumoro nakhustin bor [biduni molu mak'om] ofaridem, [aknun niz] kh'atman, tankh'o ba suii mo omadaed va on chiro ba shumo arzoni karda budem, pushti sari khud [dar dunio] voguzoshted va [ma'budonu] shafoatgaronero, ki dar [kori] khesh sharikoni [Allokh' taolo] mepindoshted, kh'amrokh'aton namebinem. Ba rosti, paivandi miioni shumo gusasta ast va on chi [shariki mo va shafe'i khud] mepindoshted, gum gashtaast>>

Be tardid Allokh' taolo shikofandai dona[-i giiokh'kh'o] va kh'asta[-i khurmo dar dili zamin] ast. [Mavch'udi] Zindaro az [moddai] bech'on berun meovarad [ravishi giiokh' az dona] va [moddai ba zokh'ir] bech'onro az [mavch'udi] zinda khorich' mesozad [berun omadani tukhm io nutfa az kh'aivonot]. In Allokh' taolost, [ki chunin k'udrati mutlak'e dorad].Pas, chiguna [az rokh'i bandagii U] bozgardanda meshaved?
[U] Shikofandai sapedadam ast va shabro [moiai] oromish k'aror dod va khurshedu mokh'ro [niz] bo kh'isob [va nazmi dak'ik' padid ovard]. Tak'diri [Parvardigori] shikastnopaziri dono chuninast

Va [ei farzandoni Odam] Ust, ki sitoragonro baroiaton k'aror dod,to dar torikikh'oi khushki va dario ba [kumaki] onkh'o rokh' iobed. Ba rosti, ki mo nishonakh'o [-i tavonu tadbiri khesh]-ro baroi mardume, ki medonand, ba tafsil baion kardaem

Va Ust, ki shumoro az iak tan ofarid, pas, baroi shumo [dar rakh'imi modar] k'arorgokh'e ast va [dar pushti padar] amonatgokh'e. Mo oiot [-i khud]-ro baroi mardume, ki [kalomi ilokh'iro] mefakh'mand, ba tafsil baion kardaem

Va Ust, ki az osmon obe furu rekht va az on [boron] kh'ar guna ruiidanie barovardem va az on [niz kh'ar kishtu giiokh'i] sabzero ruionidem, [ki] az on [giiokh'kh'o niz baroi tag'ziiai shumo] donakh'oi mutarokime [kh'amchun gandumu ch'av] padid meovarem va [kh'amchunin] az shukuftai nakhl khushakh'oi nazdik ba iakdigar [ruionidem] va bog'kh'oe az angur va zaitunu anor [ofaridem mevakh'oe, ki] barkhe kh'ammonand va barkhe nokh'ammonand kh'astand. Vak'te ba bor nishast ba mevakh'oi on va [tarzi] rasidanash bingared. Dar in [ofarinish] baroi mardume, ki imon dorand, nishonakh'oi [ravshanu k'udrati ilokh'i] ast

Va [mushrikon] baroi Allokh' taolo sharikone az ch'in k'oil shudaand, kh'ol onki [Allokh' taolo khud] onkh'oro ofaridaast.Va[kh'amchunin] az ruii nodoni baroiash [farzandon] pisaru dukhtar mesozand. U az on chi vasf mekunand, poku bartar ast
[U] padidovarandai osmonkh'o va zamin ast, chiguna mumkin ast farzand doshta boshad, dar kh'ole ki kh'amsare nadorad? Va kh'ama chizro ofarida va U ba kh'ar chize donost
In ast Allokh' taolo-Parvardigori shumo, kh'ech' ma'bude [ba kh'ak'] ch'uz U nest, ofarinandai kh'ama chiz ast, pas, Uro biparasted va [bidoned, ki] U [murok'ibu] korguzori kh'ama chiz ast
Chashmkh'o Uro darnameioband va [-le] U chashmkh'oro darmeiobad va Ust, ki borikbin va ogokh' ast

[Ei paiombar, ba mushrikon bigu] <<Barosti daloili oshkore az ch'onibi Parvardigoraton baroi shumo omadaast, pas, kh'ar ki [bo basiratu mantik' dar borai on] biandeshad, ba sudi ust va kh'ar ki chashm [bar kh'ak'ik'at] bibandad, ba ziioni ust va man nigakh'boni shumo nestam>>

Va inchunin nishonakh'o [va daloili k'udrati ilokh'i]-ro gunogun baion mekunem, to mabodo [mushrikon] biguiand: <<[Onkh'oro az akh'li kitob] omukhtai>>.Va mo in oiatkh'oro baroi gurukh'e, ki medonand [va mefakh'mand], ba ravshani baion mekunem
[Ei paiombar] Az onchi ki az ch'onibi Parvardigorat ba tu vakh'i shudaast, pairavi kun, kh'ech' ma'bude [ba kh'ak'] ch'uz U nest va az mushrikon rui bigardon
Va agar Allokh' taolo mekhost, [onon kh'argiz] shirk namevarzidand.Va mo turo bar onon nigakh'bon k'aror nadodaem va tu [kh'argiz murok'ibu] korguzorashon nesti

Va [ei mu'minon, kh'argiz] ba onkh'o [butkh'o], ki [mushrikon] ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo [ba niioish] mekhonand, dashnom nadikh'ed, [charo ki] onon niz az ruii dushmani [va] nodoni ba Allokh' taolo dashnom medikh'and. In guna baroi kh'ar ummate kirdorashonro orostem.Sipas bozgashtashon [dar k'iiomat] ba suii Parvardigorashon ast va ononro az onchi anch'om medodand, ogokh' mesozad

Va [mushrikon] bo sakhttarin savgandkh'oiashon ba Allokh' taolo savgand khurdand, ki agar mu'ch'izae [ki khostaand] bar eshon bioiad, kh'atman, imon meovarand. [Ei paiombar] Bigu: <<Mu'ch'izot fak'at dar ikhtiiori Allokh' taolo ast>>va shumo [ei mu'minon] chi medoned, ki agar [mu'ch'izae kh'am] biioiad, imon nameovarand
Va mo dilkh'o va didagonashonro [az darki kh'ak'oik'] barmegardonem, chunonchi nakhustin bor ba on imon naiovardand va ononro dar [nofarmoni va] tug'ionashon sargashta rakh'o mekunem

Va agar mo farishtagonro ba suii onon mefiristodem va [kh'atto] agar murdagon bo onon ba sukhan meomadand va kh'ar chizero dasta-dasta dar barobarashon gird meovardem, [to rostguii paiombarro guvokh'i dikh'and], boz kh'am imon nameovardand, magar in ki Allokh' taolo bikhokh'ad, vale beshtarashon nodoni mekunand

Va [ei paiombar- Mukh'ammad, turo bo dushmanii mushrikon ozmudem va] kh'amchunin, baroi kh'ar paiombare dushmane az shaiotini ins va ch'in k'aror dodem, ki barkhe az onon dar nikh'on ba barkhe digar sukhanoni firebanda [va beasos] ilk'o mekunand va agar Parvardigorat mekhost, [kh'argiz] chunin namekardand.Pas, ononro ba durug'kh'oe, ki mebofand, voguzor

Va [chunin kardem, to ononro biozmoem, khostem] to dilkh'oi kasone, ki ba okhirat imon nameovarand, ba on [sukhani firebanda] bigaroiad va onro bipisandad va kh'ar gunokh'e, ki mekhokh'and murtakib shavand

[Ei paiombar, ba mushrikon bigu] <<Oio [sazost, ki baroi k'azovat dar borai ikhtilofi manu shumo] dovare ch'uz Allokh' taolo bich'uem? Va kh'ol on ki Ust, ki in kitobro bo tafsil ba suii shumo nozil kardaast>>.Va onkh'o, ki kitob [-i osmoni] ba eshon dodaem, medonand, ki on [K'ur'on] az ch'onibi Parvardigorat ba kh'ak' nozil shudaast.Pas, kh'argiz az tardidkunandagon nabosh
Va sukhanoni Parvardigorat [K'ur'on] bo rosti [ dar guftor] va adl [dar akh'kom] ba kh'addi tamom ba kamol rasid. Kh'ech' tag'iirdikh'andae baroi sukhanonash nest va U shunavovu donost
Va agar az beshtari mardumi zamin itoat kuni, az rokh'i Allokh' taolo gumrokh'at mekunand. Onon ch'uz gumon [-i beasosi khud az chize] pairavi namekunand va ch'uz durug' namebofand
Be tardid, Parvardigorat ba [kh'oli] kase, ki az rokh'i U munkh'arif meshavad, donotar ast va U ba [kh'oli] rokh'ioftagon [niz] donotar ast
Pas, [ei mardum] agar ba oiotash imon dored, [fak'at] az [gushti] on chi nomi Allokh' taolo [kh'angomi zabkh'] bar on burdashudaast, bikhured

Va [ei musulmonon] shumoro chi meshavad, ki az on chi nomi Allokh' taolo bar on burdashudaast, namekhured? Kh'ol on ki [Allokh' taolo] on chiro bar shumo kh'arom kardaast, ba tafsil baroiaton baion doshtaast [pas, az onkh'o duri kuned] magar chize, ki ba [khurdani] on nochor shaved va be tardid, bisiore [az mardum digaronro] az ruii nodoni bo kh'avaskh'oi khesh gumrokh' mekunand. [Ei paiombar] Iak'inan, Parvardigorat ba [kh'oli] tach'ovuzkoron [az kh'ududi ilokh'i] donotar ast
Va [ei mardum] gunokh'i oshkor va pinkh'onro rakh'o kuned, [charo ki] be tardid, kasone, ki murtakibi gunokh' meshavand, ba zudi dar barobari onchi mekardand, much'ozot khokh'and shud

Va [ei mu'minon] az on chi [kh'angomi zabkh'] nomi Allokh' taolo bar on burdanashudaast, nakhured, charo ki on [kori] kh'atman, nofarmoni ast va dar kh'ak'ik'at shaiotin ba dustoni khud ilk'o mekunand, ki bo shumo [dar in mavrid] much'odala namoiand.Va agar az onon itoat kuned, kh'atman, shumo [niz dar zumrai] mushrikon kh'asted

Oio kase, ki [dilash az ch'akh'lu shirk] murda bud va mo [bo tavkh'idu imon] zindaash gardonidem va nure baroiash padid ovardem, to dar partavi [kh'idoiat] on miioni mardum gom bardorad, kh'amchun kasest, ki gui dar torikikh'o [giriftor] ast va az on berun omadani nest? On chi kofiron mekardand, in guna baroiashon orosta shudaast

Va ba in guna dar kh'ar shakh're buzurgoni gunakh'korashro megumorem, to dar on ba nairang bipardozand [va mardumro az rokh'i Allokh' taolo bozdorand], va [-le] onon ch'uz ba khud nairang namezanand va [in kh'ak'ik'atro] dark namekunand

Va [mushrikon] chun oiate [az K'ur'on] baroiashon meoiad meguiand: <<Kh'argiz ba on imon nameovarem, magar on ki kh'am monandi on chi ba paiombaroni ilokh'i dodashudaast, ba mo niz doda shavad>>. Allokh' taolo bekh'tar medonad, ki risolati kheshro kuch'o [va bar ukh'dai chi kase] k'aror dikh'ad. Ba zudi bar onon, ki murtakibi [nofarmoni va] gunokh' shudand, ba sazoi nairange, ki varzida budand, az ch'onibi Allokh' taolo khori va azobi sakhte khokh'ad rasid

Pas, kh'ar kiro Allokh' taolo bikhokh'ad, kh'idoiat kunad, dilashro baroi [pazirishi] Islom mekushoiad va kh'arkiro bikhokh'ad, dar gumrokh'i voguzorad, dilashro tang [va basta] mesozad [va pazirishi kh'ak'ro chunon baroiash makh'ol megardonad, ki] gui mekhokh'ad az osmon bolo ravad [va nametavonad], Allokh' taolo in chunin azobro bar kasone, ki imon nameovarand, megumorad
Va [ei paiombar] in [dini Islom] rokh'i rosti Parvardigori tust. Ba rosti, ki mo oiot [-i khud]-ro baroi gurukh'e, ki pand megirand, ba tafsil baion kardem
Baroi onon nazdi Parvardigorashon saroi salomatu amniiat ast va U ba [podoshi] korkh'oe, ki mekardand, [dustu] korsozashon ast

Va [iod kun az k'iiomat] ruze, ki kh'amai onon [insu ch'in]-ro gird meovarad [va mefarmoiad]: <<Ei gurukh'i ch'inniion, az odamiion [bisiorero gumrokh' karded va pairavoni] farovon iofted>>.Va dustoni [mushriki] eshon az [miioni] insonkh'o meguiand: <<Parvardigoro, barkhe az mo az barkhe digar bakh'rabardori kardand [va dar kufru gunokh' ba iakdigar iori rasonidand] va [in ki] mo ba poione, ki baroiamon muk'arrar karda budi, rasidaem>> [Allokh' taolo] Mefarmoiad: <<Ch'oigokh'aton otash ast [va] dar on ch'ovidon khokh'ed bud, magar on chiro Allokh' taolo bikhokh'ad [ki az on bikokh'ad io bibakhshoiad]. Be tardid,Parvardigorat kh'akimu donost>>
Va inchunin ba'ze az sitamgoronro ba ba'ze digar ba [sazoi] on chi mekardand, musallat megardonem

Ei gurukh'i ch'in va ins, oio az miioni shumo firistodagone baroiaton naiomadand, ki oioti Maro bar shumo bikhonand va az didori in ruz ba shumo kh'ushdor dikh'and? Onon meguiand: <<[Ore] Mo alaikh'i khesh guvokh'i medikh'em [ki omadand]>>.Va zindagii dunio firebashon dod va ba ziioni khud guvokh'i dodand, ki kofir budand
In [itmomi kh'uch'ch'at] ba on khotir ast, ki Parvardigorat kh'ech' gokh' shakh'rkh'oro, dar kh'ole ki mardumash [az paiomi ilokh'i bekhabar va] g'ofiland, ba sitam nobud nakardaast
Va kh'amagon dar barobari on chi anch'om dodaand, darach'ote dorand va Parvardigorat az on chi mekunand, g'ofil nest

Va Parvardigorat beniiozu doroi rakh'mat [-i bekaron] ast. [Ei bandagoni gunakh'gor, Allokh' taolo] Agar bikhokh'ad, shumoro [bo azob az miion] mebarad va pas az shumo kh'arkiro bikhokh'ad, ch'oinishin mesozad, kh'amchunonki shumoro niz az nasli gurukh'i digar ofarid
[Ei kofiron] On chi ba shumo va'da doda meshavad, iak'inan, khokh'ad omad va shumo nametavoned [Allokh' taoloro] notavon sozed [va az kaifarash bigurezed]

Bigu: <<Ei k'avmi man, ba shevai khud amal kuned [va bar kufru gumrokh'ii khud bimoned, ki] be tardid, man [niz ba imoni khesh] amal mekunam, pas, ba zudi khokh'ed donist, ki [piruzii dunio va] farch'omi [nekui]on saro az oni kist. Be gumon, sitamgoron [-i mushrik] rastagor nakhokh'and shud>>

Va [mushrikon] baroi Allokh' taolo az on chi ofaridaast, az kishtu chakh'orpoion, sakh'me ta'iin kardand va ba gumoni khud guftand: <<In makhsusi Allokh' taolost va in makhsusi sharikoni mo [butkh'o]>>. Pas, on chi baroi sharikonashon bud, ba Allokh' taolo namerasad, va [-le] on chi baroi Allokh' taolo bud, ba sharikoni onkh'o merasad. Chi bad dovari mekunand!

Va in guna bud, ki sharikoni onkh'o [az shaiotinu butkh'o] dar nazari bisiore az mushrikon [ki fak'ir budand] k'atli farzandonashonro orostand [va zebo ch'ilva dodand], to kh'alokashon kunand va oinashonro bar onon [oshufta va] mushtabakh' sozand.Va agar Allokh' taolo mekhost, chunin namekardand, pas, [ei paiombar, tu niz] ononro bo [tukh'matu] durug'kh'oiashon voguzor

Va ba pindori khesh guftand: <<[Istifoda az] In chakh'orpoion va kishtzor[-kh'oe, ki vak'fi butkh'o shuda] mamnu' ast va kh'ech' kas az on namekhurad, magar on [gurukh' az khodimoni butkh'o] ki mo mekhokh'em va chakh'orpoione kh'astand, ki [savor shudan bar] pushtashon kh'arom shudaast>>.Va domkh'oe [doshtand], ki [kh'angomi zabkh'] nomi Allokh' taoloro bar onkh'o nameburdand, [inkh'o kh'ama bovarkh'oe bud, ki] ba durug' ba Allokh' taolo nisbat medodand [va Allokh' taolo] ba khotiri on chi ba durug' meboftand, ch'azoiashonro khokh'ad dod

Va guftand: <<On chi dar shikami in ch'akh'orpoion ast, [agar zinda mutavalid shavad] ba mardoni mo ikhtisos dorad va bar kh'amsaronamon kh'arom shudaast, va [-le] agar [ch'anin] murda boshad, kh'amai onon [az zanu mard] dar on sharikand. Ba zudi [Allokh' taolo] ononro ba sazoi in tavsifashon kaifar khokh'ad dod. Ba rosti, ki U kh'akimi donost

Kasone, ki az ruii [chakh'lu] bekhiradi farzandoni khudro [az tarsi fak'r] kushtand va bo durug' bastan ba Allokh' taolo on chiro, ki Allokh' taolo ruziiashon karda bud, [bar khud] kh'arom donistand, sakht ziion kardand. Be tardid, onon gumrokh' shudand va kh'idoiatiofta nabudand

Ust, ki bog'kh'oe [bo buttakh'oi] dorbastdor va [darakhtoni] bedorbast padid ovard va [niz] darakhti khurmo va ziroate, ki mevakh'oiash gunogun ast va darakhti zaitun va anor, ki [bargkh'oiashon] kh'ammonand va [mevakh'oiashon] nokh'ammonand ast. [Ei mardum] Az mevai on chun ba bor nishast, bikhured va ruzi chidanash kh'ak'k'i [zakoti benavoion az] onro bipardozed, va [-le] isrof nakuned, [charo ki] be tardid, U isrofkoronro dust namedorad

Va [niz] az chakh'orpoion [kh'aivonoti] borbar va [kh'aivonoti] g'airibori [-ro ofarid]. Az on chi Allokh' taolo ba shumo ruzi dodaast, bikhured va az gomkh'oi shaiton pairavi nakuned. Be gumon, u dushmani oshkore baroi shumost

Kh'asht [ra'si] naru moda [baroi istifodai shumo ofarid] az mesh iak ch'uft va az buz iak ch'uft, [ei paiombar, ba mushrikon] bigu: <<Oio [Allokh' taolo] on du narro kh'arom kardaast io modakh'oro? Io on chi ki rakh'imkh'oi [in] du moda dar bar dorad? Agar rost megued [va bar takh'rimashon dalele dored], az ruii ilm [-u mantik'] ba man khabar dikh'ed

Va az shutur iak ch'uft va az gov iak ch'uft [ofarid].Bigu: <<Oio Allokh' taolo] on du narro kh'arom kardaast io du modaro? Io on chi ki rakh'imkh'oi [in] du moda dar bar dorad? Oio vak'te Allokh' taolo shumoro ba in [takh'rim] suporish mekard, [onch'o] kh'ozir buded? Pas, kist sitamgortar az on ki bar Allokh' taolo durug' mebandad, to biduni kh'ech' [sanadu] ilme mardumro gumrokh' kunad? Ba rosti, ki Allokh' taolo gurukh'i sitamgoronro kh'idoiat namekunad>>

Bigu: <<Dar on chi [az akh'komi ilokh'i, ki] ba man vakh'i shudaast, [g'izoi] kh'aromero, ki khurdanash baroi khurandae kh'arom boshad, nameiobam, magar [gushti] murdor io khuni rekhta io gushti khuk, ki kh'atman, palid [nach'asu kh'arom] ast, io [k'urbonie, ki kh'angomi zabkh'] az ruii nofarmoni, nomi g'airi Allokh' taolo bar on burda boshand>>. Pas, kh'ar ki [baroi kh'ifzi ch'oni khud, ba khurdani onkh'o] nochor shavad, agar sarkash va ziiodakhokh' naboshad [bar u gunokh'e nest]. Ba rosti, ki Parvardigorat omurzandai mekh'rubon ast

Va kh'ar [kh'aivoni] changoldorero bar iakh'udiion kh'arom kardem va az govu gusfand, charbkh'oi on duro bar onon kh'arom kardem, magar charbkh'oe, ki bar pushti onkh'o io davri rudakh'ost io on chi bo ustukhon daromekhtaast. In guna ononro ba sazoi sarkashiiashon much'ozot kardem va be tardid, Mo rostguem
Pas, [ei paiombar] agar turo takzib kardand, bigu: <<Parvardigoraton rakh'mati gusturda dorad, va [-le] azobash az gurukh'i gunakh'koron bozgardonda nakhokh'ad shud>>

Kasone, ki shirk varzidand, khokh'and guft: <<Agar Allokh' taolo mekhost, na mo shirk meovardem va na padaronamon va [kh'amchunin] chizero [khudsarona] takh'rim namekardem>>. Kasone, ki pesh az onon budand, niz kh'amin guna [paiombaroni khudro] takzib kardand, to azobi moro chashand. [Ei paiombar, ba in mushrikon] Bigu: <<Oio [donishu] dalele nazdaton kh'ast, ki baroi Mo oshkor kuned? [Dar kh'ak'ik'at] shumo ch'uz pindor [az chize] pairavi namekuned va ch'uz durug' namegued>>
Bigu: <<Daleli raso va ravshan az oni Allokh' taolost va agar mekhost, kh'amai shumoro kh'idoiat mekard>>

Bigu: <<Guvokh'oni khudro, ki guvokh'i medikh'and, ki Allokh' taolo inkh'oro kh'arom kardaast, biiovared>>. Pas, [kh'atto] agar guvokh'i dodand, tu bo onon [ba chunin durug'e] guvokh'i madekh' va az kh'avaskh'oi kasone, ki oioti Moro durug' shumurdand va kasone, ki ba okhirat imon nameovarand va [ma'budoni botilro] bo Parvardigorashon kh'amto k'aror medikh'and, pairavi nakun

Bigu: <<Biioed on chiro, ki Parvardigoraton bar shumo kh'arom kardaast, baroiaton bikhonam: In ki chizero bo U sharik k'aror nadikh'ed va ba padaru modar neki kuned va farzandoni khudro az [tarsi] tangdasti nakushed. Mo ba shumo va onon ruzi medikh'em va ba korkh'oi zisht, chi oshkor va chi nikh'on, nazdik nashaved va kasero, ki Allokh' taolo [k'atlashro] kh'arom kardaast ch'uz ba kh'ak' nakushed. In ast [on chi Allokh' taolo] shumoro ba [pairavi az] on suporish kardaast, boshad, ki biandeshed

Va ba moli iatim nazdik nashaved, magar ba bekh'tarin shakl [ki ba sudu salokh'i u boshad], to ba sinni [bulug' va] rushdi khud birasad va [sanch'ishi] paimona va tarozuro ba adolat komil kuned.Mo kh'ech' kasero ch'uz ba andozai tavonash mukallaf namesozem va kh'angome ki sukhan megued [io guvokh'i medikh'ed], pas, adolatro rioia kuned, kh'archand, [dar borai] kheshovand boshad va ba akh'du paimoni Allokh' taolo vafo kuned. In ast [on chi Allokh' taolo] shumoro ba [pairavi az] on suporish kardaast, boshad, ki pand gired

Va in ki [ogokh' boshed] in rokh'i rosti Man ast, pas, az on pairavi kuned va az [digar] rokh'kh'o pairavi nakuned, [charo ki] shumoro az rokh'i U ch'udo mesozad. In ast [on chi Allokh' taolo] shumoro ba [pairavi az] on suporish kardaast, boshad, ki parvo kuned

Sipas ba Muso kitob [Tavrot] dodem, to bar kase, ki neki kardaast, ne'matro tamom kunem va baroi on ki [kh'ukmi] kh'ar chizero ba tafsil baion namoem va rakh'namudu rakh'mate gardad, boshad, ki ba didori Parvardigorashon imon biiovarand
Va in [K'ur'on] ki nozil kardem, kitobi purbarakat ast, az on pairavi kuned va parvo namoed, boshad, ki mavridi rakh'mat k'aror gired
[Onro nozil kardem] To nagued: <<Kitob [-i osmoni] tankh'o bar du toifai pesh az mo [ iakh'udiion va masekh'iion] nozil shuda bud va mo az k'iroatu tilovati eshon bekhabar budem>>

Io nagued: <<Agar kitob [-i osmoni] bar mo nozil meshud, az onon rokh'ioftatar budem>>. Pas, be tardid, [in ki] az ch'onibi Parvardigoraton daleli ravshan va kh'idoiat va rakh'mate baroiaton omadaast. Pas, kist sitamgortar az on ki oioti Allokh' taoloro durug' angorad va az on ru bigardonad? Ba zudi kasonero, ki az oioti Mo ru megardonand, ba sazoi on ki [ba kalomi ilokh'i] pusht mekardand, ba azobi sakht [-u dardovar] much'ozot khokh'em kard

Oio [kofiron] intizori ch'uz in dorand, ki farishtagon [-i marg] nazdashon biioiand io Parvardigorat [khud baroi dovari] bioiad io barkhe az nishonakh'oi Parvardigorat [dar mavridi k'iiomat] faro rasad? Ruze, ki barkhe az nishonakh'oi Parvardigorat oshkor gardad, imon ovardani kase, ki peshtar imon naiovarda io bo imonash khaire kh'osil nakarda ast, sude ba kh'olash nadorad. [Ei paiombar, ba mushrikon] Bigu: <<Muntazir boshed. Be gumon mo [niz] muntazirem>>

[Ei paiombar] kasone, ki dini khudro parokanda sokhtand va firk'a-firk'a shudand, be tardid turo bo onon kore nest; onon korashon fak'at bo Allokh' taolost.Ongokh' [Allokh' taolo dar ruzi k'iiomat] az on chi mekardand, ogokh'ashon mesozad
[Dar on ruz] Kh'ar [mu'mine] ki kori neke biovarad, dakh' barobarash [podosh] khokh'ad dosht va kh'ar ki kori bade biovarad, ch'uz monandash kaifar nakhokh'ad did va ba onon sitam nakhokh'ad shud
[Ei paiombar, ba mushrikon] Bigu: <<Be tardid, Parvardigoram maro ba rokh'i rost kh'idoiat kardaast: dini poidor [va] oini Ibrokh'im, ki kh'ak'garo bud va kh'argiz dar zumrai mushrikon nabud>>
Bigu: <<Be tardid, namozam va k'urbonikh'oi man va zindagi va margam kh'ama baroi Allokh' taolo - Parvardigori ch'akh'oniion ast
[Kh'am U ki] Sharike nadorad va ba in [iaktoparasti kholisona] dastur ioftaam va man nakhustin musulmon az in k'avm kh'astam>>

Bigu: <<Oio ba ch'uz Allokh'i mutaol parvardigorero bich'uem va kh'ol on ki U Parvardigori kh'ama chiz ast? Va kh'ech' kase [kori noshoistae] anch'om namedikh'ad, magar on ki [bori gunokh'ash] bar khudi ust va kh'ech' gunakh'gore bori [gunokh'i] digarero ba dush namekashad. Sipas bozgashti [kh'amai] shumo ba suii Parvardigoraton ast. On gokh' [dar ruzi k'iiomat, az kh'ak'ik'ati] on chi dar on ikhtilof doshted, ogokh'aton mesozad

Va Ust, ki shumoro ch'oinishini [peshiniion dar] zamin k'aror dod va darach'oti barkhe az shumoro [dar ofarinish va sarvat] bar barkhi digar bartari dod, to [ba vasilai] on chi ba shumo dodaast, ozmoishaton kunad. Be tardid, Parvardigorat zudkaifar ast va iak'inan U bisior omurzanda [va] mekh'rubon ast
Alif, lom, mim, sod

[Ei paiombar, in K'ur'on] Kitobest, ki bar tu nozil shudaast, pas, naboiad dar sinaat nisbat ba on tardide boshad, [nozil shuda] to bo on [mardumro] bim dikh'i va baroi mu'minon pand [va tazakkure] boshad
[Ei mardum] On chiro az ch'onibi Parvardigoraton bar shumo nozil shudaast, pairavi kuned va az [dustonu] korsozoni digar ba ch'uz U pairavi nakuned, chi andak pand mepazired!
Chi bisior [sokinoni rustokh'o] va shakh'rkh'o, ki nobudashon kardem va azobi Mo shabkh'angom io dar kh'ole ki ba khobi nimruzi furu rafta budand, ba surog'ashon omad
Va chun azobi Mo ba surog'ashon omad, sukhanashon ch'uz in nabud, ki guftand: <<Ba rosti, ki mo [kofiru] sitamgor budem>>

Musallaman, Mo az kasone, ki [paiombaronamon] ba suiashon firistoda shudand, [dar borai pazirishi paiomi kh'ak'] suol khokh'em kard va kh'atman, az paiombaron [niz darborai posukhi ummatkh'oiashon ba da'vati onon] khokh'em pursid
Iak'inan, [kirdori bandagonro] bo ilm [-i khud] baroiashon baion mekunem va mo kh'argiz g'oib [va g'ofil az akh'voli onon] nabudaem
Dar on ruz, vazn [-u me'iori sanch'ishi a'mol, adolat] kh'ak' ast. Pas,onkh'oe, ki vazni a'molashon sangin boshad, ononand, ki rastagorand
Va onkh'oe, ki vazni a'molash sabuk boshad, onon kasone kh'astand, ki ba khesh ziion rasonidaand, charo ki [bo inkori K'ur'on] ba oioti Mo sitam mekardand
Va [ei mardum] ba rosti, ki Mo shumoro dar zamin ch'oi dodem va dar onch'o baroiaton vasoil [-u imkonot]-i zindagi nikh'odem. Chi andak shukr meguzored!

Va be tardid, Mo [nasli] shumoro [dar zamin] padid ovardem, sipas shumoro [ba bekh'tarin kh'olat] shakl dodem, on gokh' ba farishtagon guftem: <<Baroi [buzurgdoshtu ekh'tirom, bar] Odam sach'da kuned>>, pas, [kh'amagi] sach'da kardand, magar iblis, ki az sach'dakunandagon nabud

[Allokh' taolo] Farmud: <<Vak'te ki turo [ba sach'da] farmon dodam, chi chiz moneat shud, ki sach'da kuni>>? [Iblis] Guft: <<Man az u bekh'taram: maro az otash ofaridi va [-le] uro az gil padid ovardi>>
[Allokh' taolo] Farmud: <<Az in [bikh'ishti barin] furud o, [zero] kh'ak'k'i tu nest, ki dar on [makon gardankashi va] takabbur kuni. Pas, berun rav, [ki] be tardid, tu az khorshudagoni>>
[Iblis] Guft: <<To ruze, ki [insonkh'o] barangekhta shavand, maro mukh'lat bidekh' [to firebashon dikh'am]
[Allokh' taolo] Farmud: <<Kh'atman, tu az mukh'latioftagoni>>
[Iblis] guft: <<Pas, ba khotiri on ki maro ba gumrokh'i [va kh'alokat] afkandi, man niz bar sari rokh'i mustak'imi Tu baroi [firebi] onon menishinam
Sipas bar onon, az rubaru va az pushti sar va az tarafi rostu chapashon, darmeoiam va [chunon mekunam] beshtarashro shukurguzor [-i ne'matkh'oi khud] nameiobi>>

[Allokh' taolo] Farmud: <<Az onch'o [bikh'isht] nakukh'ida va rondashuda berun rav. Kh'ar kase az onon, ki az tu pairavi kunad, [dar sipokh'i tust va ruzi k'iiomat] kh'atman, duzakhro az kh'amai shumo pur khokh'am kard

Va, ei Odam, tu va kh'amsarat dar bikh'isht sokin shaved va az [khurdanikh'oi on az] kh'ar ch'oie ki khosted bikhured, va [-le] ba in darakht nazdik nashaved ki az sitamgoroni [nofarmon] khokh'ed bud>>

Pas, shaiton on duro vasvasa kard, to on chi az sharmgokh'ashon ba onon pushida monda bud, bar eshon oshkor sozad [pas, kh'ilae andeshid] va guft: <<Parvardigoraton shumoro az [khurdani mevai] in darakht man' nakard, magar [baroi] on ki [mabodo tabdil ba] du farishta garded io az ch'ovidonon shaved>>
Va baroi on du savgand khurd, ki: <<Man, kh'atman, khairkhokh'aton kh'astam>>

Pas, onkh'oro bo fireb [az mak'omu manzilashon] furud ovard va chun az [mevai] on darakht bichashidand, sharmgokh'ashon bar onon namoion shud va shuru' kardand ba k'aror dodani bargi [darakhtoni] bikh'isht bar [sharmgokh'i] khud.Va Parvardigorashon [inchunin] ba onkh'o nido dod: <<Oio shumoro az [khurdani mevai] on darakht man' nakardam va ba shumo naguftam, ki be tardid, shaiton dushmani oshkori shumost>>?!
[On du] Guftand: <<Parvardigoro, mo [ bo sarpechi az dasturat] ba kheshtan sitam kardaem va agar moro naiomurzi va bar mo rakh'm nakuni, kh'atman, az ziionkoron khokh'em bud>>

[Allokh' taolo] Farmud: <<[Az bikh'isht bar zamin] furud oed, [dar kh'ole ki azin pas] barkhe az shumo dushmani barkhe digared va dar zamin baroiaton to muddat [-i muaiian]-e k'arorgokh' va bakh'ramandi khokh'ad bud>>
[Va] Farmud: <<Dar on zindagi mekuned va dar kh'amon[ch'o] memired va [ruzi k'iiomat niz] az on berun ovarda meshaved>>

Ei farzandoni Odam, kh'amono baroiaton libose furu firistodem, ki sharmgokh'kh'otonro mepushonad va [moiai] zinati shumost va [baroi mu'min] libosi parkh'ezgori bekh'tar ast. In az nishonakh'oi [k'udrati] Allokh' taolost, boshad, ki [insonkh'o] pand girand

Ei farzandoni Odam, [ogokh' boshed, ki] shaiton shumoro nafirebad, chunonchi padaru modaratonro az bikh'isht berun kard va libosashonro az tanashon [berun] kashid, to sharmgokh'ashonro ba onon nishon dikh'ad. Be tardid, u va gurukh'ash az ch'oie, ki onkh'oro namebined, shumoro mebinand. Ba rosti, ki Mo shaiotinro dustoni kasone k'aror dodaem, ki imon nameovarand

Va chun [mushrikon] kori zishte anch'om medikh'and, meguiand: <<Mo niiogoni khudro bar in [kor] ioftaem va Allokh' taolo moro ba [anch'omi] on farmon dodast>>. Bigu: <<Allokh' taolo kh'argiz ba zishtkori farmon namedikh'ad. Oio sukhanero, ki namedoned, ba Allokh' taolo nisbat medikh'ed?>>

[Ei paiombar, ba mushrikon] Bigu: <<Parvardigoram ba adolat farmon dodaast va [inki kh'ama ch'o, ba vizha] dar kh'ar masch'ide [kholisona] ruii kheshro ba suii [k'iblai] U kuned va Uro dar kh'oli [ba duo va niioish] bikhoned ki din [-i khud]-ro baroiash kholis namudaed. [Va bidoned] Kh'amon guna ki shumoro dar og'oz padid ovard, [pas az marg niz bori digar ba suiash] bozmegarded

[Allokh' taolo] Gurukh'ero kh'idoiat kard va bar gurukh' [-i digar]-e gumrokh'i muk'arrar gashtaast; zero onon ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo shaiotinro [ba unvoni] duston [-i khesh] barguzidand va gumon mekardand, ki kh'idoiat ioftaand>>

Ei farzandoni Odam, kh'angomi raftan ba masch'id [va dar kh'ar namoze] zinati khudro bargired [va libosi shoista bipushed] va [dar zindagi, az khurokkh'oi pokiza] bikhured va bioshomed, vale isrof nakuned, [ki] be tardid, Allokh' taolo isrofkunandagonro dust namedorad

[Ei paiombar, ba mushrikon] Bigu: <<Libos [-u zinatkh'o]e-ro ki Allokh' taolo baroi bandagonash padid ovarda va [kh'amchunin] ruzikh'oi pokizaro chi kase kh'arom kardaast?>>. Bigu: <<In [ne'matkh'o] dar zindagii dunio baroi kasonest, ki imon ovardaand, [va agar chi kofiron niz az onkh'o bakh'ramandand] ruzi k'iiomat makhsus [-i mu'minon] khokh'ad bud. Mo inchunin oiot [-i khud]-ro baroi gurukh'e, ki medonand, ba tafsil baion mekunem

Bigu: <<Parvardigoram zishtkorikh'o, chi oshkor [boshad] va chi pinkh'on va gunokh'u sitami nokh'ak'ro kh'arom namudaast va in ki chizero shariki Allokh' taolo bidoned, ki dalele bar [kh'ak'k'oniiati] on nozil nakardaast va inki chizero, ki namedoned, ba Allokh' taolo nisbat dikh'ed
Kh'ar ummate ach'ale dorad.Pas, kh'angome ki ach'alashon ba sar oiad, na lakh'zae [az on] ta'khir mekunand va na [bar on] peshi megirand

Ei farzandoni Odam, agar paiombarone az khudi shumo [nazdaton] bioiand, ki oioti Maro baroiaton bikhonand, [az on pairavi kuned] pas, onon, ki parkh'ezgori namoiand va [raftorkh'oi guzashtaro] islokh' kunand, na tarse khokh'and dosht va na andukh'gin meshavand
Va kasone, ki oioti Moro durug' mepindorand va dar barobarash [gardankashi va] takabbur mevarzand, akh'li duzakhand va ch'ovidona dar on khokh'and mond

Pas, kist sitamgortar az on ki bar Allokh' taolo durug' mebandad io oiotashro durug' mepindorad? Onon kasone kh'astand, ki nasibashon az onchi [dar Lavkh'i makh'fuz] muk'arrar shudaast, ba eshon khokh'ad rasid, to on gokh' ki firistodagoni Mo ba surog'ashon meoiand, ki ch'onashonro bigirand, [ba onon] meguiand: <<Onkh'oe, ki ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo meparastided, kuch'o kh'astand>>? [Onon] Meguiand: <<Az [nazdi] mo gum shudand>>.Va [in guna] alaikh'i khud guvokh'i medikh'and, ki kofir budaand

[Farishtagon] Ba onkh'o meguiand: <<Dar baini gurukh'kh'oe az ch'in va ins, ki pesh az shumo [kofiru gumrokh'] budand, dar otash [-i duzakh] vorid shaved>>. Kh'ar gokh' gurukh'e vorid meshavand, gurukh'i digarro la'nat mekunand, to kh'angome ki [saranch'om] kh'amagi dar onch'o ba kh'am merasand. Pairavoni [firebkhurdai] onkh'o dar borai rakh'baronashon meguiand: <<Parvardigoro, inkh'o budand, ki moro gumrokh' kardand. Pas, azobi duchand az otash ba onon bidekh'>>. [Allokh' taolo] Mefarmoiad: <<Baroi kh'ar kadom [az shumo azobi] duchand ast, vale namedoned>>
Rakh'baroni onkh'o ba pairavonashon meguiand: <<Shumo bar mo kh'ech' imtiioze nadored, pas, ba [kaifari] onchi mekarded, azobro bichashed>>

Kasone, ki oioti Moro durug' angoshtand va dar barobari onkh'o [gardankashi va] takabbur namudand, darkh'oi osmon kh'argiz baroiashon kushoda nameshavad va ba bikh'isht vorid nakhokh'and shud, magar onki shutur az surokhi suzan vorid shavad.Va gunakh'goronro inchunin kaifar medikh'em
Bar eshon bistare az [otashi] duzakh [mukh'aiiost] va [ruiandozashon niz] pushishkh'oe [az otash ast] va sitamgoronro inchunin kaifar medikh'em

Kasone, ki imon ovardaand va korkh'oi shoista kardaand [kh'ar andoza amali nek kardaand, mepazirem, charo ki] va kh'ech' kasro ch'uz ba andozai tavonash mukallaf namesozem. Inon bikh'ishtiiand va dar on ch'ovidon khokh'and bud

Va kh'ar kinaero az sinakh'oiashon mezudoem.Az zeri [k'asrkh'oi] onon ch'uiborkh'o ch'ori ast va meguiand: <<Sipos makhsusi Allokh' taolo ast, ki moro [tavfik'i ibodat dod va] ba in [bikh'isht] kh'idoiat namud.Va agar Allokh' taolo kh'idoiatamon namekard, kh'argiz rokh' nameioftem. Be tardid, firistodagoni Parvardigoramon, ba rosti va durusti omadand>>. [On gokh'] Ba onon nido doda meshavad, ki: <<In bikh'isht ba podoshi on chi mekarded, ba shumo rasidaast>>

Bikh'ishtiion duzakhiionro nido medikh'and, ki: <<Mo on chiro, ki Parvardigoramon ba mo va'da doda bud, durust ioftem. Oio shumo [niz] on chiro, ki Parvardigoraton va'da karda bud, durust iofted?>> Onon meguiand: <<Ore>>. Pas, nidodikh'andae miionashon nido medikh'ad, ki: <<La'nati Allokh' taolo bar sitamgoron [kofiron] bod>>!
[Kh'amon] Kasone, ki [mardumro] az rokh'i Allokh' taolo bozmedoshtand va onro [bo ilk'oi shubakh'ot] munkh'arif mekhostand va okhiratro bovar nadoshtand>>

Dar miioni on du [gurukh': bikh'ishti va duzakhi] mone'e ast va bar a'rof [balandikh'oi on mone'] mardone kh'astand, ki kh'ar iak [az on du gurukh']-ro az [nishonakh'oi] chekh'raashon meshinosand va [az balandii a'rof] akh'li bikh'ishtro nido medikh'and, ki: <<Salom bar shumo bod>>. Inon umedi bikh'isht dorand va kh'anuz ba on vorid nashudaand
Va chun chashmonashon mutavach'ch'ekh'i akh'li duzakh meshavad, meguiand: <<Parvardigoro, moro bo gurukh'i sitamgoron [dar iakch'o] k'aror madekh'>>

Akh'li a'rof mardone [az duzakhiionro], ki ononro az chekh'rakh'oiashon meshinosand, sado mezanand [va] meguiand: <<Ch'am'iiat [-u molanduzi]-i shumo va on [kh'ama] gardankashi [va takabbur]-e, ki mekarded, ba kh'olaton sude nadosht>>

Oio inkh'o [bikh'ishtiion] kh'amon kasone kh'astand, ki savgand iod mekarded, ki Allokh' taolo [kh'argiz] rakh'mate ba onon namerasonad? [Sipas Allokh' taolo mefarmoiad: ei mu'minon] Ba bikh'isht vorid shaved [ki dar onch'o], na tarse khokh'ed dosht va na andukh'gin meshaved

Akh'li duzakh bikh'ishtiionro nido medikh'and, ki: <<Az on ob io onchi Allokh' taolo ruziiaton dodaast, andake moro bakh'ramand sozed>> [Onon dar posukh] Meguiand: <<Allokh' taolo kh'arduro bar kofiron kh'arom kardaast>>

[Kh'amon] Kasone, ki dini khudro ba sargarmi va bozi giriftand va zindagii dunio firebashon dod. Pas, chunon ki onon didori imruzashonro az iod burdand va oioti Moro inkor kardand, Mo [niz] imruz ononro az iod mebarem [va dar azob rakh'o mekunem]
Ba rosti, mo baroiashon kitobe ovardem, ki onro bar [asosi] ilm [-i bekaroni ilokh'i] ba tafsil baion kardaem va [nozil kardem, to] baroi gurukh'e, ki imon meovarand, kh'idoiatu rakh'mate boshad

Oio onon [kofiron] ch'uz ta'vili oiot [va faro rasidani k'iiomat] intizori [digare] dorand? Ruze, ki ta'vilash [k'iiomat] faro rasad, kasone, ki onro peshtar faromush karda budand, meguiand: <<Iak'inan, firistodagoni Parvardigoramon ba kh'ak' omada budand.Pas, oio [imruz] shafoatgarone dorem, ki shafoatamon kunand io [metavonem ba dunio] bozgardem, to korkh'oe g'air az onchi mekardem, anch'om dikh'em>>? Be tardid, [onon] ba khud ziion zadand va onchiro ba durug' [ma'budi khud] mesokhtand, [kh'ama] makh'vu nobud shud

[Ei mardum] Be gumon, Parvardigori shumo Allokh' taolo ast, ki osmonkh'o va zaminro dar shash ruz ofarid, sipas bar Arsh k'aror girift. [Torikii] Shabro bo [rushnoii] ruz mepushonad, ki [kh'ariaki] on [digare]-ro shitobon mech'uiad va khurshedu mokh' va sitoragonro [padid ovard], ki [kh'amagi] ba farmoni U ba khidmat [-iinson] gumoshta shudaand. Ogokh' boshed! Ofarinish va farmonravoi az oni Ust. Purbarakat [-u buzurg] ast Allokh' taoloe, ki Parvardigori ch'akh'oniion ast
[Ei mu'minon] Parvardigoratonro ba zori va pinkh'oni bikhoned, ki U tach'ovuzkunandagon [-i kh'ududi ilokh'i]-ro dust namedorad

Va dar zamin, pas az on ki [bo bi'sati paiombaron va dindorii mu'minon] islokh' gashtaast, fitna va fasod nakuned va U [Allokh' taolo]-ro bo bimu umed bikhoned, [ki] be tardid, rakh'mati Allokh' taolo ba nakukoron nazdik ast

Ust, ki peshopeshi [boroni] rakh'matash bodkh'oro bashoratbakhsh mefiristad, to abrkh'oi sanginborro [bar dush] kashand [va] onro ba suii zamini [khushku] murda mefiristem,on gokh' bar on [sarzamin] ob furu meborem va [az barakati] on [ob] kh'ar guna mevae barmeovarem. Ba in son, murdagonro [niz az k'abr] khorich' mesozem, boshad, ki pand gired

Sarzamini pokiza [va omoda] giiokh'ash ba farmoni Parvardigorash [farovonu purbor] meruiad va az on [shurazore], ki nopok ast, ch'uz [giiokh'i] andaku bearzish nameruiad. In guna oiot [-i khud]-ro baroi gurukh'e, ki sipos meguzorand, gunogun baion mekunem

Be tardid, Mo Nukh'ro ba suii k'avmash firistodem, pas, guft: <<Ei k'avmi man, Allokh' taoloro biparasted, ki ch'uz U ma'bude [ba kh'ak'] nadored. [Agar Uro ibodat nakuned] Man bar shumo az azobi ruzi buzurg metarsam>>
Ashrof [-u buzurgon]-i k'avmash guftand: <<Ba rosti, ki mo turo dar gumrokh'ii oshkor mebinem>>
U guft: <<Ei k'avmi man, kh'ech' guna gumrokh'i [va inkh'irofe] dar man nest, balki man firistodae az [ch'onibi] Parvardigori ch'akh'oniionam
Paiomkh'oi Parvardigoramro ba shumo merasonam va baroiaton khairkhokh'i mekunam va az [shariati] Allokh' taolo chizkh'oe medonam, ki shumo namedoned

Oio taach'ch'ub kardaed, ki pande az ch'onibi Parvardigoraton tavassuti marde az khudi shumo baroiaton omada boshad, to shumoro [az azobi k'iiomat] bim dikh'ad, ki parvo pesha kuned va boshad, ki farogiriftai rakh'mat garded>>?

Pas, vairo durug'gu pindoshtand,on gokh' Mo u va kasone, ki kh'amrokh'ash dar kishti budand, nach'ot dodem va kasone, ki oioti Moro durug' angoshta budand, g'ark' kardem. Ba rosti, ki onon [dar k'abuli kh'ak'] gurukh'i nobino budand.
Va ba [suii k'avmi] Od barodarashon Kh'udro [firistodem]. U guft: <<Ei k'avmi man, Allokh' taoloro biparasted, ki ch'uz U ma'budi [barkh'ak'] nadored. Oio parvo namekuned>>?
Ashrof [-u buzurgon]-i k'avmi u ki kofir budand, guftand: <<Be gumon, mo turo dar nodoni mebinem va mo, kh'atman, turo az durug'guion mepindorem>>
Guft: <<Ei k'avmi man, kh'ech'guna nodonie dar man nest, balki man firistodae az [ch'onibi] Parvardigori ch'akh'oniion kh'astam
Paiomkh'oi Parvardigoramro ba shumo merasonam va man baroiaton khairkhokh'i amin kh'astam

Oio taach'ch'ub kardaed, ki pande az ch'onibi Parvardigoraton tavassuti marde az khudi shumo baroiaton omada boshad, to shumoro [az azobi k'iiomat] bim dikh'ad? Va ba iod ovared, kh'angome ki pas az k'avmi Nukh' shumoro ch'onishinon [-i onon] k'aror dod va ba shumo dar ofarinish fuzuni [va k'udrat] dod. Pas, ne'matkh'oi Allokh' taoloro ba iod ovared, boshad, ki rastagor shaved>>

[Kofiron] Guftand: <<Oio suii mo omadai, ki fak'at Allokh' taoloro biparastem va on chiro padaronamon meparastidand, rakh'o kunem? Pas, agar az rostguioni, on chi [az azobi ilokh'i, ki] ba mo va'da medikh'i biiovar>>

[Kh'ud] guft: <<Be tardid, azob va khashmi [sakht] az [suii] Parvardigoraton bar shumo vok'e' shuda [va shumoro farogirifta] ast. Oio dar borai ismkh'oe, ki khudi shumo va padaronaton onkh'oro [ma'bud] nom nikh'odaed va Allokh' taolo kh'ech' dalele bar [kh'ak'k'oniiati] on nozil nakardaast, bo man much'odala mekuned? Pas, muntazir boshed, [ki] be gumon, man [niz] bo shumo az muntazironam>>
Pas, u va kasonero, ki kh'amrokh'ash budand, ba rakh'mat [va lutfe] az [ch'onibi] khesh nach'ot dodem va reshai kasone, ki oioti Moro durug' angoshtand va az mu'minon nabudand, barandokhtem

Va ba [suii k'avmi] Samud barodarashon Solekh' ro [firistodem] U guft: <<Ei k'avmi man, Allokh' taoloro biparasted, ki ch'uz U ma'bud [-i barkh'ak'] nadored. Be tardid, daleli ravshane az [suii] Parvardigoraton baroi shumo omadaast. In modashuturi Allokh' taolo [ki az dili sakhrakh'o berun omadaast] baroiaton mu'ch'izaest, pas, uro [ba kh'oli khud] voguzored, to dar zamini Allokh' taolo [bicharad va alaf] bikhurad va ba u ozor [-u osebe] narasoned, ki shumoro azobi dardnoke faro khokh'ad girift

Va ba iod ovared, kh'angome ki [Allokh' taolo] shumoro az [k'avmi] Od ch'onishinon [-i onon] k'aror dod va dar zamin mustak'ar sokht, ki dar dashtkh'oiash k'asrkh'oe bino mekuned va dar kukh'kh'o khonakh'oe metaroshed. Pas, ne'matkh'oi Allokh' taoloro ba iod ovared va dar zamin ba fasod [-u tabokh'i] nakushed>>

Ashrof [-u buzurgon]-i k'avmi u, ki gardankashi mekardand, ba zaifonu bechoragon, ba [kh'amon] kasone, ki imon ovarda budand, guftand: <<Oio [ba iak'in] medoned, ki Solekh' az [tarafi] Parvardigorash firistoda shudaast>>? [Onon] Guftand: <<Mo ba on chi u ba on firistoda shudaast, imon dorem>>
Onon, ki gardankashi mekardand, guftand: <<Mo ba onchi shumo ba on imon ovardaed, bovar nadorem>>

Pas, modashuturro pai kardand va az farmoni Parvardigorashon sarpechidand va guftand: <<Ei Solekh', agar az paiombaron [-ilokh'i] kh'asti, onchi az azob, ki ba mo va'da medikh'i, [bar saramon] biiovar>>
Saranch'om zaminlarza ononro faro girift, pas, dar khonakh'oi khud ba ru aftodand [va kh'alok shudand]

Pas, [Solekh'] az onon ru gardonidu guft: <<Ei k'avmi man, man paiomi Parvardigoramro ba shumo rasonidam va baroiaton khairkhokh'i kardam, vale shumo [khairkhokh'onu] nasikh'atgaronro dust namedored>>
Va Lutro [ba paiombari firistodem], ki ba k'avmi khud guft: <<Oio kori bisior zishtero anch'om medikh'ed, ki pesh az shumo kh'ech' iak az ch'akh'oniion anch'om nadodaast?
Shumo az ruii shakh'vat ba ch'oii zanon bo mardon meomezed. Ore, shumo [az kh'ududi ilokh'i farotar raftaed va] gurukh'i tach'ovuzkored>>
Va [-le] posukhi k'avmash ch'uz in nabud, ki guftand: <<Ononro az shakh'raton berun kuned, [charoki] be tardid, inkh'o afrodi pokdoman [-u muk'addasmaob] kh'astand>>
Pas, Mo u va khonadonashro nach'ot dodem, magar kh'amsarash, ki az bozmondagon [dar azob] bud
Va borone [az sang] bar onon boridem. Pas, bingar, ki saranch'omi gunakh'koron chi guna bud

Va ba suii [mardumi] Madian barodarash Shuaibro [firistodem]. U guft: <<Ei k'avmi man, Allokh' taoloro biparasted, ki ch'uz U ma'bud [-i barkh'ak'] nadored. Iak'inan, az [suii] Parvardigoraton baroi shumo daleli ravshan omadaast, pas, [kh'ak'k'i] paimona va tarozuro komil [-u durust] ado kuned va ba mardum ach'nosashonro kam nadikh'ed va dar zamin pas az islokh'ash fasod nakuned. Agar imon dored, in baroi shumo bekh'tar ast

Va bar sari kh'ar rokh'e nanishined, ki [bo zurgiri va duzdi mardumro] bitarsoned va kh'arkiro imon dorad, az rokh'i Allokh' taolo bozdored va rokh'ashro munkh'arif bikhokh'ed [ki ba kh'idoiat dast naiobad]. Va ba iod ovared, kh'angomero ki andak buded, sipas Allokh' taolo [te'dodi] shumoro fuzuni bakhshid va bingared, ki saranch'omi mufsidon [-i tabakh'kor] chi guna bud
Agar gurukh'e az shumo ba onchi ba on firistoda shudaam, imon ovardand va gurukh'i digar imon naovardand, pas, sabr kuned, to Allokh' taolo miioni mo dovari kunad va U bekh'tarin dovar ast>>

Ashrof [-u buzurgon]-i k'avmash, ki takabbur mevarzidand guftand: <<Ei Shuaib, kh'atman, tu va kasonero, ki kh'amrokh'at imon ovardaand, az shakh'ramon berun mekunem, [pas, io biraved] io ba oini mo bargarded>>. [Shuaib] Guft: <<Oio [bozgardem kh'atto] agar az on karokh'at doshta [va bezor] boshem?

Agar ba oini shumo bargardem, pas az on ki Allokh' taolo moro az on nach'ot bakhshid, dar kh'ak'ik'at, ba Allokh' taolo durug' bastaem.Va moro sazovor nest, ki ba on bozgardem, magar on ki Allokh' taolo - Parvardigori mo bikhokh'ad. Ilmi Parvardigoramon kh'ama chizro faro giriftaast.Bar Allokh' taolo tavakkal kardaem. Parvardigoro, miioni mo va k'avmamon ba kh'ak' dovari kun va Tu bekh'tarin dovari>>
Va ashrof [-u buzurgon]-i k'avmash, ki kofir budand, guftand: <<Agar az Shuaib pairavi kuned, kh'atman, ziionkor khokh'ed bud>>
On gokh' zilzila [-i shadid]-e ononro faro girift, pas, dar khonakh'oi khud ba ru daraftodand [va kh'alok shudand]
Onon, ki Shuaibro durug'gu angoshtand, [chunon az bain raftand ki] gui kh'argiz dar on [diior] nabudaand va onon ki Shuaibro durug'gu angoshtand, khud ziionkoron budand

Pas, [Shuaib] az eshon rui gardondu guft: <<Ei k'avmi man, be tardid paiomkh'oi Parvardigoramro ba shumo rasondam va pandaton dodam. Pas, chiguna baroi gurukh'i kofir [-i lach'uch'] andukh'gin bosham>>?
Va mo dar kh'ech' shakh'r [va diiore] paiombare nafiristodem, magar inki sokinonashro ba ranch'kh'o va sakhtikh'o giriftor sokhtem, boshad, ki [ba dargokh'i ilokh'i furutani va] tazarru' kunand

Sipas ba ch'oii nokhushi [va badi] neki [va khushi] ovardem, to afzun shudand va guftand: <<Be tardid, ba padaroni mo [niz ba kh'ukmi tabiat] sakhti va rokh'ate merasid>>. Pas, dar kh'ole ki bekhabar budand, ononro [ba azob] faro giriftem

Va agar akh'li on shakh'rkh'o imon meovardand va parvo mekardand, [darkh'oi] barakati osmon va zaminro bar onon mekushodem, vale [oiotu paiomkh'oi Moro] durug' angoshtaand, pas, ba [kaifari] onchi mekardand, ononro [ba azob] faro giriftem
Oio sokinoni [in] shakh'rkh'o dar amonand az inki azobi Mo [nogakh'on] shabkh'angom, ki khuftaand ba surog'ashon bioiad?
Va oio sokinoni [in] shakh'rkh'o dar amonand az in ki azobi Mo nimruzi, ki ba bozi [va umuri bekh'uda] sargarmand, ba surog'ashon bioiad?
Oio khudro az makr [-u tadbir]-i Allokh' taolo emin donistaand? [Kh'ol on ki] Ch'uz mardumi ziionkor [kase] khudro az makri Allokh' taolo dar amon namedonad

Oio baroi kasone, ki zaminro pas az sokinoni [peshini] on ba irs mebarand, ravshan nashudaast, ki agar mekhostem, ononro ba [kaifari] gunokh'onashon nobud mekardem va ba dilkh'oiashon mukh'r menikh'odem, to digar [nidoi kh'ak'ro] nashnavand?

[Ei paiombar] Inkh'o shakh'rkh'oest, ki barkhe az khabarkh'oiashonro bar tu kh'ikoiat mekunem. Be tardid, paiombaroni onkh'o daloili ravshan baroi eshon ovardand, vale onon namekhostand ba chize, ki peshtar durug' shumurda budand, imon ovarand. Allokh' taolo bar dilkh'oi kofiron, in guna mukh'r [-i g'aflat] menikh'ad
Va dar beshtarashon vafoe ba akh'd naioftem va aksarashonro ch'iddan nofarmon ioftem
Sipas ba'd az onkh'o Musoro bo oioti khesh ba suii Fir'avn va buzurgoni k'avmash firistodem, vale onkh'o ba on [oiot] kufr varzidand.Pas, bingar, ki saranch'omi tabakh'koron chiguna budaast
Va Muso guft: <<Ei Fir'avn, man firistodae az [suii] Parvardigori ch'akh'oniionam

Sazovorast, ki dar mavridi Allokh' taolo ch'uz [ba rosti va] kh'ak' sukhan naguem. Be tardid, man dalel [va mu'ch'izai ravshan] az Parvardigoraton baroi shumo ovardaam.Pas,Bani Isroilro kh'amrokh'i man bifirist>>
[Fir'avn] Guft: <<Agar mu'ch'izae ovardai, [va] agar rost megui, onro biiovar>>
Pas, [Muso] asoi khudro andokht va nogakh'on [aso tabdil ba] azhdakh'oi oshkor shud
Va dasti khudro [az girebon] berun ovard va nogakh'on baroi tamoshogaron saped [-u durakhshon] menamud
Ashrof [-u buzurgoni] k'avmi Fir'avn guftand: <<Kh'ak'k'o, ki in [mard] ch'odugari donost>>
Fir'avn] Guft: <<U mekhokh'ad shumoro az sarzaminaton berun kunad pas nazaraton chist>>?
Onon guftand: <<Kori u va barodarashro ba ta'khir biandoz va ma'muroni ch'am'ovariro ba [kh'amai] shakh'rkh'o bifirist
To kh'amai ch'odugaroni dono [va mokh'ir]-ro nazdat ovarand
Va [saranch'om] ch'odugaron nazdi Fir'avn omadand, [va] guftand: <<Agar mo piruz shavem, [nazdi tu] podoshe khokh'em dosht>>?
[Fir'avn] Guft: <<Ore, kh'atman, shumo az muk'arrabon [-i dargokh'am] khokh'ed bud>>
[Dar ruzi mav'ud ch'odugaron mag'rurona] Guftand: <<Ei Muso, io tu nakhust [asoi khudro] biafkan io mo [abzori khudro] meafkanem>>
[Muso] Guft: <<Shumo biafkaned>>. Kh'angome ki [abzori khudro] afkandand, chashmoni mardumro afsun kardand va ononro sakht tarsondand va ch'odui buzurg [padid] ovardand
Va [mo] ba Muso vakh'i kardem, ki: <<Asoi khudro biafkan>>. Pas, nogakh'on on [aso ba mori buzurge tabdil shud va] onchiro, ki ba durug' sokhta budand, furu bal'id
Pas, kh'ak'ik'at oshkor gardid va on chi mekardand, botil shud
Va [Fir'avnu fir'avniion kh'amagi dar] onch'o shikast khurdand va khor gardidand
Va ch'odugaron ba sach'da aftodand
Guftand: <<Ba Parvardigori ch'akh'oniion imon ovardem
Parvardigori Muso va Kh'orun>>

Fir'avn guft: <<Pesh az onki ba shumo ich'ozat dikh'am, ba u imon ovarded? Kh'atman, in nairangest, ki dar shakh'r ba rokh' andokhtaed, to sokinonashro az on berun kuned. Pas, ba zudi [natich'ai koratonro] khokh'ed donist
Iak'inan, dastu poiatonro barkhilofi iakdigar [az chapu rost] k'at' mekunam va kh'amai shumoro ba dor meovezam>>
Onon guftand: <<Be tardid, mo [pas az marg] ba suii Parvardigoramon bozmegardem

Va [ei Fir'avn] tu ch'uz baroi in moro ba kaifar namerasoni, ki ba mu'ch'izoti Parvardigoramon on gokh' ki ba mo rasid, imon ovardem. Parvardigoro, bar mo shikeboi [va istik'omat] bibor va moro dar kh'ole bimiron ki taslimi [farmoni tu] kh'astem>>

Va buzurgoni k'avmi Fir'avn [ba u] guftand: <<Oio Muso va k'avmashro rakh'o mekuni, to dar in sarzamin fasod kunand va tu va ma'budonatro voguzorad>>? [Fir'avn] Guft: <<[Kh'argiz, balki] Pisaronashonro khokh'em kusht va zanonashonro [baroi kanizi] zinda khokh'em guzosht va mo bar onon chiraem>>

Muso ba k'avmash guft: <<Az Allokh' taolo iori bich'ued va shikeboi [va istik'omat] pesha kuned. Be tardid, zamin az oni Allokh' taolo ast [va] onro ba kh'ar kase az bandagonash, ki bikhokh'ad, ba meros medikh'ad va saranch'omi nek az oni parkh'ezgoron ast>>

[Bani Isroil] Guftand: <<Pesh az on ki nazdi mo biioi va [kh'atto] pas az on ki nazdi mo omadi, [az sitamkh'oi Fir'avn] ozoru aziiat didaem>> [Muso] guft: <<Umedast, ki Parvardigori shumo dushmanatonro kh'alok kunad va shumoro dar zamin ch'onishin [-i onon] sozad,on gokh' bingarad, ki chiguna raftor mekuned>>
Va be tardid, Mo fir'avniionro ba khushksoli va kambudi makh'sulot duchor kardem, boshad, ki pand girand [va tavba kunand]

Pas, kh'angome ki neki [va farovonii ne'mat] ba onon merasid, meguftand: <<In ba khotiri [shoistagii] khudi most>>. Va agar badi [va khushksoli] ba eshon merasid, ba Muso va kasone, ki kh'amrokh'ash budand, foli bad mezadand. Ogokh' boshed! Sarnavishti shumi onon tankh'o nazdi Allokh' taolo [va ba dasti U] ast, ammo beshtarashon namedonand
Va [pairavoni Fir'avn ba u] guftand: <<Kh'ar [mu'ch'iza va] nishonae baroiamon biiovari, to bo on ch'oduiamon kuni, [kh'argiz] ba tu imon nameovarem>>

Pas, bar onon [balokh'oe kh'amchun] tufon va malakh va shapush va k'urbok'akh'o va [rudi pur]-i khun firistodem, [ki] nishonakh'oi ch'udo [az kh'am va paiopaie] budand.Pas, [boz kh'am] gardankashi kardand va gurukh'i gunakh'kor budand

Va kh'angome ki azob bar onon vok'e' shud, guftand: <<Ei Muso, az Parvardigorat baroi mo bikhokh', ki bino ba paimone, ki bo tu dorad, [tavbai moro bipazirad va in balokh'oero k'at' kunad] Agar in azobro az mo bardori, kh'atman, ba tu imon meovarem va Bani Isroilro kh'amrokh'at ravona mekunem>>
Pas, kh'angome ki azobro to muddati muaiiane, ki [pesh az kh'alokat] fursat doshtand az onon dur kardem, boz kh'am paimonshikani kardand
Pas az onon intik'om giriftem va dar dario g'ark'ashon sokhtem, zero oiot [-u mu'ch'izoti] Moro durug' meangoshtand va az on g'ofil budand

Va ba on gurukh'e, ki kh'amvora mavridi sitam vok'e' meshudand, [bakhshkh'oi] shark'i va g'arbii sarzamin [-i Shom]-ro, ki ba on barakat bakhshida budem, ba meros ato kardem va ba podoshi on ki shikeboi kardand, va'dai nekui Parvardigorat ba Bani Isroil [iorii sitamdidagon] takh'ak'k'uk' ioft va on chiro, ki Fir'avn va k'avmash mesokhtand va barmeafroshtand, [iaksara] vairon kardem

Va Bani Isroilro az dario guzarondem, pas, [dar rokh'] ba k'avme rasidand, ki baroi [parastishi] butkh'oiashon gird omada budand, [pas, onon niz] guftand: <<Ei Muso, kh'amonguna ki onon ma'budone dorand, baroi mo [niz] ma'bude ta'iin kun>>. [Muso] Guft: <<Be tardid, shumo gurukh'e kh'asted, ki nodoni mekuned [va azamati Allokh' taoloro namedoned]
Iak'inan, oini [mushrikonai] inkh'o nobudshudani ast va onchi mekunand, [niz] botil ast>>
[Sipas] Guft: <<Oio ba ch'uz Allokh' taolo ma'budi [digar] baroiaton bich'uiam, dar kh'ole ki U shumoro bar ch'akh'oniion [-i kh'amasraton] bartari dodaast>>?

Va [ba iod ovared] zamone, ki shumoro az [osebi] fir'avniion nach'ot dodem, [ki] badtarin [va khortarin] azobro bar saraton meovardand: pisaronatonro mekushtand va zanonatonro [baroi kanizi] zinda nigakh' medoshtand va baroi shumo dar in [azobu nach'ot] ozmoishi buzurg az ch'onibi Parvardigoraton bud

Va bo Muso si shab [baroi munoch'ot] va'da nikh'odem va onro bo dakh' shab [-i digar] komil kardem.Pas, va'dai Parvardigorash [bo u] dar chikh'il shab tamom shud. Va Muso [kh'angomi raftan ba kukh'i Tur] ba barodarash Kh'orun guft: <<Ch'oinishini man dar miioni k'avm bosh va [umurashonro] islokh' kun va az rokh'i mufsidon pairavi nakun>>

Va kh'angome ki Muso ba akh'dgokh'i Mo omad va Parvardigorash [bevosita] bo u sukhan guft, [Muso] arz kard: <<Parvardirgoro, khudro ba man nishon bidekh', to ba Tu bingaram>>. [Allokh' taolo] Farmud: <<[Dar dunio] kh'argiz Maro nakhokh'i did, vale ba in kukh' bingar, agar dar ch'oii khud bark'aror bok'i monad, tu [niz] Moro khokh'i did>>. Pas, chun Parvardigorash bar [on] kukh' tach'alli kard, onro mutaloshi [va parokanda] sokht va Muso madkh'ush aftod va chun ba kh'ush omad, arz kard: <<[Bor ilokh'o] Tu poku munazzakh'i. Ba dargokh'at tavba kardam va be tardid, man [miioni k'avmi khud] nakhustin mu'min kh'astam>>
[Allokh' taolo] farmud: <<Ei Muso, [bidon ki] man turo ba paiomkh'o va kalomi [bevositai] khesh bar mardumon barguzidam, onchi ba tu mebakhsham, bigir va siposguzor bosh>>

Va dar alvokh' [Tavrot] baroi u dar kh'ar mavride pande [ovardem] va baroi kh'ar amre sharkh'e nigoshtem [va ba Muso farmudem]: <<Onro bo ch'iddiiat bigir va ba k'avmat dastur bidekh', ki nekutarini onkh'oro faro girand [va ba on amal kunand] va ba zudi [ch'oigokh'u] saroi nofarmononro ba shumo nishon khokh'am dod>>

Ba zudi kasonero ki ba nokh'ak' dar zamin [bartarich'ui va] takabbur mekunand, az [fakh'mi] oioti khesh bozkhokh'am dosht, [chunon ki] agar kh'ar nishonae [az k'udratam]-ro bingarand, ba on imon naovarand va agar rokh'i kh'ak'ro bubinand, onro dar pesh nagirand va agar rokh'i gumrokh'iro bubinand onro barguzinand. In [much'ozot] baroi on ast, ki oioti Moro durug' angoshtand va az onkh'o g'ofil budand
Va kasone, ki oioti Mo va didori okhiratro durug' angoshtand, korkh'oiashon tabokh' gashtaast. Oio ch'uz [dar barobari] onchi mekardand, much'ozot meshavand?

Va k'avmi Muso pas az [raftani] u [ba kukh'i Tur] az zevarkh'oiashon much'assamai gusolaero sokhtand [va parastidand], ki sadoe [kh'amchun sadoi gusola] dosht. Oio namedidand, ki [on paikari bech'on] bo onon sukhan nameguiad va ba rokh'e kh'idoiatashon namekunad? Onro [ba parastish] giriftand va [ba khotiri in shirk nisbat ba khesh] sitamgor budand
Va chun [az kardai khesh] pushaimon shudand va didand, ki ba rosti, gumrokh' shudaand, guftand: <<Agar Parvardigoramon ba mo rakh'm nakunad va moro naomurzad, musallaman, ziionkor khokh'em bud>>

Va chun Muso ba suii k'avmash bozgasht [va ononro bar shirk va gumrokh'i ioft], bo khashmu andukh' guft: <<Pas az man chi bad ch'onishini karded! Oio az kh'ukmi Parvardigoraton peshi girifted>>? Va [on gokh'] alvokh'ro andokht va [rishu muii] sari barodari khudro girift va ba suii khud kashid. [Kh'orun] Guft: <<Ei pisari modaram, ba rosti, in k'avm maro notavon pindoshtand [va takh'k'iram kardand] va nazdik bud maro bikushand, pas, dushmanonro bo [sarzanishi] man shodmon nakun va maro dar zumrai gurukh'i sitamgor [-u nofarmon] k'aror nadekh'>>
[Muso] Guft: <<Parvardigoro, man va barodaramro biiomurz va moro dar [panokh'i] rakh'mati khesh darovar.Va Tu mekh'rubontarin mekh'ruboni>>
Be tardid, kasone, ki gusolaro [ba parastish] giriftand, ba zudi khashme az Parvardigorashon va zillate dar zindagii dunio ba onon khokh'ad rasid va mo durug'pardozonro inchunin kaifar medikh'em
Va kasone, ki murtakibi korkh'oi noshoista [kufru gunokh'] shudand, sipas ba'd az on tavba namudand va imon ovardand, be gumon, Parvardigorat az on pas omurzandai mekh'rubon ast
Va chun khashmi Muso furu nishast, alvokh' [-i Tavrot]-ro bargirift va dar navishtakh'oiash baroi kasone, ki az Parvardigorashon metarsand, kh'idoiatu rakh'mati [buzurg] bud

Va Muso az k'avmash kh'aftod mardro baroi va'dagokh'i Mo [dar Turi Sino] barguzid [to ba khotiri shirku gunokh'i k'avmashon ba dargokh'i ilokh'i tavba kunand]. Pas, kh'angome ki [ba daleli nofarmoni va darkhosti ru'iati Allokh' taolo] zilzila ononro faro girift [va kh'amagi murdand, Muso] guft: <<Parvardigoro, agar mekhosti, onon va maro pesh az in kh'alok mekardi. Oio moro ba khotiri onchi bekhiradonamon kardaand, kh'alok mekuni? In [azob chize] nest, magar ozmoishi Tu [az imoni mo], ba [vasilai] on kh'arkiro bikhokh'i, gumrokh' mesozi va kh'arkiro bikhokh'i, kh'idoiat mekuni. Tu [dustu] korsozi moi, pas, moro biiomurz va bar mo rakh'm ovar va Tu bekh'tarin omurzandai

Va baroiamon dar in dunio va dar saroi okhirat neki muk'arrar farmo, [ki] be tardid, mo ba suii Tu bozgashtem>>. [Allokh' taolo] Farmud: <<Azobamro ba kh'ar ki bikhokh'am merasonam va rakh'matam kh'ama chizro faro giriftaast, pas, onro baroi kasone muk'arrar khokh'am dosht, ki parvo pesha mekunand va zakot medikh'and va [kh'amchunin] baroi kasone, ki ba oioti mo imon meovarand

Kasone, ki az firistoda va paiombari darsnokhonda [ummi] pairavi mekunand, [kh'amon] ki nom [va nishonakh'oi] uro nazdi khud dar Tavrotu Inch'il navishta meioband, [kh'am u] ki ononro ba nekikh'o farmon medikh'ad va az zishtikh'o [va korkh'oi nopisand] bozashon medorad va pokizakh'oro baroiashon kh'alol megardonad va palidikh'oro ba onon kh'arom mekunad va bori garoni [takolifi shar'i]-ro, ki bar eshon budaast, az [ukh'dai] onon barmedorad. Pas, kasone, ki ba U imon ovardand va giromiiash doshtand va ioriash kardand va az nure, ki bo u nozil shudaast, pairavi namudand, ononand, ki rastagorand>>

Bigu: <<Ei mardum, man firistodai Allokh' taolo ba suii kh'amai shumo kh'astam.Kh'amon [Parvardigore], ki farmonravoii osmonkh'o va zamin az oni Ust, ma'bude [barkh'ak'] ch'uz U nest; zinda mekunad va memironad, pas, ba Allokh' taolo va firistodaash - on paiombari darsnokhondae, ki ba Allokh' taolo va sukhanonash bovar dorad, imon biiovared va az U pairavi kuned, boshad, ki kh'idoiat shaved>>
Va gurukh'e az k'avmi Muso kh'astand, ki [mardumro] ba [rokh'i] kh'ak' kh'idoiat mekunand va bar asosi on [niz k'azovat va] adolat mekunand

Va ononro ba duvozdakh' k'abila [ki kh'ar kadom] shokhae az navodagon [-i Ia'k'ub] budand, tak'sim kardem va ba Muso,on gokh' ki k'avmash az u ob khostand, vakh'i kardem, ki: <<Asoiatro bar sang bizan>>, pas, duvozdakh' chashmae az on ch'ushid [va] kh'ar gurukh'e chashmai khudro shinokht va abrro bar [sari] onon soiagustar namudem va bar eshon mannu salvo furu firistodem [va guft] <<Az chizkh'oi pokizae, ki ruziiaton kardaem, bikhured>>. Onon [bo nofarmoni va mukholifat, dar kh'ak'ik'at] ba Mo sitam nakardand, balki ba kheshtan sitam menamudand

Va [iod kun az] on gokh' ki ba onon gufta shud: <<Dar in shakh'r [Baitu-l-muk'addas] sokin shaved va [az ne'matkh'oi] on, az kh'ar ch'o [va kh'ar vak't], ki khosted, bikhured va [baroi uzrkhokh'i] bigued: <<[Parvardigoro] Gunokh'onamonro furu rez>> va bo furutani az darvoza[-i shakh'r] vorid shaved, to gunokh'onatonro biiomurzem, [va podoshi dunio va okhirati] nakukoronro khokh'em afzud>>

Ammo afrode az onkh'o, ki [nofarmonu] sitamgor budand, sukhanro ba chize g'air az onchi ki ba onon gufta shuda bud, tabdil kardand [va bach'oi istig'for donai ch'av khostand]. Pas, ba [kaifari] onki sitam mekardand, azobe az osmon bar onon furu firistodem

Va [ei paiombar] az onon dar borai [sokinoni] shakh're, ki nazdiki dario bud, bipurs, kh'angome ki onon az [kh'ukmi takh'rimi said dar ruzi] shanbe tach'ovuz mekardand, on gokh' ki mokh'ikh'oi eshon dar ruzkh'oi shanbe [ki ruzi ta'tilu ibodat bud] ruii ob zokh'ir meshudand va ruzkh'oi g'airi shanbe bar eshon [kh'ech' saide ruii ob] nameomad. Ononro ba [khotiri] on ki nofarmoni mekardand, inchunin ozmudem

Va [iod kun az] kh'angome ki gurukh'e az onon [ba gurukh'i digar] guftand: <<Charo k'avmero pand medikh'ed, [ki saranch'om] Allokh' taolo kh'alokashon khokh'ad kard io ba azobi shadid giriftorashon khokh'ad namud>>? [Nosekh'on] Guftand: <<In [pandu nakh'i dar kh'ukmi] ma'zarate ba dargokh'i Parvardigori shumost va boshad, ki parvo kunand>>

Pas, chun onchiro ba eshon pand doda budand, ba faromushi supurdand, kasonero, ki az [kori] bad bozmedoshtand, nach'ot dodem va kasonero, ki [bo nodida giriftani kh'ukmi ilokh'i ba khud] sitam karda budand, ba sazoi onki nofarmoni mekardand, ba azobi shadid giriftor namudem
Va chun dar barobari onchi az on nakh'i shuda budand, [lach'och'atu] sarpechi kardand, ba onon guftem: <<Ba surati buzinakh'oe [khoru] rondashuda daroed>>

Va [iod kun az] kh'angome ki Parvardigorat farmud, ki iak'inan, to ruzi k'iiomat, kasero bar onon khokh'ad gumosht, ki kh'amvora badtarin [va sangintarin] azoro ba sarashon biiovarad. Be gumon, Parvardigorat zudkaifar ast, [va-le] iak'inan, U omurzandai mekh'rubon ast

Va ononro dar zamin ba surati gurukh'kh'oi mukhtalif parokanda sokhtem. [Barkhe] Az onon shoistaand va [barkhe miionarav kh'astand va gurukh'e niz] g'air az inand. Va ononro ba nekikh'o va badikh'o ozmudem, boshad, ki [ba rokh'i kh'ak'] boz gardand

Va pas az onon ch'onishinon [-i noshoista]-e omadand, ki kitob [Tavrot]-ro ba irs burdand. Onon [sarvatu] koloi in [dunioi] pastro megirand, [ki sukhanoni Allokh' taoloro takh'rifu ba nokh'ak' kh'ukm kunand] va meguiand: <<Bakhshida khokh'em shud>>. Va agar kolo [-i digar]-e kh'ammonandi on baroiashon bioiad, onro [niz] megirand. Oio dar kitob [-i osmoni] az onon paimon girifta nashudaast, ki dar borai Allokh' taolo ch'uz [sukhani] kh'ak' naguiand? [Pas, nofarmoniiashon az ruii nodoni nest, zero borkh'o Tavrotro khondaand] Va onchiro, ki dar on ast, omukhtaand va saroi okhirat baroi kasone, ki parvo kunand, bekh'tar ast. Oio nameandeshed?
Va kasone, ki ba kitobi [Allokh' taolo] tamassuk mech'uiand va namoz barpo medorand, ba iak'in [bidonand, ki] Mo podoshi nakukoronro tabokh' namekunem

Va [iod kun az] kh'angome ki kukh'ro [az ch'oi barkandem va] kh'amchun soiabone bar farozashon barafroshtem va pindoshtand, ki bar onon furud meoiad [va dar in kh'olat az onon akh'd giriftem va guftem] <<On chiro, ki ba shumo dodaem, bo neru [va ch'iddiiat] bigired va onchiro, ki dar on ast, ba iod doshta boshed [va ba on amal namoed], boshad, ki parvo kuned

Va [iod kun az] kh'angome ki Parvardigorat az pushti farzandoni Odam, naslashonro bargirift va ononro bar khudashon guvokh' girift [va farmud]: <<Oio man Parvardigori shumo nestam>>? Onon guftand: <<Ore, [bar in kh'ak'ik'at] guvokh'i medikh'em>>. [Allokh' taolo farmud: <<Az shumo ik'ror giriftam] To mabodo ruzi k'iiomat bigued, ki: <<Mo, kh'atman, az in [amr] bekhabar budem>>
Io [mabodo] bigued, ki padaronamon peshtar shirk ovarda budand va mo niz farzandone pas az onon budem. Oio moro ba [sazoi] onchi [kofironu] botilandeshon anch'om dodaand, kh'alok mekuni>>?
Va inchunin oiotro ba tafsil baion mekunem [to onkh'oro bifakh'mand] va boshad, ki [ba tavkh'id] bozgardand

Va [ei paiombar] sarguzashti kasero bar onon kh'ikoiat kun, ki oiot [-u nishonakh'o]-i kheshro ba u dodem va [u kh'ak'k'oniiatashonro dark kard, vale] az onkh'o ch'udo [va ori] gasht.Pas, shaiton ba dunbolash aftod va u az gumrokh'on shud

Va agar mekhostem, [mak'omu manzalati] uro ba khotiri [poibandi va amal ba] on [oiot] bolo meburdem, vale u ba dunio [va pasti] garoid va az kh'avoi nafsi khesh pairavi kard. Pas, masali u [dar duniodusti] kh'amchun masali sag ast, ki agar ba on kh'amla kuni [va az khud dur kuni], zabon az dakh'on berun meovarad va agar onro [ba kh'oli khud] voguzori, [boz kh'am] zabon az dakh'on berun meovarad [chunin shakhsero niz chi pand bidikh'i io nadikh'i, tafovute nadorad]. In masali gurukh'est, ki oioti Moro durug' angoshtand, pas, in dostonro [bar eshon] kh'ikoiat kun, boshad, ki biiandeshand
Chi zisht ast dostoni gurukh'e, ki oioti Moro durug' angoshtand va ba khesh sitam kardand!
Kasero, ki Allokh' taolo kh'idoiat kunad, pas, u kh'idoiatiofta [-i vok'ei] ast va kasero, ki gumrokh' sozad, pas, ononand, ki ziiondidagonand

Va be tardid, bisiore az ch'inniion va odamiionro baroi duzakh ofaridaem, [charo ki] dilkh'oe dorand, ki bo onkh'o [kh'ak'oik'ro] dark namekunand va chashmone dorand, ki bo onkh'o [nishonakh'oi tavonu tadbiri ilokh'iro] namebinand va gushkh'oe dorand, ki bo onkh'o [sukhanoni kh'ak'ro] nameshunavand. Onon kh'amchun chakh'orpoionand, balki [az onkh'o kh'am] gumrokh'tarand. [Ore] Ononand,ki [az okhirat] g'ofiland

Va zebotarin nomkh'o baroi Allokh' taolo ast, pas, Uro ba on [nomkh'o] bikhoned va kasonero, ki dar [mavridi] nomkh'oiash ba inkh'irof meravand [va onkh'oro ta'vilu takh'rif mekunand] rakh'o kuned. Onon ba [sazoi] onchi mekardand, much'ozot khokh'and shud
Va az [miioni] onon, ki ofaridaem, gurukh'e kh'astand, ki [mardum] bakh'ak' kh'idoiat menamoiand va bar [asosi] on ba adolat raftor mekunand

Va kasone, ki oioti Moro durug' angoshtand, [darkh'oi ruziro ba ruiashon mekushoem, to beshtar dar gunokh' g'ark' shavand va ba in son] andak andak az ch'oie, ki namedonand [ba kaifari khud] giriftorashon khokh'em sokht
Va ba onon mukh'lat medikh'am. Ba rosti, ki tadbiri Man ustuvor [va kh'isobshuda] ast
Oio naandeshidaand, ki kh'amnishini onon [rasulullokh'] kh'ech' ch'unune nadorad? U ch'uz bimdikh'andai oshkor nest
