Oio dar farmonravoii osmonkh'o va zamin va onchi Allokh' taolo ofaridaast, namenigarand va inki chi baso kh'angomi margashon nazdik shuda boshad? Pas, ba'd az in [K'ur'on] ba kadom sukhan imon meovarand?
Kh'ar kiro Allokh' taolo gumrokh' kunad, pas, [kh'ech'] rokh'namoe baroiash nest va ononro dar sarkashii khesh sargardon rakh'o mekunad

[Ei paiombar, kofironi Makka] dar borai k'iiomat az tu mepursand, [ki] kai vok'e' meshavad? Bigu: <<Be tardid, donishi on nazdi Parvardigori man ast va kh'ech' kas ch'uz U [nametavonad] onro dar vak'ti muaiianash padidor sozad.In amr [zukh'uri k'iiomat] bar akh'li osmonkh'o va zamin dushvor ast va ch'uz ba tavri nogakh'oni ba suiaton nameoiad>>. [Onon chunon] Az tu mepursand, ki guio tu khud mushtok'i [donistani zamoni] on kh'asti [kh'ol on ki tu dar borai zamoni vuk'uash kh'ech' namepursi]. Bigu: <<Donishi on fak'at nazdi Allokh' taolo ast, vale beshtari mardum namedonand>>

[Ei paiombar] Bigu: <<Man moliki sudu ziioni kheshtan nestam, magar onchiro, ki Allokh' taolo bikhokh'ad va agar g'aibro medonistam, khair [-u sudi] bisiore [baroi khud] farokh'am mesokhtam va kh'ech' badi [va ziione] ba man namerasid. Man [kase] nestam, magar bimdikh'anda va bashoratbakhsh [-i dilsuz] baroi gurukh'e, ki imon dorand

[Ei mardum] Ust, ki shumoro az iak tan ofarid va kh'amsarashro az u padid ovard, to dar kanorash orom girad. Pas, chun [Odam] bo vai [Kh'avo] daromekht, bordor shud - bori sabuk - va [nakhustin mokh'kh'oi bordoriro] guzarond va chun sanginbor shud, Allokh' taolo - Parvardigori khudro khondand, ki: <<Agar ba mo [farzandi tandurustu] shoista ato kuni, kh'atman, siposguzor khokh'em bud>>

Pas, chun [Allokh' taolo farzandi tandurust va] shoista ba onon dod, dar in ne'mat, ki ba onkh'o bakhshida bud, baroiash sharikone k'aror dodand. Va Allokh' taolo az onchi sharik [va kh'amtoi] U mesozand, bartar ast
Oio chizkh'oero sharik megirand, ki chize nameofarand va khud ofarida meshavand?
Va nametavonand ononro iori kunand va na kheshtanro iori medikh'and
Va [ei mushrikon] agar onkh'o [butkh'o]-ro ba kh'idoiat da'vat kuned, az shumo pairavi namekunand. Chi da'vatashon kuned io khomush boshed, baroiaton iakson ast [va posukhe nakhokh'ed shunid]

Be gumon, onkh'oe, ki ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo mekhoned, ofaridagone kh'amchun shumo kh'astand [ammo ch'omid va berukh'], pas, onkh'oro [dar sakhtikh'o] bikhoned. Agar rost megued, boiad posukhatonro bidikh'and

Oio [butkh'oe, ki ma'budi khud medoned] poikh'oe dorand, ki bo onkh'o rokh' biravand io dastkh'oe dorand, ki bo onkh'o [ioriaton dikh'and va az shumo] difo' kunand? Oio chashmone dorand, ki bo onkh'o bubinand io gushkh'oe dorand, ki bo onkh'o bishnavand? [Ei paiombar, ba mushrikon] Bigu: <<Sharikonatonro bikhoned, sipas [alaikh'i man] tadbir [-u nairang] kuned va maro mukh'lat nadikh'ed
Be tardid, [dustu] korsozi man Allokh' taolo ast, ki [in] kitobro nozil kardaast va U baroi shoistagon [dusti va] korsozi mekunad
Va kasonero, ki [shumo mushrikon] ba ch'oii U mekhoned, nametavonand shumoro iori kunand va na ba kheshtan iori rasonand
Va agar ononro ba kh'idoiat da'vat kuned, [sukhanonatonro] nameshunavand va ononro mebini, ki [zokh'iran] ba tu nigokh' mekunand, dar kh'ole [ch'imodote kh'astand] ki namebinand>>
[Ei paiombar] Guzasht pesha kun va ba neki farmon bidekh' va az nodonon ru bigardon
Va agar vasvasae az suii shaiton turo barangezond, ba Allokh' taolo panokh' bibar, [ki] be tardid, U shunavovu donost
Dar kh'ak'ik'at, kasone, ki [az Allokh' taolo] parvo mekunand, chun vasvasae az ch'onibi shaiton ba onon rasad, [Allokh' taoloro] ba iod meovarand va on gokh' [nisbat ba kh'ak'ik'at] bino meshavand
Va barodaronashon [barodaroni kofiron va mushrikon, ki shaiotin kh'astand] ononro ba gumrokh'i mekashonand va [kh'argiz dar in kor] kutokh'i namekunand

Va [ei paiombar] kh'angome ki [nuzuli vakh'i ba ta'khir meaftod va] tu oiate bar eshon nameovari, meguiand: <<Charo tu khud onro namesozi>>? Bigu: <<Man fak'at az chize pairavi mekunam, ki az suii Parvardigoram ba man vakh'i meshavad. In [K'ur'on shomili] ravshangarikh'oe az suii Pavardigoraton ast va baroi gurukh'e, ki imon meovarand, kh'idoiatu rakh'mat ast
Va kh'angome ki K'ur'on khonda meshavad, pas, ba on gush faro dikh'ed va khomush boshed, boshad, ki farogiri rakh'mat shaved>>
Va Parvardigoratro dar dili khesh bo tazarru' va tars, biduni ovozi balandguftor [dar] bomdodon va shomgokh'on iod kun va [az iodi Allokh' taolo] g'ofil mabosh
[Ei paiombar] Kasone, ki nazdi Parvardigori tu kh'astand [farishtagon], iak'inan, az parastishi Vai [sarkashi va] takabbur namevarzand va Uro ba poki mesitoiand va baroiash sach'da mekunand

[Ei paiombar] Az tu dar borai [tak'sim] anfol [g'anoimi ch'angi] mepursand, bigu: <<Anfol az oni Allokh' taolo va paiombar ast, pas, az Allokh' taolo parvo kuned va bo iakdigar sozish namoed va agar imon dored, az Allokh' taolo va paiombarash itoat kuned

Be tardid, mu'minon [-i kh'ak'ik'i] kasone kh'astand, ki chun iodi Allokh' taolo meshavad, dilkh'oiashon kh'aroson megardad va chun oiotash bar onon khonda meshavad, bar imonashon meafzoiad va bar Parvardigorashon tavakkal mekunand
Kasone, ki namoz barpo medorand va az onchi ruziiashon kardaem, infok' mekunand.
Onon kh'astand, ki ba rosti mu'minand. Baroi onon nazdi Parvardigorashon darach'ot [-i volo] va omurzishu ruzii naku khokh'ad bud

[Ei paiombar, ikhtiiori komili tu bar g'anoim much'ibi nokhushnudii barkhe afrod ast, durust] Kh'amon tavre ki Parvardigorat turo ba kh'ak' az khonaat [dar Madina ba suii maidoni Badr] berun ovard va kh'atman, gurukh'e az mu'minon [az ch'angidan] nokhushnud budand
Onon pas az onki kh'ak'ik'at oshkor shud, dar borai kh'ak' [-i ch'ikh'od] bo tu much'odala mekunand, guio eshonro ba suii marg meronand, dar kh'ole ki khud [ba murdanashon] menigarand

Va [ei much'okh'idon, ba iod ovared] kh'angome ki Allokh' taolo ba shumo va'da dod, ki [g'anoimi] iake az du gurukh' [korvoni tich'ori io lashkar] nasibaton khokh'ad shud va shumo dust doshted, ki korvoni g'airi nizomi [tich'ori] baroi shumo boshad va Allokh' taolo mekhost bo sukhanoni khesh [dar borai kushtori kofiron] kh'ak' [-i Islom]-ro poidor gardonad va reshai kofironro k'at' kunad
[Allokh' taolo Islomro piruz kard] To kh'ak'ro sobit namoiad va botilro az miion bardorad, kh'archand gunakh'goron [-i mushrik] nokhushnud boshand

[Ruzi Badrro ba iod ovared] On gokh' ki az Parvardigoraton fariodrasi [va iori] mekhosted va U [darkhosti] shumoro paziruft [va farmud]: <<Be gumon, shumoro bo kh'azor farishta, ki paiopai furud meoiand, iori mekunam>>

Va Allokh' taolo in [iori]-ro ch'uz muzhdae [baroiaton] k'aror nadod, to dilkh'oiaton bo on orom girad va [bidoned, ki] piruzi ch'uz az ch'onibi Allokh' taolo nest. Ba rosti, ki Allokh' taolo shikastnopaziri kh'akim ast

[Va ba iod ovared] Kh'angome ki khobi sabuk, ki oromishe az suii U bud, shumoro faro girift va az osmon obe bar shumo furu firistod, to bo on pokaton kunad va palidii shaitonro az shumo dur sozad va dilkh'oiatonro makh'kam bidorad va gomkh'oiatonro bo on ustuvor namoiad

[Va ei paiombar, ba iod ovar] kh'angome ki Parvardigorat ba farishtagon vakh'i kard,ki: <<Man bo shumo kh'astam, pas, kasonero, ki imon ovardaand, sobitk'adam dored. Ba zudi, dar dili kasone, ki kufr varzidand, kh'aros meafkanam, pas. [ei much'okh'idon, shamsheri kheshro] bar farozi gardankh'oiashon bizaned va kh'amai angushtonashonro k'at' kuned [to silokh' barnagirand]
In ba khotiri on ast, ki onon bo Allokh' taolo va rasulash mukholifat kardand va kh'ar ki bo Allokh' taolo va rasulash mukholifat kunad, pas, [bidon, ki] Allokh' taolo sakhtkaifar ast
[Ei kofiron] In [azobi dunio]-ro bichashed va [bidoned, ki] baroi kofiron [dar k'iiomat] azobi otash ast
Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, kh'argokh' [dar maidoni ch'ang] bo anbukh'i kofiron rubaru shuded, pas, ba onon pusht nakuned [va nagurezed]

Va kh'ar ki dar on kh'angom ba onon pusht kunad, magar on ki [angezaash firebi dushman io] kanoragiri baroi nabardi [dubora] io paivastan ba gurukh' [-i digar az sipokh'i musulmonon] boshad, kh'atman, ba khashmi Allokh' taolo giriftor megardad va ch'oigokh'ash duzakh ast. Va chi bad saranch'omest!

Pas, [ei mu'minon, dar ruzi nabard bo mushrikon dar Badr] shumo [bo nerui khud] ononro nakushted, balki Allokh' taolo ononro kusht va [ei paiombar] kh'angome ki [ba suiashon khoku sang] meandokhti, [dar kh'ak'ik'at] tu naandokhti, balki Allokh' taolo andokht, to mu'minonro ba ozmoishi naku az ch'onibi khud biozmoiad. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo shunavovu donost
In [shikast va firori mushrikon va sarafrozii mu'minon kh'ama az ch'onibi Allokh' taolo] bud va Allokh' taolo nairangi kofironro sust [-u beasar] megardonad

[Ei mushrikon] Agar khokh'oni piruzi [bar musulmonon va farorasidani azobi ilokh'i kh'asted], inak piruzii [Islom, ki buzurgtarin ranch' va azobi shumost] ba surog'aton omad.Va agar [az kufru dushmani bo paiombar] dast bardored, on [kor] baroiaton bekh'tar ast, va [-le] agar [ba ch'ang bo musulmonon] bargarded, mo niz barmegardem.Va [inro bidoned] ki gurukh'i shumo, kh'archand ziiod boshad, kh'argiz nametavonad shumoro az chize beniioz kunad va [digar] inki [kh'amvora] Allokh' taolo bo mu'minon ast
Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, az Allokh' taolo va rasulash itoat kuned va az [akh'komu farmonkh'oi] U ru nagardoned, dar kh'ole ki [oioti K'ur'onro] meshunaved
Va monandi kasone naboshed, ki guftand: <<[Oioti ilokh'iro] shunidem>>, kh'ol onki nameshunidand
Be gumon, badtarin ch'unbandagon nazdi Allokh' taolo on [kasone kh'astand, ki dar barobari kh'ak'] karu gung kh'astand [va kh'ak'k'o], ki nameandeshand
Va agar Allokh' taolo khaire dar onon surog' dosht, [dar barobari kalomi kh'ak'] shunavoiashon menamud, va [le kh'atto] agar shunavoiashon mesokht, boz kh'am pusht mekardand va ruigardon meshudand

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, kh'argokh'e Allokh' taolo va paiombar, shumoro ba chize farokhondand, ki ba shumo zindagi mebakhshad, ononro ich'obat kuned va bidoned, ki Allokh' taolo miioni inson va dilash k'aror megirad [va az asror ogokh' ast] va in ki [dar k'iiomat kh'amagi] nazdi U gird ovarda meshaved
Va [ei mu'minon] az azob biparkh'ezed, ki tankh'o domani sitamgoronatonro namegirad va bidoned, ki Allokh' taolo sakhtkaifar ast

Va ba iod ovared zamonero, ki shumo dar sarzamini [Makka] andak va notavon buded [va] metarsided ki mardumon [-i mushrik] shumoro biraboiand, pas, Allokh' taolo [dar Madina] panokh'aton dod va bo iorii khesh nerumandaton sokht va az chizkh'oi pokiza ba shumo ruzi bakhshid, boshad, ki sipos guzored

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, [bo sarpechi az avomir va navokh'i] ba Allokh' taolo va paiombar khiionat nakuned va [kh'amchunin] dar amonatkh'oi khud khiionat nakuned, dar kh'ole ki medoned [in kor gunokh' ast]
Va bidoned, ki be tardid, amvolu farzandonaton [vasilai] ozmoish ast va podoshi buzurg nazdi Allokh' taolo ast

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, agar az Allokh' taolo parvo kuned, baroi shumo [nerui] tashkhis [-i kh'ak'k'u botil] k'aror medikh'ad va gunokh'onatonro az shumo mezudoiad va shumoro meomurzad. Va Allokh' taolo doroi bakhshishi buzurg ast

Va [ei paiombar, ba iod ovar] on gokh' ki kofiron dar boraat dasisa mekardand, ki turo ba zindon biafkanand io bikushand io [az Makka] berunat kunand. Onon makr meandeshidand va Allokh' taolo [niz tadbiru] makr mekard. Va Allokh' taolo bekh'tarini makrangezon ast

Va chun oioti Mo bar onon khonda shavad, meguiand: <<Ba khubi shunidem. Agar mekhostem, mo niz kh'atman, kh'ammonandi in [sukhanon]-ro meguftem. In [K'ur'on, chize] nest, magar afsonakh'oi peshiniion>>
Va [ba iod ovar] on gokh' ki guftand: <<Parvardigoro, agar in [K'ur'on] ba rosti kh'ak' ast va az ch'onibi Tust, pas, az osmon sangkh'o [-i vairongar] bar mo bibor io azobi dardnok bar mo bifirist>>
Va[-le ei Mukh'ammad] dar miioni onon kh'asti, Allokh' taolo bar on nest ki azobashon kunad va to zamone, ki [az dargokh'i ilokh'i] omurzish metalaband, Allokh' taolo azobkunandai eshon nest

Va charo Allokh' taolo [dar okhirat] azobashon nakunad, bo inki onon [mardumro] az [tavof va ibodat dar] Masch'idu-l-kh'arom bozmedorand? Va [mushrikon] kh'argiz dustoni Allokh' taolo nabudaand, [zero] dustoni Allokh' taolo kase ch'uz parkh'ezgoron nestand, vale beshtarashon namedonand
Va namozashon nazdi khonai [Ka'ba] chize ch'uz fariod kashidan va kaf zadan nabud, pas, ba sazoi on ki kufr mevarzided, azob [-i shikastu asorat dar Badr]-ro bichashed

Onon ki kufr varzidand, amvolashonro kharch' mekunand, to [mardumro] az rokh'i Allokh' taolo bozdorand, pas, ba zudi kh'amaro kharch' mekunand, on gokh' [in kor moiai] kh'asrat va pushaimoniiashon megardad va sipas shikast mekhurand va [saranch'om] kasone, ki kufr varzidand, ba suii [otashi] duzakh kashonda meshavand

To [tavassuti azobi duzakh] Allokh' taolo [mu'minoni] pokro az [mushrikoni] palid ch'udo kunad va [tamomi on amvoli] palidro [ki baroi nobudii Islom sarf meshud] bar kh'am nikh'ad va kh'amagiro mutarokim sozad va sipas [iakch'o] dar duzakh k'aror dikh'ad. Inon kh'amon ziiondidagoni [vok'ei] kh'astand

[Ei paiombar] ba kasone, ki kufr varzidand, bigu, [ki] agar [az shirk va dushmani] dast bardorand, guzashtakh'oiashon bakhshida meshavad, va [-le] agar [ba raftori guzashtai khud] bozgardand, sunnat [-u azobi ilokh'i, ki dar mavridi] peshiniion guzasht, [takror khokh'ad shud]

Va [ei mu'minon] bo onon paikor kuned, to fitna [shirk] reshakan shavad va [parastishu] din kh'ama az oni Allokh' taolo gardad. Pas, agar onon [az shirku ozor] dast bardoshtand, [rakh'oiashon kuned, charo ki] be tardid, Allokh' taolo ba onchi mekunand, binost
Va agar [az farmudakh'oi ilokh'i] sarpechi kunand, pas, bidoned ki Allokh' taolo [dustu] korsozi shumost. Chi naku korsoz va chi naku iovare kh'ast!

Va bidoned kh'ar g'animate, ki ba dast ovarded, iak panch'umash [panch'iakash] baroi Allokh' taolo va paiombar va baroi kheshovandon [-i paiombar, az Bani Kh'oshim va Bani Muttalib] va iatimoni [nobolig'] va tikh'idaston va darrokh'mondagon ast. Agar ba Allokh' taolo va onchi ki bar bandai khud dar ruzi ch'udoi [kh'ak' az botil], ruzi barkhurdi du gurukh' [mu'minon va mushrikon] nozil kardem, imon dored [ba in akh'kom amal kuned] va [bidoned, ki] Allokh' taolo bar kh'ar chize tavonost

On gokh' ki shumo [mu'minon] bar domanai nazdiktar buded va onon dar domanai durtar k'aror doshtand va korvon [-i tich'orii Kuraish] poiontar az [maidoni ch'ang va dur az tirrasii] shumo bud va agar [shumo va mushrikon] bo iakdigar [dar mavridi makh'alli dargiri] va'da guzoshta buded, kh'atman, dar va'dagokh'i khud ikhtilof mekarded, vale [ba irodai ilokh'i dar Badr ch'am' shuded], to Allokh' taolo korero, ki kh'atman, [boiad] ba vuk'u' mepaivast, anch'om dikh'ad, to kh'ar [kofire] ki kh'alok meshavad, [bo vuch'udi bartarii nizomi va adadi dar shirku gumrokh'i] kh'alok gardad va kh'ar [mu'mine] ki zinda memonad, [ba kh'idoiat] zindagi iobad [va in marg va zindagi] bar asosi daleli ravshan boshad va ba rosti, ki Allokh' taolo shunavovu donost

[Ba iod ovar] On gokh' ki Allokh' taolo [iddai] ononro dar khobat ba tu andak nishon dod va agar eshonro bisior nishon medod, musallaman, sust [-u baddil] meshuded va dar kori [ch'ang] ikhtilof mekarded. Vale Allokh' taolo [shumoro az susti va ikhtilof] dar amon nigokh' dosht. Be gumon, U ba onchi dar sinakh'ost, ogokh' ast

Va [ba iod ovar] kh'angome ki bo kh'am rubaru shuded, ononro ba chashmi shumo kamte'dod namud va shumoro [niz] ba chashmi onon andak ch'ilva dod, to Allokh' taolo korero, ki kh'atman, [boiad] ba vuk'u' mepaivast, anch'om dikh'ad va [bidoned, ki kh'amai] korkh'o ba Allokh' taolo bozgardonda meshavad
Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, kh'angome ki bo gurukh'e [az dushmanon] rubaru shuded, poidori namoed va Allokh' taoloro bisior iod kuned, boshad, ki rastagor shaved

Va az Allokh' taolo va paiombarash itoat kuned va [dar tasmimgiri] bo iakdigar kashmakash nakuned, ki sust meshaved va [tavonu] ik'tidoraton az bain meravad. Va shikeboi kuned, ki be gumon, Allokh' taolo bo shikeboion ast

Va monandi kasone naboshed, ki bo sarkashiiu khudnamoi dar barobari mardum az sarzamini khud [Makka] khorich' shudand va [mardumro] az rokh'i Allokh' taolo bozdoshtand va Allokh' taolo ba onchi mekunand, ikh'ota dorad

Va [ei mu'minon, ba iod ored] kh'angome ki shaiton a'moli ononro dar nazarashon orost va guft: <<Imruz kh'ech' kas bar shumo piruz nameshavad va man [iovaru] panokh'aton kh'astam>>. Ammo kh'angome ki du gurukh' [bo kh'am] rubaru shudand, ba ak'ib bozgashtu guft: <<Ba rosti, ki man az shumo bezoram va chize [farishtagoni iorigar] -ro mebinam, ki shumo namebined. Man az Allokh' taolo metarsam va [az kh'alok bim doram, charo ki] Allokh' taolo sakhtkaifar ast>>

Va [ba iod ovared] kh'angome ki munofik'on va kasone, ki dar dilkh'oiashon bemori bud, meguftand: <<In mu'minonro dinashon firefta ast>> va kh'ar ki bar Allokh' taolo tavakkal kunad, pas, [osudakhotir boshad, charo ki] be tardid, Allokh' taolo shikastnopaziri kh'akim ast
Va agar medidi,on gokh' ki farishtagon ch'oni kofironro mesitondand, bar suratu pushtashon mezadand va [meguiand]: <<Azobi suzonro bichashed
In [ch'ondodani sangin va azobi dardnok] dar muk'obili korkh'oest, ki az pesh firistodaed, va[-garna] Allokh' taolo nisbat ba bandagoni [khud] sitamgor nest>>.

[Azobi in kofironi kh'ak'sitez] Kh'ammonandi shevai [much'ozoti ] fir'avniion va [digar] kasonest, ki pesh az onon budand, [ki kh'amagi] ba oioti Allokh' taolo kufr varzidand va Allokh' taolo ononro ba [sazoi] gunokh'onashon giriftor kard. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo nerumandi sakhtkaifar ast

In [kaifari sakht] az on rust, ki Allokh' taolo kh'argiz bar on nabudaast, ki ne'matero, ki bar mardume arzoni doshtaast, digargun kunad, magar onki onon [raftori muvakh'kh'idonai] khudro tag'iir dikh'and [va kufru nosiposi bivarzand] va be tardid, Allokh' taolo shunavovu donost

[Kofiron raftore dorand] Kh'amchun raftori fir'avniion va kasone, ki pesh az onon budand, ki oioti Parvardigorashonro durug' meangoshtand, pas, [Mo niz] ononro ba kaifari gunokh'kh'oiashon kh'alok kardem va fir'avniionro g'ark' namudem va kh'amagi [mushriku] sitamgor budand
Iak'inan, badtarin ch'unbandagon nazdi Allokh' taolo kasone kh'astand, ki kufr varzidand va imon nameovarand
[Kh'amon] Kasone, ki bo onon paimon basti, vale kh'ar bor paimonashonro meshikanand va [az Allokh' taolo] parvo namekunand
Va [ei paiombar] agar dar ch'ang bar onon dast iofti, chunon dar kh'am bikubashon, ki ibrati digaron gardad, boshad, ki [digaron] pand girand
Va agar az gurukh'e bimi khiionat dori, [paimonashonro] ba onon bozgardon, [to ogokh'ii tarafain az shikasti paimon] ba tavri iakson [boshad]. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo khoinonro dust nadorad
Va kasone, ki kufr varzidand, kh'argiz mapindorand ki ch'on badar burdaand [va nach'ot ioftaand], onon kh'argiz [az margu azob] rokh'i gureze nadorand

Va [ei mu'minon] kh'archi dar tavon dored, az neru va aspkh'oi omoda [va ch'angafzor], basich' kuned, to bo in [tadorukot] dushmani Allokh' taolo va dushmani kheshro bitarsoned, kh'amchunin, [bo in tach'kh'izot dushmanoni] digarero g'air az eshon, ki shumo ononro nameshinosed, va [-le] Allokh' taolo meshinosadashon [ba vakh'shat biiandozed] va kh'archi dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo infok' kuned, podoshi on ba shumo bozgardonda meshavad va bar shumo sitam nameravad
Va agar [kofiron] ba sulkh' moil shudand, pas, tu [niz ei paiombar] az dari sulkh' daro va bar Allokh' taolo tavakkal kun. Be gumon, Ust, ki shunavovu donost
Va agar [kofiron bo tazokh'ur ba oshti] bikhokh'and firebat dikh'and, pas, Allokh' taolo baroiat kofi ast. Ust, ki bo iorii khud va mu'minon, turo ta'iid [-u tak'viiat] namud

Va baini dilkh'oiashon [mekh'ruboni va] ulfat bark'aror namud. [Ei paiombar] Agar tu tamomi onchiro, ki dar ruii zamin ast, kharch' mekardi, [kh'argiz] nametavonisti baini dilkh'oiashonro ulfat dikh'i, vale Allokh' taolo miioni onon ulfat padid ovard. Ba rosti, ki U shikastnopaziri kh'akim ast
Ei paiombar, [kh'imoiati] Allokh' taolo baroi tu va [niz] baroi mu'minone, ki az tu pairavi kardaand, kofi ast

Ei paiombar, mu'minonro ba ch'ang tashvik' kun. Agar az shumo [mu'minon] bist nafar [bar ch'ikh'od] shikebo boshand, bar dusad nafar [az kofiron] g'alaba mekunand va agar sad nafar az shumo [inchunin] boshand, bar kh'azor nafar az kasone, ki kufr varzidand, g'alaba mekunand, zero onon gurukh'e kh'astand, ki [arzishi kh'ak'ik'ii ch'ikh'odro] namefakh'mand

Aknun Allokh' taolo ba shumo sabuk girift va donist, ki [bar asari ch'ang] za'fe dar vuch'udaton ast. Pas, agar az [miioni] shumo sad nafar shikebo boshand, bar dusad nafar [az kofiron] piruz meshavand va agar az shumo kh'azor nafar boshand, ba farmoni Allokh' taolo, bar du kh'azor nafar g'olib khokh'and shud.Va Allokh' taolo bo shikeboion ast

Baroi kh'ech' paiombare sazovor nest, ki asirone [az lashkari kofiron] doshta boshad, ki [bitavonad bo e'domi onkh'o] dar zamin kushtori bisiore ba rokh' andozad [to ba in vasila dushmanro ba vakh'shat biandozad], Shumo [mu'minon bo giriftani fidia az asironi Badr sarvat va] koloi dunioro mekhokh'ed va Allokh' taolo okhiratro [baroiaton] mekhokh'ad va Allokh' taolo shikastnopaziru kh'akim ast
Agar dar onchi [az g'anoimu fidiakh'o] giriftaed, kh'ukmi peshini ilokh'i vuch'ud nadosht [va onro baroiaton kh'alol nakarda bud], kh'atman, azobi buzurg ba shumo merasid
Pas, [aknun] az onchi g'animat giriftaed, kh'alolu pokiza bikhured va az Allokh' taolo parvo kuned. Ba rosti, ki Allokh' taolo omurzandai mekh'rubon ast

Ei paiombar, ba asirone, ki dar dasti shumo kh'astand, bigu: <<Agar Allokh' taolo khaire dar dilkh'oiaton surog' doshta boshad, bekh'tar az [fidia va] onchiro, ki az shumo girifta shudaast, ba shumo medikh'ad va shumoro meomurzad va Allokh' taolo omurzandai mekh'rubon ast

Va [ei paiombar] agar bikhokh'and ba tu khiionat kunand, pas, [bidon, ki] onon, kh'atman, pesh az in [niz] ba Allokh' taolo khiionat kardaand va Allokh' taolo [turo] bar onon piruz namud va Allokh' taolo donovu kh'akim ast

Kasone, ki imon ovardand va kh'ich'rat kardand va bo amvolu ch'onkh'oiashon dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo ch'ikh'od namudand va kasone, ki [mukh'och'ironro] panokh' dodand va iori namudand, inon [kh'ama] dustoni iakdigarand. Va kasone, ki imon ovardand, va [-le az sarzamini kufr] kh'ich'rat nakardand, shumo kh'ech' dusti [va paivande] bo onon nadored, magar onki kh'ich'rat kunand. Va agar dar [kori] din az shumo iori khostand, pas, bar shumost, ki [ononro] iori kuned, magar [inki in iorikhokh'i] alaikh'i gurukh'e boshad, ki miioni shumo va onon paimone bark'aror ast. Va Allokh' taolo ba onchi mekuned, binost
Va kasone, ki kufr varzidand, [onon niz] dustoni iakdigarand. Agar [shumo mu'minon ba in suporish dar borai dustu dushman] amal nakuned, fitna va fasodi buzurg dar zamin barpo megardad

Va kasone, ki imon ovardand va kh'ich'rat namudand va dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo ch'ikh'od kardand va kasone, ki [in mukh'och'irinro] panokh' dodand va iori namudand, inon mu'minoni kh'ak'ik'i kh'astand. Baroi onon [dar bikh'isht] omurzish va ruzii shoistae khokh'ad bud

Va kasone, ki pas az onon imon ovardand va kh'ich'rat namudand va ba kh'amrokh'i shumo [mu'minon] ch'ikh'od kardand, pas, onon [niz] az shumo kh'astand. Va dar [kh'ukmi] kitobi Allokh' taolo kheshovandon [dar meros] nisbat ba iakdigar sazovortarand. Ba rosti, ki Allokh' taolo ba kh'ar chize donost
[In oiot] E'lomi bezori [va poioni taakh'kh'ud] az tarafi Allokh' taolo va paiombarash nisbat ba mushrikonest, ki [shumo musulmonon] bo onon paimon bastaed

Pas, [ei mushrikon, fak'at] chakh'or mokh' [fursat dored, ki bo amniiati komil] dar zamin bigarded va bidoned, ki [kh'argiz] nametavoned Allokh' taoloro notavon sozed [va az azobash bigurezed] va Allokh' taolo rasvokunandai kofiron ast

Va [in] e'lomest az ch'onibi Allokh' taolo va paiombarash ba mardum dar ruzi kh'ach'ch'i akbar [idi k'urbon], ki: <<Allokh' taolo va paiombarash az mushrikon bezorand>>. Pas, agar tavba kuned, baroi shumo bekh'tar ast va agar ru bigardoned [va sarpechi kuned], pas, bidoned, ki shumo [kh'argiz] nametavoned Allokh' taoloro notavon sozed [va az azobash bigurezed]. Va [tu ei paiombar] kasonero ki kufr varzidand, ba azobi dardnoke bashorat bidekh'

Magar kasone az mushrikon, ki bo onon paimon bastaed va chize az [taakh'kh'udoti khud nisbat ba] shumo furuguzor nakardaand va kasero alaikh'i shumo pushtiboni nakardand. Pas, paimoni ononro to poioni muddatashon ba poion birasoned, [ki] be tardid, Allokh' taolo parkh'ezgoronro dust medorad

Pas, chun mokh'kh'oi kh'arom sipari shud, mushrikonro kh'ar kuch'o iofted, bikushed va ononro dastgir kuned va dar mukh'osira biguzored va dar kh'ar guzargokh'e ba kamini onon binishined.Pas, agar tavba kardand va namoz barpo doshtand va zakot pardokhtand, rakh'oiashon kuned, [charo ki] be tardid, Allokh' taolo omurzandai mekh'rubon ast

Va [ei paiombar] agar iake az mushrikon az tu panokh' khost, pas, panokh'ash bidekh', to sukhani Allokh' taoloro bishnavad, sipas uro ba makh'alli amnash birason. In [amon dodan ba mushrikon] ba on sabab ast, ki onon gurukh'i nodonand

Chiguna mushrikon metavonand nazdi Allokh' taolo va paiombarash [akh'du] paimone doshta boshand? Magar [dar mavridi] kasone, ki bo onon nazdiki Masch'idu-l-kh'arom [dar Kh'udaibiia] paimon bastaed. Pas, to [mushrikon dar mavridi on akh'd] bo shumo poidorand, shumo [niz] bo onon poidor boshed, [charo ki] be tardid, Allokh' taolo parkh'ezgoronro dust medorad

Chiguna [paimoni mushrikon arzish dorad] bo inki agar bar shumo dast ioband, dar borai shumo na [kh'ak'k'i] kheshovandiro muroot mekunand va na kh'ech' paimonero?! Onon shumoro bo zaboni khud khushnud mekunand va kh'ol onki dilkh'oiashon imtino' mevarzad va beshtarashon nofarmonand
Oioti Allokh' taoloro ba bakh'oi nochize furukhtand va [mardumro] az rokh'i U bozdoshtand. Ba rosti, chi bad a'mole anch'om medodand!
Inon dar kh'ak'k'i kh'ech' mu'mine, na [kh'ak'k'i] kheshovandi muroot [rioia] mekunand va na paimonero. Va inonand, ki tach'ovuzkorand

Pas, [bo in kh'ol] agar tavba kardand va namoz barpo doshtand va zakot pardokhtand, barodaroni dinii shumo [musulmonon] kh'astand va Mo oioti khudro baroi gurukh'e, ki medonand, ba tafsil baion mekunem

Va agar [taakh'kh'udu] savgandashonro pas az paimoni khesh shikastand va dar dinaton ta'na zadand, pas bo peshvoioni kufr bich'anged; zero onon akh'd [-u paimone bo shumo] nadorand, boshad, ki [az raftori khud] dast bardorand

Ei mu'minon] Charo bo gurukh'e namech'anged, ki savgand [va paimoni] khudro shikastand va dar berun rondani paiombar [az Makka] kushidand? Onon budand, ki nakhustin bor [bo iori kardani k'abilai Bakr dar barobari Khuzoa ch'angro] bo shumo og'oz kardand. Oio az onon metarsed? Dar kh'ole ki agar imon dored, Allokh' taolo sazovortar ast, ki az U bitarsed
Bo onon bich'anged, to Allokh' taolo ba dasti shumo azobashon kunad va khorashon sozad va shumoro bar onon piruz gardonad va dilkh'oi mu'minonro orom bakhshad
Va [bo shikasti kofiron] khashmi dilkh'oi onon [mu'minon] -ro bartaraf kunad. Va Allokh' taolo az kh'ar ki bikhokh'ad, darmeguzarad. Va Allokh' taolo donoi kh'akim ast

Oio pindoshtaed, ki [biduni imtikh'oni ilokh'i] ba kh'oli khud rakh'o meshaved? Dar kh'ole ki Allokh' taolo kh'anuz kasone az shumoro, ki ch'ikh'od kardand va ba ch'uz Allokh' taolo va paiombar va mu'minon [kasero ba dusti va] kh'amrozi nagiriftaand, ma'lum nadoshtaast? Va Allokh' taolo ba onchi mekuned, ogokh' ast

Sazovor nest, ki mushrikon masoch'idi Allokh' taoloro obod kunand, dar kh'ole ki onon [amalan] ba kufri khesh guvokh'and [va onro izkh'or mekunand], ononand, ki a'molashon tabokh' gashtaast va khud dar otashi [duzakh] ch'ovidonand

Masoch'idi Allokh' taoloro fak'at kasone [boiad] obod kunand, ki ba Allokh' taolo va ruzi okhirat imon ovardaand va namoz barpo medorand va zakot mepardozand va az g'airi Allokh' taolo nametarsand. Umed ast, ki inon az kh'idoiatioftagon boshand

[Ei mushrikon] Oio ob dodan ba kh'och'iion va obod kardani Masch'idu-l-kh'aromro bo [imonu amali] kase, ki ba Allokh' taolo va ruzi vopasin imon ovarda va dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo ch'ikh'od kardaast, barobar medoned? [In du kh'argiz] Nazdi Allokh' taolo barobar nestand. Va Allokh' taolo sitamgoron [-i mushrik]-ro kh'idoiat namekunad
Kasone, ki imon ovardand va kh'ich'rat kardand va dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo bo amvol va ch'onkh'oi khesh ch'ikh'od kardand, nazdi Allokh' taolo mak'omi bartare dorand va inon kh'amon rastagoronand
Parvardigorashon ononro az ch'onibi khesh ba rakh'matu khushnudi va bog'kh'oe [dar bikh'isht] muzhda medikh'ad, ki dar onkh'o ne'matkh'oi poidor dorand
Kh'amvora dar on ch'ovidonand. Ba rosti, ki podoshi buzurg [fak'at] nazdi Allokh' taolo ast
Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, agar padaronu barodaronaton kufrro bar imon tarch'ekh' medikh'and, [ononro] ba dusti nagired va kh'ar kase az shumo ononro ba dusti bigirad, onon kh'amon sitamgoronand

[Ei paiombar, ba mu'minon] Bigu: <<Agar padaronu farzandon va barodaron va kh'amsaron va kheshovandonaton va amvole, ki ba dast ovardaed va tich'orate, ki az kasodiash metarsed va khonakh'oe, ki ba on dilkhush kh'asted, nazdi shumo az Allokh' taolo va paiombarash va ch'ikh'od dar rokh'i U makh'bubtarand, pas, muntazir boshed, to Allokh' taolo farmoni [azobi] kheshro nozil kunad. Va Allokh' taolo gurukh'i nofarmonro kh'idoiat namekunad>>

Be tardid, Allokh' taolo shumo [mu'minon]-ro dar mavk'eiiatkh'oi bisior iori kardaast va niz dar ch'angi Kh'unain, on gokh' ki farovonii te'dodaton shumoro [shodu] shigiftzada kard, vale kh'ech' sude ba kh'olaton nadosht va zamin bo kh'ama gusturdagi bar shumo tang omad, on gokh' [ba dushman] pusht karded [va gurekhted]

Sipas Allokh' taolo oromishi kheshro bar paiombarash va mu'minon furu firistod va sipokh'iionero, ki shumo namedided [ba kumakaton] firistod va ononro, ki kufr varzida budand, azob kard. Va ch'azoi kofiron chunin ast
Sipas Allokh' taolo ba'd az on [azobi khorkunanda] tavbai kh'arkiro bikhokh'ad, mepazirad va Allokh' taolo omurzandavu mekh'rubon ast

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, ch'uz in nest, ki mushrikon kh'atman, palidand, pas, naboiad ba'd az imsol ba Masch'idu-l-kh'arom nazdik shavand. Va agar [ba khotiri k'at'i tich'orat bo onon] az tangdasti bim dored, [bidoned, ki] agar Allokh' taolo bikhokh'ad, shumoro az bakhshishi khesh beniioz mesozad. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo donoiu kh'akim ast

Bo kasone [az akh'li kitob], ki ba Allokh' taolo va ruzi k'iiomat imon nameorand va onchiro Allokh' taolo va paiombarash kh'arom kardaand, kh'arom nameshumorand va dini kh'ak'ro namepazirand, bich'anged, to on gokh' ki bo shikastu khori ba dasti khesh ch'izia dikh'and

Va iakh'udiion guftand: <<Uzair pisari Allokh' taolo ast>> va masekh'iion guftand: <<Masekh' pisari Allokh' taolo ast>>. In sukhan [-i botil]-e ast, ki bar zabon meovarand va ba guftori kasone, ki pesh az in kufr varzidand, shabokh'at dorad. Allokh' taolo kh'alokashon kunad! Chiguna [az kh'ak'] munkh'arif meshavand?

[In mushrikon] Ulamo va rokh'iboni khud va [kh'amchunin] Masekh' pisari Mariamro ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo [ba unvoni] ma'budoni khesh talak'k'i kardand, kh'ol onki dasture ch'uz in nadoshtand, ki fak'at Allokh' taoloi iagonaro biparastand, ki ma'bude [ba kh'ak'] ch'uz U nest. U az onchi sharikash k'aror medikh'and, munazzakh' ast
Onon mekhokh'and nuri Allokh' taoloro bo sukhanoni khesh khomush kunand, vale Allokh' taolo ch'uz in namekhokh'ad, ki nuri kheshro komil kunad, kh'archand kofiron nokhushnud boshand
Ust, ki paiombarashro bo kh'idoiatu dini kh'ak' firistodaast, to onro bar kh'amai adion piruz gardonad, kh'archand mushrikon nokhushnud boshand

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, be tardid, bisiore az ulamo[-i iakh'udi] va rokh'ibon, amvoli mardumro ba nokh'ak' mekhurand va [ononro] az rokh'i Allokh' taolo bozmedorand.Va kasone, ki zaru sim meanduzand va onro dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo infok' namekunand, pas, ononro ba azobi dardnok bashorat bidekh'

Ruze, ki on [ganch'inakh'o]-ro dar otashi duzakh surkh kunand va peshoni va pakh'lu va pushtashonro bo on dog' nikh'and [va biguiand]: <<In ast onchi baroi khesh meandukhted, pas, bichashed onchiro, ki meandukhted>>

Shumori mokh'kh'o nazdi Allokh' taolo [az] ruze, ki osmonkh'o va zaminro ofaridaast, dar kitobi Allokh' taolo [Lavkh'i makh'fuz] duvozdakh' mokh' ast, ki [ch'angu dargiri dar] chakh'or mokh' az on kh'arom ast [Zulk'a'da, Zulkh'ich'ch'a, Mukh'arram va Rach'ab]. In ast oini ustuvor [va rokh'i kh'ak']. Pas, dar in [chakh'or mokh'] bar khud sitam nakuned va kh'amagi bo mushrikon bich'anged, chunonki kh'amai onon bo shumo mech'angand va bidoned, ki Alllokh' taolo kh'amrokh'i parkh'ezgoron ast

Be tardid, ba ta'khir andokhtan [-i mokh'kh'oi kh'arom va barkh'am zadani tartibi asli onkh'o much'ibi] afzoishi kufr ast [va] kasone, ki kufr varzidand, bo in kor ba gumrokh'i kashida meshavand. On [mokh']-ro iak sol kh'alol meshumorand va iak sol [-i digar] kh'aromash medonand, to bo te'dodi mokh'kh'oe, ki Allokh' taolo kh'arom kardaast, barobar sozand. Pas, [ba on sabab] onchiro, ki Allokh' taolo kh'arom kardaast, [bar khud] kh'alol mekunand.Zishtii a'molashon bar eshon orosta shudaast va Allokh' taolo gurukh'i kofironro kh'idoiat namekunad

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, shumoro chi shudaast, ki chun ba shumo gufta meshavad: <<Dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo rakh'sipor [ch'ikh'od] shaved>>, susti ba kharch' medikh'ed [va dar khonakh'oiaton menishined]? Oio ba ch'oii okhirat ba zindagii dunio dilkhush kardaed? [Pas, bidoned, ki] koloi zindagii dunio dar barobari okhirat ch'uz andake nest

[Ei mu'minon] Agar rakh'sipor [-i ch'ikh'od] nagarded, [Allokh' taolo] ba azobi dardnok giriftoraton mekunad va ba ch'oii shumo gurukh'i digarero meovarad va [shumo bo nofarmoni kh'argiz] ba U ziione namerasoned. Va Allokh' taolo bar kh'ar chize tavonost

[Ei askh'obi paiombar] Agar shumo uro iori nakuned, kh'atman, Allokh' taolo ioriash namud: kh'angome ki kofiron uro [az Makka] berun kardand, on gokh' ki iake az on du, ki dar g'or [-i Savr panokh' girifta] budand, ba kh'amrokh'i khud [Abubakr] guft: <<Andukh'gin mabosh, [ki] be tardid, Allokh' taolo bo most>>. Pas, Allokh' taolo oromishi khudro bar u furu firistod va uro bo sipokh'iione, ki onkh'oro namedided, ta'iid [-u tak'viiat] kard va sukhani kasonero, ki kufr varzidand, pasttar gardond. Va sukhani Allokh' taolost, ki bartar ast va Allokh' taolo shikastnopaziru kh'akim ast
Sabukboru garonbor [ba kh'ar kh'olate baroi ch'ikh'od] rakh'sipor shaved va bo amvolu ch'onkh'oi khesh dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo ch'ikh'od kuned. Agar bidoned, in baroi shumo bekh'tar ast

[Ei paiombar] Agar [kh'adafi munofik'on az kh'amrokh'i bo tu kasbi g'animat va ioftani] mole dar dastras va safari [oson va] kutokh' bud, kh'atman, ba dunbolat meomadand. Vale on rokh'i purmashak'k'ati [ Shom] bar eshon dur [-u dushvor] namud va ba zudi ba Allokh' taolo savgand khokh'and khurd, ki: <<Agar metavonistem, kh'atman, bo shumo rakh'sipor meshudem>> [Onon bo nofarmoni va savgandi durug'] khudro ba kh'alokat afkandand va Allokh' taolo medonad, ki onon, iak'inan, durug'gu kh'astand
[Ei paiombar] Allokh' taolo az tu darguzarad! Charo pesh az onki [kh'oli] rostguion bar tu ravshan gardad va durug'guionro bozshinosi, ba onon ich'ozat dodi [ki dar ch'ikh'od shirkat kunand]?
Kasone, ki ba Allokh' taolo va ruzi vopasin imon dorand, dar ch'ikh'od bo amvolu ch'onkh'oiashon az tu ich'ozat [muofiiat] namekhokh'and. Va Allokh' taolo ba [kh'oli] parkh'ezgoron donost
Tankh'o kasone az tu ich'ozat [-i muofiiat az ch'ikh'od] mekhokh'and, ki ba Allokh' taolo va ruzi vopasin imon nadorand va dilkh'oiashon ba tardid oluda ast va dar tardidi khud sargardonand

Va agar [ba rosti] irodai rakh'sipori [ba k'asdi ch'ikh'od] doshtand, kh'atman, sozu barge baroiash farokh'am mekardand, vale Allokh' taolo rakh'sipori ononro khush nadosht, pas, eshonro munsarif namud va [ba onon] gufta shud: <<Bo khonanishinon bimoned>>

[Ei mu'minon] Agar [munofik'on] kh'amrokh'i shumo rakh'sipor meshudand, [ba sababi buzdili va firor az maidoni ch'ang] ch'uz fitna va fasod baroiaton ba bor nameovardand va miionaton nufuz menamudand va dar kh'ak'k'i shumo fitnach'ui mekardand va dar ch'am'aton ch'osusone dorand. Va Allokh' taolo ba [kh'oli] sitamgoron ogokh' ast

Iak'inan, pesh az in [niz munofik'on bisior] fitnach'ui kardand va korkh'oro bar tu [voruna va] oshufta ch'ilva dodand, to onki kh'ak' omad va farmoni Allokh' taolo oshkor gardid, dar kh'ole ki onon karokh'at doshtand

Va az eshon kase kh'ast, ki meguiad: <<Ba man ich'ozat bidekh', [ki ch'ikh'od nakunam] va maro dar fitna naandoz>>. Ogokh' boshed! [Munofik'on] Kh'am aknun niz dar fitna aftodaand va be tardid, duzakh bar kofiron ikh'ota dorad

[Ei paiombar] Agar ba tu neki birasad, ononro norokh'at mekunad va agar musibate ba tu rasad, meguiand: <<Mo pesh az in chorai kori khud andeshidaem>> va shodmon [nazdi khonavodakh'oiashon] bozmegardand
Bigu: <<Kh'argiz [musibate] ba mo namerasad, ch'uz onchi Allokh' taolo baroiamon muk'arrar kardaast. U [dustu] korsozi most va mu'minon boiad ba Allokh' taolo tavakkal kunand>>

[Ba munofik'on] Bigu: <<Oio baroi mo ch'uz iake az du neki [piruzi io shakh'odat]-ro intizor dored? Dar kh'ole ki mo intizor mekashem, ki Allokh' taolo az ch'onibi khesh io ba dasti mo ba azob [-i sakhte] giriftoraton kunad. Pas, intizor bikashed, ki be tardid, mo [niz] bo shumo muntazirem>>
[Ba munofik'on] Bigu: <<Chi bo rag'bat, chi bo karokh'at infok' kuned, kh'argiz az shumo pazirufta nameshavad, [charo ki] be tardid, shumo gurukh'i nofarmon budaed>>

Va kh'ech' chiz monei k'abuli bakhshishkh'oiashon nashud, ch'uz inki onon ba Allokh' taolo va paiombarash kufr varzidand va ch'uz bo susti namoz nameguzorand va ch'uz ba karokh'at [va bemaili] infok' namekunand

Pas, [ei paiombar] amvolu farzandonashon turo shigiftzada nakunad. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo mekhokh'ad dar zindagii dunio ba vasilai inkh'o azobashon kunad va dar kh'ole ki kofirand, ch'onashon baroiad

Va onon [ munofik'on] ba Allokh' taolo savgand iod mekunand, ki az shumo [mu'minon] kh'astand, dar kh'ole ki az shumo nestand, vale onon gurukh'e kh'astand, ki metarsand [va ba in sabab savgand mekhurand]
Agar panokh'gokh' io g'or io gurezgokh'e paido kunand, shitobon ba suii on ru meovarand

Va barkhe az onon kh'astand, ki dar [tak'simi] sadak'ot [va g'anoim] bar tu khurda megirand, pas, agar az on [amvol] ba eshon doda shavad, khushnud megardand va agar az on ba eshon doda nashavad, on gokh' khashmgin meshavand

Va [kh'atman, bar eshon bekh'tar bud], agar onon ba onchi Allokh' taolo va paiombarash ba eshon dodaand, khushnud megashtand va meguftand: <<Allokh' taolo baroiamon kofist, ba zudi Allokh' taolo va paiombarash az fazlu bakhshishi khud ba mo medikh'ad va mo ba Allokh' taolo [umedvor va ] mushtok'em>>

Sadak'ot [va zakot] ikhtisos dorad ba fak'iron [-i tikh'idast] va mustamandon [-i tangdast] va korguzoron [-i ch'am'ovari va tavzei] on va dilch'ushudagon [tozamusulmon] va baroi [ozod kardani] bardagon va [pardokhti vomi] k'arzdoron va dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo va [kumak ba] darrokh'mondagon. [In] Farizai [muk'arrarshuda] az ch'onibi Allokh' taolo ast va Allokh' taolo donoi kh'akim ast

Va barkhe az onon [munofik'on] kh'astand, ki paiombarro meozorand va meguiand: <<U zudbovar [va soropo gush] ast>>. [Ei paiombar] Bigu: <<U baroi shumo [fak'at] shunavandai sukhani khair ast. [Vai] ba Allokh' taolo imon dorad va [sukhani] mu'minonro bovar dorad va baroi kasone az shumo, ki imon ovardaand, rakh'matest>>. Va kasone, ki Rasulullokh'ro meozorand, azobi dardnok [dar pesh] dorand

[Ei mu'minon, munofik'on] Baroiaton ba Allokh' taolo savgand iod mekunand, to shumoro khushnud sozand, dar kh'ole ki agar imon doshtand, shoistatar [in] bud, ki Allokh' taolo va paiombarashro khushnud sozand
Oio namedonand, kh'ar ki bo Allokh' taolo va rasulash mukholifat [va dushmani] kunad, musallaman, otashi ch'akh'annam baroi ust [va] ch'ovidona dar on khokh'ad bud? In kh'amon rasvoii buzurg ast

Munofik'on bim dorand, ki [mabodo] surae dar borai onon [bar paiombar] nozil shavad va onon [ mu'minon]-ro az onchi dar dilkh'oi eshon [munofik'on] ast, ogokh' sozad. [Ei paiombar, ba onon] Bigu: <<[Kh'archi mekhokh'ed] Maskhara kuned, [ki] be tardid, Allokh' taolo onchiro, ki [az on meparkh'ezed va] kh'aros dored, ifsho khokh'ad kard>>

Va agar az onon bipursi: [<<Charo tamaskhur mekarded>>?] Musallaman, meguiand: <<Mo ch'iddi nameguftem va [shukhi va] bozi mekardem>>. Bigu: <<Oio Allokh' taolo va oioti U va paiombarashro maskhara mekarded>>?

Uzr naovared. Ba rosti, ki shumo pas az imonaton kofir shudaed. Agar gurukh'e az shumoro [ba khotiri tavbaashon] bibakhshem, gurukh'i digarro [ba sababi sarkashi va tarki infok'] azob khokh'em kard, charo ki be tardid, onon tabakh'kor budand

Mardonu zanoni munofik' [monandi iakdigar va] az iak gurukh'and: ba korkh'oi zisht farmon medikh'and va az nekikh'o bozmedorand va dastkh'oi kheshro [az infok'] furu mebandand [va] Allokh' taoloro faromush kardand. Pas, Allokh' taolo [niz bo betafovuti] ononro ba faromushi supurd [va rakh'matu tavfik'ashro az onon salb namud]. Be gumon, munofik'on kh'amon fosik'onand

Allokh' taolo ba mardonu zanoni munofik' va [kh'amchunin] ba kofiron va'dai otashi duzakh dodaast, ch'ovidona dar on khokh'and mond. Kh'amon [otash] baroiashon kofist va Allokh' taolo la'natashon kardaast va azobi poidor [dar pesh] dorand

[Shumo munofik'on] Kh'ammonandi kasone [kh'asted], ki pesh az shumo budand, [balki] onon az shumo nerumandtar budand va amvolu farzandoni beshtare doshtand. Pas, az bakh'rai khesh [dar dunio] barkhurdor shudand va shumo niz az bakh'rai khud barkhurdor shuded kh'amchunon ki onon ki pesh az shumo budand [niz] az bakh'rai khesh barkhurdor shudand. Va shumo [dar gunokh'i takzibi kh'ak' va tavkh'in ba paiombari khud] furu rafted, kh'amon tavre ki onon furu raftand. Onon a'molashon dar dunio va okhirat tabokh' gasht va ononand, ki tabokh'koronand

Oio khabari kasone, ki pesh az onon budand, ba onon narasidaast? [Kasone kh'amchun] K'avmi Nukh' va Od va Samud va k'avmi Ibrokh'im va askh'obi Madian [k'avmi Shuaib] va shakh'rkh'oi zerurushuda [-i k'avmi Lut], ki paiombaronashon daloili ravshan baroiashon ovardand [vale onon napaziruftand]. Pas, Allokh' taolo bar on nabud, ki [bo nuzuli azob] ba onon sitam kunad, balki khud bar kheshtan sitam mekardand

Va mardon va zanoni mu'min dustoni iakdigarand, [mardumro] ba neki farmon medikh'and va az nopisandi bozmedorand va namoz barpo mekunand va zakot mepardozand va az Allokh' taolo va paiombarash itoat menamoiand. Inonand, ki Allokh' taolo mavridi rakh'mat k'arorashon khokh'ad dod. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo shikastnopaziri kh'akim ast

Allokh' taolo ba mardonu zanoni mu'min bog'kh'oe [az bikh'isht] va'da dodaast, ki ch'uiborkh'o az zeri [darakhtoni] on ch'ori ast, ch'ovidona dar on khokh'and mond. Va [niz] khonakh'oi pokizae dar bikh'ishtkh'oi ch'ovidon [ba onon va'da dodaast] va khushnudii Allokh' taolo [az kh'amai inkh'o] bartar ast. In kh'amon [rastagori va] komiobii buzurg ast
Ei paiombar bo kofiron va munofik'on ch'ikh'od kun va bar onon sakhtgir bosh. Va ch'oigokh'ashon duzakh ast va chi bad saranch'omest!

[Munofik'on] Ba Allokh' taolo savgand iod mekunand, ki [sukhanoni nopisande dar borai Allokh' taolo va paiombarash] naguftaand va ba rosti, ki sukhani kufr guftaand va pas az Islom ovardanashon [boz] kofir shudand [va bo dasisa baroi k'atli paiombar] tasmim ba kore giriftand, ki dar on muvaffak' nashudand. Va ba aibch'ui [va mukholifat] barnakhostand, magar pas az onki Allokh' taolo va paiombarash [bo bakhshidani g'anoim] ononro az fazli khesh beniioz kardand. Pas, agar tavba kunand, baroiashon bekh'tar ast va agar rui bigardonand, Allokh' taolo ononro dar dunio va okhirat ba azobi dardnok duchor mesozad va dar zamin kh'ech' korsozu iovare nakhokh'and dosht
Ba'ze az onon bo Allokh' taolo [akh'du] paimon bastand, ki: <<Agar [Allokh' taolo] az fazli khud [nasibe] ba mo dikh'ad, kh'atman, sadak'a [va zakot] khokh'em dod va az nakukoron khokh'em bud>>
Pas chun [Allokh' taolo] az fazli khud ba onon [nasibe] bakhshid, nisbat ba on bukhl varzidand va [az on paimon] ru gardondand va [az kh'ak'] sarpechi kardand

Pas, bo sazoi onki bo Allokh' taolo khilofi va'da kardand va ba on khotir, ki durug' meguftand, [Allokh' taolo niz] to ruze, ki Uro [dar k'iiomat] mebinand, dar dilkh'oiashon dog' [-u nangi] nifok' nikh'od
Oio nadonistaand, ki Allokh' taolo rozu nach'voiashonro [ki dar makh'filkh'oiashon baion meshavad, ba khubi] medonad va Allokh' taolo donoi rozkh'oi nikh'on ast?

[Munofik'on] Kasone [kh'astand], ki bar mu'minon aib megirand, ki ba khosti khesh sadak'ot [-i bisior] medikh'and va [kh'amchunin, fuk'aro va] afrodero, ki besh az tavoni moli khesh chize [baroi sadak'a] nameioband, maskhara mekunand. Allokh' taolo ononro ba tamaskhur megirad va baroiashon azobi dardnok [dar pesh] khokh'ad bud

[Ei paiombar] Chi baroi onon omurzish bikhokh'i, chi omurzish nakhokh'i, [sude ba kh'olashon nadorad, kh'atto] agar kh'aftod bor baroiashon omurzish bikhokh'i, Allokh' taolo kh'argiz ononro nameomurzad, charo ki ba Allokh' taolo va paiombarash kufr varzidand, va Allokh' taolo gurukh'i nofarmonro kh'idoiat namekunad

Vomondagon [az g'azvai Tabuk] pas az [mukholifat bo] Rasulullokh' az khonanishinii khud shodmon shudand va az inki bo amvolu ch'onkh'oi khesh dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo ch'ikh'od kunand, karokh'at doshtand va [ba afrodi sustimon] meguftand: <<Dar in garmo rakh'sipor [-i ch'ikh'od] nashaved>>. [Ei paiombar ba onon] Bigu: <<Agar darmeioftand, otashi duzakh [az in bisior] suzontar ast>>
Ba sazoi onchi mekardand, boiad [dar dunio] kam bikhandand va [dar okhirat] bisior bigiriand

Va agar Allokh' taolo turo ba suii gurukh'e az onkh'o bozgardond va az tu baroi kh'amrokh'i [dar ch'ikh'odi digar] ich'ozat khostand, bigu: <<[Az in pas] Kh'argiz bo man rakh'sipor [-i ch'ikh'od] nakhokh'ed shud va kh'argiz kh'amrokh' bo man bo kh'ech' dushmane nabard nakhokh'ed kard, zero shumo nakhustinbor ba khonanishini rizoiiat doded, pas, bo khonanishinon binishined

Va kh'argiz bar kh'ech' murdae az onon namoz nakhon va [baroi duo khondan va talabi omurzish] bar sari k'abrash naist, [charo ki] be tardid, onon ba Allokh' taolo va paiombarash kufr varzidaand va dar kh'ole murdand, ki nofarmon budand

Va [ei paiombar, afzunii] amvol va farzandonashon turo shigiftzada nakunad. Ba rosti, ch'uz in nest, ki Allokh' taolo mekhokh'ad ba in [vasila] dar dunio azobashon kunad va dar kh'ole ki kofirand, ch'onashon baroiad

Va kh'angome ki surae nozil shavad [va amr mekunad], ki <<Ba Allokh' taolo imon biiovared va kh'amrokh'i paiombarash ch'ikh'od kuned>>, sarvatmandonashon [baroi naraftan ba ch'ikh'od] az tu ich'ozat mekhokh'and va meguiand: <<Bigzor, mo bo khonanishinon boshem>>
Onon rozi shudand, ki bo khonanishinon boshand va bar dilkh'oiashon mukh'r [-i nifok'] nikh'oda shudaast. Pas, [khairu salokh'i kheshro] darnameioband
Ammo paiombar va kasone, ki bo u imon ovardaand, bo amvolu ch'onkh'oi khud [dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo] ch'ikh'od kardand. Ononand, ki kh'amai nekikh'o baroi eshon ast va ononand ki rastagorand
Allokh' taolo bar eshon bog'kh'oe [az bikh'isht] mukh'aiio kardaast, ki ch'uiborkh'o az zeri [darakhtoni] on ch'ori ast [va] ch'ovidona dar on memonand. In [kh'amon rastagori va] komiobii buzurg ast

Va uzrtaroshoni bodiianishin omadand, to ba onon ich'ozati [maofiiat az ch'ikh'od] doda shavad va kasone, ki [dar iddaoi imoni khud] ba Allokh' taolo va paiombarash durug' meguftand, [biduni kh'ech' uzre va ich'ozate ba ch'oii ch'ikh'od] khonanishin boshand. Ba zudi ba kasone az onon, ki kufr varzidand, azobi dardnok khokh'ad rasid

Bar notavonon [zanon va kudakon] va bemoron va bar kasone, ki chize nameioband, [to dar rokh'i ch'ikh'od] kharch' kunand, agar baroi Allokh' taolo va paiombarash khairkhokh'i kunand, gunokh'e nest [ki dar ch'ikh'od shirkat nakunand]. Bar nakukoron [-i eshon niz] kh'ech' rokh'e [baroi sarzanish va much'ozot] nest va Allokh' taolo omurzandai mekh'rubon ast

Va [kh'amchunin] gunokh'e nest bar kasone, ki chun nazdat omadand, to [baroi raftan ba ch'ikh'od bar chakh'orpoe] savorashon kuni, [ba onon] gufti: <<Chize paido namekunam, ki shumoro bar on binshonam>>. Onon bozgashtand, dar kh'ole ki chashmonashon az in andukh' ashkbor bud, ki chize nameioband, to [dar rokh'i ch'ikh'od] kharch' kunand

Rokh' [-i sarzanishu much'ozot] tankh'o baroi kasone [kushoda] ast, ki bo onki tavongar [va imkoni ch'ikh'od dorand], az tu ich'ozat mekhokh'and [ki dar ch'ikh'od shirkat nakunand]. Onon ba in rizoiiat dodand, ki bo khonanishinon boshand va Allokh' taolo bar dilkh'oiashon mukh'r [-i nifok'] zadaast, pas, [khairu salokh'i kheshro] darnameioband

Vak'te [az g'azvai Tabuk] ba suiashon bargarded, baroiaton uzr meovarand. [Ei paiombar] Bigu: <<Uzr naiovared, mo kh'argiz [sukhani] shumoro bovar namekunem. Dar kh'ak'ik'at, Allokh' taolo moro az akhbori shumo ogokh' kardaast va ba zudi Allokh' taolo va paiombarash raftoratonro khokh'and did [ki oio tavba mekuned io bar nifok' memoned]. On gokh' ba suii [Allokh' taoloi] donoi pinkh'on va oshkor bozgardonda meshaved va U shumoro az onchi mekarded, ogokh' mekunad>>

[Ei mu'minon, pas az ch'ang] vak'te ba suii onon [ munofik'on] bozgarded, baroiaton ba Allokh' taolo savgand iod mekunand, to az [gunokh'i] onon chashmpushi kuned. Pas, az eshon ru bigardoned, [charo ki] be tardid, onon palidand va ba [sazoi] onchi mekardand, ch'oigokh'ashon duzakh ast
Baroiaton savgand iod mekunand, to az onon khushnud shaved, [kh'atto] agar shumo az on rozi shaved, Allokh' taolo kh'argiz az gurukh'i nofarmon rozi namegardad
Kufru nifok'i a'rob [-i bodiianishin az digaron] shadidtar ast va sazovortarand, ki kh'ududi onchiro, ki Allokh' taolo bar paiombarash nozil kardaast, nadonand. Va Allokh' taolo donovu kh'akim ast

Va barkhe az a'rob [-i bodiianishin] kh'astand, ki onchiro [dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo] kharch' mekunand, khasorate [baroi khud] medonand va baroiaton intizori peshomadkh'oi bad dorand [to az shumo rakh'oi ioband]. Peshomadi bad baroi onon khokh'ad bud va Allokh' taolo shunavovu donost

Va barkhe az a'rob [-i bodiianishin] kh'astand, ki ba Allokh' taolo va ruzi vopasin imon dorand va onchiro, ki infok' mekunand, boisi nazdiki ba Allokh' taolo va duokh'oi paiombar [dar kh'ak'k'i khesh] medonand. Ogokh' boshed! [In infok'] Moiai nazdikii onkh'ost. Allokh' taolo [dar k'iiomat] ononro dar ch'ivori rakh'mati khesh darkhokh'ad ovard. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo omurzandai mekh'rubon ast

Va peshgomoni nakhustin az mukh'och'ironu ansor va kasone, ki ba neki az onon pairavi kardand, Allokh' taolo az onon khushnud gasht va onon [niz] az U khushnud shudand va baroiashon bog'kh'oe [dar bikh'isht] mukh'aiio kardaast, ki ch'uiborkh'o az zeri [darakhtoni] on ch'ori ast, ch'ovidona dar on khokh'and mond. In kh'amon [rastagori va] komiobii buzurg ast

Va barkhe az a'rob [-i bodiianishini Madina], ki peromuni shumo kh'astand, [gurukh'i] munofik'and va az akh'li Madina [niz] gurukh'e ba nifok' khu giriftaand. [Ei paiombar] Tu ononro nameshinosi, [vale] mo ononro meshinosem. Ononro du bor azob khokh'em kard, sipas ba suii azobi buzurg [dar k'iiomat] firistoda meshavand

Va gurukh'i digar ba gunokh'oni khud [dar borai firor az ch'ikh'od] e'tirof kardaand. [Onon] Kori shoista va noshoistaro ba kh'am omekhtaand. Umed ast Allokh' taolo tavbai eshonro bipazirad, [charoki] be tardid, Allokh' taolo omurzandai mekh'rubon ast

Az amvoli onon [tavbakoron] sadak'a [va zakot] bigir, to ba in vasila ononro [az gunokh'] pok gardoni va darach'otashonro bolo bibari va baroiashon duo kun, [charoki] iak'inan duoi tu oromish baroi ononast. Va Allokh' taolo shunavovu donost
Oio namedonand, ki Allokh' taolo ast, ki tavbaro az bandagonash mepazirad va sadak'otro mesitonad va be tardid, Allokh' taolost, ki tavbapaziri mekh'rubon ast

Va [ei paiombar, ba mutakhallifon az ch'ikh'od va tavbakoron] bigu: <<Ba amal kushed [va onchiro, ki az dast dodaed, ch'ubron kuned]. Pas, Allokh' taolo va paiombarash va mu'minon korkh'oi shumoro khokh'and did va ba zudi ba suii [Allokh' taoloi] donoi pinkh'onu oshkor bozgardonda meshaved, sipas U [dar k'iiomat] shumoro az onchi anch'om medoded, ogokh' mesozad>>

Va gurukh'i digar [az mutakhallifoni Tabuk kh'astand, ki sarnavishtashon] mavkul [vobastashuda] ba farmoni Allokh' taolo ast: io azobashon mekunad va io tavbaashonro mepazirad. Va Allokh' taolo donovu kh'akim ast

Va kasone [az munofik'on kh'astand], ki baroi ziion rasondan [ba musulmonon] va [tak'viiati] kufru tafrik'aafkani miioni mu'minon masch'ide sokhtand, [to] kamingokh'e boshad baroi kasone, ki bo Allokh' taolo va paiombarash az pesh dar ch'ang budand va, albatta, onon savgand iod mekunand, ki k'asde ch'uz neki [va khidmat] nadoshtaem. Va Allokh' taolo guvokh'i medikh'ad, ki onon, kh'atman, durug'gu kh'astand

Ei paiombar] Kh'argiz dar on masch'id [ba namoz] naist, [zero] shoistatar ast dar masch'ide [ba namoz] biisti, ki az ruzi nakhust bar poiai parkh'ezgori bino shudaast. [Ore, masch'idi K'ubost] Ki dar on, mardone kh'astand, ki dust medorand, ki [az gunokh'u oludagi] poku pokiza gardand. Va Allokh' taolo pokizagonro dust medorad

Oio kase, ki bunioni [kori] kheshro bar poiai parkh'ezgori va khushnudii Allokh' taolo bino nikh'oda,bekh'tar ast io kase, ki bunioni kheshro bar labi partgokh'i fururekhtanie bino nikh'odaast va bo on dar otashi duzakh sarnagun megardad? Va Allokh' taolo gurukh'i sitamgoronro [ba sababi kufru nifok'ashon] kh'idoiat namekunad
On binoe, ki onon bunion nikh'odaand, paivasta dar dilkh'oiashon moiai tardid [va nifok'] khokh'ad bud, magar onki dilkh'oiashon pora-pora shavad [va bimirand]. Va Allokh' taolo donovu kh'akim ast

Be tardid, Allokh' taolo az mu'minon ch'onkh'o va amvolashonro ba [bakh'oi] inki bikh'isht baroi onon boshad, kharidaast, kh'amon kasone, ki dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo mech'angand va [kofironro] mekushand va [io khud ba dasti onkh'o] kushta meshavand. [In podosh] ba unvoni va'dai rostu durust dar Tavrot va Inch'il va K'ur'on bar ukh'dai Ust. Va kist, ki az Allokh' taolo ba paimoni khesh vafodortar ast? Pas, [ei mu'minon] ba muomilae, ki bo U kardaed, shodmon boshed va in kh'amon [rastagori va] komiobii buzurg ast

[Onon, ki chunin podoshe dorand, kh'amon] tavbakunandagon, parastishgaron, siposguzoron, ruzadoron, ruku'kunandagon, sach'dakunandagon, vodorandagon ba korkh'oi pisandida va bozdorandagon az korkh'oi nopisand va posdoroni kh'udud [va akh'komi] ilokh'i kh'astand. Va on mu'minonero, [ki chunin kh'astand, ba bikh'isht] bashorat bidekh'
Baroi paiombar va kasone, ki imon ovardand, sazovor nest, ki baroi mushrikon, pas az inki bar eshon oshkor shud, ki onon akh'li duzakhand, omurzish bikhokh'and, kh'archand az nazdikon boshand

Omurzishkhokh'ii Ibrokh'im baroi padarash [Ozar] ch'uz ba khotiri va'dae, ki ba u doda bud, surat nagirift, vale kh'angome ki baroiash oshkor shud, ki vai dushmani Allokh' taolost, az u bezori ch'ust [va baroiash duo nakard]. Ba rosti, ki Ibrokh'im, base niioishgar va burdbor bud

Va Allokh' taolo kh'argiz bar on nest, ki gurukh'ero pas az onki kh'idoiatashon kardaast, gumrokh' bigzorad. Magar onki chizero, ki boiad [az on] parkh'ez kunand, baroiashon ravshan karda boshad [va onon ba on amal nakarda boshand]. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo ba kh'ar chize donost
Dar kh'ak'ik'at, farmonravoii osmonkh'o va zamin az oni Allokh' taolost. [Ust, ki] zinda mekunad va memironad va shumo ba ch'uz Allokh' taolo kh'ech' korsozu iovare nadored

Be gumon, Allokh' taolo bar paiombar va mukh'och'irin va ansor, ki dar kh'angomi dushvori [g'azvai Tabuk] az U pairavi kardand, rakh'mat ovard, ba'd az onki nazdik bud dilkh'oi gurukh'e az onon bilag'zhad [va ba sababi sakhtikh'oi farovon ch'ikh'odro tark kunand], pas, [boz] tavbai ononro paziruft. Be tardid, U [nisbat] ba onon dilsuz [va] mekh'rubon ast

Va ba on se nafar, ki [az shirkat dar g'azvai Tabuk] takhalluf namudand [va pazirishi tavbaashon ba ta'khir aftod, niz lutfu ekh'son namud],on gokh' ki [musulmonon az onon, ki buridand va] zamin bokh'amai farokhiiash bar eshon tang shud va az khud [niz] ba tang omadand va donistand, ki az Allokh' taolo ch'uz ba suii khudi U panokh'e nest. Pas, [Allokh' taolo bo bakhshoishi khesh] ba onon bozgasht, to tavba kunand [va az eshon darguzasht]. Iak'inan, Allokh' taolo ast, ki tavbapaziri mekh'rubon ast
Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, az Allokh' taolo parvo kuned va bo rostguion boshed

Sazovor nest, ki akh'li Madina va a'rob [-i bodiianishin] peromuni eshon az [kh'amrokh'i bo] Rasulullokh' bozmonand va kh'ifzi ch'oni kheshro muk'addam bar u shumorand, zero dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo kh'ech' tashnagi va ranch'u gurusnagie ba onon namerasad va dar kh'ech' makone, ki kofironro ba khashm meovarad, k'adam nameguzorand va az dushman kh'ech' [shikast va] zarbae namekhurand, magar inki ba [podoshi] on kori shoista baroiashon sabt meshavad. Barosti, ki Allokh' taolo podoshi nakukoronro zoe' namegardonad

Va kh'ech' moli kuchak va buzurgero [dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo] infok' namekunand va [dar rokh'i ch'ikh'od] az kh'ech' sarzamine nameguzarand, magar inki [podoshash] bar eshon sabt meshavad, to Allokh' taolo podoshi nakutarin kirdorashonro ba onon bidikh'ad

Va sazovor nest, ki mu'minon kh'amagi rakh'sipor [-i ch'ikh'od] shavand. Pas, charo az kh'ar gurukh'e az onon iddae rakh'sipor nameshavand [va iddae niz kh'amrokh'i paiombar namemonand], to [ba sababi onchi az makh'zarash faro megirand] dar in ogokh'i biioband va k'avmi khudro vak'te ba suiashon bozgashtand, bim dikh'and? Boshad, ki onon [az kaifari ilokh'i bitarsand va] biparkh'ezand

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, bo kofirone, ki nazdiki [makh'alli zindagii] shumo kh'astand, bich'anged [to khatarashonro raf' namoed] va onon boiad dar shumo shiddatu khushunat biioband va bidoned, ki Allokh' taolo bo parkh'ezgoron ast

Va kh'angome ki surae nozil megardad, barkhe az onon [ba digare] meguiand: << In sura ba imoni kadom iake az shumo afzud>>? Ammo kasone, ki imon ovardaand, bar imonashon meafzoiad va [ba on] shodmon megardand
Va ammo kasone, ki dar dilkh'oiashon bemori [shakku nifok'e] ast, pas, palidi bar palidiiashon meafzoiad va dar kh'ole ki kofirand, memirand
Oio onon namebinand, ki kh'ar sol iak io du bor ozmoish meshavand? Ammo na tavba mekunand va na pand mepazirand

Va kh'angome ki surae nozil meshavad [ki akh'voli munofik'onro baion namudaast], ba'ze az onon ba ba'zi digar nigokh' mekunand [va meguiand]: <<Oio kase shumoro mebinad>>? Sipas [makhfiiona az on mach'lis] bozmegardand. Allokh' taolo dilkh'oiashonro [az khairu kh'idoiat] bozgardondaast, zero onon gurukh'e kh'astand, ki namefakh'mand

Iak'inan, paiombare az [miioni] khudi shumo ba suiaton omad, ki ranch'didanaton bar u [garonu] dushvor ast va bar [kh'idoiati] shumo sakht isror dorad va [nisbat] ba mu'minon dilsuz [va] mekh'rubon ast

Pas, [ei paiombar] agar [mushrikon va munofik'on az kh'ak' ruigardon shudand, bigu: <<Allokh' taolo baroi man kofist. Kh'ech' ma'bude [barkh'ak'] ch'uz U nest, tankh'o bar U tavakkal kardam va U Parvardigori Arshi buzurg ast>>
Alif, lom, ro. In oioti kitobi purkh'ikmat ast

Oio baroi mardum much'ibi shigiftist, ki ba marde az khudashon vakh'i kardaem, ki: <<Ba mardum [dar borai azobi okhirat] kh'ushdor bidekh' va ba kasone, ki imon ovardaand, bashorat bidekh', ki baroi onon nazdi Parvardigorashon podoshi nakust>>? Kofiron guftand: <<In [mard], kh'atman, ch'odugari oshkor ast>>

Be gumon, Parvardigori shumost, ki osmonkh'o va zaminro dar shash ruz ofarid, sipas bar Arsh k'aror girift. U kor [-i ch'akh'on]-ro tadbir mekunad, [va] kh'ech' shafoatgare nest, magar pas az ich'ozati U. In Allokh' taolost-Parvardigoraton, pas, Uro biparasted. Oio pand namegired?

Bozgashti kh'amai shumo ba suii Ust. Va'dai Allokh' taolo [dar mavridi k'iiomat] kh'ak' ast. Ust, ki ofarinishro og'oz mekunad, on gokh' [pas az marg] onro bozmegardonad,to kasonero, ki imon ovardaand va korkh'oi shoista kardaand, ba adolat podosh dikh'ad, kasone, ki kufr varzidand, ba sazoi onki kofir budand, sharbate az obi ch'ushon va azobi dardnok [dar pesh] dorand

Ust, ki khurshedro durakhshon namud va mokh'ro tobon kard va baroiash ch'oigokh'kh'o [-i mushakhkhase] k'aror dod to [bo tag'iir va vaz'i mokh'] shumorishi solkh'o va kh'isob [-i zindagii khud]-ro bidoned. Allokh' taolo inkh'oro ch'uz ba kh'ak' naofaridaast. U nishona[-kh'oi khud]-ro baroi gurukh'e, ki medonand, ba tafsil baion mekunad
Be gumon, dar omadushudi shabu ruz va onchi Allokh' taolo dar osmonkh'o va zamin ofaridaast, baroi kasone, ki parvo mekunand, nishonakh'o[-i k'udrati ilokh'i] ast
Onon, ki ba didori Mo umed [va bovar] nadorand va ba zindagonii dunio khushnudand va ba on dilbastaand va kasone, ki az oioti Mo g'ofiland
Inon ba sazoi onchi mekardand, ch'oigokh'ashon otashi [duzakh] ast

Be tardid, kasone, ki imon ovardaand va korkh'oi shoista kardaand, Parvardigorashon ononro ba posi imonashon ba bog'kh'o [-i bikh'ishti pur] ne'mat kh'idoiat mekunad, ki ch'uiborkh'o az zeri [darakhtoni] on ch'ori ast

Duoiashon dar onch'o [in ast]: <<Ilokh'o, Tu poku munazzakh'i>> va durudashon [dar onch'o]: <<Salom>> ast va poioni duoiashon in ast, ki: <<Kh'amdu sipos, makhsusi Allokh' taolo - Parvardigori ch'akh'oniion ast>>

Va agar [Allokh' taolo] baroi mardum, badiro bo kh'amon shitob mekhost, ki onon nekiro mekhokh'and [va nafrinkh'oe, ki dar kh'ak'k'i khud va amvolu farzandonashon mekunand, mustach'ob mekard], kh'atman, ach'alashon faro rasida bud. Pas, kasonero ki ba didori Mo umed [-u bovar] nadorand, vomeguzorem, to dar [gumrokh'i va] sarkashiiashon sargardon bimonand

Va chun ba inson gazande merasad, [dar kh'ar kh'ole, ki boshad] ba pakh'lu khobida io nishasta io istoda Moro mekhonad. Pas, kh'amin ki on gazandro az vai bartaraf kardem, chunon meravad ki gui kh'argiz Moro baroi daf'i gazande, ki ba u rasida bud, nakhondaast. Bakh'amin surat, baroi isrofkoron [niz] onchi mekardand, [dar nazarashon] orosta shudaast

Va [ei mushrikon] be tardid, mo ummatkh'oi pesh az shumoro, kh'angome ki sitam kardand, kh'alok kardem, dar kh'ole ki paiombaronashon bo daleli ravshan ba suiashon omadand va [-le] onon bar on nabudand, ki imon ovarand. Mo gurukh'i much'rimonro in guna kaifar medikh'em
Sipas ba'd az onon shumo [mardum]-ro ch'onishinoni onkh'o [dar] zamin k'aror dodem, to bingarem, ki chiguna raftor mekuned

Va kh'angome ki oioti ravshani Mo bar onon khonda meshavad, kasone, ki ba didori Mo [dar k'iiomat] umed nadorand, meguiand: <<[Ei Mukh'ammad] K'ur'one g'air az in biiovar [ki mutobik'i maili mo boshad], io onro tag'iir bidekh'>>. [Tu, ei paiombar, ba onon ] bigu: <<Man kh'ak' nadoram, ki onro az peshi khud tag'iir dikh'am va pairavi namekunam magar az chize, ki bar man vakh'i meshavad va agar az Parvardigoram nofarmoni kunam, az azobi ruzi buzurg metarsam>>

Bigu: <<Agar Allokh' taolo mekhost, na man onro bar shumo mekhondam va na U [Allokh' taolo] shumoro az on ogokh' mekard. Ba rosti, ki pesh az in [da'vat] umrero dar miioni shumo guzarondaam. Oio nameandeshed>>?
Pas, kist sitamgortar az onki bar Allokh' taolo durug' mebandad io oiotashro durug' meangorad? Be gumon, much'rimon rastagor nakhokh'and shud

Va [mushrikon] ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo chizkh'oero meparastand, ki na ba onon ziione merasonand va na sudashon mebakhshad va meguiand: <<In butkh'o [vositakh'o va] shafoatgaroni mo nazdi Allokh' taolo kh'astand>>. [Ei paiombar] Bigu: <<Oio [ba gumoni khud] Allokh' taoloro az chize [sharike] ogokh' mesozed, ki dar osmonkh'o va zamin [baroiash k'oiled va khud] namedonad?>> U munazzakh' ast va az onchi bo vai sharik mesozand, bartar ast

[Dar og'oz] Mardum ch'uz ummati vokh'id [va iaktoparast] nabudand, sipas ikhtilof kardand.Va agar peshtar [dar mavridi mukh'lat ba gunakh'goron va kh'isobrasi dar k'iiomat] sukhane az ch'onibi Parvardigorat baion nashuda bud, iak'inan, [dar kh'amin dunio] dar borai onchi bo kh'am ikhtilof mekunand, miionashon dovari meshud

Va [mushrikon] meguiand: <<Charo [mu'ch'iza va] nishonae az [ch'onibi] Parvardigorash bar u nozil nashudaast>>? [Ei paiombar] Bigu: <<[Ogokh'i az] G'aib tankh'o az oni Allokh' taolost, pas, intizor bikashed, ki man [niz] bo shumo az muntazironam>>

Va kh'angome ki ba mardum pas az [ziion va] ranch'e, ki ba onon rasidaast, [ne'matu] rakh'mate bichashonem, on gokh' dar oioti Mo [tamaskhuru] nairang mekunand. Bigu: <<Allokh' taolo dar nairang zadan sare'tar ast>>. Be tardid, firistodagon [farishtagon]-i Mo kh'archi nairang mekuned, menavisand

[Ei mardum] Ust, ki shumoro dar khushki va dario ba kh'arakat darmeovarad, to on gokh' ki dar [dario bar] kishti k'aror megired va [kishtikh'o] bo bodi dilpazir ononro [ba suii mak'sad] kh'arakat medikh'and va [sarnishinon] ba on shodmon meshavand. [Nogakh'on] Tufoni shadide mevazad va mavch' az kh'ar taraf [basuiashon] meoiad va gumon mekunand, ki rokh'i gureze nadorand [va kh'alok khokh'and shud, pas] Allokh' taoloro az ruii ikhlos mekhonand, ki: <<Agar moro az in [giriftori] nach'ot dikh'i, kh'atman, az siposguzoron khokh'em shud>>

Va chun [Allokh' taolo] nach'otashon medikh'ad, ba nokh'ak' dar zamin sarkashi [va sitam] mekunand. Ei mardum, sarkashi [va sitami] shumo tankh'o ba ziioni khudaton ast, [charo ki fak'at] bakh'rai [nochize az] zindagii dunio [mebared va] sipas bozgashtaton ba suii Mo khokh'ad bud,on gokh' shumoro az onchi mekarded, bokhabar mesozem

Ch'uz in nest, ki misoli zindagii dunio kh'amchun obest, ki az osmon furu rekhtem, pas, giiokh'oni [gunoguni] zamin az onchi mardum va chorpoion mekhurand, bo on daromekht [va ruiid] to on gokh' ki zamin piroiai khudro [bo gulkh'o va giiokh'on] bargirift va orosta shud va sokinonash pindoshtand, ki onon bar on tavonoie dorand [ki az makh'sulotash bakh'ramand gardand, vale nogakh'on] shabe io ruze farmoni [vaironii] Mo omad va on [kishtu meva]-ro chunon darav kardem, ki gui diruz kh'ech' nabudaast. Mo nishonakh'o[-i khud]-ro baroi mardume, ki meandeshand, inchunin ba ravshani baion mekunem
Va Allokh' taolo [shumoro] ba saroi salomat [bikh'isht] faro mekhonad va kh'arkiro bikhokh'ad, ba rokh'i rost kh'idoiat mekunad

Baroi kasone, ki neki kardaand, podoshi nek [bikh'isht] ast va afzun bar on [ru'iati Bori taolost] va tiragiiu khori chekh'rakh'oiashonro nakhokh'ad pushond. Inon akh'li bikh'ishtand va ch'ovidona dar on khokh'and mond

Va kasone, ki murtakibi badikh'o shudand, [bidonand] sazoi [kh'ar] badi kh'ammonandi on ast va khori [chekh'rakh'oi] ononro mepushonad va dar barobari [azobi] Allokh' taolo kh'ech' [mone' va] mukh'ofize nadorand. [Chunon meshavand, ki] gui chekh'rakh'oiashon bo porae az shabi torik pushida shudaast. Inon akh'li otashand va ch'ovidona dar on khokh'and mond

[Va ei paiombar, iod kun az] ruze, ki kh'amai ononro gird meovarem,on gokh' ba kasone, ki shirkat varzidaand, meguem: <<Shumo va sharikonaton [ma'budonaton] bar ch'oii khud bimoned>>. Sipas miioni onkh'o ch'udoi meafkanem va sharikonashon meguiand: <<Dar kh'ak'ik'at, shumo moro nameparastided
Va kofist, ki Allokh' taolo miioni mo va shumo guvokh'i dikh'ad, [ki mo ba shirkvarzii shumo rozi nabudem va] az parastishi shumo komilan bekhabar budem>>

Onch'ost, ki kh'ar kase onchiro az pesh firistodaast, meozmoiad va kh'amagi ba suii Allokh' taolo - korsozi kh'ak'ik'iiashon bozgardonda meshavand va durug'kh'oe, ki [dar borai shafoati butkh'o] meboftand, kh'ama makh'vu nobud megardad

[Ei paiombar, ba mushrikon] Bigu: <<Kist, ki az osmonu zamin ba shumo ruzi mebakhshad? Io kist, ki bar gushkh'o va didagon kh'okim ast? Va kist, ki [mavch'udi] zindaro az [modai] bech'on berun meovarad va [modai] bech'oni murdaro az [mavch'udi] zinda khorich' mesozad? Va kist, ki kori [ch'akh'onu ch'akh'oniion]-ro tadbir mekunad>>? Khokh'and guft: <<Allokh' taolo>>. Pas, bigu: <<Oio parvo namekuned>>?
Va pas az kh'ak'ik'at ch'uz gumrokh'i chist? Pas, chiguna [az kh'ak'] bozgardonda meshaved?
In guna sukhani Parvardigorat dar borai kasone, ki [az farmoni U] nofarmoni kardand, ba kh'ak'ik'at paivast, ki: <<Onon imon nameovarand>>

[Ei paiombar, ba mushrikon] Bigu: <<Oio az ma'budonaton [butkh'o] kase kh'ast, ki ofarinishro og'oz kunad va sipas onro [pas az marg] bozgardonad?>> Bigu: <<Allokh' taolo ast, ki ofarinishro og'oz mekunad va sipas onro bozmegardonad, pas, ba kuch'o munkh'arif meshaved?>>

Bigu: <<Oio az ma'budonaton kase kh'ast, ki ba suii kh'ak' rakh'bari kunad?>>. Bigu: <<[Allokh' taolo] ast, ki ba suii kh'ak' rakh'bari mekunad. Pas, oio kase, ki ba suii kh'ak' rakh'bari mekunad, sazovortar ast, ki pairavi shavad io kase, ki khud rokh' nameiobad, magar onki kh'idoiatash kunand? Pas, shumoro chi shudaast? Chiguna dovari mekuned?>>
Va beshtarashon ch'uz az gumon pairavi namekunand, [dar kh'ole ki] gumon kh'argiz [insonro] az [shinokhti] kh'ak' beniioz namekunad. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo ba onchi mekunand, donost

Va nashoiad, ki in K'ur'on az ch'onibi g'airi Allokh' taolo [va] ba durug' sokhta shuda boshad, balki tasdik'i kitobkh'oest, ki pesh az on omadaast va sharkh'i [akh'komi] onkh'ost va tardid dar on nest [va] az [ch'onibi] Parvardigori ch'akh'oniion [nozil shuda] ast

Io meguiand: <<[Mukh'ammad] On [sukhanon]-ro ba durug' [ba Allokh' taolo] nisbat dodaast>>? Bigu: <<Agar rost megued, pas, iak sura kh'ammonandi on biiovared va ba ch'uz Allokh' taolo kh'arkiro metavoned, [ba iori] bikhoned>>

[Chunin nest] Balki chizero durug' shumurdand, ki ba shinokhtash ikh'ota nadoshtand va kh'anuz vok'eiiati on [va kh'ak'ik'ati akhborash] bar eshon ravshan nashudaast. Kasone, ki pesh az onon budand, niz [oioti K'ur'onro] kh'aminguna durug' angoshtand. Pas, [ei paiombar] bingar, ki ok'ibati sitamgoron chiguna bud
Va az onon [mushrikon] kase kh'ast, ki ba on imon meovarad va az onon kase kh'ast, ki [kh'argiz] ba on imon nameovarad va Parvardigorat ba [kh'oli] mufsidon ogokh'tar ast

Va agar [kofiron] turo durug'gu angoshtand, pas, bigu: <<[Natich'ai] amali man baroi khudam va [sazoi] amali shumo baroi khudaton ast. Shumo az onchi man mekunam, bezored va man [niz] az onchi [shumo] mekuned bezoram>>
Va barkhe az onkh'o [dar zokh'ir] ba tu gush faro medikh'and, ammo magar tu metavoni noshunavoionro [ki az shunidani kalomi kh'ak' och'izand] shunavo kuni, kh'archand khiradvarzi nakunand?
Va az eshon kasone kh'astand, ki [bo chashmi zokh'iri] turo menigarand, ammo oio tu metavoni nobinoionro kh'idoiat kuni, kh'archand akh'li basirat naboshand?
Iak'inan, Allokh' taolo ba mardum kh'ech' sitame namekunad, vale mardum [kh'astand, ki bo shirku nofarmoni] ba kheshtan sitam mekunand

Va ruze, ki [Allokh' taolo] ononro [dar peshgokh'i khesh] gird meovarad, [chunon ekh'sos mekunand, ki] gui ch'uz soate az ruz [dar dunio] dirang nakardaand [va dar onch'o] iakdigarro meshinosand. Be tardid, kasone, ki didori Allokh' taoloro durug' meangoshtand, ziion didand va kh'idoiat naioftand

Va [ei paiombar] agar bakhshe az onchi [az azob]-ro, ki ba onon va'da dodaem, nishonat dikh'em io ch'oni turo [pesh az azobi onon] bigirem, [dar kh'ar kh'ol] bozgashtaton ba suii Most, on gokh' Allokh' taolo bar onchi mekunand, guvokh' ast

Kh'ar ummate paiombare dorad, pas, kh'angome ki paiombarashon omad [barkhe mu'min va barkhe kofir shudand; va ruzi k'iiomat] miioni onon ba adolat dovari meshavad va [kh'argiz] ba eshon sitam nakhokh'ad shud
[Mushrikon ba paiombar] meguiand: <<Agar [tu va pairavonat] rost megued, in va'dai [azob] kai khokh'ad bud>>?

Bigu: <<Man baroi khesh moliki kh'ech' ziionu sude nestam, magar onchi Allokh' taolo bikhokh'ad. Kh'ar ummate ach'ale dorad va on gokh' ki ach'alashon ba sar oiad, na soate [az on] ta'khir mekunand va na peshi megirand>>
[Ei paiombar, ba kofiron] bigu: <<Ba man bigued agar azobi U shabona io dar [vak'ti] ruz bar shumo nozil gardad, [chi mekuned va] gunakh'koron chi chizero az on [azob] ba shitob mekhokh'and?>>
Oio pas az onki [azob] vok'e' shud, bovarash mekuned? Oio aknun? Va kh'ol onki [peshtar] onro ba shitob mekhosted
Sipas ba kasone, ki sitam kardand, gufta meshavad: <<Azobi ch'ovidonaro bichashed. Oio chize dar barobari onchi mekarded much'ozot meshaved?>>

Va [ei paiombar, mushrikon] Az tu khabar megirand [ki]: <<Oio on [azob] kh'ak'ik'at dorad>>? Bigu: <<Ore, savgand ba Parvardigoram,ki kh'atman, kh'ak'ik'at dorad va shumo nametavoned [Allokh' taoloro az vuk'ui maod va azob] darmonda kuned>>

Va kh'ar ki [bo irtikobi shirku gunokh'] sitam kardaast, agar onchi dar zamin ast, [dar ikhtiior] doshta boshad, kh'atman, onro baroi bozkharidi [khud az azob] khud medikh'ad va [mushrikon] vak'te azobro bubinand, pushaimonii khudro pinkh'on mekunand va miionashon ba adolat dovari meshavad va bar eshon sitam nameravad

Ogokh' boshed! Dar kh'ak'ik'at onchi dar osmonkh'o va zamin ast, [kh'ama] az oni Allokh' taolost. Ogokh' boshed! Be tardid, va'dai Allokh' taolo [dar mavridi kaifari kofiron] rost ast, vale beshtarashon namedonand
Ust, ki zinda mekunad va memironad va [kh'amagi] ba suii U bozgardonda meshaved
Ei mardum, barosti, baroi shumo az ch'onibi Parvardigoraton mav'izae omadaast va shifoe baroi onchi dar dilkh'ost va kh'idoiatu rakh'mate baroi mu'minon
Bigu: <<[Mu'minon] Boiad ba bakhshishu rakh'mati Allokh' taolo shodmon shavand, ki in [ne'mat] az onchi meanduzand, bekh'tar ast>>

Bigu: <<Ba man khabar dikh'ed, ki onchi az [ne'mat va] ruzi, ki Allokh' taolo baroiaton firistodaast, [charo] bakhshe az onro kh'arom va [bakhshi digarro] kh'alol talak'k'i kardaed>>? Bigu: <<Oio Allokh' taolo bar shumo chunin dastur dodaast io bar Allokh' taolo durug' mebanded?>>

Va kasone, ki bar Allokh' taolo durug' mebandand, [dar borai] ruzi k'iiomat chi mepindorand? Be gumon, Allokh' taolo bar [kh'amai] mardum fazl [-u bakhshish] dorad, vale beshtarashon sipos nameguzorand

Va [ei paiombar] tu mashg'uli kh'ech' kore nesti va kh'ech' [oiate az] onro namekhoni va [shumo niz ei mardum] kh'ech' kore namekuned, magar inki on gokh' ki ba on mepardozed, Mo bar [korkh'oi] shumo guvokh'em va kh'amvazni zarrae - [na] dar zamin va na dar osmon - az Parvardigorat pinkh'on nest va [kh'atto] kuchaktar io buzurgtar az on [niz] chize nest, magar inki bar kitobi ravshan [sabt shuda] ast
Ogokh' boshed! Dustoni Allokh' taolo na tarse khokh'and dosht va na andukh'gin meshavand
[Kh'amon] Kasone, ki imon ovardand va parkh'ezgori mekardand
Baroi onon dar zindagii dunio va dar okhirat bashorat ast. Sukhanoni Allokh' taolo [dar borai piruzi va podoshi du ch'akh'on] tag'iirnopazir ast. In kh'amon [rastagori va] komiobii buzurg ast
[Ei paiombar] Sukhani onon turo g'amgin nakunad. Be tardid, tamomi izzat [-u piruzmandi] az oni Allokh' taolost [va] U shunavovu donost

Ogokh' boshed! Kh'ar ki [va kh'ar chi] dar osmonkh'o va zamin ast, az oni Allokh' taolo ast, pas,kasone, ki ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo sharikonero mekhonand, az chi pairavi mekunand? Inon ch'uz az [tardidu] gumon pairavi namekunand va ch'uz durug' nameguiand

Ust, ki shabro baroiaton padid ovard, to dar on bioromed va ruzro ravshan sokht [to dar partavi nurash ba kor bipardozed]. Be tardid, dar inkh'o baroi gurukh'e, ki [sukhanoni kh'ak'ro] meshunavand, nishonakh'ost

[Mushrikon] Guftand: <<Allokh' taolo farzande baroi khud ikhtiior kardaast>>. Munazzakh' ast U [va] beniioz ast. Onchi dar osmonkh'o va zamin ast, az oni Ust. [Ei mushrikon] Shumo bar in [iddao] dalele nadored. Oio chizero, ki namedoned, ba durug' ba Allokh' taolo nisbat medikh'ed?
Bigu: <<Kasone, ki ba Allokh' taolo nisbati durug' medikh'and, kh'argiz rastagor nameshavand>>
Onon bakh'ra [-i andak] dar dunio [dorand], sipas bozgashtashon ba sui Most. On gokh' ba [sazoi] onki kufr mevarzidand, azobi sakht ba onon mechashonem

[Ei paiombar] Dostoni Nukh'ro bar onon bozgu, on gokh' ki bar k'avmash guft: <<Ei k'avmi man, agar monandi man [dar miioni shumo] va andarz dodan ba oioti Allokh' taolo bar shumo garon omadaast, [bidoned, ki man] bar Allokh' taolo tavakkal kardaaam, pas, [dar tavtea va] koraton bo sharikoni khud [alaikh'i man] kh'amdast shaved va dar koraton pardapushi nakuned,on gokh' [kh'ar chi dar dil dored va metavoned] alaikh'i man ba kor banded va mukh'latam nadikh'ed

Agar [az da'vati kh'ak'] ruigardon shuded, pas, [bidoned, ki] man podoshe az shumo nakhostaam, [charo ki] podosham tankh'o bar Allokh' taolo ast va man dastur ioftaam, ki az taslimshudagon [-i avomiri ilokh'i] bosham>>

Pas, [k'avmash] uro durug'gu angoshtand va Mo u va kasonero, ki dar kishti kh'amrokh'ash budand, nach'ot dodem va ononro ch'onishin [-i peshiniion] sokhtem va kasonero, ki oioti Moro durug' meangoshtand, g'ark' kardem. Pas, bingar, ki saranch'omi kh'ushdorioftagon chiguna bud

Sipas ba'd az u paiombarone ba suii k'avmash firistodem va mu'ch'izoti ravshan [bar eshon] ovardand, vale onkh'o bar on nabudand, ki ba chize imon biiovarand, ki az pesh onro durug' shumurda budand. Bad-in son, bar dilkh'oi tach'ovuzkoron [az kh'ududi ilokh'i] mukh'r menikh'em
Sipas ba'd az eshon Muso va Kh'orunro bo mu'ch'izoti khesh ba suii Fir'avn va buzurgoni k'avmash firistodem, vale onon gardankashi kardand va k'avme gunakh'kor budand
Pas, chun kh'ak' az nazdi mo ba suiashon omad, guftand: <<In, kh'atman, ch'odui oshkor ast>>
Muso guft: <<Oio vak'te kh'ak' ba suiaton omad, megued [ch'odust]? Oio in ch'odust? Va kh'ol onki ch'odugaron rastagor nameshavand>>

[Fir'avniion] Guftand: <<Oio ba suii mo omadai, to moro az shevae, ki padaronamonro bar on ioftaem, bozgardoni va [izzatu] buzurgi dar in sarzamin baroi shumo dutan boshad? Mo kh'argiz ba shumo du tan imon nameovarem>>
Va Fir'avn guft: <<Tamomi ch'odugaroni [mokh'iru] donoro nazdi man biiovared>>
Pas, chun ch'odugaron omadand, Muso ba onon guft: <<Onchi [az vasoili ch'odu] mekhokh'ed, biafkaned, [aknun] biafkaned>>
Pas, chun afkandand, Muso guft: <<Onchi ovardaed, ch'odust. Iak'inan, Allokh' taolo onro botil khokh'ad kard. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo kori mufsidonro islokh' namekunad
Va Allokh' taolo bo sukhanoni khesh kh'ak'ro [sobitu] poidor mekunad, kh'archand much'rimon karokh'at doshta boshand>>

Pas kh'ech' kas ba Muso imon naiovard, magar gurukh'e az k'avmi u [on kh'am] bo tarsi Fir'avn va atrofiionash, ki [mabodo] ononro biozorad. Va beshak, Fir'avn dar zamin sarkash [-u ch'okh'talab] bud va ba rosti, ki u az isrofkoron [dar kufru ch'inoiat] bud
Muso guft: <<Ei k'avmi man, agar ba Allokh' taolo imon ovardaed va agar akh'li taslim kh'asted, pas, bar U tavakkal kuned>>
Pas, onon guftand: <<Bar Allokh' taolo tavakkal kardaem. Parvardigoro, moro dastkhushi fitna [va shikanch'a va ozori] gurukh'i sitamgoron k'aror madekh'
Va ba [fazlu] rakh'mati khesh moro az [sharri] gurukh'i kofiron rakh'oi bubakhsh>>

Ba Muso va barodarash [Kh'orun] vakh'ii kardem, ki: <<Baroi k'avmi khud, khonakh'oe dar [sarzamini] Misr bargired va khonakh'oiatonro ibodatgokh' k'aror dikh'ed va namoz barpo dored. Va[ei Muso] mu'minonro [ba piruzi va bikh'isht] bashorat bidekh'>>

Muso guft: <<Parvardigoro, be gumon, tu ba Fir'avn va atrofiionash zinatu amvol [-i farovon] dar zindagii dunio dodai.Parvardigoro, to [ba on vasila mardumro] az rokh'at gumrokh' kunand. Parvardigoro, amvolashonro nobud kun va dilkh'oiashonro sakht bigardon, ki imon naovarand, to [vak'te ki] azobi dardnokro bubinand>>
[Allokh' taolo] Farmud: Kh'atman, duoi shumo du nafar pazirufta shud, pas, istik'omat kuned va az rokh'i kasone, ki namedonand, pairavi nakuned>>

Va [saranch'om] Bani Isroilro az dario guzarondem,on gokh' Fir'avn va sipokh'iionash az ruii sitam va tach'ovuz dar paii onon raftand, to kh'angome ki g'ark'obi U [Fir'avn]-ro faro girift, [bo noumedi] guft: <<Imon ovardam, ki kh'ech' ma'bude [bar kh'ak'] nest, magar kase, ki Bani Isroil ba U imon ovardaand va man az taslimshudagonam>>
[Ba u gufta shud ] <<Inak [imon meovari]? Va kh'ol onki peshtar sarpechi mekardi va az mufsidon budi?
[Bidon, ki] imruz paikari [bech'oni] turo bar balandii [sokh'il] meandozem, to baroi oiandagonat moiai ibrat boshad va ba rosti, bisiore az mardum az nishonakh'oi [tavonu tadbiri] mo g'ofiland

Va be tardid, Mo Bani Isroilro dar ch'oigokh'i shoista [dar sarzamini Shom] ch'oi dodem va az ne'matkh'oi pokiza ruziiashon kardem. Pas, onkh'o ikhtilof nakardand, magar pas az onki ilm [ba kh'ak'k'oniiati K'ur'on] ba suiashon omad. [Ei paiombar] Parvardigorat ruzi k'iiomat dar borai onchi ikhtilof mekardand, kh'atman, miionashon kh'ukm mekunad
