Pas, agar dar onchi bar tu nozil kardaem, tardide dori, az kasone, ki pesh az tu kitob [-kh'oiTavrot va Inch'il]-ro mekhondand, suol kun. Iak'inan kh'ak' az tarafi Parvardigorat ba suii tu omadaast. Pas, kh'argiz az tardidkunandagon nabosh
Va [kh'amchunin] az kasone nabosh, ki oioti Allokh' taoloro durug' angoshtand, ki az ziionkoron khokh'i bud
Be tardid, kasone, ki sukhani Parvardigorat dar borai [kufr dar dunio bar] onon takh'ak'k'uk' ioftaast, imon nameovarand
Garchi kh'ar nishona [va pande] baroiashon biioiad, [magar] vak'te ki azobi dardnokro bubinand

Kh'ech' shakh're nabud, ki [akh'lash] imon biiovarad va imonash ba kh'oli on sud bakhshad, magar k'avmi Iunus, ki chun [ba mavk'e'] imon ovardand, azobi khori [va rasvoi] dar zindagii dunioro az onon bartaraf namudem va to muddate [ki zinda budand, az ne'matkh'oi duniavi] barkhurdorashon sokhtem
Va [ei paiombar] agar Parvardigorat mekhost, kh'atman, kh'ar ki dar zamin ast, kh'amagiiashon imon meovardand. Pas, oio tu mardumro vodor mekuni, ki mu'min shavand?
Va kh'ech' kase nametavonad, [ba irodai khesh] imon ovarad, magar ba farmoni Allokh' taolo. Va [Allokh' taolo] palidi [va azobu khori]-ro bar kasone k'aror medikh'ad, ki nameandeshand

[Ei paiombar, ba mushrikon] Bigu: <<Bingared, ki [nishonakh'oi ravshani Allokh' taolo] dar osmonkh'o va zamin chist>>? Va[-le kh'amai] nishonakh'o va kh'ushdorkh'o baroi gurukh'e, ki imon nameovarand, sude namebakhshad
Oio onkh'o [chize] ch'uz kh'ammonandi ruzgori peshiniion [va azobkh'o va much'ozotkh'oiashon]-ro intizor mekashand? Bigu: <<Muntazir boshed, ki man [niz] bo shumo az muntazironam>>
Sipas [kh'angomi nuzuli azob] paiombaronamon va kasonero, ki [ba Allokh' taolo] imon ovardaand, nach'ot medikh'em, zero kh'ak' bar ukh'dai most, ki mu'minonro nach'ot dikh'em

Bigu: <<Ei mardum, agar dar dini man tardid dored, pas, [ogokh' boshed ki man] kasonero, ki shumo ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo meparasted, nameparastam, balki on Allokh' taoloro meparastam, ki ch'onatonro megirad va farmon ioftaam, ki az mu'minon bosham>>
Va [ba man amr shudaast] ki: <<Kh'ak'garoiona ba in din ru ovar va kh'argiz dar zumrai mushrikon nabosh
Va ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo, chizero, ki sudu ziione ba tu namerasonad, [ba parastishu niiozkhokh'i] makhon, ki agar chunin kuni, on gokh' kh'atman, az sitamgoron [-i mushrik] khokh'i bud

Va agar Allokh' taolo ziione ba tu birasonad, kh'ech' kase baroiash ba ch'uz U kh'ech' bozdorandae nest va agar baroiat irodai khaire namoiad, baroi fazl [-u bakhshishi] U kh'ech' mone'e nest. [U bakhshishi kheshro] Ba kh'ar kase az bandagonash, ki bikhokh'ad, merasonad va U omurzandai mekh'rubon ast>>

Bigu: <<Ei mardum, kh'ak' az ch'onibi Parvardigoraton baroiaton omadaast, pas, kh'ar ki kh'idoiat iobad, ba sudi khesh kh'idoiat meiobad va kh'ar ki gumrokh' gardad, ba ziioni khesh gumrokh' megardad va man [murok'ibu] korguzori shumo nestam>>
Va [ei paiombar] az onchi bar tu vakh'i meshavad pairavi kun va shikebo bosh, to Allokh' taolo [baini tu va kofiron] dovari kunad va U bekh'tarin dovar ast
Alif, lom, ro. In [K'ur'on] kitobest, ki oioti on istekh'kom ioftaast va sipas az ch'onibi kh'akimi ogokh' ba ravshani baion shudaast
[Paiomi paiombar in ast] Ki ch'uz Allokh'ro naparasted, [ki] be tardid, man az suii U baroiaton bimdikh'anda va bashoratgar kh'astam

Va in ki az Parvardigoraton omurzish bikhokh'ed, sipas ba dargokh'ash tavba kuned, to shumoro [dar zindagii dunio] to saromadi muaiiane ba khairu khubi bakh'ramand sozad va ba kh'ar bofazilate [ki iaktoparasti va nakukori pesha kardaast, podoshu] fuzuni bakhshad.Va agar [az imon] ru bigardoned, [bidoned, ki man] ba rosti, baroiaton az azobi ruze sakh'mgin metarsam
[Shumo ei mardum] Bozgashtaton ba suii Allokh' taolo ast va U bar kh'ar chize tavonost

Ogokh' boshed! Onkh'o [kufrro] dar sinakh'oiashon nikh'on mekunand, to onro az U [Allokh' taolo] pinkh'on dorand. Ogokh' boshed! On gokh' ki onon ch'omakh'oiashonro bar sar mekashand, Allokh' taolo on chi pinkh'on mesozand va on chi oshkor medorand, [kh'amaro] medonad. Be tardid, U ba asrori sinakh'o donost
Va kh'ech' ch'unbandae dar zamin nest, magar [in ki] ruziash bar ukh'dai Allokh' taolo ast va [U] k'arorgokh' va makh'alli margashro medonad. Kh'ama [inkh'o] dar kitobe ravshan [sabt] ast

Va Ust, ki osmonkh'o va zaminro dar shash ruz ofarid va [pesh az on] Arshi U bar ob bud, to shumoro biozmoiad, ki kadomaton nakukortared. Va agar [ba mushrikon] bigued: <<Shumo pas az marg barangekhta meshaved>>, kasone, ki kufr varzidand meguiand: <<In [K'ur'on chize] nest, magar ch'odue oshkor>>

Va agar mo azobashonro to chand muddate ba ta'khir andozem, albatta,[az ruii tamaskhur] meguiand: <<Chi chize mone'i [vuk'u'i] on shuda ast?>> Ogokh' boshed! Ruze, ki [azob] ba surog'ashon biioiad, az onon bozgardonida nakhokh'ad shud va on chiro ba maskhara megiriftand, domangirashon khokh'ad shud
Va agar az ch'onibi khesh rakh'mate ba inson bichashonem, sipas onro az u bigirem, kh'atman, dilsard [va] nosipos megardad
Va agar pas az ranch'e, ki ba u rasidaast, ne'mate ba u bichashonem, kh'atman, meguiad: <<Sakhtikh'o [va noguvorikh'o] az man dur shud>>. Kh'ak'k'o, ki u shodmonu fakhrfurush ast
Magar kasone, ki shikeboi namudand va korkh'oi nek kardand. Baroi eshon omurzishu podoshi buzurge [dar pesh] ast

Va [ei paiombar] mabodo [iblog'i] barkhe az on chiro, ki ba suiat vakh'i meshavad, tark kuni va sinaat az on ba tang oiad, ki [mushrikon] meguiand: <<Charo ganch'e bar u nozil nagashtaast io farishtae bo u naiomadaast>>? Ch'uz in nest, ki tu fak'at bimdikh'andai va Allokh' taolo [murok'ibu] korguzori kh'ar chizest
Io meguiand: <<[Mukh'ammad] On [kitob]-ro barsokhtaast>>. Bigu: <<Agar rost megued, dakh' sura barsokhta kh'ammonandi on biiovared va ba ch'uz Allokh' taolo kh'ar kiro metavoned, ba iori bikhoned>>

Pas, agar onon da'vatatonro napaziruftand, bidoned, ki [K'ur'on] fak'at ba ilmi Allokh' taolo nozil shudaast va in ki kh'ech' ma'bude [barkh'ak'] ch'uz U nest. Pas, oio taslim [-i amri Allokh' taolo va paiombar] meshaved?
Kasone, ki zindagii dunio va tach'ammuli onro mekhokh'and, [podoshi] korkh'oiashonro dar in [dunio] ba tamomi ba onon medikh'em va dar on [podosh kh'ech'] kamu koste nakhokh'and did
Inon kasone kh'astand, ki dar okhirat ba ch'uz otash [-i duzakh kh'ech' nasibe] nakhokh'and dosht va on chi dar dunio anch'om dodaand, bar bod raftaast va on chi mekardand, tabokh' ast

Oio kase [paiombar], ki daleli oshkore [K'ur'on] az Parvardigorash dorad va shokh'ide [Ch'abrail] az ch'onibi U [Allokh' taolo] onro mekhonad, [kh'ammonandi kofironi gumrokh' ast] va kh'ol on ki pesh az on niz Muso rokh'namo va moiai rakh'mat [-i eshon] bud. Inon [musulmonon] ba on [kitob] imon dorand va kh'ar kase az gurukh'kh'o[-i mukhtalifi mushrikon], ki ba on kufr bivarzad [va inkorash kunad], otashi duzakh va'dagokh'i ust. Pas,[ei paiombar] az [K'ur'on va kh'ak'ik'ati va'dakh'oi] on dar tardid mabosh. Be tardid, on [kitobe] rostu durust az sui Parvardigori tust, vale beshtari mardum imon nameovarand

Va kist sitamgortar az on kas, ki [bo nisbat dodani farzand io sharik] bar Allokh' taolo durug' mebandad? Onon [ruzi k'iiomat] bar Parvardigorashon arza meshavand va guvokh'on [paiombaron va farishtagon] meguiand: <<Inkh'o kh'amon kasone kh'astand, ki bar Parvardigorashon durug' mebastand>>. Kh'on! La'nati Allokh' taolo bar sitamgoroni [mushrik] bod!!
[Kh'amon] kasone, ki [mardumro] az rokh'i Allokh' taolo bozmedorand va onro munkh'arif mekhokh'and va onon khud okhiratro bovar nadorand

Onon dar zamin notavonkunanda [-i Allokh' az azobi khesh] nestand va ch'uz Allokh' taolo dustone nadorand. Azob bar eshon duchand meshavad,[charo ki] onon na tavoni shunidan [-i kh'ak'ro] doshtand va na [kh'ak'oik'ro] medidand
Inonand, ki ba khesh ziion zadand va durug'kh'oe, ki meboftand, [kh'ama] makh'vu nobud shud
Noguzir onon dar okhirat az kh'ama ziionkortarand
Kasone, ki imon ovardaand va korkh'oi shoista kardaand va dar barobari Parvardigorashon furutani namudaand, inon iak'inan bikh'ishtiand [va] kh'am inon dar on ch'ovidonand
Masali in du gurukh' [kofiru mu'min] kh'ammonandi nobino va noshunavo [az iak su] va bino va shunavo [az suii digar] ast. Oio bo iakdigar barobarand? Oio pand namegired?
Va ba rosti Mo Nukh'ro ba suii k'avmash firistodem [bo in paiom], ki: <<Ba rosti, ki man baroiaton bimdikh'andae oshkoram
Ch'uz Allokh'ro naparasted, [ki] be tardid man az azobi ruze dardnok bar shumo metarsam>>

Buzurgone az k'avmi u, ki kufr varzida budand, [dar posukh] guftand: <<Turo ch'uz bashare kh'ammonandi khesh namebinem va ba ch'uz furumoiagoni mo [on kh'am nadonista va] nasanch'ida [kasi digarero] namebinem, ki az tu pairavi karda boshad va baroiaton [kh'ech'] bartarie bar khud namebinem, balki shumoro durug'gu mepindorem>>

[Nukh'] guft: <<Ei k'avmi man, ba man bigued, [ki] agar az suii Parvardigoram dalel [-u mu'ch'izai] oshkore doshta bosham va U az ch'onibi khesh ba man rakh'mate [ nubuvvat] bakhshida boshad va [in mavkh'ibat] az didi shumo pushida boshad, oio mo metavonem ba [pazirishi] on vodoraton kunem va kh'ol on ki karokh'at dored?

Va ei k'avmi man, baroi in [risolat man kh'ech' sarvat] va mole az shumo darkhost namekunam. Podoshi man ch'uz bar [ukh'dai] Allokh' taolo nest va kasonero, ki imon ovardaand, az khud nameronam. Be tardid, [ruzi k'iiomat] onon mulok'otkunandai Parvardigori kheshand, vale man shumoro gurukh'e mebinam, ki nodoni mekuned
Va ei k'avmi man, agar man ononro tard kunam, kist, ki maro dar barobari [kaifari] Allokh' taolo iori kunad? Pas, oio pand namegired?

Va ba shumo nameguiam, ki ganch'inakh'oi Allokh' taolo nazdi man ast va g'aib namedonam va nameguiam, ki man farishtaam va dar borai kasone, ki ba chashmi shumo kh'ak'ir meoiand, nameguiam, ki Allokh' taolo khaire nasibashon nakhokh'ad kard. Allokh' taolo ba on chi dar dilkh'oi eshon ast, ogokh'tar ast. [Agar chunin biguiam] Dar on surat, kh'atman, az sitamgoron khokh'am bud>>
[K'avmash] Guftand: <<Ei Nukh', ba rosti, ki bo mo ch'idol kardi va bisior [kh'am] ch'idol kardi, pas, agar rost megui, on chi [az azob]-ro, ki ba mo va'da medikh'i, biiovar>>
[Nukh'] Guft: <<Tankh'o Allokh' taolo ast, ki agar bikhokh'ad, onro bar [sari] shumo meovarad va shumo och'izkunanda [-i U az azob kardan] nested

Va agar man bikhokh'am nasikh'ataton kunam, nasikh'at kardani man sude baroiaton nadorad, agar Allokh' taolo bikhokh'ad [ki nobudu] gumrokh'aton sozad. U Parvardigori shumost va [kh'amagi] ba suiash bozgardonda meshaved>>

Oio [mushrikon] meguiand: <<U [Mukh'ammad] in sukhanonro ba durug' ba Allokh' taolo nisbat dodaast? Bigu: <<Agar man inkh'oro az peshi khud sokhta bosham va ba U nisbat dikh'am, gunokh'ash bar [ukh'dai] man, va[-le] man az gunokh'oni shumo bezoram>>
Va ba Nukh' vakh'i shud, ki: <<Az k'avmi tu ch'uz kasone, ki imon ovardaand, digar kh'ech' kas imon nameovarad, pas, bar on chi mekardand, g'am makhur
Va [aknun] kishtiro zeri nazari Mo va ba vakh'i [va rokh'namoi]-i Mo bisoz va dar borai kasone, ki sitam kardand, bo Man sukhan magu [charo ki] onkh'o, kh'atman, g'ark'shudani kh'astand>>

Va [Nukh'] kishtiro mesokht va gokh'e buzurgone az k'avmash bar u meguzashtand, maskharaash mekardand. [U] Meguft: <<Agar moro maskhara mekuned, mo niz [ba kh'angomash] ba kh'amon surate, ki moro maskhara mekuned, shumoro maskhara khokh'em kard
Ba zudi khokh'ed donist, ki azobi [ilokh'i] surog'i chi kase meoiad, ki khorash sozad va azobe poidor bar u furud oiad>>

[In kh'olat kh'amchunon idoma dosht] to zamone, ki farmon [-i azob] faro rasid va [ob az] tanur ch'ushidan girift. [Ba Nukh'] guftem: <<Az [az kh'aivonot] iak ch'uft [nar va moda] dar on [kishti] savor kun va [kh'amchunin] khonadonatro, ba ch'uz kase, ki va'da [-i kh'alok] k'ablan bar u muk'arrar shudaast va [niz] kasonero, ki imon ovardaand [niz savor kun]>>.Va ch'uz iddai andake kh'amrokh'i u imon naovarda budand
[Nukh'] Guft: <<Dar on [kishti] savor shaved. Kh'arakat va tavak'k'ufash ba nom [-u khosti] Allokh' taolo ast. Be tardid, Parvardigoram omurzandavu mekh'rubon ast>>
Va on [kishti] ononro dar miioni amvoch'i kukh'paikare [pesh] meburd va Nukh' pisarashro, ki dar kanore [istoda] bud, sado zad: <<Pisaram, bo mo savor shav va kh'amrokh'i kofiron mabosh>>

[Pisari Nukh'] Guft: <<Ba kukh'e panokh' khokh'am burd, ki az ob kh'ifzam kunad>>. [Nukh'] Guft: <<Imruz kh'ech' nigakh'dorandae dar barobari farmoni Allokh' taolo nest, magar kase, ki [Allokh' taolo] ba u rakh'm kunad>>.Va[-le nogokh'] mavch' dar miioni on du fosila andokht, pas, [vai niz] az g'ark'shudagon gardid

Va gufta shud: <<Ei zamin, obatro furu bar va ei osmon [az boridan] boz ist va ob furu nishast va kor ba anch'om rasid va [kishti] bar [kukh'i] Ch'udi k'aror girift va gufta shud: <<Duri [az rakh'mati ilokh'i] bar gurukh'i sitamgoron bod>>!
Va Nukh' Parvardigorashro nido dodu guft: <<Parvardigoro, pisaram az khonadoni man ast va be gumon, va'dai Tu [dar borai nach'oti khonadonam] kh'ak' ast va Tu bekh'tarin dovari>>

[Allokh' taolo] Farmud: <<Ei Nukh', dar kh'ak'ik'at, u az khonadoni tu nest. [Kirdori] U kirdori noshoista ast. Pas, chizero, ki ba on donish nadori, az Man makhokh'. Man turo pand medikh'am, ki mabodo az ch'okh'ilon boshi>>
[Nukh'] Guft: <<Parvardigoro, man ba Tu panokh' mebaram, ki az Tu chize bikhokh'am, ki ba on donishe nadoram va agar maro nabakhshi va bar man rakh'm nakuni, az ziionkoronam>>

Gufta shud: <<Ei Nukh', bo [amniiatu] salomati az ch'onibi Mo va [niz kh'amrokh' bo] barakatkh'oi [farovon] bar tu va bar gurukh'kh'oe, ki kh'amrokh'at kh'astand, [bar zamin] furud o va gurukh'kh'oe [niz] kh'astand, ki ba zudi ononro [az ne'matkh'o] bakh'ramand mesozem, sipas azobi dardnoke az suii Mo ba onon khokh'ad rasid>>

[Ei paiombar] Inkh'o az khabarkh'oi g'aib ast, ki onro ba tu vakh'i mekunem. Na tu onkh'oro pesh az in medonisti va na k'avmat, pas,[bar ozorashon] shikeboi kun. Iak'inan, ok'ibati [naku] az oni parkh'ezgoron ast

Va ba suii k'avmi Od barodarashon Kh'udro [firistodem, ki] guft: <<Ei k'avmi man, Allokh'ro biparasted, ki ma'bud [-i barkh'ak']-e ch'uz U nadored [va] shumo [dar shirk ba Allokh' taolo] durug'bofone besh nested
<<Ei k'avmi man, baroi [rasonidani] in [da'vat] az shumo podoshe nametalabam. Podoshi man tankh'o bar [ukh'dai] kasest, ki maro ofarid. Oio nameandeshed?

Va ei k'avmi man, az Parvardigoraton talabi omurzish kuned, sipas ba suii U bozgarded [va tavba kuned], to [boroni] osmonro paiopai bar shumo bifiristad va nerue bar neruiaton biafzoiad va gunakh'korona [az kh'ak'] rui nagardoned>>
Onon guftand: <<Ei Kh'ud, baroiamon daleli ravshane naovardai va mo ba [khotiri] guftori tu ma'budonamonro rakh'o namekunem va ba tu imon nameovarem

[Mo chize] Ch'uz in nameguem, ki barkhe az ma'budonamon ba tu gazande rasondaand [va devona shudai]>>. [Kh'ud] Guft: <<Allokh'ro guvokh' megiram va shumo [niz] guvokh' boshed, ki man az on chi [ba Allokh' taolo] sharik k'aror medikh'ed, bezoram
Pas, kh'amagi dar borai man nairang kuned va mukh'latam nadikh'ed
Man bar Allokh' taolo, ki Parvardigori manu shumost, tavakkal kardam. Kh'ech' ch'unbandae nest, magar in ki dar zeri k'udrat va farmonravoii Ust. Be tardid, Parvardigoram bar rokh'i rost ast

Pas, agar rui bigardoned, [bidoned, ki] man iak'inan, on chiro, ki ba khotirash ba suii shumo firistoda shudaam ba shumo rasonidam va Parvardigori man, k'avme g'air az shumoro ch'onishinaton mekunad va shumo nametavoned kh'ech' ziione ba U birasoned, [charoki] be tardid, Parvardigoram bar kh'ar chiz nigakh'bon ast>>
Va kh'angome ki farmoni [azobi] Mo faro rasid, Kh'ud va kasonero, ki kh'amrokh'ash imon ovarda budand, ba rakh'mate az [ch'onibi] khesh nach'ot dodem va ononro az azobi sakht rakh'onidem
Va in [k'avmi] Od budand, ki oioti Parvardigorashonro inkor kardand va az paiombaronash nofarmoni namudand va az farmoni kh'ar carkashi sitezagare pairavi kardand
Va dar in dunio va ruzi k'iiomat [niz] la'nate ba dunbolashon ravon ast. Ogokh' boshed! K'avmi Od ba Parvardigorashon kufr varzidand. Kh'on! Od - k'avmi Kh'ud [az rakh'mati ilokh'i] dur bod!

Va ba suii [k'avmi] Samud barodarashon Solekh'ro [firistodem]. U guft: <<Ei k'avmi man Allokh'ro biparasted, ki ch'uz U ma'bude [bar kh'ak'] nadored. U shumoro az zamin padid ovard va obodonii onro ba shumo voguzosht, pas, az U omurzish bitalabed, sipas ba suiash bozgarded [va tavba kuned]. Be tardid, Parvardigoram nazdik [va] ich'obatgar ast>>

Onon guftand: <<Ei Solekh', pesh az in tu miioni mo moiai umedvori budi. Oio moro az parastishi on chi padaronamon meparastidand, bozmedori? Va ba rosti, mo az on chi ba suiash da'vatamon mekuni, sakht tardid dorem>>

[Solekh'] Guft: <<Ei k'avmi man, ba man bigued,[ki] agar az suii Parvardigoram dalel [-u mu'ch'izai] oshkore doshta bosham va U az ch'onibi khesh ba man rakh'mate [nubuvvat] bakhshida boshad, pas, agar az U nofarmoni kunam, chi kase maro dar barobari Allokh' taolo iori mekunad? Pas, shumo ch'uz ziionkori [chize] bar man nameafzoed

Ei k'avmi man, in modashuturi Allokh' taolo ast, ki baroi shumo nishonaest [bar durustii da'vatam], pas, bigzored, to dar zamini Allokh' taolo bicharad va ozore ba u narasoned, ki [dar g'airi in surat] azobe zudras shumoro faro megirad>>

Pas, on [modashutur]-ro pai (zakhmi) kardand, on gokh' [Solekh' ba onon] guft: <<Se ruz dar khonakh'oiaton [az ne'matkh'oi dunio] bakh'ramand garded [va pas az on azob khokh'ad omad]. In va'daest, ki durug' nakhokh'ad bud>>

Pas, chun farmoni [azob]-i mo faro rasid, Solekh' va kasonero, ki kh'amrokh'ash imon ovarda budand, ba rakh'mate az [ch'onibi] khesh az [azobu] rasvoii on ruz nach'ot dodem. Be gumon, Parvardigorat kh'amon tavonmandi shikastnopazir ast
Va kasonero, ki sitam karda budand, bong [-i margbor]-e faro girift, pas, dar ch'oii khesh ba ru aftodand va kh'alok shudand
Chunonchi gui dar on [diior] nabudaand. Ogokh' boshed! [K'avmi] Samud ba Parvardigorashon kufr varzidand. Kh'on! Samud [az rakh'mati ilokh'i] dur bod!

Ba rosti, firistodagoni Mo bo bashorati [tavalludi farzand] nazdi Ibrokh'im omadand,[va] guftand: <<Salom [bar tu]>>. [U niz dar posukh] Guft: <<Salom [bar shumo]>> va dere napoid, ki [Ibrokh'im baroiashon] gusolae birion ovard

Pas, chun did ba suii on [g'izo] dast namebarand [va chize namekhurand], bo onon ekh'sosi begonagi kard va [az bimi on ki k'asdi k'atlashro doshta boshand] az onon tarse ba dil girift. [Farishtagon] Guftand: <<Natars, mo ba suii k'avmi Lut firistoda shudaem>>
Va kh'amsarash [Sora, ki pushti parda] istoda bud, [az shunidani khabari tavalludi farzand] khandid, on gokh' uro ba Iskh'ok' va pas az u ba Ia'k'ub bashorat dodem
[Sora] Guft: <<Ei voi bar man! Oio dar kh'ole ki khudam pirazanam va in shavkh'aram piramarde [fartut] ast, farzand mezoiam? Ba rosti, in chize shigiftovar ast
[Farishtagon] Guftand: <<Oio az farmoni Allokh' taolo taach'ch'ub mekuni? Rakh'mati Allokh' taolo va barakotash bar shumo va akh'li khona bod! Be tardid, U cutudae buzurgvor ast>>
Pas, chun tars az [dili] Ibrokh'im [berun] raft va bashorati [tavalludi farzand] ba u rasid, dar borai [ta'khiri azob io nach'oti mu'minoni] k'avmi Lut bo mo bakh's [va ba chunu charo] pardokht
Ba rosti, ki Ibrokh'im burdboru bisiorniioishgar va bozoianda [ba dargokh'i Mo] bud
[Farishtagon guftand] <<Ei Ibrokh'im, az in [sukhan] bigzar, [charo ki] ba rosti, farmoni [azobi] Parvardigorat faro rasidaast va musallaman, azobe bozgashtnopazir baroiashon khokh'ad omad>>
Va chun firistodagoni Mo nazdi Lut omadand, az [tasavvuri besharmii k'avmash nisbat ba] onon nigaron va diltang shud va guft: <<Imruz ruzi bisior sakhtest>>

Va k'avmi u shitobon [ba k'asdi komch'ui az mekh'mononi Lut] ba [khonai] u kh'uch'um ovardand, dar kh'ole ki pesh az on [niz] murtakibi korkh'oi zishte meshudand. [Lut]Guft: <<Ei k'avmi man, inkh'o dukhtaroni [ummati] man kh'astand; [bo eshon izdivoch' kuned]. Onon baroi shumo pokizatarand, pas, az Allokh' taolo bitarsed va maro dar [muk'obili] mekh'mononam sharmsor nakuned. Oio baini shumo mardi khiradmande nest [ki shumoro az in kor bozdorad]>>?
Onon guftand: <<Tu khud medoni, ki mo ba dukhtaroni [ummati] tu niioze nadorem va khub medoni, ki mo chi mekhokh'em>>
[Lut] Guft: <<Kosh, dar barobari shumo k'udrate doshtam io metavonistam ba takiagokh'i ustuvore [kh'amchun khonavoda va k'abilaam] panokh' bibaram>>

[Farishtagon] Guftand: <<Ei Lut, mo firistodagoni Parvardigorat kh'astem. Onon kh'argiz ba tu dast nameioband, pas, vak'te pose az shab guzarad, khonavodaatro [az in shakh'r berun] bibar va kh'ech' iak az shumo ba pushti sar nigokh' nakunad, magar kh'amsarat, ki on chi [az azob], ki ba onon merasad, kh'atman, ba u [niz] khokh'ad rasid. Dar kh'ak'ik'at, va'dagokh'ashon subkh' ast. Oio subkh' nazdik nest?>>
Pas, chun farmoni Mo faro rasid, on [sarzamin]-ro zeruru kardem va bar onon sanggilkh'oe paiopai boridem
[Sangkh'oe, ki] Nazdi Parvardigorat nishondor bud va in [azobi dardnok] az sitamgoroni [digar, az ch'umla K'uraish] dur nest

Va ba suii [k'avmi] Madian barodarashon Shuaibro [firistodem]. U guft: <<Ei k'avmi man, Allokh'ro biparasted, ki ba ch'uz u ma'bude [bar kh'ak'] nadored va paimona va mizonro kam nakuned. Ba rosti, shumoro dar ne'mat mebinem, va[le] az azobi ruzi farogir bar shumo metarsam
Va ei k'avmi man, paimona va mizonro bo adolat tamom [-u komil] bidikh'ed va kolokh'oi mardumro kam nadikh'ed va dar zamin ba fasod [-u gunokh']nakushed
Agar imon doshta boshed, on chi Allokh' taolo [pas az takh'vili komili paimona az kasbi kh'alol] baroiaton bok'i meguzorad, bekh'tar ast va man bar shumo nigakh'bon nestam>>

Onon guftand: <<Ei Shuaib, oio namozat turo bar on medorad, ki [ba mo amr kuni, to] dast az on chi padaronamon meparstidand, bardorem io dar amvolamon kh'ar kore, ki mekhokh'em, nakunem? Tu, ki burdbor [va] khiradmandi [pas, charo chunin megui]?>>

[Shuaib] Guft: <<Ei k'avmi man, ba man bigued, [ki] agar az suii Parvardigoram dalel [-u mu'ch'izai] oshkore doshta bosham va az ch'onibi khesh ruzii nakuie ba man ato karda boshad [on gokh' chi mekuned]? Va man namekhokh'am dar on chi shumoro az on bozmedoram, bo shumo mukholifat kunam [vale khud anch'omash dikh'am]. To on ch'o dar tavon doram, ch'uz islokh' namekhokh'am va tavfik'i man tankh'o ba [lutfu khosti] Khudost, bar U tavakkal kardam va ba suii U bozmegardam

Va ei k'avmi man, dushmani [va mukholifat] bo man sabab nashavad, ki kh'ammonandi on chi ki ba k'avmi Nukh' io k'avmi Kh'ud io k'avmi Solekh' rasid, ba shumo [niz] birasad va [ba khusus azobi] k'avmi Lut [ki az likh'ozi zamonu makon] chandon az shumo dur nest
Va az Parvardigoraton omurzish bikhokh'ed, sipas ba suii U bozgarded [va tavba kuned, ki] be tardid, Parvardigoram mekh'rubon [va] dustdor [-i tavbakunandagon] ast

Onon guftand: <<Ei Shuaib, bisiore az on chiro, ki megui, namefakh'mem va iak'inan turo dar miioni khud notavon mebinem va agar [ekh'tiromi] k'abilaat namebud, musallaman, sangsorat mekardem va tu nazdi mo tavonmand [garonk'adr] nesti>>

[Shuaib] Guft: <<Ei k'avmi man, oio k'abilaam nazdi shumo giromitar az Allokh' taolo ast, ki [farmoni] Uro [faromush karded va] pushti sari khesh andokhtaed. Be tardid, Parvardigoram ba on chi anch'om medikh'ed, ikh'ota dorad

Va ei k'avmi man, shumo ba ravishi khud amal kuned, man niz [ba ravishi khud] amal mekunam. Ba zudi khokh'ed donist, ki azobi rasvokunanda bar chi kase furud meoiad va durug'gu kist. Shumo muntazir boshed va man [niz] bo shumo dar intizoram>>

Va chun farmoni Mo faro rasid, Shuaib va kasonero, ki kh'amrokh'ash imon ovarda budand, ba rakh'mate az [ch'onibi] khesh nach'ot dodem va kasonero, ki sitam kardand, bonge [margbor] faro girift, pas, dar ch'oii khud ba ru aftodand va kh'alok shudand;
Chunon [murdand] ki gui kh'argiz dar on [diior] nabudand. Kh'on! [K'avmi] Madian [az rakh'mati ilokh'i] dur bod! Chunonchi [k'avmi] Samud dur shudand
Va ba rosti, Musoro bo oioti khud va dalele oshkor firistodem
Ba suii Fir'avn va buzurgon [-u ashrofi k'avm]-i u, pas, onon az farmoni Fir'avn pairavi kardand va farmoni Fir'avn durust [va bikhradona] nabud
[Fir'avn] Ruzi k'iiomat peshopeshi k'avmash meravad va ononro ba otash [-i duzakh] vorid mekunad va chi bad ch'oigokh'est, ki ba on vorid meshavand!
Va dar in [dunio] va ruzi k'iiomat, nafrin ba dunbol dorand va chi bad armug'one ba onon mebakhshand!
[Ei paiombar] In [barkhe] az khabarkh'oi on [sarzaminkh'o va] shakh'rkh'ost, ki onkh'oro baroiat bozgu mekunem, barkhe az onkh'o [kh'anuz] pobarch'ost va [barkhe digar] vairon [gashtaast]

Va Mo ba eshon sitam nakardem, balki onon [khud] ba kheshtan sitam kardand, pas, kh'angome ki farmoni Parvardigorat [baroi azobashon] faro rasid, ma'budonashon, ki ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo mekhondand, sude baroiashon nadoshtand [va ioriashon nadodand] va bar onon ch'uz kh'alokat [-u tabokh'i] naafzudand
Va chunin ast bozkhosti Parvardigorat, ki akh'olii shakh'rkh'oero, ki sitamgor [-u mushrik] budand, faro megirift. Be gumon, bozkhosti u dardnok va sakht ast

Iak'inan, dar in [dostonkh'o, pand va] nishonaest baroi kase, ki az azobi okhirat metarsad. On [ruz] ruzest, ki mardumro baroi [kh'isobrasi dar] on ch'am' mekunand va on [ruz] ruzest, ki [tamomi akh'li makh'shar] onro mebinand
Va Mo onro ch'uz to muddate muaiian ba ta'khir nameandozem
Ruze biioiad, ki kh'ech' kas ch'uz ba ich'ozati U [Allokh' taolo] sukhan nameguiad, pas, barkhe az onon badbakhtand va [barkhe digar] nekbakht
Ammo kasone, ki badbakht shudand, [duzakhiand va] dar otash baroiashon [bo kh'ar damu bozdam] fariodu nolae ast

To osmonkh'o va zamin [bok'i] ast, dar on [azob] ch'ovidonand, magar on ki Parvardigorat bikhokh'ad [ki muvakh'kh'idoni gunakh'gorro az duzakh khorich' sozad]. Be tardid, Parvardigorat on chiro, ki bikhokh'ad, anch'om medikh'ad

Va ammo kasone, ki nekbakht [va saodatmand] shudand, to osmonkh'o va zamin [bok'i] ast, ch'ovidona dar bikh'ishtand, magar on ki Parvardigorat bikhokh'ad [ki muvakh'kh'idoni gunakh'gorro pesh az vurud ba bikh'isht dar duzakh much'ozot kunad. In ne'mat] bakhshishe bepoion ast

Pas, az [botil budani] on chi inon [mushrikon] meparastand, dar tardid mabosh. Onon in ma'budonro nameparastand, magar ba kh'amon shakle, ki padaronashon [niz] peshtar meparastidand va Mo sakh'mashonro [az azob] bekamukost ba onon khokh'em dod

Va ba rosti, [Mo] ba Muso kitob dodem, pas, dar on ikhtilof shud. Va agar peshtar [dar mavridi mukh'lat ba gunakh'goron va kh'isobrasi dar k'iiomat] sukhane az ch'onibi Parvardigorat baion nashuda bud, iak'inan, [dar kh'amin dunio] miionashon dovari meshud [va azob nozil megasht] va ba rosti, ki onon [iakh'udiion va mushrikon] dar borai [kh'ak'k'oniiati] in [K'ur'on] sakht dar tardidand
Va Parvardigorat [podoshi] a'moli kh'ar kadomashro, kh'atman, bekamu kost khokh'ad dod. Be tardid, U ba on chi mekunand, ogokh' ast

Pas, [ei paiombar] chunon ki farmon ioftai, [dar barobari mushrikon] istik'omat kun va kase, ki kh'amrokh'i tu [ba peshgokh'i ilokh'i] ru ovardaast [niz boiad dar dindori istik'omat kunad] va sarkashi nakuned. Be tardid, u ba on chi mekuned, binost

Ba kasone, ki sitam kardand [kofiron] garoish naiobed, ki [agar chunin kuned] otashi duzakh ba shumo niz khokh'ad rasid va dar barobari Allokh' taolo [kh'ech'] duste nadored va on gokh' iori nameshaved
Va dar du tarafi ruz [og'oz va poioni ruz] va soate az shab namoz bigzor. Be tardid, nekikh'o badikh'oro az bain mebarad. In [sukhan] pandest baroi pandpaziron
Va shikeboi kun,[ki] be tardid, Allokh' taolo podoshi nakukoronro tabokh' namekunad

Pas, charo dar miioni ummatkh'oi pesh az shumo, ch'uz andake az onon, ki [az azob] nach'otashon dodem,[mu'minon va] khiradmandone nabudand, ki [mardumro] az fasod dar zamin bozdorand? Va kasone, ki sitam kardand, ba dunboli nozu ne'mate, ki iofta budand, raftand va gunakh'gor budand
Va [sunnati] Parvardigorat chunin nabudaast, ki shakh'rkh'oro, dar kh'ole ki sokinonash [afrode] nakukor budand, ba sitam nobud kunad
Va agar Parvardigorat mekhost, [kh'amai] mardumro iak ummati [muvakh'kh'id va durustkor] k'aror medod, vale [onon] kh'amvora mukhtalifand

Magar kasone, ki Parvardigorat ba onon rakh'm kard va baroi kh'amin ononro ofaridaast va va'dai Parvardigorat [chunin] takh'ak'k'uk' paziruftaast [ki]: <<Kh'atman, duzakhro az ch'innu inson [-i gunakh'gor] anboshta khokh'am sokht>>

Va [ei Mukh'ammad] az akhbori paiombaron in kh'amaro bar tu kh'ikoiat mekunem, to dilatro bo onkh'o subot [-u oromish] bakhshem va dar in [sarguzashtkh'o] kh'ak'ik'at baroiat omadaast va [in dostonkh'o] pandest [baroi kofiron] va tazakkurest baroi mu'minon
Va ba kasone, ki imon nameovarand, bigu: <<Shumo ba ravishi khud amal kuned, mo [niz ba shevai khud] amal mekunem
Va muntazir boshed, [ki] be tardid, mo [niz] muntazirem>>

Va [ogokh'i az] g'aibi osmonkh'o va zamin, az oni Allokh' taolo ast va kh'amai korkh'o ba suii u bozgardonda meshavad. Pas, Uro biparast va bar U tavakkal kun va Parvardigorat az on chi mekuned,[kh'argiz] g'ofil nest
Alif, lom, ro. In oioti kitobi ravshangar ast
Mo onro K'ur'one [ba zaboni] arabi nozil kardem, boshad, ki [dar mafokh'imash] biiandeshed
[Ei paiombar] mo bekh'tarin dostonro bo vakh'i kardani in K'ur'on bar tu kh'ikoiat mekunem va musallaman, peshtar tu [az in dostonkh'o] bekhabar budi
[Iod kun az] kh'angome ki Iusuf ba padarash [Ia'k'ub] guft: <<Padarch'on, man [dar khob] iozdakh' sitora va khurshedu mokh' didam. Onkh'oro didam, ki baroiam sach'da mekardand>>
[Ia'k'ub] Guft: <<Pisaram, khobatro baroi barodaronat bozgu makun, ki baroiat nairange meandeshand,[charo ki] be tardid, shaiton dushmani oshkore baroi inson ast

Parvardigorat turo in guna barmeguzinad va ba tu [ilmi] ta'biri khobkh'oro meomuzad va ne'matashro bar tu va bar khonadoni Ia'k'ub tamom megardonad, chunon ki pesh az in [niz] bar ach'dodat - Ibrokh'im va Iskh'ok' tamom kard. Be tardid, Parvardigorat donovu kh'akim ast>>
Ba rosti, ki dar [dostoni] Iusuf va barodaronash, baroi pursishgaron [dar borai Iusuf ibratkh'o va] nishonakh'ost

On gokh' ki [ba iakdigar] guftand: <<Iusuf va barodarash [Biniomin] nazdi padaramon az mo makh'bubtarand, dar kh'ole ki mo iak gurukh' [-i nerumand] kh'astem. Kh'ak'k'o, ki padaramon [bo in mekh'rvarzii bedalel] dar gumrokh'ii oshkore ast
[Iake az barodaron guft] Iusufro bikushed io uro ba sarzamin [-i durdast]-e biafkaned, to tavach'ch'ukh'i padaraton fak'at ba [suii] shumo boshad va pas az on [tavba kuned va] afrode shoista boshed>>

Iake [digar] az onon guft: <<Iusufro nakushed va agar [mekhokh'ed] kore anch'om dikh'ed, uro dar k'a'ri chokh' biandozed, to barkhe az musofiron [-i korvon] uro bargirand [va bo khud ba ch'oie dur barand]>>
[Sipas nazdi Ia'k'ub raftand] Va guftand: <<Padarch'on, charo moro bar Iusuf amin nameshumori, kh'ol on ki mo khairkhokh'ash kh'astem?
Fardo uro bo mo [ba dasht] bifrist, to [dar chamankh'o] bigardad va bozi kunad va mo ba khubi murok'ibash kh'astem>>
[Ia'k'ub] Guft: <<In ki uro bibared, maro andukh'gin mekunad va az in metarsam, ki gurg uro bikhurad va shumo az u g'ofil boshed>>
Onon guftand: <<Bo vuch'udi in ki mo iak gurukh' [-i nerumand] kh'astem, agar [ich'ozat dikh'em, ki] gurg uro bikhurad, kh'atman, ziionkor khokh'em bud>>

Pas, chun vairo [kh'amrokh'i khud] burdand va kh'amdast shudand, ki uro dar k'a'ri chokh' biandozand, ba u vakh'i kardem, ki: <<[Saranch'om] Kh'atman, ononro, dar kh'ole ki [dar boraat] kh'ech' namedonand, az [chandu chuni] in korashon ogokh' khokh'i sokht>>
Va shabongokh' giriakunon nazdi padarashon omadand
Guftand: <<Padarch'on, mo [durtar] raftem, ki musobik'a dikh'em va Iusufro nazdi asosi khud guzoshtem, ki gurg uro khurd va kh'archand rostgu boshem, tu [kh'argiz sukhani] moro bovar nakhokh'i kard>>

Va perokh'ani uro bo khuni durug'ine [baroi Ia'k'ub] ovardand. [U] Guft: <<[Chunin nest] Balki [kh'avoi] nafsi shumo kore [noshoista]-ro baroiaton orostaast, pas, sabre naku [baroiam bekh'tar ast] va Allokh' taolo dar [mavridi] on chi megued, iorigar [-i man] ast>>

Va korvone omad va onon obovari khudro firistodand,pas,u dalvashro [dar chokh'] andokht [va chun Iusufro bolo kashid] guft: <<Muzhda dikh'ed! In iak navch'avon ast>> va [pas az nach'otash] uro kh'amchun iak kolo[-i arzishmand az digaron] pinkh'on doshtand, va[-le] Allokh' taolo ba on chi mekardand, ogokh' bud
Va [saranch'om] uro ba bakh'oe andak, chand dirkh'am, furukhtand va dar [borai nigakh' doshtani] u bemail budand

Va on shakhs az [mardumi] Misr [Aziz], ki uro kharida bud, ba kh'amsarash guft: <<Mak'omashro giromi bidor. Umed ast, ki baroiamon sudmand boshad io uro ba farzandi bigirem>>. Va inchunin bud, ki Iusufro dar [on] sarzamin arch'mand [-u muk'tadir] gardonidem, to ba u ta'biri khob biiomuzem; va Allokh' taolo bar kori khesh [tavono va] chira ast, vale beshtari mardum namedonand
Va chun [Iusuf ba avch'i] nerui ch'avoni rasid, ba u kh'ikmatu donish ato kardem va nakukoronro inchunin podosh medikh'em

Va on zane, ki u [Iusuf] dar khonaash bud, az vai komch'ui kard va darkh'oro bastu guft: <<Biio [ki dar ikhtiiori tu kh'astam]>>. [Iusuf] Guft: <<Panokh' bar Allokh' taolo! On mard [shavkh'ari tu va] sarvari man ast [va] ch'oigokh'amro giromi doshtaast [pas, chi guna ba u khiionat kunam?] iak'inan, sitamgoron rastagor nameshavand>>

Va dar kh'ak'ik'at, [on zan] k'asdi u kard va u niz agar burkh'oni Parvardigorashro nadida bud, k'asdi on zan mekard. Mo inchunin [kardem], to badi va zishtkoriro az u dur sozem. Ba rosti, ki u az bandagoni mukhlisi Mo bud

Va kh'ar du ba tarafi dar shitoftand va [kh'amsari azizi Misr] perokh'ani uro az pusht pora kard va [dar in kh'angom] shavkh'arashro dar ostonai dar ioftand.[On] Zan guft: <<Kaifari kase, ki k'asdi bad ba khonavodai tu doshta boshad, chist, ch'uz in ki zindon shavad io azobe dardnok [bubinad]>>?

[Iusuf] Guft: <<U az man komch'ui kard>> va [dar on kh'angom] shokh'ide az bastagoni on zan shakh'odat dod: <<Agar perokh'anash az ch'ilav pora shuda boshad, in zan rost meguiad va on mard [Iusuf] durug'gust
Va[-le] agar perokh'anash az pusht pora shuda boshad, in zan durug' meguiad va on mard rostgust>>
Pas, chun [Azizi Misr] did, ki perokh'ani u az pusht pora shudaast, [ba kh'ak'ik'at pai burd va] guft: <<In az nairangi shumo [zanon] ast, ba rosti, ki nairangi shumo buzurg ast
Ei Iusuf, az in [moch'aro] darguzar va [tu ei zan] baroi gunokh'at omurzish bikhokh', ki be tardid khatokor budai>>

[Kh'angome ki in khabar muntashir shud] Barkhe az zanon dar shakh'r guftand: <<Kh'amsari Aziz [-i Misr] az g'ulomi [ch'avoni] khesh komch'ui mekunad [va] sakht sheftaash gashtaast. Mo uro vok'ean dar gumrokh'ii oshkore mebinem>>

Pas, chun [kh'amsari Aziz] nairang [-u badgui]-i ononro shunid, [shakhsero baroi da'vat] ba surog'ashon firistod va mach'lise baroiashon tartib dod va ba kh'ar kadom [baroi buridani g'izo] korde dod va ba Iusuf guft: <<Bar [ch'am'i] onon vorid shav>>. Pas, [zanon] chun uro didand, bisior buzurg [-u zebo] shumurdand va [chunon makh'vi ch'amolash shudand] dastkh'oiashonro zakhmi kardand va guftand: <<Panokh' bar Allokh' taolo! In bashar nest, in ch'uz farishtae buzurgvor nest>>

[Kh'amsari Aziz] Guft: <<In [ch'avoni zeboru] kh'amon ast, ki maro dar baroi u sarzanish mekarded. [Ore] Dar kh'ak'ik'at, man az u komch'ui namudam va u kheshtandori kard va [inak] agar on chiro ba u dastur medikh'am, anch'om nadikh'ad, kh'atman, zindoni meshavad va musallaman, az khorshudagon khokh'ad bud>>

[Iusuf] Guft: <<Parvardigoro, zindon baroi man az on chi [inkh'o] maro ba suiash mekhonand, makh'bubtar ast va agar nairangashonro az man nagardoni, ba onon garoish meiobam va [agar chunin kunam] nodon khokh'am bud>>
Pas, Parvardigorash [duoi] uro ich'obat kard va nairangashonro az u bozgardonid. Be tardid, U shunavovu donost
On gokh' pas az on ki [Azizi Misr va atrofiionash] nishonakh'o[-i pokdomanii Iusuf]-ro didand, tasmim giriftand [baroi sarpush guzoshtan bar in beobrui] uro to muddate zindoni kunand

Va du ch'avon kh'amrokh'i u voridi zindon shudand. [Ruze] Iake az on du guft: <<Man [dar khob] khudro didam, ki [angur baroi] sharob mefishoram>> va digari guft: <<Man khob didaam, ki bar sari khesh [zarfi] none mebaram [va] parandagon az on mekhurand. Moro az ta'birash ogokh' kun, [ki] kh'atman, turo az nakukoron mebinem>>

[Iusuf] Guft: <<Kh'ech' g'izoe baroi khurdan nazdaton nameovarand, magar on ki pesh az ovardanash, shumoro az [kaifiiatu] kh'ak'ik'atash ogokh' sozam. In [akhbori g'aibi] az onkh'ost, ki Parvardigoram ba man omukhtaast. Dar kh'ak'ik'at, man oini k'avmero, ki ba Allokh' taolo imon nameovarand va ba [saroi] okhirat [niz] kufr mevarzand, tark kardam

Va az oini padaronam Ibrokh'im va Iskh'ok' va Ia'k'ub pairavi kardam. Baroi mo sazovor nest, ki chizero shariki Allokh' taolo k'aror dikh'em. In [iaktoparasti] az fazli Allokh' taolo bar mo va bar [kh'amai] mardum ast, vale beshtari mardum sipos nameguzorand
Ei dustoni zindonii man, oio ma'budoni parokanda [va mutaaddid] bekh'tarand, io Allokh'i iagonai piruzmand?

Shumo ba ch'oi u [chizero] nameparasted, magar nomkh'oe [bema'ni], ki khud va padaronaton bar onkh'o nikh'odaed. Allokh' taolo kh'ech' dalele bar [kh'ak'ik'ati] onkh'o nozil nakardaast. Farmonravoi, tankh'o az oni Allokh' taolo ast [va] farmon dodast, ki ch'uz Uro naparasted. In kh'amon dini rost va ustuvor ast; vale beshtari mardum namedonand

Ei dustoni zindonii man, iake az shumo [ozod meshavad] va ba sarvari khesh sharob khokh'ad nushond va ammo digare ba dor ovekhta meshavad va parandagon az [mag'zi] sarash khokh'and khurd. Amre, ki dar [mavridi] on az man nazar khosted, [chunin] muk'addar shudaast>>

Va [Iusuf] ba iake az on du [nafar], ki donist rakh'o meshavad, guft: <<Az man nazdi sarvarat [podshokh'] iod kun>>. Va[-le] shaiton iod kardan [az Iusufro nazdi] sarvarash az khotiri vai [sok'ii podshokh'] burd va u [Iusuf] chandin sol [-i digar niz] dar zindon bok'i mond

Va [ruze] podshokh' guft: <<Man [dar khob] didam, ki kh'aft govi farbekh'ro kh'aft govi log'ar mekhurdand va kh'aft khushai sabz va [kh'aft khushai] digarro khushk [didam]. Ei buzurgon, agar ta'biri khob mekuned, dar [borai] khobam nazar dikh'ed>>
Onon guftand: <<[Inkh'o] Khobkh'oe pareshon ast va mo ba ta'biri in [guna] khobkh'o dono nestem>>
Va iake az on du [zindoni], ki nach'ot iofta bud, pas az muddatkh'o [Iusuf]-ro ba iod ovard [va] guft: <<Maro ba [zindon] bifiristed, to dar borai ta'biri on [khob] ba shumo khabar dikh'am>>

[U ba zindon raft va guft] <<Iusuf, ei mardi rostgu, dar borai in khob izkh'ori nazar kun, ki kh'aft govi farbekh'ro kh'aft govi log'ar mekhurdand va kh'aft khushai sabz va [kh'aft khushai] khushkidai digar baroiamon ta'bir kun, to nazdi mardum bargardam, shoiad onkh'o [ta'biri in khob va tavonoikh'oi turo] bidonand
[Iusuf] guft: <<Kh'aft soli paiopai [bo ch'iddiiat] kishovarzi kuned va on chiro, ki darav mekuned, ch'uz andake, ki mekhured, bo khushaash [kanor] bigzored
Sipas ba'd az on [davroni ravnak'] kh'aft [soli k'akh'tii] sakht meoiad, ki on chiro baroi on solkh'o [kanor] guzoshtaed, mekhured, ba ch'uz andake, ki onro [baroi tukhmi] zakhira mekuned
Sipas ba'd az on kh'aft [sol] sole faro merasad, ki boroni farovone nasibi mardum meshavad va dar on sol, [bar asari farovoni, az mevakh'o] assora (afshurdanikh'o) megirand>>

Podshokh' [chun in ta'birro shunid] guft: <<Uro nazdi man biiovared>>. Pas, chun firistoda [-i podshokh'] nazdi u omad, [Iusuf] guft: <<Nazdi sarvarat bozgard va az u bipurs, ki moch'aroi zanone, ki dastkh'oi khudro buridand, chi bud? Kh'atman, Parvardigoram ba nairangi onon ogokh' ast>>

[Podshokh' on zanonro khost va] Guft: <<Kh'angome ki Iusufro ba suii khesh da'vat karded, ch'araioni koraton chi bud>>? Guftand: <<Panokh' bar Allokh' taolo! Mo kh'ech' gunokh'e dar u surog' nadorem>>. [Dar in kh'angom] Kh'amsari Aziz guft: <<Aknun kh'ak' oshkor shud, man [budam, ki] az vai komch'ui kardam [va u pokdomani varzid] va iak'inan, rostgust
In [e'tirof] baroi on ast, ki [Iusuf] bidonad, ki man dar pinkh'on ba u khiionat nakardaam [va dar g'iiobash kh'ak'ik'atro guftaam] va in ki Allokh' taolo nairangi khoinonro ba ch'oie namerasonad

Man kh'argiz khudro begunokh' nameshumoram. Be shak, nafs [-i vasvasagari inson uro] paivasta ba badi farmon medikh'ad, magar on ki Parvardigoram rakh'm kunad. Be tardid, Parvardigoram omurzandai mekh'rubon ast>>

Va podshokh' guft: <<U [ Iusuf]-ro nazdam biiovared [to mushoviri] khosi khud gardonam>>. Pas, chun [Iusuf nazdash omad va] bo vai sukh'bat kard, [podshokh'] guft: <<Tu imruz nazdi mo arch'mand [va] amin kh'asti>>
Iusuf] guft: <<Maro bar [sarparastii] khazonakh'oi [moli va g'izoii in] sarzamin bigumor, [ki] be tardid, man nigakh'bone dono kh'astam>>

Va in guna ba Iusuf dar on sarzamin manzalat [-u k'udrat] dodem, [on chunon] ki [metavonist ba kh'ar ch'o biravad va] dar kh'ar ch'oie az on ki mekhost, ik'omat mekard. Mo rakh'mati khudro ba kh'ar ki bikhokh'em merasonem
Va podoshi okhirat baroi kasone, ki imon ovardaand va parkh'ezgori kardaand, bekh'tar ast
Va [chun sarzamini Kan'onro khushksoli faro girift] barodaroni Iusuf [baroi takh'iiai gandum ba Misr] omadand va bar u vorid shudand. Pas, u onkh'oro shinokht, dar kh'ole ki onon vairo nashinokhtand
Pas, chun borkh'oiashonro omoda kard, [ba onon] guft: <<[Navbati oianda] Barodarero, ki az padaraton dored, nazdi man ovared. Oio namebined, ki man paimonaro tamom medikh'am va bekh'tarin mizbonam?
Pas, agar uro nazdam naovared, paimonae nazdi man nakhokh'ed dosht va nazdikam nashaved>>
[Barodaron] Guftand: <<Uro az padarash khokh'em khost va kh'atman, in korro mekunem>>

Va [Iusuf] ba g'ulomonash guft: <<Sarmoiakh'oiashonro [ki baroi kharidi g'alla ovardaand, makhfiiona] dar borkh'oiashon biguzored, shoiad kh'angome ki ba suii khonavodai khud bozgashtand, onro [bubinand va] bishnosand. Umed, ki bozoiand>>

Pas, chun ba suii padarashon bozgashtand, guftand: <<Padarch'on, paimona [va sakh'mi g'allai navbati oianda]-ro az mo bozdoshtand, pas, barodaramon [Biniomin]-ro bo mo bifirist, to sakh'me [az g'alla] bigirem va mo kh'atman, murok'ibash khokh'em bud>>

[Ia'k'ub] guft: <<Oio kh'amon guna, ki peshtar shumoro nisbat ba barodarash [Iusuf] amin doshtam, [in bor kh'am] bar u amin bidonam? Pas, Allokh' taolo bekh'tarin nigakh'bon ast va u mekh'rubontarini mekh'rubonon ast>>

Va chun bori khudro kushodand, sarmoiaashonro ioftand, ki ba onon bozgardonda shuda bud. Guftand: <<Padarch'on, [digar] chi mekhokh'em? In sarmoiai most, ki ba mo bozgardonida shudaast, [bad-in vasila] baroi khonavodai khud ozuk'a meovarem va barodaramonro [niz] kh'ifozat mekunem va [bo burdani Biniomin] iak bori shutur izofa megirem. In paimona [baroi Azizi Misr kori] osonest

[Ia'k'ub] Guft: <<Kh'argiz uro bo shumo nakhokh'am firistod, to bo man ba nomi Allokh' taolo paimoni ustuvore bibanded, ki kh'atman uro nazdi man bozmeovared, magar on ki giriftor shaved [va kh'ech' iak nach'ot naiobed]. Pas, chun [akh'du] paimoni ustuvori khesh ba u dodand, [Ia'k'ub] guft: <<Allokh' taolo bar on chi meguem, [guvokh'u] nigakh'bon ast>>

Va [kh'amchunon] guft: <<Ei pisaronam, [baroi on ki ch'albi tavach'ch'ukh' nakuned] az iak dar vorid nashaved, balki az darkh'oi mukhtalif dokhil shaved va [albatta, bo in suporish] nametavonam chize az [k'azo va k'adari] Allokh'ro az shumo dur kunam. Kh'ukm ch'uz baroi Allokh' taolo nest. Bar U tavakkal kardam va tavakkalkunandagon boiad bar U tavakkal kunand

Va chun kh'amon guna ki padarashon ba onon dastur doda bud, vorid shudand. [In shevai vurud] Eshonro az [k'azoi] Allokh' taolo boznadosht, vale [kh'ar chi bud] niiozi k'albi Ia'k'ubro barovarda kard. U az [barakati] on chi bad-u omukhta budem, doroi donishe farovon bud, vale beshtari mardum namedonand

Va chun [barodaron] bar Iusuf vorid shudand, barodarash [Biniomin]-ro nazdi khud ch'oi dod [va ba okh'istagi ba u] guft: <<Man barodarat kh'astam, pas, az korkh'oe, ki [barodaronamon] mekardand, andukh'gin mabosh>>

Pas, kh'angome ki borkh'oiashonro omoda kard, ch'omi [podshokh']-ro dar bori barodarash [Biniomin] guzosht, on gokh' nidodikh'andae bong barovard [ki]: <<Ei korvoniion, kh'atman, shumo duzd kh'asted>>
[Barodaroni Iusuf] Ru ba onon kardand va guftand: <<Chi gum kardaed>>?
[Korguzoron] Guftand: <<Paimonai podshokh'ro gum kardaem va [on ki bong barovarda bud, guft] kh'ar ki onro biiovarad, iak bori shutur [ch'oiza] dorad va man zomini in [podosh] kh'astam>>
[Barodaroni Iusuf] Guftand: <<Ba Allokh' taolo savgand, shumo medoned, ki mo naiomadaem, to dar in sarzamin fasod kunem va mo [kh'argiz] duzd nabudaem>>
[Onon] Guftand: <<Pas, agar durug'gu boshed, kaifarash chist>>?
Guftand: <<Kaifari kase, ki [on paimona] dar borash paido shavad, [in ast, ki] khudash kaifari on boshad [va ba bardagii shumo daroiad]. Mo sitamgoronro in guna much'ozot mekunem>>

Pas, [Iusuf] pesh az bori barodarash, shuru' ba [ch'ustuch'ui] borkh'oi onon kard, sipas on [paimona]-ro az bori barodarash berun kashid. In guna baroi Iusuf choraandeshi kardem, [to bitavonad Biniominro nazdi khud nigakh' dorad, zero u] tibk'i oini podshokh'i [Misr] nametavonist barodarashro bozdosht kunad, magar in ki Allokh' taolo bikhokh'ad. Mo darach'oti kh'ar kiro bikhokh'em bolo mebarem va [bidoned, ki] farotar az kh'ar sokh'ibdonishe donishvare kh'ast

[Barodaron] Guftand: <<Agar u duzdi kardaast [shigift nest, charo ki] barodarash [niz] pesh az in duzdi karda bud. Pas, Iusuf onro dar dili khesh pinkh'on dosht va [norokh'atiash] bar onon oshkor nakard [va bo khud] guft: <<Shumo az nazari ch'oigokh' [az on chi vonamud mekuned], badtared va Allokh' taolo ba on chi baion mekuned, donotar ast>>
Guftand: <<Ei Aziz, u padari pire dorad [ki tok'ati durii farzandashro nadorad], pas, iake az moro ba ch'oii u bigir. Ba rosti, ki mo turo az nakukoron mebinem>>
[Iusuf] Guft: <<Panokh' bar Allokh' taolo, ki ch'uz on kasero, ki koloiamonro nazdash ioftaem, bozdosht kunem! On gokh' [agar chunin kunem] kh'atman, sitamgor khokh'em bud>>

Pas, chun [barodaron] az u noumed shudand, nach'vokunon ba gushae raftand. [Barodari] Buzurgashon guft: <<Magar namedoned, ki padaraton bo nomi Allokh' taolo paimone ustuvor az shumo giriftaast va peshtar [niz] dar mavridi Iusuf chi kutokh'ie karded? Man kh'argiz az in sarzamin nameravam, to padaram ba man ich'ozati [bozgasht] dikh'ad io [on ki] Allokh' taolo dar boraam dovari kunad, [ki] be tardid, U bekh'tarin dovar ast
[Shumo] Nazdi padaraton bozgarded va bigued: <<Ei padar, pisarat duzdi kard va mo ch'uz ba on chi medonistem, guvokh'i nadodem va az g'aib ogokh' nabudem [ki bidonem duzdi mekunad]
Va az [mardumi] shakh're, ki dar on budem va az korvone, ki bo on omadem, bipurs va mo, kh'atman, rostguem>>

[Ia'k'ub] Guft: <<[Chunin nest] Balki kh'avoi nafsi shumo kor [-i noshoista]-ro baroiaton orosta ast, pas, [chorai kor] sabre nakust. Umed ast, ki Allokh' taolo kh'amai ononro ba man birasonad. Be tardid, U donoi kh'akim ast>>
Va az onon ru bigardond va guft: <<Dareg' az Iusuf>>! Va chashmonash az shiddati andukh' [va giristan baroi farzandash] safed shud va kh'amchunon andukh'i khudro furu mekhurd
[Pisaronash] Guftand: <<Ba Allokh' taolo savgand, tu [on k'adr] paivasta az Iusuf iod mekuni, to [ok'ibat] ba sakhti bemor shavi io bimiri>>
[Ia'k'ub] Guft: <<Man az dardu andukh'i khesh ba [dargokh'i] Allokh' taolo menolam va az [lutfu buzurgii] Allokh' taolo chizkh'oe medonam, ki shumo namedoned>>

Ei pisaronam, biraved va dar borai Iusuf va barodaronash ch'ustuch'u kuned [va khabar bigired] va az rakh'mati Allokh' taolo ma'ius nashaved, [charo ki] ch'uz gurukh'i kofiron, kase az rakh'mati Allokh' taolo ma'ius namegardad>>

Pas, chun [pisaroni Ia'k'ub ba Misr raftand va] bar u [ Iusuf] vorid shudand, guftand: <<Ei Aziz, ba mo va khonadonamon [dar asari fak'ru khushksoli] sakhtii farovone rasidaast va [inak] koloi nochiz [va moli andake baroi kharidi g'alla] bo khud ovardaem, pas, paimonaro baroiamon komil kun va bar mo sadak'a [va bakhshish] kun. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo bakhshandagonro podosh medikh'ad>>
[Iusuf] Guft: <<Oio donisted, ki vak'te [az ok'ibati koraton] bekhabar buded, dar kh'ak'k'i Iusuf va barodarash chi karded>>?

[Onon] Guftand: <<Oio ba rosti, tu [kh'amon] Iusufi>>? U guft: <<[Ore] Man Iusufam va in barodari man ast. Iak'inan, Allokh' taolo bar mo minnat nikh'od. Ba rosti, kh'ar ki parkh'ezkori va shikeboi kunad, pas, [bidonad, ki] be tardid, Allokh' taolo podoshi nakukoronro tabokh' namekunad>>
[Barodaronash] Guftand: <<Ba Allokh' taolo savgand, [ki] iak'inan, Allokh' taolo turo bar mo bartari dodaast va mo, kh'atman, khatokor budem>>
[Iusuf] Guft: <<Imruz kh'ech' sarzanishe bar shumo nest. Allokh' taolo shumoro meomurzad va U mekh'rubontarini mekh'rubonon ast
[Aknun] In perokh'ani maro bibared va bar rui padaram biandozed, to bino gardad va [sipas] kh'amai khonavodai khudro nazdi man biiovared>>
Va chun korvon [az Misr ba suii Kan'on] ba rokh' aftod, padarashon [ba atrofiionash] guft: <<Agar maro kamkhirad nashumored, [meguiam, ki] iak'inan, buii Iusufro ekh'sos mekunam>>
[Onon] Guftand: <<Ba Allokh' taolo savgand, ki kh'atman, [boz kh'am] dar ishtibokh'i derinaat kh'asti>>

Pas, chun muzhdarason omad va on [perokh'an]-ro bar chekh'rai u afkand, pas, nogakh'on bino shud [va] guft: <<Oio ba shumo naguftam, ki man az [lutfu buzurgii] Allokh' taolo chizkh'oe medonam, ki shumo namedoned>>?
Guftand: <<Ei padar, baroi mo [ba khotiri] gunokh'onamon omurzish bikhokh', [charo ki] iak'inan, mo gunakh'gor budem>>
[Ia'k'ub] Guft: <<Ba zudi baroiaton az Parvardigoram omurzish metalabam. Be tardid, U omurzandai mekh'rubon ast>>

Pas, [kh'amagi ba Misr raftand va] chun bar Iusuf vorid shudand, u padaru modarashro [dar og'ush girift va] nazdi khud ch'oi dodu guft: <<[Kh'amagi ba Misr daroed, ki inshoallokh' [az kh'ar guna ozore] emin khokh'ed bud>>

Va padaru modarashro bar takht nishond va [kh'amagi] baroiash ba sach'da aftodand va [Iusuf] guft: <<Padarch'on, in ta'bir [-i kh'amon] khobam ast, ki peshtar dida budam. Parvardigoram onro rost gardonid [va takh'ak'k'uk' bakhshid]. Iak'inan, U ba man neki kard, ki maro az zindon berun ovard va pas az on ki shaiton miioni manu barodaronam fitna barpo kard, shumoro az biiobon [-i Kan'on ba Misr] ovard. Be tardid, Parvardigoram dar on chi mekhokh'ad, borikbin ast. Ba rosti, ki U donoi kh'akim ast

Parvardigoro, maro az farmonravoi [bakh'rae] ato kardi va ilmi ta'biri khobkh'o ba man omukhti. Ei Padidovarandai osmonkh'o va zamin, Tui, ki dar dunio va okhirat [dustu] korsozi mani. Maro musulmon [farmonbardor] bimiron va ba shoistagon mulkh'ak' farmo>>
Ei paiombar] in [doston] az khabarkh'oi g'aib ast, ki ba tu vakh'i mekunem va kh'angome ki [barodaroni Iusuf alaikh'i vai] badandeshi mekardand va nairang mezadand, tu nazdashon nabudi
Va beshtari mardum mu'min nestand, kh'atto agar [baroi imon ovardanashon] kh'irs bivarzi
Tu az onon baroi in [risolat] podosh namekhokh'i. In [K'ur'on chize] nest, magar pande baroi ch'akh'oniion
Va chi bisior nishonakh'o dar osmonkh'o va zamin vuch'ud dorad, ki bar onkh'o meguzarand, va [-le] az onkh'o rui barmegardonand [va tavach'ch'ukh' namekunand]
Va beshtarashon [dar zokh'ir] ba Allokh' taolo imon nameovarand, magar on ki [dar amal ba nav'e] mushrikand
Oio [mushrikon] emin kh'astand az in ki azobe farogir az ch'onibi Allokh' taolo bar onon furud oiad io dar kh'ole ki g'ofiland, nogakh'on k'iiomat bar eshon faro rasad?

[Ei paiombar, ba mardum] bigu: <<In rokh'i man ast. Man bo daleli oshkor ba suii Allokh' taolo da'vat mekunam va kasone, ki az man pairavi kardand [niz chunin mekunand] va Allokh' taolo poku munazzakh' ast va man az mushrikon nestam>>

Va Mo pesh az tu ch'uz mardone az akh'li [kh'amin] shakh'rkh'o [-ro ba paiombari] nafiristodaem, ki ba onon vakh'i mekardem. Oio dar zamin gardish nakardaand, to bubinand saranch'omi kasone, pesh az onon budand, chi guna budaast? Va iak'inan, saroi okhirat baroi parkh'ezgoron bekh'tar ast. Oio nameandeshed?

[Mo kh'amchunon ba kofiron mukh'lat medodem] To on gokh' ki paiombaron [az nuzuli azob] ma'ius shudand va [mardum] pindoshtand, ki ba onon durug' gufta shudaast. [Dar in kh'angom] Iorii Mo ba surog'ashon omad. Pas, kh'ar kiro khostem, nach'ot ioft, va[-le] azobi sakhti Mo az gurukh'i much'rimon bozgardonida nameshavad

Iak'inan dar dostoni onon baroi khiradmandon ibratest. In [K'ur'on] sukhane nest, ki ba durug' sokhta shuda boshad, balki tasdik'kunandai on chi [az kitobkh'oe] ast, ki pesh az on [omada] ast va ravshangari kh'ama chiz ast va rakh'namudu rakh'mate ast baroi gurukh'e, ki imon meovarad
Alif, lom, mim, ro. In oioti kitobi [osmoni] va on chi az [suii] Parvardigorat bar tu nozil shudaast, kh'ak' ast, vale beshtari mardum imon nameovarand

Allokh' taolo ast, ki osmonkh'oro biduni sutunkh'oe, ki onkh'oro bubined, barafrosht, on gokh' bar Arsh k'aror girift va khurshedu mokh'ro ba khidmat [-i inson] gumoshtaast, ki kh'ar iak to zamone muaiian dar [madori khud] ravon boshand. U kor [-i ch'akh'on]-ro tadbir mekunad va oioti [khesh]-ro ba ravshani baion medorad, boshad, ki ba didori Parvardigoraton iak'in paido kuned

Va Ust on ki zaminro bigustard va dar on kukh'kh'oi ustuvor va ch'uiborkh'o padid ovard va dar on az kh'ar guna mevae du guna ofarid, shabro ba ruz [va ruzro ba shab] mepushonad. Kh'atman, dar inkh'o baroi mardume, ki meandeshand, nishonakh'oe [az k'udrati Parvardigor] ast

Va dar zamin k'itaote ast dar kanori kh'am [ki bo iakdigar mutafovitand] va [niz] bog'kh'oe az angur va kishtzorkh'ovu darakhtoni khurmo, ki [naru modaand va] gokh' az iak resha meruiand va gokh' az reshakh'oe mutafovitand va [kh'amai onkh'o] bo iak ob serob meshavand. Va [bo in kh'ol] ba'ze az onkh'oro dar [ta'mu khosiiati] meva bar digare bartari medikh'em. Be tardid, dar in [amr niz] baroi mardume, ki khirad mevarzand, nishonakh'o [-i ravshane] kh'ast

Va [ei paiombar] agar [az beimonii kofiron] taach'ch'ub mekuni, ach'ib [-tar] guftori onon ast, ki [dar borai miod meguiand]: <<Oio vak'te khok shudem, vok'ean [zinda meshavem va] dar ofarinishi ch'adide khokh'em bud>>? Inonand, ki ba Parvardigorashon kufr varzidaand va dar gardankh'oiashon [az otash] zanch'irkh'ost va onon akh'li otashand [va] dar on ch'ovidonand

Va [ei paiombar, mushrikon] pesh az neki [rakh'mat] ba shitob az tu badi [azob]-ro darkhost mekunand va kh'ol on ki pesh az eshon [niz bar kofiron] uk'ubatkh'oi ibratomuz raftaast va ba rosti, Parvardigorat nisbat ba mardum, bo vuch'udi sitamgoriashon omurzandaast va beshak Parvardigorat sakhtkaifar ast

Kofiron meguiand: <<Charo nishonakh'o [va mu'ch'izote kh'ammonandi Muso va Iso] az Parvardigorash bar u nozil nashudaast>>? [Ei paiombar] be tardid, tu fak'at bimdikh'andai va kh'ar k'avme [paiombari] kh'idoiatgare dorad
Allokh' taolo medonad on chiro, ki kh'ar modae [dar rakh'im] bor megirad va [niz] on chiro, ki rakh'imkh'o mekokh'and va on chiro meafzoiand va kh'ar chize nazdi U ba andoza [va dak'ik'] ast
[U] Donoi nikh'onu oshkor [va] buzurgu balandmartaba ast

[Ei mardum] Kh'ar kase az shumo, ki sukhani khudro pinkh'on kunad io onro oshkoro baion sozad va kh'ar ki dar [torikii] shab pinkh'on gardad io dar ruz [ba dunboli anch'omi korkh'oiash] biravad, [dar ilmi ilokh'i] iakson ast [va U kh'amaro medonad]

U [Allokh' taolo] farishtagone dorad, ki kh'amvora [bandai] Uro az peshoru va az pushti sarash ba farmoni Allokh' taolo kh'ifz mekunand. Be gumon, Allokh' taolo kh'ol [va sarnavishti nakui] kh'ech' k'avmero tag'iir namedikh'ad, magar on ki onon on chiro, ki dar dilkh'oiashon dorand, digargun sozand [va murtakibi gunokh' shavand]. Va kh'angome ki Allokh' taolo baroi k'avme [giriftori va] badi bikhokh'ad, kh'ech' chiz moneash nakhokh'ad shud va onon ch'uz [Zoti poki] U kh'ech' korsoze nadorand
Ust, ki bark'ro baroi bim [soik'a va otash] va umed [boron] ba shumo menamoionad va abrkh'oi garonborro padid meovarad

Ra'd ba sitoishi U va farishtagon az khavfu khashiat Uro tasbekh' meguiand va [Ust, ki] soik'akh'oro mefiristad. Pas, on [soik'ai margbor] ba kh'ar ki U bikhokh'ad, barkhurd mekunad va onon [kofiron] dar borai [iagonagii] Allokh' taolo much'odala mekunand va U sakhtgir [-u sakhtkaifar] ast

Da'vat ba kh'ak' [tavkh'id] az oni Ust va [butkh'o va digar] kasonero, ki [mushrikon] ba ch'oii U mekhonand, [kh'argiz] ba eshon posukhe namedikh'and, magar monandi kase, ki du dastashro ba suii ob bikushoiad, to [ob] ba dakh'onash birasonad, dar kh'ole ki [kh'ech' obe] ba [dakh'oni] u namerasad va duoi kofiron [dar barobari butkh'oiashon] ch'uz dar gumrokh'i nest
Va kh'ar ki [va kh'ar chi] dar osmonkh'o va zamin ast, khokh'u nokhokh' va [kh'atto] soiakh'oiashon bomdodu shabongokh' baroi Allokh' taolo sach'da [va furutani] mekunand

[Ei Paiombar, ba mushrikon] bigu: << Parvardigori osmonkh'o va zamin kist>>? Bigu: <<Allokh' taolo>>. [Sipas] Bigu: <<Oio ba ch'oii U [dustonu] korsozone barguzidaed, ki [kh'atto] moliki sudu ziioni khud nestand>>? Bigu: <<Oio nobino va bino barobarand? Io torikikh'o va nur iaksonand? Io onon sharikone baroi Allokh' taolo k'aror dodaand, ki kh'amchun ofarinishi U ofaridaand va [dar natich'a amri] ofarinish bar onon mushtabakh' shudaast>>? Bigu: <<Allokh' taolo ofarinandai kh'ama chiz ast va U iagonai piruzmand ast

[Allokh' taolo] Az osmon obe furu borid, on gokh' rudkh'o kh'ar iak ba andozai [g'unch'oishi] khud ch'ori shudand va selob kafk ruii khud barovard va az on chi bar otash meafruzand [va megudozand], to zevar io koloe ba dast ovarand, [niz] kafke kh'ammonandi on [az ob barmeoiad]. Allokh' taolo kh'ak'k'u botilro inchunin misol mezanad. Va ammo kafk ba kanore meravad va nest megardad, vale on chi ba mardum sud merasonad, bar zamin [bok'i] memonad. Allokh' taolo masalkh'o inchunin baion mekunad

Baroi kasone, ki [da'vati] Parvardigorashonro ich'obat kardand, podoshi neki [bikh'isht dar pesh] ast va kasone, ki [da'vati[ Uro ich'obat nakardand, agar tamomi on chi dar zamin ast va [niz] kh'ammonandashro bo on doshtand, iak'inan [kh'ozir budand, ki kh'amaro] baroi rakh'oii khesh [az azob] bipardozand [vale az eshon pazirufta nakhokh'ad shud]. Onon kh'isobi bade dorand [va bozkhoste bisior sakht] va ch'oigokh'ashon duzakh ast va chi bad ch'oigokh'e kh'ast!
Oio kase, ki medonad, ki on chi az [tarafi] Parvardigorat bar tu nozil shuda, kh'ak' ast, monandi kasest, ki [nisbat ba kh'ak'] nobinost? Tankh'o khiradmandon pand megirand.
[Kh'amon] Kasone, ki ba paimoni Allokh' taolo vafo mekunand va akh'd nameshikanand
Va kasone, ki kh'ar on chiro Allokh' taolo ba paivand kardani on farmon dodaast, mepaivandand [silai rakh'im mekunand] va az Parvardigorashon metarsand va az sakhtii kh'isob mekh'arosand

Va kasone, ki baroi kasbi khushnudii Parvardigorashon shikeboi kardaand va namoz barpo doshtaand va az on chi ba onon ruzi dodaem, pinkh'onu oshkoro infok' kardaand va badiro bo neki mezudoiand. Ononand, ki nek farch'ome khokh'and dosht.

[Podoshashon] Bog'kh'oi ch'ovidon [-i bikh'isht ast], ki onon va kh'ar iak az padaron va kh'amsaronu farzandonashon, ki nakukor budaand, ba on vorid meshavand va farishtagon az kh'ar dare bar onon darmeoiand
[Va ba onon meguiand] <<Salom bar shumo ba [podoshi] on chi [bar imonaton] shikeboi kardaed. Pas, chi nakust farch'omi on saro!>>

Va kasone, ki paimoni Allokh'ro pas az ustuvor kardanash meshikanand va on chiro, ki Allokh' taolo ba paivastanash farmon dodaast [silai rakh'im] k'at' mekunand va dar zamin [fitnavu] fasod mekunand, inonand, ki [dar okhirat] la'nat va bad farch'ome dorand

Allokh' taolo [ne'matu] ruziro bar kh'ar ki bikhokh'ad, gusturda medorad va io tang megirad va [kofiron] ba zindagii dunio shod shudand, va[-le] zindagii dunio dar [barobari] okhirat ch'uz bakh'rae [nochiz] nest

Va kasone, ki kufr varzidand, meguiand: <<Charo nishonae az [suii] Parvardigorash bar u nozil nashudaast>>? Bigu: <<Be tardid, Allokh' taolo kh'ar kiro, ki bikhokh'ad gumrokh' mekunad va kh'ar kiro, ki tavba namoiad, ba suii khesh kh'idoiat mekunad>>
[Kh'amon] Kasone, ki imon ovardaand va dilkh'oiashon ba iodi Allokh' taolo orom megirad. Bidoned, ki bo iodi Allokh' taolo ast, ki dilkh'o orom megirad
Kasone, ki imon ovardaand va korkh'oi shoista kardaand, khusho bar onon! Va nek saranch'ome dorand

[Ei paiombar] Bad-in son turo baini ummate firistodem, ki pesh az onkh'o ummatkh'oe omada [va rafta] budand, to on chi bar tu vakh'i kardaem, bar onon bikhoni va kh'ol on ki onon ba [Parvardigori] rakh'mon kufr mevarzand. Bigu: <<U Parvardigori man ast [va] ma'bude [barkh'ak'] ch'uz U nest. Bar U tavakkal kardam va bozgashtam ba suii Ust>>

Va [kh'atto] agar K'ur'one bud, ki kukh'kh'o az [kh'aibati] on ba kh'arakat darmeomad va zamin pora-pora meshikoft io murdagon az [tilovati] on ba sukhan darmeomadand, [boz kh'am kofiron imon nameovardand]. Amri [tadbiri ch'akh'on va nuzuli mu'ch'izot] az oni Allokh' taolo ast. Oio kasone, ki imon ovardaand, namedonand, ki agar Allokh' taolo mekhost, kh'atman, kh'amai mardumro kh'idoiat mekard? Va kasone, ki kufr varzidand, paivasta ba [sazoi] on chi kardaand, giriftori musibati kubandae meshavand io [azobi ilokh'i] nazdiki khonakh'oiashon furud meoiad io [saranch'om] va'dai Allokh' taolo faro merasad. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo khilofi va'da namekunad

[Ei paiombar] Iak'inan, paiombarone, ki pesh az tu budand, [niz] mavridi tamaskhur vok'e' shudand, on gokh' ba kasone, ki kufr varzidand, mukh'lat dodam, sipas ononro [ba azob] furu giriftam. Pas, [bingar, ki] kaifari man chi guna bud

Oio on [Parvardigore], ki kh'okim bar kh'ar kas va [nozir bar] raftoru kirdori ust, [ba parastish sazovortar ast io butkh'oi bech'on]? Va [kofiron] baroi Allokh' taolo sharikone k'aror dodaand. Bigu: <<Ononro nom bared>>. Oio [mekhokh'ed ba] u dar borai on chi dar zamin ast va u namedonad khabar dikh'ed, io fak'at sukhani satkh'ie va [beasos] megued? [Chunin nest] balki baroi kasone, ki kufr varzidaand, nairangashon orosta shudaast va az rokh'i [kh'ak'] bozdoshta shudaand va kh'ar kiro Allokh' taolo gumrokh' guzorad, kh'idoiatgare nakhokh'ad dosht
Onon dar zindagii dunio azob [-i dardnoke] dorand va kh'atman, azobi okhirat sakhttar ast va dar barobari [azobi] Allokh' taolo kh'ech' [ioru] mudofe'e nadorand

Vizhagii bikh'ishte, ki ba parkh'ezgoron va'da doda shuda, [chunin ast, ki] ch'uiborkh'o az zeri [darakhtoni] on ch'ori ast, mevakh'oiash kh'ameshagi va soiaash [niz doimi ast]. In saranch'omi kasonest, ki parkh'ezgori kardaand va saranch'omi kofiron otash [-i duzakh] ast

Va kasone, ki ba onon kitobi osmoni dodaem, az on chi bar tu nozil shudaast, shodmon meshavand va barkhe az gurukh'kh'o[-i akh'li kitob] bakhshe az onro inkor mekunand. [Ei paiombar, ba onon] Bigu: <<Ch'uz in nest, ki man dastur ioftaam, Allokh'ro biparastam va ba U shirk navarzam, ba suii U da'vat mekunam va bozgashtam ba suii Ust>>

Va bad-in son, in K'ur'onro farmone ba zaboni arabi [-i fasekh'] nozil kardem va agar pas az donishe, ki [az ch'onibi Parvardigor] baroiat omadaast, az kh'avaskh'oi onon [mushrikon] pairavi kuni, dar barobari [azobi] Allokh' taolo kh'ech' korsoz va nigakh'dorandae nakhokh'i dosht

Va be tardid, pesh az tu paiombarone firistodem va baroi onon [monandi digar insonkh'o] kh'amsaronu farzandone k'aror dodem va baroi kh'ech' paiombare sazovor nest, ki ch'uz ba farmoni Allokh' taolo [mu'ch'iza va] oiate biiovarad. Kh'ar amre [tak'diru] navishtae [ma'lum] dorad
Allokh' taolo kh'ar chiro, ki bikhokh'ad az miion mebarad va [on chiro bikhokh'ad] ustuvor medorad va ummu-l-kitob [Lavkh'i makh'fuz] nazdi Ust

Va [ei paiombar] agar barkhe az on chiro, ki ba onon va'da medikh'em, ba tu nishon dikh'em io [pesh az faro rasidani azob] turo bimironem, [dar kh'ar kh'ol] fak'at tablig'i [risolat] bar [ukh'dai] tust va kh'isob [-u much'ozotashon] bar most

Oio [kofiron] nadidaand, ki mo [bo futukh'oti lashkari islom] az domanakh'oi sarzamini [kufr] mekokh'em [va bar k'alamravi islom meafzoem]? Va Allokh' taolo kh'ukm mekunad va baroi kh'ukmash [kh'ech'] bozdorandae nest va u dar kh'isobrasi sare' ast

Va ba rosti, kasone, ki pesh az onon budand [baroi muk'obala bo paiombaronashon] makr varzidand, vale tamomi makrkh'o [va tadbirkh'o] az oni Allokh' taolo ast. U medonad, ki kh'ar kase chi mekunad va ba zudi kofiron khokh'and donist, ki farch'omi [nakui] saroi [okhirat] az oni kist

Va kasone, ki kufr varzidand, meguiand: <<[Ei Mukh'ammad] Tu firistoda [-i Allokh' taolo] nesti>>. Bigu: <<Kofist, ki Allokh' taolo va kase, ki donishi [kitobkh'oi osmonii peshin] nazdi Ust, miioni manu shumo guvokh' boshad>>

Alif, lom, ro. In [K'ur'on] kitobest, ki bar tu nozil kardem, to mardumro ba farmoni Parvardigorashon az torikikh'o [-i shirku ch'akh'l] ba rushnoi [-i imon va donish] berun ovari, ba rokh'i [Parvardigori] shikastnopaziri sutuda
Kh'amon] Allokh' taolo, ki on chi dar osmonkh'o va zamin ast, az oni Ust va voi bar kofiron az azobe sakht!
Kasone, ki zindagii dunioro bar okhirat tarch'ekh' medikh'and va [mardumro] az rokh'i Allokh' taolo bozmedorand va on rokh'ro munkh'arif mekhokh'and, inon dar gumrokh'ii duru daroze kh'astand

Mo kh'ech' paiombarero ch'uz ba zaboni k'avmash nafiristodem, to [bitavonad paiomi ilokh'iro] baroiashon baion kunad. Allokh' taolo kh'ar kiro bikhokh'ad, [ba adolati khesh] gumrokh' mesozad va [ba fazli khesh] kh'ar kiro bikhokh'ad, kh'idoiat mekunad va U shikastnopaziri kh'akim ast

Va ba rosti, Mo Musoro bo nishonakh'oe ravshani khud firistodem [va ba u dastur dodem], ki: <<K'avmatro az torikikh'o [-i kufr] ba rushnoii [tavkh'id] berun ovar va ruzkh'oi Allokh'ro ba onon iodovari kun. Be tardid, dar in [iodovari] baroi kh'ar shikeboi shukrguzor nishonakh'oe [az iaktoi va buzurgii Allokh' taolo] ast

Va [ei paiombar, iod kun az] kh'angome ki Muso ba k'avmash guft: <<Ne'mati Allokh'ro bar khud ba iod ovared, on gokh', ki az [changoli] fir'avniion nach'otaton dod, ki badtarin [va sakhttarin] azobro bar saraton meovardand: pisaronatonro mekushtand va zanonatonro [baroi kanizi] zinda meguzoshtand va dar in [amr] az ch'onibi Parvardigoraton baroi shumo ozmoishe buzurg bud [to shikeboiiatonro biiozmoiad]>>
Va [iod kuned az] kh'angome ki Parvardigoraton farmud, ki: <<Agar shukr guzored, iak'inan, [ne'matamro] bar shumo meafzoiam va agar nosiposi kuned, iak'inan, azobi man sakht ast>>
Va Muso ba [onon] guft: <<Agar shumo va kh'amai mardumi rui zamin kofir shaved, pas, [ba Allokh' taolo kh'ech' ziione namerasad, charo ki] be tardid, Allokh' taolo beniiozi sutuda ast>>

[Ei kofiron] Oio khabari [kh'alokati] kasone, ki pesh az shumo budand, [monandi] k'avmi Nukh' va Od va Samud va [niz] onon, ki ba'd az eshon budand [va] ch'uz Allokh' taolo kase az onon khabar nadorad, ba shumo narasidaast? Paiombaronashon bo daloil [-u mu'ch'izot]-i ravshan ba suiashon omadand, vale onon [ba nishonai mukholifat] dastkh'oiashonro bar dakh'onkh'oiashon nikh'odand va [angusht ba dandon gazidandu] guftand: <<Mo on chiro, ki shumo baroi [iblog'i] on firistoda shudaed, inkor mekunem va dar borai on chi moro ba suiash mekhoned, sakht dar tardidem>>

Paiombaronashon guftand: <<Oio dar [iagonagii] Allokh' taolo - Ofarinandai osmonkh'o va zamin tardide kh'ast? U shumoro [ba imon] faro mekhonad, to gunokh'onatonro bibakhshoiad va ba shumo to muddati muaiiane mukh'lat dikh'ad>>. Onon guftand: <<Shumo ch'uz bashare kh'ammonandi mo nested, [va] mekhokh'ed moro az on chi ki padaronamon meparastidand, bozdored. Pas, daleli oshkore [dar mavridi rostguiiaton] baroiamon biiovared>>

Paiombaronashon ba onon guftand: <<[Ore] Mo ch'uz insonkh'oe monandi shumo nestem, vale Allokh' taolo bar kh'ar iak az bandagonash, ki bikhokh'ad [bo ne'mati nubuvvat] minnat menikh'ad va sazovor nest, ki mo ch'uz ba ich'ozati Allokh' taolo baroi shumo dalele biiovarem. Pas, mu'minon boiad bar Allokh' taolo tavakkal kunand

Va charo bar Allokh' taolo tavakkal nakunem va kh'ol on ki u moro ba rokh'kh'oi [saodat]-amon kh'idoiat namud? Va mo bar ozore, ki [dar rokh'i risolat] ba mo merasoned, kh'atman, shikeboi mekunem va tavakkalkunandagon boiad fak'at bar Allokh' taolo tavakkal kunand>>

Va kasone, ki kufr varzidand ba paiombaronashon guftand: <<Io shumoro az sarzaminamon berun mekunem io ba oini mo bozgarded>>. Pas, Parvardigorashon ba onon vakh'i kard, ki: <<Iak'inan sitamgoronro nobud mekunem
Va kh'atman, shumoro pas az onon dar zamin ch'oi khokh'em dod. In [azobu podosh] baroi kasest, ki az istodan [ba kh'angomi kh'isobrasi] dar peshgokh'i man bitarsad va az takh'didam bikh'arosad>>
Va [paiombaron az Allokh' taolo] darkhosti piruzi [bar kofironro] kardand va [saranch'om] kh'ar gardankashi sitezach'u nokom [-u nobud] shud
[Kh'amon ki] Duzakh peshorui ust va ba vai obe az chirki khunoludi [duzakhiion] menushonand

[Obe] Ki onro ch'ur'a-ch'ur'a meoshomad va [az farti taaffunu talkhi] furu burdanash osonu guvoro nest va marg az kh'ar taraf ru ba suiash meovarad, vale namemirad va azobe sakht [-u sakh'mgine] peshoruii ust

Masali kasone, ki ba Pravardigorashon kufr varzidaand, [in ast, ki] raftorashon kh'amchun khokistarest, ki dar ruzi tufoni bod bar on mevazad, ki az on chi kardaand, chize dar dast nadorand. In kh'amon gumrokh'ii duru daroz ast
[Ei inson] Oio nadidi, ki Allokh' taolo osmonkh'o va zaminro ba kh'ak' ofaridaast? Agar bikhokh'ad, shumoro [az miion] mebarad va ofarinishe ch'adid [ba ch'oiaton padid] meovarad
Va in [kor] bar Allokh' taolo dushvor nest

Va [ruzi k'iiomat] kh'amagi dar peshgokh'i Allokh' taolo kh'ozir [-u oshkor] meshavand, pas, [dar in kh'angom] sitamdidagon ba kasone, ki gardankashi mekardand, meguiand: << Mo [dar dunio] pairavi shumo budem, pas, oio [imruz] metavoned, chize az azobi Allokh'ro az mo bozdored>>? Onon meguiand: <<Agar Allokh' taolo moro [dar dunio ba suii rastagori] rokh'namoi mekard, mo niz rokh'ro ba shumo nishon medodem. Chi betobi kunem io shikeboi namoem, baroiamon iakson ast. [Kh'ech'] Gurezgokh'e nadorem>>

Va chun kori [dovari] anch'om shud, shaiton meguiad: <<Be tardid, Allokh' taolo ba shumo va'da dod va va'dai rostu durust va man ba shumo va'da[-i durug'in] dodam va bo shumo khilofi va'da kardam va man bar shumo kh'ech' tasallute nadoshtam, ch'uz in ki da'vataton kardam va shumo [niz] ich'obatam namuded. Pas, maro sarzanish nakuned va khudro sarzanish kuned. [Imruz] Na man fariodrasi shumo kh'astam va na shumo fariodrasi man kh'asted. Man bezoram az in ki pesh az in maro [bo Allokh' taolo] sharik megirifted. Sitamgoroni [mushrik] azobe purdard khokh'and dosht

Va kasone, ki imon ovardand va korkh'oi shoista anch'om dodand, ba bog'kh'oi [bikh'ishte] darovarda meshavand, ki ch'uiborkh'o az zeri [darakhtoni] on ch'ori ast. Ba farmoni Parvardigorashon dar on ch'ovidonand va durudashon dar on ch'o <<salom>> ast

[Ei paiombar] Oio nadidi, ki Allokh' taolo chi guna masal zadaast? Kalimai pok [-i lo ilokh'a illallokh'] kh'amchun darakhti [nakhli tanumandu] pokest, ki reshaash [dar a'mok'i zamin] ustuvor ast va shokhaash bar osmon [sar barovarda] ast
Mevaashro kh'ar lakh'za ba farmoni Parvardigorash medikh'ad va Allokh' taolo [baroi kh'idoiati mardum] masalkh'o mezanad, boshad, ki pand girand
Va masali kalimai palid [shirk] kh'amchun darakhti palidest, ki az zamin barkanda shuda [va kh'ech'] k'aroru subote nadorad

Allokh' taolo kasonero, ki imon ovardaand, dar zindagii dunio va dar okhirat bo sukhani ustuvor [-i tavkh'id] sobit megardonad va sitamgaron [-i mushrik]-ro gumrokh' mekunad va Allokh' taolo kh'ar chi bikhokh'ad mekunad
Oio nadidi on kasone [az K'uraish]-ro, ki [siposi] ne'mati Allokh' taolo [Kh'arami amn va vuch'udi paiombar]-ro ba [nosiposi va] kufr badal kardand va k'avmashonro ba saroi kh'alok darovardand?
[On saroi kh'alok] Duzakh ast, [ki] dar on vorid meshavand va chi bad ch'oigokh'est!

[Mushrikon] Baroi Allokh' taolo kh'amtoione k'aror dodaand, to [mardumro] az rokh'i U gumrokh' kunand. Bigu: <<[Chand ruze az ne'matkh'oi dunio] Bakh'ra gired, pas, iak'inan bozgashtaton ba suii otashi [duzakh] ast>>

[Ei paiombar] ba bandagoni man, ki imon ovardaand, bigu, namoz barpo dorand va az on chi ruziashon kardaem, pinkh'ou oshkor infok' kunand, pesh az on ki ruze faro rasad, ki dar on na kharidu furushest va na dustie

Allokh' taolo ast, ki osmonkh'o va zaminro ofarid va az osmon obe furu firistod va bo on [anvoi] mevakh'oro baroi ruzii shumo padid ovard va kishtikh'oro ba khidmataton gumosht, to ba farmonash dar dario ravon boshand va ch'uiborkh'oro [niz] dar khidmati shumo nikh'od
Va khurshedu mokh'ro, ki paivasta [dar madori khud] ravonand va [kh'amchunin] shabu ruzro ba khidmataton gumosht

Va az kh'ar on chi az u khosted, ba shumo bakhshid va agar ne'mati Allokh'ro bishmored, [chunon farovon ast, ki] nametavoned onro shumorish kuned. Ba rosti, ki inson, [dar kh'ak'k'i khesh] sitamgor [va nisbat ba Allokh' taolo] nosipos ast
Va [iod kun az] Ibrokh'im kh'angome ki guft: <<Parvardigoro, in shakh'r [Makka]-ro amn bigardon va manu farzandonamro az parastishi butkh'o dur bidor

Parvardigoro, ba rosti, ki onkh'o [butkh'o] bisiore az mardumro [bo tasavvuri shafoat] gumrokh' sokhtaand, pas, kh'ar ki [dar iaktoparasti] az man pairavi kunad, iak'inan, az man ast va kh'ar ki az man nofarmoni kunad, pas, be tardid, tu omurzandai mekh'ruboni

Parvardigoro, man barkhe farzandonam [Ismoil va khonadonash]-ro dar zamini beobu kisht nazdi khonai mukh'taram [-u shukukh'mand]-i Tu ch'oi dodam. Parvardigoro, [chunin kardam] to namoz barpo dorand, pas, dilkh'oi barkhe az mardumro chunon kun, ki ba suii onon [va in sarzamin] mutamoil gardad va ba eshon az makh'suloti [mavridi niiozashon] ruzi bibakhsh, boshad, ki sipos guzorand
Parvardigoro, tu on chiro, ki pinkh'on mekunemu oshkor mesozem, [kh'amaro] medoni va chize dar zaminu osmon az Allokh' taolo pushida nest
Sitoish az oni Allokh' taolo ast, ki dar kukh'ansoli Ismoil va Iskh'ok'ro ba man ato farmud. Be tardid, Parvardigoram shunavandai duost
Parvardigoro, maro barpodorandai namoz k'aror bidekh' va az farzandonam [niz chunin kun]. Parvardigoro, duoiamro bipazir
Parvardigoro, man va padaru modaram va [kh'amai] mu'minonro ruze, ki kh'isob barpo meshavad, biiomurz>>

Va [ei paiombar, kh'argiz] mapindor, ki Allokh' taolo az on chi sitamgoron mekunand, g'ofil ast. [Na, balki kaifari] ononro baroi ruze ba ta'khir meafkanad, ki chashmkh'o dar on [az vakh'shat] khira meshavand

Dar kh'ole ki [ba suii munodii makh'shar] shitobonand va sarkh'oro bolo giriftaand [va bo bek'arori ba osmon menigarand] va chashm bar kh'am namezanand va dilkh'oiashon [az vakh'shat] tikh'i gashtaast

Va [ei paiombar] mardumro az ruze bitarson, ki azobi ilokh'i ba surog'ashon meoiad, pas, onon, ki [bo kufru shirk ba khesh] sitam kardaand, meguiand: <<Parvardigoro, andake ba mo mukh'lat bidekh', to [ba dunio bozgardem va] da'vatatro posukh guem va az paiombaron pairavi kunem. [Gufta shavad] <<Shumo nabuded, ki peshtar savgand mekhurded, ki shumoro fanoe nest>>?

Va [magar na in ast, ki] dar khonakh'oi kasone, ki [bo shirku nosiposi] ba kheshtan sitam karda budand [k'avmi Kh'ud va Solekh'] sokin shuded va baroiaton ravshan shud, ki [chun kufr varzidand] bo onon chi guna raftor kardem va [az sarguzashti peshiniion] baroiaton masalkh'o zadem [vale boz kh'am pand nagirifted]

Va onon nikh'oiati nairangi khudro [baroi mukholifat bo paiombar va kushtani u] ba kor burdand va makrashon nazdi Allokh' taolo [oshkor] ast, kh'archand nairangashon [chunon zaif ast, ki] nametavonad kukh'kh'oro az ch'oi bardorad
Pas, kh'argiz mapindor, ki Allokh' taolo va'dai kheshro [dar borai piruzii kh'ak'] bo paiombaronash khilof mekunad. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo shikastnopaziri dodsiton ast
Dar on ruz [in] zamin ba zamine digar va osmonkh'o [ba osmonkh'oi digar] tabdil meshavand va [mardum] dar muk'obili Allokh'i iagonai piruzmand zokh'ir megardand
Va gunakh'goronro dar on ruz mebini, ki dar zanch'irkh'o basta shudaand
Ch'omakh'oiashon az k'iri gudokhta ast va otash suratkh'oiashonro mepushonad
To Allokh' taolo kh'ar kiro ba [sazoi] on chi kardaast, kaifar dikh'ad. Ba rosti, ki Allokh' taolo dar kh'isobrasi sare' ast
In [K'ur'on] paiome raso baroi mardum ast [to ba vasilai on kh'idoiat shavand] va bo on kh'ushdor ioband va bidonand, ki U ma'bude iaktost va to khiradmandon pand girand
Alif, lom, ro. In oioti kitob [-i ilokh'i] va K'ur'oni ravshangar ast
Chi baso kofiron [kh'angomi rubarushavi bo azobi k'iiomat] orzu kunand, ki kosh musulmon budand
Biguzor bikhurand va [az lazzatkh'oi dunio] bakh'ramand boshand va orzukh'o [-i moddi] sargarmashon sozad, pas, ba zudi khokh'and donist
Mo [sokinoni] kh'ech' [shakh'ru] diiorero kh'alok nakardem, magar in ki [mukh'lat va] ach'ale muaiian doshtand
Kh'ech' ummate az ach'ali [muk'arrarii] khud na peshi megirad va na [az on] ak'ib memonad
[Kofiron] guftand: <<Ei kase, ki [iddao mekuni] K'ur'on bar tu nozil shudaast, iak'inan devonai
Agar rost megui, charo farishtagonro nazdamon nameovari [to dar borai paiombariat guvokh'i dikh'and]>>?
[Boiad bidonand, ki] Mo farishtagonro ba kh'ak' [va fak'at dar kh'angomi azobi kofiron] nozil mekunem va [agar baroi azobashon nozil shavand] digar mukh'late nameioband
Ba rosti, ki mo khud K'ur'onro nozil kardem va kh'atman, khud niz [az kh'ar guna tabdilu takh'rife] nigakh'bonash kh'astem
[Ei paiombar] pesh az tu niz [firistodagoni khudro] miioni gurukh'kh'oi peshin firistodem
Kh'ech' paiombare nazdashon nameomad, magar on ki maskharaash mekardand
Inchunin on [takzib va tamaskhur]-ro dar dilkh'oi gunakh'goron [kofiron] rokh' medikh'em
Onon ba on [K'ur'on] imon nameovarand va shevai [Allokh' taolo dar much'ozoti] peshiniion [niz chunin] raftaast [ki ononro bo azobe dardnok kh'alok namoiad]
Va [kh'atto] agar dare az osmon ba ruii onon mekushodem, to paivasta dar on bolo ravand [va shigiftikh'oi malakutro bubinand]
Iak'inan, boz kh'am meguftand: <<Be tardid, moro chashmbandi kardaand, balki mo gurukh'e ch'odushudaem>>
Va ba rosti, mo dar osmon sitoragone [buzurgu durakhshon] k'aror dodem va onkh'oro baroi tamoshogaron orostem
Va onro az [vurudu dastburdi] kh'ar shaitoni rondashuda kh'ifz kardem
Magar on ki [az malakutiion] duzdona sukhane bishnavad, ki [dar on surat] shikh'obe ravshan uro dunbol mekunad [va mesuzonad]
Va zaminro gusturdem va dar on kukh'kh'oi ustuvore afkandem va az kh'ar giiokh'i sanch'ida [va munosibe] dar on ruionidem
Va dar on baroi shumo va baroi kase, ki ruzirasonash nested [soiri mardum va mavch'udoti zinda], asbobi zindagi padid ovardem
Va kh'ech' chiz nest, magar on ki ganch'inakh'oiash nazdi Most va Mo onro ch'uz ba andozai muaiian furu namefiristem
Va bodkh'oro borvarkunanda [-i abrkh'o] firistodem, sipas az osmonkh'o obe nozil kardem va bo on serobaton sokhtem, dar kh'ole ki shumo zakhirakunandaash nested
Va iak'inan, moem, ki zinda mekunem va memironem va Mo [bozmondai ch'ovidu] voris [-i kh'amai ch'akh'oniion] kh'astem
Va be tardid, [tavalludu margi] guzashtagoni shumoro donistaem va iak'inan [tavalludu margi] oiandagonro [niz ba khubi] medonem
Va [ei paiombar] be gumon, Parvardigorat [kh'amai] ononro [dar k'iiomat] makh'shur mekunad. Ba rosti, ki U kh'akimu donost
Va dar kh'ak'ik'at, Mo [nakhustin] inson [Odam]-ro az gili khushk [-i bozmonda] az loii badbu ofaridem
Va pesh az on ch'inro az otashe suzon ofaridem
Va [iod kun] az kh'angome ki Parvardigorat ba farishtagon farmud: <<Kh'amono man basharero az gili khushk [-i bozmonda] az loii badbu khokh'em ofarid
Pas, chun [uro ofaridem va] ba u somon dodem va az rukh'i khesh dar vai damidem, [ba nishonai itoat az farmoni Man kh'amagi] bar u sach'da kuned>>
Pas, farishtagon kh'amagi sach'da kardand
Magar Iblis, ki az on ki bo sach'dakunandagon boshad, sarpechi kard
[Allokh' taolo] Farmud: <<Ei Iblis, charo tu bo sach'dakunandagon [kh'amrokh'] nesti>>?
[Iblis] guft: <<Man on nestam, ki baroi bashare, ki uro az gili khushk [-i bozmonda] az loii badbu ofaridai sach'da kunam>>
[Allokh' taolo] Farmud: <<Az on ch'o [bikh'isht] berun shav, [ki] be tardid, tu [az borgokh'i Mo] rondashudai
Va iak'inan, to ruzi k'iiomat bar tu la'nat khokh'ad bud>>
[Iblis] Guft: <<Parvardigoro, to ruze, ki [mardum] barangekhta meshavand, ba man mukh'lat bidekh' [va namiron]>>
[Allokh' taolo] Farmud: <<[Birav, ki] Iak'inan, tu az mukh'latioftagoni
To ruzi on vak'ti ma'lum [ki tamomi makhluk'ot bo nafkhai nakhust memirand]>>
[U] Guft: <<Parvardigoro, ba sababi on ki maro gumrokh' sokhti, dar zamin [badikh'oro] dar nazarashon nek ch'ilva medikh'am va kh'amai ononro ba gumrokh'i mekashonam
Magar bandagoni kholisi Tu az [miioni] onon [ki kh'idoiatashon kardai]>>
[Allokh' taolo] Farmud: <<In [ikhlos] rokh'i mustak'imest [ki ba Man merasad]
