Iak'inan, tu bar bandagonam tasallute nadori, magar [bar on mushrikon va] gumrokh'one, ki az tu pairavi mekunand
Va be tardid, duzakh va'dagokh'i kh'amai onon ast
[Duzakh] Kh'aft dar dorad [va] baroi kh'ar dare gurukh'e az onon tak'sim [va mushakhkhas] shudaand>>
Iak'inan, parkh'ezgoron dar bog'kh'o [-i bikh'isht] va dar [kanori] chashmakh'o kh'astand
Kh'angomi vurud ba onon gufta meshavad] <<Ba salomat va emini ba on [bog'kh'o] vorid shaved>>
On chi dar dilkh'oiashon az kina [va kh'asad] ast, barmekanem, barodarona bar takhtkh'o muk'obili iakdigarand
Dar on ch'o na ranch'e ba onon merasad va na az on ch'o berun ronda meshavand
[Ei paiombar] Ba bandagonam khabar bidekh', ki man omurzandai mekh'rubonam
Va in ki azobi man azobe dardnok ast
Va az mekh'mononi Ibrokh'im [niz] ba onon khabar bidekh'
Kh'angome ki bar u vorid shudand, salom guftand, [ammo chun dast ba g'izo naburdand, Ibrokh'im] guft: <<Mo az shumo kh'arosonem>>
Onon guftand: <<Natars, mo turo ba pisare dono muzhda medikh'em>>
[Ibrokh'im] Guft: <<Oio bo in ki solkhurda shudaam, muzhda [-i tavalludi farzand] ba man medikh'ed? Ba chi [dalel inchunin] bashorat medikh'ed>>?
Onon guftand: <<Mo turo ba durusti bashorat dodem, pas, noumed nabosh>>
[Ibrokh'im] Guft: <<Va ch'uz gumrokh'on chi kase az rakh'mati Parvardigorash noumed megardad>>?
[On gokh' ba farishtagon] guft: <<Ei firistodagon, kor [-u ma'muriiat]-i shumo chist>>?
Onon guftand: <<Dar kh'ak'ik'at, mo ba suii k'avmi gunakh'gor [-i Lut] firistoda shudaem [to kh'alokashon kunem]
Ba ch'uz khonavodai Lut, ki mo iak'inan, kh'amai ononro nach'ot khokh'em dod
Magar kh'amsarash, ki muk'addar kardaem, ki az bozmondagon [dar azob] boshad>>
Pas, kh'angome ki farishtagon [-i Allokh' taolo ba shakli inson] nazdi khonadoni Lut omadand
[U] Guft: <<Shumo gurukh'e noshinos kh'asted>>
[Farishtagon] Guftand: <<Balki mo kh'amon chizero baroiat ovardaem, ki [in mardumi gunakh'gor] dar boraash tardid mekardand [nuzuli azob]
Va mo baroiat [khabari kh'ak'ik'i va] rost ovardaem va kh'atman, mo rostguem

Pas, pose az shab [ki guzasht] khonavodaatro bo khud [az in ch'o] bibar va [khudat] ba dunbolashon birav va kh'ech' iak az shumo pushti sarashro nigokh' nakunad va ba ch'oie, ki ba shumo farmon medikh'and, biraved>>
Va Mo u [Lut]-ro az in amr ogokh' kardem, ki subkh'gokh'on reshai onon kanda khokh'ad shud
Va akh'li shakh'r, dar kh'ole ki [dar borai omadani afrodi ch'adid] bo shodi [ba iakdigar] khabar medodand, [ba suii khonai Lut] omadand
[Lut] Guft: <<Inkh'o mekh'mononi man kh'astand, pas, maro rasvo [va sharmandai mekh'mononam] nakuned
Va az Allokh' taolo bitarsed va sarshikastaam nasozed>>
[Onon] Guftand: <<Magar mo turo az [mizbonii] afrodi [g'arib] nakh'i nakardem>>?
[Lut] Guft: <<Agar mekhokh'ed, [kore kh'alol] anch'om dikh'ed, inkh'o dukhtaroni [ummati] man kh'astand [bo eshon izdivoch' kuned]>>
Savgand ba ch'oni tu [ei paiombar], ki onon dar mastii khesh sargashta budand
Pas, kh'angomi baromadani oftob bongi [margbor] ononro faro girift
On gokh' on [sarzamin]-ro zeruru kardem va bar onon sanggilkh'oe paiopai boridem
Ba iak'in, dar in [kaifar] baroi kh'ushioron ibratkh'ost
Va on [shakh'rkh'oi vairona kh'anuz] bar sari rokh'i [musofiron] pobarch'ost.
Iak'inan, dar in [azob] nishonakh'oe baroi [ibrat giriftani] mu'minon ast
Va askh'obi Aika [k'avmi Shuaib], kh'atman, sitamgor budand
Pas, [Mo] az onon intik'om giriftem va [shakh'rkh'oi vaironshudai] in du [k'avm] bar sari rokh' oshkor ast
Va be tardid, akh'li Kh'ich'r [k'avmi Samud] paiombaronro durug'gu angoshtand
Va [Mo mu'ch'izot va] nishonakh'oi khudro ba onon dodem, va [-le] az onkh'o ruigardon shudand
Va az kukh'kh'o khonakh'oe [baroi khud] metaroshidand, ki dar amon bimonand
Pas, subkh'gokh'on bong [-i margbor] ononro faro girift
Va on chi [az amvolu khonakh'oi makh'kam] ba dast ovarda budand, sude ba kh'olashon nadosht [va azobi ilokh'iro daf' nakard]
Va Mo osmonkh'o va zamin va on chiro, ki miioni onkh'ost, ch'uz ba kh'ak' naofaridaem va k'iiomat kh'atman, omadani ast, pas, [ei paiombar az kofiron] ba nakui guzasht kun.
Be tardid, Parvardigorat kh'amon ofarinishgari donost.
Va ba rosti, Mo ba tu [sab'u-l-masoni>> [surai Fotikh'a] va K'ur'oni buzurgro dodem

[Binobar in] Kh'argiz ba on chi [az ne'matkh'oi duniavie], ki gurukh'kh'oe az onon [kofiron]-ro bakh'ramand kardaem, chashm naduz va ba khotiri [nosiposi va shirki] onon andukh'gin mabosh va bo mu'minon furutani kun
Va bigu: <<Ba rosti, ki man kh'amon bimdikh'andai oshkoram>>
[Va ononro az azob bitarson] Kh'amon guna ki [onro] bar tak'simkunandagon [-i oioti ilokh'i] firistodem
Kh'amon kasone, ki K'ur'onro [ba] bakhshkh'o [-e kh'amchun she'ru peshgui va ch'odu tak'sim] kardand
Pas, savgand ba Parvardigorat, kh'atman, [dar k'iiomat] az kh'amai onon suol khokh'em kard
Az on chi mekardand
Pas, [ei paiombar] on chi [-ro, ki az suii Allokh' taolo] dastur ioftai, oshkor kun va az mushrikon ru bigardon
Be tardid, Mo [sharri] maskharakunandagonro az tu dur mekunem
Onon, ki [baroi khud] bo Allokh' taolo ma'budi digare k'aror medikh'and, pas, ba zudi [natich'ai shirki kheshro] khokh'and donist
Va [ei paiombar] iak'inan, Mo medonem, ki tu az on chi onon [kofiron] meguiand, ozurdakhotir megardi
Pas, ba sitoishi Parvardigorat tasbekh' bigu va az sach'dakunandagon bosh
Va to kh'angome ki margat faro merasad, Parvardigoratro parastish kun

[Ei kofiron, lakh'zai vuk'ui k'iiomat va] Farmoni Allokh' taolo [baroi azobaton] nazdik shudaast; pas, baroi [rasidani] on shitob nakuned. U munazzakh' ast va az on chi bo vai sharik mesozand bartar ast

[Allokh' taolo] Ba farmoni khesh farishtagonro bo vakh'i bar kh'ar iak az bandagonash, ki bikhokh'ad, nozil mekunad [bo in paiom], ki: <<[Ei paiombaron, mardumro az shirk ba Allokh' taolo] bim dikh'ed [va ba onon bigued, ki] ma'bude [bakh'ak'] ch'uz man nest; pas, [ei mardum] az man parvo kuned>>
U osmonkh'o va zaminro ba kh'ak' [va kh'adafmand] ofarid [va] az on chi [bo vai] sharik mesozand, bartar ast
[Allokh' taolo] Insonro az nutfae ofarid va on gokh' u sitezagari oshkor shud
Va chakh'orpoionro baroiaton ofarid, ki dar onon pushish [-i garm] va manofe' [-i digare] ast va az [gushti barkhe az] onon mekhured
Va dar onkh'o baroiaton zeboi [va shukukh'] ast, on gokh' ki [onkh'oro shomgokh'on] az charo bozmeovared va [bomdodon] baroi charo [ba sakh'ro] mefiristed

[Onkh'o] Borkh'oi sangini shumoro [az shakh're] ba shakh're mebarand, ki [agar chunin namekardand] ch'uz bo zakh'mat dodan ba badani khesh nametavonisted ba on ch'o birased. Ba rosti, ki Parvardigoraton dilsuzu mekh'rubon ast
Va asponu shuturon va kharonro [niz ofarid] to bar onkh'o savor shaved va [niz baroiaton moiai] tach'ammul [ast] va chizkh'oe meofarinad, ki namedoned.
Bar Allokh' taolo ast, ki rokh'i rost [ islom]-ro [ba bandagonash binamoiad] va barkhe az on [rokh'kh'o] berokh'a ast; va agar [Allokh' taolo] mekhost, kh'amai shumoro kh'idoiat mekard
Ust, ki az osmon obe furu firistod, ki oshomidanii shumo az on ast va [giiokh' va] darakhte, ki [chakh'orpoioni khudro] dar on mecharoned, [niz] az on [ob] ast

[Allokh' taolo] Ba vasilai on kisht va zaitun va darakhtoni khurmo va angur va kh'ama nav' mevakh'o[-i gunogun] baroiaton meruionad. Ba rosti, ki dar inkh'o baroi mardume, ki meandeshand nishonae [az k'udrati Parvardigor] ast

Va shabu ruz va khurshedu mokh'ro ba khidmataton gumosht; va sitoragon [niz] ba farmonash dar khidmat [-i inson] kh'astand. Be tardid, dar in [ofarinish] baroi mardume, ki khiradvarzi mekunand, nishonae [az k'udrati Parvardigor] ast
Va on chiro, ki baroiaton dar zamin ba rangkh'oi gunogun ofarid [niz ba khidmati shumo gumosht]. Be tardid, dar in [umur] baroi mardume, ki pand megirand, nishonae [az k'udrati Parvardigor] ast.

Ust, ki darioro ba khidmataton gumosht, to az [saidi] on gushti toza bikhured va az on zevare [kh'amchun marvorid va march'on] berun meovared, ki mepushed; va kishtikh'oro dar on [dario] mebini, ki [amvoch'ro] meshikofand, to shumo az fazl [-u bakhshishi] Allokh' taolo bakh'ramand garded va boshad, ki sipos guzored
Va dar zamin kukh'kh'oi ustuvor [va mukh'kame] darafkand, ki mabodo shumoro bilarzonad va ch'uiborkh'o [-e padid ovard], to [biduni gum shudan] rokh'i khudro biiobed
Va nishonakh'oe [baroi ioftani masirkh'o dar tuli ruz ofarid] va tavassuti sitora[-kh'o niz dar shab] rokh'iobi mekunand
Oio on ki meofarinad, kh'amchun kase ast, ki [kh'ech'] nameofarinad? Oio pand namegired?
Agar [bikhokh'ed] ne'mat[-kh'oi] Allokh'ro bishmored, nametavoned onro ba shumorash darovared. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo omurzandai mekh'rubon ast
Va Allokh' taolo on chi pinkh'on mekuned va oshkor mesozed, [kh'amaro] medonad.
Va onkh'oero, ki [mushrikon] ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo [ba parastish] mekhonand, chizero nameofarinand va khud ofarida meshavand
In butkh'o dar kh'ak'ik'at] murdaand na zinda; va khud namedonand, ki chi kh'angom barangekhta meshavand
Ma'budi shumo ma'bude iagona ast va kasone, ki ba okhirat imon nadorand, dilkh'oiashon inkorkunanda [-i kh'ak'] ast va khud mutakabbirand
Kh'atman, Allokh' taolo on chiro, ki pinkh'on mekunand va oshkor mesozand [kh'amaro] medonad. Be tardid, U mutakabbironro dust namedorad
Kh'angome ki ba onon gufta meshavad: <<Parvardigoraton chi chize nozil kardaast?>> Meguiand: <<Afsonakh'oi peshiniion>>

[Kh'amchunon dar kufr memonand] To ruzi k'iiomat, [kh'am] bori gunokh'oni khudro ba tamomi bar dush kashand va [kh'am bakhshe] az bori gunokh'oni kasonero, ki az ruii nodoni gumrokh'ashon kardaand. Kh'on! Chi bad ast, on chi bar dush mekashand!

Dar kh'ak'ik'at, kasone, ki pesh az onon budand, niz nairang [va badandeshi] kardand; pas, farmoni Allokh' taolo darrasid, ki buniodashonro az asos barandokht va sak'f bar sarashon furu rekht va az [kh'amon] ch'oie, ki fikr namekardand, azob domangirashon shud

Sipas ruzi k'iiomat [Allokh' taolo bo azobe dardnok] khorashon mesozad va mefamoiad: <<Kuch'o kh'astand sharikoni man, ki dar borai onon [bo paiombaron va mu'minon] sitez mekarded?>> Kasone, ki ba eshon ilm doda shudaast [ulamoi rabboni], meguiand: <<Imruz khori va azob nasibi kofiron ast>>

[Kh'amon] Kasone, ki farishtagon [-i azob] dar kh'ole ch'onashonro megirand, ki [ba sababi shirk dar dunio] ba khud sitam karda budand. Pas, [onon dar kh'angomi marg] sari taslim furud meovarand [va meguiand:] <<Mo kh'ech' [kori] bade namekardem. Ore, musallaman Allokh' taolo ba on chi mekarded donost
Pas, az darvozakh'oi duzakh vorid shaved [ki] ch'ovidona dar on khokh'ed bud; va ba rosti, ch'oigokh'i gardankashon chi bad ast!

Va ba kasone, ki parkh'ezkori kardand, gufta meshavad: <<Parvardigoraton [bar paiombar] chi chiz nozil kardaast?>> Onon meguiand: <<Khair [va nakuii bisior]>>. Baroi kasone, ki dar in dunio neki kardaand, [podosh] nakui ast va, kh'atman, saroi okhirat bekh'tar ast; va, ba rosti, chi nakust saroi parkh'ezkoron!

[Ch'oigokh'ashon] Bog'kh'oe [az bikh'isht] ch'ovidon ast, ki ba on vorid meshavand. Az zeri [darakhtoni] on ch'uiborkh'o ch'ori ast [va] dar on ch'o kh'ar chi bikhokh'and, baroiashon [farokh'am] ast. Allokh' taolo parkh'ezkoronro chunin podosh medikh'ad

[Kh'amon] Kasone, ki farishtagon dar kh'ole ch'onashonro mesitonand, ki [az oludagii kufru gunokh'] pokand [va ba onon] meguiand: <<Durud bar shumo. Ba podoshi on chi mekarded, [inak] ba bikh'isht daroed>>

Oio [kofiron] ch'uz in intizor dorand, ki farishtagon [baroi k'abzi rukh'] ba surog'ashon biioiand io farmoni Parvardigorat [baroi azobashon] biioiad? Kasone, ki pesh az onon budand [niz] chunin mekardand va Allokh' taolo ba onon sitam nakard, vale onon khud ba kheshtan sitam mekardand
Pas, [kaifari] badikh'oe, ki karda budand, girebongirashon shud va on chi maskhara mekardand, ononro furu girift

Va kasone, ki shirk varzidand, guftand: <<Agar Allokh' taolo mekhost, na mo va na padaronamon chizero g'air az U nameparastidem va chizero ch'uz ba [khostu farmoni] U kh'arom namekardem>>. Kasone, ki pesh az onon budand, niz chunin kardand; pas, oio paiombaron vazifae ch'uz rasonidani oshkor [-i vakh'i] dorand?

Iak'inan, Mo dar kh'ar ummate paiombarero [bo in paiom] barangekhtem, ki: <<Allokh'i iaktoro biparasted va az tog'ut [ma'budoni g'airi Allokh' taolo] duri kuned>>. Pas, Allokh' taolo barkhe az ononro kh'idoiat kardaast va barkhe az onon niz sazovori gumrokh'i shudand. Pas, dar zamin gardish kuned va bingared, ki saranch'omi takzibkunandagon [-i oioti ilokh'i] chi guna budaast
[Ei Paiombar] kh'ar andoza bar kh'idoiati onon mushtok' boshi, [sude nadorad, zero] Allokh' taolo kasero, ki gumrokh' namoiad, kh'idoiat nakhokh'ad kard va onon [kh'ech'] iovare nadorand

[Mushrikon] Bo sakhttarin savgandkh'oiashon ba Allokh' taolo savgand khurdand, ki: <<Allokh' taolo kasero, ki memirad, barnameangezad>>. Ore, in [barangekhtani murdagon] va'daest, ki bar kh'ak' bar ukh'dai Ust, vale beshtari mardum namedonand
[U murdagonro zinda mekunad] To saranch'omi [kh'ak'ik'ati] on chiro, ki dar on ikhtilof mekunand, baroiashon ravshan sozad va to kasone, ki kufr varzidand, bidonand, ki durug'gu budaand.
Sukhani Mo dar borai chize, ki irodaashro kardaem, fak'at in ast, ki ba on meguem: <<Mavch'ud shav>>, pas, bedirang mavch'ud meshavad

Va kasone, ki dar [rokh'i] Allokh' taolo - pas az on ki mavridi sitam vok'e' shudand - kh'ich'rat kardand, dar dunio [dar sarzamin va] makone naku ononro ch'oi medikh'em; va iak'inan podoshi okhirat buzurgtar ast. Agar [onon, ki az kh'ich'rat khuddori kardand, podoshi in korro] medonistand, [kh'argiz az kh'ich'rat boznamemondand]
[Mukh'och'iron dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo] kasone [kh'astand], ki shikeboi namudand va bar Parvardigorashon tavakkal mekunand
Va [ei Paiombar] Mo pesh az tu ba ch'uz mardone, ki ba onon vakh'i mekardem, [kasero ba risolat] nafiristodem; pas, [ei mushrikon] agar namedoned, az akh'li zikr [donishmandoni akh'li kitob] bipursed

[On paiombaronro] Bo daloili ravshan va kitobkh'o[-i osmoni firistodem]; va [Mo in] K'ur'onro bar tu nozil kardem, to baroi mardum on chiro, ki bar eshon nozil shudaast, ravshan sozi; boshad, ki [dar mafokh'imash] biiandeshand
Oio kasone, ki badandeshi [va tavtea] kardand, [az in] emin kh'astand, ki Allokh' taolo [kh'amai] ononro dar zamin furu barad io azobi [ilokh'i] az ch'oie, ki namedonand, [ba surog'ashon] biioiad?
Io [on ki] ba kh'angomi raftu omadashon [gireboni] ononro bigirad? Pas, onon mone' [-i rasidani azob] nestand
Io [on ki azobi ilokh'i] dar kh'ole ki [az on] metarsand, girebongirashon shavad? Pas, be tardid, Parvardigoraton dilsuzi mekh'rubon ast [ki dar much'ozotaton shitob namekunand]

Oio onon ba chizkh'oe [kh'amchun darakhton va kukh'kh'o], ki Allokh' taolo ofarida ast, namenigarand, ki [chi guna bo kh'arakati khurshedu mokh'] soiakh'oiashon az rostu chap megusturad va dar kh'ole baroi Allokh' taolo sach'da mekunand, ki [dar barobarash] khoksorand?
Va kh'ar chi dar osmonkh'o va zamin ast - az ch'unbandagonu farishtagon - [kh'amagi] baroi Allokh' taolo sach'da meovarand va gardankashi namekunand
[Farishtagon] Az Parvardigori khesh, ki [ba zot va g'alaba va k'udratash] boloi onon ast, metarsand va on chi farmon doda meshavand, kh'amon mekunand
Va Allokh' taolo farmud: <<Du ma'bud [-ro baroi khud ba parastish] nagired. Ch'uz in nest, ki [ma'budi shumo] kh'amon Allokh'i iaktost; pas, tankh'o az man parvo kuned>>
Va on chi dar osmonkh'o va zamin ast, az oni Ust va parastishu farmondori [niz] kh'amesha va paivasta baroi Ust. Oio az g'airi Allokh' taolo parvo mekuned?
Va [ei mardum] kh'ar ne'mate, ki dored, az sui Allokh' taolo ast; sipas chun ba shumo gazande merasad, ba peshgokh'i U nola va zori mekuned
Sipas vak'te on gazandro az shumo barataraf sokht, on gokh' gurukh'e az shumo ba Parvardigorashon shirk mevarzand
To saranch'om ba on chi ba eshon dodaem, nosiposi kunand. Pas, [chand ruze az ne'matkh'oi dunio] barkhurdor shaved, ki ba zudi [natoich'i kirdoratonro] khokh'ed donist

Va [mushrikon] az on chi ruzishon kardaem, baroi chizkh'oe, ki kh'ech' fakh'me nadorand [butkh'o] sakh'me k'aror medikh'and. Ba Allokh' taolo savgand, ki dar borai on iftiro, ki mebasted, kh'atman, bozkhost khokh'ed shud
Va [onon farishtagonro] dukhtarone baroi Allokh' taolo k'aror medikh'and - U munazzakh' ast - va on chiro mail dorand [pisaron] baroi khudashon [k'aror medikh'and]
Va kh'ar gokh' iake az ononro ba [tavalludi] dukhtare bashorat dikh'and, dar kh'ole ki khashmashro furu mekhurad, chekh'raash [az andukh'] tira meshavad

Az badi [va norokh'atii] on chi ba u muzhda dodaand, az k'avm [-i khesh] pinkh'on meshavad [va bo khud meandeshad, ki] oio uro bo sarafkandagi nigakh' dorad io dar khok pinkh'onash kunad. Kh'on! Chi bad dovari mekunand!
Sifati zisht [-i chakh'lu kufr] baroi kasonest, ki ba okhirat imon nadorand va sifati bartar az oni Allokh' taolo ast va U shikastnopaziru kh'akim ast

Va agar Allokh' taolo mardumro ba khotiri zulmashon bozkhost mekard, ch'unbandae ruii zamin bok'i nameguzosht; vale [kaifari] ononro to zamoni muaiian ba ta'khir meandozad; va chun ach'alashon ba sar oiad, na soate [az on] ta'khir mekunand va na peshi megirand

Va [mushrikon] on chiro khush nadorand baroi Allokh' taolo k'aror medikh'and va zabonashon [chunin] durug' mesozad, ki [rasttagori va] nakui az oni eshon ast. Kh'ak'k'o, ki otash nasibashon ast va onon, kh'atman, az peshgomon [-i duzakh] kh'astand

[Ei paiombar] Savgand ba Allokh' taolo, ki ba sui ummatkh'oe, ki pesh az tu budand, [niz paiombarone] firistodem; pas, shaiton korkh'oiashonro baroiashon orost; az in ru, imruz [niz dust va] korsozashon kh'am ust va baroiashon azobe dardnok [dar pesh] ast

Va [ei paiombar] in kitobro bar tu nozil nakardem, magar baroi in ki [kh'ak'ik'ati] on chiro, ki [mardum] dar on ikhtilof dorand, baroiashon baion kuni va kh'idoiatu rakh'mate boshad baroi gurukh'e, ki imon meovarand

Va Allokh' taolo az osmon obe furu firistod va bo on zaminro pas az khazon va khushkiash zinda kard. Kh'atman, dar in amr baroi mardume, ki [sukhani kh'ak'ro] meshunavand, nishonae [az k'udrati Parvardigor] ast

Va [ei mardum,] dar [afzoishi] chakh'orpoion baroi shumo ibrate ast: az on chi dar shikami onkh'ost, az miioni g'izokh'oi kh'azmshuda va khun shiri kholise ba shumo menushonem, ki baroi nushandagon guvorost

Va [niz] az mevakh'oi darakhtoni khurmo va angur kh'am sharob [-i mastiovar] va kh'am ruzii naku [va pokiza] ba dast meovared. Be gumon, dar in [amr] baroi kasone, ki khirad mevarzand, nishonae [az lutfu k'udrati Parvardigor] ast
Parvardigorat ba zanburi asal ilkh'om kard, ki: az kukh'kh'o va darakhton va az on chi [mardum] bino mekunand, [baroi khud] khonakh'oe bargir

On gokh' az [shirai] tamomi mevakh'o [va gulkh'o] bikhur va rokh'kh'oi Parvardigoratro furutanona tai kun>>. Az shikami onkh'o shakh'de rangorang berun meoiad, ki shifoi mardum dar on ast. Ba rosti, dar in [amr] baroi mardume, ki meandeshand, nishonae [az ilmu k'udrati Parvardigor] ast

Va Allokh' taolo shumoro ofaridaast va sipas ch'onatonro megirad; va barkhe az shumo ba furutarini [davroni] umr [kukh'ansoli] merasand, chunonchi pas az donistani [bisiore chizkh'o, digar] chize namedonand [va kh'amaro faromush mekunand]. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo donovu tavonost

Va Allokh' taolo barkhe az shumoro bar barkhe [digar] dar [ne'matu] ruzi bartari dodast; pas, kasone, ki bartari doda shudaand, kh'ozir nestand, ki az ruzii khud ba bardagonashon bidikh'and, to kh'amagi dar on [ne'matu doroi] barobar shavand. [Agar khud az sharik bezorand, charo baroi Allokh' taolo sharik k'aror medikh'and?] Pas, oio [bo in shirkvarzi] ne'mati Allokh'ro inkor mekunand?

Va Allokh' taolo baroi shumo az [ch'insi] khudaton kh'amsarone k'aror dod va az kh'amsaronaton baroi shumo farzandon va navodagone ofarid va az chizkh'oe pokiza ba shumo ruzi bakhshid. Pas, oio [boz kh'am] ba botil imon meovarand va ba ne'mati Allokh' taolo nosiposi mekunand?
Va [mushrikon] ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo chizkh'oero meparastand, ki moliki kh'ech' ruzie dar osmonkh'o va zamin baroiashon nestand va tavonoi [-i kh'ech' kore] nadorand
Pas, baroi Allokh' taolo amsol [va sharikkh'oe mutaaddid] k'oil nashaved. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo medonad va shumo namedoned

Allokh' taolo misole zadaast: bardai mamluke, ki k'odir ba kh'ech' kore nest va [dar muk'obil,] kase, ki az ch'onibi khesh ba u ruzii nakuie bakhshidaem va u az kh'amon [ne'matkh'oi ilokh'i] pinkh'onu oshkor infok' mekunad. Oio in du barobarand? [Pas, shumo mushrikon chi guna moliki mutlak'ro bo butkh'oi notavon iakson medoned?] Sitoish makhsusi Allokh' taolo ast; ammo beshtarashon [kh'ak'k'i iagonagiashro] namedonand

Va Allokh' taolo masali [digare] zadaast: du mardro [farz kuned], ki iake az on du lol ast va kh'ech' kore az vai barnameoiad va sarbori dusti khud meboshad, kh'ar kuch'o uro mefiristad, kh'ech' khaire ba kh'amrokh' nameovarad [va vazoifashro ba durusti anch'om namedikh'ad]; oio u bo kase, ki ba adolat farmon medikh'ad va khud bar rokh'e mustak'im k'aror dorad, barobar ast? [Pas, shumo mushrikon chi guna k'odiri mutlak'ro bo butkh'oi beekh'sosi notavon iakson medoned?]

[Ilmi] G'aibi osmonkh'o va zamin tankh'o az oni Allokh' taolo ast va amri [barpoii] k'iiomat ch'uz [ba sur'ati] iak chashm bar kh'am zadan nest; io [kh'atto] sare'tar. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo bar kh'ar chize tavonost

[Ei mardum] Allokh' taolo shumoro az shikami modaronaton khorich' namud, dar kh'ole ki kh'ech' chiz namedonisted; va baroiaton gushu chashm va dil [-u ak'l] padid ovard [to k'udratkh'oi ilokh'iro dark kuned]; boshad, ki sipos guzored

Oio [mushrikon] parandagonro nadidaand, ki dar fazoi osmon rom shudaand [va] kase ch'uz Allokh' taolo onkh'oro [dar on kh'ol] nigakh' namedorad? Ba rosti, dar in [amr] baroi mardume, ki imon dorand, nishonakh'oe [az k'udrati Parvardigor] ast

Allokh' taolo baroi shumo az khonakh'oiaton makh'alli sukunat [va oromish] k'aror dod va az pushti chakh'orpoion [niz] baroiaton khonakh'oe [khaimakh'oe] k'aror dod, to ruzi kuch kardan sabukbor boshed va ruzi ik'omataton [niz barpoiiash oson boshad]; va az pashmu kurku muikh'oiashon to muddate muaiian [baroiaton] asosi [khona] va asbob [-u vasoili zindagi] farokh'am kard

Allokh' taolo az on chi ofarid, soiakh'oe baroiaton farokh'am ovardaast va az kukh'kh'o [niz rokh'kh'o va] panokh'gokh'kh'oe baroiaton k'aror dodaast va baroiaton ch'omakh'oe padid ovardaast, ki az [sarmo] va garmo nigokh'aton medorad va [zirekh'kh'o va] tanpushkh'oe, ki shumoro dar ch'ang[-kh'oia]-ton kh'ifz mekunad. U, inchunin, ne'matashro bar shumo tamom megardonad; boshad, ki [dar barobari tavkh'id] taslim shaved [va shirk navarzed]
Pas, [ei Paiombar] agar [mushrikon] rui gardonand, ch'uz in nest, ki vazifai tu [fak'at] paiomrasonii oshkor ast
[Onon] ne'mati Allokh'ro meshinosand; on gokh' [boz kh'am] inkorash mekunand va beshtarashon nosiposu kofirand

Va [iod kun az] ruze, ki az kh'ar ummate guvokh'e [baroiashon] barmeangezem; on gokh' ba kasone, ki kufr varzidand, na ich'ozat [-i sukhan guftan] doda meshavad va na az eshon darkhosti puzish meshavad
Va kasone, ki sitam kardand, kh'angome ki azobi [okhirat]-ro mebinand; na azobashon sabuk meshavad va na mukh'lat doda meshavand

Onon, ki shirk varzidand, vak'te sharikoni khudro mebinand, meguiand: <<Parvardigoro, inkh'o budand on sharikone, ki mo ba ch'oii tu mekhondem>> va[-le sharikon] sukhani ononro rad mekunand, ki: <<iak'inan shumo durug'gued>>
Dar on ruz dar barobari Allokh' taolo sari taslim meafkanand va durug'kh'oe, ki [dar borai shafoati g'airi Allokh' taolo] meboftand, kh'ama makh'vu nobud megardad
Kasone, ki kufr varzidand va [mardumro] az rokh'i Allokh' taolo bozdoshtand, ba [kaifari] on ki fasod mekardand, azobe bar azobashon meafzoem

Va ruze [-ro iod kun], ki az kh'ar ummate guvokh'e az khudashon bar onon megirem [ki ba kufru imonashon guvokh'i dikh'ad] va turo [ei Mukh'ammad] bar inon guvokh' megirem; va Mo in kitob [K'ur'on] - ro bar tu nozil kardem, ki ravshangari kh'ama chiz ast va baroi musulmonon rakh'namud va rakh'matu bashorat ast

Dar kh'ak'ik'at, Allokh' taolo [shumoro] ba adlu nakukori va bakhshish ba kheshovandon farmon medikh'ad va az fakh'sho va zishtkori va sarkashi nakh'i mekunad. U shumoro pand medikh'ad; boshad, ki pand gired

Va chun bo Allokh' taolo [io mardum] paimon basted, ba on vafo kuned; va savgandkh'oi khudro pas az mukh'kam sokhtanashon nashkaned, dar kh'ole ki Allokh'ro bar [vafodorii] khesh guvokh' k'aror dodaed. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo medonad, ki chi mekuned

Va monandi on zan [-i nodone] naboshed, ki rishtai [pashmii tobidai] kheshro az kh'am bozkushod [va gusast; pas, mabodo] savgandkh'oi khudro vasilai firebi iakdigar k'aror dikh'ed [on kh'am tankh'o] bad-in sabab, ki gurukh'e [sarvat va] ch'am'iiatashon afzuntar az digare ast. Ch'uz in nest, ki Allokh' taolo shumoro bo in [kor] meozmoiad va iak'inan ruzi k'iiomat on chiro, ki dar on ikhtilof mekarded, baroiaton ravshan mesozad

Va agar mekhost, kh'amai shumoro iak ummat k'aror medod, vale [bo adolati khesh] kh'ar kiro bikhokh'ad gumrokh' mekunad va [bo fazli khesh] kh'ar kiro bikhokh'ad, kh'idoiat menamoiad; va shumo [ruzi k'iiomat], kh'atman, az on chi mekarded, bozkhost khokh'ed shud

Va savgandkh'oiatonro vasilai nairang [va firebgari] miioni khesh k'aror nadikh'ed, to mabodo [imonaton ba khatar aftad va] gome pas az ustuvoriash bilag'zhad va ba sazoi on ki [mardumro] az rokh'i Allokh' taolo bozdoshtaed, [kaifari] noguvore bichashed va azobe buzurg baroiaton [dar pesh] boshad
Va paimoni Allokh'ro ba bakh'oi andak nafurushed. Agar bidoned, iak'inan on chi nazdi Allokh' taolo ast, baroiaton bekh'tar ast

On chi nazdi shumost, poion mepazirad va[-le] on chi nazdi Allokh' taolo ast, bok'i [va ch'ovid] ast; va, kh'atman, ba kasone, ki shikeboi kardaand, ach'rashonro bar asosi nakutarin [toat va] kore, ki mekardand, khokh'em dod

Kh'ar kas - az mard io zan - ki kori nek kunad va mu'min boshad, kh'atman, uro [dar dunio] ba zindagonii poku pisandidae zinda medorem va [dar okhirat niz] bar asosi nakutarin [toat va] kore, ki mekardand, ba onon podosh medikh'em
Pas, [ei mu'min] kh'angome ki K'ur'on mekhoni, az [sharri] shaitoni rondashuda ba Allokh' taolo panokh' bibar
Be tardid, u bar kasone, ki imon ovardaand va bar Parvardigorashon tavakkal mekunand [kh'ech'] tasallute nadorad
Tasalluti u tankh'o bar kasonest, ki uro [dustu] korsozi khud giriftaand va [kh'amchunin bar] kasone, ki ba Allokh' taolo shirk mevarzand

Va kh'angome ki [kh'ukmi] oiatero ch'oiguzini oiate [digar] mekunem - kh'ol on ki Allokh' taolo ba on chi nozil mekunad, donotar ast - [kofiron] meguiand: <<[Ei Mukh'ammad] ch'uz in nest, ki tu durug'bofi>>. [Chunin nest] Balki beshtarashon [az akh'komi shar' va kh'ikmati ilokh'i chize] namedonand
Bigu: <<Rukh'u-l-k'udus [Ch'abrail] onro az ch'onibi Parvardigorat bar kh'ak' nozil kardaast, to kasonero, ki imon ovardaand, sobitk'adam gardonad va baroi musulmonon kh'idoiat va bashorate boshad>>

Va iak'inan medonem, ki onon meguiand: <<Kh'atman, bashare [in oiotro] ba u omuzish medikh'ad>>. [Na, chunin nest; zero] zaboni kase, ki [in] nisbatro ba u medikh'ad, g'airi arabi ast, kh'ol on ki in [K'ur'on] ba zaboni arabii ravshan ast
Iak'inan, kasone, ki ba oioti Allokh' taolo imon nameovarand, Allokh' taolo kh'idoiatashon namekunad va baroi onon azobi dardnoke [dar pesh] ast
[Mukh'ammad durug'gu nest, balki] Kasone durug' mebofand, ki ba oioti Allokh' taolo imon nadorand va inon durug'guion [-i vok'ei] kh'astand

Kh'ar ki ba'd az imonash ba Allokh' kufr bivarzad [giriftori azobi ilokh'i khokh'ad shud]; magar kase, ki [ba in kor] vodor shuda boshad va[-le] dilash ba imon orom [va ustuvor] boshad; ammo kh'ar ki sinaashro ba kufr kushoda kard, khashmi Allokh' taolo bar onon ast va azobe sakh'mgin [dar pesh] dorand
In [much'ozot] az on rust, ki zindagii dunioro bar okhirat tarch'ekh' dodand; va Allokh' taolo gurukh'i kofironro kh'idoiat namekunad
Inon kasone kh'astand, ki [bar asari gunokh'onashon] Allokh' taolo bar dilkh'o va gushu chashmonashon mukh'r nikh'odaast; va inon g'ofilon [-i vok'ei] kh'astand
Iak'inan onon dar okhirat ziionkorand

Sipas Parvardigorat nisbat ba kasone, ki pas az zach'r kashidan [az ozori mushrikon] kh'ich'rat kardand va sipas ba ch'ikh'od barkhostand va shikeboi namudand, Parvardigorat [nisbat ba onon] pas az on [kh'ama sakhtikh'o], kh'atman, omurzandai mekh'rubon ast

[Ei paiombar, iod kun az] Ruze, ki kh'ar kas dar kh'ole [ba peshgokh'i adli ilokh'i] meoiad, ki [tankh'o] az khud difo' mekunad; va kh'ar kas dar barobari on chi kardaast, be kamu kost podosh megirad va bar onon sitam nameravad

Va Allokh' taolo shakh're [kh'amchun Makka]-ro misol mezanad, ki amnu orom bud va ruziash az kh'ar su ba osoni va farovoni merasid, vale [mardumonash] nisbat ba ne'matkh'oi ilokh'i nosiposi namudand va on gokh' Allokh' taolo niz ba sazoi on chi mekardand, ta'mi gurusnagi va tarsro ba [akh'li] on chashonid
Va paiombare az khudshon ba suii onon omad, ammo uro durug'gu angoshtand; on gokh', dar kh'ole ki sitamgor [va mushrik] budand, azobi [ilokh'i] ononro furu girift
Pas az on chi Allokh' taolo ruziaton kardaast, kh'alolu pokiza bikhured va agar fak'at Uro meparasted, bar ne'mati ilokh'i shukr guzored

Ch'uz in nest, ki [Allokh' taolo] fak'at murdor va khun va gushti khuk va on chiro, ki [kh'angomi zabkh'] nomi g'airi Allokh' taolo bar on burda shudaast, bar shumo kh'arom kardaast; pas, kh'ar ki [baroi kh'ifzi ch'onash ba khurdani onkh'o] nochor shavad [va] sarkashu ziiodakhokh' naboshad, [bar u gunokh' nest, charo ki] be tardid, Allokh' taolo omurzandai mekh'rubon ast

Va [ei mushrikon] bo durug'e, ki bar zabonaton ch'ori meshavad, nagued: <<In kh'alol ast va on kh'arom>>, to bar Allokh' taolo durug' banded. Kasone, ki bar Allokh' taolo durug' mebandand, kh'argiz rastagor nameshavand
[Natich'ai duniodustiiashon] Bakh'rae andak ast va [dar okhirat] azobe dardnok [dar pesh] dorand
Va bar iakh'udiion on chiro peshtar bar tu kh'ikoiat kardem, kh'arom namudem va Mo ba onon sitam nakardem; balki onkh'o khud [budand, ki dar natich'ai nofarmoni] ba kheshtan sitam mekardand

On gokh' Parvardigorat nisbat ba kasone, ki az rui nodoni gunokh' kardand va sipas az on [ishtibokh'ot] tavba namudand va durustkori kardand, kh'atman, Parvardigorat pas az on omurzandai mekh'rubon ast
Be gumon, Ibrokh'im peshvoe furutan dar barobari Allokh' taolo va kh'ak'garo bud va [kh'argiz] dar zumrai mushrikon nabud
U shukrguzori ne'matkh'oi Allokh' taolo bud. [Allokh' taolo] Vairo barguzid va ba rokh'i rost kh'idoiat namud
[Mo] Dar dunio ba u neki ato kardem va, kh'atman, u dar okhirat [niz] az shoistagon ast
Sipas [ei Paiombar] ba tu vakh'i kardem, ki az oini Ibrokh'im pairavi kun, ki kh'ak'garo bud va [kh'argiz] dar zumrai mushrikon nabud

[Vuch'ubi buzurgdoshti ruzkh'oi] Shanbe tankh'o bar kasone k'aror doda shud, ki dar on ikhtilof kardand; va, kh'atman, Parvardigorat ruzi k'iiomat dar mavridi on chi ikhtilof mekardand, miionashon dovari khokh'ad kard

[Ei Paiombar, mardumro] Bo kh'ikmat va pandi naku ba rokh'i Parvardigorat da'vat namo va bo ravishe, ki nakutar ast, bo onon [bakh'su] munozira kun. Be tardid, Parvardigorat ba [kh'oli] kase, ki az rokh'i u gumrokh' shud, donotar ast va u ba [kh'oli] kh'idoiatioftagon [niz] donotar ast

Va agar [shumo mu'minon] khosted [dushmanonatonro] much'ozot kuned, pas, chunon much'ozot kuned, ki [onon] shumoro much'ozot kardaand; va agar [kheshtandori va] shikeboi kuned, [bidoned, ki] kh'atman, in [kor] baroi shikeboion bekh'tar ast
Va [ei Paiombar] shikeboi pesha kun va shikeboiiat ch'uz ba [iori va] tavfik'i Allokh' taolo nest; va bar onon [kofiron] andukh' makhur va az nairange, ki mevarzand, diltang mabosh
Be tardid, Allokh' taolo bo kasone ast, ki parkh'ezkori kardand va kasone, ki nakukorand

Poku munazzakh' ast on [Parvardigore] ki bandaash [Mukh'ammad]-ro shabongokh' az masch'idu-l-kh'arom ba suii Masch'id-ul-ak'so - ki peromunashro barakat dodaem - sair dod, to barkhe az nishonakh'oi [k'udrati] kheshro ba u binmoionem. Be tarded, U kh'amon shunavoi binost
Va Mo ba Muso kitobi [Tavrot] dodem va onro [moiai] kh'idoiati Bani Isroil sokhtem [va farmudem], ki: <<Ch'uz man korguzore [baroi khud] barnaguzined>>
Ei farzandoni kasone, ki bo Nukh' [bar kishti] savorashon kardem, ba rosti u [Nukh'] bandae shukrguzor bud
Va dar kitobi [Tavrot] ba Bani Isroil vakh'i kardem, ki kh'atman, du bor dar zamin fasod khokh'ed kard va kh'atman, sarkashi [va tug'ioni] buzurge khokh'ed namud

Pas, kh'ar gokh' va'dai nakhustin az on du [bor] faro rasid, gurukh'e az bandagoni bisior nerumand [va paikorch'uii] khudro bar shumo barmeangezem, to miioni khonakh'o [-iaton baroi k'atlu g'orati shumo] ba ch'ustuch'u daroiand; va in va'dai anch'omshudani [va k'at'i] bud
On gokh' [pas az muddate] shumoro bar onon musallat megardonem va bo amvolu farzandon ioriaton mekunem, va [te'dodi] nafaroti shumoro beshtar [az dushman] megardonem

Agar [dar guftoru raftor] neki kuned, ba khud neki kardaed; va agar badi kuned, [boz kh'am ba] khud kardaed. Pas, kh'angome ki va'dai digar faro rasid [dushman onchunon khoraton mesozad], ki osori g'amu andukh' dar chekh'rakh'oiaton zokh'ir meshavad va kh'amon guna ki bori nakhust vorid shudand [in bor niz kh'amla meovarand], to ba Masch'id[-ul-ak'so] dokhil shavand va to bar kh'ar chi dast ioband, iaksara nobud kunand
[Ei Bani Isroil agar tavba kuned] Umed ast, ki Parvardigoraton bar shumo rakh'mat ovarad va agar [ba tabokh'i] bozgashted, Mo niz bozmegardem va duzakhro zindoni kofiron kardaem
Ba rosti, ki in K'ur'on ba ustuvortarin rokh' kh'idoiat mekunad va ba mu'minone, ki korkh'oi shoista mekunand, muzhda medikh'ad, ki baroiashon podoshe buzurg [dar pesh] ast
Va baroi kasone, ki ba okhirat imon nameovarand, azobe dardnok mukh'aiio kardaem
Inson [dar kh'angomi khashm, az rui nodoni va shitob nafrin mekunad va] badiro metalabad, kh'amon guna ki nekiro mekhokh'ad; va inson kh'amvora shitobzada ast

Shabu ruzro du nishona [-i k'udratu iagonagii khesh] k'aror dodem; va nishonai shabro makh'v [va tira] kardem va nishonai ruzro oshkoru ravshan k'aror dodem, to az Parvardigoraton ruzi bich'ued va shumori solkh'o va kh'isob [-i vak'oe']-ro bidoned; va kh'ar chizero ba tafsil baion kardem
Va [sarnavishti] raftori kh'ar insonero [to lakh'zai kh'isobrasi] dar gardanash bastaem va ruzi k'iiomat baroiash navishtae berun meovarem, ki onro kushoda mebinad
[Ba u meguem] <<Nomaatro bikhon. Kofi ast, ki imruz khud kh'isobgari khesh boshi>>

Kh'ar ki rokh' [-i rost] ioft, ch'uz in nest, ki ba sudi khesh rokh' ioftaast va kh'ar ki gumrokh' shud, iak'inan ba ziioni khud gumrokh' shudaast; va kh'ech' gunakh'kore bori gunokh'i digarero barnamedorad; va mo kh'argiz [k'avmero] much'ozot nakhokh'em kard, magar on ki [miionashon] paiombare mab'us karda boshem [to vazoifashonro baion kunad]

Va chun bikhokh'em, [mardumi] shakh'rero nobud kunem, [nakhust] ba sarvatmandoni carkashi on ch'o farmoni] itoat az Allokh' taolo va pairavi az paiombaron] medikh'em, sipas vak'te dar on ch'o ba fasod [va mukholifat] barkhostand, va'dai [azobi ilokh'i bar] on mukh'ak'k'ak' megardad; pas, ononro ba sakhti nobud mekunem
Va chi bisior naslkh'oero, ki pas az Nukh' [zindagi mekardand] kh'alok kardem va [kh'amin] kofi ast, ki Parvardigorat az gunokh'oni bandagonash ogokh' [va nisbat ba onon] binost

Kh'ar ki khokh'oni [dunioe] zudguzar ast, kh'ar chi bikhokh'em [va] ba kh'ar ki bikhokh'em [bakh'rae] az on medikh'em; on gokh' duzakhro nasibash mekunem, ki dar on ch'o khoru rondashuda vorid megardad
Va kh'ar ki [zindagii] okhiratro bikhokh'ad va baroi [rasidan ba] on bo ch'iddiiat bikushad va mu'min boshad, pas, inonand, ki az taloshashon k'adrdoni khokh'ad shud
Kh'amaro - [khokh'] in gurukh'i [badkor] va [io] on gurukh'i [nakukor] - az bakhshish [va ne'matkh'oi duniavii] Parvardigorat bakh'ramand mesozem va bakhshishi Parvardigorat [az kase] man' nashudaast

Bingar, ki chiguna barkhe az ononro [az likh'ozi molu mak'om] bar barkhi digar bartari dodaem va k'at'an okhirat [dar muk'oisa bo dunio] az nazari darach'ot, buzurgtar va az likh'ozi fazilat, bartar ast [pas mu'min boiad ba on ishtiiok' varzad]
[Ei inson, kh'argiz kh'ech'] Ma'budi digarero bo Allokh' taolo [sharik] k'aror nadekh', ki nakukh'ida va beiovar khokh'i mond

Va Parvardigorat chunin farmon dodaast, ki: <<Ch'uz Uro naparasted va ba padaru modar neki kuned. Kh'ar gokh' iake az on du io kh'ar dui onkh'o dar kanori tu ba sinni piri rasidand, kh'atto kamtarin ikh'onate ba eshon nakun va bar sarashon fariod nazan va bo onon ba neki [va mekh'ruboni] sukhan bigu
Va az ruii mekh'ruboni dar barobarashon furutan bosh va bigu: <<Parvardigoro, kh'amon guna ki [bar man rakh'mat ovardand va] dar kudaki parvarisham dodand, [Tu niz] ba onon rakh'mat ovar>>
Parvardigori shumo ba on chi dar dilkh'oiaton ast, ogokh'tar ast. Agar shoista boshed, iak'inan U dar kh'ak'k'i tavbakoron omurzanda ast
Va kh'ak'k'i kheshovandro ba u bidekh' [silai rakh'im ba ch'oi ovar] va tikh'idast va darrokh'monda [-ro iori kun] va kh'ech' isrofkori nakun
Dar kh'ak'ik'at, isrofkoron barodaroni shaiotin kh'astand va shaiton nisbat ba Prarvardigorash kh'amvora nosipos budaast
Va agar ba umedi rakh'mat va [kushoishi ruzi] az ch'onibi Parvardigorat [ba nochor] az onon rui megardoni, pas, ba eshon sukhane narm bigu
Va [kh'argiz] dast az infok' naband va [niz] kushodadastii bisior nakun, ki malomatshuda va kh'asratzada megardi
Be gumon, Parvardigorat [ne'mat va] ruziro bar kh'ar ki bikhokh'ad, gusturda medorad va io tang megirad. Be tardid, U kh'amvora ba [akh'voli] bandagonash ogokh' va binost
Va farzandonatonro az bimi tangdasti nakushed. Mo ba eshon va shumo ruzi mebakhshem. Iak'inan kushtani onkh'o kh'amvora khatoe buzurg ast.
Va ba zino nazdik nashaved. Be tardid, on [kor] bisior zishtu rokh'e nopisand ast

Va kasero, ki Allokh' taolo [kushtanashro] kh'arom kardaast, ch'uz ba kh'ak' nakushed; va kh'ar ki ba sitam kushta shavad, ba valii u k'udrat [va kh'ak'k'i k'isos] dodaem; pas, vai niz naboiad dar [kaifari] k'atl ziiodaravi kunad. Be tardid, u [valii dam] takh'ti kh'imoia [-i Allokh' taolo va shar'i muk'addas] k'aror dorad

Va ba moli iatim - ch'uz shevae, ki nakutar ast - nazdik nashaved, to on gokh' ki ba kh'addi [rushd va] bulug'ash birasad va ba paimon [-i khesh] vafo kuned; charo ki [az shumo] dar borai paimon pursida khokh'ad shud

Va kh'angome ki [dar kharidu furush ach'nosro] paimona mekuned, paimonaro komil [-u tamom] bidikh'ed va [onkh'oro] bo tarozui durust vazn kuned. In [kor] baroi shumo bekh'tar va saranch'omash nakutar ast
Va az on chi dar boraash donishe nadori, pairavi nakun. Be tardid, [dar k'iiomat] gushu chashm va dil az kh'ama inkh'o bozkhost khokh'ad shud
Va dar zamin bo takabbur rokh' narav. Tu kh'argiz nametavoni [bo rokh' raftani g'ururomezat] zaminro bishkofi va dar balandi [va gardanfarozi niz] ba kukh'kh'o namerasi
Kh'amai inkh'o nazdi Parvardigorat nopisand ast.
In az on kh'ikmat [-kh'oe] ast, ki az ch'onibi Parvardigorat ba tu vakh'i shudaast; va bo Allokh' taolo ma'budi digare k'aror nadekh', ki nakukh'ida va rondashuda ba duzakh khokh'i aftod

Oio [shumo mushrikon gumon mekuned, ki] Parvardigoraton [doshtani] pisaronro ba shumo ikhtisos dodaast va khud az [miioni] farishtagon dukhtarone bargiriftaast? Ba rosti, ki sukhane bisior buzurg [va noravo] megued
Va be tardid, Mo dar in K'ur'on [akh'komu andarzkh'oro bo shevakh'oi] gunogun baion kardem, to [mardum] pand bigirand; va[-le in sukhanon] ch'uz duri [az kh'ak'] bar onon nameafzoiad

[Ei paiombar] Bigu: <<Agar [bar farzi makh'ol] chunon ki [mushrikon] meguiand, bo U [Allokh' taolo] ma'budone [digar] bud, dar in surat, onon [baroi tak'arrub va kasbi khushnudii Parvardigor] ba sui [Allokh' taolo] sokh'ibi Arsh rokh'e mech'ustand>>
U poku munazzakh' ast va az on chi onon meguiand, base bartar ast

Osmonkh'oi kh'aftgonavu zamin va kh'ar ki dar onkh'ost, Uro ba poki mesitoiand; va kh'ech' chiz nest, magar on ki Uro ba poki iod mekunad; vale shumo tasbekh'i ononro darnameiobed. Be tardid, U kh'amvora burdbor [va] omurzanda ast
Va [ei paiombar] kh'angome ki K'ur'on mekhoni, miioni tu va kasone, ki ba okhirat imon nadorand, pardae pushida k'aror medikh'em

Va bar dilkh'oiashon pushishe k'aror dodem, to [paiomi] onro darnaioband va dar gushkh'oiashon sangini [nikh'odem, to kh'ak'ro nashnavand]; va chun Parvardigoratro dar K'ur'on ba iagonagi iod mekuni, bo nafrat pusht mekunand [va megurezand]

Va on gokh' ki [kofiron] ba tu gush mesuporand, Mo bekh'tar medonem, ki ba chi [manzur va chi guna] gush medikh'and va [niz] on gokh' ki nach'vo mekunand [Mo az sukhanonanshon ogokh'em]; on gokh' ki sitmakoron [-i mushrik ba mardum] meguiand: <<Shumo ch'uz az mardi ch'odushudae pairavi namekuned>>
Bingar, ki chi guna baroiat misolkh'o zadaand, pas, gumrokh' shudand va dar natich'a nametavonand rokh'e [ba suii kh'ak'] bibarand
Va [mushrikon] guftand: <<Oio kh'angome ki ustukhonkh'oe [pusida va] parokanda shudem, dubora bo ofarinishi ch'adid barangekhta meshavem?>>
Bigu: <<[Kh'atto agar] Sang boshed io okh'an

Io [Kh'ar] Ofaridae, ki dar khotiraton buzurg menamoiad [boz kh'am Allokh' taolo metavonad shumoro zinda kunad]. Pas, khokh'and guft: <<Chi kase moro bozmegardonad?>>. Bigu: [Kh'amon Parvardigore, ki] ki nakhustin bor shumoro ofarid>>. On gokh' sarkh'oiashonro [ba nishonai nobovari] muk'obilat takon medikh'and va meguiand: <<On [kh'odisa] kai khokh'ad bud?>>. Bigu: <<Chi baso nazdik boshad
Ruze, ki [Allokh' taolo] shumoro [ba sakh'roi makh'shar] faro mekhonad va shumo bo siposu sitoish ich'obatash mekuned va mepindored, ki ch'uz andake [dar dunio] ba sar naburdaed>>

Va [ei Paiombar] bandagonamro bigu bo bekh'tarin [alfoz bo iakdigar] sukh'bat kunand [va az baddakh'oni biparkh'ezand; charo ki] be tardid, shaiton miionashon dushmani meafkanad. Ba rosti, ki shaiton baroi inson dushmane oshkor ast

[Ei mardum] Parvardigoraton ba [akh'voli] shumo donotar ast; agar bikhokh'ad, bar shumo rakh'mat meovarad io agar bikhokh'ad, azobaton mekunad; va [ei Paiombar] Mo turo [baroi onon nigakh'bon va] murok'ib nafiristodaem

Parvardigorat ba [kh'ar chi va] kh'ar ki dar osmonkh'o va zamin ast, donotar ast; va ba rosti, [Mo] barkhe paiombaronro [bo afzunii pairavon va dodani kitob] bar barkhe [digar] bartari bakhshidem va ba Dovud Zabur dodem

[Ei Paiombar, ba mushrikon] Bigu: <<Kasonero, ki ba ch'oii U [ma'bud va korsozi khesh] pindoshtaed, faro bikhoned; pas, [khokh'ed did, ki] nametavonand gazandero az shumo dur kunand va na k'odirand, onro [suii digare] bigardonand>>

Kasonero, ki onon mekhonand, khud [bo parastish va nakukori] vasilae [baroi tak'arrub] ba Parvardigorashon mech'uiand [va dar rak'obatand, to bidonand] kadom iak az az onon [ba parastishi Allokh' taolo] nazdiktarand va ba rakh'matash umedvorand va az azobash metarsand; [charo ki] be tardid, azobi Parvardigorat kh'amvora shoistai parkh'ez ast

Va kh'ech' shakh're nest, ki magar in ki [dar surati nofarmoni mardumi] onro pesh az ruzi k'iiomat nobud mekunem io ba azobe sakht giriftor mesozem. In [kaifar] dar kitobi ilokh'i [Lavkh'i Makh'fuz] sabt ast

[Chize] Moro az firistodani mu'ch'izot [darkhosti mushrikon] boznadosht, magar in ki peshiniion onro durug' pindoshtand; va Mo ba Samud [k'avmi Solekh'] on modashuturro ba unvoni nishonai ravshan dodem; pas, ba on sitam kardand va Mo nishonakh'o [va mu'ch'izot]-ro ch'uz baroi bim dodan [-i mardum] namefiristem.

Va [ba iod ovar] kh'angome ki ba tu guftem: <<Iak'inan, Parvardigorat bar mardum ikh'ota dorad>>; va on ru'ioero, ki [dar shabi me'roch'] ba tu namoiondem; va [kh'amchunin] on darakhti la'natshuda [-i zak'um] dar K'ur'onro ch'uz baroi ozmoishi mardum k'aror nadodem; va Mo ononro bim medikh'em, vale ch'uz bar carkashii beshtarashon nameafzoiad
Va [iod kun az] kh'angome ki ba farishtagon guftem: <<Baroi Odam sach'da kuned>>; pas, [kh'amagi] sach'da kardand, ba ch'uz Iblis, ki guft: <<Oio baroi kase sach'da kunam, ki [uro] az gil ofaridai?>>

[Va] Guft: <<Ba man khabar bidekh', in ast on ki bar man [bartari dodi va] giromi doshti? Agar ba man to ruzi k'iiomat mukh'lat dikh'i, farzandonashro - ch'uz iddai kame- [makh'orzada va] reshakan khokh'am kard>>
[Allokh' taolo] Farmud: <<Birav, ki kh'ar iak az eshon az tu pairavi kunad, pas, iak'inan duzakh podoshaton khokh'ad bud, ki podoshe komil ast

Va az eshon kh'ar kiro tavonisti, ba ovozi khud barangez [va ba suii gunokh' bikash] va ba savoronu piiodagonat bar onon bong bizan [to oludai gunokh' gardand] va dar amvolu farzandon sharikashon shav va ba onon va'da[-kh'oi vokh'i] bidekh'; va[-le] shaiton ba onon va'da namedikh'ad, magar ba fireb
[Ei shaiton] Tu kh'argiz bar bandagoni man tasallute nakhokh'i dosht>>; va [ei Paiombar] kh'amin bas, ki Parvardigorat [korguzoru] nigakh'boni onon [mu'minon] boshad
[Ei mardum] Parvardigori shumo kasest, ki kishtiro dar dario baroiaton ba kh'arakat darmeovarad, to az fazlash bakh'ramand garded. Be tardid, U kh'amvora nisbat ba shumo mekh'rubon ast

Va on gokh' ki dar dario gazande ba shumo merasad, kh'ar kiro [ba kh'och'atkhokh'i] mekhoned, nopadid [va faromush] megardad, magar [zoti poki] U; ammo vak'te shumoro [az khatari marg] rakh'onad va ba khushki rasonad, [az iaktoparasti] ruigardon meshaved; va inson kh'amvora nosipos ast

Oio [mepindored] az in ki [Allokh' taolo] shumoro dar kanorai khushki [dar zamin] furu barad io tufoni sakhte ba suiaton bifiristad [va sangboronaton kunad] emin shudaed? On gokh' baroi khud kh'ech' [korguzor va] nigakh'bone nameiobed

Io emin az in shudaed, ki bori digar shumoro ba dario bozgardonad va tundbode kubanda ba suiaton bifiristad va ba sazoi kufraton shumoro g'ark' kunad? On gokh' baroi khud dar barobari Mo kh'ech' bozpurse nameiobed [ki daleli koramonro ch'uio shavad]

Va ba rosti, Mo farzandoni Odamro giromi doshtem va ononro dar khushki va dario [bar vasoili safar] savor kardem va az anvoi [ne'matkh'oi] pokiza ba onon ruzi dodem va ononro bar bisiore az mavch'udote, ki ofaridaem, bartarii bisior bakhshidem

Va [iod kun az] ruze, ki kh'ar gurukh'ero bo peshvoiashon faro mekhonem; pas, kasone, ki noma [i a'mol]-ashon ba [dasti] rostashon doda meshavad, inon nomai khudro [bo shodmoni] mekhonand va kuchaktarin sitame namebinand; [kh'atto ba andozai rishtai miioni kh'astai khurmo]
Va[-le] kase, ki dar in [dunio az didani kh'ak'] nopaido budaast, dar okhirat [niz] nobino va gumrokh'tar ast

[Ei Paiombar] Nazdik bud onkh'o turo [bo vasvasakh'oi khud] az on chi bar tu vakh'i kardaem, bifireband, to [alfoze] g'air az onro [ki vakh'i kardaem] ba durug' ba Mo nisbat dikh'i va ongokh' turo ba dusti bigirand
Va agar [Mo] turo sobitk'adam namekardem, ba rosti, nazdik bud andake ba onon garoish biiobi
Dar on surat, kh'atman, du chandon [azob dar in] zindagi va du chandon [pas az] marg ba tu mechashondem va on gokh' baroi khesh dar barobari mo iovare nameiofti

Va nazdik bud [ki kofiron bo nairang va dushmani] turo az sarzamin [-i Makka] barkanand, to az on ch'o berunat kunand va [agar chunin mekardand] dar on surat onon [niz] pas az tu ch'uz [zamoni] andake namemondand [va giriftori azob meshudand]
In [shevai barkhurd bo millatkh'oi nosipos] sunnati [Mo dar borai] paiombarone ast, ki pesh az tu firistodem; va [kh'argiz] dar sunnati Mo [digarguni va] tag'iire nameiobi

Namozro az zavoli khurshed [kh'angomi zukh'r] to nikh'oiati torikii shab [nimai shab] bar po dor va [ba vizha] namozi subkh'ro. Ba rosti, ki namozi subkh' [va tilovati K'ur'on dar in vak't] mavridi mushokh'ida [va dar kh'uzuri farishtagoni ruzu shab] ast

Va [ei Paiomabr] pose az shabro [az khob] barkhez va namoz biguzor. Kh'atman, [in namozi shab] baroi afzunii mak'omu martabai tust. Umed ast, Parvardigorat turo ba mak'ome pisandida [shafoat] barangezad

Va bigu: <<Parvardigoro, maro [dar kh'ar kore] ba durusti dokhil namo va ba durusti khorich' soz [chunon ki mavridi rizoi tust]; va az ch'onibi khesh baroi man [dar barobari dushmanonam] dalele ioribakhshe k'aror bidekh'>>
Va bigu: <<Kh'ak' [islom] omad va botil [shirk] nobud shud. Ba rosti, ki botil nobudshudani ast>>
Va az K'ur'on on chi darmoni [shirku kufr] va rakh'mate baroi mu'minon ast, nozil mekunem va [in kitob] bar sitamgoroni [mushrik] ch'uz ziion nameafzoiad
Va chun ba inson ne'mat [-i sarvat va salomati] medikh'em, rui megardonad va [az shukrguzori va parastish] duri mekunad va chun badi [va gazande] ba u merasad, [az rakh'mati ilokh'i] noumed megardad
[Ei Paiombar] Bigu: <<Kh'ar kas tibk'i ravishi khesh [va mutanosib bo kh'idoiat io gumrokh'iiash] raftor mekunad; va Parvardigoraton bekh'tar medonad, ki chi kase kh'idoiatioftatar ast>>
Va [ei Paiombar, kofiron] az tu darborai Rukh' mepursand; bigu: Rukh' az [ch'umlai umuri g'aibi va barkhosta az] farmoni Parvardigori man ast va ba ch'uz andake donish ba shumo nadodaand>>
Va agar mekhostem, kh'atman, on chiro ba tu vakh'i kardaem, [az iodat] meburdem; on gokh' dar barobari Mo baroi khud kh'ech' [korguzor va] nigakh'bone nameiofti [ki monei faromushiat gardad]
Vale [chunin nakardem va in lutf ba khotiri] rakh'mate az ch'onibi Parvardigori tust. Be tardid, kh'amvora bakhshishi U bar tu bisior ast
[Ei Paiombar] Bigu: <<Agar insu ch'in [kh'amagi] ch'am' shavand, to kh'ammonandi in K'ur'onro biiovarand, [kh'argiz] kh'ammonandashro nakhokh'and ovard; kh'archand onon pushtiboni iakdigar boshand>>
Va ba rosti, Mo dar in K'ur'on baroi mardum az kh'ar misol [va andarzu doston] ovardem, vale beshtari mardum [az pazirishi on] khuddori kardand [va] ch'uz sari inkor nadoshtand
Va guftand: <<Mo kh'argiz ba tu imon nameovarem, magar in ki az zamin [-i Makka] baroiamon chashmae ch'ori kuni
Io bog'e az nakhl va angur doshta boshi va minioni [darakhtoni on] ch'uikh'o ravon gardoni
Io chunonchi iddao kardi, az osmon porakh'oe [az azob] bar saramon biiafkani io Allokh' taolo va farishtagonro dar barobaramon kh'ozir kuni [to ba rostguiiat guvokh'i dikh'ad]

Io khonae [orosta az tillo doshta boshi io dar osmon bolo ravi; va kh'argiz bolo raftanatro bovar namekunem, magar on ki navishtae bar mo furud ovari, ki onro bikhonem>>. Bigu: <<Parvardigoram munazzakh' ast. Oio man ch'uz bashare firistodashuda kh'astam?>>
Va [chize] imon ovardani mardum nashud-on gokh' ki kh'idoiat baroiashon omad-ch'uz in ki guftand: <<Oio Allokh' taolo iak insonro ba paiombari barangekhta ast?>>

[Ei Paiombar] Bigu: <<Agar dar zamin [ba ch'oii inson] farishtagone budand, ki [kh'amchun shumo] bo oromish rokh' meraftand, kh'atman, az osmon farishtaero [az ch'insi khudashon ba unvoni] paiombar bar onon nozil mekardem>>
Bigu: <<Kofist, ki Allokh' taolo miioni manu shumo guvokh' boshad. Be tardid, U kh'amvora [nisbat] ba bandagonash ogokh' [va] binost

Va kh'ar kiro Allokh' taolo kh'idoiat kunad, u kh'idoiatiofta [-i vok'ei] ast va kh'ar kiro gumrokh' sozad, kh'argiz baroiashon ba ch'uz U [Allokh' taolo] dustone nakhokh'i ioft; va ononro dar k'iiomat nobino va gung va noshunavo makh'shur megardonem, [dar kh'ole ki] bar suratkh'oiashon [kashida meshavand]; ch'oigokh'ashon duzakh ast [ki] kh'ar gokh' shu'laash furu nishinad, sharorae bar onon meafzoem
In ch'azoi onon ast; charo ki oioti Moro inkor kardand va guftand: <<Oio kh'angome ki ustukhonkh'oe [pusida va] parokanda shudem, dubora bo ofarinishe ch'adid barangekhta meshavem?>>

Oio nadonistand Allokh'ro, ki osmonkh'o va zaminro ofarida ast, metavonad kh'ammonandi ononro biiofarinad va baroiashon ach'ale ta'iin kardaast, ki kh'ech' tardide dar on nest? Va [-le] sitamgoron ch'uz inkor [-i chizero] napaziruftand

[Ei Paiombar, ba mushrikon] Bigu: <<Agar shumo moliki ganch'inakh'oi [bakhshishu] rakh'mati Parvardigoram buded, [boz kh'am] az bimi kharch' kardan [va tangdasti] az infok' khuddori mekarded; va inson kh'amvora bakhil [va tangnazar] ast>>

Va ba rosti, Mo nukh' mu'ch'izai ravshan [-ro ba unvoni nishonakh'oi paiombari] ba Muso dodem; pas, az Bani Isroil bipurs, on gokh' ki [Muso] nazdashon omad va Fir'avn ba u guft: <<Ei Muso, iak'inan turo afsunshuda mepindoram>>

[Muso] Guft: <<Tu, kh'atman, medoni, ki inkh'o [mu'ch'izot]-ro [kase] ch'uz Parvardigori osmonkh'o va zamin nafiristodaast. [In mu'ch'izot] Daloili ravshan [dar borai k'udratu iagonagii Allokh' taolo va rostguii paiombarash kh'astand]; va, ei Fir'avn, ba rosti, ki turo kh'alokshuda [va ziiondida] mepindoram>>
Pas, [Fir'avn] khost, ki onon [Bani Isroil]-ro az on sarzamin berun kunad; va[-le Mo] u va tamomi kasonero, ki kh'amrokh'ash budand, g'ark' kardem
Va pas az [nobudii] u ba Bani Isroil guftem: <<Dar sarzamin [-i Shom] sokin shaved va kh'angome ki va'dai okhirat faro rasid, kh'amai shumoro bo kh'am [ba saroi makh'shar] meovarem>>
Va in [K'ur'on]-ro bar kh'ak' nozil kardem va bar kh'ak' [va biduni kh'ech' takh'rifu tag'iire] nozil shud; va [ei Mukh'ammad] turo ch'uz bashoratgar va bimdikh'anda nafiristodem

Va K'ur'on [-i garonk'adr]-ro bakhsh-bakhsh [va ba murur bar tu] nozil kardem, to onro bo dirang [va okh'istagi] baroi mardum bikhoni va onro ba tadrich' [va bar kh'asbi ruidodkh'oi mukhtalif] nozil kardem

[Ei Paiombar, ba kofiron] bigu: <<[Chi] Ba on imon biiovared io naiovared [fark'e ba kh'olaton nadorad]. Be tardid, kasone, ki k'abl az [nuzuli] on donish [-i kitobkh'oi osmonii peshinro] ioftaand, chun [oioti K'ur'on] bar onon khonda shavad, sach'dakunon [ bar zamin] meaftand>>
Va meguiand: <<Parvardigoramon poku munazzakh' ast. Iak'inan, va'dai Parvardigoramon anch'omshudani ast>>
Va [on gokh'] giriakunon bar [zamin] meaftand va [tilovati K'ur'on va tadabbur dar oiotash] bar furutaniashon meafzoiad

Bigu: <<Allokh' taolo>>-ro bikhoned io <<Rakh'mon>>-ro bikhoned; kh'ar kadomro, ki bikhoned, nakutarini nomkh'o baroi Ust>>. Va [ei Paiombar] namozatro [onchunon] ba sadoi baland nakhon [ki mushrikon bishnavand] va onro [on k'adr niz] okh'ista nakhon [ki kh'atto askh'obat nashnavand]; va miioni in [du kh'olat] rokh'e [miiona] bich'ui

Va bigu: <<Sitoish makhsusi Allokh' taolo ast, ki farzande [baroi khesh] barnaguzidaast va dar farmonravoi kh'ech' sharike nadorad va kh'argiz khoru notavon namegardad, ki [niioz ba dust va] korsoz doshta boshad>> va Uro buzurg bidor; buzurgdoshte shoista
Kh'amdu sipos makhsusi Allokh' taolo ast, ki K'ur'onro bar bandaash [Mukh'ammad] nozil kard va kh'ech' guna inkh'irofe dar on k'aror nadod
[Kitobe] Ustuvor to [kofironro] az azobe sakht az ch'onibi U [Allokh' taolo] bim dikh'ad va ba mu'minone, ki korkh'oi shoista mekunand, muzhda dikh'ad, ki podoshi nakue baroiashon [dar pesh] ast
[Kh'amon bikh'ishte] ki ch'ovidona dar on khokh'and monad
Va [niz] kasonero, ki guftand: <<Allokh' taolo farzande [baroi khud] barguzida ast>>, bim dikh'ad
Na khudashon ba in [guftori nodurust] ilm [-u iak'in] dorand na padaronashon. Sukhani bisior nopisandest, ki az dakh'onashon berun meoiad [va] ch'uz durug' nameguiand
Pas, [ei Paiombar] nazdik ast, agar [k'avmat ba in sukhan [K'ur'on]] imon naiovarand, dar paii [beimonii] onon khudro [az taassuf va andukh'] kh'alok kuni
Dar kh'ak'ik'at, Mo on chiro, ki ruii zamin ast, zevare baroi on k'aror dodaem, to ononro biiozmoem, ki kadomashon nakukortarand
Va Mo [pas az poioni kh'aiot] on chiro, ki ruii zamin ast, ba biiobone khushk va begiiokh' tabdil khokh'em kard
Oio pindoshtai, ki [moch'aroi] askh'obi Kakh'f va on sangnavishta [ki nomashon bar on kh'ak shuda bud] az ch'umlai nishonakh'oi shigiftangez [va g'airimumkini] Mo budaast?

Kh'angome ki on ch'avonmardon ba g'or panokh' burdand va guftand: <<Parvardigoro, moro az ch'onibi khesh rakh'mate arzoni dor va dar kori [kh'ich'rati] mo baroiamon kh'idoiat va nach'ot farokh'am soz>>
Pas, dar on g'or bar gushkh'oiashon to soliioni daroz [pardae az sukutu oromish] zadem [to ba khob ravand]
Sipas bedorashon kardem, to bidonem kadom iak az on du gurukh' muddatero, ki [dar khob] mondaand, durusttar kh'isob kardaast
[Ei Paiombar] Mo dostoni ononro, ba durusti, baroiat bozgu mekunem. Onon ch'avonone [shoista] budand, ki ba Parvardigorashon imon ovarda budand va Mo [niz] bar kh'idoiatashon afzudem

Va dilkh'oiashonro [bar imon] ustuvor sokhtem, on gokh' ki [dar barobari podshokh'i kofir] k'iiom kardand va guftand: <<Parvardigori mo parvardigori osmonkh'o va zamin ast; va kh'argiz ch'uz u ma'budero nameparastem, ki on gokh' [agar chunin kunem] sukhane gazofu noravo guftaem>>

[Sipas ba kh'amfikronashon guftand:] <<In k'avmi mo [ki] ba ch'oi U [Allokh' taolo] ma'budone [digar] barguzidaand, charo daleli oshkore bar [kh'ak'k'oniiati] onon nameovarand? Pas, kist sitamgortar az on ki bar Allokh' taolo durug' bast [va baroiash sharik k'oil shud]?

Va chun az onon va az on chi ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo meparastand, kanoragiri karded, pas, ba g'or panokh' bibared, to Parvardigoraton az [soiai] rakh'mati khesh bar shumo bigustaronad va dar koraton [osoishu] kushoishe padid ovarad

Va [ei Mukh'ammad, agar on ch'o budi] khurshedro medidi, ki vak'te tulu' mekunad, ba samti rost [-i g'or] mutamoil megardad va vak'te g'urub mekunad, az samti chapi onon dur meshud [va garmo ozorashon namedod]; va onon dar makh'alle gustarda az on [g'or] budand. In az nishonakh'oi [k'udrati] Allokh' taolo ast. Kh'ar kiro Allokh' taolo kh'idoiat kunad, pas, u kh'idoiatiofta [-i vok'ei] ast va kh'ar kiro gumrokh' kunad, kh'argiz dust [va] rokh'namoe baroiash nameiobi

Va [agar ba onkh'o nigokh' mekardi] mepindoshti, bedorand; dar kh'ole ki [bo chashmoni boz] khufta budand; va Mo ononro ba pakh'lui rostu chap megardondem [to badanashon oseb nabinad]; va sagashon bar ostonai g'or [nishasta va ba kh'olati posboni] dastkh'oiashro kushoda bud. Agar [nigokh'ashon mekardi va] az kh'olashon ogokh' meshudi, kh'atman, [az vakh'shat] firor mekardi va dilat az tarsi onon labrez meshud

Va kh'amchunon [ki khobashon kardem] ononro [az khob] bedor namudem, to baini khud az iakdigar suol kunand. Iake az onon guft: <<Chi muddat dar khob monded?>> [Bak'iia] Guftand: <<Iak ruz io bakhshe az iak ruz>>. [Saranch'om] Guftand: <<Parvardigoraton donotar ast, ki chi k'adar [dar in kh'olat] mondaed. Pas, [aknun] iak nafar az khudatonro bo in sikka[-kh'oia]-ton ba shakh'r bifiristed, to bubinad, kadom iak az [furushandagoni on ch'o kosibi va] g'izoiash pokizatar ast va az [nazdi] u g'izoe baroiaton biiovarad; va boiad [dar raftuomadu kharid pinkh'onkori va] ziraki namoiad va kh'ech' kasro az [kh'oli] shumo ogokh' nasozad
Be tardid, agar onon [makonatonro bidonand va] bar shumo dast ioband, sangsoraton mekunand io shumoro ba oini khesh bozmegardonand va dar on surat, kh'argiz rastagor nakhokh'ed shud

Va bad-in guna [mardumi on sarzamin]-ro az kh'oli onon ogokh' kardem, to bidonand, ki va'dai Allokh' taolo [dar borai iorii mu'minon va barangekhtani murdagon] rostu durust ast va in ki dar [faro rasidani] k'iiomat tardide nest. Kh'angome ki [mardumi shakh'r] baini khud [dar borai on ch'avonmardoni mutavaffo] duchori ikhtilof shudand, pas, gurukh'e guftand: <<Devore bar [vurudi] on [g'or] bisozed. Parvardigorashon ba kh'oli onon ogokh'tar ast>>. Barkhe digar, ki [noogokh' budand va nufuzu] k'udrat doshtand, guftand: <<[Ba nishonai buzurgdosht] Bar [g'ori] eshon parastishgokh'e mesozem>>

[Dar borai te'dodashon] Khokh'and, guft: <<Se nafar budand va chakh'orumini onon sagashon bud>>. Va [gurukh'e] meguiand: <<Panch' nafar budand va shashumini onon sagashon bud>> - [ki albatta] kh'ama az rui kh'ads va gumon ast - va [gurukh'e] meguiand: <<Kh'aft nafar budand va kh'ashtumini onon sagashon bud>>. Bigu: <<Parvadigoram az te'dodi onon ogokh'tar ast [va] ch'uz gurukh'e andak te'dodashonro kase namedonad. Pas, dar borai onon guftugue mukhtasar [va bakh'se orom va guzaro] doshta bosh va dar borai onon az kh'ech' kas suol nakun
Va kh'argiz dar mavridi kore nagu: <<Fardo onro anch'om medikh'am>>

Magar in ki [bigui] <<Inshoallokh'>>; va kh'ar gokh' faromush kardi, [bo guftani in lafz] Parvardigoratro iod kun va bigu: <<Umedvoram Parvardigoram maro ba rokh'e rakh'namun gardad, ki az in [rokh'] ba kh'idoiat [va salokh'] nazdiktar boshad>>
Va onon [askh'obi Kakh'f] sesad sol dar g'orashon [dar kh'olati khob] mondand va nukh' sol [niz] bar on afzudand

[Ei paiombar] Bigu: <<Allokh' taolo az [muddati] mondanashon [dar g'or] ogokh'tar ast; g'aibi osmonkh'o va zamin az oni Ust. [Ba rosti, ki] U chi bino va chi shunavo ast! Onon [ch'akh'oniion] ba ch'uz U kh'ech' [dustu] korsoze nadorand va U kh'ech' kasro dar kh'ukm [-u farmon]-i khesh sharik namesozad>>
Va [ei paiombar] az kitobi Parvardigorat on chiro ba tu vakh'i shudaast, tilovat kun. Kh'ech' kas tag'iirdikh'andai sukhanoni U [Allokh' taolo] nest va kh'argiz panokh'gokh'e ch'uz U nameiobi

Va khudro [bar musokh'ibat] bo kasone kh'amrokh' [va shikebo] gardon, ki Parvardigorashonro bomdod va shomgokh' mekhonand [va bo on ki fak'irand, tankh'o] rizoiiati Uro mekhokh'and; va kh'argiz chashmonatro az onon barnagardon, to zevarkh'oi dunio [va kh'amnishini bo ashrof va k'udratmandon]-ro bikhokh'i va [kh'amchunin] az kase pairavi nakun, ki dilashro az iodi khesh g'ofil sokhtaem va az kh'avoi nafsi khesh pairavi karda va korash tabokh' ast

[Ei paiombar, ba mushrikon] bigu: <<[In K'ur'on sukhani] Kh'ak' ast az ch'onibi Parvardigoraton; pas, kh'ar ki mekhokh'ad, imon ovarad va kh'ar ki mekhokh'ad, kofir shavad>>. Mo baroi sitamgoron otashe omoda kardaem, ki saropardakh'oiash ononro az kh'ar su faro megirad; va agar [dar talabi ob] fariodrase bich'uiand, bo obe kh'amchun misi gudokhta ba fariodashon merasand; [obe, ki kh'aroratash] chekh'rakh'oro birion mekunad. Chi bad nushidani va chi bad ch'oigakh'e ast!
Kasone, ki imon ovardand va korkh'oi shoista anch'om dodaand [ba iak'in, bidonand, ki] Mo podoshi kasero, ki kori naku karda boshad, kh'argiz tabokh' namekunem

Ononand, ki bikh'ishtkh'oi ch'ovidoni dorand, ki [az zeri darakhtoni] onkh'o ch'uiborkh'o ch'ori ast. Dar on ch'o bo dastbandkh'oi zarrin orosta meshavand va ch'omakh'oi [fokhiri] sabzrang az kh'ariri nozuk va kh'ariri zakhim bar tan mekunand, dar kh'ole ki bar takhtkh'o takia zadaand. Chi podoshi shoista va chi naku ch'oigokh'e ast!

Va [ei paiombar] baroi onon misole bizan: du mard [kofir va mu'min], ki baroi iake az onon [ki kofir ast] du bog'i angur k'aror dodem va peromuni on du [bog']-ro bo darakhtoni nakhl pushonidem va miioni on kishtzore [purbor] nikh'odem
Kh'ar du bog' meva medod va chize az on namekost; va miioni on du [bog'] nakh're buzurg ch'ori kardem

U [sokh'ibi bog'] mevakh'oe [bisior va daromade farovon] dosht; pas, ba dusti khud, ki bo u guftugu mekard, guft: <<Sarvati man az tu beshtar ast va az likh'ozi khonavoda [va nafaron] az tu tavonmandtaram>>
Va u dar kh'ole ba bog'i khesh dokhil shud, ki [ba khotiri kufru g'urur] dar kh'ak'k'i khesh sitamgor bud; [pas, ba dustash ru ovarda] guft: <<Gumon namekunam, ki in [bog'] kh'argiz nobud gardad
Va gumon namekunam, ki k'iiomat barpo gardad; va agar [k'iiomate dar kor boshad va] ba suii Parvardigoram bozgardanda shavam, kh'atman, ch'oigokh'e bekh'tar az in meiobam>>
Dustash, ki bo vai guftugu mekard, ba u guft: <<Oio ba on kase, ki turo az khok [va] sipas az nutfa ofarid va sipas turo marde [komil] somon dod, kofir shudai?
Ammo man [meguiam:] U Allokh' taolo parvardigori man ast va kh'ech' kasro bo Parvardigoram sharik namedonam

Vak'te voridi bog'at shudi, charo nagufti, kh'ar chi Allokh' taolo bikhokh'ad [kh'amon meshavad] va kh'ech' nerue ch'uz ba [ta'iidi] Allokh' taolo nest? Agar mebini man az nazari molu farzand az tu kamtaram [mukh'im nest]
Chi baso Parvardigoram [chize] bekh'tar az bog'i tu ba man bidikh'ad va az osmon chunon azobe [otashbor] bar bog'at furu borad, ki [tabdil ba zamin] begiiokh'i lag'zhandae gardad
Io obash dar [a'mok'i zamin chunon] furu ravad, ki kh'argiz natavoni ba on dast biiobi>>

[Saranch'om azobi ilokh'i faro rasid] Va tamomi mevakh'oiashro dar bar girift [va nobud shud]. Va u ba khotiri kharch'kh'oe, ki carfi on ch'o karda bud, paivasta dastkh'oiashro [az pushaimoni va andukh'] bar kh'am mezad va dar kh'ole ki dorbast va chubbandkh'oiash furu rekhta bud, meguft: <<Ei kosh [dar parastish] kasero shariki Parvardigoram k'aror nadoda budam>>
Va u [ki ba khondani khud mebolid, inak] gurukh'e nadosht, ki dar barobari [azobi] Allokh' taolo ioriash kunand va khud [niz] iorikunandai khesh nabud
On ch'o [sobit shud, ki iori va] korsozi az oni [Parvardigori] kh'ak' ast. U podoshi [ibodatash] bekh'tar ast va saranch'omi [bandagoni mu'minash] nakutar

Va [ei paiombar, fanopazirii] zindagii dunioro ba obe masal bizan, ki az osmon furu firistodem va ba vasilai on giiokh'i zamin [sarsabz shud va] dar kh'am omekht; sipas [chunon] khushku shikasta shud, ki bodkh'o [ba kh'ar su] parokandaash megardonad; va Allokh' taolo bar kh'ar chize tavonost
Molu farzandon zinati zindagii duniost va nekikh'oi poidor [raftoru guftori shoista] nazdi Parvardigorat podoshash bekh'tar ast, umed doshtan [ba savobash] nakutar

Va [iod kun az] ruze, ki kukh'kh'oro ba kh'arakat darmeovarem va zaminro oshkor [va kh'amvor] mebini va kh'ama [makhluk'ot]-ro ch'am' mekunem va kh'ech' iak az ononro [ba kh'oli khud] rakh'o namekunem

Va [kh'amagi] safkashida bar Parvardigorat arza meshavand [va ba onon meguiand:] <<Be tardid, chunon ki nakhustin bor shumoro ofaridem, [imruz niz tankh'o va pobarakh'na] nazdi Mo omaded; balki mepindoshted, ki kh'argiz va'dagokh'e baroiaton k'aror namedikh'em>>

Va noma [-i a'mol dar miion] nikh'oda meshavad; pas, gunakh'koronro mebini, ki az on chi dar on [noma] ast, tarson va nigaronand va meguiand: <<Ei voi bar mo! In chi nomae ast, ki kh'ech' [guftoru raftori] kuchak va buzurgro rakh'o nakardaast, magar in ki onro dar shumor ovardaast?>> Va kh'ar chi kardaand, kh'ozir meioband va Parvardigorat ba kh'ech' kase sitam namekunad

Va [iod kun az] kh'angome ki ba farishtagon guftem: <<Baroi Odam sach'da kuned>>; pas, [kh'ama] sach'da kardand, magar Iblis, ki az ch'in bud va az farmoni Parvardigorash sar pechid. Pas, [ei mardum] oio ba ch'oii Man u va farzandonashro duston [-i khud] megired, kh'ol on ki onon dushmanaton kh'astand? Sitamgoron [-i mushrik baroi Allokh' taolo] chi bad ch'oiguzine dorand!

Man ononro [ki mushrikona ba parastish megired] na kh'angomi ofarinishi osmonu zamin ba guvokh'i giriftam va na kh'angomi ofarinishi khudashon; va man kh'argiz gumrokh'garonro ioru madadgori [khesh] nagiriftaam

Va [iod kun az] ruze, ki Allokh' taolo [ba mushrikon] mefarmoiad: <<Sharikonero, ki baroi man mepindoshted, faro bikhoned [to shumoro az azob birakh'onand]; pas, onkh'oro mekhonand, vale posukhashonro namedikh'and; va Mo dar miioni in du gurukh' makh'lakae [az otashi duzakh] k'aror dodaem
Va gunakh'goron otash [-i duzakh]-ro mebinand va ba iak'in darmeioband, ki dar on khokh'and aftod va az on ch'o kh'ech' rokh'i bozgashte nadorand
Va ba rosti, dar in K'ur'on baroi mardum az kh'ar guna masale ovardem; va[-le] inson besh az kh'ar chize ba sitez [va chunucharo] mepardozad

Va chize mardumro boznadosht, ki vak'te kh'idoiat [paiombar va K'ur'on] ba suiashon omad, imon biiovarand va az Parvardigorashon omurzish bikhokh'and, magar in ki [az rui lach'och'at mekhostand] sunnati [Allokh' taolo dar mavridi azobi] peshiniion bar [sari] onon [niz] biioiad io azobi ru dar ru ba onon birasad

Va mo paiombaronro ch'uz bashoratgar va bimdikh'anda namefiristem va kasone, ki kufr varzidand, ba [sukhanoni bekh'uda va] botil siteza mekunand, to ba vasilai on kh'ak' [K'ur'on]-ro poimol kunand va [mu'ch'izotu] oioti man va on chiro, ki ba on bim doda shudaand, ba tamaskhur giriftand

Kist sitamgortar az on ki ba oioti Parvardigorash pand doda shavad, vale az on ru bigardonad va korkh'oi [zishti] guzashtaashro faromush kunad? Mo bar dilkh'oiashon pardakh'oe afkandaem, to [paiomi kh'ak']-ro darnaioband va dar gushkh'oiashon sangini [nikh'odaem, to sukhani kh'ak'ro nashnavand]; va agar ononro ba sui kh'idoiat bikhoni, kh'argiz kh'idoiat nameshavand

[Ei Paiombar] Parvardigorat omurzanda va doroi rakh'mat [farovon] ast. Agar onon [kofiron]-ro ba [sazoi] on chi kardaand, bozkhost mekard, kh'atman, dar azobashon shitob menamud; [ammo chunin namekunad] balki onon mav'ide dorand, ki kh'argiz az on gureze nakhokh'and dosht
Mo [sokinoni] on shakh'rkh'oro kh'angome kh'alok namudem, ki [ba khotiri kufru gunokh'] ba khud sitam kardand va baroi kh'alokatashon mav'ide ta'iin kardem

[Iod kun az] Kh'angome ki Muso ba [khidmatkori] ch'avoni khud [Iusha' ibni Nun] guft: <<Kh'amchunon khokh'am raft, to ba makh'alli barkhurdi du dario birasam io baroi muddati tuloni rokh' bipaimoiam [to bandai durustkore biiobam va nodonistakh'oiamro az u biiomuzam]>>

Pas, chun ba makh'alli barkhurdi du dario rasidand, mokh'ii khudro [ki baroi khurdan kh'amrokh' doshtand] faromush kardand [pas, Allokh' taolo onro zinda kard va ba ob andokht] va mokh'i rokh'i khudro dar dario pesh girift
Pas, kh'angome ki [ba rokh' aftodand va az on ch'o] guzashtand, [Muso] ba [khidmatkori] ch'avoni khud guft: <<G'izoiamonro biiovar, ki az in safar bisior khasta shudaem>>

[Iusha'] Guft: <<Ba iod dori, kh'angome ki [baroi istirokh'at] ba kanori on takhtasang ch'oi giriftem, man [dar on ch'o dostoni zinda shudani] mokh'iro faromush kardam [ki bo tu biguiam] va ch'uz shaiton [kase] maro az iodovarii on [doston] ba faromushi naandokht va mokh'i ba tarze shigiftovar rokh'ashro dar dario pesh girift>>
[Muso] Guft: <<On kh'amon chizest, ki mekhostem [va ch'oigokh'i on bandai nakukor kh'amon ch'ost]>>. Pas, ch'ustuch'ukunon radi poi khudro giriftand [va az kh'amon rokh'] bozgashtand
Pas, [dar on ch'o] bandae az bandagoni mo [Khizr]-ro ioftand, ki az ch'onibi khesh ba u rakh'mate doda budem va az nazdi khud ba vai donishe omukhta budem
Muso ba u guft: <<Oio [ich'ozat medikh'i] kh'amrokh'at biioiam, to az on chi ba tu omukhta shuda va moiai kh'idoiatu irshod ast ba man biiomuzi?>>
[Khizr] Guft: <<Tu kh'argiz nametavoni, [dar itoat va kh'amrokh'i] kh'amrokh'i man shikeboi kuni
Va chi guna bar [anch'omi] kore, ki ba [rozi] on ogokh' nesti, shikeboi mekuni?>>
[Muso] Guft: <<Inshoallokh' shikebo khokh'am bud va dar kh'ech' kore az tu nofarmoni namekunam>>
[Khizr] Guft: <<Pas, agar bo man kh'amrokh' shudi, dar borai kh'ech' chiz az man suol nakun, to khud bo tu dar boraash sukhane biguiam>>
Pas, on du ba rokh' aftodand, to on ki savori kishti shudand. [Khizr] Kishtiro surokh kard. [Muso] guft: <<Onro surokh kardi, to sarnishinonashro g'ark' kuni? Rosti, chi kori noravoe kardi!>>
[Khizr] Guft: <<Oio naguftam, tu kh'argiz nametavoni bo man shikeboi kuni?>>
[Muso] guft: <<Ba khotiri on chi faromush kardam, sarzanisham nakun va dar koram bar man sakht nagir>>

Pas, ba rokh' aftodand, to kh'angome ki ba navch'avone rasidand va [Khizr] uro kusht. [Muso] guft: <<Shakhsi [begunokh'u] pokero kushti [on kh'am] biduni in ki kasero kushta boshad? Vok'ean, kori nopisande kardi!>>
Khizr guft: <<Ba tu naguftam, ki kh'argiz nametavoni bo man shikeboi kuni?>>
Muso guft: <<Agar az in pas chize az tu pursidam, digar bo man kh'amrokh'i nakun va az ch'onibi man, kh'atman, ma'zur khokh'i bud>>

Pas, ba rokh' aftodand, to ba akh'li shakh're rasidand [va] az onon g'izo khostand; [ammo onon] az mekh'mon kardani eshon khuddori kardand. Sipas dar on ch'o devore ioftand, ki mekhost furu birezad va [Khizr] onro rostu ustuvor kard. [Muso] Guft: <<Agar mekhosti, [metavonisti] baroi on [kor az onon] muzde bigiri>>
[Khizr] Guft: <<In ki zamoni ch'udoii manu tu faro rasidaast. Ba zudi turo az tavzekh' [va daleli] on chi ki natavonisti dar barobarash shikeboi kuni, ogokh' khokh'am sokht

Ammo on kishti az oni benavoione bud, ki dar dario kor mekardand; pas, khostam ma'iubash kunam; [zero] peshi rokh'ashon [dar dario] podshokh'e [sitamgor] bud, ki kh'ar kishtii [solime]-ro ba zur megirift
Va ammo on navch'avon padaru modarash mu'min budand; pas, tarsidem, ki on duro ba sarkashi va kufr vo dorad
Az in ru, khostem, ki Parvardigorashon ba ch'oii u [farzandi] poktaru mekh'rubontare ba onkh'o ato farmoiad

Va ammo on devor baroi ba du pisarbachai iatim dar on shakh'r bud va zeri on ganch'e bud, ki ba on du taalluk' dosht va padarashon [niz] marde durustkor bud; pas, Parvardigorat khost, ki onon ba kh'addi bulug' birasand va ganch'i kheshro [az zeri on devor] berun ovarand. In rakh'mate az ch'onibi Parvardigori tu bud va man in [korkh'o]-ro khudsarona nakardam, in bud tavzekh' [va daleli] korkh'oe, ki natavonisti dar barobarash shikeboi kuni>>
Va [ei paiombar, mushrikonu iakh'udiion] dar borai <<Zu-l-k'arnain>> az tu mepursand; bigu: <<Ba zudi chize az sarguzashti u baroiaton khokh'am khond>>
Mo dar zamin ba u k'udratu kh'ukumat dodem va vasilai [rasidan ba] kh'ar chizero dar ikhtiiorash nikh'odem
Pas, u [az in] vasoil [baroi rasidan ba akh'dofash] istifoda kard

[Ruze dar zamin ba rokh' aftod] To ba makh'alli g'urubi khurshed rasid. [Chunin ba nazarash rasid] Ki khurshed dar chashmae garm va gilolud g'urub mekunad va dar [nazdikii on ch'o k'avme [kofir]] ioft. [Ba u] Guftem: <<Ei Zu-l-k'arnain, io [ononro] much'ozot mekuni io dar miionashon [raftori] nakue pesh megiri>>

[Zu-l-k'arnain] Guft: <<Ammo kasero, ki sitam karda [va shirk varzida] ast, much'ozot khokh'em kard, sipas ba suii Parvardigorash bozgardonida meshavad, on gokh' uro ba azobe bisior sakht much'ozot khokh'ad kard
Va ammo kase, ki imon ovarad va kori shoista anch'om dikh'ad, pas, [dar okhirat] nakutarin podosh [bikh'isht]-ro khokh'ad dosht va bo muloimat [va mekh'ruboni] bo vai sukhan khokh'em guft>>
Sipas [Zu-l-k'arnain] az vasoili [khud] istifoda kard [va ba suii mashrik' raft]

To on ki ba ch'oigokh'i baromadani khurshed rasid. [Dar on ch'o khurshedro] Did, ki bar mardumone tulu' mekunad, ki dar barobari on [nuru garmoi oftob] baroiashon pushishe k'aror nadoda budem [na sarpanokh'e na soiai darakhte]
[Kori Zu-l-k'arnain] Inchunin, bud va Mo ba on chi u dar ikhtiior dosht [va anch'om medod], komilan ogokh' budem
Sipas [Zu-l-k'arnain] az imkonot [-i khud] istifoda kard [va ba ch'oie baini shark'u g'arb raft]
[U kh'amchunon raft] To ba [darae] miioni du kukh' rasid va dar kanori on du [kukh'] mardumero ioft, ki sukhane [ba ch'uz zaboni khudro] namefakh'midand

[Onon] Guftand: <<Ei Zu-l-k'arnain, Ia'ch'uch'u Ma'ch'uch' dar in sarzamin [tabakh'kori va] fasod mekunand. Pas, oio [mumkin ast] kharch'e dar ikhtiior k'aror dikh'em, to miioni mo va onon sadde bisozi?>>

U guft: <<On chi [az k'udratu sarvat] ki Parvardigoram dar on ba man tavonoi dodaast [az on chi arza mekuned], bekh'tar ast; pas, maro bo neru [-i insoni] iori kuned, [to] miioni shumo va onon sadde mukh'kami ustuvor sozem

Kh'atman, k'it'akh'oi okh'an baroiam biiovared [va ruii kh'am bichined]>>, to vak'te komilan miioni du kukh'ro barobar sokht [va pushond. Sipas] guft: <<[Dar atrofi devorai okh'anin otash biiafruzed va] dar on bidamed>>. [Onon chunin kardand] To vak'te on [k'itaoti okh'an]-ro gudokhta kard; [sipas] guft: <<[Aknun] misi obshuda baroiam biiovared, to ruii on [devor] birezam>>.
Pas, [Ia'ch'uch'u Ma'ch'uch'] digar natavonistand az on bolo ravand va [kh'atto] natavonistand surokhe dar on ech'od kunand

[On gokh' Zu-l-k'arnain] Guft: <<In [sad] az rakh'mati Parvardigori man ast [va to Allokh' taolo bikhokh'ad, bok'i memonad]; ammo kh'angome ki va'dai Parvardigoram faro rasad, onro darkh'am mekubad va va'dai Parvardigoram kh'ak' ast>>

Va dar on ruz [ki ch'akh'on poion mepazirad] ononro [chunon] rakh'o mekunem, ki [az farovonii ch'am'iiat] dar kh'am meomezand va [kh'amin, ki] dar sur damida shud, kh'amaro [dar iak ch'o] ch'am' mekunem
Va on ruz duzakhro oshkoro bar kofiron arza medorem
[Kh'amon] Kasone, ki chashmonashon az iodi man dar parda [-i g'aflat] bud va tavoni shunidan [-i oioti ilokh'iro] nadoshtand
Oio kasone, ki kufr varzidand, pindoshtaand, ki [metavonand] ba ch'oii man bandagonamro korsoz [va dusti khud] bigirand? Be tardid, Mo duzakhro baroi kofiron ch'oigokh'i paziroi sokhtaem
[Ei Paiombar] Bigu: <<[Mekhokh'ed] Shumoro az ziionkortarin [mardum] dar korkh'o ogokh' sozam?
Kasone, ki taloshashon dar zindagii dunio tabokh' gashtaast va khud mepindorad, ki kori naku mekunand>>
Onon kasone kh'astand, ki ba oioti Parvardigorashon va didori U [dar okhirat] kofir shudand; pas, korkh'oiashon tabokh' gasht va ruzi k'iiomat baroiashon [kh'ech' k'adru] arzishe k'oil nameshavem
Inchunin ast, ki ba khotiri kufre, ki varzidaand va oiotu paiombaroni Maro ba tamaskhur giriftaand podoshashon duzakh ast
Be tardid, kasone, ki imon ovardaand va korkh'oe shoista anch'om dodaand, bog'kh'oi [bikh'ishti] barin manzilgokh'ashon khokh'ad bud
Ch'ovidona dar on khokh'and mond va kh'argiz az on ch'o ba ch'oii digare garoish nadorand

[Ei Paiombar] Bigu: <<Agar dario baroi [nigorishi] kalimoti Parvardigoram rang shavad, pesh az on ki kalimoti Parvardigoram poion iobad, kh'atman, dario ba poion merasad; kh'archand [dariokh'oe digar] kh'ammonandi on [darioro niz] ba kumak biiovarem>>

[Ei paiombar] Bigu: <<Man fak'at bashare [odi] kh'amchun shumo kh'astam. Ba man vakh'i meshavad, ki tankh'o ma'budaton Allokh' taolo iaktost; pas, kh'ar ki ba didori Parvardigorash [dar okhirat] umed dorad, boiad kori shoista anch'om dikh'ad va kh'ech' kasro dar parastishi Parvardigorash sharik nasozad>>
Kof, kh'o, io, 'ain, sod
[In] Baioni rakh'mati Parvardigorat [nisbat] ba bandaash Zakariiost
On gokh' ki Parvardigorashro ba nidoe pinkh'on [ba duo] khond
Guft: <<Parvardigoro, ba rosti, ki ustukhonam sust shuda va muikh'oiam az piri saped gashta va ei Parvardigoram, [kh'argiz] dar duoi tu [az ich'obat] bebakh'ra nabudaam
Va man pas az [margi] khud az kheshovandonam [nisbat ba kh'ifzi dini Tu] bimnokam va kh'amsaram [niz] nozost; pas, ba lutfi khesh farzande ba man ato farmo
[Pisare, ki] Vorisi manu vorisi khonadoni Ia'k'ub boshad; va Parvardigoro, uro [dar ilmu din insone] pisandida gardon>>
[Allokh' taolo duoiashro ich'obat kardu farmud] <<Ei Zakariio, Mo turo ba [tavalludi] pisare bashorat medikh'em, ki nomash Iakh'io ast [va] pesh az in kh'amnome baroiash k'aror nadodaem>>
[Zakariio] Guft: <<Parvardigoro, chi guna pisare khokh'am dosht, dar kh'ole ki kh'amsaram nozost va man [niz] az shiddati piri ba notavoni rasidaam?>>
[Farishta] Guft: <<In guna ast [ki tu megui, vale] Parvardigorat farmudaast: <<In [amr] baroi Man oson ast va ba rosti, pesh az in [niz] turo ofaridem, dar kh'ole ki chize nabudi>>

[Zakariio] Guft: <<Parvardigoro, baroi man nishonae [bar takh'ak'k'uk'i in bashorat] k'aror bidekh'>>. [Allokh' taolo] Farmud: <<Nishonai tu in ast, ki ce shabona [ruz] dar kh'ole ki solim [va tandurust] kh'asti, bo mardum sukhan namegui>>
Pas, u az mekh'rob [ ch'oigokh'i ibodatash] ba suii k'avmash raft va ba onon ishora kard, ki: <<bomdodu shomgokh' [Parvardigorro] ba poki iod kuned>>
[Allokh' taolo farmud] <<Ei Iakh'io, kitobi [Tavrot]-ro bo k'uvvat [va ch'iddiiat] bigir>> va dar kudaki ba u donish [va kh'ikmat] dodem
Va az ch'onibi khesh [ba u] mukh'abbatu poki [az gunokh'on ato kardem] va u parkh'ezkor bud
Va nisbat ba padaru modarash nakukor bud va sarkash [-u] nofarmon nabud
Va salom [va amniiati Allokh' taolo] bar u bod, ruze, ki mutavallid shud va ruze, ki memirad va ruze, ki zinda barangekhta meshavad
Va dar [in] kitob [K'ur'on] az Mariam iod kun, on gokh' ki az khonavodaash kanora girift [va dar] nokh'iiai shark'i [az onon] mustak'ar shud.
Va miioni khud va onkh'o pardae afkand [to khilvatgokh'i ibodatash boshad]. On gokh' [mo] Rukh'i khud [Ch'abrail]-ro ba suiash firistodem va ba shakli insone khushandom bar vai namoion gasht.
[Mariam] Guft: <<Man az [sharri] tu ba [Allokh'i] Rakh'mon panokh' mebaram. Agar parkh'ezkori [ba man oseb narason]>>
[Ch'abrail] guft: <<Iak'inan, man firistodai Parvardigorat kh'astam, to ba tu pisari pokizae bakhsham>>
[Mariam] guft: <<Chi guna mumkin ast pisare doshta bosham; kh'ol on ki dasti kh'ech' insone ba man narasidaast va badkor [niz] nabudaam?>>

[Ch'abrail] Guft: <<[Dastur] chunin ast. Parvardigorat farmud: <<In [kor] bar man oson ast va uro baroi mardum nishonae [az k'udrati khesh] k'aror medikh'em va [niz] rakh'mate az suii Most; va in [shevai tavallud] amre anch'omiofta [va kh'atmi] ast>>
Pas, [Mariam] ba u bordor shud. Va bo u ba ch'oie durdast [raft va az mardum] kanora girift

Pas, dardi zoimon uro ba samti iak tanai nakhl kashond [va u dar kh'ole ki dard mekashid] guft: <<Ei kosh, pesh az in memurdam va ba kulli az iodkh'o meraftam [to kase dar boraam khaioli botil nakunad]>>
Nogakh'on az zeri [poii] u [Iso] nidoiash dod, ki: <<G'amgin mabosh. Parvardigorat zeri [poii] tu chashmai obe ravon sokhtaast
Va tanai nakhlro ba tarafi khud takon bidekh', [to] rutabi toza bar tu furu rezad
