Pas, [az on khurmo] bikhur va [az obi chashma] binush va didagonro [ba in farzand] ravshan dor; va agar kh'ar iak az mardumro didi, [bo ishora] bigu: <<Man baroi [Allokh'i] Rakh'mon ruzai [cukut] nazr kardam va imruz bo kh'ech' insone sukhan nakhokh'am guft>>
Pas, [Mariam] dar kh'ole ki u [Iso]-ro bardoshta bud, nazdi k'avmash omad. Onon guftand: <<Ei Mariam, ba rosti, durug'i buzurge megui [ki navzod biduni padar mutavallid shudaast]
Ei khokh'ari Kh'orun, na padarat mardi badkore bud va na modarat [zani] badkorae>>
Pas, Mariam ba u [Iso] ishora kard. Onon guftand: <<Chi guna bo kudake dar gakh'vora sukhan biguem?>>
[Iso ba sukhan omad va] guft: <<Man bandai Allokh' taolo kh'astam. U ba man kitob doda va maro paiombar sokhtaast
Va maro - kh'ar ch'o ki bosham - purbarakat namuda va to zinda kh'astam, ba namozu zakot suporisham kardaast
Va nisbat ba modaram nakukor [gardonida] va maro [dar barobari Parvardigoram] sarkash [-u] nofarmon k'aror nadodaast
Va salom bar man ruze, ki mutavallid shudam va ruze, ki memiram va ruze, ki zinda barangekhta meshavam>>
In ast [kh'ikoiati] Iso pisari Mariam; [kh'amon] guftori roste, ki [gumrokh'on] dar boraash tardid [va ikhtilof] mekunand

[Kh'argiz] Sazovor nest, ki Allokh' taolo [baroi khesh] farzande bigirad. U [poku] munazzakh' ast. [Allokh' taolo] Kh'ar gokh' korero iroda kunad, fak'at ba on meguiad: <<Mavch'ud shav>>; pas [bedirang] mavch'ud meshavad
Va [Iso ba k'avmash guft] <<Be tardid, Allokh' taolo Parvardigori man va shumost; pas, uro parasted [ki] rokh'i rost in ast>>
On gokh' gurukh'kh'o [-i mukhtalifi k'avmash] dar miioni khud duchori ikhtilof shudand. Pas, voi bar onkh'o, ki kufr varzidand az mushokh'idai ruzi buzurg [k'iiomat]!
On ruz, ki nazdi mo meoiand, chi [khub] shunavo va bino kh'astand! Ammo imruz [dar zindagii dunio] sitamgoron dar gumrokh'ii oshkorand
Va [ei paiombar] ba onon dar borai ruzi [pushaimoni va] kh'asrat kh'ushdor bidekh'; on gokh' ki kori [dovari] anch'om megirad; va [imruz] onon dar g'aflatand va imon nameovarand
Iak'inan, Mo zamin va kh'ar kiro bar on ast, ba irs mebarem va [kh'ama] ba suii Mo bozgardonida shavand
Va [ei paiombar] dar in kitob az Ibrokh'im iod kun. Be tardid, u paiombare rostgu bud
Kh'angome ki ba padarash [Ozar] guft: <<Padarch'on, charo chizero parastish mekuni, ki na [duoiatro] meshunavad va na [ibodatatro] mebinad va na gazandero az tu dur mesozad?
Padarch'on, iak'inan, az donishi [vakh'i] chize ba man rasidaast, ki [kh'argiz] ba tu narasidaast; pas, az man pairavi kun, to ba rokh'e rost kh'idoiat kunam
Padarch'on, az shaiton pairavi nakun, [charo ki] be tardid, shaiton nisbat ba [Allokh'i] Rakh'mon nofarmon bud
Padarch'on, man metarsam, ki az [ch'onibi Allokh'i] Rakh'mon azobe ba tu rasad va [dar duzakh] az duston [va kh'amnishinoni] shaiton boshi>>
[Ozar] Guft: <<Ei Ibrokh'im, oio az ma'budkh'oi man ruigardoni? Agar [az ak'idaat] dast barnadori, kh'atman, sangsorat mekunam; [birav] va muddati ziiode az man dur shav>>
[Ibrokh'im] Guft: <<Salom [va amniiat az ch'onibi man] bar tu. Ba zudi az Parvardigoram baroiat omurzish khokh'am khost. Be tardid, u nisbat ba man bisior mekh'rubon ast
Va az shumo [kofiron] va on chi ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo mekhoned, kanoragiri mekunam va Parvardigoramro mekhonam. Umed ast, ki dar khondani Parvardigoram [az ich'obat] bebakh'ra nabosham>>
Pas, chun az onon va on chi ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo meparastidand, kanoragiri kard, Iskh'ok' va Ia'k'ubro ba u bakhshidem va kh'amai [onon]-ro paiombar namudem
Va eshonro az rakh'mati khesh bakh'ramand sokhtem va baroiashon [dar miioni mardum ovozai baland va] nomi naku nikh'odem
Va dar in kitob az Muso iod kun. Be tardid, u [barguzidae] mukhlis va firistodavu paiombar bud
Va [mo] uro az samti rosti [kukh'i] Tur nido dodem va munoch'otkunon [ba khesh] nazdikash sokhtem
Va az rakh'mati khud barodarash Kh'orunro - ki, paiombar [va iovari u] bud - va ba vai ato kardem
Va dar in kitob az Ismoil iod kun. Be tardid, u rostva'da va firistodavu paiombar bud
Va [kh'amvora] khonavodaashro ba namozu zakot farmon medod va nazdi Parvardigorash pisandida bud
Va dar in kitob az Idris iod kun. Be tardid, u rostguftoru paiombare bud
Va [mo] uro ba mak'ome baland barkashidem

Inon kasone az paiombaron kh'astand, ki Allokh' taolo bar eshon ne'mat [kh'idoiat] dod; [afrode] az farzandoni Odam va az kasone, ki kh'amrokh'i Nukh' [bar kishti] savor kardem va az farzandoni Ibrokh'im va Ia'k'ub va az [ch'umla] afrode, ki kh'idoiat kardem va barguzidem [va] kh'ar gokh' oioti [Parvardigori] Rakh'mon bar eshon khonda meshud, sach'dakunon va girion ba khok meaftodand

On gokh' pas az onon ch'onishinone gumrokh' va noshoista omadand, ki namozro tabokh' sokhtand [dar on sakh'langori namudand] va az kh'avaskh'o [va shakh'avot] pairavi kardand; va ba zudi [kaifari] gumrokh'ii [khesh]-ro khokh'and did
Magar kase, ki tavba namud va imon ovard va kore shoista kard. Pas, inon ba bikh'isht dokhil meshavand va bar onon kh'ech' sitame nameravad
Bog'kh'oe ch'ovidon, ki [Allokh'i] Rakh'mon az [olam] nopaido ba bandagonash va'da dodaast. Iak'inan, va'dai u omadani ast
Dar on ch'o sukhani bekh'udae nameshunavad [va guftorashon] ch'uz salom [u takh'iiat nest]; va dar on ch'o bar eshon [kh'ar] subkh'u shom ruzi [bekh'isob farokh'am] ast
In kh'amon bikh'ishte ast, ki ba kh'ar kas az bandagonamon, ki [dar dunio] parkh'ezkor boshad, ba meros medikh'em
Va [ei Ch'abrail, ba Mukh'ammad bigu] <<Mo ch'uz ba farmoni Parvardigorat furud nameoem. U kh'okim bar oianda va guzashta va kh'oli most; va Parvardigorat faromushkor nest
[Kh'amon] Parvardigori osmonkh'o va zamin va on chi miioni onkh'ost; pas, uro parastish kun va bar ibodatash shikebo [va poidor] bosh. Oio [kh'ammonand va] kh'amnome baroiash meshinosi?>>
Va insoni [kofir] meguiad: <<Oio kh'angome ki bimiram, ba rosti, maro zinda [az gur] berun khokh'and ovard?>>
Oio inson ba iod nameovarad, ki mo pesh az in uro ofaridem, dar kh'ole ki kh'ech' nabud?
Pas, savgand ba Parvardigorat, ki iak'inan, onon [munkironi k'iiomat]-ro bo shaiotin makh'shur khokh'em kard; sipas kh'amaro ba zonu darovarda girdogirdi duzakh kh'ozir mekunem
Sipas az kh'ar gurukh'e kasonero dar barobari [farmoni Allokh'i] Rakh'mon sarkashtar budaand, berun mekashem
On gokh', iak'inan, Mo ba [kh'oli] kasone, ki baroi [daraftodan ba] on [otashi dakh'shatnok] sazovortarand, donotarem
Va kh'ech' iak az shumo [mardum] nest, magar on ki voridi on megardad; [mu'minon baroi ubur va didan, kofiron baroi vurud va mondan]. In [amr] kh'amvora bar Parvardigorat k'azoi kh'atmi ast
Sipas kasonero, ki parkh'ezkori kardaand, [az otash] nach'ot medikh'em va zolimonro ba zonu daromada, dar on rakh'o mekunem

Va kh'angome ki oioti ravshani Mo bar onon tilovat meshavad, kasone, ki kufr varzidaand, ba afrode, ki imon ovardaand, meguiand: <<Kadom iak az [mo] du gurukh' ch'oigokh'e bekh'taru mach'lise nakutar dorad?>>
Chi bisior naslkh'oro pesh az onon nobud kardem, ki sarvate beshtar va zokh'ire orostatar doshtand

[Ei paiombar] Bigu: <<Kh'ar ki dar gumrokh'i ast, [Allokh'i] Rakh'mon ba u mukh'lat medikh'ad [to gumrokh'iash beshtar shavad] to zamone, ki va'dai ilokh'iro [ba chashmi khud] bubinand: io azobi [dunio] io [kaifari] k'iiomat. Pas, ba zudi khokh'and donist, ki chi kase ch'oigokh'ash badtar va sipokh'ash notavontar ast>>

Va [ammo] kasone, ki rokh' ioftaand, Allokh' taolo bar kh'idoiatashon meafzoiad; va nekikh'oi poidor [raftoru guftori shoista] dar peshgokh'i Parvardigorat podoshe bekh'tar va saranch'ome nakutar dorad
Oio didi on kasero, ki ba oioti Mo kofir shud va guft: <<Kh'atman, molu farzand [-i farovone dar okhirat] ba man doda khokh'ad shud?>>
Oio u bar g'aib ogokh'i ioftaast, io az [Allokh'i] Rakh'mon paimone giriftaast?
[Kh'argiz] Chunin nest; guftaashro menavisem va bar azobash meafzoem
Va on chi [az amvolu farzandon], ki meguiad, az u ba irs mebarem va [ruzi k'iiomat tikh'idast va] tankh'o nazdi mo meoiad
Va [mushrikon] ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo ma'budone barguzidaand, to [iovaru] pushtibonashon boshad
Chunin nest; [balki on ma'budkh'o dar k'iiomat] ibodati ononro inkor khokh'and kard va dushmanashon khokh'and bud
]Ei paiombar] Oio nadidi, ki Mo shaiotinro bar kofiron firistodem, to ononro [bo vasvasakh'oi khud] takh'rik kunand [va az rokh'i Allokh' taolo bozdorand]?
Pas, dar borai [nobudii] onon shitob nakun. Ch'uz in nest, ki Mo [ruzkh'oi marg va faro rasidani azobro] ba dik'k'at baroiashon meshumorem
[Iod kun az] Ruze, ki parkh'ezkoronro [bo izzatu ekh'tirom] ba mekh'monii [Allokh'i] Rakh'mon gird meovarem
Va much'rimonro tashnakom ba suii ch'akh'annam meronem
Onon kh'argiz [tavoni] shafoat nadorand; magar kase, ki [bo imon va amali shoistaash] az [Allokh'i] Rakh'mon paimone girifta boshad
Va [mushrikon] guftand: <<[Allokh'i] Rakh'mon farzande [baroi khesh] barguzidaast>>
Ba rosti, [bo in iddao] chize bisior zisht [ba miion] ovarded!
Az in [sukhani kufromez] nazdik ast osmonkh'o az kh'am biposhad va zamin bishkofad va kukh'kh'o dar kh'am bishkanand va furu rezand
[Charo] Ki baroi [Allokh'i] Rakh'mon farzande iddao kardaand
Va kh'argiz sazovori [Allokh'i] Rakh'mon nest, ki farzande barguzinad
Dar osmonkh'o va zamin kh'ech' kase nest, magar on ki [dar ruzi k'iiomat khoksor va] bandavor nazdi Allokh'i Rakh'mon meoiad
Iak'inan, [Allokh' taolo kh'amai] ononro dar shumor ovarda va durust barshumurdaast
Va kh'amagiashon ruzi k'iiomat tankh'o [va tikh'idast] nazdi U kh'ozir meshavand
Kasone, ki imon ovardaand va korkh'oi shoista kardaand, iak'inan, [Allokh'i] Rakh'mon [dar dilkh'oi bandagonash] baroiashon mukh'abbate khokh'ad nikh'od
[Ei paiombar] Be tardid, Mo in [K'ur'on]-ro bar zaboni tu oson namudem, to parkh'ezkoronro bo on bashorat dikh'i va sitezagaron [-i sarsakht]-ro bim dikh'i
Va chi bisior naslkh'oi guzashtaro pesh az onon nobud kardem. Oio [vuch'udi] kh'ech' iak az ononro ekh'sos mekuni io kamtarin sadoe az onon meshunavi?
To, kh'o
[Ei paiombar, mo] K'ur'onro bar tu nozil nakardem, to dar ranch' biiafti
[Onro nafiristodem] Magar on ki pande boshad, baroi kh'ar ki [az azobi ilokh'i] metarsad
[In K'ur'on] Furufiristodae ast az ch'onibi on ki zaminu osmonkh'oi balandro ofaridaast
[Parvardigori] Rakh'mon [onguna ki shoistai U ast va biduni on ki mukh'toch' ba Arsh boshad] bar Arsh k'aror girift
On chi dar osmonkh'o va zamin va on chi miioni onkh'ost va on chi zeri khok [pinkh'on] ast, [kh'amagi] az oni Ust
Va agar sukhan oshkor bigui [io onro pinkh'on dori], iak'inan, U [rozi] nikh'on va [kh'atto] nikh'ontar [az on]-ro niz medonad
Allokh' taolo ast, ki kh'ech' ma'bude [bar kh'ak'] ch'uz U nest [va] nakutarin nomkh'o az oni Ust
[Ei paiombar] Oio khabari Muso ba tu rasidaast?
On gokh' ki otashero [az dur] didu ba khonavodaash guft: <<[Lakh'zae] Dirang kuned [ki] man otashe didaam. Shoiad shu'lae az on baroiaton biiovaram io kanori on otash rokh'namoe biiobam>>
Pas, chun nazdi on [otash] omad, nido doda shud, ki: <<Ei Muso
Ba rosti, man Parvardigorat kh'astam; pas, [baroi munoch'ot bo Parvardigor] kafshkh'oiatro darovar [ki] dar kh'ak'ik'at, tu dar sarzamini muk'addasi <<Tuvo>> kh'asti
Va man turo [ba paiombari] barguzidam; pas, ba on chi vakh'i meshavad, gush faro dor
Be tardid, manam <<Allokh' taolo>>, ki kh'ech' ma'bude [bar kh'ak'k'e] ch'uz man nest; pas, maro biparast va baroi iodi man namoz bar po dor
Iak'inan, k'iiomat omadani ast; [vale] mekhokh'am [vak'ti] onro pinkh'on doram, to ba kh'ar kase dar barobari [kor va] taloshe, ki mekunad, podosh doda shavad
Pas, mabodo kase, ki ba on imon nadorad va az kh'avaskh'oiash pairavi mekunad, turo az [nakukori va omodagi baroi] on bozdorad, ki kh'alok meshavi
Va, ei Muso, on chist ba [dasti] rostat?>>
U guft: <<In asoi man ast; bar on takia mekunam va bo on baroi gusfandonam [bargi darakhtonro] furu merezam va bo on korkh'oi digare [niz] doram [ki barovarda mekunam]
[Allokh' taolo] Farmud: <<Ei Muso, onro biiafkan>>
Pas, [Muso] onro [bar zamin] afkand va nogakh'on [tabdil ba] more shud, ki ba sur'at mekhazid
[Allokh' taolo] Farmud: <<Onro bigir va natars. Ba zudi onro ba shakli avvalash bozmegardonem
Va dastro dar bag'al kun, to biduni kh'ech' gazande [ba unvoni] mu'ch'izae digar safed [-u durakhshon] berun oiad
[Kh'adaf az iroai du mu'ch'iza in bud], ki barkhe az nishonakh'oi buzurgi kheshro nishonat dikh'em
[Inak] Ba suii Fir'avn birav [ki] be tardid, [kufr varzida va] sarkashi kardaast>>
[Muso] Guft: <<Parvardigoro, bar [kh'avsala va] shikeboiiam biiafzo
Va koramro baroiam oson gardon
Va girekh' az zabonam boz kun
To sukhanamro darioband
Va baroi man iovare az [afrodi] khonadonam k'aror bidekh'
Kh'orun-barodaramro
Pushtamro bo u ustuvor soz
Va uro dar kori [risolati] man sharik kun
Turo bisior ba poki bisitoem
va bisior iodat kunem
Be tardid, Tu ba [kh'oli] mo binoi>>
[Allokh' taolo] Farmud: <<Ei Muso, khostaat ba tu doda shud
Dar kh'ak'ik'at, mo [peshtar] iak bori digar [niz] bar tu minnat nikh'oda budem
On gokh' ki on chiro, ki [boiad dar borai kh'ifozat az tu] ilkh'om meshud, ba modarat ilkh'om kardem

Ki: <<uro dar sanduk'e bigzor va on [sanduk']-ro ba dario [rudi Nil] biiandoz, to dario uro ba sokh'il biiafkanad [va] dushmani Man va dushmani u onro [az ob] bigirad; va bar tu az ch'onibi khesh mukh're [dar dilkh'o] afkandam va [kh'imoiatat kardam] takh'ti nazar parvarish iobi

On gokh' ki khokh'arat [dar kanori rud kh'amrokh' bo sanduk'i tu] rokh' meraft va [ba kasone, ki turo az ob giriftand] guft: <<Mekhokh'ed shakhsero nishonaton dikh'am, ki sarparastii uro ba ukh'da bigirad?>> Pas, turo ba modarat bozgardonidem, to chashmash [ba didorat] ravshan gardad va andukh'gin naboshad; va [ba'dkh'o] tu shakhse [k'ibti]-ro kushti va Mo az andukh' [va much'ozoti k'atl] nach'otat dodem va turo borkh'o ozmudem. Pas [az on] chand sol baini mardumi Madian ba sar burdi; on gokh', ei Muso, bar [tibk'i] tak'diri [ilokh'i va dar zamoni muk'arrar ba in ch'o] omadi
Va turo baroi khudam barguzidam [to paiomamro ba mardum birasoni]
[Inak] Tu va barodarat bo nishonakh'oi [k'udratu iagonagii] Man ravona shaved va dar [da'vati kh'ak' va] iod kardani Man susti navarzed
Ba suii Fir'avn biraved, ki u [kufr varzida va] sarkashi kardaast
Pas, ba narmi bo u sukhan bigued; boshad, ki pand girad io [az azobi ilokh'i] bitarsad [va tavba kunad]
[Muso va Kh'orun] guftand: <<Parvardigoro, mo bimnokem, ki bar mo peshdasti namoiad [va pesh az poioni da'vat much'ozotamon kunad] io [dar barobari sukhani kh'ak'] sarkashi kunad>>
[Allokh' taolo] farmud: <<Natarsed [ki] iak'inan, Man kh'amrokh'aton kh'astam [va kh'ama chizro] meshunavam va mebinam

Pas, ba sui u biraved va bigued: <<Mo firistodagoni Parvardigorat kh'astem. Bani Isroilro kh'amrokh'i mo bifirist va [takh'k'iru] ozorashon nakun. Ba rosti, ki Mo baroi tu az ch'onibi Parvardigorat nishonakh'oi ravshane ovardaem; va salomati [az azobi ilokh'i] bar kasest, ki az kh'idoiat pairavi kunad
Dar kh'ak'ik'at, ba mo vakh'i shudaast, ki azobi [duzakh] bar kasest, ki [oiot va mu'ch'izotro] durug' angosht va [az da'vati paiombarash] rui gardond>>
[Fir'avn] Guft: <<Ei Muso, Parvardigori shumo kist?>>
[Muso] guft: <<Parvardigori mo kasest, ki ba kh'ar chize ofarinishi [zokh'ir va vizhagikh'oi munosibi] uro bakhshida va sipas [onro] kh'idoiat namudaast>>
[Fir'avn] Guft: <<Pas, kh'ol [va sarnavishti naslkh'oi guzashta [ki kofir budaand] chist?>>
[Muso] Guft: <<Donishi on dar kitobe [Lavkh'i Makh'fuz] nazdi Parvardigori man [sabt] ast. Parvardigoram na ishtibokh' mekunad va na faromush menamoiad

On [ma'bude], ki zaminro baroiaton [kh'amchun] gakh'vorae [makh'alli osoish] k'aror dod va dar on rokh'kh'oe ech'od kard va az osmon obe furu firistod va ba vasilai on anvoi gunoguni giiokh'onro [az zamin] berun ovardem
[Kh'am khud az on] Bikhured va [kh'am] chakh'orpoionatonro bicharoned. Be tardid, dar in [umur] baroi khiradmandon nishonakh'oe [az k'udrati ilokh'i] ast
Shumoro az on [khok] ofaridem va ba on bozmegardonem va bori digar [dar k'iiomat] az on berun meovarem
Va ba rosti, [Mo] kh'amai nishonakh'oi [k'udrati] khudro ba u nishon dodem; vale [kh'amaro] durug' pindosht va [da'vati kh'ak'ro] napaziruft
[On gokh'] Guft: <<Ei Muso, oio nazdi mo omadi, ki bo ch'oduiat moro az sarzaminamon berun kuni?

Pas, iak'inan, mo niz ch'odue monandi on baroiat meovarem; pas, dar makone, ki [fosilaash az kh'ar du taraf] iakson boshad, va'dagokh'e miioni Mo va khud ta'iin kun, ki na Mo az on khilof kunem va na tu
[Muso] guft: <<Va'dagokh'i shumo ruzi id boshad, ki [kh'amai] mardum pesh az zukh'r ch'am' meshavand>>
On gokh' Fir'avn bozgasht va [tamomi] nairangu kh'ilai kheshro ch'am' kard va [kh'amrokh'i ch'odugaronash ba makh'alli mavridi nazar] omad

Muso ba onon guft: <<Voi bar shumo! Bar Allokh' taolo durug' nabanded, ki bo azobe [sakht] nobudaton mesozad; va iak'inan, kh'ar ki [bo fireb dodani mardum bar Allokh' taolo] durug' bast, ziionkor gasht>>
Pas, [ch'odugaron pas az kh'ushdori Muso] dar korashon miioni khud ikhtilof kardand va pinkh'oni guftugu kardand
[Barkhe az onon] Guftand: <<In du [nafar] kh'atman, ch'odugarand [va] bo ch'odui khesh mekhokh'and shumoro az sarzaminaton berun kunand va oin [va rokh'u rasm]-i bartari shumoro az miion bardorand
Pas, [kh'amai] nairangi kheshro farokh'am kuned [va ba kor banded]; sipas dar iak saf [baroi muboriza] ba pesh oed. Be tardid, kh'ar ki imruz [bar dushman] chira shavad, piruz [va komiob] gashtaast
[Ch'odugaron] guftand: <<Ei Muso, oio tu [on chiro bo khud dori] meafkani io [mo] nakhustin kase boshem, ki meafkanad?>>
[Muso] Guft: <<[Na] balki shumo biiafkaned>>. Pas, nogokh' resmonkh'o va chubdastkh'oi onon az ch'oduiashon chunon ba nazarash rasid, ki gui ba shitob mekhazand
Pas, Muso dar dilash tarse ekh'sos kard
Guftem: <<Natars, [ki] tu, kh'atman, [piruz va] bartari

Va on chiro, ki dar dasti rosti khud dori, biiafkan, to [tamomi] on chiro, ki sokhtaand, bibal'ad. Be tardid, on chi onon sokhtaand, fak'at nairangi ch'odugar ast va ch'odugar kh'ar ch'o, ki boshad [va kh'ar chi kunad], piruz namegardad>>

[Pas, chun Muso asoiashro bar zamin andokht, ba mori buzurge tabdil shud va sokhtakh'oi ononro bal'id], on gokh' ch'odugaron ba sach'da aftodand [va] guftand: <<Ba Parvardigori Kh'orun va Muso imon ovardem>>

[Fir'avn] Guft: <<Oio pesh az on ki ba shumo ich'ozat dikh'am ba u imon ovarded? Kh'atman, u buzurgi shumost, ki ba shumo ch'odugari omukhtaast. Pas, kh'atman, dastu poii shumoro bar aksi iakdigar [az chapu rost] k'at' mekunam va kh'amagiatonro dar tanakh'oi nakhl ba dor meovezam va on gokh' khub khokh'ed donist, ki azob [va shikanch'ai] kadom iaki az mo sakhttar va poiandatar ast; [man io Parvardigori Muso]>>

[Ch'odugaron] Guftand: <<Kh'argiz [pairavi az] turo bar in daloili ravshane, ki baroiamon omadaast va [kh'amchunin] bar on ki moro ofaridaast, tarch'ekh' namedikh'em; pas, ba kh'ar kh'ukme, ki mekhokh'i, kh'ukm kun. Tu fak'at metavoni dar zindagii in dunio kh'ukm kuni
Be tardid, mo ba Parvardigoramon imon ovardem, to gunokh'onamon va on chiro az ch'odugari bar mo takh'mil kardai, bibakhshoiad; va Allokh' taolo bekh'taru poiandatar ast>>
Kh'ar ki dar peshgokh'i Parvardigorash gunakh'kor kh'ozir shavad, iak'inan, otashi duzakh baroi ust; dar on ch'o na memirad [ ki rakh'oi iobad] va na [ba khushi] zindagi mekunad
Va kh'ar ki mu'min nazdi u biioiad, dar kh'ole ki korkh'oi shoista anch'om doda boshad, pas, inon darach'oti oli dorand
Bog'kh'oi ch'ovidoni [bikh'isht], ki ch'uiborkh'o zeri [darakhtoni] on ch'ori ast. Kh'amesha dar on khokh'and bud; va in ast podoshi kase, ki khudro [az oludagikh'oi shirku gunokh'] pok kardaast

Va ba rosti, [Mo] ba Muso vakh'i kardem, ki: <<Bandagonamro shabona [az Misr berun] bibar, sipas baroi onon dar dario rokh'e khushk biksho, ki na az ta'k'ib [-i dushmanon] khokh'i tarsid va na [az g'ark' shudan dar dario] bim dori
On gokh' Fir'avn bo sipokh'iionash ononro dunbol kard va obi dario eshonro furu pushonid; chunon pushonidane [ki kh'ak'ik'atashro kase ch'uz Allokh' taolo namedonad]
Va [bad-in son Fir'avn k'avmi khudro gumrokh' namud va kh'idoiat nakard

Ei Bani Isroil, ba rosti, [Mo] shumoro az [changi] dushmanonaton nach'ot dodem va dar samti rosti [kukh'i] Tur bo shumo va'da guzoshtem [to Tavrotro nozil kunem] va bar shumo mann [shirini] va salvo [bedona] furu firistodem
Az ne'matkh'oi pokizae, ki ba shumo ruzi dodaem, bikhured va dar on ziiodaravi nakuned, ki khashmi Man bar shumo furud meoiad; va kh'ar ki khashmi man bar u furud oiad, kh'atman, kh'alok megardad
Va iak'inan, man omurzandai kase kh'astam, ki tavba kunad va imon ovarad va kore shoista kunad va on gokh' bar kh'idoiat [-i khud bok'i] bimonad
Ei Muso, chi chiz much'ib shud, ki ch'ilavtar az k'avmat [ba suii va'dagokh'i Tur] bishitobi?
[Muso] Guft: <<Parvardigoro, onon ba dunbolam meoiand va man ba suiat shitoftam, to [az man] khushnud gardi>>
[Allokh' taolo] Farmud: <<Pas, [bidon, ki] Mo k'avmatro pas az [raftani] tu ozmudem va Somiri gumrokh'ashon kard>>

Pas, Muso khashmgin [va] andukh'nok ba suii k'avmash bozgasht [va] guft: <<Ei k'avmi man, magar Parvardigoraton [dar borai nuzuli Tavrot] va'dai naku ba shumo nadoda bud? Oio bar paimoni shumo [bo Allokh' taolo] zamone tuloni guzasht [va kh'amaro az iod burded] io khosted, khashme az [sui] Parvardigoraton bar shumo furud oiad, ki va'dai maro khilof karded?>>

Onon guftand: <<[Mo] Ba ikhtiiori khud paimoni turo nashikastem, vale borkh'oi sangine az zaru zevarkh'oi k'avm [-i Fir'avn]-ro, ki bar mo nikh'oda budand, [dar otash] andokhtem va Somiri niz [on chiro, ki iddao mekard, khoki sumi asbi Ch'abrail ast, dar otash] andokht>>

On gokh' baroiashon much'assamai gusolae sokht, ki sadoe [kh'amchun sadoi gusola] dosht. Pas, [Somiri va pairavonash ba mardum] guftand: <<In ma'budi shumo va ma'budi Muso ast, ki onro faromush [va in ch'o rakh'o] kardaast>>
Oio namedidand, ki [in gusola] kh'ech' posukhe ba onkh'o namedikh'ad va kh'ech' ziione va sude baroiashon nadorad?

Va dar kh'ak'ik'at, pesh az on [ki Muso bozgardad] Kh'orun niz ba onkh'o gufta bud: <<Ei k'avmi man, ch'uz in nest, ki shumo bo in gusola imtikh'on shudaed va be tardid, Parvardigori [kh'ak'ik'ii] shumo [Allokh'i] Rakh'mon ast; pas, pairavi man boshed va az farmonam itoat kuned>>
[Onon] Guftand: <<Mo paivasta bar in [gusolaparasti] memonem, to Muso nazdamon bozgardad>>
[Vak'te Muso bozomad] Guft: <<Ei Kh'orun, kh'angome ki didi onon gumrokh' shudaand,
chi chize turo az pairavii man bozdosht [va charo ononro tark nakardi]? Oio az farmonam sarpechi kardi?>>
[Kh'orun] Guft: <<Ei pisari modaram, rishu [muii] saramro nagir. Dar kh'ak'ik'at, tarsidam, ki bigui, miioni Bani Isroil tafrik'a andokhti va sukhan [va suporish]-i maro ba kor nabasti>>
[Muso] Guft: <<Ei Somiri, in chi kore ast, ki kardi?>>

U guft: <<Man chizero didam, ki onon nadidand va mushte az khoki poii [asbi] firistoda [Ch'abrail]-ro bardoshtam va [dar paikari gusola] andokhtam va [kh'avoi] nafsam [in korro] inchunin baroiam orost>>

[Muso] Guft: <<Pas, birav. Be tardid, bakh'rai tu dar zindagi in ast, ki [chunon matrud shavi, ki ba mardum] bigui: <<[Ba man] Dast nazaned>>; va va'dagokh'e [baroi azob] khokh'i dosht, ki kh'argiz az on takhalluf nakhokh'ad shud; va [aknun] ba on ma'bude, ki paivasta dar ibodatash budi, bingar; onro mesuzonem, on gokh' [ki komilan khokistar shud,] dar dario parokandaash mesozem>>
[Ei mardum] Ma'budi shumo Allokh' taolo ast, ki kh'ech' ma'bude [bar kh'ak'] ch'uz U nest va ilmash kh'ama chizro faro giriftaast
[Ei Paiombar] In guna az akhbor [va dostonkh'oi paiombaroni] guzashta bar tu kh'ikoiat mekunem; va ba rosti, ki [mo] az ch'onibi khesh ba tu K'ur'one [pandomuz] dodaem
Kh'ar ki az on ruigardon shavad, iak'inan, ruzi k'iiomat bori sangine [az gunokh'] bar dush khokh'ad kashid
Ch'ovidona dar on [azob] khokh'and mond; va chi bad ast bore, ki [kofiron] dar k'iiomat khokh'and kashid!
Ruze, ki dar <<sur>> damida meshavad va dar on ruz much'rimonro [ki bisior tarsidaand, bo chashmu badani] kabud ch'am' mekunem
Baini khud okh'ista sukhan meguiand: <<[Shumo] Besh az dakh' ruz [dar dunio] ba sar naburdaed>>
Mo ba on chi eshon meguiand, donotarem; on gokh' ki khiradmandtarinashon meguiad: <<[Shumo] Tankh'o iak ruz ba sar burdaed>>
Va [ei paiombar] az tu dar borai kukh'kh'o [dar k'iiomat] mepursand; pas, bigu: <<Parvardigoram ononro sakht mutaloshi [va parokanda] mekunad
Va onkh'oro sofu kh'amvor khokh'ad namud
[Kh'amchun zamine] Ki dar on kh'ech' pasti va balandi namebini>>

Dar on ruz [kh'amai mardum] biduni kh'ech' mukholifate az da'vatkunanda [-i ilokh'i] pairavi mekunand va sadokh'o dar barobari Khudoi mekh'rubon past meshavand va az kh'ech' chiz ch'uz sadoi poie nakhokh'i shunid
Dar on ruz shafoat sud nadikh'ad, magar onro, ki Khudoi Rakh'mon ba u ich'ozat dikh'ad va sukhanashro bipisandad
[Allokh' taolo] On chiro, ki insonkh'o [dar okhirat] dar pesh dorand va on chiro, ki [dar dunio] pushti sar guzoshtaand, [kh'amaro] medonad, vale donishi onon uro faro namegirad
Va chekh'rakh'o dar barobari [Parvardigori] zindai poidor khor megardad va kh'ar ki [bori] sitam bardosht, ziion did
Va kase, ki az korkh'oi shoista anch'om dikh'ad va mu'min boshad, na az kh'ech' sitame mekh'arosad va na az kostan [-i podoshash]
Va, inchunin, onro K'ur'one [ba zaboni] arabi nozil kardem va kh'ushdorkh'oi gunogun dar on baion namudem; boshad, ki [az azobi ilokh'i] parkh'ezand io [in kitob] baroiashon pande padid ovarad

Pas, balandmartaba ast Allokh' taolo, ki farmonravoi kh'ak' ast. Va dar [khondani] K'ur'on - pesh az on ki vakh'ii on bar tu poion iobad - shitob makun; va bigu: <<Parvardigoro, bar donisham biiafzo>>
Ba rosti, pesh az in bo Odam paimon bastem [ki az mevai darakhti mamnua nakhurad]; vale [paimonashro] faromush kard va dar u azme [ustuvor] naioftem
Va [iod kun az kh'angome ki ba farishtagon guftem: <<Baroi Odam sach'da kuned>>; pas, [kh'amagi] sach'da kardand, magar Iblis, ki sarpechi namud
Pas, guftem: <<Ei Odam, in [Iblis] dushmani tu va kh'amsari tust; mabodo shumoro az bikh'isht berun kunad, ki ba sakhti meafti
Dar kh'ak'ik'at, tu in [ne'mat]-ro [dar bikh'isht] dori, ki na gurusna meshavi va na barakh'na memoni
Va in ki dar on ch'o na tashna meshavi va na oftobzada
Pas, shaiton uro vasvasa kard [va] guft: <<Ei Odam, oio [mekhokh'i] darakhti ch'ovidonagi va farmonravoii fanonopazirro nishonat dikh'am?>>

On gokh' az on [darakhti mamnua] khurdand va sharmgokh'ashon bar onon namoion shud va shuru' kardand ba k'aror dodani bargi [darakhtoni] bikh'isht bar khud [to avratashonro bipushonand]; va [inchunin bud, ki] Odam az Parvardigorash sarpechi kard va ba berokh'i raft
Sipas Parvardigorash uro barguzid va tavbaashro paziruft va kh'idoiatash kard

Farmud: <<[Shumo du tan khamrokh'i Iblis] Kh'amagi az bikh'isht furud oed, dar kh'ole ki dushmani iakdigared. Agar az [ch'onibi] man rakh'namude baroiaton rasid, [bidoned] kh'ar ki az kh'idoiatam pairavi kunad, na gumrokh' meshavad va na [az azobi duzakh] ba ranch' meaftad
Va kase, ki az iodi Man ruigardon shavad, iak'inan zindagii sakhte khokh'ad dosht va ruzi k'iiomat uro nobino barmeangezem
Vai meguiad: <<Parvardigoro, charo maro nobino barangekhti; kh'ol on ki [dar dunio] bino budam?>>
[Allokh' taolo] Mefarmoiad: <<Kh'amon tavr, ki oioti Mo bar tu omad va onkh'oro ba faromushi supurdi, imruz tu [niz] ba kh'amon surat faromush meshavi>>
Va kasero, ki [dar gumrokh'i va gunokh'] ziiodaravi kunad va ba oioti Parvardigorash imon naovarad, in guna kaifar medikh'em; va kh'atman, azobi okhirat shadidtar va poidortar ast

Oio baroi kh'idoiatashon kofi nest, ki [bidonand] chi naslkh'oero pesh az onon nobud kardem, ki [aknun in mushrikon] dar khonakh'oi eshon [naslkh'oi guzashta] rokh' meravand? Ba rosti, dar in [nukta] baroi khiradmandon nishonakh'oe [ibratangez] ast
Va agar az suii Parvardigorat sukhane [dar borai itmomi kh'uch'ch'at bo mardum] naguzashta bud va zamoni muaiiane dar kor nabud, kh'atman [azobi ilokh'i dar kh'amin dunio bar onon] lozim meshud

Pas [ei Paiombar,] bar on chi meguiand, shikebo bosh va Parvardigoratro pesh az tului oftob [dar namozi bomdod] va pesh az g'urub [dar namozi asr] ba poki sitoish kun va soate az shab [dar namozi khuftan] va kanorakh'oi ruz [dar namozi peshin va shom niz ba niioish bipardoz]; boshad, ki [az podoshi ilokh'i] khushnud shavi

Va kh'argiz ba [ne'matkh'oi duniavi va] on chi ki gurukh'kh'oe az onon [mushrikon]-ro az onkh'o bakh'ramand sokhtaem, chashm naduz. Inkh'o zinati zindagii duniost, to ononro bad-on biozmoiad; va ruzii Parvardigorat bekh'tar va poidortar ast
Va khonavodaatro ba namoz farmon bidekh' va [khud] bar [anch'omi] on shikebo bosh [Mo] Az tu ruzi namekhokh'em, [balki] khud ba tu ruzi medikh'em; va saranch'omi nek baroi [akh'li] parkh'ez ast

[Mushrikon] guftand: <<Charo [Mukh'ammad] mu'ch'izae az ch'onibi Parvardigorash baroi mo nameovarad?>> Bigu: <<Oio [K'ur'on ba unvoni] daleli ravshan on chi dar kitobkh'oi peshin ast, baroiashon naiomadaast?>>

Agar Mo ononro pesh az on [ki paiombar va kitobi osmoni biioiad] bo azobe kh'alok mekardem, kh'atman, [ruzi k'iiomat mushrikon] meguftand: <<Parvardigoro, charo paiombare ba suiamon nafiristodi, to pesh az on ki khoru rasvo shavem, az oioti Tu pairavi kunem?>>
[Ei Paiombar, ba onon] Bigu: <<Kh'ama muntazirand; pas, shumo [niz] muntazir boshed. Ba zudi khokh'ed donist, ki rakh'ravoni rokh'i rost chi kasone kh'astand va kh'idoiatiofta kist>>
Zamoni kh'isobi mardum nazdik shudaast va onon dar noogokh'i [az bozkhosti okhirat] rui gardonand
Kh'ech' pandi tozae az Parvardigorashon baroi onon nameoiad, magar on ki bozikunon ba on gush medikh'and

[Paiomi ilokh'iro dar kh'ole meshunavand, ki] dilkh'oiashon g'ofil ast va kasone, ki [kofir va] sitamgor budand, nach'vokh'oiashonro pinkh'on kardand [va guftand]: <<Oio in [muddaii paiombari] ch'uz bashare kh'amchun shumost? Oio dar kh'ole ki [kh'ak'ik'atro] mebined, ba ch'odu rui meovared?>>
[Paiombar] guft: <<Parvardigoram kh'ar sukhanero, ki dar osmon va zamin boshad medonad va U shunavovu donost>>

Balki [kofiron dar sitez bo K'ur'on] guftand: <<[On chi Mukh'ammad meguiad] khobkh'oe oshufta ast, balki onro ba durug' [ba Allokh' taolo] nisbat medikh'ad. [Na] Balki u shoir ast. Pas, [agar rost meguiad] baroiamon mu'ch'izae biiovarad, chunon ki paiombaroni peshin [niz bo mu'ch'izot] firistoda shudand>>
Pesh az onon [niz sokinoni kh'ar] shakh're, ki nobudash mekardem, [ba oiot va mu'ch'izoti Mo] imon naovarda budand. Pas, oio [inkh'o] imon meovarand?
Va [ei paiombar] pesh az tu ch'uz mardone, ki ba onon vakh'i mekardem [baroi kh'idoiati mardum] nafiristodem, pas, [ei kofiron] agar namedoned, az akh'li kitob bipursed
Va [mo] ononro paikarkh'oe, ki g'izo nakhurand, k'aror nadodem va [dar dunio niz] ch'ovidon nabudand
Sipas va'daero, ki [dar borai piruzi va nach'ot] ba onon doda budem, takh'ak'k'uk' bakhshidem va ononro ba kh'amrokh'i kh'ar ki khostem, nach'ot dodem va isrofkoron [-i kofir]-ro nobud kardem
Be tardid, kitobe ba suiaton nozil kardem, ki izzat [-u sharafi dunio va okhirat]-i shumo dar on ast. Oio nameandeshed?
Chi bisior shakh'rkh'oero, ki [sokinonash] sitamgor budand, dar kh'am shikastem va pas az onon gurukh'e digar padid ovardem
Pas, chun azobi Moro ekh'sos mekardand [va ba chashm medidand], nogokh' az on ch'o megurekhtand
[Ba tamaskhur guftem] <<Firor nakuned. Ba suii khonakh'oiaton va ne'matkh'oe, ki dar on osuda buded, bozgarded. Boshad, ki [fak'at dar borai umuri duniavi] bozkhost shaved>>
guftand: <<Voi bar mo [, ki] kh'atman sitamgor budaem!>>
Pas, guftorashon paivasta kh'amin bud, to on ki ononro [chun giiokh'e] daravshuda [va] bech'on sokhtem
Va Mo osmonu zamin va on chiro, ki miioni onkh'ost ba bozicha naiofaridaem
Agar [ba farz] mekhostem, ki sargarmie [monandi farzand io kh'amsukh'bat baroi khud] barguzinem, onro [na az butkh'oi shumo, balki] az nazdi khesh barmeguzidem
Balki Mo kh'ak'ro bar botil meafkanem, pas, onro dar kh'am meshikanad va nogokh' on [botil] nobud meshavad va [ei kofiron] voi bar shumo az on chi tavsif mekuned!
Kh'ar ki [va kh'ar chi] dar osmonkh'o va zamin ast az oni Ust va onon, ki nazdi U kh'astand [farishtagon] az ibodatash sarkashi namekunand va khasta nameshavand
Onon shabu ruz [ilokh'ro] ba poki mesitoiand va susti namevarzand
Oio [in mushrikon] ma'budone az zamin barguzidaand, ki [murdagonro] zinda mekunand?

Agar dar osmon va zamin ma'budone ba ch'uz Allokh' taolo vuch'ud dosht, [dar asari nosozgorii onkh'o] kh'atman, kh'ar du tabokh' meshudand. Pas, Allokh' taolo - Parvardigori Arsh - az tavsife, ki [mushrikon] mekunand, poku munazzakh' ast
U ba khotiri on chi mekunad, bozkhost nameshavad, vale onon [dar barobari raftorashon] mas'uland

Oio [mushrikon] ba ch'uz U ma'budone barguzidaand? [Ba onon] Bigu: <<Dalelatonro biiovared. In [K'ur'on] kitobest, ki kh'amrokh'i man ast va [inkh'o niz] kitobkh'oest [mutaallik' ba paiombarone], ki pesh az man budand [va dar kh'ech' kadom dalele bar kh'ak'k'oniiati shumo vuch'ud nadorad]>>, balki beshtarashon kh'ak'ro namedonand va [az on] ruigardonand
Va Mo pesh az tu kh'ech' paiombarero nafiristodem, magar on ki ba u vakh'i kardem, ki [ba mardum biguiad]: <<Ma'bude [ba kh'ak'] ch'uz Man nest, pas, tankh'o Maro biparasted>>

[Mushrikon bo in tasavvur, ki farishtagon dukhtaroni Allokh' taolo kh'astand] guftand: <<[Allokh'i] Rakh'mon farzande [baroi khesh] barguzidaast>>. U munazzakh' ast [chunin nest, ki mepindorand], balki farishtagon bandagoni giromiash kh'astand
Onon kh'argiz dar sukhan bar U peshi nameguzinad va [paivasta] ba farmonash amal mekunand
[Allokh' taolo] Guzashta va oiandai ononro medonad va eshon ch'uz baroi kase, ki U pisandad, shafoat namekunand va khud az bimi U kh'arosonand
Va kh'ar kase az onon biguiad: <<Ba ch'uz u man [niz] ma'bud kh'astam>>, pas, vairo ba duzakh kaifar medikh'em. [Ore] Sitamgoronro chunin kaifar medikh'em

Oio kasone, ki kufr varzidand, nadidand, ki [darkh'oi ne'mati] osmonkh'o va zamin basta bud [na borone meborid va na giiokh'e meruid], pas, on duro boz kardem va kh'ar chizi zindaero az ob padid ovardem? Pas, oio imon nameovarand?
Va dar zamin kukh'kh'oe ustuvor nikh'odem, to mabodo ononro bilarzonad va dar on rokh'kh'oe [vase'] padid ovardem, boshad, ki [dar safarkh'oiashon ba mak'sad] rokh' ioband
Va osmonro sak'fe makh'fuz k'aror dodem va onon [mushrikon] az [tafakkur dar] nishonakh'oiash ruigardonand
Ust, ki shabu ruz va khurshedu mokh'ro ofarid [va chunon munazzam sokht, ki] kh'ar iak [az inkh'o] dar madore [muaiian] shinovarand
[Ei paiombar] Mo pesh az tu baroi kh'ech' bashare ch'ovidonagi k'aror nadodem. Oio agar tu bimiri, onon ch'ovidonand?
Kh'ar kase chashandai [ta'mi] marg ast va [ei mardum] shumoro bo badi va neki meozmoem va [saranch'om] ba suii Mo bozgardanda meshaved

Kasone, ki kufr varzidand, kh'ar gokh' ki turo mebinand, fak'at ba maskharaat megirand [va meguiand]: <<Oio in kh'amon kasest, ki az ma'budonaton [ba badi] iod mekunad>>? Va kh'ol on ki onon khud iodi [Allokh'i] Rakh'monro inkor mekunand

Inson [zotan] shitobkor ofarida shudaast [va kh'ama chizro pesh az zamoni muk'arrarash mekhokh'ad]. Ba zudi nishonakh'o [-i azob]-i kheshro nishonaton khokh'em dod, pas, [nuzuli azobro] ba shitob nakhokh'ed
[Kofiron] meguiand: <<Agar rostgued, in va'da [k'iiomat] kai khokh'ad bud?>>

Kasone, ki kufr varzidand, agar medonistand zamone, ki [ba duzakh meaftand] nametavonand [shu'lakh'oi] otashro az chekh'rakh'o va pushtkh'oiashon bozdorand va [az suii kh'ech' kas] iori nameshavand [kh'argiz in guna shitobon azobro namekhostand]
Balki [otash chunon] nogakh'oni ba onon merasad va eshonro [chunon sargashta va] mabkh'ut mekunad, ki na metavonand onro [az khud] daf' kunand va na mukh'lati [tavba] ba onon doda meshavad

Iak'inan, paiombaron pesh az tu [niz] mavridi tamaskhur k'aror girifta budand, pas, bar sari kasone, ki onkh'o [azobkh'oi ilokh'i]-ro ba rishkhand megiriftand, kh'amon chize omad, ki maskharaash mekardand
[Ei paiombar, ba kofiron] Bigu: <<Chi kase shumoro dar shabu ruz az [azobi Allokh'i] Rakh'mon nigokh' medorad? Balki [kh'ak' in ast, ki] onon az iodi Parvardigorashon ruigardonand
Oio onon ma'budone dorand, ki [metavonand] dar barobari Mo az eshon difo' kunand? [Kh'argiz!] Onon na metavonand khudro iori dikh'and va na az [azobi] Mo dar amonand

Balki [Mo] onon va padaronashonro [az ne'matkh'oi duniavi] bakh'ramand sokhtem, to umrashon ba darozo kashid [va mag'rur shudand]. Oio namebinand, ki Mo [kh'amvora] ba surog'i zamin meoem va onro az kh'ar taraf mekokh'em [va mardumashro nobud mekunem]? Pas, oio onon [bar k'udrati Allokh' taolo] piruzand?
Bigu: "Man fak'at shumoro ba vasilai vakh'i [az azobi ilokh'i] bim medikh'am" va [-le] chun ba karon bim doda shavad, da'vati [kh'ak']-ro nameshunavand
Agar andake az azobi Parvardigorat ba onon birasad, kh'atman, meguiand: "Ei voi bar mo [ki], iak'inan, sitamgor budaem!"

Ruzi k'iiomat Mo tarozukh'oi adlro [baroi kh'isobrasi dar miion] menikh'em, pas, ba kh'ech' kas [kamtarin] sitame nameshavad va agar [kirdorashon] kh'amsangi donai khardale boshad, onro [ba kh'isob] meovarem va kofist, ki Mo kh'isobras boshem
Ba rosti, Mo ba Muso va Kh'orun kitob [Tavrot] dodem va [in kitob] baroi parkh'ezkoron ravshani va andarze ast
[Kh'amon] kasone, ki dar nikh'on az Parvardigorashon metarsand va az k'iiomat bimnokand
Va in [K'ur'on] pandi muborake ast, ki onro nozil kardem. Oio [boz kh'am] inkorash mekuned?
Va be tardid, pesh az on Mo ba Ibrokh'im [rushdi fikri va] kh'idoiatashro ato kardem va ba [shoistagikh'oi] u dono budem;
On gokh' ki ba padari khud va k'avmash guft: "In much'assamakh'o chist, ki ba parastishi onkh'o istodaed?"
Onon guftand: "Mo padaronamonro didem, ki onkh'oro meparastidand"
[Ibrokh'im] Guft: "Kh'atman, shumo va padaronaton dar gumrokh'ii oshkor budaed"
Onon guftand: "Oio [sukhani] kh'ak' baroiamon ovardai io shukhi mekuni?"
U guft: "Balki [sukhanam kh'ak' ast] Parvardigoraton parvardigori osmonkh'o va zamin ast, kh'amon ki onkh'oro padid ovardaast va man bar in [sukhan] guvokh'am"
Va [bo khud guft] "Ba Allokh' taolo savgand, pas az on ki pusht karded va [ba ch'ashn] rafted, baroi [nobudii] butkh'oiaton tadbire meandesham"
Pas [dar g'iiobi butparaston] kh'amai onkh'oro ba ch'uz [buti] buzurgashon bishkast, shoiad, ba surog'i on biravand [to kh'ak'oik'ro baroiashon bozgu kunad]
[Vak'te onon butkhonaro chunin didand] Guftand: "Chi kase bo ma'budoni mo chunin kardaast? Kh'atman, u sitamgor ast"
[Barkhe] Guftand: "Mo shunidem ch'avone, ki uro Ibrokh'im meguiand, az onkh'o [ba badi] iod mekunad"
Guftand: "Pas uro dar barobari didagoni mardum biiovared, boshad, ki [bar e'tirofash ba gunokh'] guvokh' boshand"
[Vak'te Ibrokh'imro ovardand] Guftand: "Ei Ibrokh'im, oio tu in [kor] -ro bo ma'budoni mo kardai?"
U guft: "Balki [buti] buzurgashon chunin kardaast. Agar sukhan meguiand, az onkh'o bipursed>>
On gokh' [onon] ba khud omadand va [ba iakdigar] guftand: "Vok'ean, shumo [mushriku] sitamgored"
Sipas [boz kh'am] sar ba dushmani va inkor bardoshtand [va guftand] "Tu khub medoni, ki inkh'o sukhan nameguiand"
[Ibrokh'im] guft: "Oio ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo chizkh'oero meparasted, ki na sude baroiaton dorad va na ziione ba shumo merasonad?
Voi bar shumo va bar on chi ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo meparasted! Oio nameandeshed?"
Onon guftand: "Agar mekhokh'ed [baroi much'ozotash] kore kuned, uro bisuzoned va ma'budonatonro iori dikh'ed"
[Saranch'om uro dar otash andokhtand, vale Mo] Guftem: "Ei otash, bar Ibrokh'im sard va salomat bosh"
Va khostand baroi [nobudii u nairange ba kor barand, vale Mo ononro ziionkortarin [mardum] sokhtem
Va u va Lutro [bo kh'ich'rat] ba sarzamine, ki baroi ch'akh'oniion dar on barakat nikh'odaem [Shom], nach'ot dodem
Va Iskh'ok' va [navaash] Ia'k'ubro [niz ba unvoni bakhshish] afzuni ba u bakhshidem va kh'amagiashonro [afrode] shoista gardonidem

Va ononro peshvoione k'aror dodem, ki ba farmoni Mo [mardumro] kh'idoiat mekardand va anch'omi korkh'oi nek va barpo doshtani namoz va adoi zakotro ba eshon vakh'i kardem va onon [kh'ama] parastishgari Mo budand

Mo ba Lut [ich'ozati] k'azovat va ilm [-i din] dodem va uro az shakh're, ki [sokinonash] a'moli zisht [-u palid] anch'om medodand, nach'ot bakhshidem. Ba rosti, ki onon gurukh'e palid va nofarmon budand
Va uro dar rakh'mati khud vorid kardem. Be gumon, u az shoistagon bud
Va Nukh'ro [iod kun] kh'angome ki peshtar [az soiri paiombaron moro] nido dod. Pas, Mo [niz duoi] vairo ich'obat kardem, on gokh' u va khonadonashro az andukh'i buzurg nach'ot dodem
Va dar barobari k'avme, ki oioti Moro durug' angoshta budand, ioriash kardem. Be tardid, onon gurukh'i badkirdore budand, pas, kh'amagiashonro g'ark' kardem
Va [iod kun az] Dovud va Sulaimon on gokh' ki dar borai kishtzore dovari mekardand, ki gusfandoni k'avm shabona dar on charida budand va Mo bar dovarii onon guvokh' budem

Pas, on [kh'ak'ik'at]-ro ba Sulaimon fakh'monidem va ba kh'ar iak az onon paiombari va donish [-i amal ba akh'komi din] ato kardem va kukh'kh'o va parandagon dar khidmati Dovud gumoshtem, ki [kh'amrokh' bo u Parvardigorro] tasbekh' meguftand va Mo budem, ki in [kh'ama]-ro anch'om dodem
Va ba u sokhtani zirekh'ro omukhtem, to shumoro az [osebi] ch'angkh'oiaton kh'ifz kunad. Pas, oio shukr meguzored?
Va tundbodro baroi Sulaimon [ba khidmat gumoshtem], ki ba farmoni u ba suii sarzamine, ki dar on barakat nikh'oda budem [Shom], ravon bud va mo bar kh'ar chiz dono budem
Va [niz] az shaiotin kasonero [gumoshtem], ki baroiash g'avvosi mekardand [va ch'avokh'ir meovardand] va korkh'oe g'air az in [niz] anch'om medodand va mo murok'ibi [raftor va te'dodi] onon budem
Va Aiubro [iod kun] on gokh' ki Parvardigorashro [chunin nido dod: "Ranch' [-u bemori] ba man rasidaast va Tu mekh'rubontarini mekh'rubononi"

Pas, Mo [duoi] uro ich'obat kardem va ranch'ero, ki ba u rasida bud, bartaraf sokhtem va khonavodaash va [niz te'dode] kh'ammonandashonro ba kh'amrokh'i onon ba vai bozgardonidem, [to] rakh'mate az ch'onibi Mo va pande baroi parastishgaron boshad
Va [iod kun az] Ismoil va Idris va Zu-l-kifl, ki kh'amagi az shikeboion budand
Va [Mo] ononro dar rakh'mati khesh vorid kardem. Be tardid, onon az shoistagon budand

Va [iod kun az] Zu-n-nun [Iunus] on gokh' ki khashmgin [az miioni k'avmash] raft va chunin pindosht, ki Mo kh'argiz bar u tang namegirem [va ba khotiri in kor much'ozotash namekunem]. Pas, [vak'te mokh'i uro furu burd] dar torikikh'o nido dod, ki: "[Parvardigoro] Kh'ech' ma'bude [ba kh'ak'] ch'uz tu nest. Tu munazzakh'i. Be tardid, man az sitamgoron budaam"
Pas duoiashro ich'obat kardem va az andukh' nach'otash dodem va mu'minonro [niz] in chunin nach'ot medikh'em
Va [iod kun az] Zakariio, on gokh' ki Parvardigorashro [in guna] nido dod: "Parvardigoro, maro tankh'o [va befarzand] magzor va tu bekh'tarin bozmondai [vorisoni]"

Pas, duoiashro ich'obat kardem va Iakh'ioro ba u bakhshidem va kh'amsarashro [ki nozo bud] baroiash shoista [va omodai bordori] namudem. Onon kh'amvora dar korkh'oi khair meshitoftand va dar kh'oli bimu umed Moro mekhondand va paivasta baroi Mo [farmonbardor va] furutan budand
Va [iod kun az Mariam] zane, ki domani khudro pok nigokh' dosht va [Mo] az rukh'i khesh dar [vuch'udi] u damidem va u va pisarashro baroi ch'akh'oniion nishonae [az k'udrati ilokh'i] k'aror dodem
[Ei mardum] Ba rosti, in oini shumo oini iagona [va asosiofta bar iaktoparasti] ast va Man Parvardigoraton kh'astam, pas, Maro biparasted
Va [mardum] miioni khud dar amri [din]-ashon firk'a-firk'a shudand; [vale saranch'om] kh'amagi ba sui Mo bozmegardand
Pas, kh'ar ki korkh'oi shoista anch'om dikh'ad va mu'min boshad, dar barobari kushishi u nosiposi nakhokh'ad shud va Mo korkh'oiashro menavisem
Va [mardumi] kh'ar shakh'rero, ki [bar asari kufru gunokh'] nobudash kardem, makh'ol ast, ki [bitavonand ba k'asdi tavba ba dunio] bozgardand
To zamone, ki [saddi] Ia'ch'uch'u Ma'ch'uch' kushoda shavad va onon az kh'ar balandi [va tepae] shitobon sarozer gardand

Va va'dai kh'ak' [k'iiomat] nazdik gardad. Pas, dar on kh'angom chashmkh'oi kasone, ki kufr varzidand, [az shiddati vakh'shat] khira memonad [va meguiand]: "Ei voi bar mo! Kh'atman, mo az in [kh'odisa] dar g'aflat budem! Balki [kofiru] sitamgor budem"
[Ba onon gufta meshavad] "Kh'atman, shumo va on chi ki ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo meparasted, kh'ezumi duzakhed, [va kh'amagi] dar on vorid khokh'ed shud"
Agar in butkh'o ma'budone [ba kh'ak'] budand, kh'argiz voridi on nameshudand va kh'ol on ki kh'amagi dar on [azobi suzon] ch'ovidonand
Dar on ch'o nolakh'oe [dardnok] dorand va [az shiddati dardu tars] chize nameshunavand
Kasone, ki peshtar az ch'onibi Mo ba eshon va'dai naku [bikh'isht] doda shudaast, iak'inan, az on [azob] dur nigakh' doshta meshavand
Onon sadoi on [otashi kh'avlnok va fariodkh'oi duzakhiion]-ro nameshunavand va dar on chi mail doshta boshand, ch'ovidona [dar osoish] kh'astand
Vakh'shati buzurgi [k'iiomat] andukh'ginashon namesozad va farishtagon ba istik'bolashon meoiand [va meguiand]: <<In kh'amon ruzest, ki ba shumo va'da doda meshud>>

Ruze, ki osmonro chun tumore navishtashuda dar kh'am mepechem, [va] kh'amon guna ki nakhustin [bor] ofarinishro og'oz kardem, [bori digar] onro bozmegardonem. [In] Va'dae ast bar ukh'dai Mo, ki kh'atman, anch'omash khokh'em dod
Va ba rosti, pas az Tavrot dar Zabur navishtem, ki: <<Zaminro bandagoni shoistaam ba irs mebarand>>
Be gumon, dar in [sukhan ibratu] paiomi ravshane baroi parastishgaron ast
Va [ei Mukh'ammad] turo ch'uz rakh'mate baroi ch'akh'oniion nafiristodem
Bigu: <<Dar kh'ak'ik'at, ba man vakh'i meshavad, ki: <<Be tardid, ma'budi shumo ma'bude iagona ast. Pas, oio taslim [-i da'vati kh'ak'] meshaved?>>

Pas, agar ruigardon shudand, bigu: <<Man [kh'amai] shumoro ba tavri iakson ogokh' kardam [va dar borai azobi ilokh'i kh'ushdor dodam] va namedonam, on chi ki ba shumo va'da doda meshavad, nazdik ast io dur>>
Iak'inan, u sukhani oshkoro medonad va on chiro [dar dili khesh] pinkh'on mekuned, [niz] medonad
Va namedonam, shoiad in [ta'khiri azob moiai] ozmoish va bakh'ramandii shumo to muddate [muaiian] boshad>>
[Paiombar] Guft: <<Parvardigoro, [baini mo va kofiron] ba kh'ak' dovari kun va Parvardigori mo [Allokh'i] Rakh'mon ast, ki dar barobari on chi [az kufru shirk] megued, az u iori mekhokh'em>>
Ei mardum, az Parvardigoraton parvo kuned. Be tardid, zilzilai k'iiomat amri buzurge ast

Ruze, ki onro mebined, [on chunon vakh'shatnok ast, ki] kh'ar modari shirdekh'e [farzandi] shirkhorashro faromush mekunad va kh'ar [mavch'udi] bordore ch'anini khudro [bar zamin] menikh'ad va mardumro mast mebini, dar kh'ole ki mast nestand, balki azobi Allokh' taolo shadid ast
Va az [miioni] mardum kase kh'ast, ki biduni [kh'ech'] donishe dar borai Allokh' taolo much'odala mekunad va az kh'ar shaitoni sarkashe pairavi menamoiad
[Dar k'azoi ilokh'i bar shaiton] Muk'arrar shudaast, kh'ar ki uro ba dusti bigirad, kh'atman, gumrokh'ash mesozad va ba azobi otash mekashonad

Ei mardum, agar dar borai barangekhta shudan [dar k'iiomat] tardid dored, pas, [bidoned, ki] be tardid, Mo shumoro az khok ofaridem, sipas az nutfa va on gokh' az khuni bastashuda, sipas az poragushte shakliofta va [ba'zan] shaklnoiofta, [chunin kardem] to [k'udrati kheshro] baroiaton oshkor sozem; va kh'ar chiro ki bikhokh'em, to muddate muaiian dar rakh'im [-i modaron] nigakh' medorem, on gokh' shumoro ba surati navzode berun meovarem, sipas [parvarish meiobed] to ba kh'addi rushd [va bulug'i] khud birased va az shumo kase kh'ast, ki [dar davroni ch'avoni] memirad va kase niz kh'ast [ki on k'adar umr mebinand, to] ba nikh'oiati furutani [va kukh'ansoli] merasad, chunonki pas az [on kh'ama] donish [kh'amaro faromush mekunad va] chize namedonad. Va [ammo misole digar] zaminro khushkida mebini, vale chun obi [boron] bar on furu mefiristem, ba ch'unbish darmeoiad va rushd mekunad va az kh'ar nav' [giiokh'i] zeboe meruionad
In [shigiftikh'oi khilk'at] az on rust, ki [bidoned] Allokh' taolo kh'ak' ast va ust, ki murdagonro zinda mekunad va u bar kh'ar kore tavonost
Va in ki k'iiomat omadani ast [va] tardide dar on nest va in ki Allokh' taolo [kh'amai] kasonero, ki dar gurkh'o kh'astand, barmeangezad
Va az mardum kase kh'ast, ki biduni kh'ech' donish va kh'idoiat va kitobi ravshanibakhshe dar borai Allokh' taolo much'odala mekunad

[Az ruii takabbur] Sari khesh barmegardonad, to [mardumro] az rokh'i Allokh' taolo gumrokh' sozad. Baroi u dar in dunio rasvoi va khori ast va ruzi k'iiomat [niz] azobi otashi suzonro ba u mechashonem
In [kaifar] ba sazoi korkh'oest, ki az pesh firistodaast va Allokh' taolo kh'argiz nisbat ba bandagon [-i khud] sitamgor nest

Va az [miioni] mardum kase kh'ast, ki Allokh'ro bo tardid meparastad [va imonash zaif ast], pas, agar khaire ba u birasad, [dilash] ba on orom megirad [va bar imonash bok'i memonad] va agar baloe [baroi ozmoish] ba u birasad, ru megardonad [va ba kufr bozmegardad]. U dar dunio va okhirat ziion kardaast. In kh'amon ziioni oshkor ast
[Insoni kofir] Ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo chizero mekhonad, ki na ba u ziione merasonad va na sude mebakhshad. In kh'amon gumrokh'ii duru daroz ast
U kasero mekhonad, ki k'at'an, ziionash nazdiktar az sudash meboshad va chi bad dust va chi bad kh'amdame ast!

Be tardid, Allokh' taolo kasonero, ki imon ovardaand va korkh'oe shoista anch'om dodaand, ba bog'kh'oe [az bikh'isht] vorid mekunad, ki ch'uiborkh'o az zeri [darakhtoni] on ch'ori ast. Ba rosti, Allokh' taolo on chiro, ki mekhokh'ad, anch'om medikh'ad

Kase, ki gumon mekunad, ki Allokh' taolo u [paiombar]-ro dar dunio va okhirat kh'argiz iori nakhokh'ad kard [va aknun kh'imoiati Allokh'ro mebinad va khashmgin ast], pas, boiad resmone ba sak'f [-i khonaash] biiovezad va [khudro dor bizanad, to rokh'i nafas]-ro k'at' kunad [va to sarkh'adi marg pesh ravad], on gokh' bingarad, ki oio [in guna fandu] nairangi u khashmashro az miion mebarad
Va bad-in guna Mo in [K'ur'on]-ro [ba surati] oiote ravshan nozil kardem va Allokh' taolo kh'ar kiro khokh'ad, kh'idoiat mekunad

Kasone, ki imon ovardaand va kasone, ki iakh'udi shudand va sobeon [fitratgaroion] va masekh'iion va zartushtiion va kasone, ki shirk varzidand, iak'inan, ruzi k'iiomat Allokh' taolo miionashon dovari mekunad. Be gumon, Allokh' taolo bar kh'ar chize guvokh' ast

Oio nadidi, ki kh'ar ki dar osmonkh'o va kh'ar ki dar zamin ast va khurshed va mokh'u sitoragon va kukh'kh'o va darakhton va ch'unbandagon va bisiore az mardum baroi Allokh' taolo sach'da mekunand? Va bisiore niz kh'astand, ki [dar natich'ai sarpechi az parastish farmoni] azob bar onon takh'ak'k'uk' ioftaast va kh'ar ki Allokh' taolo khorash sozad, kase giromiash namedorad. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo kh'ar chi bikhokh'ad anch'om medikh'ad

In du [gurukh'i mu'min va kofir] dushmanoni iakdigarand va dar borai Parvardigorashon sitez mekunand. Pas kasone, ki kufr varzidand, baroiashon ch'omakh'oe az otash buridaand [va] az boloi sarashon [bar onon] obi ch'ushon merezand
On chi dar darunashon kh'ast va [niz] pustkh'oiashon bo on gudokhta meshavad
Va baroiashon gurzkh'oi okh'anin [mukh'aiio] ast
Kh'ar gokh' bikhokh'and, az [shiddati] andukh' az on ch'o [duzakh] khorich' shavand, ba on bozgardonda meshavand va [ba onon gufta meshavad]: <<Azobi suzonro bichashed>>

Be tardid, Allokh' taolo kasonero, ki imon ovardaand va korkh'oi shoista anch'om dodaand, ba bog'kh'oe [az bikh'isht] vorid mekunad, ki az zeri [darakhtoni] on ch'uiborkh'o ch'ori ast. Dar on ch'o ba dastabandakh'oe az tillo va marvorid orosta meshavand va libosashon dar on ch'o abreshim ast
Va [dar dunio] ba suii guftori pok [tavkh'idu takbir] kh'idoiat meshavand va ba rokh'i sutuda [islom] rokh'namoi mekardand

Be gumon, kasone, ki kufr varzidand va [monandi moch'aroi Kh'udaibiia mardumro] az rokh'i Allokh' taolo bozmedorand [azobe dardnok dar pesh dorand] va Masch'idu-l-kh'arom, ki onro baroi mardum [k'ibla va ibodatgokh'] k'aror dodem, muk'imu musofir dar on iaksonand va kh'ar ki dar on ch'o bo sitamgori [va gunokh'] inkh'irof bikhokh'ad, az azobe dardnok ba u mechashonem

Va [iod kun az] on gokh' ki makh'alli khona [-i Ka'ba]-ro baroi Ibrokh'im ta'iin kardem [va guftem], ki: <<Chizero shariki Man k'aror nadekh' va khonaamro baroi tavofkunandagon va k'iiomkunandagon va ruku'kunandagon [va] cach'dakunandagon pok gardon
Va baini mardum baroi [adoi] kh'ach' nido bidekh', to piioda va [savor] bar kh'ar [vasilai safar io] shuturi log'are az kh'ar rokh'i dure ba suiat biioiand

To shokh'idi manofei [gunoguni] khesh boshand va dar ruzkh'oe muaiian [ba kh'angomi k'urboni] nomi Allokh'ro bar chakh'orpoione, ki ba onon ruzi dodaem, iod kunand. Pas, az [gushti] on bikhured va ba darmondai tikh'idast [niz] g'izo bidikh'ed
Sipas boiad oludagikh'oiashonro bartaraf sozand va ba nazrkh'oi khesh vafo kunand va [girdogirdi] in khonai kukh'an [Ka'ba] tavof kunand

[Akh'kom va manosiki kh'ach'] In ast va kh'ar ki [mukh'arramot va] muk'arraroti ilokh'iro buzurg dorad, in [kor] nazdi Parvardigorash baroi u bekh'tar ast va [ei mardum] chakh'orpoione baroi [masrafi] shumo kh'alol shudaast, magar on chi [kh'ukmash] bar shumo khonda meshavad. Pas, az butkh'oi palid duri kuned va az guftori botil [va durug'] ich'tinob namoed

Dar kh'ole ki [bandai mukhlisi Allokh' taolo va] kh'ak'garo boshed va ba U shirk navarzed va kh'ar ki ba Allokh' taolo shirk varzad, chunon ast, ki gui az osmon furu aftad va murg'oni [shikori] vairo biraboiand va bod uro ba ch'oie dur biiandozad
[Kh'ukmi kh'ach'] In ast va kh'ar ki dasturkh'oi dini va ilokh'iro buzurg bishmorad, iak'inan, in [buzurgdosht nishonae] az parkh'ezkorii dilkh'ost
Dar on [chakh'orpoioni vizhai k'urboni] to zamoni muaiian [kh'angomi zabkh'] baroi shumo manofe' [va bakh'rakh'oe] ast. Pas, k'urbongokh'i onkh'o khonai kukh'ani [Ka'ba] ast

Va baroi kh'ar ummate oine [dar k'urboni kardan] k'aror dodem, to nomi Allokh'ro [vak'ti zabkh'] bar chakh'orpoione, ki ruziashon kardaast, zikr kunand. Pas, ma'budi shumo ma'budi iagona ast. [Kh'ama] Dar barobari U taslim boshed va [ei paiombar, khairi dunio va okhiratro] ba furutanon bashorat bidekh'

[Kh'amon] Kasone, ki chun nomi Allokh' taolo burda shavad, dilkh'oiashon metarsad va [kasone, ki] dar barobari musibatkh'oe, ki ba eshon merasad, shikebo kh'astand va onon, ki namozguzorand va az on chi ruzishon kardaem, infok' mekunand

[K'urboni kardani] shutur [va gov dar mavsimi kh'ach']-ro baroi shumo az shaoiri din [va nishonakh'oi ibodati Allokh' taolo] k'aror dodem. Dar in [kor] baroiaton khair [-u barakat] ast. Pas, [kh'angomi k'urboni] dar kh'ole ki [shuturon] bar po istodaand, nomi Allokh'ro bar onkh'o bibared [va nakh'rashon kuned]. On gokh' chun bar khok aftodand, az [gushti] onkh'o bikhured va tikh'idastoni obrumand va gadoionro niz taom dikh'ed. Onkh'o [chakh'orpoion]-ro inchunin ba khidmati shumo gumoshtem, boshad, ki sipos guzored

Gushtu khuni in k'urbonikh'o kh'argiz ba Allokh' taolo namerasad, balki parkh'ezkorii shumost, ki ba U merasad. U onkh'oro inchunin ba khidmati shumo gumosht, to Allokh'ro ba [shukronai] on ki shumoro kh'idoiat kardaast, ba buzurgi iod kuned va nakukoronro [ba khairu rastagori] bashorat bidekh'
Allokh' taolo az kasone, ki imon ovardaand, kh'atman, [dar barobari dushmanonashon] difo' mekunad. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo kh'ech' khiionatkori nosiposero dust namedorad
Ba kasone, ki [mushrikon] bo onon ch'angidaand, ich'ozat [-i ch'ikh'od] doda shudaast, charo ki sitam didaand va iak'inan, Allokh' taolo bar ioriashon tavonost

[Kh'amon] Kasone, ki ba nokh'ak' az diiorashon ronda shudand, [va gunokh'e nadoshtand] ch'uz in ki meguftand: <<Parvardigori mo Allokh' taolo ast>>. Va agar Allokh' taolo [zulmu kufri] barkhe az mardumro ba vasilai barkhe digar daf' namekard, savmaakh'o[-i rokh'ibon] va maobid [-i masekh'iion] va ibodatgokh'kh'o [-i iakh'udiion] va masoch'ide, ki nomi Allokh' taolo dar onon bisior burda meshavad, kh'atman, vairon megardid. Va Allokh' taolo kasero, ki [dini] Uro iori dikh'ad, iak'inan, iori mekunad. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo k'udratmandi shikastnopazir ast

[Kh'amon] Kasone, ki kh'ar gokh' dar zamin ba onon k'udrat [va kh'ukumat] bibakhshem, namoz barpo medorand va zakot mepardozand va [mardumro] ba neki farmon medikh'and va az nopisand bozmedorand. Va saranch'omi korkh'o az oni Allokh' taolo ast
[Ei paiombar] Agar [in k'avmi butparast] turo durug'gu meangorand, [shikebo bosh] kh'atman, pesh az onon k'avmi Nukh' va Od va Samud [niz paiombaronashonro] durug'gu meangoshtand
Va [kh'amchunin] k'avmi Ibrokh'im va k'avmi Lut

Va askh'obi Madian [Shuaibro durug'gu medonistand] va Muso [niz tavassuti fir'avniion] durug'gu khonda shud. Pas, ba kofiron mukh'lat dodam, on gokh' ononro [ba azob] furu giriftam. Pas, [bingar, ki natich'ai] inkori [oiot va much'ozoti] Man chi guna buvad

Chi bisior shakh'rkh'oero, ki [chun mardumash kofiru] sitamgor budand, nobudashon kardem va [inak] sak'fkh'oiash furu rekhtaast va chi bisior chokh' [-kh'o]-i matruk va k'asr [-kh'o]-i ustuvor [va boshukukh', ki sokinonashro az azobi ilokh'i nach'ot nadod]

Oio onon dar zamin gardish nakardaand, to dilkh'oe doshta boshand, ki [kh'ak'ik'atro] bo on darioband io gushkh'oe, ki [akhbori guzashtagonro] bo on bishnavand? Ba rosti, tankh'o chashmkh'o nest, ki nobino megardad, balki dilkh'oe, ki dar sinakh'ost [bebasirat gashta va baroi didani kh'ak'] nobino meshavad

[Ei Paiombar, kofiron] ba shitob az tu darkhosti azob mekunand va Allokh' taolo kh'argiz va'daashro khilof namekunad va dar vok'e', iak ruz [az azobi okhirat] nazdi Parvardigorat bo kh'azor sol, ki shumo meshumored, iakson ast

Va chi bisior [akh'olii] shakh'rkh'oe, ki ba onon mukh'lat dodam, dar kh'ole ki sitamgor budand [ammo boz kh'am sarpechi kardand], pas, ononro [ba azob] furu giriftam va bozgasht [-i kh'ama] ba sui Man ast
Bigu: <<Ei mardum, ch'uz in nest, ki man baroi shumo bimdikh'andae oshkoram>>
Pas, kasone, ki imon ovardaand va korkh'oi shoista anch'om dodaand, omurzishu ruzii nek [dar pesh] dorand
Va kasone, ki dar [rokh'i inkor va takzibi] oioti Mo mekushand, to [ba pindori khesh] Moro darmonda kunand, onon akh'li duzakhand

Va [Mo] kh'ech' rasul va paiombarero pesh az tu nafiristodem, magar in ki chun [oioti ilokh'iro] tilovat mekard, shaiton dar tilovatash [kalimoti ishtibokh'] ilk'o mekard. On gokh' Allokh' taolo on chiro, ki shaiton ilk'o namuda bud, az miion meburd va sipas oioti kheshro ustuvor mesokht va Allokh' taolo donoi kh'akim ast

To [bad-in vasila Allokh' taolo] on chiro, ki shaiton ilk'o mekunad, baroi kasone, ki dar dilkh'oiashon bemori [shakku nifok'] ast va [kh'amchunin baroi] sangdilon vasilai ozmoish k'aror dikh'ad. Va iak'inan, sitamgoron [-i mushrik] dar dushmanii duru daroze [bo Allokh' taolo va paiombarash] kh'astand

Va to kasone, ki donish ioftaand, bidonand, ki in [K'ur'on] kh'ak' ast [va] az ch'onibi Parvardigori tust va ba on imon biiovarand va dilkh'oiashon baroiash [narmu] furutan gardad; va be tardid, Allokh' taolo kasonero, ki imon ovardaand, ba rokh'i rost kh'idoiat mekunad
Kasone, ki kufr varzidand, kh'amvora dar mavridi on [chi dar K'ur'on nozil kardaem] tardid dorand, to on gokh' ki nogakh'on k'iiomat faro rasad io azobi ruzi bekhairu rakh'mat bar onon [furud] oiad
Dar on ruz farmonravoi az oni Allokh' taolo ast [va] miioni onon dovari mekunad. Pas kasone, ki imon ovardaand va korkh'oi shoista anch'om dodaand, dar bog'kh'oi purne'mat [-i bikh'isht] kh'astand
Va kasone, ki kufr varzidand va oioti Moro durug' angoshtand, azobi khorkunandae [dar pesh] dorand

Va kasone, ki dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo kh'ich'rat kardand, sipas kushta shudand io vafot kardand, iak'inan Allokh' taolo ba onon ruzii nakue medikh'ad. Ba rosti, ki Allokh' taolo bekh'tarin ruzidikh'anda ast
Be tardid, ononro ba ch'oigokh'e vorid mekunad, ki az on khushnud boshand va ba rosti, ki Allokh' taolo donoi burdbor ast

In ast [kh'ukmi ilokh'i dar borai kofir va mu'min] va kh'ar kas ba kh'amon mik'dor, ki ba u sitam shudaast, much'ozot kunad, sipas [boz] mavridi sitam k'aror girad, Allokh' taolo ioriash khokh'ad kard. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo bakhshandai omurzanda ast
In [iorii mazlumon] az on rust, ki Allokh' taolo [bar kh'ar kore tavonost; chunon ki] shabro dar ruz mekashonad va ruzro dar shab darmeovarad; va be tardid, Allokh' taolo shunavoi binost
In bad-on sabab ast, ki Allokh' taolo kh'ak' ast va on chiro, ki [mushrikon] ch'uz u mekhonand, [kh'ama] botil ast va Allokh' taolo balandmartabai buzurg ast
Oio nadidi, ki Allokh' taolo az osmon obe furu firistod va zamin [bar asari on khurramu] sarsabz megardad? Be tardid, Allokh' taolo borikbini ogokh' ast
On chi dar osmonkh'o va zamin ast, az oni Ust va be tardid, Allokh' taolo beniiozi sutuda ast

Oio nadidi, ki Allokh' taolo on chiro dar zamin ast, ba khidmati shumo gumoshtaast va kishtikh'o ba farmonash dar dario ravonand va osmonro nigakh' medorad, ki ch'uz ba ich'ozati U bar zamin naaftad. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo [nisbat] ba mardum dilsuzi mekh'rubon ast
Va Ust, ki shumoro zinda kard, sipas memironad va on gokh' [bori digar] zinda mekunad. Ba rosti, ki inson [nisbat ba ne'matkh'oi ilokh'i] bisior nosipos ast

Baroi kh'ar ummate oine muk'arrar kardaem, ki ba on amal kunand, pas, [ei paiombar, pairavoni soiri adion] naboiad bo tu dar in amr sitez kunand. Ba rokh'i Parvardigorat da'vat kun, [charo ki] tu iak'inan, bar [oini durust va] rokh'i rost k'aror dori
Va agar [dar borai kh'ak'k'oniiati din] bo tu much'odala kardand, pas, bigu: <<Allokh' taolo ba on chi anch'om medikh'ed, donotar ast
Allokh' taolo ruzi k'iiomat dar mavridi on chi dar boraash ikhtilof mekarded, miionaton dovari mekunad>>
Oio nadonistai, ki Allokh' taolo on chiro dar osmon va zamin ast medonad? Be gumon [kh'amai] inkh'o dar kitobe [sabt] ast. Musallaman, in [kor] bar Allokh' taolo oson ast

Va [mushrikon] ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo chizero meparastand, ki kh'ech' dalele bar [kh'ak'k'oniiati] on nozil nakardaast va bad-on ogokh'i [va shinokhte niz] nadorand va sitamgoron [-i mushrik dar barobari azobi ilokh'i] kh'ech' iorikunandae nadorand

Va kh'angome ki oioti ravshani Mo bar onon khonda meshavad, dar chekh'rai kasone, ki kufr varzidaand, [osori karokh'at va] nokhushoiandi mebini. Nazdik ast ba kasone, ki oioti Moro baroiashon mekhonand, kh'amlavar shavand. [Ei paiombar, ba kofiron] Bigu: <<Oio shumoro ba badtar az in [ki dar intizoraton ast] khabar dikh'am? Otash [-i duzakh] ast, ki Allokh' taolo onro ba kasone, ki kufr varzidand, va'da dodast va chi bad saranch'omest!>>

Ei mardum, [dar borai notavonii butkh'o] masale zada shudaast, pas, ba on gush dikh'ed: Kasonero, ki ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo [ba parastish] mekhoned, kh'argiz nametavonand magasero biiofarinand, kh'atto agar [kh'amagi] baroi in [kor] ch'am' shavand. Va agar on magas chize az onon biraboiad, nametavonand onro bozpas girand. [Ore] Khostor va khosta [but va magas] kh'ar du notavonand
[Onon] Allokh'ro chunon ki sazovori [buzurgdoshti] Ust, nashinokhtaand. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo nerumandi shikastnopazir ast

Allokh' taolo az miioni farishtagon firistodagone [baroi iblog'i vakh'i ba paiombaron] barmeguzinad va az miioni insonkh'o niz [paiombarone baroi rasonidani paiomi ilokh'i ba mardum intikhob mekunad]. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo shunavoi binost
U oianda va guzashtai ononro medonad va [kh'amai] korkh'o ba Allokh' taolo bozgardonda meshavad
Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, ruku' kuned va sach'da guzored va Parvardigoratonro biparasted va kori nek anch'om dikh'ed, boshad, ki rastagor shaved

Va dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo - chunon ki sazovori ch'ikh'od [dar rokh'i] Ust - ch'ikh'od kuned. U shumoro barguzid va dar din baroiaton kh'ech' sakhti [va tangnoe] k'aror nadod. Oini padaraton Ibrokh'im [niz chunin bud]. U [Allokh' taolo] pesh az in [dar kitobkh'oi osmonii guzashta] va dar in [K'ur'on] shumoro musulmon nomid, to paiombar bar [iblog'i paiomash ba] shumo guvokh' boshad va shumo [niz] bar mardum guvokh' boshed [ki kh'amai paiombaron paiomi ilokh'iro ba k'avmi khud rasonidaand]. Pas, namoz barpo dored va zakot bipardozed va ba Allokh' taolo panokh' bibared [va bar U tavakkal kuned], ki U [dustu] korsozi shumost. Pas, chi naku korsozu chi nek iovarest!
Ba rosti, ki mu'minon rastagor shudand
Kh'amon kasone, ki dar namozashon furutan kh'astand
Va onon, ki az [guftoru raftori] bekh'uda ruigardonand
Va onon, ki zakot mepardozand
Va onon, ki sharmgokh'ashonro kh'ifz mekunand
Magar dar mavridi kh'amsaron io kanizonashon, ki [dar bakh'ragirii ch'insi az onkh'o] nakukh'ishe bar onon nest
Pas, kh'ar ki farotar az in bikhokh'ad, ononand, ki az kh'ad darguzashtaand
Va [dar zumrai mu'minonand] kasone, ki amonatkh'o va akh'di khudro rioiat mekunand
Va kasone, ki bar [adoi] namozkh'oiashon murok'ibat mekunand
Inonand, ki vorison kh'astand
[Kh'amon] Kasone, ki bikh'ishti barinro ba irs mebarand [va] dar on ch'ovidonand
Va dar kh'ak'ik'at, insonro az chakidae az gil ofaridem
Sipas uro ba shakli nutfae dar k'arorgokh'e ustuvor [rakh'im] nikh'odem

Sipas nutfaro [Ba shakli] khuni basta sokhtem va on gokh' khuni bastaro [ba surati] poragushte sokhtem, sipas poragushtro [ba shakli] ustukhon darovardem va on gokh' bar ustukhonkh'o gusht pushonidem. Sipas on [ch'anin]-ro ofarinishe digar bakhshidem. Pas, [purbarakatu] buzurgvor ast Allokh' taolo, ki nakutarin ofarinanda ast
Sipas shumo [pas az taii marokh'ili zindagi] kh'atman, khokh'ed murd
On gokh' be tardid, dar ruzi k'iiomat barangekhta meshaved
Va ba iak'in Mo bar farozaton kh'aft osmon ofaridem va [kh'argiz] az ofarinish g'ofil nabudaem
Va az osmon ba andozae muaiian [baroi niiozi makhluk'ot] obe firistodem va onro dar zamin ch'oi dodem va kh'atman, baroi az bain burdanash [niz] komilan tavonoem
Sipas tavassuti on [ob] baroiaton bog'kh'oe az darakhtoni khurmo va angur padid ovardem, ki dar on [bog'kh'o] baroi shumo mevakh'oe bisiore ast va az on [makh'sulot] mekhured
Va darakhte [ofaridem], ki az Turi Sino barmeoiad va ravg'ani [zaitun] medikh'ad va khurishe baroi khurandagon ast

Va be tardid, baroi shumo dar [vuch'udi] chakh'orpoion ibrate [az k'udrati Allokh' taolo] ast: az on chi dar shikami onkh'ost ba shumo [shir] menushonem va dar [vuch'udi] onkh'o baroiaton sudkh'oi bisiore vuch'ud dorad va az [gushti] onkh'o mekhured
[Dar khushki] Bar onkh'o savor meshaved va [dar ob] bar kishtikh'o
Va be tardid, Mo Nukh'ro ba suii k'avmash firistodem, pas, [ba onon] guft: <<Ei k'avmi man, Allokh'ro biparasted [ki] ch'uz U ma'bude [ba kh'ak'] nadored. Oio parvo namekuned?>>

Pas, ashrof va buzurgoni k'avmash, ki kufr varzida budand, guftand: <<In [mard kase] nest, magar bashare kh'amchun shumo, [ki] mekhokh'ad bar shumo bartari ch'uiad. Agar Allokh' taolo mekhost, farishtagone [ba suiaton] nozil mekard. Mo inro [ki Nukh' meguiad] dar miioni niiogoni khud nashnidaem
U mardi devonae besh nest. Pas, to muddate muntazir boshed [ki io durug'ash oshkor gardad va dast az da'vatash bardorad io margash faro rasad]
[Nukh'] Guft: <<Parvardigoro, maro dar barobari takzibi onon iori kun>>

Pas, ba u vakh'i kardem: <<Kishtiro takh'ti nazari Mo va ba vakh'ii Mo bisoz va kh'angome ki farmoni [azobi] Mo faro rasad va [ba nishonai rasidani tufon ob az] tanur ch'ushad, az kh'ar nav'i [kh'aivon] iak ch'ufti [naru moda] dar kishti savor kun va khonavodaatro [niz kh'amrokh'i khud bubar], magar kasone, ki peshtar va'da [-i kh'alok] bar onon muk'arrar shudaast va dar borai [nach'oti] kasone, ki sitam kardaand, bo Man sukhan nagu, [charo ki] onon kh'atman, g'ark' khokh'and shud
Pas, kh'angome ki tu va kh'amrokh'onat bar kishti savor shuded, bigu: <<Sipos makhsusi Allokh' taolo ast, ki moro az [changi] gurukh'i sitamgor nach'ot dod>>
Va [niz] bigu: <<Parvardigoro, moro dar manzilgokh'e purbarakat furud ovar, ki Tu bekh'tarin furudovarandai>>
Be tardid, dar in [moch'aro] nishonakh'oe [az k'udrati Allokh' taolo dar nach'oti mu'minon va azobi kofiron] ast va iak'inan, Mo ozmoishgar [-i imon va kufri mardum] budaem
On gokh' gurukh'i digarero pas az onon padid ovardem
Va az khudashon paiombare dar [miioni] onon firistodem [to biguiad]: <<Allokh'ro biparasted, [ki] ch'uz U ma'bude [ba kh'ak'] nadored. Oio parvo namekuned?>>

Gurukh'e az ashrof va buzurgoni k'avmash, ki kufr varzida budand va didori okhiratro durug' meangoshtand va dar zindagii dunio ba onon ne'matu osoish doda budem, guftand: <<In [mard kase] nest, magar bashare kh'amchun shumo. Az on chi [shumo] mekhured, [u niz] mekhurad va az on chi ki shumo menushed, [u niz] menushad [pas, bartarie nadorad, ki paiombar boshad]
Va agar az bashare kh'amchun khud itoat kuned, dar on surat iak'inan, ziionkored
Oio u ba shumo va'da medikh'ad, ki vak'te murded va khoku ustukhon shuded, [dar k'iiomat az gur] berun ovarda meshaved?
On chi ba shumo va'da medikh'ad, chi dur ast, chi dur!
[Zindagoni] Ch'uz kh'amin zindagii dunioii mo nest. [Gurukh'e] Memirem [va gurukh'e ba ch'oii onkh'o] zinda meshavem va kh'argiz [pas az marg] barangekhta nakhokh'em shud
U [kase] nest, magar mardest, ki bar Allokh' taolo durug' mebandad va mo ba u imon nameovarem>>
Paiombarashon] Guft: <<Parvardigoro, maro dar barobari takzibi onon iori kun>>
[Allokh' taolo] Farmud: <<Pas az andak zamone, [az kori khud] sakht pushaimon meshavand>>
Pas, bong [-i margbor]-e ononro ba kh'ak' furu girift va [kh'amchun] khoru khoshokashon namudem. Pas, k'avmi sitamgor [az rakh'mati Allokh' taolo] dur bod!
Sipas ba'd az onon naslkh'oe digar padid ovardem
Kh'ech' ummate na az ach'ali khud peshi megirad va na ta'khir mekunad

Sipas paiombaroni khudro paiopai firistodem. Kh'ar gokh' paiombare baroi [kh'idoiati] ummate meomad, uro durug'gu meangoshtand, pas, [Mo niz] ononro iake pas az digare kh'alok kardem va ononro dostonkh'o [-i ibratomuze baroi oiandagon] k'aror dodem. Pas, nobud bod, k'avme, ki imon nameovarand!
Sipas Muso va barodarash Kh'orunro bo oioti [nukh'gonai] khesh va daloili oshkor firistodem
Ba suii Fir'avn va ashrofi [k'avmi] u, vale onon gardankashi kardand va gurukh'e bartarikhokh' budand
Va guftand: <<Oio ba du insoni monandi khud imon biiovarem, kh'ol on ki k'avmashon bardagoni mo kh'astand?>>
Pas on duro durug'gu angoshtand, [va] saranch'om kh'alok shudand
Va be tardid, ba Muso kitobi [Tavrot] dodem, boshad, ki [Bani Isroil] kh'idoiat shavand
Va pisari Mariam va modarashro nishonae [az k'udrati ilokh'i] karor dodem va ononro dar makone baland va kh'amvore, ki doroi amniiat va obe [zulolu] ch'ori bud, ch'oi dodem
Ei paiombaron, az [g'izokh'oi] pokiza bikhured va kori shoista anch'om dikh'ed. Iak'inan, man ba on chi mekuned, ogokh'am
Va dar kh'ak'ik'at, in dini shumo dini vokh'id [ba nomi islom] ast va man Parvardigoraton kh'astam. Pas, az man parvo kuned [bitarsed]
Ammo [pairavonashon ikhtilof kardand va] dar kori dinashon miioni khud firk'a-firk'a va parokanda gashtand va kh'ar gurukh'e ba on chi nazdashon ast, dilkhushand [charo ki khudro bar kh'ak' medonand]
Pas, [ei paiombar] ononro to vak'te [ki azob faro merasad] dar ch'akh'lu nodonishon rakh'o kun
Oio gumon mekunand, on chi az sarvatu farzandon, ki ba onon medikh'em,
[baroi in ast, ki] shitobon nekikh'oro ba eshon birasonem? [Na, kh'argiz chunin nest] Balki onon [kh'ak'ik'atro] darnameioband
Kasone, ki az bimi Parvardigorashon tarsonand
Va kasone, ki ba oioti Parvardigorashon imon meovarand
Va kasone, ki ba Parvardigorashon shirk namevarzand

Va kasone, ki dar anch'omi korkh'oi khair mekushand va az in ki ba suii Parvardigori khesh bozmegardand, [va az in ki korkh'oi nekashon mak'buli dargokh'i kh'ak' vok'e' nashavad] dilkh'oiashon kh'aroson ast
Inon dar nekikh'o shitob mekunand va dar anch'omi on [az iakdigar] peshi megirand
Va [Mo] ba kh'ech' kas ch'uz ba andozai tavonash taklif namekunem va nazdi Mo kitobest, ki [dar borai a'moli bandagon] ba kh'ak' sukhan meguiad va ba onon sitam nameshavad
[Na] Balki dilkh'oiashon az in [kitob] dar g'aflat ast va onon ba ch'uz in [gunokh'i kufr] korkh'oe [digar niz] anch'om medikh'and
To kh'angome ki sarvatmandonashonro ba azob giriftor kunem, nogakh'on fariodi zori sar medikh'and
[Ba onon gufta meshavad] <<Imruz nola va zori nakuned, [ki] kh'argiz az suii mo iori nakhokh'ed shud
Be tardid, oioti Man paivasta bar shumo khonda meshud, vale [az kh'ak'] rui megardoned
Dar kh'ole ki dar barobarash takabbur mekarded [va dar mach'olisi shabonai khud] ba badgui mepardokhted
Oio onon dar in guftor [K'ur'on] naiandeshidaand io [magar] chize baroiashon omada, ki baroi niiogonashon naiomadaast?
Io paiombarashonro nashinokhtaand va [az in rust, ki] inkorash mekunand
Io meguiand, u ch'unun dorad? [Na, chunin nest] Balki [u dini] kh'ak'ro baroiashon ovardaast, vale beshtarashon az [pazirishi] kh'ak' nokhushnudand

Agar Allokh' taolo az kh'avaskh'oi onon pairavi kunad [va umuri kh'asti ba maili kofiron idora shavad], osmonkh'o va zamin va kh'ar ki dar onkh'ost, tabokh' megardad, balki baroi onon pandashon [K'ur'on]-ro ovardaem [ki moiai izzatu sharafashon ast], vale onon az pandashon ruigardonand
[Ei Paiombar] Oio tu az onon [baroi tablig'i din] podoshe metalabi? Va kh'ol on ki podoshi Parvardigorat [base] bekh'tar ast va U bekh'tarin ruzidikh'anda ast
Va be tardid, tu ononro ba rokh'e rost da'vat mekuni
Kasone, ki ba okhirat imon nadorand, kh'atman az in rokh'i [rost] munkh'arif shudaand

Agar ba onon rakh'm kunem va balovu ranch'ero, ki [az k'akh'ti va gurusnagi] didaand, az eshon bartaraf sozem, bar sarkashi [va gumrokh'ii] khesh pofishori mekunand [va kh'amchunon] ba berokh'a meravand
Dar kh'ak'ik'at, [Mo] ononro ba azob [-u balo] giriftor sokhtem [to bedor shavand], ammo dar barobari Parvardigorashon furutani nanamudand va [ba dargokh'ash tazarru' va] zori nakardand
[Onon paivasta chunin kh'astand] To on gokh' ki dare az azobi sakht bar onon mekushoem [va chunon giriftor shavand], ki [az kh'ama ch'o] ma'ius gardand
[Ei munkironi k'iiomat] Allokh' taolo ast, ki baroi shumo gushu chashm va dil padid ovard. Chi andak sipos meguzored!
Va Ust, ki shumoro dar zamin [ofarid va] parokanda kard va [ruzi k'iiomat] ba suii U ch'am' meshaved
Va Ust, ki zinda mekunad va memironad va ikhtilofi shabu ruz az tadbiri Ust. Oio nameandeshed?
[Chunin nakardand] Balki onon niz kh'amon [sukhanonero] guftand, ki peshiniion meguftand
Guftand: <<Oio kh'angome ki murdemu khoku ustukhon shudem, barangekhta khokh'em shud?
Be tardid, in va'daro pesh az in niz ba mo va niiogonamon dodaand. In [sukhan chize] nest, magar [durug'kh'o va] afsonakh'oi peshiniion>>
[Ei paiombar, ba munkironi meod] bigu: <<Agar medoned, [bigued], zamin va kh'ar ki dar on ast, az oni kist?>>
Khokh'and guft: <<[Kh'ama] Az oni Allokh' taolo ast>>. Bigu: <<Pas, oio pand namegired?>>
Bigu: <<Parvardigori kh'aft osmon va Parvardigori Arshi buzurg kist?>>
Khokh'and guft: <<[Kh'ama] Az oni Allokh' taolo ast>>. Bigu: <<Pas, oio [az Allokh' taolo] parvo namekuned?>>
Bigu: <<Agar medoned, [bigued] farmonravoii kh'ama chiz ba dasti kist? Va [kist, ki] panokh' medikh'ad va kase dar barobari [azobi] u panokh' nadorad?>>
Khokh'and guft: <<[Farmonravoii kh'ama chiz] Az oni Allokh' taolo ast>>. Bigu: <<Pas, chi guna afsun meshaved [va nameandeshed]?>>
[Chunin nest, ki kofiron gumon mekunand] Balki Mo kh'ak'ro baroiashon ovardem va iak'inan, onon durug'gu kh'astand

Allokh' taolo kh'argiz farzande barnaguzidaast va kh'ech' ma'bude bo U nest. [Agar chunin bud] On gokh' kh'ar ma'bude on chiro ofarida bud, [bo khud] meburd va musallaman, barkhe bar barkhe digar bartari mech'ustand [va nizomi kh'asti tabokh' megasht]. Allokh' taolo az on chi [mushrikon] tavsif mekunand, munazzakh' ast
U donoi nikh'onu oshkor ast va az on chi bo Vai sharik mesozand, bartar ast
Bigu: <<Parvardigoro, agar on [azobe]-ro, ki ba onon va'da doda meshavad, ba man nishon medikh'i [ki shokh'idash bosham],
pas, Parvardigoro maro dar [kh'angomi azob dar kanori in] gurukh'i sitamgor k'aror madekh'>>
Va kh'atman, Mo tavonoem, ki on chiro ba onon va'da medikh'em, ba tu nishon dikh'em
[Ei paiombar] badiro ba shevae, ki bekh'tar ast, daf' kun [va bubakhshu shikebo bosh]. Mo ba on chi [mushrikon dar borai tu] tavsif mekunand, donotarem
Va bigu: <<Parvardigoro, man az vasvasakh'oi shaiotin ba Tu panokh' mebaram
Va Parvardigoro, az in ki onkh'o nazdi man kh'ozir shavand, [niz] ba Tu panokh' mebaram>>

[Kofiron paivasta bar ak'idai botilashon kh'astand] To kh'angome ki margi iake az onon faro rasad, [on gokh' dar kh'ole ki] nazdi Parvardigori [khud nolavu zori mekunad, ba farishtagon] meguiad: <<Maro [ba dunio] bozgardoned

Shoiad dar on chi [kutokh'i namuda va] tark kardam, kori shoistae anch'om dikh'am>>. Kh'argiz chunin nest. Be tardid, in fak'at sukhane ast, ki u ba zabon meguiad [va kh'argiz raftorash tag'iir namekunad] va ruze, ki barangekhta shavand, pushti sarashon barzakhest
Ruze, ki dar sur damida meshavad, kh'ech' iak az [ iftikhoroti khonavodagi va] paivandkh'oi kheshovandi miionashon [bark'aror] nakhokh'ad bud va [az vakh'shati azob] az [kh'oli] iakdigar namepursand
Va kh'ar ki vaznai a'molash sangin boshad, ononand, ki rastagorand
Va kh'ar ki vaznai a'molash sabuk boshad, ononand, ki ba khesh ziion zadaand va dar duzakh ch'ovidonand
Otash chekh'rakh'oiashonro mesuzonad va dar on ch'o ruitursh va zishtmanzarand
[Ba onon gufta meshavad] <<Magar na in bud, ki oiotam bar shumo khonda meshud va onkh'oro durug' meangoshted?>>
[Dar posukh] Meguiand: <<Parvardigoro, badbakhti bar mo chira shud va gurukh'e gumrokh' budem
Parvardigoro, moro az in [duzakh] berun ovar. Pas, agar [ba kufru nofarmoni] bozgashtem, kh'atman, sitamgorem>>
[Allokh' taolo] Mefarmoiad: <<Dar on [otash] gum shaved va bo Man sukhan nagued
Gurukh'e az bandagonam meguftand: <<Parvardigoro, imon ovardem, pas, moro bibakhsho va bar mo rakh'm kun, [ki] be tardid, Tu bekh'tarin bakhshoiandai>>
Vale shumo ononro maskhara mekarded, to ch'oie, ki [sargarm shudan ba tamaskhuri eshon] zikr [-u ibodati] Maro az iodaton burd va kh'amchunon ba onon mekhandided
Imruz Man ononro az on ch'ikh'ate, ki shikeboi kardand, podosh medikh'am. Ore, eshonand, ki rastagorand>>
[Allokh' taolo ba duzakhiion] Meguiad: <<Chand sol dar zamin ba sar burded>>?
Meguiand: <<Iak ruz io bakhshe az iak ruzro ba sar burdem. Az kh'isobgaron [ki kh'isobi ruzu solro nigakh' medorand] bipurs>>
U meguiad: <<[Ore] Agar medonisted, ch'uz andake [dar dunio] ba sar naburded
Oio pindoshtaed, ki shumoro bekh'uda ofaridaem va ba suii Mo bozgardonida nameshaved?
Pas, balandmartaba [va buzurg] ast Allokh' taolo [ki] farmonravoi kh'ak' ast. Kh'ech' ma'bude [ba kh'ak'] ch'uz U nest [va] Parvardigori Arshi garonk'adr ast

Va kh'ar ki bo Allokh' taolo ma'budi digarero bikhonad, iak'inan, kh'ech' dalele bar [kh'ak'k'oniiati] on nakhokh'ad dosht va kh'isobi u bo Parvardigorash khokh'ad bud. Be tardid, kofiron rastagor nameshavand
Va [ei Paiombar] bigu: <<Parvardigoro, [gunokh'onamro] bibakhshoi va rakh'm kun va Tu bekh'tarin bakhshandai>>
[In] Suraest, ki onro nozil kardaem va [amal ba akh'komi] onro voch'ib namudaem va dar on oioti ravshane nozil kardaem, boshad, ki pand gired

Kh'ar iak az zanu mardi zinokorro sad toziiona bizaned va agar ba Allokh' taolo va ruzi okhirat imon dored, naboiad dar [ich'roi akh'komi] dini Allokh' taolo nisbat ba on du [nafar] dilsuzi [va mekh'rubonii be dalel] doshta boshed va boiad gurukh'e az mu'minon bar much'ozotashon guvokh' boshand
Mardi zinokor ch'uz bo zani zinokor io mushrik izdivoch' namekunad va zani zinokorro [niz] ch'uz mardi zinokor io mushrik ba izdivoch'i khud darnameovarad va in [zanoshui] bar mu'minon kh'arom ast

Va kasone, ki [mardonu] zanoni pokdomanro [ba zino] muttakh'am mekunand va chakh'or shokh'id [bar iddaoi khud] nameovarand, ononro kh'ashtod toziiona bizaned va kh'argiz shakh'odatashonro [dar kh'ech' mavride] napazired va inonand, ki nofarmonand
Magar kasone, ki ba'd az on [tukh'mat] tavba kunand va [raftori guzashtai khudro] islokh' [-u ch'ubron] namoiand, pas, be tardid, Allokh' taolo omurzandai mekh'rubon ast

Va kasone, ki kh'amsaroni khudro [ba zino] muttakh'am mekunand va ch'uz kheshtan shokh'ide [bar in iddao] nadorand, pas, kh'ar iak az onon boiad chakh'or bor ba Allokh' taolo savgand iod kunad, ki kh'atman, rost meguiad
Va panch'umin bor [shavkh'ar biguiad], ki la'nati Allokh' taolo bar u bod, agar durug'gu boshad
Va kaifari zan dar surate bardoshta meshavad, ki chakh'or bor ba Allokh' taolo savgand iod kunad, ki on mard kh'atman, durug'gu ast
Va panch'umin bor [biguiad], ki khashmi Allokh' taolo bar u bod, agar [shavkh'arash] rost gufta boshad
