Va [ei mardum] agar bakhshishi Allokh' taolo va rakh'matash bar shumo nabud va in ki Allokh' taolo tavbapaziri kh'akim ast [kh'atman, giriftori azob meshuded]

[Ei mu'minon] Be tardid, kasone, ki on tukh'mati buzurgro [dar borai Oisha] matrakh' kardand, gurukh'e az khudi shumo kh'astand. Gumon nakuned, ki in [moch'aro] baroi shumo sharr ast, balki khaire baroiaton dar on [nukh'ufta] ast. Baroi kh'ar iak az onon [ki dar in shoeaparokani nak'sh doshtaand] kaifari gunokh'est, ki murtakib shudaast va baroi on kase az eshon, ki bakhshi buzurgi on [tukh'mat]-ro ba ukh'da dorad, azobi buzurge [dar pesh] ast
Charo kh'angome ki in [tukh'mat]-ro shunided, mardonu zanoni mu'min gumoni nek ba khud naburdand va naguftand: <<In tukh'mate [buzurgu] oshkor [ba kh'amsari paiombar] ast?>>
Charo chakh'or shokh'id bar on naiovardand? Pas, chun shokh'idonro naiovardand, ononand, ki nazdi Allokh' taolo durug'gu kh'astand
Va agar bakhshishi Allokh' taolo va rakh'mati U dar duniovu okhirat nabud, kh'atman, ba kaifari on chi bad-on pardokhted, ba azobe [sakhtu] buzurg giriftor meshuded

On gokh' ki on [shoea]-ro az zaboni iakdigar meshunided va sukhanero dakh'on ba dakh'on nak'l mekarded, ki dar boraash kh'ech' ogokh'i [va iak'ini] nadoshted va onro soda [va kuchak] mepindoshted, dar kh'ole ki on [tukh'mat] nazdi Allokh' taolo bisior buzurg ast
Charo kh'angome ki onro shunided, nagufted: <<Sazovor nest, ki in [sukhani bad]-ro bar zabon ovardem. [Parvardigoro] Tu munazzakh'i, in durug'i buzurge ast?>>
Allokh' taolo shumoro pand medikh'ad, ki agar mu'min kh'asted, kh'argiz in [kor]-ro takror nakuned
Va Allokh' taolo oiot [-i khud]-ro baroi shumo baion mekunad va Allokh' taolo donoi kh'akim ast

Onon, ki dust dorand, baini kasone, ki imon ovardaand, zishtkori roich' gardad, kh'atman, dar dunio va okhirat azobe dardnok [dar pesh] dorand va Allokh' taolo [kh'ak'oik'u masolekh'ro] medonad va shumo namedoned
Va agar bakhshishi Allokh' taolo va rakh'matash bar shumo nabud va in ki Allokh' taolo dilsuzi mekh'rubon ast, [kh'atman, much'ozoti sakhte dar intizoraton bud]

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, dar rokh'kh'oi shaiton gom naguzored va kh'ar ki rokh'kh'oi shaitonro mepuiad, [bidonad, ki] u tankh'o ba zishtkori va a'moli nopisand farmon medikh'ad va agar bakhshishi Allokh' taolo va rakh'matash bar shumo nabud, kh'argiz kh'ech' iak az shumo [az gunokh'] pok nameshud, vale Allokh' taolo kh'ar kiro bikhokh'ad, pok mekunad va Allokh' taolo shunavoi donost

Afrode az shumo, ki bartarii [imoni] va vus'ati [moli] dorand, naboiad savgand iod kunand, ki ba kheshovandon va tikh'idaston va mukh'och'ironi dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo [ki murtakibi gunokh' shudaand] chize nadikh'and. Onon boiad afv kunand va [az gunokh'i digaron] chashm bipushand. Oio dust namedored, ki Allokh' taolo [niz] shumoro bibakhshad? Va Allokh' taolo omurzandai mekh'rubon ast

Kasone, ki zanoni pokdomani bekhabar [az fakh'sho va] mu'minro [ba zino] muttakh'am mekunand, dar dunio va okhirat az rakh'mati Allokh' taolo dur gashtaand va [dar okhirat] azobe buzurg [dar pesh] dorand
Ruze, ki zabonkh'o va dastkh'o va poikh'oiashon dar borai on chi mekardand [va meguftand], alaikh'i onon guvokh'i medikh'and
On ruz Allokh' taolo ch'azoi vok'eii ononro bekamu kost medikh'ad va khokh'and donist, ki Allokh' taolo kh'amon kh'ak'k'i oshkor ast

Zanoni palid baroi mardoni palidand va mardoni palid [niz] baroi zanoni palidand. Va zanoni pok az oni mardoni pokand va mardoni pok [niz] az oni zanoni pokand. Inon az on chi [nopokon dar boraashon] meguiand, mubarro kh'astand [va] omurzishi [ilokh'i] va ruzii arzishmande [dar pesh] dorand

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, ba khonakh'oe ch'uz khonakh'oi khud vorid nashaved, magar in ki ich'ozat bigired va bar akh'li on [khona] salom kuned. In [kor] baroi shumo bekh'tar ast, boshad, ki pand gired

Pas, agar kasero dar on [khona] naiofted, vorid nashaved, to ba shumo ich'ozat doda shavad va agar ba shumo gufta shud: <<Bozgarded>>! Pas, bozgarded! [Charo ki] In [kasbi ich'ozat] baroi shumo shoistatar ast va Allokh' taolo ba on chi mekuned donost

Bar shumo gunokh'e nest, ki ba khonakh'oi g'airimaskuni [va makonkh'oi umumi], ki dar on ch'o [ekh'tiioch' io] bakh'rae dored, vorid shaved va Allokh' taolo on chi oshkor mesozed va on chi pinkh'on medored, [kh'amaro] medonad

[Ei paiombar] Ba mardoni mu'min bigu, chashmoni khudro [az nigokh' ba nomakh'ram] furu girand va pokdomani pesha kunand. In [kor] baroi onon pokizatar ast. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo ba on chi anch'om medikh'and, ogokh' ast

Va ba zanoni mu'min [niz] bigu, chashmoni khudro [az nigokh' ba nomakh'ram] furu girand va pokdomani varzand va zevar [-u oroishi] khudro oshkor nakunand, magar on chi [ba surati tabii] namoion ast. Va boiad rusarii khudro bar sina biafkanand [to muikh'o va sinakh'oshon pushida gardad] va zinati khudro oshkor nasozand, magar baroi shavkh'ar io padar io padarshavkh'ar io pisari khud io pisari shavkh'arashon io barodar io pisari barodar io pisari khokh'ar io [digar] zanon io kanizon va bardagonashon io kheshovandone, ki [digar] niioz va tamoiule ba zanon nadorand io kudakone, ki az masoili ch'insii zanon ogokh'i naioftaand. Kh'amchunin, [kh'angomi rokh' raftan] poikh'oi khudro [chunon bar zamin] nakuband, ki [sadoi] zinnatkh'oe, ki [zeri libos] pinkh'on kardaand, [khalkhol] oshkor shavad. Va ei mu'minon, kh'amagi ba sui Allokh' taolo tavba kuned; boshad, ki rastagor garded

[Ei mu'minon] Mardonu zanoni much'arradi khudro kh'amsar dikh'ed va g'ulomonu kanizonro, ki shoistagi dorand [niz kh'amsar dikh'ed]. Agar onon tikh'idast boshand, Allokh' taolo az bakhshish [va lutfi] khesh beniiozashon mesozad va Allokh' taolo kushoishgari ogokh' ast

Kasone, ki [sharoitu imkonoti] izdivoch' nadorand, boiad pokdomani pesha kunand, to Allokh' taolo ononro az bakhshishi khesh beniioz namoiad. Va bardagone, ki khostori bozkharid [va ozodii khesh] kh'astand, agar dar onon [tavonoii pardokhti mol va] shoistagi mebined, [darkhostashonro] bipazired va az sarvate, ki Allokh' taolo ba shumo ato kardaast, chize ba onon bakhshed [to ba ozodiashon kumak kuned]. Kh'amchunin, kanizonatonro, ki mekhokh'and pokdoman boshand, ba zino vodor nakuned, to bakh'rai [nochiz] zindagii dunioro ba dast ovared va agar kase, ki ononro [ba in kor] vorid namoiad, Allokh' taolo pas az mach'bur shudanashon, kh'atman, [nisbat ba onon] omurzanda [va] mekh'rubon ast
Va ba rosti, ba suii shumo oiote ravshan va dostone az zindagii peshiniionaton va pande baroi parkh'ezgoron nozil kardaem

Allokh' taolo nuri osmonkh'o va zamin ast. Masali nuri U kh'ammonandi charog'donest, ki darunash charog'e [afrukhta] ast [va] on charog' dar shishae k'aror dorad [va] on shisha gui sitorae durakhshon ast. In charog' bo [ravg'ani] darakhti purbarakati zaitun afrukhta meshavad, ki na shark'i ast va na g'arbi [va khurshed kh'amvora bar on metobad]. Ravg'anash [chunon zulol ast, ki] nazdik ast, biduni tamos bo otash shu'lavar gardad. Nurest afzun bar nur. [K'albi mu'min niz bo nuri kh'idoiat in guna ravshan meshavad] Va Allokh' taolo kh'ar kiro bikhokh'ad, ba nuri khesh kh'idoiat mekunad va Allokh' taolo baroi mardum masalkh'o mezanad va Allokh' taolo ba kh'ar chiz donost

[In charog'i kh'idoiat] Dar masoch'idest, ki Allokh' taolo amr kardaast, to [k'adru manzalatshon] giromi doshta shavad va nomash dar onkh'o burda shavad, [va] dar on ch'o bomdodon va shomgokh'on Uro ba poki bisitoiand

Mardone, ki kh'ech' tich'orat va kharidu furushe ononro az iodi Allokh' taolo va barpo doshtani namoz va pardokhti zakot g'ofil namekunad, [va] az ruze, ki dilkh'o va chashmkh'o digargun meshavad, bim dorand
To Allokh' taolo bekh'tar az on chi anch'om dodaand, ba onon podosh dikh'ad va az fazli khud niz bar podoshashon biiafzoiad va Allokh' taolo ba kh'ar ki bikhokh'ad, bekh'isob ruzi medikh'ad

Va kasone, ki kufr varzidand, a'molashon kh'amchun sarobe dar biiobone kh'amvor ast, ki [az dur insoni] tashna onro ob mepindorad, to on ki nazdikash meshavad [va] chize nameiobad va [a'moli kofir niz sarobest, ki sude baroiash nadorad va dar ivaz] Allokh'ro nazdi khesh meiobad, ki kh'isobashro ba tavri komil medikh'ad va Allokh' taolo dar kh'isobrasi sare' ast

Io [a'molash] kh'amchun torikikh'oe dar darioi zharf ast, ki mavch'e onro mepushonad va bar farozi on mavch'e digar ast, [va] bar farozash abre [torik] k'aror dorad. Torikikh'oe ast, iake bar farozi digare [chunon ki] agar [shakhsi gumgashta] dasti khudro berun ovarad, mumkin nest onro bubinad. Va kase, ki Allokh' taolo nure [az kh'idoiat] baroiash k'aror nadoda boshad, pas, [kh'ech' kh'idoiat va] nure baroiash nest

Oio nadidi, kh'ar ki dar osmonkh'o va zamin ast va [kh'atto] parrandakh'oi dar osmon parkushoda [dar osmon kh'amagi] Allokh'ro ba poki mesitoiand. Kh'ar iak az onon niioishu sitoishi kheshro medonad va Allokh' taolo ba on chi mekunand, ogokh' ast
Va farmonravoii osmonkh'o va zamin az oni Allokh' taolo ast va bozgasht [-i kh'ama] ba suii Allokh' taolo ast

Oio nadidi, ki Allokh' taolo abrkh'oero ba oromi meronad, sipas baini [ach'zoi] on paivand medikh'ad, on gokh' tudai anbukh'e padid meovarad, pas, k'atrakh'oi boronro mebini, ki az miionash tarovish mekunad va az kukh'kh'oe [az anbukh'i abrkh'o], ki dar osmon ast, donakh'oi zhola furu meborad, pas, onro ba kh'ar ki bikhokh'ad furu merezad va az kh'ar ki bikhokh'ad bozmedorad. Nazdik ast, durakhshandagii bark'ash chashmkh'oro [az bain] barad
Allokh' taolo shabu ruzro megardonad [va paiopai meovarad]. Iak'inan, dar in [gardish] ibrate baroi akh'li basirat ast

Va Allokh' taolo kh'ar mavch'udi zindaero az ob ofarid, pas, barkhe az onon bar shikami khud meravand va barkhe bar du po rokh' meravand va barkhe az onon chakh'or [po] rokh' meravand. Allokh' taolo kh'ar chi bikhokh'ad meofarinad. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo bar kh'ama chiz tavonost
Ba rosti, ki [Mo] oioti ravshangare nozil kardem va Allokh' taolo kh'ar kiro bikhokh'ad, ba rokh'i rost kh'idoiat mekunad

Va [munofik'on] meguiand: <<Ba Allokh' taolo va paiombar [-i U] imon ovardem va [az farmonashon] itoat kardem>>, ammo pas az in [iddao] gurukh'e az onon ruigardon meshavand va inon [dar kh'ak'ik'at] mu'min nestand
Va kh'angome ki ba suii Allokh' taolo va paiombarash farokhonda meshavand, to dar miionashon dovari kunad, nogokh' gurukh'e az onon ruigardon meshavand
Va agar kh'ak' ba onon boshad, muteona [furutanona] ba suii u meoiand
Oio dar dilkh'oiashon bemori ast io [dar borai risolatash] tardid dorand? Io metarsand, ki Allokh' taolo va paiombarash bar onon sitam kunand? [Na] Balki onon khud sitamgorand

Sukhani mu'minon, kh'angome ki ba sui Allokh' taolo va paiombarash farokhonda meshavand, to miionashon dovari kunad, fak'at in ast, ki meguiand: <<Shunidem va itoat kardem>> va inonand, ki rastagorand
Va kh'ar ki az Allokh' taolo va paiombarash itoat kunad va az Allokh' taolo bitarsad va az [nofarmonii] U biparkh'ezad, pas, inon komioband

[Munofik'on] Bo sakhttarin savgandkh'oiashon ba Allokh' taolo savgand iod kardand, ki agar ba onon farmon dikh'i, [baroi ch'ikh'od] rakh'sipor meshavand. Bigu: <<Savgand iod nakuned. Itoat [va sukhanoni durug'aton] shinokhtashuda ast. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo az on chi mekuned, ogokh' ast>>

Bigu: <<Az Allokh' taolo va paiombar itoat kuned, pas, agar sarpechi karded, paiombar mas'uli chizest, ki bar u taklif shudaast [iblog'i vakh'i] va shumo niz mas'uli chize kh'asted, ki ba on taklif shudaed; ammo agar az u itoat kuned, kh'idoiat meshaved; va paiombar vazifae ch'uz rasonidani oshkoro [-i vakh'i] nadorad>>

Allokh' taolo ba afrode az shumo, ki imon ovardaand va korkh'oi shoista anch'om dodaand, va'da dodaast, ki kh'atman, ononro dar zamin ch'onishin [-i mushrikon] mesozad. Kh'amon guna ki kasonero, ki pesh az onon budand, [niz] ch'onishin [-i kofironu sitamgaron] namud va [farmudaast] dinashonro, ki baroi onon pisandidaast, baroiashon ustuvor [-u piruzmand] sozad va tarsashonro ba oromishu amniiat tabdil kunad [charo ki] tankh'o Maro meparastand va chizero bo Man sharik namesozand va kh'ar ki az in pas kufr bivarzad, pas, inonand, ki nofarmonand
Va namoz barpo dored va zakot bipardozed va az paiombar itoat kuned, boshad, ki mavridi rakh'mat k'aror gired

[Ei paiombar] Kh'argiz mapindor kasone, ki kufr varzidand, notavonkunanda [-i Allokh' taolo] dar zaminand [va metavonand az much'ozoti ilokh'i bigrezand]. Ch'oigokh'i inon otash ast va chi bad bozgashtangokh'est!

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, bardagonaton va kasone az [kudakoni] shumo, ki ba sinni bulug' narasidaand, boiad dar se vak't az shumo ich'ozat [-i vurud] bigirand: pesh az namozi subkh' va nimruz - kh'angome ki liboskh'oiatonro berun meovared - va pas az namozi khuftan. [In] Se [vak't] kh'angomi khilvati shumost. Ba ch'uz in [ce vak't] bar shumo va bar onon kh'ech' gunokh'e nest [ki biduni ich'ozat vorid shavand, charo ki] onon peromunaton dar raftu omadand, [va] bo iakdigar [muoshirat mekuned]. Allokh' taolo inchunin oiot [-i khud]-ro baroiaton baion mekunad va Allokh' taolo donoi kh'akim ast

Va kh'angome ki kudakonaton ba sinni bulug' rasidand, boiad [baroi vurud ba khonakh'oi digaron] ich'ozat bigirand, chunonki buzurgsolone, ki [akh'komashonro] pesh az onkh'o [sharkh' dodem niz] boiad ich'ozat megiriftand. Allokh' taolo inchunin oiotashro baroiaton baion mekunad va Allokh' taolo donoi kh'akim ast

Va bar zanon [-i ioisavu pirazan va] az kor aftodae, ki [digar mailu] umedi zanoshui nadorand, gunokh'e nest, ki pushish [-i saru surat]-i kheshro kanor guzorand, [ba sharti on ki oroish va] zinatero oshkor nakunand va agar iffat bivarzand [va khudro bipushonand] baroiashon bekh'tar ast. Va Allokh' taolo shunavoi donost

Bar [afrodi] nobino va langu bemor [ki az takolifi ich'timoi - kh'amchun ch'ikh'od - maof shudaand] gunokh'e nest va [kh'amchunin] bar khudi shumo gunokh'e nest, ki az khonakh'oi khud [io farzandonu kh'amsaronaton g'izoe] bikhured io az khonakh'oi padaronaton io khonakh'oi modaronaton io khonakh'oi barodaronaton io khonakh'oi khokh'aronaton io khonakh'oi amukh'oiaton io khonakh'oi ammakh'oiaton io khonakh'oi tag'okh'oiaton io khonakh'oi kholakh'oiaton io khonae, ki kalidash dar ikhtiiori shumost io [az khonakh'oi] dustonaton. Bar shumo gunokh'e nest, ki dastach'am'i io ch'udogona [g'izo] bikhured va kh'angome ki ba khonakh'o vorid meshaved, ba iakdigar salom kuned, ki durude muborak [va] pisandida az suii Allokh' taolo ast. Allokh' taolo in guna oioti [khesh]-ro baroiaton ba ravshani baion mekunad, boshad, ki biandeshed

Mu'minoni [vok'ei] kasone kh'astand, ki ba Allokh' taolo va Paiombarash imon ovardaand va kh'angome ki baroi [ich'roi iak] amri ich'timoi bo u [paiombar] kh'amrokh' kh'astand, to az vai ich'ozat nagiriftaand, [az ch'am'] khorich' nameshavand. Be tardid, kasone, ki az tu ich'ozat megirand, ononand, ki ba Allokh'u paiombarash imon ovardaand. Pas, agar baroi anch'omi barkhe korkh'o [-i mukh'im]-i khud az tu ich'ozat mekhokh'and, ba kh'ar iak az onon, ki mekhokh'i ich'ozat bidekh' va az Allokh' taolo baroiashon omurzish bikhokh'. Ba rosti, ki Allokh' taolo omurzandai mekh'rubon ast

Farokhonii paiombar [baroi shirkat dar korkh'oi gurukh'e]-ro baini khud kh'amchun farokhonii iakdigar talak'k'i nakuned [ki bitavoned onro bipazired io rad kuned]. Iak'inan, Allokh' taolo afrode az shumoro, ki pushti digaron pinkh'on meshavand va makhfiiona [az nazdi paiombar] megurezand, [ba khubi] meshinosad. pas kasone, ki az farmonash sarpechi mekunand, boiad bitarsand az in ki andukh' va baloe bar sarashon biioiad io ba azobe dardnok giriftor shavand

Ogokh' boshed! Be tardid, on chi dar osmonkh'o va zamin ast az oni Allokh' taolo ast va iak'inan, U medonad, ki shumo [bar chi koru] dar chi kh'ole kh'asted va ruze, ki [bandagon] ba suiash bozgardonda meshavand, ononro az on chi [dar dunio] kardaand, ogokh' mesozad va Allokh' taolo ba kh'ar chize donost
Purbarakat [va buzurgvor] ast, kase, ki K'ur'onro [ki ch'udokunandai kh'ak' va botil ast] bar bandaash nozil kard, to bimdikh'andai ch'akh'oniion boshad

Kh'amono farmonravoii osmonkh'o va zamin az oni Ust va farzande [baroi khesh] barnaguzidaast va dar farmonravoi kh'ech' sharike nadorad va kh'ama chizro ofaridaast va andozai kh'ar chizro - chunon ki munosibash meboshad - tadbir namudaast

Va [mushrikon] ba ch'oii U [Allokh' taolo] ma'budone barguzidaand, ki chize nameofarinand va khud ofarida meshavand va moliki kh'ech' ziionu sude baroi khud nestand va [niz] moliki margu zindagi va [k'odir ba] barangekhtani [murdagon] nestand

Va kasone, ki kufr varzidand, guftand: <<In [K'ur'on] ch'uz durug'e nest, ki [Mukh'ammad] boftaast va gurukh'e digar uro bar in [kor] iori dodaand>>. Kh'ak'k'o, ki onon [bo in sukhan] ba sitamu durug'i buzurge rui ovardaand
Va [kofiron] guftand: <<[In K'ur'on kh'amon] afsonakh'oi peshiniion ast, ki [Mukh'ammad] onro runavisi kardaast va kh'ar bomdodu shomgokh' bar u imlo meshavad>>
Bigu: <<Kase onro nozil kardaast, ki rozi osmonkh'o va zaminro medonad. Be tardid, U kh'amvora omurzanda [va] mekh'rubon ast

Va [mushrikon] guftand: <<In chi guna paiombarest, ki [kh'amchun mardumi odi] g'izo mekhurad va dar bozorkh'o rokh' meravad? Charo farishtae bar u nozil nashudaast, to [ioriash kunad va] kh'amrokh'i u kh'ushdordikh'anda boshad?
Io charo ganch'e [az osmon] bar u furud nameoiad va io charo bog'e nadorad, ki az [mevakh'oi] on bikhurad>>? Sitamgoron [-i mushrik] guftand: <<Shumo ch'uz az marde ch'odushuda pairavi namekuned>>
Bingar, ki chi guna baroiat masalkh'o zadand va gumrokh' shudand! Chunon ki nametavonand rokh'e [ba sui kh'ak'ik'at] biioband

Purbarakat [va buzurgvor] ast, kase, ki agar bikhokh'ad, baroiat bekh'tar az in k'aror medikh'ad: bog'kh'oe, ki ch'uiborkh'o az zeri [darakhtoni] on ch'ori ast va [kh'atto] baroiat kokhkh'oe padid meovarad
[Mushrikon bo in sukhanon dar paii kh'ak' naraftand] Balki k'iiomatro durug' angoshtand va [Mo] baroi kh'ar ki k'iiomatro durug' angorad, otashi suzon [-i duzakhro] mukh'aiio kardaem
Kh'angome ki [duzakh] ononro az durdast mebinad ovozi khashmu khurush [-i vakh'shatnok]-e az on meshunavand
Va chun dastupobasta [bo g'ulu zanch'ir] dar tangnoe az on andokhta shavand, dar on ch'o margashonro ba fariod mekhokh'and
[Ba onon gufta meshavad] <<Imruz na iak bor, balki borkh'o darkhosti marg kuned>>
[Ei paiombar, ba kofiron] Bigu: <<In [azobi dardnok] bekh'tar ast io bikh'ishti ch'ovidoni, ki ba parkh'ezkoron va'da doda shuda va podoshu saranch'omi onon ast?>>
Dar on ch'o kh'ar chi bikhokh'and, baroiashon [farokh'am] ast [va] dar on ch'ovidonand. In va'dae ast bar [ukh'dai] Parvardigorat, ki [bandagoni parkh'ezkor anch'omashro] az U khostaand

Va ruze, ki [kh'amai] onon va on chiro, ki ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo meparastidand, ch'am' mekunad va [ba ma'budoni botil] mefarmoiad: <<Oio shumo in bandagoni Maro gumrokh' karded io khud rokh'ro gum kardand?>>

Onon meguiand: <<Tu munazzakh'i, shoistai mo nabud, ki ba ch'oii Tu [dustonu] korsozone barguzinem, vale Tu onon va padaronashonro [az ne'matkh'o] bakh'ramand sokhti, to in ki iod [-i Tu]-ro faromush kardand va [bad-in khotir] gurukh'e kh'alokshuda gashtand>>

[Allokh' taolo ba mushrikon mefarmoiad] <<Be tardid, [ma'budonaton] iddaoi shumoro durug' shumurdand. Pas, [aknun] nametavoned [azobro az khud] dur kuned va na [az kase] iori bich'ued va kh'ar iak az shumo, ki [shirk bivarzad va ba khud] sitam kunad, azobe buzurg ba vai mechashonem>>

[Ei paiombar] Pesh az tu paiombaronro nafiristodem, magar in ki onon niz g'izo mekhurdand va [kh'amchun digar insonkh'o] dar bozorkh'o rokh' meraftand va mo barkhe az shumoro vasilai ozmoishi barkhe digar sokhtem, [to ravshan shavad] oio shikeboi mekuned. Va Parvardigorat kh'amvora binost

Kasone, ki ba didori Mo [dar okhirat] umed nadorand, guftand: <<Charo farishtagone bar mo nozil nashudaand, io [charo] Parvardigoramonro namebinem>>? Be tardid, onon dar borai khud takabbur varzidand va sarkashii buzurg kardand

Ruze, ki [kofiron] farishtagonro mebinand, kh'ech' bashorate baroi much'rimon nakhokh'ad bud, [balki ruzi kaifaru azob ast] va [farishtagon] meguiand: <<[Bikh'isht] Bar shumo mamnu' [va kh'arom] ast>>
Va ba [barrasii] korkh'oiashon mepardozem va kh'amaro [kh'amchun] g'ubore parokanda mesozem
Dar on ruz bikh'ishtiion bekh'tarin ch'oigokh'u nakutarin istirokh'atgokh'ro dorand
Va [iod kun az] ruze, ki osmon bo abrkh'oi saped shikofta meshavad va farishtagon [paiopai ba sarzamini makh'shar] furu firistoda meshavand
Dar on ruz farmonravoi [-i rostin] az oni [Allokh'i] Rakh'mon ast va baroi kofiron ruze dushvor ast
Va [iod kun az] ruze, ki sitamgor dastonashro [az kh'asrat] megazad va meguiad: <<Ei kosh, man rokh'e [kh'amokh'ang] bo paiombar barguzida budam!
Ei voi bar man! Ei kosh, falon [kofir]-ro ba dusti namegiriftam!
Be tardid, pas az on ki K'ur'on [va da'vati paiombar] ba man rasid, u [bud, ki] maro ba gumrokh'i kashond va shaiton kh'amvora insonro tankh'o [va khor] vomeguzorad>>
Va Paiombar guft: <<Parvardigoro, k'avmi man in K'ur'onro rakh'o kardaand>>
Va inchunin baroi kh'ar paiombare dushmane az badkoroni [k'avmash] k'aror dodem. Va kofi ast, ki Parvardigorat rokh'namo va iovarat boshad

Va kasone, ki kufr varzidand, guftand: <<Charo K'ur'on iakbora bar u nozil nashudaast?>> Mo in guna [kalomi ilokh'iro ba murur nozil] kardaem, to dilatro bo on [orom va] ustuvor gardonem va onro ba tadrich' bar tu khondaem [to darku kh'ifzash oson boshad]
Va [kofiron] kh'ech' [e'tirozu] masale baroiat nameovarand, magar on ki Mo [niz posukhe] bar kh'ak' va khushbaiontar baroiat meovarem
Kasone, ki ba rui daraftoda ba duzakh kashonda meshavand, inon badch'oigokh'tar va gumrokh'tarand
Va dar kh'ak'ik'at, Mo ba Muso kitob [Tavrot] dodem va barodarash Kh'orunro dastiorash sokhtem
Va guftem: <<Shumo du nafar ba sui k'avme biraved, ki oioti Moro durug' angoshtand>>. Pas, [chun fir'avniion sarpechi namudand] ba shiddat nobudashon sokhtem
Va k'avmi Nukh'ro - on gokh' ki paiombaronro durug'gu angoshtand - g'ark' kardem va ononro baroi mardum [nishona va] ibrate k'aror dodem; va baroi sitamgoron azobe dardnok mukh'aiio kardaem
Va [kh'amchunin] k'avmi Od va Samud va akh'olii "chokh'" va naslkh'oi bisiorero, ki baini onon budand [nobud sokhtem]
Va baroi kh'ar iak az onkh'o masalkh'o zadem va [chun pand nagiriftand] kh'amaro ba shiddat az miion burdem

Va [mushrikon] kh'atman, az [sarzamini k'avmi Lut kh'amon] shakh're, ki boroni balo bar on borida bud, guzar kardaand. Oio on [vaironakh'oi bok'imonda az azob] -ro nadidaand? [Chunin nest] Balki ba zinda shudan [pas az marg] umede nadorand
Va kh'angome ki turo mebinand, fak'ta ba tamaskhur megirand [va meguiand] <<Oio in kh'amon kasest, ki Allokh' taolo ba paiombari firistodaast?

Agar bar [parastishi] ma'budonamon [shikeboi va] poidori namekardem, nazdik bud [Mukh'ammad] az [rokh'i] onkh'o gumrokh'amon kunad>>. Vale on gokh' ki azob [-i ilokh'i]-ro bubinand, khokh'and donist chi kase gumrokh'tar [buda] ast
Oio kase, ki kh'avoi nafsashro ma'budi khud kardaast, didai? Oio tu [metavoni] nigakh'boni [imoni] u boshi?
Oio gumon dori, ki beshtarashon meshunavand io mefakh'mand? Onon ch'uz kh'ammonandi chakh'orpoion nestand, balki gumrokh'tarand

Oio [ofarinishi] Parvardigoratro nadidai, ki chi guna soiaro gustaronidaast va agar mekhost, onro sobit menamud? On gokh' [tag'iiri ch'oigokh'i] khurshed [nisbat ba zamin]-ro daleli [gustarishu kh'arakati] on [soia] k'aror dodem
Sipas [bo tag'iiri balandii khurshed soiaro kutokh' mekunem va] onro andak-andak ba suii khesh bozmegirem
Va Ust, ki shabro [bo torikii farogirash] pushishe baroi shumo k'aror dod va khobro moiai osoish va ruzro kh'angomi barkhostan [va koru talosh] sokht
Va Ust, ki pesh az [boroni] rakh'matash bodkh'oro bashoratbakhsh firistod va az osmon obe pok [va pokkunanda] furu firistodem
To bo on sarzamini [khushku] murdaro zinda gardonem va chakh'orpoion va insonkh'oi bisiorero, ki ofaridaem, serob sozem
Va ba rosti, on [daloilu nishonakh'oi k'udrati ilokh'i]-ro ba suratkh'oi gunogun baion kardem, to pand girand, vale beshtar mardum ch'uz [inkoru] nosiposi nakardand
Va agar mekhostem, dar kh'ar diiore bimdikh'andae barmeangekhtem
Pas, [ei paiombar] az kofiron itoat nakun va ba vasilai K'ur'on bo onon ba ch'ikh'odi buzurge barkhez [va dar in rokh' shikebo bosh]
Va Ust, ki du darioro ba kh'am omekht: in iake khushguvor va shirin ast va on iake shuru talkh va dar miioni on du moneai nufuznopazire k'aror dod [to bo kh'am naiomezand]
Va Ust, ki insonro az obi [mani] ofarid va uro doroi paivandi nasabi va sababi gardonid va Parvardigorat kh'amvora tavonost
Va [mushrikon] ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo chizero meparastand, ki na ba onon sude mebakhshad va na ziione merasonad va kofir dar barobari Parvardigorash paivasta pushtibon [-i shaiton] ast
Va [ei paiombar] Mo turo ch'uz bashoratbakhsh va bimdikh'anda nafiristodem
Bigu: <<Man [dar barobari risolatam] kh'ech' podoshe az shumo namekhokh'am, magar kase, ki bikhokh'ad rokh'e ba sui Parvardigorash barguzinad [va kh'amin baroiam kofi ast]>>
Va bar [Parvardigori] zindae, ki kh'argiz namemirad, tavakkal kun va bo citoish Uro ba poki iod kun. Va kh'amin bas, ki U ba gunokh'oni bandagonash ogokh' ast

[Kh'amon] Kase, ki osmonkh'o va zamin va on chiro miioni onkh'ost dar shash ruz ofarid, sipas bar Arsh k'aror girift. [U Allokh'i] Rakh'mon ast, pas, dar mavridi U az on ki ogokh' ast, bipurs [va U niz kase ch'uz Allokh' taolo nest]

Va kh'angome ki ba ba onon gufta shavad: <<Baroi [Allokh'i] Rakh'mon sach'da kuned>>, meguiand: <<Rakh'mon kist? Oio [k'aror ast] bar kh'ar chi tu amr mekuni sach'da barem>>? Va [in da'vati tu duri az kh'ak' va] nafratashonro meafzoiad
Purbarakat [va buzurgvor] ast, on ki dar osmon manzilgokh'kh'oe [baroi sitoragon] k'aror dod va dar [miioni] onkh'o khurshed [-i durakhshon] va mokh'i tobone padid ovard
Va Ust, ki shabu ruzro dar paii iakdigar k'aror dod, baroi kh'ar ki bikhokh'ad [az tadbiri ilokh'i] pand girad io siposguzor boshad

Va bandagoni [mu'minu shoistai] Rakh'mon kasone kh'astand, ki bo furutani [va matonat] bar zamin rokh' meravand va kh'angome ki ch'okh'ilon [bo sukhanoni nopisand] khitobashon mekunand, [ba ch'oi talofi bo onon] ba neki sukhan meguiand
Va kasone baroi Parvardigorashon dar kh'oli sach'da va k'iiom shabzindadori mekunand
Va kasone, ki meguiand: <<Parvardigoro, azobi duzakhro az mo bozgardon, [ki] be tardid, azobash [sakhtu] poidor ast
Kh'ak'k'o, ki duzakh bad ch'oigokh' va ik'omatgokh'est
Va [mu'minon] kasone kh'astand, ki chun infok' menamoiand, na ziiodaravi mekunand va na sakhtgiri va baini in du [kh'olat rokh'i] e'tidol pesh megirand

Va kasone kh'astand, ki bo Allokh' taolo ma'bude digar namekhonand va kase, ki Allokh' taolo [kushtanashro] kh'arom kardaast, ch'uz ba kh'ak' namekushand va zino namekunand. Va kh'ar ki in [gunokh'on]-ro murtakib shavad, kaifari gunokh'i [khesh]-ro mebinad
Ruzi k'iiomat azobash duchandon megardad va bo khori dar on [azob] ch'ovidon memonad

Magar kase, ki tavba kunad va imon ovarad va kore shoista anch'om dikh'ad. Pas, inonand, ki Allokh' taolo badikh'oiashonro ba nekikh'o tabdil mekunad va Allokh' taolo kh'amvora omurzgoru mekh'rubon ast
Va kase, ki tavba kunad va kore shoista anch'om dikh'ad, pas, iak'inan ba dargokh'i Allokh' taolo - chunon ki boiadu shoiad - tavba kardaast

Va kasone [mu'minand], ki guvokh'ii durug' namedikh'and [va dar mach'olisi botil kh'uzur nameioband] va chun ba [kori nopisand io] bekh'udae barkhurd mekunand, buzurgvorona [az kanorash] meguzarand [va khudro oluda namesozand]
Va kasone, ki chun ba oioti Parvardigorashon pand doda meshavand, [az on g'aflat namekunand va dar barobari K'ur'on] chun karonu kuron nestand

Va kasone, ki meguiand: <<Parvardigoro, az kh'amsaronu farzandonamon [kasonero] ba mo ato farmo, ki [moiai shodii dilkh'o va] ravshanii chashmkh'o boshand va moro peshvoi parkh'ezkoron k'aror bidekh'>>
[Ore] Inon ba posi on ki shikeboi kardaand, manozil [-i olii bikh'isht]-ro podosh megirand va dar on ch'o bo durudu salomi [farishtagon] ru ba ru megardand
Dar on ch'o ch'ovidonand. Chi naku ch'oigokh' va [chi nek] ik'omatgokh'e ast!

[Ba kofiron] bigu: <<Agar ibodat va duoiaton naboshad, Parvardigoram e'tinoe ba shumo nadorad [va arzishe baroiaton k'oil nest]. Ba rosti, shumo [da'vati kh'ak'ro] durug' angoshted, pas, ba zudi [kaifari in kor] girebongiraton khokh'ad shud
To, sin, mim
In oioti kitobi ravshangar ast
Shoiad mekhokh'i az [andukh'i] in ki [mushrikon] imon nameovarand, khudro kh'alok kuni
Agar bikhokh'em, az osmon nishonae bar onon nozil mekunem, ki dar barobarash bo furutani sar furud ovarand
Va kh'ech' pandi tozae az sui [Allokh'i] Rakh'mon baroi onon nameoiad, magar in ki az on rui gardonand
Ba rosti, onon [da'vati paiombaron va azobi k'iiomatro] durug' angoshtand, pas, ba zudi akhbori on chi maskhara mekardand, ba eshon khokh'ad rasid
Oio ba zamin namenigarand, ki chi bisior az kh'ar guna [giiokh'i] sudmande dar on ruionidaem?
Be tardid, dar in [ofarinish] nishonae [az k'udrati Allokh' taolo bar meod] ast, vale beshtarashon imon nameovarand
Va be tardid, Parvardigorat shikastnopaziri mekh'rubon ast
Va [iod kun az] kh'angome ki Parvardigorat Musoro nido dod, ki: <<Ba suii k'avmi sitamgor birav
- k'avmi Fir'avn - [va ba onon bigu] oio [az kufru sarkashi] nameparkh'ezand?>>
[Muso] Guft: <<Parvardigoro, bim doram, ki maro durug'gu angorand
Va [az kufrashon noshikebo va] g'amgin gardam. Pas, [Ch'abrailro] ba suii Kh'orun bifrist [to baroi ioriam rakh'siporash kunad]
Va onon [ba gumoni khesh k'asosi] gunokh'e bar man dorand, pas, metarsam, ki maro bikushand>>
[Allokh' taolo] Farmud: <<Kh'argiz! Pas bo oiot [va mu'ch'izot]-i Mo biraved. Iak'inan, [kh'ama ch'o] bo shumoem va [guftuguiatonro] meshunavem
Pas, nazdi Fir'avn biraved va bigued: <<Mo firistodai Parvardigori ch'akh'oniion kh'astem
[U mefarmoiad] Ki Bani Isroilro kh'amrokh'i mo bifirist>>
[Fir'avn] guft: <<Oio turo dar kudaki miioni khesh parvarish nadodem va solkh'oe az umratro baini mo nabudi?
Va kori khudro - chunon ki khosti - kardi [va on mardi k'ibtiro kushti] va tu [nisbat ba ne'matkh'oi man] nosiposi?!>>
[Muso] guft: <<Man on [kor]-ro zamone anch'om dodam, ki gumrokh' budam
Pas, chun az shumo tarsidam, firor kardam. On gokh' Parvardigoram ba man donish bakhshid va maro az paiombaron k'aror dod
Va in [chi] ne'matest, ki tu bar man minnat meguzori, ki Bani Isroilro bardai khud sokhtai?!>>
Fir'avn guft: <<Parvardigori ch'akh'oniion kist?>>
[Muso] Guft: <<Parvardigori osmonkh'o va zamin va on chi miioni onkh'ost. Agar akh'li iak'in kh'asted [tankh'o uro biparasted]>>
[Fir'avn] Ba kasone, ki dar atrofash budand [bo tamaskhur] guft: <<Oio meshunaved [chi meguiad]?>>
[Muso] Guft: <<[Allokh' taolo] Parvardigori shumo va Parvardigori niiogoni shumost
[Fir'avn] Guft: <<In paiombaraton, ki ba suii shumo firistoda shudaast, iak'inan devona ast>>
[Muso] Guft: <<Agar biandeshed, [khokh'ed donist, ki U] Parvardigori mashrik' va mag'rib ast va kh'ar on chi miioni on du k'aror dorad>>
[Fir'avn] Guft: <<Agar ma'bude ch'uz man barguzini, kh'atman, zindonat mekunam>>
[Muso] Guft: <<Kh'atto agar nishonai oshkore [dar mavridi risolatam] baroiat ovarda bosham?>>
[Fir'avn] Guft: <<Agar rost megui, onro biiovar>>
Pas, [Muso] asoi khudro andokht, nogakh'on [tabdil ba] azhdakh'oe oshkor shud
Va dastashro [az girebon] berun ovard va nogokh' dar nazari binandagon saped [-u ravshan] bud
[Fir'avn] ba buzurgoni peromunash guft: <<Kh'ak'k'o, ki in [mard] ch'odugari donost
[U] Mekhokh'ad, bo ch'oduiash shumoro az sarzaminaton berun kunad, pas, nazaraton chist?>>
Onon guftand: <<[Tasmim dar borai much'ozoti] u va barodarashro ba ta'khir andoz va ma'muroni ch'am'ovari [ch'orzanandagon]-ro ba [kh'amai] shakh'rkh'o bifirist,
to kh'ar ch'odugari mokh'ir [va] donoero nazdat biiovarand>>
Pas, [chunin kardand va saranch'om] ch'odugaron baroi va'dagokh'i ruzi muaiian gird ovarda shudand
Va ba mardum gufta shud: <<Oio shumo [niz] ch'am' meshaved, to [bubinem baranda kist]?
Agar ch'odugaron piruz shudand, [kh'amagi] az onon pairavi kunem>>
Pas, vak'te ch'odugaron omadand, ba Fir'avn guftand: <<Agar mo piruz shavem, oio podoshe khokh'em dosht>>?
U guft: <<Ore, dar on surat, kh'atman, az nazdikonam khokh'ed bud>>
Muso ba onon guft: <<Kh'ar chi [mekhokh'ed] biafkaned, [aknun] biafkaned>>
Pas, onon resmonkh'o va asokh'oiashonro afkandand va guftand: <<Ba izzati Fir'avn savgand, ki mo, kh'atman, piruzem>>
Sipas Muso asoiashro afkand, nogakh'on [tabdil ba azhdakh'oe shud va] on chiro, ki ba durug' sokhta budand, bal'id [furu burd]
Pas, ch'odugaron ba sach'da daraftodand
[Va] Guftand: <<Mo ba Parvardigori ch'akh'oniion imon ovardem
Parvardigori Muso va Kh'orun>>

[Fir'avn] Guft: <<Oio pesh az on ki ba shumo ich'ozat dikh'am, ba u imon ovarded? Be tardid, u kh'amon buzurgi shumost, ki ba shumo ch'odu omukhtaast. Pas, ba zudi khokh'ed donist [ki much'ozotaton chist]. Iak'inan, dastkh'o va poikh'oiatonro bar'aks [-i iakdigar az chapu rost] k'at' mekunam va kh'amagiatonro ba dor meovezam>>
Onon guftand: <<[Dar in shikanch'a va azob] Kh'ech' ziione nest. Be tardid, mo ba suii Parvardigoramon bozmegardem
Umed dorem, ki Parvardigoramon gunokh'oni moro bubakhshad, ki mo nakhustin kasone kh'astem, ki [az in k'avm ba Parvardigori Muso] imon ovardem>>
Va ba Muso vakh'i kardem, ki: <<Bandagonamro shabona [az Misr] berun bibar; [zero sipokh'i Fir'avn] kh'atman, ba dunbolaton khokh'ad omad>>
Pas Fir'avn [chun az moch'aro ogokh' gardid] ma'muroni ch'am'ovari [neru]-ro ba shakh'rkh'o firistod
[Va e'lon kard] Inkh'o [Bani Isroil] iddai nochizand
Va ch'iddan moro ba khashm ovardaand
Va mo kh'amagi komilan [kh'ushioru] omodai paikorem>>
Pas, ononro az bog'kh'o va chashmakh'o [-i sarzamini Misr] berun ovardem
Va az ganch'kh'o va khonakh'oi much'allal [dur sokhtem]
Inchunin [kardem] va Bani Isroilro vorisi on [sarvatu doroi] kardem
Pas, [sipokh'i Fir'avn] kh'angomi tului oftob ba ta'k'ibi onon pardokhtand
Va chun du gurukh' iakdigarro didand, ioroni Muso guftand: <<Kh'atman, [dar changoli fir'avniion] giriftorem>>
[Muso] Guft: <<Kh'argiz! Be tardid, Parvardigoram bo man ast va maro [ba rokh'i nach'ot] kh'idoiat khokh'ad kard>>
Pas, ba Muso vakh'i kardem: <<Asoiatro ba dario bizan>>, pas, [Nil] shikofta shud va kh'ar bakhshe [az on] kh'amchun kukh'e buzurg gasht
Va on gurukh'i digar [sipokh'i Fir'avn]-ro ba on ch'o kashondem
Va Muso va kh'amai kasonero, ki kh'amrokh'ash budand, nach'ot dodem
Va digaronro g'ark' namudem
Kh'atman, dar in [moch'aro] nishonae [baroi ibrat giriftan] ast, vale beshtarashon mu'min nabudand
Va be tardid, Parvardigorat kh'amon shikastnopaziri mekh'rubon ast
[Ei paiombar] Dostoni Ibrokh'imro bar onon bozgu
Kh'angome ki ba padar va k'avmash guft: <<Chi chizro meparasted?>>
Onon guftand: <<Butkh'oero meparastem va paivasta sar bar ostonashon dorem>>
[Ibrokh'im] Guft: <<Oio vak'te onkh'oro mekhoned, [sadoi] shumoro meshunavand?
Io ba shumo sudu ziion merasonand?>>
Onon guftand: <<[Na] Vale padaronamonro ioftem, ki chunin mekardand>>
[Ibrokh'im] guft: <<Oio dided [va donisted] chizkh'oero, ki kh'amvora meparastided
- [kh'am] shumo va [kh'am] padaronaton -
iak'inan, [kh'amai] onkh'o dushmani [ak'idai tavkh'idii] man kh'astand. Magar Parvardigori ch'akh'oniion
On [ma'bude], ki maro ofarida va kh'idoiatam mekunad
Va kh'amone, ki ba man g'izo medikh'ad va serobam mesozad
Va kh'angome ki bemor meshavam, Ust, ki shifoiam medikh'ad
Va kase, ki maro memironad va [dubora] zindaam mekunad
Va kase, ki umed doram ruzi ch'azo gunokh'onamro bubakhshad
Parvardigoro, ba man donishe [dar din] bubakhsh va maro ba shoistagon mulkh'ak' kun
Va baroiam dar oiandagon ovozai nek k'aror bidekh'
Va maro az vorisoni bikh'ishti purne'mat bigardon
Va padaramro biiomurz, [ki] be tardid, dar zumrai gumrokh'on bud
Va ruze, ki [mardum] barangekhta meshavand, maro rasvo [va sharmanda] nasoz
Kh'amon ruze, ki molu farzandon sude namebakhshand
Magar kase, ki bo k'albi pok [va kholi az shirku nifok' va riio] ba peshgokh'i Allokh' taolo biioiad>>
Va [on ruz] bikh'isht baroi parkh'ezkoron nazdik megardad
Va duzakh baroi gumrokh'on oshkor meshavad
Va ba onon gufta meshavad: <<On chi ba ch'oi Allokh' taolo meparastided, [aknun] kuch'o kh'astand?
Oio [onkh'o dar barobari azobi ilokh'i] ioriaton mekunand io [kh'atto khud]-ro iori medikh'and?>>
Pas, onkh'o [butkh'o] kh'amrokh'i gumrokh'on dar on [otashi kh'avlangez] afkanda meshavand
Va [kh'amrokh'i] tamomi lashkariioni Iblis
Dar on ch'o [mushrikon] dar kh'oli sitez [bo ma'budoni botil] meguiand:
<<Ba Allokh' taolo savgand, ki mo dar gumrokh'ii oshkore budem>>
On gokh' ki shumoro bo Parvardigori ch'akh'oniion barobar medonistem
Va moro kase ch'uz much'rimon gumrokh' nakard
Pas, [aknun] na kh'ech' shafoatgare dorem
Va na kh'ech' dusti mekh'rubone
Pas, kosh bozgashte [ba dunio] doshtem va dar zumrai mu'minon k'aror megiriftem>>
Kh'atman, dar in [moch'aro] nishonae [baroi ibrat giriftan] ast, vale beshtarashon mu'min nabudand
Va be tardid, Parvardigorat kh'amon shikastnopaziri mekh'rubon ast
K'avmi Nukh' paiombaronro durug'gu angoshtand
On gokh' ki barodarashon Nukh' ba onon guft: <<Oio [az Allokh' taolo] parvo namekuned?>>
Ba rosti, man baroi shumo paiombari amin kh'astam
Pas, az Allokh' taolo parvo kuned va mutei [dasturkh'oi] man boshed
Va man [dar barobari risolatam] kh'ech' podoshe az shumo namekhokh'am. Podoshi man tankh'o bar [ukh'dai] Parvardigori ch'akh'oniion ast
Pas, az Allokh' taolo parvo kuned va mutei [dasturkh'oi] man boshed>>
Onon guftand: <<Oio ba tu imon biiovarem, dar kh'ole ki [fak'at] furumoiagon] az tu pairavi kardaand?>>
[Nukh'] Guft: <<Man ba on chi onon [dar guzashta] mekardand, chi donishe doram?
Kh'isobi onon tankh'o bo Parvardigori man ast. Agar mefakh'med [chunin sukhani gazofe nagued]
Va man [kh'argiz] mu'minonro tard [dur] namekunam
Man ch'uz bimdikh'andai oshkor nestam>>
Onon guftand: <<Ei Nukh', agar [az da'vatat] dast barnadori, kh'atman, sangsor meshavi>>
U guft: <<Parvardigoro, k'avmam maro durug'gu angoshtand
Pas, miioni manu eshon dovari kun va maro va mu'minonero, ki kh'amrokh'am kh'astand, nach'ot bidekh'>>
Pas, u va afrodero, ki kh'amrokh'ash budand, dar [on] kishtii oganda [ pur az insonu kh'aivon] nach'ot dodem
Va bok'imondagonro g'ark' kardem
Kh'atman, dar in [moch'aro] nishonae [baroi ibrat giriftan] ast, vale beshtarashon mu'min nabudand
Va be tardid, Parvardigorat kh'amon shikastnopaziri mekh'rubon ast
[K'avmi] Od paiombaronro durug'gu angoshtand
On gokh' ki barodarashon Kh'ud ba onon guft: <<Oio [az Allokh' taolo] parvo namekuned?"
Ba rosti, man baroi shumo paiombari amin kh'astam
Pas, az Allokh' taolo parvo kuned va mutei [dasturkh'oi] man boshed
Va man [dar barobari risolatam] kh'ech' podoshe az shumo namekhokh'am. Podoshi man tankh'o bar [ukh'dai] Parvardigori ch'akh'oniion ast
Oio bar kh'ar makoni balande binoe bekh'uda mesozed?
Va k'asrkh'o va k'al'akh'oi mukh'kamu ustuvor bino mekuned, guiio [dar dunio] ch'ovidonaed
Va chun [ba kase] kh'amlavar meshaved, [berakh'm va] zolimona kh'amla mekuned
Pas, az Allokh' taolo parvo kuned va mutei [dasturkh'oi] man boshed
Va az kase parvo kuned, ki ba shumo [ne'matkh'oe chunon farovon] ato kardaast, ki khud [onkh'oro bekh'tar] medoned
U ba shumo chakh'orpoionu farzandon [-i bisior] ato kardaast
Va bog'kh'o va chashmasorkh'o
Ba rosti, ki man az azobi ruzi buzurg bar shumo metarsam"
Onon guftand: "Chi moro pand bidikh'i, io nadikh'i, baroiamon iakson ast [va az tu toat namekunem]
In [oini mo kh'amon] ravishi peshiniion ast
va mo [kh'argiz] azob nakhokh'em shud>>
Pas, onon Kh'udro durug'gu angoshtand. Pas, Mo [niz] kh'alokashon kardem. Kh'atman, dar in [moch'aro] nishonae [baroi ibrat giriftan] ast va beshtarashon mu'min nabudand
Va be tardid, Parvardigorat shikastnopaziri mekh'rubon ast
[K'avmi] Samud paiombaronro durug'gu angoshtand
On gokh' ki barodarashon Solekh' ba onon guft: <<Oio [az Allokh' taolo] parvo namekuned?
Ba rosti, man baroi shumo paiombari amin kh'astam
Pas, az Allokh' taolo parvo kuned va mutei [dasturkh'oi] man boshed
Va man [dar barobari risolatam] kh'ech' podoshe az shumo namekhokh'am. Podoshi man tankh'o bar [ukh'dai] Parvardigori ch'akh'oniion ast
Oio [mepindored, ki] shumoro dar ne'matkh'oe, ki in ch'ost, osuda rakh'o mekunand?
Dar [in] bog'kh'o va chashmasorkh'o
Va [dar kanori in] kishtzorkh'o va nakhlkh'oe, ki mevakh'oiash narmu rasidaast?
Va mokh'irona az kukh'kh'o [baroi khud] khonakh'oe metaroshed
Pas, az Allokh' taolo parvo kuned va mutei [dasturkh'oi] man boshed>>
Va az isrofkoron [-i gunakh'gor] pairavi nakuned
[Kh'amon] Kasone, ki dar zamin ba fasod mepardozand va [kheshtanro] islokh' namekunand"
Onon guftand: "[Ei Solekh'] Ch'uz in nest, ki tu ch'odushudai
Tu ch'uz bashare kh'ammonandi mo nesti, pas, agar rost megui, nishonae [bar paiombariat] biiovar"
[Solekh'] Guft: <<In modashuturest, ki sakh'me az ob [-i chashma] dorad va [ruzkh'oi muaiiane niz] shumo sakh'me az ob dored
Pas, [kamtarin] ozore ba on narasoned, ki azobi ruzi buzurg shumoro faro megirad"
Pas, onro [zakhmi kardand va] kushtand va [on gokh' az kardai khud] pushaimon shudand
Pas, azob [-i ilokh'i] ononro furu girift. Be gumon, dar in [moch'aro] nishonae [baroi ibrat giriftan] ast va beshtarashon mu'min nabudand
Va be tardid, Parvardigorat kh'amon shikastnopaziri mekh'rubon ast
K'avmi Lut [niz] paiombaronro durug'gu angoshtand
On gokh' ki barodarashon Lut ba onon guft: <<Oio [az Allokh' taolo] parvo namekuned?
Ba rosti, man baroi shumo paiombare amin kh'astam
Pas, az Allokh' taolo parvo kuned va mutei [dasturkh'oi] man boshed>>
Va man [dar barobari risolatam] kh'ech' podoshe az shumo namekhokh'am. Podoshi man tankh'o bar [ukh'dai] Parvardigori ch'akh'oniion ast
Az mardumi ch'akh'on bo mardon meomezed
va kh'amsaronero, ki Allokh' taolo baroiaton ofaridaast, rakh'o mekuned? Balki shumo gurukh'i mutach'ovized
Onon guftand: <<Ei Lut, agar [az in amru nakh'i] dast barnadori, kh'atman, [az shakh'r] ikhroch' meshavi>>
[Lut] Guft: <<Man dushmani [sarsakhti] in koraton kh'astam
Parvardigoro, man va khonavodaamro az [ok'ibati] on chi [inkh'o] anch'om medikh'and, nach'ot dekh'>>
Pas, mo u va kh'amai khonavodaashro nach'ot dodem
Magar pirazane, ki dar miioni bozmondagon [dar azob] bud
Sipas digaronro nobud kardem
Va bar onon borone [az sang] boronidem va boroni bimdodashudagon chi bad bud!
Be gumon, dar in [moch'aro] nishonae [baroi ibrat giriftan] ast va beshtarashon mu'min nabudand
Va be tardid, Parvardigorat kh'amon shikastnopaziri mekh'rubon ast
Askh'obi Aika [niz] paiombaronro durug'gu angoshtand
On gokh' ki Shuaib ba onon guft: <<Oio [az Allokh' taolo] parvo namekuned?
Ba rosti, man baroi shumo paiombare amin kh'astam
Pas, az Allokh' taolo parvo kuned [bitarsed] va mutei [dasturkh'oi] man boshed>>
Va man [dar barobari risolatam] kh'ech' podoshe az shumo namekhokh'am. Podoshi man tankh'o bar [ukh'dai] Parvardigori ch'akh'oniion ast
Paimonaro tamom bidikh'ed va kamfurushi nakuned
Va bo tarozui durust vazn kuned
Va koloi mardumro kam nadikh'ed [va kh'ak'k'ashonro zoe' nakuned] va dar zamin ba fasod [va tabokh'i] nakushed
Va az kase, ki shumo va ummatkh'oi peshinro ofarid, parvo kuned [bitarsed]
Onon guftand: <<[Ei Shuaib] Ch'uz in nest, ki tu ch'odushudai
Tu ch'uz bashare kh'ammonandi mo nesti va mo turo durug'gu mepindorem
Pas, agar rost megui, porae az osmonro bar [sari] mo biandoz>>
[Shuaib] Guft: <<Parvardigoram ba on chi mekuned, donotar ast>>
Pas, uro durug'gu angoshtand va azobi ruzi abr [-i otashbor] ononro faro girift. Ba rosti, ki on [boroni otash] azobi ruzi kh'avlnoke bud
Be gumon, dar in [moch'aro] nishonae [baroi ibrat giriftan] ast; va beshtarashon mu'min nabudand
Va be tardid, Parvardigorat kh'amon shikastnopaziri mekh'rubon ast
Va ba rosti, [in] K'ur'on furufiristodai Parvardigori ch'akh'oniion ast
Rukh'u-l-amin [Ch'abrail] onro furud ovardaast
Bar k'albi tu [nozil kardaast], to bimdikh'anda boshi
[K'ur'onro] Ba zaboni arabii ravshan [nozil namud]
Va be tardid, [bashorati nuzuli] on dar kitobkh'oi peshiniion [niz omada] ast
Oio kh'amin nishona baroiashon kofi nest, ki ulamoi Bani Isroil az [kh'ak'ik'ati] K'ur'on ogokh'and?
Va agar onro bar ba'ze az g'airiarabkh'o nozil mekardem
Va [paiombar] onro baroiashon mekhond, ba on imon nameovardand
[Ore] In guna on [kufru takzib]-ro dar dilkh'oi gunakh'goron ch'oi dodem
Ammo ba on imon nameovarand, to on gokh' ki azobi dardnokro bubinand
Pas, nogakh'on dar kh'ole ki bekhabarand, ba surog'ashon meoiad
Pas, [dar on kh'ol] meguiand: "Oio mukh'late [baroi tavba] khokh'em dosht?"
Oio onon azobi moro ba shitob khostorand?
Oio donisti, ki agar ononro solkh'o [az zindagii dunio] bakh'ramand sozem
Sipas on chi ki ba onon va'da doda shudaast, ba surog'ashonn biioiad
In bakh'ramandiashon [az dunio dar kh'angomi azob] sude baroiashon nakhokh'ad dosht?
Va Mo [sokinoni] kh'ech' shakh'rero kh'alok nakardem, magar in ki kh'ushdordikh'andagone [az paiombaron] doshtand
To ononro pand dikh'and va Mo kh'argiz sitamgor nabudaem [ki itmomi kh'uch'ch'at nakunem]
Va in K'ur'onro shaiotin nozil nakardaand
Onon na darkhuri in korand va na tavonashro dorand
Be tardid, onon az shunidani [vakh'i] barkanorand
Pas, [ei paiombar] kh'ech' ma'budero bo Allokh' taolo makhon, ki azob khokh'i shud
Va kheshovandoni nazdikatro [az azobi ilokh'i] bim dekh'
Va bo mu'minone, ki az tu pairavi kardaand, mekh'rubon [-u furutan] bosh
Pas, agar az [farmoni] tu sarpechi kardand, bigu: "Ba rosti, man az on chi mekuned, bezoram"
Va bar [Allokh'i] shikastnopaziri mekh'rubon tavakkal kun
Kh'amon ki chun [baroi ibodat] barmekhezi, turo mebinad
Va kh'arakat [va nishastu barkhosti] turo miioni sach'dakunandagon [mebinad]
Be tardid, U kh'amon shunavoi donost
Oio ba shumo khabar dikh'am, ki shaiotin bar chi kase nozil meshavand?
Bar kh'ar durug'gui gunakh'kor
Onon shunidakh'oe [-ro, ki duzdona az malakut gush dodaand, ba ch'odugaron va folgiron] ilk'o mekunand va beshtarashon durug'gu kh'astand
Va [Mukh'ammad shoir nest, zero] shoironro gumrokh'on pairavi mekunand
Oio nadidi, ki onon dar kh'ar lag'vu bekh'udae [kh'aironu] sargashtaand?
Va chizero meguiand, ki [khud ba on e'tik'od nadorand va] amal namekunand?

Magar kasone, ki imon ovardaand va korkh'oi shoista anch'om dodaand va Allokh'ro bisior iod kardaand va pas az on ki sitam didand, intik'om giriftand [va bo she'ri khud az islomu muslimin difo' namudand] va kasone, ki sitam kardand, ba zudi khokh'and donist, ba chi bozgashtgokh'e bozmegardand
To, sin. In oioti K'ur'on va kitobe ravshangar ast
[Ki] Kh'idoiatu bashorate baroi mu'minon ast
[Kh'amon] Kasone, ki namoz barpo medorand va zakot mepardozand va ba okhirat iak'in dorand
Dar kh'ak'ik'at, kasone, ki ba okhirat imon nameovarand, a'molashonro baroiashon orostaem, pas, [kurdilu] sargashtaand
Ononand, ki azobi dardnok [dar pesh] dorand va dar okhirat ziionkortarand
Va [ei paiombar] iak'inan, tu K'ur'onro az peshgokh'i [Parvardigori] kh'akimi dono darioft mekuni
[Iod kun az] Kh'angome ki Muso ba khonavodaash guft: "[Biisted] Man otashe [az dur] didam. Ba zudi khabare az on baroiaton meovaram io shu'lai otashe meovaram, to garm shaved"

Pas, chun ba on [otash] rasid, nido doda shud, ki: "Muborak [va khuch'asta] bod on ki dar otash ast va kh'ar [farishtae], ki peromuni on ast va poku munazzakh' ast Allokh' taolo - Parvardigori ch'akh'oniion
Ei Muso, ba rosti, ki Manam Allokh'i shikastnopaziri kh'akim

Va asoiatro biafkan. Pas, chun [Muso] onro did, ki kh'amchun more [bo sur'at] mekhazad, [az tars] pusht kard va gurekht va boznagasht. [Nido omad] "Ei Muso, natars! Paiombaron dar peshgokh'i Man kh'ech' tarse nadorand
Ammo kase, ki sitam kunad, on gokh' [pas az tavba] badiro ba neki tabdil namoiad, [bidonad, ki] be tardid, Man omurzandai mekh'rubonam

Va dastatro dar girebon furu bar, [to] saped va biduni aib [-u bemorii pesi] khorich' shavad. [In mu'ch'izaest] Dar zumrai mu'ch'izoti nukh'gona [ki boiad] ba suii Fir'avn va k'avmash [bibari, charo ki] be tardid, onon gurukh'e nofarmonand"
Pas, chun oioti Mo ravshan [-u vozekh'] ba suiashon omad, guftand: "In ch'odue oshkor ast"
Va onkh'oro az rui sitamu sarkashi inkor kardand, dar kh'ole ki dilkh'oiashon ba onkh'o iak'in doshtand; pas bingar, ki saranch'omi mufsidon chi guna buvad
Va ba rosti, ba Dovud va Sulaimon donishe [azim] dodem va onon guftand: "Sitoish az oni Allokh' taolo ast, ki moro bar bisiore az bandagoni mu'mini khud bartari bakhshid"

Va Sulaimon az Dovud meros burd va guft: "Ei mardum, [fakh'mi] zaboni parandagon ba mo omukhta shuda va az kh'ar chiz ba mo [bakh'rae] dodaand. Be tardid, in fazle oshkor [az ch'onibi Parvardigor] ast"
Va sipokh'iioni Sulaimon - az ch'innu ins va parandagon - nazdash gird omadand; on gokh' munazzam [va paivasta dar kanori iakdigar] meraftand

[Onon ba rokh'i khud idoma dodand], to vak'te ba sarzamini murchagon [dar Shom] rasidand. Murchae guft: "Ei murchagon, ba lonakh'oi khud biraved, to Sulaimon va lashkariionash shumoro [nadida va] nadonista poimol nakunand"

Pas [Sulaimon] az sukhani on [murcha] khandid va guft: <<Parvardigoro, ba man tavfik' bidekh', to shukri ne'matero, ki bar man va bar padaru modaram arzoni doshtai ba ch'oi ovaram va [ioriam kun, to] kore shoistae anch'om dikh'am, ki moiai khushnudiat gardad va ba rakh'mati khesh maro dar ch'am'i bandagoni shoistaat vorid kun"
Va [Sulaimon kh'oli] parandagonro ch'uio shud va guft: <<Chi shudaast, ki kh'udkh'udro namebinam? [Oio ch'oie pinkh'on shuda] io g'oib ast?
[Pas, chun uro naioft guft] Kh'atman, ba sakhti much'ozot mekunam io sarashro meburam, magar on ki daleli ravshane [baroi g'aibatash] biiovarad>>
Pas, dere napoid [ki kh'udkh'ud omad] va guft: <<Az chize ogokh'i ioftaam, ki tu bad-on ogokh'i naioftai va az [sarzamini] Saba' baroiat khabare boe'timod ovardaam
Man [on ch'o] zanero ioftaam, ki bar onon farmonravoi mekunad va [ba u] az kh'ar guna ne'mate dodaand va takhti buzurge dorad

U va k'avmashro didam, ki ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo baroi khurshed sach'da mekunand va shaiton korkh'oi [botili] ononro baroiashon orosta va eshonro az rokh' [-i rost] bozdoshtaast, az in ru, kh'idoiat nameshavand>>

[Shaiton firebashon dodaast] To baroi Allokh' taolo sach'da nakunand [kh'amon ma'bude], ki nikh'oni osmonkh'o va zaminro oshkor mekunad va on chiro, ki pinkh'on mekuned va oshkor mesozed, [kh'amaro] medonad
Allokh' taolo, ki kh'ech' ma'bude [ba kh'ak'] ch'uz u nest, Parvardigori Arshi buzurg ast
[Sulaimon] guft: <<Khokh'em did, ki oio rost guftai io durug'gui
In nomai maro bibar va ba suii onon biiafkan, on gokh' dur shav va [dar gushae biist va] bingar, ki [dar borai on] chi meguiand>>
[Malikai Saba'] guft: <<Ei buzurgon, nomai arch'mande ba suii man afkanda shudaast
In [noma] az ch'onibi Sulaimon ast va chunin ast: <<Ba nomi Allokh'i bakhshandai mekh'rubon
Bar man bartari mach'ued va dar kh'ole ki [az shirk dast bardoshta va] taslim [-i kh'ak' va tavkh'id] shudaed, nazdi man biioed>>
[Malika] Guft: <<Ei buzurgon, nazari khudro dar in mavrid bigued, [charo ki] man kh'argiz biduni kh'uzur [-u mashvarat]-i shumo dar borai kore tasmim nagiriftaam>>
Onon guftand: <<Mo nerui bisior va ch'angch'uioni k'udratmande dorem, vale ikhtiior [-u tasmimi nikh'oi] bo tust. Pas, barrasi kun, ki chi dasture bidikh'i>>

[Malika] guft: <<Be tardid, vak'te podshokh'on [ba unvoni fotekh'] voridi shakh're meshavand, onro vairon [va tabokh'] mesozand va buzurgonashro khoru zalil mekunand va raftorashon kh'amvora chunin budaast
Va man kh'adiae baroiashon mefiristam va muntazir memonam, to bubinam, ki firistodagon chi posukhe [baroiam] meovarand>>

Pas, chun [firistodai malika] nazdi Sulaimon omad, [Sulaimon] guft: <<Oio [mekhokh'ed] bo mol [-u sarvat] ba man kumak kuned? On chi Allokh' taolo [az paiombari va donishu farmonravi] ba man bakhshida, az on chize, ki ba shumo ato karda bekh'tar ast, balki shumoed, ki ba kh'adiai khesh [va sarvatkh'oi dunio] shodmon meshaved
Nazdi onon bozgard [va bigu, ki] kh'atman, bo lashkariione ba suiashon khokh'em omad, ki tavoni muk'obila bo onro nadoshta boshand va be tardid, ononro az on [sarzamin] khoru zor berun mekunem>>
[On gokh'] Guft: <<Ei buzurgon, kadom iake az shumo, pesh az on ki onon taslimshuda nazdi man biioiand, takhti uro baroiam meovarad?>>
Iake az ch'inniioni tanumand guft: <<Pesh az on ki az ch'oiat barkhezi, man onro nazdat meovaram va kh'atman, baroi anch'omi in kor nerumandu aminam>>

Kase, ki donishe az kitob [-i ilokh'i] dosht, guft: <<Pesh az on ki chashm bar kh'am bizani, onro baroiat meovaram>>. Pas, chun [Sulaimon] on [takht]-ro nazdi khud mustak'ar did, guft: <<In az fazli Parvardigori man ast, to biozmoiadam, ki oio sipos medoram io nosiposi mekunam. Pas, kh'ar ki sipos guzorad, tankh'o ba sudi khesh sipos meguzorad va kh'ar ki nosiposi kunad, pas, [ba ziioni khud nosiposi kardaast, charo ki] be tardid, Parvardigoram beniiozi karim ast
[Sulaimon] guft: <<Takhtashro [tag'iiri shakl dikh'ed va] baroiash noshinos kuned, to bubinam, oio [onro] tashkhis medikh'ad io az kasonest, ki [ashio va amvoli khudro] nameshinosand

Pas, chun [malikai Saba'] omad, [ba u] gufta shud: <<Oio takhti tu in guna ast?>>. [Malika] guft: <<Guio kh'amon ast>>. Va [Sulaimon guft] <<In donish [va tavonoi] pesh az in ba mo doda shudaast va kh'amvora farmonbardor budaem>>
Va on chi ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo meparasted, uro [az imon va tavkh'id] bozdoshta bud. Be tardid, [malika] az ch'umlai kofiron bud

Ba vai gufta shud: <<Ba sakh'n [-i k'asr] vorid shav>>. Pas, kh'angome ki onro did, pindosht, ki obi amik'est va ch'oma az sok'kh'o [-i poi] khesh bolo kashid [to az ob bigzarad. Sulaimon] Guft: <<In [ob nest, balki] kokhe ast, ki bo [k'itaoti bulur farsh shudaast>>. [On gokh' uro ba tavkh'id da'vat kard. Malikai Saba'] Guft: <<Parvardigoro, man ba khud sitam kardaam va [inak] kh'amrokh'i Sulaimon taslimi Allokh' taolo - Parvardigori ch'akh'oniion - shudam>>
Va ba suii k'avmi Samud barodarashon Solekh'ro firistodem, ki [biguiad] <<Allokh'i iagonaro biparasted>>, vale onon ba du gurukh' [mu'minon va kofiron] tak'sim shudand va ba sitez pardokhtand
[Solekh'] Guft: <<Ei k'avmi man, charo ba ch'oii rakh'mat shitobzada khokh'oni azobi ilokh'i kh'asted? Charo az Allokh' taolo omurzish namekhokh'ed? Boshad, ki mavridi rakh'mat k'aror gired>>

Onon guftand: <<Mo tu va kasonero, ki kh'amrokh'at kh'astand, ba foli bad giriftaem>>. [Solekh'] Guft: <<Foli badi shumo [va donishi on] nazdi Allokh' taolo ast, balki shumo gurukh'e kh'asted, ki ozmoish meshaved>>
Va dar shakh'r [-i Kh'ich'r] nukh' nafar [sardastai gurukh'] budand, ki dar on sarzamin ba fasod mepardokhtand va [kh'ech'] kori shoistae namekardand

[Onon ba iakdigar] Guftand: <<Ba Allokh' taolo savgand iod kuned, ki bar u [Solekh'] va khonavodaash shabekhun bizanem [va ononro bikushem]. On gokh' ba khunkhokh'ash biguem: <<Mo kh'angomi kushtori khonavodaash kh'ozir nabudem va kh'atman, rost meguem>>
Onon [baroi k'atli Solekh' va pairavonash] nairange ba kor burdand va Mo [baroi nobudii kofiron] niz nairange andeshidem, dar kh'ole ki onon namedonistand
Pas, bingar ok'ibati nairangashon chi shud: mo kh'amai on afrod va k'avmashonro nobud kardem
Inak khonakh'oiashon ba sazoi sitame, ki kardand, [vaironu] tikh'i mondaast. Be gumon, dar in [kaifar] baroi kasone, ki medonand [va imon dorand] nishonae [baroi ibrat giriftan] ast
Va kasonero, ki imon ovarda va parkh'ezkor budand, [kh'amrokh'i Solekh'] nach'ot dodem
Va [iod kun az] Lut on gokh' ki ba k'avmash guft: <<Bo on ki [zishti va gunokh'i livotro] medoned, oio [boz kh'am] murtakibi in amali besharmona meshaved?
Oio az ruii shakh'vat ba ch'oii zanon bo mardon darmeomezed? Balki shumo gurukh'e nodoned>>
Pas, posukhi k'avmash ch'uz in nabud, ki [ba iakdigar] guftand: <<Khonavodai Lutro az shakh'ri khud berun kuned, [charo ki] be tardid, inkh'o afrode pokdoman [muk'addasmaob] kh'astand>>
On gokh' u va khonavodaashro nach'ot dodem, magar kh'amsarashro, ki muk'addar kardem az bozmondagon [dar azob] boshad
Va bar onon borone [az sang] borondem va boroni bimdodashudagon chi bad buvad!
Bigu: <<Sitoishu sipos az oni Allokh' taolo ast va salom bar bandagonash, ki [ononro] barguzidaast>> Oio Allokh' taolo bekh'tar ast io on chi [bo U] sharik mesozand?

[Oio ma'budoni shumo bekh'tarand] Io kase, ki osmonkh'o va zaminro ofarid va az osmon baroiaton obe nozil kard va bo on boron bustonkh'oe khurram [-u zebo] ruionidem, ki kh'argiz tavoni ruionidani darakhtonro nadoshted? Oio ma'budi digare bo Allokh' taolo ast? [Kh'argiz] Balki onkh'o gurukh'e kh'astand, ki [makhluk'otro] kh'amtirozi [Allokh' taolo] k'aror medikh'and

[Oio ma'budoni shumo bekh'tarand] Io kase, ki zaminro k'arorgokh'i [amne] sokht va miionash ch'uiborkh'oe ravon kard va baroiash kukh'kh'oe [ustuvor] padid ovard va miioni du dario moneae k'aror dod [to obi shuru shirin bo kh'am naiomezand]? Oio ma'budi digare bo Allokh' taolo vuch'ud dorad? [Kh'argiz] Ammo beshtarashon namedonand

[Oio ma'budoni shumo bekh'tarand] Io kase, ki [duoi] darmondaro - chun bikhondash - ich'obat mekunad va giriftoriro bartaraf mesozad va shumoro ch'onishinoni [peshiniion dar] zamin k'aror medikh'ad? Oio ma'budi digare bo Allokh' taolo vuch'ud dorad? Chi andak pand megired!

[Oio ma'budoni shumo bekh'tarand] Io kase, ki dar torikikh'oi biiobon va dario [ba vasilai mokh'u sitoragon] kh'idoiataton mekunad va on ki pesh az [boroni] rakh'matash bodkh'oro ba muzhda mefiristad? Oio ma'budi digare bo Allokh' taolo vuch'ud dorad? Allokh' taolo az on chi [baroiash] sharik k'aror medikh'and, bartar ast

[Oio ma'budoni shumo bekh'tarand] Io kase, ki ofarinishro og'oz kard va sipas onro bozmegardonad va [io] on ki az osmon va zamin ba shumo ruzi medikh'ad? Oio ma'budi digare bo Allokh' taolo vuch'ud dorad? Bigu: <<Agar rostgued, dalelatonro biiovared>>
Bigu: <<Kase dar osmonkh'o va zamin az g'aib ogokh' nest, magar Allokh' taolo. Va namedonand chi zamone barangekhta meshavand

Oio ilmashon dar borai okhirat ba kamol rasidaast [va dar boraash iak'in dorand? Kh'argiz], balki onon dar in mavrid dar shak [-u kh'aironi] kh'astand, balki eshon nisbat ba [fakh'mi] on [bebasirat va] kurdiland
Va kasone, ki kufr varzidand, guftand: <<Oio kh'angome ki mo va padaronamon khok shudem, moro [zinda mekunand va az gur] berun meovarand?
Dar kh'ak'ik'at, inro ba mo va pesh az in ba padaronamon [niz] va'da dodaand. In [sukhan chize] nest, magar afsonakh'oi peshiniion>>
[Ei paiombar, ba kofiron] Bigu: <<Dar zamin gardish kuned va bingared, ki saranch'omi gunakh'goron chi guna budaast>>
Va az [ruigardonii] onon g'amgin nabosh va az nairangkh'oe, ki mevarzand, diltang nashav
Va [kofiron] meguiand: <<Agar rostgued, in va'da [-i azob] kai khokh'ad bud>>?
Bigu: <<Chi baso barkhe az on chi ba shitob mekhokh'ed, ba shumo nazdik boshad>>
Va be gumon, Parvardigorat nisbat ba mardum bakhshish [-u rakh'mat] dorad, vale beshtarashon sipos nameguzorand
Va be tardid, Parvardigorat on chiro dar sinakh'oiashon pinkh'on mekunand va on chiro oshkor mesozand, ba khubi medonad
Va kh'ech' pinkh'oni dar osmonu zamin nest, magar on ki dar kitobe ravshan [Lavkh'i makh'fuz] sabt ast
Be gumon, in K'ur'on beshtar on chiro, ki Bani Isroil dar boraash ikhtilof dorand, baroiashon baion mekunad
Va kh'ak'k'o, ki rakh'namun va rakh'mate baroi mu'minon ast
Musallaman, Parvardigorat [dar k'iiomat] ba kh'ukmi khesh miionashon dovari mekunad va U shikastnopaziri donost
Pas, bar Allokh' taolo tavakkal kun. Ba rosti, ki tu bar kh'ak'ik'ati oshkor kh'asti
Va tu kh'argiz nametavoni murdadilonro shunavo sozi va [nidoi] da'vat [-i kh'ak']-ro ba gushi karon birasoni, on gokh' ki onon pusht mekunand va rui megardonand

Va tu nametavoni kurdilonro az gumrokh'iashon [bozgardoni va] kh'idoiat kuni. Tu [metavoni paiomi kh'ak'ro tankh'o] ba gushi kasone birasoni, ki ba oioti Mo imon dorand va [dar barobari kh'ak'] taslimand

Va on gokh' ki [dar ostonai k'iiomat] farmoni [azob] bar onon voch'ib gardad, ch'unbandaero baroiashon az zamin burun meovarem, ki bo onon [dar in mavrid] sukhan biguiad, ki mardum ba oioti Mo iak'in nadoshtand
Va [iod kun az] ruze, ki az kh'ar ummate gurukh'e az onon, ki oioti Moro durug' meangoshtand, ch'am' mekunem, on gokh' [baroi kh'isobrasi ba saf] nigokh' doshta meshavand

To kh'angome ki [ba ch'oigokh'i kh'isobrasi] birasand, [dar on ch'o Allokh' taolo] mefarmoiad: <<Oio dar kh'ole ki nisbat ba [kh'ak'ik'ati] oiotam donishe nadoshted, onkh'oro durug' meangoshted? In chi kore bud, ki mekarded?>>
Va ba khotiri sitame, ki kardand, farmon [-i azob] bar onon vok'e' megardad va kh'ech' sukhane [dar difo' az khud] nameguiand

Oio nadidand, ki shabro padid ovardaem, to dar on oromish ioband va ruzro ravshanibakhsh [sokhtaem, to ba kor va talosh bipardozand]? Be tardid, dar in [ofarinish] baroi onon, ki imon meovarand, nishonakh'o [-i ravshane az k'udrati Allokh' taolo] ast

Va [iod kun az] ruze, ki dar sur damida meshavad va kh'ar ki dar osmonkh'o va zamin ast, vakh'shat mekunad, magar on ki Allokh' taolo bikhokh'ad va kh'amagi bo khori [va zillat] ba peshgokh'i Allokh' taolo meoiand

Va kukh'kh'oro mebini [va] onkh'oro bekh'arakat mepindori, kh'ol on ki monandi guzari abrkh'o dar kh'arakatand. In ofarinishi ilokh'i ast, ki kh'ar chizero makh'kam [-u ustuvor] padid ovardaast. Be tardid, U ba on chi mekuned ogokh' ast
Kh'ar ki [dar ruzi k'iiomat] neki biiovarad, [podoshe] bekh'tar az on khokh'ad dosht va az vakh'shati on ruz dar amonand
Va kh'ar ki badi biiovarad, bo ruiash dar otash nagunsor meshavand [va ba onon gufta meshavad]: <<Oio ch'uz dar barobari on chi kardaed, much'ozot meshaved?>>

[Ei Paiombar, ba kofiron bigu] <<Man fak'at ma'muram, ki Parvardigori in shakh'r [Makka]-ro biparastam, kh'amon ki ba in ch'o kh'urmat bakhshida va kh'ama chiz az oni Ust va ma'muram, ki taslim [-i farmonash] bosham
Va in ki K'ur'onro tilovat kunam. Pas, kh'ar ki kh'idoiat shavad, ba sudi khesh kh'idoiat ioftaast, va [ba] kh'ar ki gumrokh' megardad, bigu: <<Man fak'at bimdikh'andaam>>
Va bigu: <<Sitoish az oni Allokh' taolo ast. Ba zudi nishonakh'o [-i k'udrat]-i kheshro nishonaton khokh'ad dod va onkh'oro khokh'ed shinokht>>. Va Parvardigorat az on chi mekuned, g'ofil nest
To, sin, mim
In oioti kitobi ravshangar ast
[bakhshkh'oe] az dostoni Muso va Fir'avnro baroi kasone, ki imon ovardaand, ba durusti bar tu tilovat mekunem

Be tardid, Fir'avn dar sarzamini [Misr] bartarikhokh'i kard va mardumashro ba gurukh'kh'o tak'sim namud. Gurukh'e az ononro ba notavoni [va khori] mekashond, [chunon ki] pisaronashonro mekusht va zanonashonro [baroi kanizi] zinda nigakh' medosht. Ba rosti, ki u az tabakh'koron bud

Va mekhostem bar Bani Isroil, ki dar on sarzamin ba notavoni kashida shuda budand, [bo nobud kardani dushmanashon] minnat biguzorem va peshvoion [-i mardum] k'arorashon dikh'em va [pas az nobudii Fir'avn] ononro vorison [-i sarzamini Shom] namoem
Va dar on sarzamin kh'ukumat ba eshon dikh'em va on chiro Fir'avn va [vazirash] Kh'omon va sipokh'iionashon kh'amvora az on metarsidand [suk'uti kh'ukumat], ba onon nishon dikh'em

Va ba modari Muso ilkh'om kardem, ki: <<Uro shir bidekh' va kh'angome ki [az osebi fir'avniion] bar u tarsidi, [kudakro dar sanduk'e bigzor va] ba rud [-i Nil] biandozash va natars va andukh'gin nashav [zero] kh'atman, uro ba tu bozmegardonem va az paiombaron k'arorash medikh'em>>

Pas, [chun modari Muso chunin kard] khonadoni Fir'avn uro [az ob] giriftand, to saranch'om [solkh'o ba'd in farzandi Bani Isroil] dushman va [moiai] andukh'ashon gardad. Ba rosti, ki Fir'avn va Kh'omon va sipokh'iionashon gunakh'gor budand

Va [chun Fir'avn dasturi k'atli Musoro dod, Osiia] kh'amsari Fir'avn guft: <<[In pisar] Nuri chashmi manu tust. Uro nakushed. Chi baso ba mo sude bibakhshad, io uro ba farzandi bigirem>>, kh'ol on ki [ok'ibati korro] namedonistand
Va dili modari Muso [az kh'ama chiz ch'uz iodi pisarash] tikh'i gasht va agar k'albashro k'avi nakarda budem, ki [ba va'dai Mo] imon doshta boshad, nazdik bud on rozro fosh kunad

Va [modari Muso pas az on ki uro dar Nil rakh'o kard] ba khokh'ari u guft: <<Ba dunbolash birav>>, pas, [khokh'arash] az dur ba u menigarist, dar kh'ole ki onon namedonistand [ki on dukhtar, khokh'ari in kudak ast]

Va Mo [shiri] kh'amai zanoni shirdekh'ro az k'abl bar u kh'arom kardem [chunon ki sinai kh'ech' iakro napaziruft]. On gokh' [khokh'arash] guft: <<Mekhokh'ed khonavodaero nishonaton dikh'am, ki uro baroiaton nigakh' dorand va khairkhokh'ash boshand?>>
Pas, [onon paziruftand va bad-in surat] uro ba modarash bozgardonidem, to chashmash ravshan gardad va g'amgin naboshad va to bidonad, ki va'dai Allokh' taolo kh'ak' ast, vale beshtarashon namedonand
Va chun Muso ba rushdu kamoli khesh rasid va barumand shud, ba u kh'ikmatu donish [-i oini Bani Isroilro] ato kardem va nakukoronro inchunin podosh medikh'em

Kh'angome ki mardum [mashg'uli istirokh'at va] bekhabar budand, Muso [makhfiiona] voridi shakh'r shud va du mardro did, ki bo iakdigar dargir shudaand. Iake az onon [az k'avmi Bani Isroil va] az dustoni Muso bud va digare [k'ibti bud va] az dushmanonash. Pas, on ki az dustoni u bud, alaikh'i dushmanash az Muso iori khost, pas, [Muso] musht [-i makh'kam]-e ba vai zadu uro az poi darovard [on gokh'] guft: <<In kori shaiton bud. Kh'ak'k'o, ki u dushman [-i inson va] gumrokh'kunandai oshkore ast>>
[Sipas] Guft: <<Parvardigoro, man ba khud sitam kardaam, pas, maro bibakhsh>> va [Allokh' taolo] uro bakhshid. Be tardid, U omurzandai mekh'rubon ast
[On gokh'] Guft: <<Parvardigoro, ba shukronai on ki bar man ne'mat [-i k'udratu donish] arzoni doshtai, kh'argiz pushtiboni much'rimon nakhokh'am bud>>

[Muso] Shabro bo tarsu nigaroni dar shakh'r ba subkh' rasond, ki nogokh' marde, ki diruz az u iori khosta bud, boz ba fariod az u iori khost. Muso ba u guft: <<Vok'ean, oshkor ast, ki tu [moch'aroch'u va] gumrokh'i>>

Pas, kh'angome ki [Muso] khost, ba kase, ki dushmani kh'ar dui onon bud, kh'amla kunad, [on mardi k'ibti] guft: <<Ei Muso, oio mekhokh'i kh'amon guna ki diruz kasero kushti, [imruz niz] maro bikushi? K'asdi tu fak'at zurgui dar in sarzamin ast va namekhokh'i az islokh'garon [baini afrod] boshi>>

Va [dar in kh'angom] marde [ki az dustoni Muso bud] az durtarin nuk'tai shakh'r shitobon omad [va] guft: <<Ei Muso, buzurgon [-i k'avmi Fir'avn] dar borai kushtanat ba mashvarat nishastaand, pas, bedirang [az shakh'r] khorich' shav, [ki] man kh'atman, khairkhokh'at kh'astam>>
Pas, Muso bo tarsu nigaroni az shakh'r berun raft va guft: <<Parvardigoro, maro az [osebi] sitamgoron nach'ot bidekh'>>
Va chun ba shakh'ri Madian ru ovard, guft: <<Umed ast, Parvardigoram maro ba rokh'i rost kh'idoiat kunad>>

Va kh'angome ki ba [chokh'i] obi Madian rasid, bar sari chokh' gurukh'e az mardumro did, ki [chakh'orpoioni khudro] ob medikh'and va nazdiki onon du zanro did, ki [gusfandonashonro] kanor mekashidand [va az digaron fosila megiriftand. Muso] guft: <<Shumo chi mekuned? [Charo gusfandoni khudro ob namedikh'ed.] Onon guftand: <<Mo [ba ramai khud] ob namedikh'em, to in chuponkh'o bozgardand [va muzokh'imamon naboshand]. Padaramon piramarde kukh'ansol ast [va tavonoii in korro nadorad]>>
Muso baroi on du nafar [gusfandonashonro] ob dod, on gokh' suii soia bozgasht va guft: <<Parvardigoro, ba kh'ar khaire, ki baroiam bifiristi, sakht niiozmandam>>

On gokh' iake az on du [zan], dar kh'ole ki bo sharmu kh'aio gom barmedosht, nazdash omadu guft: <<Padaram da'vatat mekunad [ki nazdash biravi], to muzdi on ki [gusfandon]-ro baroiamon ob dodi, ba tu pardokht kunad>>. Chun [Muso] nazdi u raftu sarguzashtashro baroi u kh'ikoiat kard, vai guft: <<Natars, ki az gurukh'i sitamgor nach'ot ioftai>>
Iake az on du [dukhtar] guft: <<Padarch'on, uro istikhdom kun, [zero] be tardid, bekh'tarin kase, ki metavoni ba kor bigiri on ast, ki nerumandu amonatdor boshad [va u chunin ast]>>

[Piramard ba Muso] Guft: <<Mekhokh'am iake az du dukhtaramro ba kh'amsariat darovaram, ba in [shart] ki kh'asht sol baroiam kor kuni va agar [in korro] to dakh' sol idoma dikh'i, lutfu mukh'abbate az suii tust. Man namekhokh'am bar tu sakhtgiri kunam. In shoal-l-lokh' maro shoista [va nakukor] khokh'i ioft>>

[Muso] Guft: <<In [k'arordod] miioni manu tu boshad, ki kh'ar kadom az in du muddat [kh'asht io dakh' sol]-ro, ki anch'om dodam, [ba akh'di khud vafo kardaam], pas, sitame bar man naboshad [va nakhokh'i, ki beshtar bimonam] va Allokh' taolo bar on chi meguem, guvokh' ast>>

Kh'angome ki Muso [on] muddat [-i muaiian]-ro ba poion rasond va kh'amrokh'i khonavodaash [az Madian ba suii Misr] kh'arakat kard, [nogakh'on dar torikii shab] az suii [kukh'i] Tur otashe did, ba khonavodaash guft: <<Biisted, ki man otashe [az dur] didam. Shoiad khabare az on baroiaton biiovaram io shu'lai otashe [biiovaram], to garm shaved>>

Pas, vak'te ba on otash nazdik shud, dar kanorai rosti on sarzamini dar mintak'ai purbarakat [-i Tur] az [miioni] iak darakht nidod doda shud, ki: <<Ei Muso, be tardid, man Allokh' taolo-Parvardigori ch'akh'oniionam

Va asoiatro biiafkan>>. Pas, chun [Muso chunin kardu] onro did, ki kh'amchun more [bosur'at] mekhazad, [az tars] pusht kardu gurekht va boznagasht. [Nido omad] <<Ei Muso, pesh o va natars. Kh'atman, tu az [osebi khatarkh'o] emin shudai

Va dastro dar girebonat furu bar [to] sapedu biduni aib [va bemorii pesi] khorich' shavad va [baroi rakh'oi] az in tars dastonatro ba samti khud ch'am' kun [va ba sinaat bichaspon]. In du [mu'ch'izai aso va iadi baizo] du daleli [ravshan] az sui Parvardigorat baroi Fir'avn va buzurgoni [k'avmi] ust. Ba rosti, ki onon gurukh'e nofarmonand>>
[Muso] Guft: <<Parvardigoro, man iake az ononro [biduni amd] kushtaam, metarsam, ki [ba k'asosi on k'atl] maro bikushand
Va barodaram - Kh'orun - zabonash az man shevotar ast, pas, uro kh'amrokh'am bifirist, to iovaram boshad va rostguiiamro ta'iid kunad, zero metarsam, maro durug'gu angorand>>

[Allokh' taolo] Farmud: <<Turo bo [paivastani] barodarat tak'viiat khokh'em namud va baroiaton tasallute k'aror medikh'em, ki [fir'avniion kh'argiz] ba shumo dast naioband va ba [barakati] mu'ch'izotamon [ki dar ikhtiior dored] shumo va kh'ar ki az shumo pairavi kunad, piruzed>>
Pas, chun Muso bo mu'ch'izoti ravshani Mo ba suiashon omad, guftand: <<In [chize] nest, magar ch'odue sokhta va mo kh'argiz in [iddaoi iaktoparasti]-ro az padaronamon nashnidaem>>
Va Muso guft: <<Parvardigoram bekh'tar medonad, chi kase kh'idoiatro az nazdi U ovardaast va [ogokh'tar ast, ki] ok'ibati neki on saro baroi kist. Be tardid, sitamgoron rostkor nameshavand>>

Fir'avn guft: <<Ei buzurgon, ma'bude ba ch'uz khud baroiaton nameshinosam, pas, ei Kh'omon, baroiam otashe bar gil barafruz [va khisht bipaz], on gokh' burch'i balande bisoz, boshad, ki az ma'budi Muso bokhabar shavam. Kh'ar chand ki kh'atman, uro durug'gu mepindoram>>
Va u [Fir'avn] va lashkariionash ba nokh'ak' dar sarzamin [-i Misr] sarkashi kardand va pindoshtand, ki ba suii Mo bozgardonda nameshavand
Pas, [mo] u va lashkariionashro [ba azob] furu giriftem va ononro ba dario andokhtem. Pas, bingar, ki ok'ibati sitamgoron chi guna bud
Va ononro peshvoione k'aror dodem, ki [pairavonashonro] ba otashi [duzakh] da'vat mekardand va ruzi k'iiomat iori nameshavand
Dar in dunio ba dunbolashon la'nat ravon kardem va ruzi k'iiomat [niz] zishtmanzarand
Va ba rosti, pas az on ki ummatkh'oi peshinro nobud namudem, ba Muso kitob [Tavrot] dodem, ki [mushtamil bar] ravshangarikh'o va kh'idoiat va rakh'mate baroi mardum bud, boshad, ki pand pazirand
Va tu [ei paiombar] on gokh' ki farmoni [nubuvvat]-ro ba Muso medodem, dar domanai g'arbi [-i kukh'i Tur] kh'uzur nadoshti va az guvokh'on [niz] nabudi

Va [Mo pas az Muso] naslkh'oe ofaridem va solkh'oi tuloni bar onon guzasht [va paimoni ilokh'iro faromush kardand]. Va tu dar miioni akh'li Madian ik'omat nadoshti [ki az dostoni Muso bokhabar boshi va] oioti Moro bar onon [mardumi Makka] bikhoni, balki Mo budem, ki [in oiotro ba suiat] mefiristodem

Va on gokh' ki [ba Muso] nido dodem, tu dar kanori kukh'i Tur nabudi, vale ba unvoni rakh'mate az suii Parvadigorat [ba tu vakh'i namudem], to gurukh'ero, ki pesh az tu bimdikh'andae ba surog'ashon naomadaast, [bo in oiot] bim dikh'i, boshad, ki pand pazirand

[Bo kofiron itmomi kh'uch'ch'at kardem] To vak'te ba kaifari korkh'oe, ki dar guzashta murtakib shudaand, musibate ba onkh'o merasad, naguiand: <<Parvardigoro, charo paiombare bar mo nafiristodi, to az oiotat pairavi kunem va az mu'minon boshem>>?

Vale kh'angome ki [paiombari] kh'ak' az ch'onibi Mo ba surog'ashon omad, [iakh'udiion az sari lach'och'at] guftand: <<Charo mu'ch'izote kh'ammonand Muso ba u doda nashudaast>>? [Dar posukhashon bigu] <<Magar [iakh'udiion] dar guzashta mu'ch'izoti Musoro inkor nakardand>>? Onon guftand: <<[K'ur'onu Tavrot] du ch'odu kh'astand, ki iakdigarro ta'iid mekunand>> va guftand: <<Mo tamomi [matolibi] onkh'oro inkor mekunem>>
Bigu: <<Agar rostgued, az ch'onibi Allokh' taolo kitobe kh'idoiatbakhshtar az in du [kitob] biiovared, to man niz az on pairavi kunam>>

Pas, agar [K'uraish] ba darkhostat posukhe nadodand, bidon, ki onon fak'at az kh'avoi nafsashon pairavi mekunand va kist gumrokh'tar az on ki biduni rakh'namude az sui Allokh' taolo az kh'avoi nafsash pairavi mekunad? Be tardid, Allokh' taolo gurukh'i sitamgorro kh'idoiat namekunad
Va ba rosti, Mo in oiot [va kh'ikoiot]-ro iake pas az digare baroi onon [mushrikonu iakh'udiion] nozil kardem, boshad, ki pand girand
Kasone, ki pesh az in [oioti ilokh'i] ba onon kitob [Tavrot] dodaem, ba in [K'ur'on] niz imon meovarand

Va chun [oiotash] bar onon khonda meshavad, meguiand: <<Ba on imon ovardem. Iak'inan, sukhani kh'ak'k'e ast az ch'onibi Parvardigoramon. Ba rosti, ki Mo pesh az [nuzuli] on niz taslim [-i farmoni Parvardigor] budaem>>
Inonand, ki ba posi on ki shikeboi kardand, podoshashonro du bor megirand va bo korkh'oi nek [gunokh'on va] badikh'oro daf' mekunand va az on chi ba onon ruzi dodaem, infok' menamoiand

Va kh'ar gokh' sukhane bekh'uda [va noshoista az akh'li kitob] meshunavand, [bo betavach'ch'ukh'i] az on rui megardonand va meguiand: <<[Podoshi] Korkh'oi mo baroi most va [kaifari] korkh'oi shumo az oni shumost, [shumo az ozoru nosozii mo] dar amoned. Mo ba dunboli [kh'amsukh'bati bo] ch'okh'ilon nestem>>

[Ei paiombar] Be tardid, tu kh'ar kiro dust doshta boshi, nametavoni [ba ich'bor ba rokh'i rost] kh'idoiat kuni, balki Allokh' taolo ast, ki kh'ar kasro bikhokh'ad, kh'idoiat mekunad va 'U ba [kh'oli] rokh'ioftagon donotar ast

Va [mushrikon] guftand: <<Agar kh'amrokh'i tu az kh'idoiat pairavi kunem, moro az sarzaminamon meraboiand>>. Oio mo ononro dar kh'arami amne ch'oi nadodem, ki anvoi makh'sulot - ba unvoni ruzie az ch'onibi Mo - ba suiashon sarozer megardad? Vale beshtarashon [k'adri ne'matkh'oi ilokh'iro] namedonand

Va chi bisior [mardumi] shakh'rkh'oero nobud sokhtem, ki dar kh'ak'k'i ne'matkh'oi ilokh'i nosiposi karda budand. In khonakh'oi [vaironshudai] onon ast, ki pas az eshon ch'uz andake - [kase] dar onkh'o sukunat nakardaast va Mo vorisi onon budem

Va Parvardigorat kh'argiz [mardumi] shakh'rkh'oro nobud namekunad, magar on ki dar shakh'ri buzurge az onkh'o [kh'amchun Makka] paiombare bifiristad, ki oioti Moro bar onon bikhonad. Va Mo kh'argiz shakh'rkh'oro nobud nakardem, magar on ki sokinonash [kofiru] sitamgor budaand
Va on chi ba shumo doda shudaast, bakh'ra [-i guzaro] va zinati zindagii duniost va on chi nazdi Allokh' taolo ast, bekh'tar va poidortar ast. Oio nameandeshed?

Oio kase, ki ba u va'dai naku dodaem va ba on khokh'ad rasid, kh'amchun kasest, ki uro az bakh'rai zindagii dunio barkhurdor sokhtaem va ruzi k'iiomat az [ch'umlai] ekh'zorshudagon [dar otashi duzakh] ast?
Va [iod kun az] ruze, ki Allokh' taolo ba onon nido medikh'ad va meguiad: <<Afrode, ki sharikoni man [dar parastish] mepindoshted, kuch'o kh'astand?>>

Kasone [az saroni kofiron], ki azob baroiashon kh'atmi ast, meguiand: <<Parvardigoro, inkh'o kasone kh'astand, ki mo gumrokh'ashon kardem. [Ore] Ononro gumrokh' kardem, chunon ki [khud niz] gumrokh' shudem. Az [shirku tavassuli] eshon ba suiat bezori mech'uem. [Dar kh'ak'ik'at] Onon moro nameparastidand [balki shaitonro parastish mekardand]>>

Va [ba mushrikon] gufta meshavad: <<Sharikonatonro [ki ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo meparastided] faro bikhoned [to ioriaton kunand]>>. Pas, ononro mekhonand, vale posukhe ba eshon namedikh'and va azobi [duzakh]-ro mebinand [va orzu mekunand], kosh kh'idoiatiofta budand
Va ruze, ki [Allokh' taolo] ononro nido medikh'ad va mefarmoiad: <<Ba [da'vati] paiombaron chi posukhe doded?>>
Dar on ruz kh'amai daloil [va bakh'onakh'oe, ki baroi tavch'ekh' dorand] az onon pinkh'on megardad va az [shiddati azob az kh'oli] iakdigar namepursand
Ammo kase, ki tavba kunad va imon ovarad va kori shoista anch'om dikh'ad, umed ast, ki az rastagoron boshad

Va Parvardigorat kh'ar chi bikhokh'ad, meofarinad va [kh'ar kiro bikhokh'ad ba parastish va paiombari] barmeguzinad. Mushrikon ikhtiiore nadorand [ki dar in mavrid e'tiroz kunand]. Allokh' taolo munazzakh' va bartar ast az on chi bo U sharik medonand
Va Parvardigorat on chi dar sinakh'oiashon pinkh'on mekunand va on chi oshkor mesozand, [kh'amaro] medonad
Va U Allokh' taolo ast, ki kh'ech' ma'bude [bar kh'ak'] ch'uz U nest. Sitoish dar duniovu okhirat baroi Ust va kh'ukm [-u farmonravoi niz] az oni Ust va [kh'amagi] ba suii U bozgardanda meshaved

[Ba mushrikon] bigu: <<Ba man bigued, agar Allokh' taolo [torikii] shabro to ruzi k'iiomat bar shumo poianda gardonad, kadom ma'bud ba ch'uz Allokh' taolo baroiaton ravshani meovarad? Oio [sukhani kh'ak'ro] nameshunaved?

Bigu "Ba man bigued, agar Allokh' taolo [rushnoii] ruzro to ruzi k'iiomat bar shumo poianda gardonad, kadom ma'bud ba ch'uz Allokh' taolo baroiaton shabe meovarad, ki dar on orom bigired? Oio [in nishonakh'oi k'udrati ilokh'iro] namebined?
Va Allokh' taolo az rakh'mati khesh shabu ruzro baroiaton k'aror dod, to dar shab orom gired va dar ruz [talosh kuned va] az bakhshishi U [ruzi] bich'ued va boshad, ki sipos guzored
Va [iod kun az] ruze, ki Allokh' taolo ba onon nido medikh'ad va meguiad: <<Afrode, ki sharikoni man [dar parastish] mepindoshted, kuch'o kh'astand?>>

Va az kh'ar ummate guvokh'e barmeguzinem [ki paiombari onon ast va dar mavridi kufrashon shakh'odat medikh'ad]. Sipas ba onon meguem: <<Daleli [kufru shirki] kheshro biiovared>>, pas, medonand, ki kh'ak' az oni Allokh' taolo ast va durug'kh'oe, ki meboftand [va on chi mushrikona meparastidand], makh'vu nobud gashtaast

K'orun az k'avmi Muso bud, ammo bar onon fakhrfurushi namud va az ganch'ina on k'adar ba vai doda budem, ki [kh'atto] kh'amli kalidkh'oiash baroi gurukh'e nerumand mushkil bud. Kh'angome ki [mardumi] k'avmash ba u guftand: <<[Ba khotiri sarvatat chunin mag'ruru] sarmast nabosh. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo sarmastonro dust namedorad

Va bo on chi Allokh' taolo ba tu bakhshidaast, [savobi] saroi okhiratro bich'ui va [dar aini kh'ol] bakh'raatro az [zindagii] dunio niz faromush nakun va chunon ki Allokh' taolo ba tu neki kardaast, tu niz [ba bandagonash] neki kun va kh'argiz dar paii tabakh'kori [va fasod] dar zamin nabosh. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo mufsidonro dust namedorad>>

[K'orun] guft: <<On chi ba man doda shuda, dar natich'ai [k'udratu] donishest, ki nazdi man ast>>. Oio namedonist, ki Allokh' taolo naslkh'oero pesh az vai nobud karda bud, ki az u nerumandtar va sarvatmandtar budand? Va [ruzi k'iiomat] az much'rimon dar borai gunokh'onashon suol nameshavad [zero Allokh' taolo kh'amaro medonad]

On gokh' K'orun bo [tach'ammulotu] zinatkh'oiash dar barobari k'avmash zokh'ir shud. Afrode [az atrofiioni u], ki khostori zindagii dunio budand, guftand: <<Ei kosh, kh'ammonandi on chi ba K'orun doda shudaast, mo niz doshtem. Vok'ean, u bakh'rai buzurge [az moli dunio] dorad>>

Ammo kasone, ki donish [-i kh'ak'ik'i] iofta budand, guftand: <<Voi bar shumo! Baroi kase, ki imon ovardaast va korkh'oi shoista mekunad, savobi ilokh'i bekh'tar ast va in [sukhan]-ro kasone ba ch'uz shikeboion namepazirand>>
On gokh' K'orunro kh'amrokh'i [khonaash dar zamin furu burdem, pas, kh'ech' gurukh'e nadosht, ki dar barobari [azobi] Allokh' taolo ioriash kunand va [khud niz] natavonist ba kheshtan iori rasonad

Va kasone, ki diruz orzu mekardand, ba ch'oii u boshand, bomdod [-i ruzi ba'd] meguftand: <<Voi bar mo! Gui Allokh' taolo ast, ki [ne'matu] ruziro bar kh'ar ki bikhokh'ad gusturda medorad va [io] tang megirad.
