Agar Allokh' taolo bar mo minnat nanikh'oda bud, kh'atman, moro [niz ba sazoi sukhanonamon ba zharfoi zamin] furu meburd. Ei voi! Gui kofiron kh'argiz rastagor nameshavand
In saroi okhiratro [fak'at] baroi kasone k'aror medikh'em, ki khokh'oni gardankashi va fasod dar zamin nestand va saranch'omi nek az oni parkh'ezkoron ast

[Ruzi k'iiomat] Kh'ar ki neki biiovarad, [podoshe] bekh'tar az on khokh'ad dosht va kh'ar ki badi biiovarad, [bidonad, ki] kasone, ki korkh'oi noshoista kardaand, ch'uz [ba mik'dori] on chi mekardand, kaifar namebinand

Kh'amon [Parvardigore], ki K'ur'onro [nozil namud va tablig'ashro] bar tu voch'ib kard, kh'atman, turo ba ch'oigokh'at [dar Makka] bozmegardonad. Bigu: <<Parvardigoram bekh'tar medonad, chi kase kh'idoiat ovardaast va chi kase dar gumrokh'ii oshkor ast>>
Va [pesh az bi'sat] tu orzu nadoshti, ki in kitob [-i osmoni] bar tu nozil shavad. [In nabud] Magar rakh'mate az ch'onibi Parvardigorat. Pas, kh'argiz pushtiboni kofiron nabosh
Va mabodo [kofiron] turo az [tablig'i] oioti ilokh'i - pas az on ki bar tu nozil shud - bozdorand! Va [mardumro] ba suii Parvardigorat da'vat kun va kh'argiz az mushrikon nabosh

Va ma'budi digare bo Allokh' taolo [ba niioish] nakhon. Kh'ech' ma'bude [ba kh'ak'] ch'uz U nest. Kh'ama chiz fanopazir ast, magar [zoti ch'ovid va] ruii U. Farmonravoi [tankh'o] az oni Ust va [ruzi k'iiomat kh'amagi] ba peshgokh'ash bozgardonda meshaved
Alif, lom, mim
Oio mardum pindoshtaand, kh'amin ki [ba zabon] biguiand: <<Imon ovardem>>, ononro [ba kh'oli khud] vomeguzorand va ozmuda nameshavand?
Va ba rosti kasonero, ki pesh az onon budand, niz ozmudem va to Allokh' taolo kasonero, ki [dar borai imonashon] rost guftaand, bozshinosad va durug'guionro [niz] ma'lum gardonad
Oio kasone, ki korkh'oi noshoista kardaand, pindoshtaand, ki metavonand az Mo peshi bigirand [va az azobamon bigurezand]? Chi bad dovari mekunand!
Kh'ar ki ba didori Allokh' taolo umed dorad, [bidonad, ki] va'dai Allokh' taolo, kh'atman, khokh'ad omad va u shunavovu donost
Va kh'ar ki [dar rokh'i kh'ak'] bikushad, ba sudi khesh kushidaast. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo az ch'akh'oniion beniioz ast
Va kasone, ki imon ovardaand va korkh'oi shoista anch'om dodaand, iak'inan gunokh'onashonro mezudoem va ononro ba bekh'tar az on chi kardaand, podosh medikh'em

Va ba inson suporish kardem, ki ba padaru modarash neki namoiad va [guftem]: <<Agar on du kushidand, to chizero, ki tu ba on donishe nadori shariki Man sozi, pas, az onkh'o itoat makun. Bozgashtaton ba sui Man ast, on gokh' shumoro az [kh'ak'ik'ati] on chi mekarded, ogokh' khokh'am kard
Va kasone, ki imon ovardaand va korkh'oi shoista anch'om dodaand, albatta, ononro dar [zumrai] shoistagon darmeovarem

Va barkhe az mardum kh'astand, ki meguiand <<ba Allokh' taolo imon ovardem>>. Ammo kh'angome ki dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo ozor mebinand, ozori kofironro kh'amchun azobi Allokh' taolo [sakhtu ch'onkokh'] medonand [va az imonashon dast mekashand] va agar az suii Parvardigorat piruzi [va kushoishe baroiaton] pesh oiad, meguiand: <<Be tardid, mo [niz] bo shumo kh'amrokh' budem>>. Oio Allokh' taolo ba on chi dar dilkh'oi ch'akh'oniion ast, donotar nest?
Va ba rosti, Allokh' taolo kasonero, ki imon ovardaand, ba khubi meshinosad va iak'inan, munofik'onro [niz] meshinosad

Va kasone, ki kufr varzidand, ba kasone, ki imon ovardand, meguftand: <<Az rokh'i mo pairavi kuned, va kh'atman, bori gunokh'onatonro ba ukh'da megirem>>, vale onon kh'argiz chize az gunokh'oni eshonro bar ukh'da nakhokh'and girift. Ba rosti, ki onon durug'gu kh'astand

Va, kh'atman, bori sangini [gunokh'i] khud va borkh'oi sangin [-i gunokh'i pairavon]-ashonro kh'amrokh'i bori sangini khud ba dush khokh'and kashid va iak'inan, ruzi k'iiomat dar mavridi durug'kh'oe, ki meboftand, bozkhost khokh'and shud
Va Mo Nukh'ro ba sui k'avmash firistodem va u nukh'sadu panch'okh' sol dar miioni onon bud. On gokh', dar kh'ole ki sitamgor [-u kofir] budand, tufon [-i sangin] ononro faro girift
Pas u [Nukh'] va sarnishinoni kishtiro nach'ot dodem va on [kishti]-ro nishonae baroi [ibrat giriftani] ch'akh'oniion k'aror dodem
Va [iod kun az] Ibrokh'im on gokh' ki ba k'avmash guft: <<Allokh'ro biparasted va az U parvo kuned, [ki] agar bidoned, in kor baroiaton bekh'tar ast

Ch'uz in nest, ki ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo shumo fak'at butkh'oe [az sangu chub]-ro meparasted va [bo in kor ba Allokh' taolo] durug' mebanded. Dar kh'ak'ik'at, kasonero, ki shumo ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo meparasted, ikhtiiori ruziatonro nadorand, pas, [ne'matu] ruziro tankh'o az peshgokh'i Allokh' taolo talab kuned va Uro biparasted va shukri Uro ba ch'o ovared [ki] ba suii U bozgardonda meshaved

Va [ei mushrikon] agar shumo [Mukh'ammadro] durug'gu bidoned, [ach'ib nest] be tardid, barkhe az ummatkh'oi pesh az shumo niz [paiombaroni ilokh'iro] durug'gu angoshtand. Va paiombar vazifae ch'uz rasonidani oshkori [vakh'i] nadorad>>
Oio nadidand, ki Allokh' taolo chi guna ofarinishro og'oz mekunad, sipas onro [pas az margash] bozmegardonad? Kh'atman, in kor baroi Allokh' taolo oson ast

[Ei paiombar, ba kofiron] bigu: <<Dar zamin gardish kuned va bingared, ki Allokh' taolo chi guna ofarinishro og'oz kard, pas, [ba kh'amin surat niz] zindagii digarro padid meovarad. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo bar kh'ar kore tavonost
U kh'ar kiro bikhokh'ad, azob mekunad va bar kh'ar ki bikhokh'ad, rakh'mat meovarad va [kh'amagi] ba suiash bozgardonda meshaved
Shumo - [na] dar zamin va na dar osmon - kh'argiz notavonkunandai U nested va ch'uz Allokh' taolo kh'ech' korsozu iovare nadored>>
Va kasone, ki ba oioti Allokh' taolo va didori U kufr varzidand, ononand, ki az rakh'mati Man ma'iusand va azobi dardnoke baroiashon [dar pesh] ast

On gokh' ch'avobi k'avmi u [Ibrokh'im] ch'uz in nabud, ki guftand: <<Uro bikushed, bisuzoned>>. Pas, Allokh' taolo az otash nach'otash dod. Be tardid, dar in [rakh'oi az otash] baroi gurukh'e, ki imon meovarand, nishonakh'oe [baroi ibrat giriftan] ast

Va [Ibrokh'im] guft: <<Shumo ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo butkh'oe baroi khud barguzidaed, ki [moiai dusti va] mukh'abbat miioni shumo dar zindagii dunio boshad. On gokh' ruzi k'iiomat munkiri iakdigar meshaved va kh'amdigarro la'nat mekuned va ch'oigokh'aton otash ast va kh'ech' iorigare nakhokh'ed dosht>>
Pas, Lut ba u imon ovard va [Ibrokh'im] guft: <<Man ba suii Parvardigoram [ba sarzamini Shom] kh'ich'rat mekunam. Be tardid, U shikastnopaziri kh'akim ast>>
Va Iskh'ok'u Ia'k'ubro ba u bakhshidem va miioni farzandonash nubuvvat va kitob [-i osmoni] k'aror dodem va podoshashro dar in dunio dodem va iak'inan, u dar okhirat [niz] az shoistagon khokh'ad bud
Va [iod kun az] Lut kh'angome ki ba k'avmash guft: <<Vok'ean, kori bisior zishte mekuned, ki pesh az shumo kh'ech' iak az mardumi ch'akh'on anch'om nadodaast

Oio bo mardon meomezed va [ba k'asdi tach'ovuz ba musofiron] rokh'ro mebanded va dar mach'olisi khud murtakibi korkh'oi nopisand meshaved>>? Pas, posukhi k'avmash ch'uz in nabud, ki guftand: <<Agar rostgui, azobi ilokh'iro pesh ovar>>
[Lut] Guft: <<Parvardigoro, maro dar barobari mufsidon iori kun>>

Va kh'angome ki firistodagoni mo ba Ibrokh'im bashorati [tavalludi pisarashro] dodand, ba u guftand: <<Mo sokinoni shakh'ri [Sadum]-ro nobud khokh'em kard, [charo ki] be tardid, mardumi on ch'o sitamgorand>>

[Ibrokh'im] Guft: <<Lut niz dar on ch'ost>>. Farishtagon guftand: <<Mo bekh'tar medonem chi kasone dar on ch'o kh'astand. U va khonavodaashro, kh'atman, nach'ot khokh'em dod, magar kh'amsarash, ki az bozmondagon [dar azob] khokh'ad bud>>

Va chun farishtagoni mo nazdi Lut omadand, az [tasavvuri besharmii k'avmash nisbat ba] onon nigaron va diltang shud va [farishtagon] guftand: Natars va andukh'gin nabosh. Mo tu va khonavodaatro, kh'atman, nach'ot medikh'em, magar kh'amsaratro, ki az bozmondagon [dar azob] ast
Mo bar sokinoni in shakh'r - ba kaifari on ki nofarmoni [va gunokh'] kardaand - azobe az osmon furud meovarem>>
Va dar kh'ak'ik'at, mo az on shakh'r [-i vaironshuda] baroi kasone, ki meandeshand, nishona [va ibrati] oshkore bok'i guzoshtem
Va ba suii [sokinoni] Madian barodarashon Shuaib [-ro firsitodem]. U guft: <<Ei k'avmi man, Allokh'ro biparasted va ba ruzi bozpasin umedvor boshed va dar zamin ba fasod [va tabokh'i] nakushed>>
Vale uro durug'gu angoshtand va zilzila ononro faro girift. Pas, dar khonakh'oi khud ba rui aftodand va kh'alok shudand

Va [k'avmi] Od va Samudro [niz kh'alok kardem] va iak'inan barkhe az khonakh'oi [vaironshudai] onon baroiaton namoion ast. Va shaiton korkh'oiashonro dar nazarashon biiorost va ononro az rokh'i [kh'ak'] bozdosht, dar kh'ole ki [nisbat ba kh'ak'k'u botil] bino budand

Va K'orun va Fir'avn va Kh'omonro [niz nobud kardem] va ba rosti, Muso bo daloili ravshan nazdashon omad, pas, onon dar sarzamin [-i Misr] sarkashi kardand, vale [az azobi ilokh'i] peshi nagiriftand [va rokh'i firor nadoshtand]

Pas, kh'ar iake az eshonro ba [kaifari] gunokh'ashon azob kardem. Pas, ba barkhe az onon boroni sang firistodem va barkhe digarro bongi margbor furu girift va barkhero dar zamin furu burdem va barkhero g'ark' kardem. Allokh' taolo kh'argiz ba onon sitam nakard, balki onon [khud] ba kheshtan sitam mekardand

Masali kasone, ki ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo dustone [az sangu chub va murdagonro ba unvoni shafoatgar] baroi khud barguzidaand, kh'amchun masali ankabut ast, ki khonai [bedavomro panokh'gokh'i khesh] barguzidaast va be tardid, susttarin khonakh'o khonai ankabut ast. Agar [mushrikon in kh'ak'ik'atro] medonistand, [butkh'oro ba parastish namegiriftand]
Iak'inan, Allokh' taolo kh'ar on chiro ba ch'oii U [ba parastish] mekhonand medonad va U shikastnopaziri kh'akim ast
In masalkh'oro baroi mardum mezanem va ch'uz donoion kase onkh'oro darnameiobad
Allokh' taolo osmonkh'o va zaminro ba kh'ak' ofarid. Be tardid, dar in [ofarinish] baroi mu'minon nishonae [az k'udrati ilokh'i] ast

[Ei paiombar] On chiro az in kitob bar tu vakh'i shudaast, tilovat kun va namoz barpo dor. Ba rosti, ki namoz insonro az gunokh' va zishtkori bozmedorad va, albatta, iodi Allokh' taolo [az kh'ar kore] bolotar ast va Allokh' taolo medonad, ki chi mekuned

[Ei mu'minon] Bo akh'li kitob ch'uz ba bekh'tarin sheva bakh'su munozira nakuned, magar kasone az onon, ki sitam kardand [va bo shumo ba ch'ang brakhostand] va bigued: <<Mo ba tamomi on chi [az suii Allokh' taolo] bar mo va shumo nozil shudaast, imon ovardaem va ma'budi mo va shumo iakest va mo taslimi [farmoni] U kh'astem>>

Va bad-in guna [ki ba paiombaroni peshin kitobi osmoni furu firistodem] in kitobro [niz] bar tu nozil kardem, pas, kasone, ki [pesh az tu] ba onon kitob [-i osmoni] dodem, ba in [K'ur'on niz] imon meovarand va az inon [mushrikon] kasone kh'astand, ki ba on imon meovarand va ch'uz kofiron [kase] oioti Moro inkor namekunad
Va pesh az [nuzuli] K'ur'on tu [kh'argiz] kh'ech' kitobe namekhondi va bo dasti khud chize namenavishti, vagarna, kh'atman, botilandeshon [dar borai kh'ak'ik'ati paiombariat] tardid mekardand
Balki on [kitob mushtamil bar] oioti ravshanest, ki dar sinai donishvaron [-i mu'min] ch'oi dorad va ch'uz sitamgoron [-i mushrik kase] oioti Moro inkor namekunad

Va [mushrikon] guftand: <<Charo mu'ch'izote az sui Parvardigorash bar u nozil nashudaast>>? Bigu: <<Mu'ch'izot nazdi Allokh' taolo ast [va ba farmoni U nozil meshavad] va man fak'at bimdikh'andai oshkoram>>
Oio baroiashon kofi nest, ki Mo K'ur'onro bar tu nozil kardem, ki [paivasta] bar onon khonda meshavad? Be gumon, dar in [K'ur'on] baroi mardume, ki imon meovarand, rakh'matu pand ast

Bigu: <<Kh'amin bas, ki Allokh' taolo miioni manu shumo guvokh' ast. U on chiro, ki dar osmonkh'o va zamin ast, medonad va kasone, ki ba botil garavidaand va ba Allokh' taolo kufr varzidaand, ononand, ki ziionkorand>>

Va [mushrikon] ba shitob az tu darkhosti azob mekunand va agar mav'idi muk'arrare [dar kor] nabud, iak'inan, azobi [ilokh'i] ba [surog'i] onon meomad va [saranch'om] dar kh'ole ki g'ofiland, nogakh'on ba surog'ashon khokh'ad omad
Va [mushrikon] ba shitob az tu darkhosti azob mekunand, va iak'inan, duzakh bar kofiron ikh'ota dorad
Ruze, ki azob az boloi saru zeri poiashon ononro faro megirad va [Allokh' taolo ba onon] mefarmoiad: <<[Kaifari] On chiro anch'om medoded, bichashed
Ei bandagoni man, ki imon ovardaed, be gumon, zamini Man gustarda ast [pas, baroi rakh'oi az fishori mushrikon kh'ich'rat kuned] va tankh'o Maro parasted>>
Kh'ar kase chashandai [ta'mi] marg ast; on gokh' ba sui Mo bozgardonda meshaved

Va kasone, ki imon ovardaand va korkh'oi shoista anch'om dodaand, kh'atman, ononro dar g'urfakh'oe az bikh'isht ch'oi medikh'em, ki ch'uiborkh'o az zeri on ch'ori ast. Ch'ovidona dar on khokh'and mond. Chi nakust podoshi amalkunandagon!
[Kh'amon] Kasone, ki shikeboi varzidand va tankh'o bar Parvardigorashon tavakkal mekunand
Va chi bisior ch'ondorone, ki [nametavonand] ruzii khudro kh'aml [io zakhira] kunand. Allokh' taolo ba onkh'o va shumo ruzi medikh'ad va U shunavovu donost

Va agar az onon [mushrikon] bipursi: <<Chi kase osmonkh'o va zaminro ofarida va khurshedu mokh'ro ba khidmat [-i inson] gumoshtaast?>>. Musallaman, meguiand: <<Allokh' taolo. Pas, chi guna [az kh'ak'] ruigardon meshavand?
Allokh' taolo [ne'matu] ruziro bar kh'ar ki bikhokh'ad gusturda medorad va [io] tang megirad. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo ba kh'ar chize donost

Va agar az onon bipursi: <<Chi kase az osmon boron firistod va ba vasilai on zaminro - pas az khushki va khazonash - zinda kard>>? Musallaman, meguiand: <<Allokh' taolo>>. Bigu: <<Kh'amdu sitoish makhsusi Allokh' taolo ast>>, balki beshtarashon [dar in nishonakh'o] nameandeshand
Va in zindagii dunio [chize] ch'uz sargarmi va bozicha nest va be tardid, saroi okhirat zindagoni [-i rostin] ast. Agar [kofiron in kh'ak'ik'atro] medonistand [ba dunio dilbasta namebudand]
Vak'te [mushrikon] dar kishti savor meshavand, Allokh'ro bo ikhlos mekhonand, ammo chun ononro ba khushki merasonad va [az khatari g'ark' shudan] merakh'onad, on gokh' [boz kh'am] shirk mevarzand
[Chunin mekunand] To nisbat ba ne'matkh'oe, ki ba eshon dodaem, nosiposi kunand va [az lazzatkh'oi zindagii dunio] bakh'ramand boshand. Pas, ba zudi [saranch'omi dardnokashonro] khokh'and donist

Oio nadidaand, dar kh'ole ki mardum peromunashon [giriftori k'atlu g'orat kh'astand va] mavridi dastburd k'aror megirand, Mo kh'arami amne [baroi mardumi Makka] padid ovardem? Oio [boz kh'am] ba [butkh'oi] botil imon meovarand va nisbat ba ne'mati Allokh' taolo nosiposi mekunand?
Va kist sitamgortar az on ki bar Allokh' taolo durug' mebandad io kh'ak'ro - on gokh' ba u merasad - durug' meangorad? Oio dar duzakh ch'oigokh'e baroi kofiron nest?
Kasone, ki dar rokh'i [khushnudii] Mo mekushand, kh'atman, ba rokh'kh'oi khesh kh'idoiatashon mekunem va be tardid, Allokh' taolo bo nakukoron ast
Alif, lom, mim
Rumiion [dar ch'ang bo Fors] shikast khurdand
Dar nazdiktarin sarzamin [marzi Shom bo Fors] va onon pas az shikastashon [dar nabardi digare] piruz khokh'and shud
Dar chand soli [oianda]. Chi k'abl va chi ba'd in [piruzi sarrishtai] kor dar ikhtiiori Allokh' taolo ast va dar on ruz mu'minon shodmon megardand
[In shodi] ba khotiri iori rasonidani Allokh' taolo [ba akh'li kitob] ast va U kh'ar kiro bikhokh'ad, iori mekunad va U shikastnopaziri mekh'rubon ast
[In piruzi] Va'dai Allokh' taolo ast [va] Allokh' taolo kh'argiz az va'dai khud takhalluf namekunad, vale beshtari mardum namedonand
Onon fak'at zokh'ire az zindagii dunioro medonand va az okhirat g'ofiland

Oio bo khud nameandeshand, ki Allokh' taolo osmonkh'o va zamin va on chiro, ki miioni onkh'ost, ch'uz ba kh'ak' va baroi muddati muaiiane naofaridaast? Be tardid, bisiore az mardum ba didori Parvardigorashon [dar k'iiomatro] bovar nadorand

Oio [mushrikon] dar zamin gardish nakardaand, to bubinand saranch'omi kasone, ki pesh az onon budand, chi guna budaast? Onkh'o bisior nerumandtar az inon budand va zaminro [baroi kishovarzi va obodkori] besh az inon digargun sokhtand va obod kardand va paiombaronashon bo daloili ravshan ba surog'ashon omadand [ammo onon inkor kardand va nobud shudand]. Allokh' taolo kh'argiz bar on nabud, ki ba eshon sitam kunad, balki onon khud ba kheshtan sitam mekardand
On gokh' saranch'omi kasone, ki badi karda budand, bisior badtar shud, charo ki oioti Allokh'ro durug' meangoshtand va onkh'oro ba tamaskhur megiriftand
Allokh' taolo ofarinishro og'oz mekunad, sipas onro [pas az margash] bozmegardonad, on gokh' [dar k'iiomat kh'amagi] ba suiash bozgardonda meshaved
Ruze, ki k'iiomat barpo gardad, gunakh'goron [az rakh'mati ilokh'i] noumed meshavand

[Dar on ruz] Mushrikon az baini ma'budoni khud [ki meparastidand] kh'ech' shafoatgare nakhokh'and dosht va nisbat ba ma'budonashon [ki onkh'oro kh'amtoi Allokh' taolo k'aror doda budand] kufr mevarzand
Ruze, ki k'iiomat barpo gardad, [mardum bar asosi korkh'oiashon] az iakdigar ch'udo meshavand
Ammo kasone, ki imon ovardaand va korkh'oi shoista anch'om dodaand, dar bustone [az bikh'isht] shodmon megardand
Va ammo onon, ki kufr varzidand va oioti Mo va didoramon dar okhiratro durug' angoshtand, inon ekh'zorshudagon dar azoband
Pas, Allokh'ro ba poki sitoish kuned, on gokh' ki ba shab darmeoed va on dam, ki ba subkh' merased
va asrgokh'on va kh'angome ki ba nimruz merased va kh'amdu sitoish dar osmonkh'o va zamin az oni Ust

U [mavch'udi] zindaro az [moddai] bech'on [nutfa] padid meovarad va [moddai] bech'onro az [mavch'udi] zinda khorich' mesozad va zaminro - pas az khushki va khazonash - zinda mesozad va [shumo niz ruzi k'iiomat] inchunin barangekhta meshaved
Va az nishonakh'oi U [in] ast, ki shumoro az khok ofarid, sipas insonkh'oe shuded [ki tavalludi misl karded va dar zamin] parokanda gashted

Va dar nishonakh'oi U [in] ast, ki baroi shumo az ch'insi khudaton kh'amsarone ofarid, to dar kanorashon orom gired va miionaton mukh'abbatu mekh'ruboni padid ovard. Be gumon, dar in [ne'mat] baroi khiradvarzon nishonakh'oe [az k'udrati Parvardigor] ast
Va az nishonakh'oi U ofarinishi osmonkh'o va zamin va ikhtilofi zabonkh'o va rangkh'oi shumost. Be tardid, dar in [umur] baroi donishvaron nishonakh'oe [az k'udrati Parvardigor] ast

Va az nishonakh'oi U khobi shumo dar shab va ruz va taloshaton baroi bakh'ragiri az bakhshishi Parvardigor [va ta'mini maosh] ast. Be gumon, dar in umur baroi onon, ki gushi shunavo dorand, nishonakh'oe [az k'udrati Parvardigor] ast

Va az nishonakh'oi U [in] ast, ki soik'aro baroi bimu umed nishonaton medikh'ad va az osmon obe mefiristad va zaminro - pas az khushki va khazonash - bo on zinda mesozad. Be gumon, dar in umur baroi onon, ki meandeshand, nishonakh'oe [az k'udrati Parvardigor] ast
Va az nishonakh'oi U [in] ast, ki osmonkh'o va zamin ba farmonash barpost va [ruzi k'iiomat] kh'angome ki bo nidoe shumoro az zamin faro mekhonad, nogakh'on [kh'amagi az gurkh'o] berun meoed
Kh'ar ki [va kh'ar chi] dar osmonkh'o va zamin ast az oni Allokh' taolo ast va kh'amagi [taslimu] farmonbari U kh'astand

Ust, ki ofarinishro og'oz mekunad, sipas onro [pas az margash] bozmegardonad va in kor baroiash osontar [az ofarinishi nakhustin] ast va bartarin vasf dar osmonkh'o va zamin baroi Ust va U shikastnopaziri kh'akim ast

[Ei mushrikon] Allokh' taolo baroi shumo az khudaton misole meovarad: <<Oio az bardagonaton kase kh'ast, ki dar amvole ba shumo dodaem, sharikaton boshad, chunon ki kh'ar du [dar barkhurdori az on amvol] iakson boshed va kh'amon tavr ki [ba khotiri tasarrufi mol] az iakdigar bim dored, az onon niz bim doshta boshed? [Kh'ol ki chunin nest, pas, charo bandagon va makhluk'oti Allokh'ro bo U sharik medoned]? Mo oiatamonro baroi kasone, ki meandeshand, in chunin ba ravshani baion mekunem

[Daleli shirk kambudi daloili tavkh'idi nest] Balki sitamgoron biduni ilmu ogokh'i az kh'avoiu kh'avasi khud pairavi mekunand, pas onro, ki Allokh' taolo gumrokh' kardaast, chi kase kh'idoiat mekunad? Va onon [dar barobari azobi ilokh'i] kh'ech' iovare nakhokh'and dosht

Pas, [ei paiombar,] kh'ak'garoiona va kholisona ba in din ru ovar. [In oini pok] Islom ast, ki Allokh' taolo fitrati mardumro bar asosi on sirishta ast. Kh'ech' tag'iire dar ofarinishi Allokh' taolo nest. In ast [rokh'i rost va] dini ustuvor, vale beshtari mardum [kh'ak'ik'atro] namedonand
[Ei mu'minon, ba dargokh'i Parvardigor tavba kuned va] Ba sui U bozgarded va az U parvo kuned va namoz barpo dored va az mushrikon naboshed
Az kasone [naboshed], ki dar dinashon tafrik'a ech'od kardand va dasta-dasta shudand va kh'ar gurukh'e ba on chi nazdi khesh dorand khushnudand

Kh'angome ki ba mardum [ranch'u] ziione birasad, zorikunon Parvardigorashonro mekhonand, sipas chun [Allokh' taolo] rakh'mate az ch'onibi khesh ba onon bichashonad [va girekh' az korashon bikshoiad], on gokh' gurukh'e az onon ba Parvardigorashon shirk meovarand
To ba on chi ki ba onon dodaem, nosiposi kunand. Pas, [az lazzatkh'oi duniavi] bakh'ra bigired, ki ba zudi [natich'ai kirdoratonro] khokh'ed donist
Oio [dar kitobkh'oi osmoni] daleli mukh'kame bar onon nozil kardaem, ki az [durustii] on chi ba U [Allokh' taolo] shirk varzidand, sukhan meguiad [va in korro ta'iid mekunad]?
Vak'te rakh'mate ba mardum bichashonem, az on khushnud megardand va agar ba sazoi korkh'oe, ki mekardand, ranch'u musibate ba eshon birasad, [az rakh'mati ilokh'i] noumed meshavand

Oio nadidand, ki Allokh' taolo [ne'matu] ruziro bar kh'ar ki bikhokh'ad gusturda medorad va [io] tang megirad? Be gumon, dar in [kushoishu sakhti] baroi mu'minon nishonakh'oe [az lutfu rakh'mati Parvardigor] ast
Pas, kh'ak'k'i [silai rakh'imi] kheshovand va [sadak'a va zakoti] mustamandu darmondaro ado kun. In [kor] baroi kasone, ki [khushnudii] Allokh'ro metalaband, bekh'tar ast va ononand, ki rastagorand

On chi az amvol [-i khud, ki ba k'asd]-i ribo ba mardum medikh'ed, to [bo pas giriftani on ba mizoni beshtare bar amvolaton] afzun gardad, nazdi Allokh' taolo afzoish nameiobad, va[-le] on chi baroi khushnudii Allokh' taolo [ba unvoni] zakot mepardozed, [barakatu afzoish meiobad] va [kasone, ki chunin mekunand] inonand, ki podoshashon [nazdi Allokh' taolo] chand barobar megardad

Allokh' taolo ast, ki shumoro ofarid va ruzi dod, on gokh' shumoro memironad va boz [dar k'iiomat] zinda mekunad. Oio dar miioni sharikonaton kase kh'ast, ki chize az in [korkh'o]-ro anch'om dikh'ad? Munazzakh' ast U va az on chi bo Vai sharik mesozand, bartar ast

Ba sababi gunokh'one, ki mardum murtakib shudaand, fasod [-u tabokh'i] dar khushki va dario oshkor gashtaast, to [Allokh' taolo] ch'azoi barkhe az a'molashonro ba eshon bichashonad, boshad, ki [ba suii kh'ak'] bozgardand

[Ei paiombar, ba mushrikon] Bigu: <<Dar zamin gardish kuned, to bubined saranch'omi kasone, ki pesh az shumo budand, chi guna budaast. Beshtari onon mushrik budand [va ba kh'amin sabab kh'alok shudand]>>

Pas, ba suii dini mustak'im [va poidor] rui ovar, pesh az on ki ruze az ch'onibi Allokh' taolo faro rasad, ki bozgashte nadorad. Dar on ruz [mardum] parokanda meshavand [gurukh'e ba bikh'isht meravand va gurukh'e ba duzakh]
Kh'ar ki kufr bivarzad, kufrash ba ziioni [khudi] ust va kh'ar ki kore shoista anch'om dikh'ad, [bikh'ishtro] baroi khud omoda mesozad
To [Allokh' taolo] kasonero, ki imon ovardaand va korkh'oi shoista anch'om dodaand, az fazli khud podosh dikh'ad. Be tardid, U kofironro dust namedorad

Az nishonakh'oi [k'udrati] U in ast, ki bodkh'oi bashoratbakhshro [bo muzhdai boron] mefiristad, to az rakh'mati khesh ba shumo bichashonad va kishtikh'o ba farmonash ravon shavand, to az bakhshishi U [ruzi] bich'ued, boshad, ki sipos guzored

Va dar kh'ak'ik'at, pesh az tu [niz]paiombaronero ba suii k'avmashon firistodem va onon ba daloili ravshan nazdashon omadand [vale onkh'oro durug' angoshtand]. Sipas az onon, ki murtakibi gunokh' shuda budand, intik'om giriftem [va mu'minonro nach'ot dodem] va iori dodani [mu'minon [kh'ak'k'e] bar ukh'dai Mo bud

Allokh' taolo ast, ki bodkh'oro ravon mekunad va [onkh'o niz tudai] abrero ba kh'arakat darmeovarand va [Allokh' taolo] onkh'oro chunon ki mekhokh'ad dar [pakh'noi] osmon megustaronad va ba surati porakh'oe darmeovarad va boronro mebini, ki az miioni on [abrkh'o] berun meoiad va chun [Parvardigori mekh'rubon] in [boroni kh'aiotbakhsh]-ro ba kh'ar iak az bandagonash, ki bikhokh'ad furuborad, on gokh' ast, ki shodmon meshavand
Va kh'atman, pesh az on ki bar eshon biborad. [Ore] Pesh az on noumed budand
Pas, ba osori rakh'mati ilokh'i bingar, ki chi guna zaminro pas az khushki va khazonash zinda mekunad. Ba rosti, Ust, ki iak'inan zindagibakhshi murdagon ast va U bar kh'ar chize tavonost
Agar bod [-i suzon]-e bifiristem va on [kishtzorkh'oiashon]-ro zard [-u pazhmurda] bubinand, kh'atman, az on pas nosiposi mekunand
Pas, [ei paiombar] tu kh'argiz nametavoni murdagonro shunavo sozi va ovoi da'vat [-i kh'ak']-ro ba gushi karon birasoni, on gokh' ki onon pusht mekunand va rui megardonand
Va tu rokh'namoi kurdilon az gumrokh'iiashon nesti. Tu tankh'o [sukhani kh'ak'ro] ba gushi kasone merasoni, ki ba oioti Mo imon dorand va [dar barobari farmoni Allokh' taolo] taslimand

Allokh' taolo ast, ki shumoro az [obi] bearzishe ofarid, sipas ba'd az notavoni [davroni khurdsoli] nerumandi bakhshid, on gokh' pas az nerumandi za'fu kukh'ansoli padid ovard. U kh'ar chi bikhokh'ad, meofarinad va U donovu tavonost
Va ruze, ki k'iiomat barpo gardad, gunakh'goron savgand iod mekunand, ki ch'uz soate [dar gur] dirang nakardaand. Onon [dar dunio niz] in guna ba inkh'irof kashida meshudand

Va kasone, ki ba onon donish va imon doda shudaast, [ba gunakh'goron] meguiand: <<Be tardid, shumo [bar asosi on chi] dar kitobi Allokh' taolo [muk'addar budaast], to ruzi rastokhez dirang kardaed. Pas, in ruzi rastokhez ast, ammo shumo namedonisted [va inkorash mekarded]>>
Dar on ruz uzrkhokh'ii kasone, ki sitam kardaand, sude nadorad va az onon darkhosti puzish nameshavad

Ba rosti, ki dar in K'ur'on baroi mardum az kh'ar guna masale ovardem va agar nishonae [dar mavridi rostguiiat] baroiashon biiovari, kasone, ki kufr varzidand, meguiand: <<Shumo botilandeshone besh nested>>
Allokh' taolo bar dilkh'oi kasone, ki [sukhani kh'ak'ro] namefakh'mand, in guna mukh'r [-i g'aflat] menikh'ad
[Ei paiombar, bar ozoru takzibi mushrikon] Shikebo bosh, [ki] kh'atman, va'da [-i iori]-i Allokh' taolo kh'ak' ast va mabodo kasone, ki [ba rastokhez] bovar nadorand, turo az shikeboi bozdorand
Alif, lom, mim
In oioti kitobi kh'akim ast
[Ki] Kh'idoiat va rakh'mate baroi nakukoron ast
Kasone, ki namoz barpo medorand va zakot mepardozand va ba okhirat iak'in dorand
Onon az ch'onibi Parvardigorashon az kh'idoiate barkhurdorand va ononand, ki rastagorand

Va az mardum kase kh'ast, ki dar paii sukhani iova ast, to [digaronro] az rokh'i Allokh' taolo gumrokh' sozad va on [oioti ravshangar]-ro ba tamaskhur megirad. Onon [ki raftorashon chunin ast], azobi khorkunanda [dar pesh] dorand
Va kh'angome ki oioti Mo bar u khonda meshavad, mutakabbirona rui megardonad, guio onro nashnida [va] guio dar gushkh'oiash sangini ast. Pas, uro ba azobe dardnok bashorat dekh'
Be tardid, kasone, ki imon ovardaand va korkh'oi shoista anch'om dodaand, bog'kh'oi purne'mati [bikh'isht] baroi eshon ast
Dar on ch'o ch'ovidonand. Va'dai Allokh' taolo rost ast va U shikastnopaziri kh'akim ast

Chunon ki mebined, [Allokh' taolo] osmonkh'oro biduni sutun ofarid va dar zamin kukh'kh'oi ustuvor [-u mukh'kame] paiafkanad, to [zamini] shumoro nalarzonad va az kh'ar guna ch'unbandae dar on parokanda sokht va az osmon obe firistodem va az kh'ar [giiokh']-i sudmande dar on ruiondem

In ofarinishi Allokh' taolo ast. Inak [ei mushrikon] ba man nishon dikh'ed, ki kasone, ki g'air az U kh'astand [va shumo meparastedashon] chi ofaridaand? Balki sitamgoron [mushrikon] dar gumrokh'ii oshkorand

Ba rosti, Mo ba Luk'mon donish [-i fakh'mi din va tadbiri zindagi] bakhshidem [va ba u guftem], ki: Shukri Allokh'ro ba ch'oi ovar, pas, kh'ar ki shukr kunad, tankh'o ba sudi khesh shukrguzoranda ast va kh'ar ki nosiposi kunad, pas, [bidonad, ki] be tardid, Allokh' taolo beniiozi sutuda ast
Va [iod kun az] on gokh' ki Luk'mon ba pisarash [chunin] pand medod: <<Pisaram, ba Allokh' taolo shirk naovar [va chizero kh'amtoiash k'aror madekh', charo ki] iak'inan, shirk sitami buzurgest>>

Mo insonro [dar borai nakui] ba padaru modarash suporish kardem, [az on ru, ki] modarash uro bo notavonii ruzafzun bordor shud va [davroni shirkhoragi va] bozgiriftanash az shir du sol tul mekashad. [Ba u guftem] Ki: <<shukri Man va padaru modaratro ba ch'o ovar, [ki] bozgasht [kh'ama] ba suii Man ast

Va agar on du [mushrik boshand va] talosh kunand, ki tu chizero shariki Man k'aror dikh'i, ki nisbat ba on donishe nadori, pas, az on du itoat nakun va dar dunio bo eshon ba shoistagi [va nakui] raftor kun va az rokh'i kase pairavi kun, ki [muvakh'kh'idona] ba suii Man bozomadaast. Bozgashti kh'ama ba suii Man ast va az on chi mekarded, ogokh'aton mekunam

[Luk'mon guft] <<Pisaram, agar [amali nek io bad] kh'amsangi donai khardal boshad va daruni takhtasange io dar [gushae az] osmonkh'o io dar zamin [nukh'ufta] boshad, Allokh' taolo onro [ruzi k'iiomat ba kh'isob] meovarad. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo borikbini ogokh' ast

Pisaram, namoz barpo dor va [mardumro] ba neki farmon bidekh' va az nopisand bozdor va bar on chi [ki az sakhtikh'oi in kor] ba tu merasad, shikebo bosh. Be tardid, in az [ch'umlai korkh'oest, ki niiozmandi irodai k'avi va] azmi ustuvor ast
Va [bo bee'tinoi] az mardum rui nagardon va mag'rurona dar zamin rokh' narav. Ba rosti, ki Allokh' taolo kh'ech' mutakabbiru fakhrfurushero dust namedorad
Va [dar manishu raftorat] miionarav bosh va ba oromi sukhan bigu [na bo sadoi baland, charo ki] kh'atman, zishttarin sado sadoi kharon ast

[Ei mardum] Oio nadidaed, ki Allokh' taolo on chiro dar osmonkh'o va zamin ast, ba khidmataton gumoshta va [bakhshishi] ne'matkh'oi oshkor va pinkh'oni kheshro bar shumo tamom kard? [Bo in kh'ol] Az mardum kase kh'ast, ki biduni kh'ech' donish va kh'idoiat va kitobi ravshangare dar [mavridi] Allokh' taolo much'odala mekunad

Va kh'angome ki ba onon gufta meshavad: <<Az on chi Allokh' taolo nozil kardaast, pairavi kuned>>. Meguiand: <<[Na] Balki az chize pairavi mekunem, ki padaronamonro bar on ioftem>>. Oio agar shaiton ononro ba suii azobi [otashi] suzon da'vat kunad [boz kh'am az padaronashon pairavi mekunand]?
Kh'ar ki [kholisona] ba Allokh' taolo ru ovarad va nakukor boshad, ba rosti, ki ba dastovezi mukh'kame chang zadaast va saranch'omi korkh'o ba suii Allokh' taolo ast
Kh'ar ki kufr varzad, kufrash turo g'amgin nasozad. Bozgashti onon ba sui Most, on gokh' az on chi kardaand, ogokh'ashon mesozem. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo az [rozi] dilkh'o ogokh' ast
Onon [kofiron]-ro andake [az ne'matkh'oi dunio] bakh'ramand mesozem, on gokh' ba takh'ammuli azobe sakht duchorashon mekunem

Va agar az mushrikon bipursi: Chi kase osmonkh'o va zaminro ofaridaast?>>, k'at'an, meguiand: <<Allokh' taolo>>. Bigu: Sipos [-u sitoish] makhsusi Allokh' taolo ast [ki shumoro az in kh'ak'ik'at ogokh' namud]>>, balki beshtarashon namedonand
On chi dar osmonkh'o va zamin ast, az oni Allokh' taolo ast. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo beniiozu sutuda ast

Agar [kh'amai] darakhtoni rui zamin k'alam shavad va dario [rang gardad] va kh'aft darioi digar ba ioriashon biioiad [to donishi ilokh'iro binavisand], sukhanoni Allokh' taolo poion nameiobad. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo shikastnopaziru kh'akim ast
[Ei mardum] Ofarinish va barangekhtani shumo [dar k'iiomat] kh'amchun iak nafar besh nest. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo shunavovu binost

Oio nadidi, ki Allokh' taolo az shab mekokh'ad va bar ruz meafzoiad va az ruz mekokh'ad va bar shab meafzoiad va khurshedu mokh'ro ba khidmat [-i inson] gumoshtaast, ki kh'ar iak to zamone muaiian dar [madori khud] ravon boshad? Be tardid, Allokh' taolo az on chi mekuned, ogokh' ast
In [tak'diru tadbir] az on rust, ki Allokh' taolo kh'ak' ast va on chi ch'uz U mekhonand, [kh'ama] botil ast va Allokh' taolo ast, ki balandmartaba [va] buzurg ast

Oio nadidi, ki kishtikh'o ba [farmonu] ne'mati Allokh' taolo dar dario ravonand, to barkhe az nishonakh'oi kheshro ba shumo binamoiad? Be tardid, dar in amr baroi kh'ar shikeboi siposguzor nishonakh'oe [az k'udratu lutfi Parvardigor] ast

Va on gokh' ki mavch'i kukh'paikare ononro ikh'ota mekunad, Allokh'ro dar kh'oli kholisona mekhonand, ki din [-u parastish]-ro tankh'o vizhai U medonand. On gokh' chun ononro [az marg] rakh'onad va ba khushki rasonad, barkhe az eshon miionarav [meshavand, vale chunon ki boiad, sipos nameguzorand, dar kh'ole ki barkhe digar nosiposand] va oioti Moro kase ch'uz paimonshikanoni nosipos inkor namekunand

Ei mardum, az Parvardigoraton parvo kuned va az ruze bitarsed, ki na kh'ech' padare baroi farzandash sude dorad va na kh'ech' farzande sudrasoni padar ast. Iak'inan, va'dai Allokh' taolo [dar mavridi k'iiomat] kh'ak'ik'at dorad. Pas, [kh'ushior boshed, ki lazzatkh'oi] zindagii dunioi shumoro nafirebad va shaiton nisbat ba [ta'khiri azob va shikeboii] Allokh' taolo firebaton nadikh'ad

Be tardid, ogokh'i [az zamoni vuk'ui] k'iiomat [tankh'o] nazdi Allokh' taolo ast va [Ust, ki] boron nozil mekunad va on chiro, ki dar rakh'imkh'ost, medonad va kase namedonad, fardo chi ba dast meovarad va kh'ech' kas ogokh' nest, ki dar kadom sarzamin memirad. Ba rosti, ki Allokh' taolo donovu ogokh' ast
Alif, lom, mim
Nuzuli in kitob, ki dar [kh'ak'k'oniiati] on kh'ech' shakke nest, az ch'onibi Parvardigori ch'akh'oniion ast

[Kofiron] Meguiand: <<[Mukh'ammad] Onro ba durug' [ba Parvardigorash] nisbat medikh'ad>>. [Kh'argiz chunin nest] Balki on [oiot sukhani] kh'ak'k'e az ch'onibi Parvardigori tust, to ba k'avme, ki pesh az tu baroiashon [kh'ech'] bimdikh'andae naomadaast, kh'ushdor dikh'i, boshad, ki kh'idoiat shavand

Allokh' taolo ast, ki osmonkh'o va zamin va on chiro, ki miioni onkh'ost, dar shash ruz ofarid, on gokh', [ki shoistai shukukh'i Ust] bar Arsh k'aror girift. Shumo ba ch'uz U kh'ech' korsozu shafoatgare nadored. Oio pand namegired?
Kor [-i ch'akh'oni kh'asti]-ro az osmon to zamin tadbir mekunad. On gokh' dar ruze, ki mik'dori on baroi shumo [insonkh'o] kh'azor sol ast, [in korkh'o] ba sui U bolo meravad
In [Parvardigori shumost] donoi pinkh'onu oshkor, shikastnopaziri mekh'rubon
[Kh'amon] Kase, ki kh'ar chi ofarid, ba nakutarin [shakl] ofarid va ofarinishi [nakhustini] insonro az gil og'oz kard
Sipas nasli uro az chakidai obi bearzish padid ovard
On gokh' [andomi] uro somon dod va az rukh'i khesh [rukh'e, ki khud ofarid] dar vai damid va baroi shumo [ne'mati] gushu chashm va dil k'aror dod. Chi andak sipos meguzored!
[Mushrikon] Meguiand: <<Oio vak'te [murdem va] dar zamin nopadid shudem, ofarinishi ch'adide khokh'em ioft>>? Balki onon didori Parvardigorashonro munkirand
[Ei paiombar] bigu: <<Farishtai marg, ki bar shumo gumoshta shudaast, ch'onatonro megirad, on gokh' ba suii Parvardigoraton bozgardonda meshaved>>

Va chun [dar k'iiomat] gunakh'goronro dar peshgokh'i Parvardigorashon bubini, sar ba zer afkandaand [va meguiand] <<Parvardigoro, [aknun kh'ak'ik'atro] didem va shunidem, pas, moro bozgardon, to kori shoistae anch'om dikh'em. Be tardid, mo [ba k'iiomat] iak'in dorem>>

Agar mekhostem, ba kh'ar kase [tavfik' va] kh'idoiatashro arzoni medoshtem, vale in sukhan [-u va'dai] man kh'ak' ast, ki: <<Duzakhro az kh'amai ch'inniion va odamiion [-i kofir] anboshta khokh'am kard>>

[Ba onon gufta meshavad] <<Ba sazoi on ki didori imruzatonro faromush karded, [azobi suzonro] bichashed. Iak'inan, mo [niz] shumoro [dar otash] rakh'o kardaem va [aknun] ba sazoi on chi mekarded, azobi ch'ovidonro bichashed
Fak'at kasone ba oioti Mo imon meovarand, ki chun ba onkh'o pand doda shavad, ba sach'da meaftand va Parvardigorashonro ba poki mesitoiand va takabbur namekunand
[Dar dili shab] Az bistarkh'o barmekhezand va Parvardigorashonro bo bimu umed [ba niioish] mekhonand va az on chi ba onon ruzi dodaem, infok' mekunand
Pas, kh'ech' kas namedonad, ba [posi] on chi [in mu'minon dar dunio] anch'om medikh'and, chi [bisior moiai] ravshanii chashmkh'o baroiashon nukh'ufta ast
Oio [podoshi] kase, ki mu'min ast, kh'amchun kasest, ki nofarmon ast? Kh'argiz barobar nestand
Ammo kasone, ki imon ovardaand va korkh'oi shoista anch'om dodaand, ch'oigokh'ashon bog'kh'o [-i bikh'ishti] ast. Podoshest ba [posi] on chi mekardand

Va ammo kasone, ki nofarmoni kardand, ch'oigokh'ashon otash [-i duzakh] ast. Kh'ar gokh' bikhokh'and az on khorich' shavand, ba darunash bozgardonda meshavand va ba onon gufta meshavad: <<Bichashed azobi otashero, ki kh'amvora durug'ash meangoshted>>
Iak'inan pesh az azobi buzurgi [okhirat] az azobi nazdik [va sakhtikh'oi in dunio] ba onon mechashonem, boshad, ki [ba dargokh'i ilokh'i] bozgardand
Kist sitamgortar az on ki uro ba oioti Parvardigorash pand doda meshavad, sipas az on rui megardonad? Be tardid, Mo az gunakh'goron intik'om megirem
Mo ba Muso kitob [Tavrot] dodem - pas, [ei paiombar] az didori U dar tardid nabosh - va onro rakh'namudi Bani Isroil gardonidem
va chun onon [bar ibodat va duri az gunokh'] shikeboi mekardand va ba oioti Mo iak'in doshtand, az miionashon peshvoione bargumoshtem, ki ba farmoni Mo [mardumro] kh'idoiat mekardand
Musallaman, Parvardigori tust, ki ruzi k'iiomat dar mavridi on chi ikhtilof doshtand, miionashon dovari mekunad

Oio baroiashon ravshan nashudaast, ki chi bisior naslkh'oero pesh az onon nobud kardem, ki [aknun in kofiron] dar khonakh'oi onkh'o rokh' meravand? Ba rosti, ki dar in [azobu nobudi] ibratkh'ost. Oio [boz kh'am sukhani kh'ak'ro] nameshunavand?

Oio nadidand, ki Mo boronro ba suii zamini khushk [va begiiokh'] mefiristem va ba vasilai on kishtzore padid meovarem, ki khud va chakh'orpoionashon az on mekhurand? Oio [nishonakh'oi k'udrati Allokh' taolo bar rastokhezro] namebinand?
Va [kofiron] meguiand: <<Agar rostgued, in dovari [miioni mo va shumo] kai faro merasad>>?
Bigu: <<Dar ruzi dovari [ki ch'udoii kh'ak' va botil ast] imon ovardani kasone, ki kufr varzidand, sude nadorad va ba onon mukh'lat [-i tavba] doda nameshavad>>
Pas, [ei paiombar, aknun ki bar shirk pofishori mekunand] az eshon rui bigardon va muntaziri [azobashon] bosh [ki] be tardid, onon [niz] muntazirand
Ei paiombar, az Allokh' taolo parvo kun va az kofiron va munofik'on itoat nakun. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo kh'amvora donoi kh'akim ast
Va az on chi az ch'onibi Parvardigorat ba tu vakh'i meshavad pairavi kun. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo kh'amvora ba on chi mekuned, ogokh' ast
Va bar Allokh' taolo tavakkal kun va kh'amin basanda ast, ki Allokh' taolo korsozi tu boshad

Allokh' taolo daruni kh'ech' marde du k'alb baroiash nanikh'odaast va [ba kh'amin surat] kh'argiz kh'amsaronatonro ki mavridi zikh'or [va takh'rimi ch'insi] k'aror medikh'ed, [kh'amchun] modaronaton nagardondaast; va [kh'amchunin] pisarkhondakh'oiatonro pisaronaton nasokhtaast. In sukhani [nodurust] ast, ki bar zabon meovared va Allokh' taolo kh'ak'ro meguiad va Ust, ki ba rokh'i rost kh'idoiat mekunad

Onon [pisarkhondakh'o]-ro ba padaronashon nisbat dikh'ed, [ki] nazdi Allokh' taolo odilonatar ast. Agar padaronashonro nameshinosed, pas, onkh'o barodaroni dini va bardagoni ozodshuda [va dar kh'ukmi dustoni] shumo kh'astand. Dar mavridi on chi [k'ablan] ishtibokh' kardaed, gunokh'e bar shumo nest; vale on chi dilkh'oiaton k'asdi onro dorad [va amdan bar zabon meovared, gunokh' ast; pas, agar tavba kuned] kh'amvora Allokh' taolo omurzandai mekh'rubon ast

Paiombar [dar tamomi umur] nisbat ba mu'minon, az khudashon sazovortar ast [va nazar va khostash avlaviiat dorad] va kh'amsaroni u [az likh'ozi kh'urmati izdivoch' dar kh'ukm] modaronashon kh'astand; va dar kitobi Allokh' taolo, kheshovandon [dar irs burdan az iakdigar] nisbat ba mu'minom va mukh'och'iron avlaviiat dorand [va miloki irs, kheshovandi ast na imon]; magar in ki [bikhokh'ed] ba dustonaton neki kuned [va bakhshe az amvolatonro ba eshon bidikh'ed]. In [kh'ukm] dar on kitob [Lavkh'i makh'fuz] navishta shudaast

Va [ei Paiombar, iod kun az] kh'angome ki az paiombaron paimon [iaktoparasti va nubuvvat] giriftem va [ba vizha] az tu va Nukh' va Ibrokh'im va Muso va Iso- pisari Mariam; va az kh'amai onon paimoni makh'kame [dar borai tablig'i din] giriftem
[Allokh' taolo chunin kard] to [bo kofiron itmomi kh'uch'ch'at karda boshad va] az rostguion [paiombaron] dar borai rostiashon bipursad va baroi kofiron azobe dardnok mukh'aiio kardaast

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, ne'mati Allokh'ro bar khud ba iod ovared; on gokh' ki sipokh'iione [az k'aboili arab] ba suiaton omadand. Pas, Mo tundbode [sakht] va lashkare [az farishtagon] ki onkh'oro namedided, bar onon firistodem [va ba sakhti shikastashon dodem]; va kh'amvora Allokh' taolo ba on chi mekuned binost

Vak'te [dar g'azvai Khandak'] dushmanon az bolo va poion [va az shark' va g'arbi shakh'r] ba suiaton omadand [va Madinaro mukh'osira kardand]; on gokh' ki chashmkh'o [ba farovonii dushman] khira gashta va ch'onkh'o [az shiddat va vakh'shat] ba gulugokh' rasida bud va shumo ba Allokh' taolo gumonkh'o [-i gunogun] meburded
Onch'o bud, ki mu'minon ozmoish shudand va shadidan ba vakh'shat va iztirob aftodand

Va [niz ba iod ovared] kh'angome ki munofik'on va kasone, ki dar dilkh'oiashon bemori [shak va tardid] bud, meguftand: <<On chi Allokh' taolo va Paiombarash [dar borai piruzi bar kofiron] va'da dodaand, ch'uz firebe besh nest>>

Va [niz] kh'angome ki gurukh'e az onon guftand: <<Ei akh'li Iasrib, inch'o ch'oii mondani shumo nest; pas, [ba khonakh'oiaton] bozgarded>>; va barkhe az onon az Paiombar ich'ozati [bozgasht] mekhostand va meguftand: <<Khonakh'oi mo be kh'ifzkunanda ast>>; dar kh'ole ki be kh'ifzkunanda nabud. Onon chize ch'uz firor [az ch'ikh'od] namekhostand

Agar [lashkari dushmanon] az atrofi on [shakh'r] bar onon vorid meshudand [va khonakh'oiashonro mukh'osira mekardand] va az onon khosta meshud, ba kufr va shirk bozgardand, kh'atman chunin [taakh'kh'ude ba dushman] dodand va ch'uz te'dode andak [dar barobari in darkhost] muk'ovimat namekardand

Va pesh az in [vak'te kh'amin munofik'on dar ch'angi Ukh'ud az muk'obili kofiron gurekhtand] bo Allokh' taolo paimon bastand, ki [kh'argiz ba dushman] pusht nakunand [va az maidon nagurezand]; va kh'amvora paimoni ilokh'i bozkhost dorad
[Ei Paiombar, ba munofik'on] bigu: << Agar az marg io kushta shudan firor kuned, kh'argiz sude ba kh'olaton nadorad; va dar on surat niz [az zindagii dunio] ch'uz andake bakh'ramand nameshaved>>

Bigu: <<Agar Allokh' taolo baroiaton musibat io rakh'mate khosta boshad, kist, ki shumoro dar barobari [ich'roi farmoni] U kh'ifz kunad?>> va onon baroi khesh ba ch'uz Allokh' taolo kh'ech' korsoz va iorigare nameioband

Allokh' taolo kasonero az shumo, ki bozdoranda [-i mardum az ch'ikh'od] kh'astand va ba barodaronashon meguiand: <<Ba mo bipaivanded>> ba khubi meshinosad. [Onon sustbovarand] va ch'uz andake ba maidoni ch'ang nameoiand

[Munofik'on dar kh'ama chiz] bar shumo bukhl mevarzand; va kh'angome ki bim [ch'ang pesh] meoiad, dar kh'ole ki chashmkh'oiashon [az vakh'shat dar kosakhona] mecharkhad, kh'amchun kase, ki az [sakhtii] marg bekh'ush shuda boshad, turo nigokh' mekunand; va chun [bukh'ron va] tars bartaraf shud, ba khotiri kh'irs va tama'e, ki ba g'anoim dorand, bo zabonkh'oi tund va neshdor shumoro meranch'onand. Onon [kh'argiz] imon naiovardaand; pas, Allokh' taolo a'molashonro tabokh' megardonad va in [kor] kh'amvora bar Allokh' taolo oson ast

[Munofik'on] mepindorand [ki lashkariion] akh'zob [kh'anuz az atrofi Madina] naraftaand; va agar akh'zob bozgardand, [in sustbovaron] orzu mekunand, ki miioni bodiianishinon [pinkh'on] boshand [va az kh'amon ch'o] akhbori [dargirii] shumoro ch'uio shavand; va [kh'atto] agar baini [sipokh'i] shumo budand, ch'uz andake namech'angidand
Be tardid, dar [ raftor va guftori] Rasulullokh', baroi shumo sarmashk'i nekue ast; baroi kh'ar ki ba Allokh' taolo va ruzi okhirat umed dorad va Allokh'ro bisior iod mekunad

Va chun mu'minon [lashkari] akh'zobro didand, guftand: <<In [imtikh'oni ilokh'i va piruzii nikh'oiiash] kh'amon chize ast, ki Allokh' taolo va Paiombarash ba mo va'da dodaand va [bar kh'ak' ] Allokh' taolo va Paiombarash rost guftand>> va [mushokh'idai anbukh'i dushman] ch'uz bar imon va taslimashon [dar muk'obili Parvardigor] naiafzud

Az miioni mu'minon mardone kh'astand ba akh'd va paimone, ki bo Allokh' taolo basta budand, [sodik'ona] vafo kardand; barkhe az onon to okhir bar akh'd va paimoni khud istodand [ va dar in rokh' darguzashtand io shakh'id shudand] va barkhe digar kh'anuz chashmintizor [shakh'odat] kh'astand va kh'argiz [paimoni khudro] digargun nasokhtaand

[In ruidodkh'o pesh meoiad] to Allokh' taolo rostguionro ba [posi poimardi va] rostguiiashon podosh dikh'ad va munofik'onro - agar bikhokh'ad - azob kunad io tavbaashonro bipazirad. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo omurzandai mekh'rubon ast

Va Allokh' taolo [sipokh'i ] kasonero, ki kufr varzida budand bo [tamomi nokomi va] khashmashon [az in ki] ba kh'ech' g'animate dast naiofta budand, [az atrofi Madina] bozgardond va [pushtibonii] Allokh' taolo dar ch'ang, mu'minonro kifoiat kard; va Allokh' taolo kh'amvora tavonovu shikastnopazir ast

[Allokh' taolo] Gurukh'e az akh'li kitob [iakh'udiioni Bani K'uraiza]- ro, ki az onon [mushrikon] pushtiboni karda budand, az k'al'akh'oiashon ba zer kashid va dar dilkh'oiashon vakh'shat andokht; [chunon ki shumo] gurukh'e [az onon] -ro mekushted va gurukh'ero ba asorat megirifted

Va zaminkh'oi kishovarzi va khonakh'o va amvolashon va [kh'amchunin] sarzaminero, ki kh'argiz po ba on ch'o naguzoshta buded [Khaibar], dar ikhtiioraton nikh'od; va Allokh' taolo bar kh'ar chize tavonost

Ei Paiombar, ba kh'amsaronat [ki nafak'ai beshtare mekhokh'and] bigu: << Agar zindagii dunio va zinatkh'oiashro mekhokh'ed, biioed, to shumoro [bo kh'adiai munosib] bakh'ramand sozam va [biduni kh'ech' ozore] ba shoistagi rakh'oiaton kunam
Va agar mushtok'i Allokh' taolo va paiombarash va saroi okhirat kh'asted, pas, [bidoned, ki] be tardid, Allokh' taolo baroi nekukoronaton podoshi buzurge farokh'am kardaaast>>
Ei zanoni Paiombar, kh'ar iake az shumo, ki [gunokh'i] noshoisti oshkore murtakib shavad, azobash duchandon megardad; va in [kor] kh'amvora baroi Allokh' taolo oson ast

Va kh'ar iake az shumo, ki paivasta farmonbardori Allokh' taolo va Paiombarash boshad va kore shoista kunad, podoshashro du barobar medikh'em va baroiash [dar bikh'isht] ruzii arzishmande farokh'am ovardaem

Ei zanoni Paiombar, agar parkh'ezkori kuned, [dar bartari va sharofat] monandi kh'ech' iak az zanoni [odi] nakhokh'ed bud; pas, kh'angomi sukhan guftan [bo mardon] noz va narmish ba kor nabared, to [mabodo] on ki dar dilash bemori ast, [dar shumo] tama' kunad va ba shevai shoista sukhan bigued

Va dar khonakh'oiaton bimoned va kh'amchun ch'ilvagari [-i zanon dar davroni] ch'okh'iliiati peshin, ch'ilvagari [va khudnamoi] nakuned va namoz barpo dored va zakot bipardozed va az Allokh' taolo va Paiombarash itoat kuned. Ei akh'li khona [paiombar], ch'uz in nest Allokh' taolo mekhokh'ad palidi [va ozori begonagon]-ro az shumo dur namoiad va komilan pokaton gardonad
Va kh'ar on chiro, ki az oioti ilokh'i va sunnati Paiombar dar khonakh'oiaton khonda meshavad, ba iod doshta boshed. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo kh'amvora borikbini ogokh' ast

Allokh' taolo baroi mardoni musulmon va zanoni musulmon va mardoni mu'min va zanoni mu'min va mardoni farmonbardor va zanoni farmonbardor va mardoni rostgu va zanoni rostgu va mardoni shikebo va zanoni shikebo va mardoni furutan va zanoni furutan va mardoni infok'gar va zanoni infok'gar va mardoni ruzador va zanoni ruzador va mardoni pokdoman va zanoni pokdoman va mardon va zanone, ki Allokh'ro bisior iod mekunand, baroi [kh'amai] onon omurzish va podoshi buzurg farokh'am namudaast

Baroi kh'ech' mard va zani mu'mine shoista nest, ki vak'te Allokh' taolo va rasulash ba kore farmon medikh'and [dar ich'roi on farmon] ikhtiiore doshta boshand;va kh'ar ki az Allokh' taolo va rasulash nofarmoni kunad, kh'ak'k'o, ki dar gumrokh'ii oshkore giriftor shudaast

[Ba iod ovar] Vak'te ba [Zaid ibni Kh'orisa]-kase, ki Allokh' taolo ba u ne'mat [Islom] doda bud va tu ne'mat [ozodi] bakhshida budi- [ba nasikh'at] megufti: <<Kh'amsaratro baroi khud nigakh' dor va az Allokh' taolo parvo kun>> va dar dili khesh [dar mavridi izdivoch' bo Zainab pas az talok'ash] pinkh'on medoshti, ki Allokh' taolo oshkorkunandai on bud va [chun in izdivoch' bo sunnatkh'oi ch'okh'ili mukholif bud] az [sarzanishi] mardum metarsidi; kh'ol on ki Allokh' taolo sazovortar ast, ki az U bitarsi. Pas, kh'angome ki Zaid niiozashro az vai ba poion burd [va talok'ash dod], uro ba izdivoch'i tu darovardem, to baroi mu'minon dar mavridi izdivoch' bo kh'amsaroni pisarkhondakh'oiashon, ki az onon kom giriftaand [va talok'ashon dodaand], kh'ech' gunokh'e naboshad; va farmoni Allokh' taolo kh'amvora anch'ompazir ast

Bar Paiombar, dar mavridi on chi Allokh' taolo baroiash muk'arrar [va kh'alol] doshtaast, kh'ech' guna gunokh'e vuch'ud nadorad. [In kor] Sunnati ilokh'i ast [va] dar borai kasone [paiombarone], ki pesh az in budaand [niz sidk' mekunad]; va farmoni Allokh' taolo kh'amvora dak'ik' va kh'isobshuda ast

[kh'amon] kasone, ki paiomkh'oi Allokh'ro [ba mardum] merasonand va tankh'o az U metarsand va az kh'ech' kas ch'uz Allokh' taolo tarse nadorand; va Allokh' taolo baroi kh'isobrasii [korkh'oi bandagonash] kofi ast
Mukh'ammad kh'argiz padari kh'ech' iaki az mardoni shumo [az ch'umla Zaid] nest; balki rasuli Allokh' taolo va khotami paiombaron ast; va Allokh' taolo kh'amvora ba kh'ar chize donost
Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, Allokh'ro bisior iod kuned
Va bomdod va shomgokh' Uro ba poki bisitoed

Ust, ki bar shumo durud [va rakh'mat] mefiristad va farishtagonash [niz duoiaton mekunand], to shumoro az torikikh'o ba suii nur berun ovarad va [Allokh' taolo] kh'amvora nisbat ba mu'minon mekh'rubon ast
Ruze, ki bo U didor mekunand, durudashon <<Salom>> ast va [Allokh' taolo] bar eshon podoshe arch'mand farokh'am sokhtaast
Ei Paiombar, Mo turo guvokh' va bashoratbakhsh va bimdikh'anda firistodaem
Va [turo] da'vatgare ba suii Allokh' taolo ba farmoni U va charog'i ravshanibakhsh [k'aror dodem]
Va ba mu'minon bashorat bidekh', ki az ch'onibi Allokh' taolo bakhshishi buzurge baroiashon [dar pesh] ast
Va az kofiron va munofik'on itoat nakun va ba ozorashon betavach'chukh' bosh va bar Allokh' taolo tavakkal kun; va kh'amin basanda ast, ki Allokh' taolo [iovar va] korguzori tu boshad

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, kh'ar gokh' bo zanoni mu'min izdivoch' karded, sipas pesh az onki bo onon kh'ambistar shaved talok'ashon doded, az ch'onibi shumo kh'ech' iddae bar ukh'dai onon nest, ki kh'isobashro nigokh' dored; az in ru, eshonro [bo kh'adiai munosib] bakh'ramand sozed va ba nekutarin vach'kh' rakh'oiashon sozed

Ei paiombar, Mo kh'amsaronat, ki makh'rashonro pardokhtai va [niz] kanizonero, ki Allokh' taolo [az bakh'rai ch'ang] ba tu arzoni doshtaast, baroiat kh'alol kardaem va [niz izdivoch' bo] dukhtari amukh'oiat va dukhtari ammakh'oiat va dukhtartag'okh'oiat va dukhtarkholakh'oiat, ki bo tu kh'ich'rat kardaand va [kh'amchunin] agar zani mu'mine khudro [biduni makh'riia] ba paiombar bibakhshad, chunonchi paiombar bikhokh'ad, [metavonad] bo vai izdivoch' kunad. [In kh'ukm] Vizhai tust, na digar mu'minon. Be tardid, Mo medonem baroi onon dar mavridi kh'amsaron va kanizonashon chi kh'ukme ta'iin kardaem. [In kh'ukmi vizharo bark'aror kardem] To kh'ech' tangnoe [dar rokh'i anch'omi vazifa] bar tu naboshad; va Allokh' taolo kh'amvora omurzandai mekh'rubon ast

[Navbati] kh'ar iak az onon [kh'amsaronat]- ro, ki bikhokh'i [metavoni] ba ta'khir andozi va kh'ar kadomro bikhokh'i, [metavoni] nazdi khesh ch'oi dikh'i; va agar kh'ar iak az ononro, ki az u kanora giriftai [va navbatash ba ta'khir aftodaast] talab kuni, [dar kh'ar kh'ol] kh'ech' gunokh'e bar tu nest. In [ikhtiior dar intikhob] nazdiktar ast va in ki chashmashon ravshan shavad va andukh'gin naboshand va kh'amagiashon az on chi ba onon bakhshidai khushnud gardidaand; va Allokh' taolo medonad, ki shumo [mardon dar borai mukh'abbati beshtar ba barkhe zanonaton] chi dar dil dored; va Allokh' taolo kh'amvora donoi burdbor ast

Az in pas [digar izdivoch' bo] kh'ech' zane baroiat kh'alol nest va naboiad [barkhe az kh'amsaronatro talok' dikh'i, to] kh'amsaronero ch'oinishini onon kuni, kh'atto agar zeboii onon [zanoni ch'adid] turo khush oiad. Magar on ki [ba surati kaniz] dar ikhtiiorat boshad; va Allokh' taolo kh'amvora bar kh'ar chize nigakh'bon ast

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, ba khonakh'oi paiombar dokhil nashaved; magar on ki baroi [sarfi] g'izoe ba shumo ich'ozat dikh'and; be on ki [zudtar az vak'ti g'izo biraved va] muntaziri omoda shudanash shaved; vale kh'angome ki shumoro faro khondand, vorid shaved va chun g'izo khurded, parokanda garded va sargarmi [bakh's va] guftugu nashaved. In [raftoraton] paiombarro meozorad va uro az [ibrozi in mavzu' dar barobari] shumo sharm dorad; [vale] Allokh' taolo az [baioni] kh'ak' sharm nadorad. Va kh'angome ki az kh'amsaroni u darkhoste dored, [niiozatonro] az pushti pardae az onon bikhokh'ed [va dar chekh'rai onon nanigared; charo ki] in [kor] baroi dilkh'oi shumo va eshon poktar ast; va [kh'amchunin] baroiaton sazovor nest, ki Rasulullokh'ro biiozored va kh'argiz shoistai shumo nest, ki pas az u bo kh'amsaronash izdivoch' kuned. Ba rosti, ki in [kor] nazdi Allokh' taolo [gunokh'e] buzurg ast
Agar chizero oshkor kuned io pinkh'on dored, [bidoned, ki] betardid, Allokh' taolo ba kh'ar chize ogokh' ast

Bar onon [zanoni musulmon] gunokh'e nest [dar nadoshtani kh'ich'ob] nazdi padaronashon va pisaronashon va barodaronashon va pisaroni barodaronashon va pisaroni khokh'aronashon va zanon [kh'amdin]-ashon va bardagonashon; va [ei zanoni musulmon] az Allokh' taolo parvo kuned. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo bar kh'ama chiz guvokh' ast
Ba rosti, Allokh' taolo va farishtagonash bar paiombar durud mefiristand; [pas] ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed [shumo niz] bar u durud firisted va ba shoistagi salom gued
Kasone ki Allokh' taolo va paiombarashro meozorand, Allokh' taolo dar dunio va okhirat ononro az rakh'mati khesh dur mekunad va baroiashon azobi khorkunanda omoda kardaast
Va onon, ki mardon va zanoni mu'minro be on ki murtakibi [amali zishte] shuda boshand, [bo ittikh'omoti noravo] meozorand, bori durug' va gunokh'i oshkorro bar dush mekashand

Ei paiombar, ba kh'amsaron va dukhtaronat va digar zanoni mu'min bigu, ki chodarkh'oiashonro ba shoistagi bar [sar va sinai] khesh biiafkanand. In [guna pushish] munosibtar ast ba in ki [dar ch'omea matonat va vik'or] shinokhta shavand va [dar natich'a] mavridi ozor [kh'arzagon] k'aror nagirand, Va Allokh' taolo omurzandai mekh'rubon ast

Agar munofik'on va kasone, ki dar dilkh'oiashon bemori [nifok'] ast va ovozasozi dar Madina [az durug'gui va shoeasozi] dast barnadorand, iak'inan turo bar onon musallat megardonem. Dar in surat ch'uz muddati kutokh'e nametavonand dar in shakh'r dar kanori tu bimonand
La'natshudagonand va kh'ar ch'o ki iofta shavand, boiad bemukh'obo dastgir va kushta shavand
[In] Sunnati Allokh' taolo dar mavridi afrode [az munofik'on], ki peshtar budaand, ch'ori gashtaast; va kh'argiz dar sunnati Allokh' taolo digarguni [va tag'iire] nameiobi
[Ei paiombar] Mardum dar borai [zamoni vuk'u'i] k'iiomat az tu mepursand; bigu: <<Donishi on tankh'o nazdi Allokh' taolo ast>>; va tu chi medoni? Shoiad k'iiomat nazdik boshad
Be tardid, Allokh' taolo kofironro az rakh'mati khesh dur karda va baroiashon otashi afrukhta mukh'aiio kardaast
[Otashe] Ki ch'ovidona dar on khokh'and mond [va baroi difo' az khud] kh'ech' korsoz va iorigare nameioband
Ruze, ki chekh'rakh'oiashon dar otashi duzakh digargun meshavad, [bo pushaimoni] meguiand: <<Ei kosh, az Allokh' taolo va Paiombar itoat karda budem
[Onon bakh'ona meovarand va] meguiand: <<Parvardigoro, mo az rakh'baron va buzurgoni khud itoat kardem va onon [budand], ki moro gumrokh' kardand
Parvardigoro! Azobashonro duchandon kun va ba la'nati buzurg [va sakht] la'nat bifarmo!>>

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, [Paiombarro naiozored va] monandi kasone naboshed ki Musoro [bo tukh'matkh'oi noravo] ozurdand, sipas Allokh' taolo uro [az on chi dar kh'ak'k'ash meguftand] tabria namud; va [Muso] kh'amvora nazdi Allokh' obrumand ast.
Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, az Allokh' taolo parvo kuned va sukhani rost va durust bigued

[Parkh'ezgor va rostgu boshed] to Allokh' taolo korkh'oiatonro islokh' kunad va gunokh'onatonro biiomurzad va [bidoned] kh'ar ki az Allokh' taolo va Paiombarash itoat kunad, iak'inan ba komiobii buzurge dast ioftaast

Mo amonati [anch'omi takolifi shar'i] - ro bar osmonkh'o va zamin va kukh'soron arza doshtem va onkh'o az takh'ammulash sar boz zadand va az on tarsidand va [-le] inson onro paziruft. Kh'ak'k'o, ki u [dar kh'ak'k'i khesh] kh'amvora sitamgor va nodon ast

[Inson chunin kard] to Allokh' taolo mardonu zanoni munofik' va mardonu zanoni mushrikro azob kunad va tavbai mardonu zanoni mu'minro [ki amonatdoroni shoistae budand] bipazirad; va Allokh' taolo kh'amvora omurzandai mekh'rubon ast
Sitoish makhsusi Allokh' taolo, ki on chi dar osmonkh'o va zamin ast az oni Ust va dar okhirat [niz] sitoish az oni Ust va U kh'akimu ogokh' ast
Kh'ar chi dar zamin furu meravad va kh'ar chi az on barmeoiad va on chi az osmon furud meoiad va on chi ba suii on bolo meravad [kh'amaro Allokh' taolo] medonad va U mekh'ruboni omurzanda ast

Kasone, ki kufr varzidand, meguiand: <<K'iiomat kh'argiz ba surog'i mo nakhokh'ad omad>>. Bigu: <<Ore, savgand ba Parvardigoram, ki donoi g'aib ast, kh'atman, ba surog'aton meoiad. kh'amsangi zarrae dar osmonkh'o va zamin az U pushida nest va kuchaktar va buzurgtar az on zarra chize nest, magar on ki dar kitobe oshkor [Lavkh'i makh'fuz] sabt ast
To kasonero, ki imon ovardaand va korkh'oi shoista anch'om dodaand podosh dikh'ad. Eshonand, ki bakhshoish va ruzii arzishmande [dar pesh] dorand>>
Va kasone, ki dar [rokh'i inkor va takzibi] oioti Mo kushidand, to [ba pindori khesh] Moro darmonda kunand, azobe sakht va dardnok [dar pesh] dorand

Akh'li donish [donishmandoni sakh'oba va ulamoi mu'mini akh'li kitob] medonand on chi ki az suii Parvardigorat bar tu nozil shuda, kh'ak' ast va ba rokh'i [Allokh' taolo] shikastnopaziri sutuda kh'idoiat mekunad

Kasone, ki kufr vazidand [bo tamaskhur ba iakdigar] meguiand: <<Mekhokh'ed mardero nishonaton dikh'em, ki iddio mekunad vak'te [pas az marg] komilan mutaloshi shuded, [bori digar] dar ofarinishe nav darkhokh'ed omad?

Oio [in mard] bar Allokh' taolo durug' mebandad io devona ast?>> [kh'argiz chunin nest] balki kasone, ki ba okhirat imon nadorand, dar azob [shadidi okhirat] va gumrokh'ii duru daroz [dunio] giriftorand

Oio [kofiron] ba osmonu zamine, ki peshi ru va pushti sarashon ast, nanigaristaand? Agar bikhokh'em, ononro [monandi K'orun] dar zamin furu mebarem io [kh'amchun k'avmi Shuaib] tikkae az osmonro bar sarashon meafkanem. Be gumon, dar in [kh'ushdor] baroi kh'ar bandai tavbakor, nishonae [az k'udrati Allokh' taolo] ast

Mo az ch'onibi khesh ba Dovud fazilate [kh'ukmroni va nubuvvat] bakhshidem [va guftem] <<Ei kukh'soron va ei parandagon, [dar sitoish va niioish] bo u kh'amovoz shaved>> va okh'anro baroiash narm kardem [to kh'ar chi mekhokh'ad bisozad]

[Ba u dastur dodem] ki: <<Zirekh'kh'oi baland [va farokh] bisoz va dar boftan [va paivastani kh'alk'akh'oi zirekh'] sanch'ida va dak'ik' kor kun va [shumo ei mardum] nekukori kuned, [ki] be tardid, Man ba on chi mekuned, bino kh'astam>>

Va baroi Sulaimon bodro [ba khidmat gumoshtem], ki [dar vazish] subkh'gokh'on, masiri iak mokh'aro tai mekard va shomgokh'on [niz] masiri iak mokh'aro mepaimud; va chashmai misi [gudokhta]-ro baroiash ravon sokhtem va gurukh'e az ch'inniion, ba farmoni Parvardigorash, nazdi u kor mekardand va kh'ar iak az onon, ki az farmoni Mo sarpechi mekard, ba u az azobi suzon mechashondem

Onkh'o baroi u kh'ar chi mekhost mesokhtand: az [kokh va] ibodatgokh' va much'assama va kosakh'oe [ki az buzurgi] kh'amchun kh'avz [budand] va degkh'oe bisior buzurg va sobit. [Ba onon guftem] <<Ei oli Dovud, siposi [ne'matkh'oi Maro] ba ch'oi ovared>> va [-le] andake az bandagonam siposguzorand

Pas, chun margro bar Sulaimon muk'arrar doshtem, [kh'ech' kas] ononro az margash ogokh' nasokht, magar muriiona [kirmak]-e, ki asoiashro khurd. Pas, chun [paikari Sulaimon] furu aftod, ch'inniion darioftand, ki agar az g'aib ogokh' budand, kh'argiz dar on azobi sangin [va kori tok'atfarso] bok'i namemondand

Dar makh'alli sukunati [k'avmi] <<Saba'>> du bog' [buzurg] az rost va chap [k'aror dosht], ki nishonae [az k'udrat va bakhshishi ilokh'i] bud. [Ba onon guftem] <<Az ruzii Parvardigoraton bikhured va shukrguzorash boshed, [ki] sarzamine pok va Parvardigore omurzanda [dored]

Ammo onon [az shukr va imon] rui gardondand; pas, Mo seli vairongar ba suiashon ravon kardem va du bog'i [purmakh'suli] ononro ba du bog'i [bearzish] tabdil namudem, [ki tankh'o] mevakh'oi talkh va darakhti shuragaz va andake darakhti sidr dosht
Mo ononro ba sazoi nosiposiashon, inchunin, kaifar dodem va oio ch'uz nosiposro kaifar medikh'em?

Va [kh'amchunin] miioni onkh'o [k'avmi Saba' dar Iaman] va sarzaminkh'oe, ki ba onkh'o barakat doda budem, [Shom] shakh'rkh'oe [khurram va] ba kh'am paivasta k'aror dodem va sairu safare [oson] dar on muk'arrar namudem [va ba onon guftem] <<Shabu ruz baini onkh'o emin [va osuda] safar kuned>>

Ammo onon [bo nosiposi] guftand: <<Parvardigoro, miioni safarkh'oi mo fosila [-i beshtare] ech'od kun [to arzishi aspkh'o va shuturkh'oiamon namoion gardad va benavoion natavonand kh'amchun sarvatmandon ba rokh'ati safar kunand]>> va ba kheshtan sitam kardand; pas, Mo [niz sarguzashti] ononro dostone [ibratomuz] baroi digaron sokhtem va sakht [mutaloshi va] parokandaashon namudem. Ba rosti, ki dar in [moch'aro] baroi kh'ar shikeboi siposguzor, nishonakh'oe [az k'udrati ilokh'i] ast
Va iak'inan, iblis gumoni khudro dar mavridi onon ba takh'ak'k'uk' rasond; pas, ch'uz gurukh'e [andak] az mu'minon, [kh'amagi] az u pairavi kardand

[Shaiton] bar onon kh'ech' tasallute nadosht; balki [Mo mekhostem] kasero, ki ba okhirat imon dorad, az kase, ki dar borai on tardid dorad, boz shinosem; va Parvardigorat bar kh'ar chize nigakh'bon ast

[Ei paiombar, ba mushrikon] bigu: <<Kasonero, ki ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo [iovar va shafoatgari khud] mepindored, [ba fariod] bikhoned. Onon kh'atto kh'amsangi zarrae dar osmonkh'o va zamin moliki chize nestand va na dar [ofarinish va tadbiri] on du [zaminu osmon] shirkate dorand va na U [ Allokh' taolo] az ch'onibi onon kh'ech' pushtibone dorad

Shafoat [kh'ech' kas] nazdi U [Allokh' taolo] sude nadorad; magar baroi on ki [Allokh' taolo] ba u ich'ozat doda boshad. [Dar on ruz farishtagon az khavf va kh'aibati ilokh'i tarsonand] to ongokh', ki iztirob [va tashvish] az dilkh'oiashon bartaraf megardad, [gurukh'e az onon ba gurukh'i digar] meguiand: <<Parvardigoraton chi guft?>> [Onon dar posukh] meguiand: <<kh'ak'ro [farmud] va U balanmartabai buzurg ast>>

[Ei paiombar, ba mushrikon] bigu: <<Chi kase az osmonkh'o va zamin ba shumo ruzi medikh'ad?>> [Dar posukh] bigu: <<Allokh' taolo; va iak'inan [iak gurukh' az baini] mo va shumost io bar [rokh'i] kh'idoiat io dar gumrokh'ii oshkor>>
Bigu: <<[Ruzi k'iiomat] Shumo az gunokh'e, ki mo murtakib shudaem, bozkhost nameshaved va moro [niz] ba khotiri on chi shumo anch'om medikh'ed, bozkhost namekunand
Bigu: <<[On ruz] Parvardigoramon [kh'amai] moro gird meovarad, sipas miioni mo ba kh'ak' [va adolat] dovari mekunad va U dovari donost>>
Bigu: <<Kasonero, ki [dar k'udrat va tadbir] shariki U [Allokh' taolo] sokhtaed, nishonam dikh'ed. Kh'argiz [chunin nest, ki mepindored], balki U shikastnopaziri kh'akim ast
[Ei paiombar] Mo turo ch'uz bashoratbakhsh va bimdikh'andae baroi kh'amai mardum nafiristodaem; ammo beshtari mardum [in kh'ak'ik'atro] namedonand
Va [kofiron] meguiand: <<Agar rostgued, in va'da [k'iiomat] kai khokh'ad bud?>>
Bigu: <<Va'dagokh'aton ruzest, ki na soate az on ta'khir mekuned va na [bar on] peshi megired>>

Va kasone, ki kufr varzidand meguiand: <<Mo kh'argiz ba in K'ur'on va ba on [kitobkh'oe], ki pesh az on budaast, imon nameovarem>>. Kosh medidi on vak'tro, ki in sitamgoron dar peshgokh'i Parvardigorashon nigokh' doshta meshavand [va] sukhani iakdigarro rad mekunand [va kh'ar iak gunokh'ro ba gardani digare meandozad]. Onon, ki [dar dunio] ba notavoni kashida shuda budand ba kasone, ki gardankashi mekardand, meguiand: <<Agar shumo nabuded, mo kh'atman, imon meovardem>>

Onon, ki gardankashi mekardand, [dar posukh ba] kasone, ki ba notavoni kashida shuda budand, meguiand: <<Oio mo [budem, ki] shumoro az kh'idoiat-pas az on ki ba suiaton omad- bozdoshtem? [Kh'argiz] Balki shumo khud gunakh'gor [va akh'li fasod] buded>>

Onon, ki ba notavoni kashida shuda badand, ba kasone, ki gardankashi mekardand, meguiand: <<[Chunin nest] balki nairangi shabu ruz [-i shumo sabab shud, ki az kh'idoiat bozmonem] ongokh', ki ba mo dastur medoded, ba Allokh' taolo kofir shavem va baroiash [dar k'udrat va parastish] kh'amtoione k'aror dikh'em>>. Onon kh'angome ki azob [-i ilokh'i]-ro mebinand, pushaimonii khudro [dar dil] pinkh'on mekunand va Mo g'ulu zanch'irkh'oro dar gardani onone, ki kufr varzidaand, meandozem. Oio ch'uz [ba kaifari] on chi mekardand, much'ozot meshavand?
Va dar kh'ech' shakh're bimdikh'andae nafiristodem, magar in ki sarvatmandoni sarkashi onch'o guftand: <<Paiomero, ki ma'mur ba [iblog'i] on shudaed, kh'atman, inkor mekunem>>
Onon meguftand: <<Amvol va farzandoni mo [az shumo] beshtar ast va kh'argiz much'ozot nakhokh'em shud>>
[Ei paiombar] bigu: <<Be tardid, Parvardigoram [baroi ozmoishi mardum, ne'mat va] ruziro bar kh'ar ki bikhokh'ad, gusturda medorad va [io] tang megirad; vale beshtari mardum namedonand

Va amvolu farzandonaton [fazilate] nest, ki shumoro ba peshgokh'i Mo nazdik sozad, magar kase, ki imon ovarda va kore shoista anch'om dodaast; pas, onon dar barobari on chi kardaand, podoshi duchandon dorand va dar khonakh'oi balandi bikh'isht dar amnu osoishand
Va kasone, ki dar [dur kardani mardum az] oioti Mo mekushand, to [ba pindori khesh] Moro darmonda kunand, ononand, ki [ba azobi duzakh] faro khonda meshavand

[Ei Paiombar] Bigu: <<Be tardid, Parvardigoram [ne'mat va] ruziro bar kh'ar ki bikhokh'ad, gusturda medorad va [io] tang megirad; va kh'ar chizero [ki dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo] infok' kuned, U ba ch'oii on [mol- va bekh'tar az on -ba shumo] bozpas medikh'ad; va U bekh'tarin ruzidikh'anda ast>>
Va [iod kun az] ruze, ki Allokh' taolo kh'amai ononro barmeangezad, ongokh' ba farishtagon meguiad: <<Oio inkh'o shumoro meparastidand?>>
[Farishtagon] meguiand: <<Tu munazzakh'i; [dust va] korsozi mo Tu kh'asti, na onon; balki [in mushrikon] shaiotinro meparastidand va beshtarashon ba onkh'o imon doshtand>>
Pas, imruz kh'ech' iak az shumo sud va ziione baroi digare nadorad; va ba kasone, ki [bo shirk varzidan] ba khud sitam mekardand, meguem: <<Bichashed azobi otashero, ki durug'ash meangoshted

Va kh'angome ki oioti ravshani Mo bar onon [kofiron] khonda meshavad, meguiand: <<In ch'uz marde nest, ki mekhokh'ad shumoro az on chi padaronaton meparastidand, bozdorad>>; va [niz] meguiand: <<In [K'ur'on] ch'uz durug'e barbofta nest>>; va kasone, ki kufr varzidand, dar borai kh'ak' - vak'te ba suiashon omad - guftand: <<In [K'ur'on, chize] nest, magar ch'odue oshkor>>

Mo [pesh az in K'ur'on] kh'ech' kitobe ba onon [mushrikon] nadodaem, ki onro bikhonand [va bo istinod ba matolibash turo durug'gu bidonand] va pesh az tu kh'ech' bimdikh'andae ba suiashon nafiristodaem

Kasone, ki pesh az onon budand [niz paiombaroni ilokh'iro] durug'gu angoshtand va [in dar kh'ole ast, ki mushrikoni k'avmi tu, kh'atto] ba dakh'iaki on chi [az k'udratu sarvat] ba onon doda budem, narasidaand, vale [on kofiron] paiombaronamro durug'gu angoshtand; pas, [bingar, ki] kaifari Man chi guna bud

[Ei Paiombar, ba mushrikon] bigu: <<Man fak'at shumoro ba iak [sukhan] pand medikh'am, ki: du-du va iak-iak [gurukh'-gurukh' io infirodi] baroi Allokh' taolo barkhezed, sipas [dar akh'vol va zindagii paiombar] biiandeshed, [to bidoned, ki] in kh'amnishini shumo [Mukh'ammad] devona nest; u bimdikh'andaest, ki pesh az [faro rasidani] azobi sakht, baroi [kh'idoiati] shumo omadaast>>
Bigu: <<Kh'ar podoshe, ki [baroi risolatam] az shumo khostaam, baroi khudaton boshad. Podoshi man ch'uz bar [ukh'dai] Allokh' taolo nest va U bar kh'ar chize guvokh' ast>>
Bigu: <<Iak'inan Parvardigoram, ki donoi rozkh'oi nikh'on ast, [istidlolkh'oi] kh'ak'ro bar botil furu meafkanad [va onro nobud mesozad]>>
Bigu: <<Kh'ak' [Islom] faro rasid va botil nametavonad [ta'sir va k'udrati ch'adide] og'oz kunad va na [nufuzi guzashtaashro] bozgardonad

Bigu: <<Agar [man bo rasondani in paiom] gumrokh' shuda bosham, ch'uz in nest, ki ba ziioni khesh gumrokh' shudaam va agar kh'idoiat iofta bosham, ba sababi on [sukhane] ast, ki Parvardigoram bar man vakh'i mekunad. Be tardid, U shunavo [va] nazdik ast>>
Kosh kh'angomero medidi, ki [kofiron az mushokh'idai azob] vakh'shatzada meshavand va [kh'ech' rokh'i] gureze nest va ononro az ch'oii nazdike [ki intizorashro nadorand] dastgir mekunand
Onon [dar in kh'ol] meguiand: <<Ba in [k'iiomat] imon ovardem>>; va [aknun, ki murdaand] chi guna az ch'oii [chunin] dur dastrasi [ba imon] baroiashon mumkin ast?
Kh'ol on ki onon dar dunio in [k'iiomat]-ro inkor mekardand va az dur [va biduni donish va ogokh'i, ba Paiombar] nisbatkh'oi noravo medonand

Va [saranch'om] miioni onon va on chi [az lazzatkh'oi duniavi] ki khush dorand, ch'udoi aftod; chunonki pesh az in niz bo amsoli [va kh'amfikroni] eshon niz chunin raftore shud [charo ki] iak'inan onon [niz nisbat ba k'iiomat] sakht dar tardid budand

Sipos [va sitoish] az oni Allokh'i ofarinandai osmonkh'o va zamin ast; [Parvardigore, ki] farishtagonro bo bolkh'oi dugona va segona va chakh'orgona, firistodagon [-i khesh ba suii mardum] k'aror dod [va] kh'ar chi bikhokh'ad dar ofarinish meafzoiad. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo bar kh'ar chize tavonost

Kh'ar [bakhshoish va] rakh'mate, ki Allokh' taolo baroi mardumon bikushoiad, kh'ech' bozdorandae baroiash nest va kh'ar chiro bozgirad, firistandae pas az U vuch'ud nadorad; va U shikastnopaziru kh'akim ast

Ei mardum, ne'mati Allokh'ro bar khud ba iod ovared. Oio ofarinandae ch'uz Allokh' taolo kh'ast, ki shumoro az osmon va zamin ruzi dikh'ad? Kh'ech' ma'bude ch'uz U nest. Pas, chi guna [az kh'ak'] munkh'arif meshaved?
[Ei paiombar] Agar mushrikon turo durug'gu meangorand [g'amgin mabosh; zero] paiombaroni pesh az turo niz durug'gu angoshtand va [saranch'om kh'amai] korkh'o ba Allokh' taolo boz gardonida meshavad

Ei mardum, iak'inan, va'dai Allokh' taolo [dar mavridi k'iiomat] kh'ak' ast; pas, [kh'ushior boshed, ki lazzatkh'oi] zindagii dunio shumoro nafirebad va shaiton shumoro nisbat ba [ta'khir dar azob va shikeboi] Allokh' taolo nafirebad
Be tardid, shaiton dushmani shumost; pas, shumo niz uro dushman [-i khud] gired. Ch'uz in nest, ki u pairavonashro [ba kufr] mekhonad, to az akh'li otash boshand
Kasone, ki kufr varzidaand, azobe sakht [dar pesh] dorand va kasone, ki imon ovardaand va korkh'oi shoista anch'om dodaand omurzish va podoshe buzurg [dar itizor] dorand

Pas, oio kase, ki kirdori zishtash dar nazarash orosta gashtaast va onro neku mebinad [kh'amchun mu'mini kh'ak'ik'atbin ast?] pas, be tardid, Allokh' taolo kh'ar kiro khokh'ad gumrokh' mesozad va kh'ar kiro bikhokh'ad kh'idoiat mekunad; pas, [ei paiombar] vuch'udatro ba khotiri dareg'kh'o [-i farovon] bar [gumrokh'ii] onon tabokh' nakun. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo bar on chi mekunand, ogokh' ast

Allokh' taolo ast, ki bodkh'oro ravon mekunad va [onkh'o niz] abrero barmeangezand; sipas Mo on [abr]-ro ba suii sarzamine [khushk va] murda mefiristem va ba [vasilai] on zaminro - pas az khushki va khazonash-zinda mekunem. Barangekhtan [-i murdagon az k'abrkh'o niz] chunin ast

Kh'ar ki sarbalandi [-i dunio va okhiratro] mekhokh'ad, [bidonad, ki] sarbalandi kh'ama az oni Allokh' taolo ast. Guftori pok [va zikri ilokh'i] ba suiash avch' megirad va kirdori shoistai on [guftor]-ro bolo mebarad; va onon, ki zishtikh'o [va gunokh'on]-ro dasisachini mekunand, azobi sakhte [dar pesh] dorand va [nak'sha va] nairangashon nobud megardad

Va Allokh' taolo [nakhustin] shumoro az khoke ofarid va on gokh' [farzandonash] az nutfae [padid ovard]; sipas shumoro ch'uftkh'o [-i iakdigar] k'aror dod. Kh'ech' [ch'ondori] modae bordor nameshavad va zoimon namekunad, magar bo donish [va ogokh'ii] U; va kh'ech' [ch'ondori] kukh'ansole umri tuloni namekunad va az umrash kosta namegrdad, magar on ki dar kitobe [Lavkh'i makh'fuz] sabt ast. Ba rosti, ki in kor baroi Allokh' taolo oson ast

Va on du dario iakson nestand: in iake shirin va khushguvor ast va nushidanash guvorost va on iake shuru talkh ast; va az [saidi] kh'ar iak gushte toza mekhured va zevare [kh'amchun marvorid va march'on az a'mok'ash] berun meovared, ki onkh'oro bar tan mekuned; va kishtikh'oro dar on dario mebini, ki [sinai amvoch'ro] meshikofand, to az bakhshoishi on bakh'ramand garded; boshad, ki sipos guzored

[Allokh' taolo] shabro dar ruz darmeovarad va ruzro dar shab darmeovarad [va inchunin bar tuli kh'ar iake meafzoiad] va khurshed va mokh'ro ba khidmat [-i inson] gumosht, ki kh'ar iak to zamone muaiian [ dar madori khud] ravon boshand. In ast Allokh' taolo-Parvardgori shumo; farmonravoi az oni Ust va kasonero, ki ba ch'oii U mekhoned, [dar barobarash chunon fak'irand, ki kh'atto] pusti kh'astai khurmoero doro nestand

Agar ononro bikhoned, sadoiatonro nameshunavand va [ba farzi makh'ol] agar bishnavand, posukhatonro namedikh'and va ruzi k'iiomat az shirki shumo bezori mech'uiand; va [ei paiombar] kh'ech' kas kh'amchun [Parvardgori] ogokh' turo [az kh'ak'oik'] khabardor namesozad
Ei mardum, [kh'amai] shumo ba Allokh' taolo niiozmanded va [tankh'o] Allokh' taolo ast, ki beniiozi sutuda ast
U agar bikhokh'ad, shumoro [az miion] mebarad va ofarinishe ch'adid [ba ch'oii shumo padid] meovarad
Va [anch'omi] in kor baroi Allokh' taolo dushvor nest

Va kh'ech' gunakh'gore, bori gunokh'i digarero ba dush namegirad va agar [shakhsi] garonbore, [digarero] baroi kh'amli bori [gunokh'oni] khesh faro bikhonad, [chize az on bor] bardoshta nameshavad; kh'archand, ki u kheshovand [-i nazdikash] boshad. [Ei paiombar] Ch'uz in nest, ki tu fak'at ba kasone kh'ushdor medikh'i, ki dar nikh'on az [much'ozoti] Parvardgorashon metarsand va namoz barpo medorand. Kh'ar ki [az gunokh'on] pok shavad, pas? iak'inan tankh'o ba sudi khesh pok gashtaast va bozgasht [-i kh'ama] ba suii Allokh' taolo ast
Va [kofir va mu'min barobar nestand; chunonki] nobino va bino iakson nestand
Va na torikikh'o va nur
Va na soia va bodi suzon

Va zindagon va murdagon iakson nestand. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo [nidoi kh'ak'ro] ba gushi kh'ar ki bikhokh'ad merasonad va tu [ei paiombar] nametavoni kasonero, ki dar gurkh'o kh'astand, shunavo sozi
Tu ch'uz bimdikh'andae [besh] nesti
Ba rosti, Mo turo ba kh'ak' bashoratdikh'anda va bimdikh'anda firistodem va [dar naslkh'oi guzashta niz] kh'ech' ummate nabud, magar on ki miionashon bimdikh'andae guzashta ast

Va agar [mushrikon] turo durug'gu meangorand, [ach'ib nest; charo ki] be tardid, kasone, ki pesh az onon budand, [niz] paiombaronashonro, ki bo daloili ravshan va kitobkh'oi osmoni va kitobi ravshangar ba surog'ashon omadand, durug'gu angoshtand
On gokh' [Man niz] kasonero, ki kufr varzida budand, nobud kardam; pas, [bingar, ki] kaifari Man chi guna bud

Oio nadidai, ki Allokh' taolo az osmon obe nozil kard va ba [vasilai] on [az darakhtoni mukhtalif] mevakh'oe padid ovardem, ki rangkh'oiash gunogun ast va az kukh'kh'o [niz ragakh'o va] rokh'kh'oe safed va k'irmiz va komilan siiokh' [ofaridem], ki rangkh'oiash gunogun ast?

Va kh'amchunin az insonkh'o va ch'unbandagon va chakh'orpoion [niz makhluk'ote ofaridem, ki] rangkh'oiash gunogun ast. Ba rosti, az [miioni] bandagoni Allokh' taolo, tankh'o donoion [kh'astand, ki ba sifot va akh'komi ilokh'i ogokh'i dorand va] az U metarsand. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo shikastnopaziri omurzanda ast

Dar kh'ak'ik'at, kasone, ki kitobi Allokh'ro mekhonand va namoz barpo medorand va az on chi ba eshon ruzi dodaem, pinkh'onu oshkor infok' mekunand, ba tich'orate [pursud] umed dorand, ki kh'argiz ziion [va kasodi] nadorad
To [Allokh' taolo] podoshashonro ba tamomi bidikh'ad va az fazli khesh bar [kh'ak'k'i] onon biafzoiad. Be tardid, U omurzandai siposguzor ast
[Ei paiombar] on chi az in kitob ba tu vakh'i kardem kh'ak' ast va on [kitobkh'oi osmoni]-ro, ki peshtar budaast, tasdik' mekunad. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo ba [kh'oli] bandagonash ogokh' va binost

Ongokh' in kitob [K'ur'on]-ro ba gurukh'e az bandagonamon, ki barguzidem [ummati Mukh'ammad] ba meros dodem; pas, [barkhe] az onon dar kh'ak'k'i khesh sitamgorand va [barkhe digar] az onon miionarav kh'astand va [barkhe] az onon ba farmoni Allokh' taolo dar nekikh'o peshtozand. In [musulmoni va bakh'ramandi az K'ur'on, fazilat va] bakhshoishi buzurg ast
[Podoshashon] bog'kh'oi ch'ovidon [-i bikh'ishti] ast, ki ba on vorid meshavand. Dar on ch'o ba dastbandkh'oe az tillo va marvorid orosta megardand va libosashon az kh'arir ast
[Onon pas az vurud] meguiand: <<Sipos [va sitoish] az oni Allokh' taolo ast, ki andukh'ro az mo dur kard. Ba rosti, ki Parvardigoramon omurzandai siposguzor ast
On [ma'bude], ki az fazli khesh moro dar in saroi ch'ovid ch'oi dod; dar on ch'o ranch'e ba mo namerasad va duchori khastagi [va kasolat] nameshavem

Va baroi kasone, ki kufr varzidaand otashi duzakh [dar pesh] ast. Na farmon [-i marg] bar onon ch'ori meshavad, to bimirand va na [chize] az azobash bar onon kosta megardad. Mo kh'ar nosiposero chunin ch'azo medikh'em

[Duzakhiion] Dar on [otash] fariod mezanand: <<Parvardigoro, moro [az in azob] berun ovar, to g'air az on chi [peshtar] mekardem, kori shoistae anch'om dikh'em>>. [Ba onon gufta meshavad] <<Oio ba shumo [on k'adar fursat va] umr nadodem, to kh'ar ki pandpazir ast, dar on [muddat] pand girad? Va [paiombar niz ba unvoni] bimdikh'anda nazdaton omad; pas, [kh'olo ki itoat nakarded, ta'mi azobro] bichashed, ki sitamgoron kh'ech' iorigare nadorand
Be tardid, Allokh' taolo donoi nikh'oni osmonkh'o va zamin ast [va] Ust, ki ba rozi dilkh'o donost

Ust, ki shumoro dar zamin ch'onishin [-i peshiniion] k'aror dod; pas, kh'ar ki kufr bivarzad, kufrash ba ziioni khudi ust; va kofironro kufrashon nazdi Parvardgorashon ch'uz khashm [va bezori] nameafzoiad; va kofironro kufrashon ch'uz ziion [va gunokh', chize] nameafzoiad

[Ei paiombar, ba mushrikon] bigu: <<On ma'budone, ki ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo mekhoned, nishonam dikh'ed, chi chize az zaminro ofaridaand? Io [kh'amrokh'i Allokh' taolo] dar ofarinishi osmonkh'o shirkat doshtaand? Io ba onon [mushrikon] kitobe dodaem va az [matolibi] on nishonai ravshane [bar kh'ak'k'oniiati khud] dorand?>> [Chunin nest] Balki sitamgoron [-i mushrik] ch'uz fireb, ba iakdigar va'dae namedikh'and

Ba rosti, Allokh' taolo, ki osmonkh'o va zaminro nigakh' medorad, to [az masiru madori khud] munkh'arif nashavand va agar inkh'irof ioband, pas, az U kase onkh'oro nigakh' namedorad. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo kh'amvora burdbori omurzanda ast

[Kofiron] Bo sakhttarin savgandkh'oiashon ba Allokh' taolo savgand iod kardand, ki agar [paiombari] bimdikh'andae bar eshon biioiad, az kh'ar ummate rokh'ioftatarand; ammo chun [Mukh'ammad ba unvoni] bimdikh'andae nazdashon omad, ch'uz duri [va nafrat az kh'ak' chize] bar onon naafzud

[Savgandkh'oiashon sodik'ona nabud; balki] Az ruii gardankashi dar zamin va nairangi zisht [bud] va nairangi zisht, ch'uz domangiri sokh'ibash namegardad. Pas, oio [kofiron chize] ch'uz sunnati [ilokh'i va kaifari] peshiniionro intizor dorand? Pas, kh'argiz dar sunnati Allokh' taolo tabdile nameiobi va kh'argiz dar sunnati Allokh' taolo tag'iire nameiobi

Oio [kofiron] dar zamin gardish nakardaand, to bubinand saranch'omi kasone, ki pesh az onon va nerumandtar az onon budand, chi guna shud? Kh'ech' chize dar osmonkh'o va zamin nest, ki Allokh'ro notavon sozad [va az kh'avzai k'udratash berun ravad]. Be tardid, U kh'amvora donovu tavonost
