Va agar Allokh' taolo mardumro ba sababi on chi kardaand, much'ozot mekard, kh'ech' ch'unbandaero bar pushti zamin bok'i nameguzosht, ammo [mukh'lat medikh'ad va kaifari] ononro to saromadi muaiiane ba ta'khir meandozad; pas, kh'angome ki ach'alashon [dar k'iiomat] faro rasad, iak'inan, Allokh' taolo ba kh'oli bandagonash binost.
Io, sin
Savgand ba K'ur'oni kh'akim
Be tardid, tu az paiombaron [-i Mo] kh'asti
[Va] Bar rokh'i rost [Islom k'aror dori]
[In K'ur'on] Furufiristodai [Parvardigori] shikastnopaziri mekh'rubon ast
To mardumero [dar borai azobi k'iiomat] bim dikh'i, ki padaronashon kh'ushdor naioftaand va [bad-in sabab] onkh'o niz g'ofiland
Iak'inan, farmon [-i azobi ilokh'i] bar beshtarashon takh'ak'k'uk' ioftaast; pas, [lach'och'at mekunand va] imon nameovarand

[Misoli gumrokh'ii kofiron, chunon ast, ki gui] Mo bar gardankh'oiashon zanch'irkh'oe nikh'odaem, ki to zeri manakh'oiashon [pechidashuda] ast, chunonki sarkh'oiashon bolo mondaast [va az anch'omi kh'ar khaire och'izand va rokh'i kh'idoiatro nameioband]
Va az peshi ruiashon devore va az pushti sarashon niz devore nikh'odaem va chashmonashonro bo pardae pushonidaem; az in rust, ki [kh'ak'ik'atro] namebinand
[Ei paiombar] baroiashon iakson ast, ki ononro bim dikh'i io nadikh'i; [dar kh'ar kh'ol] imon nameovarand

Ch'uz in nest, ki tu ba kase bim medikh'i [va in kor baroi kase sud dorad], ki pairavi K'ur'on boshad va dar nikh'on az [Parvardigori] Rakh'mon bitarsad; pas, Uro [ki chunin ast] ba omurzish va podoshi arch'mand bashorat bidekh'

Iak'inan, Moem, ki murdagonro zinda mekunem va on chiro, ki az pesh firistodaand va osori [bok'imonda az] eshonro menavisem; va kh'ama chizro dar Kitobi ravshan [Lavkh'-ul-makh'fuz] ba shumor ovardaem
[Ei paiombar] baroiashon [moch'aroi] mardumi on shakh'rro misol bizan, on gokh' ki paiombaron nazdashon raftand

Va vak'te du nafar az paiombaronro ba suiashon firistodem; ammo [mardum] ononro durug'gu angoshtand; pas, bo firistodani paiombari savum on duro [ta'iid va] tak'viiat kardem. Onon [ba akh'olii shakh'r] meguftand: <<Mo firistodagon [-i ilokh'i] ba sui shumo kh'astem>>
[Onon dar posukh] guftand: <<Shumo ch'uz bashare kh'ammonandi mo nested va [Parvardigori] Rakh'mon chize [az vakh'i] nozil nakardaast. Shumo ch'uz durug' namegued>>
[Paiombaron] guftand: <<Parvardigoramon medonad, ki k'at'an, ba suii shumo firistoda shudaem
Va mo vazifae ch'uz rasonidani oshkor [-i vakh'i] nadorem>>
[Mardum] Guftand: <<Mo shumoro ba foli bad giriftaem. Agar [az tablig'] dast barnadored, kh'atman, sangsoraton mekunem va be tardid, azobi dardnoke az [ch'onibi] mo ba shumo khokh'ad rasid>>

[Paiombaron] Guftand: <<Shumii shumo bo khudaton [va noshi az kufru gunokh'] ast. Oio agar pandaton dikh'and, [onro shum mepindored?] balki [kh'ak'ik'at in ast, ki shumo dar irtikobi gunokh'] mardumi isrofkored>>
Va marde az durtarin nuk'tai shakh'r shitobon omad [va] guft: <<Ei k'avmi man, az in paiombaron pairavi kuned>>
Pairavi kasone boshed, ki az shumo podoshe namekhokh'and va khud kh'idoiat ioftaand
Va charo ma'budero naparastam, ki maro ofaridaast va [shumo niz] ba suiash bozgardonda meshaved?
Oio ba ch'oi U ma'budone barguzinam, ki agar [Parvardigori] Rakh'mon bikhokh'ad, gazande ba man birasonad, na shafoatashon baroiam sude dorad va na metavonand [az azobi ilokh'i] nach'otam dikh'and?
Dar on surat, iak'inan, dar gumrokh'ii oshkore khokh'am bud
Man ba Parvardigoraton imon ovardaam [va az marg kh'arose nadoram] pas, sukhanonamro bishunaved
[Pas, chun on mard ba dasti k'avmash ba shakh'odat rasid] Ba vai gufta shud: <<Voridi bikh'isht shav>>. U guft: <<Ei kosh, k'avmi man medonistand,
ki Parvardigoram maro omurzida va giromi doshtaast>>
Pas az [shakh'odati] u bar k'avmash kh'ech' sipokh'e az osmon nafiristodem va [pesh az in niz] furu firistanda nabudem
[Kaifarashon] Ch'uz iak bongi margbor nabud; pas, ba nogokh' kh'amagi [murda va] khomush gashtand
Ei afsus, bar in bandagon! Kh'ech' paiombare ba suiashon naiomad, magar on ki maskharaash mekardand
Oio nadidand [va namedonand] ki k'abl az onon chi bisior naslkh'oro kh'alok kardaem, ki digar nazdi inkh'o [ba dunio] boznamegardand?
Va [ruzi k'iiomat] kh'ech' kas nest, magar on ki kh'amagi nazdi Mo ekh'zor meshavand
Baroi onon [ki k'iiomatro bovar nadorand] zamini khushk nishonae [ibratomuz] ast: Mo on [zamin]-ro zinda kardem va az [khoki] on donakh'oe ruionidem, ki [makhluk'oti ilokh'i] az on mekhurand
Va dar on [zamin] bog'kh'oe az nakhl va angur padid ovardem va dar on chashmakh'o ravon sokhtem
To mardum az mevaash bikhurand, dar kh'ole ki in [makh'sulot, kh'osili taloshi onkh'o nest va onkh'o]-ro bo dastoni khud amal naovardaand. Pas, oio sipos nameguzorand?
Pok va munazzakh' ast, on [Parvardigore] ki kh'amai naru modakh'oro ofarida ast; az on chi zamin meruionad [giiokh'onu darakhton] va az khudashon [insonkh'o] va az on chi namedonand
Va shab baroi onon nishonae [digar az k'udrati ilokh'i] ast, [ki] ruzro az on barkanor mekunem va nogakh'on [kh'ama] dar toriki furu meravand
Va khurshed [niz paivasta] ba suii k'arorgokh'ash dar kh'arakat ast. In tak'diri [Parvardigori] shikastnopaziru donost
Va baroi mokh' [niz] manzilgokh'kh'oe muk'arrar namudaem, to [saranch'om az k'ursi komil ba kh'ilol va] ba shakli shokhai khushki khurmo bozgardad
Na khurshedro sazovor ast, ki [dar sairi khud] ba mokh' birasad v na shab bar ruz peshi megirad; va kh'ar iak az [sitoravu saiiora] dar madore shinovarand
Nishonae [digar az k'udrati Parvardigor] baroi onon in ast, ki padaronashonro dar kishti anboshta [az sarnishin va bor] kh'aml kardem
Kh'amchunin, baroiashon chize kh'ammonandi on [kishti] ofaridaem, ki savorash shavand
Agar bikhokh'em, g'ark'ashon mekunem; dar in surat, na fariodrase dorand va na [az tak'diri ilokh'i] rakh'oi meioband
Magar in ki rakh'mate az ch'onibi Mo [binand] va bakh'ramandi [az ne'matkh'oi dunio] to zamone [muaiian shomili kh'olashon shavad]

Va chun ba onon [mushrikon] gufta meshavad: <<Az on chi peshorui shumost [azobi okhirat] va on chi pushti sar meguzored [sakhtikh'oi dunio] parvo kuned; boshad, ki mavridi rakh'mat k'aror gired>>, [itoat namekunand]
Kh'ech' nishonae az nishonakh'oi [k'udrat va buzurgii] Parvardigorashon bar onon arza namegardad, magar on ki az on rui megardonand

Va chun ba onon gufta meshavad: <<Az on chi Allokh' taolo ruziiaton kardaast, infok' kuned>>, kasone, ki kufr varzidaand, ba onon, ki imon ovardaand meguiand: <<Oio ba kase g'izo bidikh'em, ki agar Allokh' taolo mekhost, [Khud] ba u g'izo medod? Shumo ch'uz dar gumrokh'ii oshkor nested>>
Va [bo tamaskhur ba mu'minon] meguiand: <<Agar rostgued, in va'da [k'iiomat] kai khokh'ad bud>>?
[In munkironi k'iiomat] ch'uz dar intizori iak bongi margbor nestand, ki nogakh'on, dar kh'ole ki sargarmi ch'idol [dar umuri dunio] kh'astand, ononro faro girad
Pas, [dar on kh'angom] nametavonand [ba kase] vasiiat kunand va na ba sui khonavodai khud bozgardand
Va [kh'angome ki baroi duvumin bor] dar sur damida shavad va nogakh'on az k'abrkh'oiashon [berun meoiand va] ba sui Parvardigorashon meshitoband

[Va bo nobovari] Meguiand: <<Voi bar mo! Chi kase moro az k'abrkh'oiamon barangekht?>> [Ba onon gufta meshavad] <<In kh'amon [ruze] ast, ki [Parvardigori] Rakh'mon va'da doda bud; va paiombaron [dar in bora] rost meguftand
[Barangekhtani murdagon az gur] Ch'uz iak bongi kh'avlnok [duvumin damidani sur] nest va nogakh'on kh'amaro nazdi Mo kh'ozir mekunand
Pas, [bidoned, ki] imruz, ba kh'ech' kas sitame nameshavad va ch'uz dar barobari on chi [dar dunio] kardaed, ch'azo namebined
Be tardid, akh'li bikh'isht imruz bo shodmoni sargarm [-i ne'matkh'oi ilokh'i] kh'astand
Onon va kh'amsaronashon dar soiakh'o [-i gusturdai bikh'ishti] bar takhtkh'o takia zadaand
Dar on ch'o [kh'ar guna] meva va kh'ar chi bikhokh'and, baroiashon [farokh'am] kh'ast
[Bartar az in ne'matkh'o] salomest, ki sukhani Parvardigori mekh'rubon ast
[On gokh' ba mushrikon khitob meshavad] <<Ei gunakh'koron, imruz [az mu'minon] ch'udo shaved
Ei farzandoni Odam, oio bo shumo paimon nabastam [va farmon nadodam], ki shaitonro naparasted, [ki] k'at'an u dushmani oshkori shumost?
Va in ki [tankh'o] Maro biparasted, [ki] rokh'i rost kh'amin ast?
Va be tardid, shaiton bisiore az shumoro gumrokh' sokht. Oio andesha namekarded?
In [kh'amon] duzakhest, ki ba shumo va'da doda meshud
Imruz ba sazoi on ki kufr mevarzided, ba on [otash] vorid shaved>>
Imruz bar dakh'onkh'oiashon mukh'r menikh'em va dastkh'oiashon bo Mo sukhan meguiand va poikh'oiashon ba on chi mekardand, guvokh'i medikh'and
Va agar bikhokh'em, be tardid, chashmonashonro makh'v mekunem, pas, [bo chashmi basta] ba suii [puli] sirot [az iakdigar] peshi megirand [to ba bikh'isht rokh' ioband]; ammo magar kuch'oro mebinand?
Va agar bikhokh'em [zokh'irashonro tag'iir medikh'em va chunon] ononro dar ch'oi khud maskh [va zamingir] mekunem, ki natavonand gome ba pesh biguzorand io ba ak'ib bozgardand

Va Mo ba kh'ar ki umri tuloni bidikh'em, dar ofarinish digargunash mekunem [va uro ba notavonii zekh'ni va badani davroni kudaki barmegardonem]. Pas, oio [dar borai k'udrati Parvardigor] nameandeshand?
Va Mo ba u [Mukh'ammad] she'r naomukhtaem va [shoiri] shoistai u nest. In [ki omukhtaem, chize] nest, magar andarz va K'ur'one ravshan
To kh'ar kiro zinda [-dil] boshad, bim dikh'ad va azob bar kofiron mukh'ak'k'ak' gardad
Oio nadidaand, ki Mo az on chi dastkh'oiamon sokhtaast, chakh'orpoione baroiashon ofaridaem, ki moliki onkh'o kh'astand?
Va onkh'oro dar khidmati eshon guzoshtaem, to bar barkhe savor shavand va az [gushti] barkhe tag'ziia kunand
Va az on [kh'aivonot] bakh'rakh'oi digar va nushidanikh'oe [shir] dorand. Pas, oio sipos nameguzorand?
[Bo in kh'ama ne'mat mushrikon] ba ch'oi Allokh' taolo ma'budone barguzidaand; ba in umed, ki [az suii onkh'o] iori shavand
On [ma'budkh'oi bech'on] k'odir ba ioriashon nestand; va in [mushrikon dar k'iiomat] lashkare baroi onkh'o [butkh'o] khokh'and bud, ki [kh'amagi dar otashi duzakh] ekh'zor meshavand
[Ei Paiombar] sukhani onon turo g'amgin nasozad. Be tardid, Mo on chiro pinkh'on mekunand va oshkor mesozand, [ba khubi] medonem
Oio inson nadidaast, ki Mo uro az nutfae ofaridaem [on gokh' marokh'ili rushdro tai kard va] sipas dushmane oshkor shud?
Va baroi Mo misole zad va ofarinishi kheshro faromush kard [va] guft: <<Chi kase in ustukhonkh'oro [dubora] zinda mekunad, dar kh'ole ki pusidaast?>>
Bigu: <<kh'amon kase zindaash mekunad, ki nakhustin bor onro padid ovard va U ba kh'ar ofarinishe donost
Kh'amon ki az darakhti sabz otashe baroiaton padid ovard va shumo [dar surati niioz] khud az on [darakht] otash meafruzed>>
Oio kase, ki osmonkh'o va zaminro ofaridaast, nametavonad kh'ammonandi inkh'oro [pas az margashon dubora] biofarinad? Ore [metavonad] va U Ofarinandai donost
Farmoni U chun chizero iroda kunad, tankh'o in ast, ki ba on meguiad: <<Mavch'ud shav>>; pas, [bedirang] mavch'ud meshavad
Pas, pok va munazzakh' ast Parvardigore, ki [kh'okimiiat va] ikhtiiori kh'ama chiz ba dasti Ust va [kh'amagi] ba sui U bozgardonida meshaved
Savgand ba farishtagoni saf ba saf [ki baroi parastishi Parvardigor istodaand]
Va savgand ba farishtagone, ki abrkh'oro meronand
Va savgand ba farishtagone, ki K'ur'on tilovat mekunand
[ki] Be tardid, ma'budi shumo iaktost
[Kh'amon] Parvardigori osmonkh'ovu zamin va on chi miioni onkh'ost va Parvardigori [khurshed dar g'urubgokh'kh'o va] tulu'gokh'kh'o
Ba rosti, ki Mo osmoni dunioro bo zevari sitoragon orostem
Va onro az [dastrasii] kh'ar shaitoni sarkash kh'ifz kardem
[On shaiotin kh'argiz] nametavonand [sukhanoni farishtagoni] olami boloro bishunavand va az kh'ar su [bo shakh'obkh'oi otashin] tirboron meshavand
[Az vurudi onon ba olami farishtagon ch'ilavgiri meshavad va kh'amvora ba] ak'ib ronda meshavand va azobi ch'ovidon [dar pesh] dorand
Magar kase, ki nogakh'on chize [az guftugui farishtagon]-ro duzdida gush dikh'ad, ki [dar in surat] shakh'obi durakhshon uro dunbol mekunad

Az onon [kofiron] bipurs, ki oio ofarinishi [paikarkh'oi] onon sakhttar ast io on chi ki Mo [az zaminu osmonkh'o va ch'akh'oni bekaron] ofaridaem; [dar kh'ole ki] Mo onkh'oro az gili [bearzish va] chaspida padid ovardem
Tu [az inkori onon] dar shigifti va onkh'o [niz sukhanonatro dar borai k'iiomat] maskhara mekunand
Va chun pand doda shavand, namepazirand
Va chun nishonakh'oi [dar mavridi rostguii Paiombar] mebinand, [onro] ba tamaskhur megirand
Va meguiand: <<In [K'ur'on chize] nest, magar ch'odue oshkor
Oio kh'angome ki murdem va khok va ustukhon shudem, barangekhta khokh'em shud?
Oio padaroni mo [niz barangekhta meshavand]?>>
Bigu: <<Ore, shumo, dar kh'ole ki khor kh'asted [zinda meshaved]>>
Pas, [vuk'ui k'iiomat] tankh'o bo iak bong [-i sakh'mnok] ast va nogakh'on [kh'ama az k'abrkh'o berun meoiand va dar intizori dasturi Parvardigor, vakh'shati k'iiomatro] nazorat mekunand
Va meguiand: <<Voi bar mo! In [kh'amon] ruzi ch'azost>>
[Gufta meshavad: Ore] in kh'amon ruzi dovariest, ki durug'ash meangoshted>>
[Ba farishtagon gufta meshavad] <<Kasonero, ki [bo shirk ba khesh] sitam kardand,io bo [kh'amfikron va] kh'ammonandkh'oiashon
va on chi ba ch'oi Allokh' taolo meparastidand, gird ovared va ba rokh'i duzakh kh'idoiatashon kuned
Va ononro nigakh' dored, ki, kh'atman, [pesh az raftan ba duzakh] bozkhost khokh'and shud
[Az duzakhiion mepursand] <<Charo [monandi dunio] az iakdigar kh'imoiat namekuned?>>
Balki imruz [kh'amagi] taslim [-i amri Parvardigor] kh'astand
Va sarzanishkunon ba iakdigar ru meorand
[Va ba rokh'baron va buzurgoni khud] meguiand: <<Shumo [baroi ba kufr kashonondani mo bo iddaoi dini rostin va] az ch'onibi kh'ak' ba surog'amon meomaded>>
[Rokh'baronashon] Meguiand: <<Mo muk'assir nestem], balki shumo khud imon nadoshted
Va mo kh'ech' tasallute bar shumo nadoshtem; balki shumo khud gurukh'i sarkash buded
Pas, [aknun] farmoni much'ozoti Parvardigoramon bar mo mukh'ak'k'ak' shuda va ba rosti, mo [kh'amagi azobi duzakhro] chashandaem
Pas, shumoro gumrokh' namudem [charo ki] dar kh'ak'ik'at, khud niz gumrokh' budem>>
Pas, iak'inan on ruz kh'amai [onon] dar azob sharikand
Be tardid, Mo bo gunakh'koron inchunin [raftor] mekunem
Onon budand, ki chun ba eshon gufta meshud: <<Ma'bude [barkh'ak'] ch'uz Allokh' taolo nest>> sarkashi [va takabbur] mekardand
va meguftand: <<Oio mo ma'budonamonro ba khotiri [sukhani] shoire devona rakh'o kunem?>>
[Chunin nest] balki u kh'ak' [tavkh'id]- ro ovarda va paiombaroni [peshin] - ro tasdik' kardaast
Shumo [kofiron], kh'atman, azobi dardnoki [duzakh]-ro mechashed
Va ch'uz [dar barobari] on chi mekarded, much'ozot nameshaved
Kh'ama azob mebinand, magar bandagoni mukhlisi Allokh' taolo
Onon [dar peshgokh'i Parvardigor rizk'u] ruzii mushakhkhase dorand
[Anvoi] mevakh'o [-ro dar ikhtiior khokh'and dosht] va giromi doshta meshavand
Dar bog'kh'oi purne'mati [bikh'isht]
Dar kh'ole ki muk'obili iakdigar bar takhtkh'o [takia zadaand]
ch'ome az sharobi nob [va zulol] peromunashon megardonand
[Sharobe ravshan va] safed, ki baroi nushandagonashon lazzatbakhsh ast
[Sharobe, ki khumori va] sardardi dar nushidanash nest va az on mast namegardand
Va nazdashon zanoni durushtchashm ast, ki [ tankh'o ba shavkh'aroni khud] nazar dorand
[Zanon chunon safedandomand, ki] guio tukhm [-i parandagon] kh'astand [va zeri par va boli onkh'o az dastrasii kh'amagon] pinkh'on mondaand
[Bikh'ishtiion dar borai ruidodkh'oi dunio sukh'bat mekunand va] barkhe az onon pursishkunon ru ba barkhe digar mekunand
Iake az onon meguiad: <<Man [dar dunio] kh'amnishine doshtam
[U paivasta] Meguft: Oio tu vok'ean [ba k'iiomat] bovar dori?
Oio kh'angome ki murdem va khok va ustukhon shudem, oio kh'ak'ik'atan [zinda meshavem va ba khotiri korkh'oiamon] ba mo kaifar medikh'and?>>
[Sipas, ba dustoni bikh'ishtiash] meguiad: <<Oio [shumo niz kh'amrokh'i man] sar mekashed [to bidonem u kuch'ost]?>>
On gokh' khudi u sar mekashad va uro dar miioni duzakh mebinad
Ba u meguiad: <<Ba Allokh' taolo savgand, ki nazdik bud maro [bo vasvasakh'oi kufromezat] nobud sozi
Agar ne'mati [kh'idoiati] Parvardigoram nabud, man niz az kh'ozirshudagon [dar duzakh] budam>>
[On gokh' ba bikh'ishtiion meguiad] <<Oio mo digar marge nakhokh'em dosht
ch'uz margi nakhustin, va azob nameshavem?
Ba rosti, ki in kh'amon komiobii buzurg ast
Akh'li amal boiad baroi chunin [podosh] bikushand
Oio in [ne'mati bikh'isht, karimonatar va] baroi paziroi bekh'tar ast io darakhti zak'um [dar duzakh]?
Be tardid, Mo on darakhtro moiai ozmoishi sitamgoroni [mushrik] dodaem [charo ki meguiand: <<Kh'ech' darakhte dar otash nameruiad>>]
Dar kh'ak'ik'at, on [moiai azob] darakhte ast, ki az zharfoi duzakh meruiad
Mevakh'oiash [chunon badmanzar ast, ki] guio sarkh'oi shaiotin ast
Onon [duzakhiion] az [mevakh'oi talkhi] on mekhurand va shikamkh'oro az onkh'o anboshta mekunand
On gokh' rui in [g'izoi nopok, ba ch'oii nushidani] omezakh'oi az obi ch'ushon dorand
Sipas, iak'inan, bozgashtashon ba duzakh ast
Onon padaroni khudro gumrokh' ioftand
Va [kh'amchunon] dar paii onon meshitoftand
Va, kh'atman, k'abl az onon niz beshtari peshiniion gumrokh' shudand
Va be tardid, Mo miionashon kh'ushdordikh'andagon [-i bisior] firistodem
Pas, bingar, ki saranch'omi kh'ushdorioftagon chi guna bud
[Kh'ama giriftori azob shudand] magar bandagoni mukhlisi Allokh' taolo
Nukh' ba dargokh'i Mo duo kard va [Mo] chi naku ich'obatkunanda budem!
Va u va khonavodaashro [bo kh'amrokh'i mu'minon] az baloi buzurgi [tufon] nach'ot dodem
Va [pas az tufon, fak'at pairavoni mu'min va] khonavodai uro [dar zamin] bok'i guzoshtem
Va baroiash dar miioni oiandagon [nomi nek] bar ch'oi nikh'odem
Salom [va sitoishi] ch'akh'oniion bar Nukh' bod
Ba rosti Mo nakukoronro, inchunin, podosh medikh'em
Be tardid, u az bandagoni mu'mini Mo bud
On gokh' digaronro [ki dar tufon monda budand] g'ark' kardem
Va, kh'atman, Ibrokh'im az pairavoni u [Nukh'] bud
[Iod kun az] kh'angome ki vai bo dili pok [va kholi az shirk] ba [dargokh'i] Parvardigorash omad
On gokh' ki ba padar va k'avmash guft: << Chi chize meparasted?
Oio ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo in ma'budoni durug'inro mekhokh'ed?
Gumonaton dar borai Parvardigori ch'akh'oniion chist?>>
Sipas nigokh'e ba sitoragon afkand [va andeshid]
Va guft: <<Man bemoram [va dar ch'ashn shirkat namekunam]>>
Mardum uro tark kardand va raftand
On gokh' pinkh'oni nazdi butkh'oiashon raft va [bo tamaskhur] guft: <<Chize namekhured?
Shumoro chi shudaast, ki sukhan namegued?>>
Sipas bo dasti rosti khud zarbakh'oi [mukh'kam] bar onkh'o vorid ovard [va ch'uz buti buzurg kh'amaro shikast]
Pas, k'avmash shitoftand va ba suii u omadand
[Ibrokh'im] guft: <<Oio chizero, ki khud metaroshed, meparasted?
Va kh'ol on ki Allokh' taolo [kh'am] shumo va [ kh'am] on chiro anch'om medikh'ed ofaridaast
[Vak'te butparaston az posukh darmondand] Guftand: <<Baroiash binoi [baland] bisozed va uro dar otash biafkaned>>
Pas, baroi [nobudii] u nairang khostand, [vale] Mo ononro past va [mag'lub] sokhtem [va otash bar Ibrokh'im sard va beasar shud]
Va guft: <<Man ba sui [sarzamini digare baroi ibodati] Parvardigoram meravam va U kh'idoiatam khokh'ad kard
Parvardigoro, ba man [farzande] az shoistagon ato kun>>
Mo [duoiashro mustach'ob kardem va] uro ba tavalludi pisari burdbore bashorat dodem

Va chun [Ismoil] ba [sinni navch'avoni va] kh'addi talosh [va kh'amkori] bo u [Ibrokh'im] rasid, ba vai guft: Pisaram, dar khob [ba man vakh'i meshavad va] mebinam, ki turo zabkh' mekunam. Nazarat dar in bora chist?>> [Ismoil] guft: <<Padarch'on, on chiro ki ba tu amr shudaast anch'om bidekh'. Inshoallokh' maro [dar barobari in farmon] shikebo khokh'i ioft>>
Pas, chun kh'ar du taslimi [farmoni Parvardigor] shudand va [Ibrokh'im] uro bo guna [bar khok] nikh'od
Ba u nido dodem, ki <<Ei Ibrokh'im!
Iak'inan khobatro takh'ak'k'uk' bakhshidi>>. Mo nakukoronro chunin podosh medikh'em
Be tardid, in [khob] ozmoishe oshkor bud [va Ibrokh'im az on sarbaland berun omad]
Va [ch'oni] uro dar barobari k'urbonii buzurge bozkharidem
Va baroiash dar miioni oiandagon [nomi nek] bar ch'oi nikh'odem
Salom bar Ibrokh'im
Mo nakukoronro chunin podosh medikh'em
Be tardid, u az bandagoni mu'mini Mo bud
Va uro ba [tavalludi] Iskh'ok', ki paiombare az shoistagon bud, bashorat dodem
[Mo] Ba u va Iskh'ok' barakat dodem, va [barkhe] az afrodi dudmonashon nakukor budand va [barkhe digar] oshkoro nisbat ba kheshtan sitamgor budand
Va ba rosti, bar Muso va Kh'orun minnat nikh'odem
Va on duro kh'amrokh'i k'avmashon az andukh'i buzurg [sitami Fir'avn va khatari g'ark' shudan dar Nil] nach'ot dodem
Va ioriashon kardem, to piruz shudand
Va ba on du kitobi ravshangar [Tavrot] dodem
Va ba rokh'i rost kh'idoiatashon kardem
Va baroiashon dar miioni oiandagon [nomi nek] bar ch'oi nikh'odem
Salom bar Muso va Kh'orun
Mo nakukoronro chunin podosh medikh'em
Be tardid, on du bandagoni mu'mini Mo budand
Va, kh'atman, Ilios [niz] iake az paiombaroni [Mo] bud
[Iod kun az] Kh'angome ki u ba k'avmash guft: <<Oio [az Allokh' taolo] parvo namekuned?
Oio [buti] <<Ba'l>>-ro [ba parastish] mekhoned va bekh'tarin ofarandaro rakh'o mekuned?
Allokh' taolo [-ro tark mekuned], ki Parvardigori shumo va Parvardigori padaronaton ast>>
Ammo uro durug'gu angoshtand va musallaman, [baroi azob] kh'ozir karda meshavand
Magar bandagoni mukhlisi Allokh' taolo
Mo baroiash dar miioni oiandagon [nomi nek] bar ch'oi nikh'odem
Salom bar Ilios
Ba rosti, Mo nakukoronro chunin podosh medikh'em
Be tardid, u az bandagoni mu'mini Mo bud
Va kh'atman, Lut [niz] iake az paiombaroni [Mo] bud
[Iod kun az] kh'angome ki u va kh'amai khonavodaashro nach'ot dodem
Magar pirazane, ki az bok'imondagon [dar azob] bud
Sipas digaronro kh'alok kardem
Va shumo [dar safar ba sarzamini Shom] subkh'gokh'on bar [vaironakh'oi shakh'rkh'oi] onon meguzared,
va shabongokh'. Oio nameandeshed [va ibrat namegired]?
Va, kh'atman, Iunus [niz] iake az paiombaroni [Mo] bud
[Iod kun az] kh'angome ki [ khashmgin az kufri k'avmash, biduni ich'ozati Parvardigor] ba kishtii anboshta [az musofir va bor] gurekht
Pas, [chun kishti dar kh'oli g'ark' shudan bud, Iunus kh'amrokh'i musofiron baroi berun andokhtani barkhe afrod] k'ur'a andokhtand va bozanda shud [va uro ba dario andokhtand]
Sipas mokh'ii [buzurge] uro bal'id [furu burd], dar kh'ole ki [khudro ba khotiri tarki vazifa] sarzanish mekard
Pas, agar dar zumrai tasbekh'guioni [Parvardigor] nabud,
Iak'inan, to ruze, ki [mardum] barangekhta meshavand, dar shikami on [mokh'i] bok'i memond
On gokh' uro dar kh'ole ki [za'if va] bemor bud ba sarzamini khushk [va begiiokh'] afkandem
Va bar [sari] u butai kadu ruiondem [to az soia va mevakh'oiash bakh'ra girad]
Va [dubora] uro ba suii sad kh'azor nafar io beshtar [ba risolat] firistodem
Pas, onon imon ovardand va Mo niz to muddate [az ne'matkh'oi zindagi] bakh'ramandashon sokhtem
Pas, az eshon [mushrikon] bipurs, oio dukhtarkh'o baroi Parvardigori tu va pisarkh'o baroi onkh'ost?
Oio Mo farishtagonro dukhtar ofaridem va onkh'o kh'uzur doshtand?
Ogokh' bosh! Onon az [rui tukh'mat va] durug'gui
meguiand: <<Allokh' taolo farzand dorad>> va, iak'inan, durug' meguiand
Oio [Allokh' taolo] dukhtaronro bar pisaron tarch'ekh' dodaast?
Shumoro chi shudaast? Chi guna kh'ukm mekuned?
Oio [nameandeshed va] pand namegired?
Oio [bar iddaoi botili khesh] daleli ravshane dored?
Pas, agar rostgued, kitobatonro biiovared
[Mushrikon] baini U [Allokh' taolo] va farishtagon, kheshovandi k'oil shudaand; dar kh'ole ki farishtagon ba iak'in medonand, ki [mushrikon ruzi k'iiomat baroi kh'isobrasi] ekh'zor meshavand
Allokh' taolo az on chi [mushrikon] tavsif mekunand, munazzakh' ast
[Mardum dar tavsifi Parvardigor, sukhani gazof meguiand] magar bandagoni mukhlisi Allokh' taolo
Pas, shumo [mushrikon] va on chi meparasted,
[kh'argiz] gumrokh'gari [kase az dini kh'ak'] nested
Magar on ki [ba tak'diri ilokh'i] akh'li duzakh boshad
Va [farishtagon meguiand]: << Kh'ech' iak az mo nest, magar on ki mak'omi mushakhkhase [dar peshgokh'i ilokh'i] dorad
Moem, ki [baroi parastish va niioish ba dargokh'i Parvardigor] ba saf istodaem
Va be tardid, moem, ki tasbekh'gui [U] kh'astem>>
Va [kofiron, pesh az bi'sat] kh'amvora meguftand:
<<Agar kitobe az [kitobkh'oi osmonii] peshiniion nazdamon bud,
iak'inan, az bandagoni mukhlisi Allokh' taolo meshudem>>
Ammo [kh'angome ki paiombar bo K'ur'on ba suiashon omad, kh'ak'k'oniiati] onro inkor kardand; pas, ba zudi [natich'ai in korashonro] khokh'and donist
Va kh'atman sukhanoni Mo dar borai bandagoni firistodaamon az pesh sodir shudaast
Onon, kh'atman, az ch'onibi Mo iori shudaand
Va be tardid, lashkari Mo piruzand
Pas, [ei Paiombar] to muddate az onon [mushrikon] rui bigardon
Va ononro [dar kh'angomi nuzuli azob] bingar; pas, ba zudi khud [niz natich'ai kufrashonro] khokh'and did
Oio onon azobi moro ba shitob khostorand?
On gokh' ki [azobi ilokh'i] bar khonakh'oiashon furud oiad, chi bad ast bomdodi kh'ushdorioftagon!
Va to muddate az onon rui bigardon
Va ononro [dar kh'angomi nuzuli azob] bingar; pas, ba zudi khud [niz natich'ai kufrashonro] khokh'and did
Pok va munazzakh' ast Parvardigorat - Parvardigori izzat va k'udrat-az on chi [mushrikon ba durug'] vasf mekunand
Va salom bar paiombaron
Va sipos [va sitoish] az oni Allokh' taolo- Parvardigori ch'akh'oniion- ast
Sod. Savgand ba K'ur'oni pandomuz [ki Allokh' taolo kh'ech' sharike nadorad]
Ammo kofiron giriftori taassub [-u ch'okh'iliiat] va sitezand
Chi bisior naslkh'oi kofirro pesh az onon kh'alok kardem, ki [dar kh'angomi nuzuli azob] fariod mezadand, ammo [on zamon digar] kh'angomi nach'ot nabud
Mushrikon az in ki bimdikh'andae az miioni khudashon ba surog'ashon omadaast, ibrozi shigifti kardand va guftand: <<In mard ch'odugaru durug'gust
Oio ba ch'oii ma'budoni mukhtalif ma'bude iagona k'aror dodaast? Vok'ean, kori ach'ibe ast>>

Buzurgonashon ba po khostand [va ba pairavoni khud guftand]: <<Biraved va bar [parastishu kh'ifzi] ma'budonaton istodagari kuned. Be tardid, [Mukh'ammad bo] in kor khostaast [ki shumoro gumrokh' kunad va khudro ba raiosat birasonad]
Mo in [nazariiai tavkh'id]-ro kh'atto dar oini masekh'iiat kh'am nashnidaem. In sukhan ch'uz durug' [chize] nest
Oio az miioni [kh'amai] mo K'ur'on ba u nozil shudaast>>? [Chunin nest, ki onon meguiand] Balki onon dar [asli] vakh'ii Man tardid dorand va kh'anuz azobi Maro nachashidaand
Oio ganch'inakh'oi rakh'mati Parvardigori shikastnopaziri bakhshandaat nazdashon kh'ast?
Oio farmonravoi osmonkh'o va zamin va baini onkh'o kh'astand? [Agar chunin ast] Bo vasoil [-u imkonoti khud ba osmon] avch' bigirand [va monei nuzuli vakh'i gardand]
[In kofiron] Lashkare shikastkhurda az ch'umla soiri gurukh'kh'o [va akh'zobi mukholifi paiombaron] kh'astand
Pesh az onon niz k'avmi Nukh' va Od va Fir'avni sokh'ibsipokh' niz [paiombaroni Moro] takzib kardand
K'avmi Samud va k'avmi Lut va askh'obi Aika [k'avmi Shuaib] niz az on gurukh'kh'o budand [ki paiombaronro takzib kardand]
Kh'ar iak [az in gurukh'kh'o] paiombaron [-i khud]-ro takzib kardand va kaifari man [dar mavridashon] takh'ak'k'uk' ioft
Inon fak'at bonge sakh'mnokro intizor mekashand, ki kh'ech' bozgashte nadorad
[Bo tamaskhur] Meguiand: <<Parvardigoro, pesh az faro rasidani ruzi kh'isob bakh'rai moro [az azob] ba shitob bidekh'>>
[Ei paiombar] Dar barobari guftorashon shikebo bosh va az Dovud, bandai tavonmandi Mo iod kun, ki kh'amvora [bo tavba va anch'omi kori khair ba dargokh'i mo] bozmegasht
Mo kukh'kh'oro ba u ba khidmat gumoshtem, ki kh'amnavo bo u shomgokh'on va bomdodon [Parvardigorro] tasbekh' meguftand
Va parandagonro [niz ba khidmat gumoshtem], ki gird meomadand va kh'amagi muteash budand [va bo vai dar zikri Parvardigor kh'amovozi mekardand]
Mo farmonravoiashro ustuvor namudem va ba u paiombari va kalome faisalabakhsh ato kardem
Oio khabari afrode ba tu rasidaast, ki baroi dodkhokh'i [ba surog'i Dovud omadand va] az devori ibodatgokh'ash bolo raftand?

Chun [biduni ittilo'] bar Dovud vorid shudand, az didanashon ba vakh'shat aftod; onon guftand: <<Natars, mo du nafari shoki [shikoiatkunanda] kh'astem, ki iake bar digare sitam kardaast. Miionamon ba adolat dovari kun va az kh'ak' dur nashav va moro ba rokh'i rost kh'idoiat kun>>

[Iake az onon guft] <<In mard barodari man ast. U navadu nukh' mesh dorad va man iak mesh doram va [ba isror] meguiad: <<On [iak mesh]-ro kh'am ba man vo guzor>> va dar bakh's bar man piruz shudaast>>

[Dovud] Guft: <<Musallaman, u bo khostani meshi tu [baroi afzudan] ba meshkh'oi khudash bar tu sitam kardaast va bisiore az sharikon [va kh'amkoron] dar kh'ak'k'i iakdigar sitam mekunand, magar kasone, ki imon ovardaand va korkh'oi shoista anch'om dodaand, ki [onkh'o niz] bisior nodirand>>. Dovud [ki biduni tavzekh' khostan az tarafi digar kh'ukm sodir karda bud] mutavach'ch'ekh' shud, ki imtikh'onash kardaem. On gokh' az Parvardigorash omurzish khost va bo furutani ba zamin aftod va [ba dargokh'i ilokh'i] tavba kard
Pas, uro ba khotiri on [khato] bakhshidem va baroiash dar peshgokh'i khud mak'ome volo k'aror dodem va [dar okhirat] bozgashti nekue khokh'ad dosht

Ei Dovud, mo turo dar zamin khalifa va farmonravo k'aror dodem; Pas, dar miioni mardum ba kh'ak' dovari kun va pairavi kh'avo [-i nafs] nabosh, ki az rokh'i Allokh' taolo gumrokh'at mekunad. Be gumon kasone, ki az rokh'i Allokh' taolo gumrokh' meshavand, ba sazoi on ki ruzi kh'isobro faromush kardaand, azobi shadide [dar pesh] dorand
Mo osmon va zamin va on chiro, ki miioni onkh'ost, bekh'uda naofaridaem. In gumoni kofiron ast. Pas, voi bar kofiron az otashi duzakh!
Oio kasone, ki imon ovardaand va korkh'oi shoista anch'om dodaand, monandi kasone ba kh'isob meovarem, ki dar zamin tabakh'kori kardaand? Oio parkh'ezkoronro monandi badkoron ba kh'isob meovarem?
[Ei Mukh'ammad, in K'ur'on] Kitobest purbarakat, ki bar tu nozil kardem, to [mardum] dar oiotash biandeshand va khiradmandon pand girand
Mo Sulaimonro ba Dovud ato kardem, neku bandae bud va kh'amvora [ba dargokh'i Parvardigorash] tavba mekard
[Iod kun] On gokh' ki asrgokh'on aspkh'oi asil [va tundpo] baroiash ovardand

[Sulaimon sargarmi tamoshoi aspkh'o shud va vak'ti namoz guzasht.] On gokh' guft: <<Ba rosti, ki dustii in aspkh'o, maro az iodi Parvardigoram g'ofil kard, to on ki [khurshed] dar pardai mag'rib pinkh'on shud
[Bori digar] Onkh'oro nazdi man bozgardoned>>. On gokh' [ba nishonai vak'f dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo] ba sok'u gardani aspkh'o dast kashid

Sulaimonro ozmudem va ch'asadi navzodero [ki biduni tavakkal bar Allokh' taolo mushtok'ona dar intizori tavalludash bud] bar takhtash afkandem [to dariobad, ki k'udrat ba tamomi dar ikhtiiori Allokh' taolo ast]. On gokh' [tavba kard va ba dargokh'i ilokh'i] bozgasht
Guft: <<Parvardigoro, maro biomurz va kh'ukumate ba man arzoni dor, ki pas az man benazir boshad, ki bakhshoianda Tui, Tu>>
Pas, [Mo] bodro dar khidmatash gumoshtem, ki kh'ar kuch'o iroda mekard, ba farmoni U ba oromi ravon meshud
Va kh'ar binokor va g'avvose az ch'inniionro [ki mekhost, ba farmonash darovardem]
Va [gurukh'i] digare [az ch'iniion]-ro [ki kh'amagi] dar g'ulu zanch'ir budand, [takh'ti sultaash] darovardem
[Ba u guftem] <<In atoi Most, pas, [ba kh'ar kas mekhokh'i] bibakhsh va az kh'ar ki mekhokh'i, boz dor. Kh'isobe bar tu nest>>
Be tardid, baroi Sulaimon dar peshgokh'i khud mak'omi volo k'aror dodem va [dar okhirat] bozgashte neku khokh'ad dosht
[Ei paiombar] Az bandai Mo Aiub iod kun, on gokh' ki Parvardigorashro nido dod, ki: <<Shaiton maro ba ranch'u dard ovardaast>>
[Ba u farmon dodem] <<Poii khudro bar zamin bikub [to chashmae bich'ushad]. In chashmasore khunuk baroi shustushu va oshomidanist>>
Va khonavodaashro [ki az dast doda bud] duchand ba vai bakhshidem, to [nishonai] rakh'mate az ch'onibi Mo va andarze baroi khiradmandon boshad

Va [ba u farmon dodem] <<Dastae az shokhakh'o [-i borikro] bargir va bo on [kh'amsaratro] bizan va savgandatro [ki dar kh'angomi khashm iod karda budi] nashikan. Be tardid, u mardi shikeboe bud. Chi neku bandae! Ba rosti, ki u bisior tavbakor bud
Va [ei paiombar] az bandagoni Mo Ibrokh'im va Iskh'ok' va Ia'k'ub, ki tavonmandu bobasirat budand
Mo bo [mavkh'ibati] iodi okhirat ba onon khulusi vizhae bakhshidem
Onon dar peshgokh'i Mo nekmard va barguzida budand
Va [niz] iod kun az Ismoil va Iasa' va Zulkifl, ki kh'amagi az nekon budand
In [K'ur'on] pandest va be gumon, parkh'ezgoron [dar bikh'isht] manzilgokh'e neku khokh'and dosht
Bog'kh'oe ch'ovidon, ki darkh'oiash ba ruiashon kushodaast
On ch'o, dar kh'ole ki bar takhtkh'o takia zadaand, dasturi mevakh'oi farovon va nushidani medikh'and
Va nazdashon zanoni durushtchashm ast, ki [ tankh'o ba shavkh'aroni khud] nazar dorand va [kh'amagi] kh'amsin kh'astand
In kh'amon ne'matkh'oest, ki baroi ruzi kh'isob ba shumo va'da doda meshavad
In rizk'u ruzi az ch'onibi Most, ki kh'argiz [k'at' nameshavad va] poion namepazirad
In [podoshi parkh'ezkoron] ast va sarkashon badtarin bozgashtro dorand
[Kh'amon] Duzakh, ki dar on vorid meshavand va chi bad k'arorgokh'e ast!
In [much'ozot] obi ch'ushon va khunobai chirkoludest, ki boiad az on bichashand
Va ch'uz inkh'o kaifarkh'oi gunoguni digare kh'ammonandi on dorand
[Ba rakh'baroni duzakhi gufta meshavad] <<In gurukh' niz kh'amrokh'i shumo [ba duzakh] darmeoiand>>. [Onon posukh medikh'and] <<Khush omad bar onon mabod! Charo ki ba otash darmeoiand>>
[Pairavon] Meguiand: <<Balki, shumoro khushomad mabod, ki in [azob]-ro peshi poii mo nikh'oded. Pas, [duzakh] chi bad k'arorgokh'e ast>>!
[Sipas] Meguiand: <<Parvardigoro, kh'ar kas, ki in [azob]-ro baroi Mo farokh'am kardaast, azobashro dar otash duchand kun>>
[Duzakhiioni mutakabbir] Meguiand: <<Charo kasonero, ki [dar dunio] dar zumrai ashror mepindoshtem, [dar duzakh] namebinem?
Oio [be ch'ikh'at] ononro, ki tamaskhur megiriftem io [in ch'o kh'astand va] chashmon [-i mo] bar eshon nameaftad?>>
In much'odalai akh'li otash k'at'an rostast
[Ei paiombar, ba kofiron] Bigu: <<Man fak'at bimdikh'andaam va kh'ech' ma'bude [ba kh'ak'] ch'uz Allokh'i iagonai piruzmand nest
Parvardigori osmonkh'o va zamin va on chi miioni onkh'ost. [On] Shikastnopaziri omurzanda>>
[Ei paiombar] Bigu: <<In [K'ur'on] khabare buzurg ast,
shumo az on ruigardoned
[Agar ba man vakh'i nameshud] Az olami bolotar on gokh', ki farishtagon [dar mavridi ofarinishi inson] ch'idol mekardand, kh'ech' ittiloe nadoshtam
Tankh'o az on rui ba man vakh'i meshavad, ki bimdikh'andae oshkoram>>
[Iod kun az] Kh'angome ki Parvardigorat ba farishtagon guft: <<Man bashare az gil meofarinam
On gokh' ki uro somon dodam va az rukh'i khesh dar u damidam, dar barobarash sach'da kuned>>
Pas, [chun Odam khalk' shud] farishtagon kh'amagi sach'da kardand
Magar Iblis, ki takabbur varzid va kofir shud
[Allokh' taolo] Farmud: <<Ei Iblis, chi chiz much'ib shud, ki dar barobari on chi ba dastoni khud ofaridaam, sach'da nakuni? Oio takabbur varzidi io bartarich'ui kardi>>?
Guft: <<Man az u bartaram: Maro az otash ofaridai va uro az gil>>
Allokh' taolo farmud: <<Az bikh'isht berun shav, ki tu [manfuru] rondashudai
Va la'nati Man to ruzi k'iiomat bar tu khokh'ad bud>>
[Iblis] Guft: <<Parvardigoro, pas to ruze, ki [bandagonat] barangekhta meshavand, ba man mukh'lat bidekh'>>
[Allokh' taolo] Farmud: <<Mukh'lat khokh'i dosht
To [ruzi k'iiomat] on vak'ti muaiian>>
[Iblis] Guft: <<Ba izzatat savgand, ki kh'amai ononro gumrokh' khokh'am kard
Magar bandagoni kholisi Tu az [miioni] onon [ki kh'idoiatashon kardai]>>
[Allokh' taolo] Farmud: <<Pas, [sukhani Man] kh'ak' ast va kh'ak'ro meguiam
K'at'an, ch'akh'annamro az tu va kh'ar ki az tu pairavi kunad, anboshta khokh'am sokht>>
[Ei paiombar, ba mushrikon] Bigu: <<Man [dar barobari risolatam] kh'ech' podoshe az shumo namekhokh'am va firebkor nestam [va ba durug' iddaoi nubuvvat namekunam]>>
In [K'ur'on] ch'uz pand baroi ch'akh'oniion [inson va ch'in] nest
Va k'at'an, pas az marg az khabari [kh'ak'k'oniiat va rostii] on ogokh' khokh'ed shud
Nuzuli in kitob az ch'onibi Allokh'i shikastnopaziri kh'akim ast
In kitobro ba kh'ak' bar tu nozil kardem, pas, Allokh'ro bo khulusi e'tik'od parastish kun

Ogokh' boshed, ki dini kholis [va kholi az shirk] az oni Allokh' taolo ast va afrode, ki g'airi Allokh'ro [dust va] korsozi khud intikhob kardaand [pindorashon in ast, ki]: <<Onkh'oro fak'at ba in dalel meparastem, ki moro ba Allokh' taolo nazdik gardonand [va manzalatamonro beshtar kunand]>>. Allokh' taolo dar mavoridi ikhtilofashon miioni onon [va muvakh'kh'idoni rostin] dovari khokh'ad kard. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo kasero, ki durug'gui nosipos boshad, kh'idoiat nakhokh'ad kard
Agar Allokh' taolo mekhost farzande barguzinad, az miioni ofaridagoni khud kh'ar chi mekhost, barmeguzid. U munazzakh' [az in nisbatkh'o] ast va Ust Allokh'i iagonai piruzmand

Osmonkh'o va zaminro ba kh'ak' [va bo kh'adaf] ofarid. Shabro bar ruz megusturonad va ruzro bar shab va khurshedu mokh'ro dar khidmat [-i shumo] gumosht, ki kh'ar iak to saromadi muaiiane ravon ast. Ogokh' boshed! U shikastnopaziri omurzgor ast

U shumoro az iak tan ofarid, on gokh' kh'amsarashro niz az vai padid ovard va baroi [istifodai] shumo kh'asht nav' az chakh'orpoion [naru modai shutur, gov, gusfand va buz]-ro ofarid. Shumoro dar shikami modaraton taii marokh'ili mukhtalif dar nikh'ongokh'kh'oi segona meofarinad. In ast Allokh' taolo, Parvardigori shumo, ki farmonravoi khosi Ust. Ma'bude [ba kh'ak'] ch'uz U nest, pas, chi guna ba berokh'a meraved?

Agar nosiposi kuned, [bidoned, ki] Allokh' taolo az shumo beniioz ast va kh'argiz nosiposii bandagonashro namepisandad va agar shukri Uro ba ch'oi ovared, in korro baroiaton mepisandad va kh'ech' gunakh'gore bori gunokh'i digarero bar dush namekashad, pas, bozgashtaton ba suii Parvardigoraton ast. On gokh' U shumoro az on chi anch'om medoded, ogokh' mekunad. Iak'inan, U az rozi dilkh'o ogokh' ast

Kh'argokh' inson duchori [ranch'u] ziione meshavad, Parvardigorashro [bo tazarru' va zori] mekhonad va ba dargokh'ash bozmegardad. Ammo kh'angome ki ne'mate az ch'onibi khud ba vai mebakhshem, mushkilero, ki k'ablan baroiash duo mekard, az iod mebarad va baroi Allokh' taolo [dar k'udrat] kh'amtoione k'oil meshavad, to [digaronro niz] az rokh'i U gumrokh' kunad. [Ei paiombar, ba chunin kase] Bigu: <<Andak zamone bo nosiposi [az ne'matkh'oi dunio] bakh'ramand shav, ki k'at'an duzakhi khokh'i bud>>

Oio [chunin mushrike bekh'tar ast io] on ki dar tuli shab dar kh'oli sach'da va k'iiom ba ibodat mashg'ul ast va az [azobi] okhirat tarson ast va ba rakh'mati Parvardigorash umed dorad? Bigu: <<Oio kasone, ki [kh'ak'k'i bandagii Parvardigorro] medonand va kasone, ki namedonand, iaksonand? Tankh'o khiradmandon pand mepazirand>>

[Ei paiombar] Bigu: <<Ei bandagoni boimoni man, az Parvardigoraton parvo kuned. Afrode, ki nekui mekunand [ilova bar okhirat dar in dunio niz] podoshi neku dorand. Zamini Allokh' taolo gusturdaast [pas, agar baroi kh'ifzi ak'idai khud duchori mushkil shuded, kh'ich'rat kuned]. K'at'an, podoshi poidoron komilu bedareg' ato khokh'ad shud>>
Bigu: <<Man ma'muram bo khulusi e'tik'od Allokh'ro biparastam
Va ma'mur shudaam nakhustin kase [dar in ummat] bosham, ki taslim [makh'z dar muk'obili Parvardigor] ast>>
Bigu: <<Agar dar barobari Parvardigoram nofarmon bosham, az azobi ruzi buzurg [k'iiomat] metarsam>>
[Ei paiombar] Bigu: <<Man Allokh'ro bo khulusi e'tik'odi khud meparastam

Shumo niz g'air az Allokh' taolo kh'ar chiro mekhokh'ed, biparasted>>. Bigu: <<Ziionkoron [-i vok'ei] kasone kh'astand, ki [ba tama'i dunio] khud va khonavodaashonro dar rastokhez ba ziion andokhtaand. Ogokh' boshed, ki in kh'amon ziioni oshkor ast
Bar boloi sar va zeri poiashon tabak'ote az otash ast. In ast on chi Allokh' taolo bandagonashro az on metarsonad. Ei bandagoni Man, az [nofarmonii] Man parvo kuned
Bashorat baroi kasonest, ki az parastishi tog'ut [butkh'o] ich'tinob varzidand va [tavbakunon] ba dargokh'i ilokh'i bozgashtand. Pas, [ei paiombar] ba bandagonam [bikh'ishtro] bashorat bidekh'
[Kh'amon] Kasone, ki sukhan [-kh'oi mukhtalif]-ro meshunavand va az bekh'tarini on pairavi mekunand. Onon kasone kh'astand, ki Allokh' taolo kh'idoiatashon karda va khiradmandand
Oio kasero, ki farmoni much'ozot bar u k'at'i shudaast [metavon kh'idoiat namud]? Oio tu metavoni kasero, ki dar otash ast, nach'ot dikh'i?

Ammo kasone, ki az Parvardigorashon parvo dorand, [dar bikh'isht] g'urfakh'oe dorand, ki bar farozi onkh'o g'urfakh'oe [digar] sokhta shudaast [va] az zeri onkh'o ch'uiborkh'o ch'orist. Allokh' taolo [ba durusti] va'da dodaast va va'dakhilofi namekunad

Oio nadidai, ki Allokh' taolo borone az osmon firistod va onro [ba surati] chashmakh'oe dar zamin ch'ori sokht. On gokh' ba vasilai on kishtzore bo rangkh'oi gunogun padid meovarad. Sipas pazhmurda megardad va mebini, ki zard shudaast. On gokh' onro khurdu khoshok mesozad? Be tardid, dar in [digargunikh'o] pande baroi khiradmandon ast

Oio kase, ki Allokh' taolo dilashro paziroi Islom karda va az ch'onibi Parvardigorash az nur [kh'idoiat va basirat] barkhurdor gashta [kh'ammonandi sakhtdilon ast]? Voi bar onon dar barobari zikri Allokh' taolo sangdil shudaand! Onon dar gumrokh'ii oshkorand

Allokh' taolo bekh'tarin sukhanro dar surati kitobe nozil karda, ki [barkhe az oiotash] kh'ammonandi iakdigar va [barkhe niz] mukarrar ast. Kasone, ki az [much'ozoti] Parvardigorashon bim dorand, [bo shunidani in oiot] mui bar tanashon rost meshavad va sipas dilu ch'onashon ba iodi Allokh' taolo orom megirad. In kh'idoiati Allokh' taolo ast, ki kh'ar kiro bikhokh'ad, ba on rokh' menamoiad va kh'ar kiro Allokh' taolo gumrokh' sozad, kh'ech' kh'idoiatgare nakhokh'ad dosht

Oio kase, ki dar ruzi k'iiomat [dastonash basta ast va nochor] bo ruiash on azobi sakhtro daf' mekunad, [kh'amchun kasest, ki dar osoishi bikh'isht k'aror dorad]? Ba sitamgoron [-i mushrik] gufta shavad, [natich'ai] dastovardatonro bichashed
Kasone, ki pesh az onon budand, niz [oioti Allokh'ro] durug' shumurdand va az ch'oie, ki fikr namekardand, azob domangirashon shud

Pas, Allokh' taolo [ta'mi] rasvoi va khoriro dar zindagii dunio ba onon chashond va musallaman, azobi okhirat buzurgtar [va sakhttar] ast. Agar mushrikon medonistand [ki raftorashon chi paiomade dorad, ibrat megiriftand]
Dar in K'ur'on az kh'ar [guna] masale baroi mardum ovardaem, boshad, ki pand pazirand
K'ur'one ba zaboni fasekh'i arabi va biduni kh'ech' guna ibkh'omu inkh'irof [nozil kardem], boshad, ki [takh'ti ta'limotash az Parvardigori iakto] parvo kunand

Allokh' taolo [baroi muk'oisai mushriku muvakh'kh'id] mardero misol mezanad, ki chand sharik dar borai [molikiiati] u paivasta bo kh'am ikhtilofu mushoch'ara dorand va dar muk'obilash marde, ki takh'ti farmoni iak nafar k'aror dorad. Oio in du nafar [az nazari mavk'eiiat] iaksonand? Sitoish makhsusi Allokh' taolo ast, vale beshtarashon namedonand
[Ei paiombar] K'at'an, tu khokh'i murd va onon [niz] khokh'and murd
On gokh' [shumo-mardum] dar ruzi k'iiomat nazdi Parvardigoraton [dar borai masoili mavridi ikhtilof] much'odala khokh'ed kard
Va kist sitamgortar az on ki ba Allokh' taolo, durug' nisbat medikh'ad va sukhani rostero, ki ba vai rasidaast, durug' meshumorad? Oio dar duzakh ch'oigokh'e baroi kofiron nest?
Ammo onon, ki paiomi rostin biiovarand [va digaronro ba pazirishi on da'vat kunand] va khud niz onro tasdik' namoiand, ba rosti, parkh'ezgorand
Kh'ar chi bikhokh'and, nazdi Parvardigorashon dorand. Podoshi nekukoron kh'amin ast
To Allokh' taolo badtarin raftorashonro az [kornomai] onon bizudoiad va bar asosi bekh'tarin a'molashon ba eshon podosh dikh'ad
Oio Allokh' taolo baroi difo' az bandaash kofi nest? Ammo mushrikon turo az butkh'o va ma'budonashon metarsonand va kh'ar kiro Allokh' taolo gumrokh' kunad, kh'ech' kh'idoiatgare nakhokh'ad dosht
Va kh'ar kiro, ki Allokh' taolo kh'idoiat kunad, kh'ech' kas gumrokh'ash nakhokh'ad sokht. Oio Allokh' taolo shikastnopaziru dodsiton nest?!

[Ei paiombar] Agar az mushrikon bipursi: <<Chi kase osmonkh'o va zaminro ofaridaast>>? Musallaman, meguiand: <<Allokh' taolo>>. Ba onon bigu: <<Pas, ba nazari shumo, agar Allokh' taolo nokhushi va ranch'e baroiam bikhokh'ad, oio on chi ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo [ba niioish] mekhoned, metavonand osebashro bartaraf kunand? Io agar Allokh' taolo rakh'mate baroi man bikhokh'ad, oio metavonand moneash shavand?>> Bigu: [Pushtibonii] Allokh' taolo baroiam kofi ast. Akh'li tavakkal tankh'o bar U tavakkal mekunand>>
Bigu: <<Ei k'avmi man, shumo bar kh'ol [va vaz'i shirkomez]-i khud boshed, man niz [ba vazoifi khud] amal mekunam. Ba zudi khokh'ed donist,
[Ba zudi khokh'ed donist, ] ki kist on ki [dar dunio] giriftori azobi rasvogar meshavad va [dar okhirat] azobi poianda bar sarash meborad>>

In kitobi osmoniro baroi [kh'idoiati] mardum, barkh'ak' bar tu nozil kardem. Kh'ar ki kh'idoiat shavad, ba sudi khudi ust va kh'ar ki gumrokh' gasht, ba ziioni khesh gumrokh' shudaast va tu [nigakh'bon va] korsozashon nesti [ki ononro ba kh'idoiat ich'bor kuni]

Allokh' taolo ch'onkh'oro dar lakh'zai marg megirad va[niz] ch'oni kasero, ki namurdaast, ba kh'angomi khobash [megirad], on gokh' ch'onkh'oero, ki kh'ukmi marg bar onkh'o rondaast, nigakh' medorad va ch'oni digaronro bozpas mefiristad, to kh'angomi muaiian [marg]. Dar in [amr] baroi kh'ar ki biandeshad, nishonakh'oe [az k'iiomat] ast

Oio mushrikon g'air az Allokh' taolo [baroi khud az miioni butkh'o] shafoatkunandagone intikhob kardaand? [Ei paiombar, ba onon] Bigu: <<Kh'atto agar onkh'o moliki chize naboshand va [chizero] dark nakunand [boz kh'am onkh'oro ba shafoat metalabed]>>?
Bigu: <<Shafoat ba tamomi az oni Allokh' taolo ast. Farmonravoii osmonkh'o va zamin niz az oni Ust va nikh'oiatan [kh'amagi] ba peshgokh'i U bozgardonda meshaved>>

Kh'angome ki Allokh' taolo ba iaktoi [va tavkh'id] iod meshavad, dilkh'oi kasone, ki ba okhirat imon nadorand, mutanaffir [va bezor] megardad. Va chun az ma'budone g'air az Allokh' taolo iod shavad, on gokh' ast, ki mushrikon shodmon megardand
Bigu: <<Bor ilokh'o, [ei] ofarinandai osmonkh'o va zamin, ei donoi nikh'onu oshkor, Tu dar miioni bandagonat dar mavoridi ikhtilofashon dovari khokh'i kard>>

Agar du barobari on chi dar zamin ast, dar ikhtiiori sitamgoron [mushrikon] boshad, kh'amaro baroi nach'oti khud az sakhtii azobi ruzi k'iiomat fido mekunand [Vale paziruftani nest]. Va az ch'onibi Allokh' taolo umure baroiashon oshkor megardad, ki tasavvurashro kh'am namekardand
[Dar on ruz] Dastovardi zishtashon bar onon oshkor meshavad va azobe, ki maskhara mekardand, domangirashon khokh'ad shud

Kh'ar gokh' inson duchori [ranch'u] ziione shavad, Moro [ba niioish] mekhonad va chun az ch'onibi khesh ne'mate ba vai arzoni dorem, meguiad: "Fak'at [laiok'at va] donoii khudam much'ibi in ne'mat shudaast. [Na] balki in ozmoish [-i ilokh'i] ast, vale beshtari mardum namedonand
Peshiniionashon kh'am kh'amin sukhanro guftand, vale [ba kh'angomi azob] dastovardashon sude ba kh'olashon nadosht
Va [uk'ubati] dastovardi zishtashon domangirashon shud. In sitamgoron [-i mushrik] niz ba uk'ubati dastovardashon giriftor khokh'and shud va [Parvardigori mutaolro] ba tang nakhokh'and ovard

Oio mushrikon namedonand, ki Allokh' taolo [ne'mat va] ruziro bar kh'ar kase, ki bikhokh'ad, gusturda medorad va io tang megirad? Be gumon, dar in amr baroi mu'minon nishonakh'oe [az tadbiri ilokh'i] ast

[Ei paiombar] Ba bandagonam, ki [dar irtikob ba shirku gunokh'] ziiodaravi kardaand, bigu: <<Az rakh'mati ilokh'i ma'ius naboshed, charo ki [agar tavba kuned] Allokh' taolo kh'amai gunokh'onatonro mebakhshad. Ba rosti, ki U bisior omurzanda va mekh'rubon ast
Pesh az on ki azob ba surog'aton biioiad va kh'ech' kas natavonad ioriaton kunad, ba suii Parvardigoraton bozgarded va taslimi [farmoni] U garded
Va pesh az on ki nogakh'on, dar kh'ole ki g'ofiled, azob ba surog'aton biioiad, az bekh'tarin dasturkh'oe, ki az ch'onibi Parvardigoraton ba shumo nozil shudaast, pairavi kuned
[Kh'am aknun barkh'azar boshed] to kase [dar ruzi k'iiomat] naguiad: <<Ei dareg' bar man, ki dar kh'ak'k'i Allokh' taolo kutokh'i namudam va [mu'minonro] maskhara mekardam>>!
Io [gunokh'i khudro bar gardani tak'dir naandozad va] naguiad: <<Agar Allokh' taolo maro kh'idoiat karda bud, k'at'an, parkh'ezkor budam>>
Io kh'angome ki azobro mebinad, naguiad: <<Ei kosh, bozgashte [ba dunio] doshtam, to dar zumrai nekukoron k'aror megiriftam>>
[Allokh' taolo mefarmoiad] <<Oioti Man baroiat omad va tu onkh'oro durug' pindoshti va takabbur namudi va kufr varzidi>>
Va ruzi k'iiomat kasonero, ki bar Allokh' taolo durug' bastaand, siiakh'rui mebini. Oio dar duzakh ch'oigokh'e baroi mutakabbiron nest>>?
Allokh' taolo parkh'ezkoronro bo vorid kardan ba makoni komiobiashon, [az azob] nach'ot medikh'ad. [Dar bikh'isht] Na ranch'e ba onon merasad va na andukh'gin meshavand
Allokh' taolo ofaridgori kh'ar chizest va U bar kh'ama chiz [nigakh'bonu] korsoz ast
Kalidi ganch'inakh'oi osmonkh'o va zamin az oni Ust va kasone, ki ba oioti ilokh'i kofir shudand, k'at'an, ziionkorand
[Ei paiombar] Bigu: <<Ei bekhabaron, oio ba man farmon medikh'ed, ki [ma'bude] g'air az Allokh'ro parastish kunam?!>>
Ba tu va paiombaroni pesh az tu vakh'i shudaast, ki: <<Agar shirk bivarzi, [podoshi] korkh'oiat, k'at'an, barbod khokh'ad raft va ziionkor khokh'i shud
Balki tankh'o Allokh'ro parastish kun va siposguzor bosh>>

Mushrikon Allokh'ro chunon ki sazovori Ust, arch' nanikh'odand, kh'ol on ki dar ruzi k'iiomat zamin iaksara dar k'abzai Ust va osmonkh'o ba dasti Vai darkh'ampechida khokh'ad shud. Poku munazzakh' ast Allokh' taolo va az on chi bo vai sharik mesozand, bartar ast

[Dar ostonai k'iiomat] Dar sur damida meshavad. Pas, kh'ar ki dar osmonkh'o va dar zamin ast, madkh'ushi marg khokh'ad shud, magar kase, ki Allokh' taolo bikhokh'ad, on gokh' bori digar dar on damida meshavad va nogakh'on [kh'ama az marg] barmekhezand va chashm ba rokh' [-i farmoni Parvaridgor] kh'astand

[Dar ruzi k'iiomat] zamin ba nuri Parvardigorash ravshan khokh'ad shud va noma [-i a'mol] nikh'oda meshavad va paiombaron va guvokh'onro meovarand va miioni bandagon ba kh'ak' va adolat dovari meshavad va ba kh'ech' kas sitam nakhokh'ad shud
Va ch'azoi amalkardi kh'ar kas ba tamomi doda meshavad. Va Allokh' taolo nisbat ba a'molashon donotar ast

Kofiron gurukh'-gurukh' ba suii duzakh ronda meshavand. Kh'amin ki ba on ch'o merasand, darkh'oiash kushoda megardad va nigakh'bononash meguiand: <<Oio paiombarone az miioni khudi shumo ba surog'aton naomadand, ki oioti Parvardigoratonro baroi shumo mekhondand va dar borai didori in ruz kh'ushdor medodand? Onon [dar posukh] meguiand: Ore, vale [mo inkorashon kardem va] farmoni much'ozot sazoi kofiron ast>>
[Ba onon] Gufta meshavad: <<Az darkh'oi duzakh vorid shaved va ch'ovidona dar on ba sar bared. Va [ba rosti] ch'oigokh'i mutakabbiron chi bad [ch'oigokh'e] ast!>>

Va kasone, ki az Parvardigorashon parvo doshtand, gurukh'-gurukh' ba suii bikh'isht kh'idoiat meshavand. Kh'amin ki ba on ch'o merasand, dar kh'ole ki darkh'oi bikh'isht kushoda shudaast, [bo izzatu ekh'tirom vorid meshavand] va nigakh'bononi on ch'o meguiand: <<Salom bar shumo. Khush omaded. Ch'ovidona ba bikh'isht daroed>>

Bikh'ishtiion meguiand: <<Sitoish va sipos makhsusi Allokh' taolo ast, ki va'dai kheshro dar mavridi mo takh'ak'k'uk' bakhshid va sarzamin [-i bikh'isht]-ro ba mo meros dod, ki dar kh'ar ch'oii on bikhokh'em, manzil megirem. Va [ba rosti] podoshi akh'li amal chi nekust>>

[Dar on ruz] Farishtagonro khokh'i did, ki peromuni Arsh kh'alk'a zadaand va Parvardigorashonro ba poki mesitoiand. Va miioni mardum ba kh'ak'k'u adolat dovari khokh'ad shud va gufta meshavad: <<Sitoishu sipos makhsusi Allokh' taolo Parvardigori ch'akh'oniion ast>>
Kh'o, mim
Nuzuli [in] kitob az suii Allokh'i shikastnopaziri donost
[Parvardigore, ki] Omurzandai gunokh' va tavbapazir, sakhtkaifar va ne'matbakhsh ast. Kh'ech' ma'bude ba [kh'ak'] ch'uz U nest va bozgasht [-i kh'ama] ba suii Ust
Tankh'o kofiron kh'astand, ki dar borai oioti ilokh'i much'odala mekunand, pas, mabodo raftuomadashon dar shakh'rkh'o [baroi tich'oratu bakh'ramandiashon az ne'matkh'oi dunio] turo bifirebad

Pesh az onon k'avmi Nukh' va pas az onon niz gurukh'kh'oi digare [kh'amchun k'avmi Od va Samud va Lut niz paiombaronashonro] durug'gu shumurdand va kh'ar k'avme khost paiombarashro dastgir kunad [va ba k'atl birasonad]. Onon ba botil much'odala kardand, to bad-on vasila kh'ak'ro az miion bardorand. Man niz ononro azob kardam. [Pas, bingared, ki] azobi Man chi guna bud
Va farmoni azobi Parvardigorat dar borai kofiron inchunin ba takh'ak'k'uk' paivast, ki onon akh'li otashand

Farishtagone, ki Arshro kh'aml mekunand va onon, ki girdi on kh'alk'a zadaand, Parvardigorashonro ba poki mesitoiand va ba U imon dorand va [in guna] baroi akh'li imon omurzish mekhokh'and: <<Parvadigoro, rakh'mat va donishat kh'ar chizero faro giriftaast, pas, kasonero, ki tavba kardand va pairavi rokh'i Tu shudand, biiomurz va az azobi duzakh nigakh' dor>>
Parvardigoro, onon va padaron [va modaron] va kh'amsaronu farzandoni solekh'ashonro dar bog'kh'oi ch'ovidoni bikh'isht, ki va'da dodai, dokhil kun, ki be tardid, Tu shikastnopaziru kh'akimi
[Bor ilokh'o] Ononro az [kaifari] badikh'o kh'ifz kun va kh'ar kiro dar on ruz az [kaifari] badikh'o nigokh' dori, farogiriftai rakh'matat k'aror dodai. In kh'amon komiobii buzurg ast>>

Va kofironro [dar duzakh] nido medikh'and, ki: <<Dushmani va khashmi Allokh' taolo sakhttar az dushmani va khashmi shumo nisbat ba khudaton ast, charo ki ba imon da'vat meshuded, vale [bo dushmani nisbat ba khud ak'idai tavkh'idro] inkor mekarded>>
Onon [dar posukh] meguiand: <<Parvardigoro, moro du bor mirondi va du bor zinda kardi, pas, [aknun ki] ba gunokh'oni khud e'tirof kardem, oio rokh'e baroi khuruch' [az duzakh] vuch'ud dorad>>?

[Ba onon gufta meshavad] <<In [azob] bad-on sabab ast, ki chun Allokh' taolo ba iaktoi khonda meshud, inkor mekarded, vale agar ba U shirk ovarda meshud, imon meovarded. [Aknun] Dovari az oni Allokh'i balandmartabai buzurg ast>>

Ust, ki nishonakh'oi [tavon va tadbiri] khudro ba shumo iroa medikh'ad va baroiaton [bo nuzuli boron] az osmon ruzi mefiristad, vale tankh'o kasone pand megirand, ki [kholisona ba dargokh'i ilokh'i] tavba kunand
[Tankh'o] Allokh'ro bo khulusi e'tik'od bikhoned, kh'archand kofiron nokhushnud boshand
U doroi darach'oti rafe' va sokh'ibi Arsh ast va ba suii kh'ar iak az bandagonash, ki bikhokh'ad, ba farmoni khesh vakh'i mefiristad, to [ba onon] dar borai ruzi mulok'ot kh'ushdor dikh'ad

On ruz, ki mardum kh'ozir va namoion meshavand va chize az onon bar Allokh' taolo pushida nakhokh'ad mond [Allokh' taolo mefarmoiad]: <<Imruz farmonravoi az oni kist>>? [On gokh' khud mefarmoiad] <<Az oni Allokh'i iagonai piruzmand>>
Imruz kh'ar kas dar barobari on chi kardaast, podosh doda meshavad va kh'ech' sitame dar miion nest. Be gumon, Allokh' taolo dar kh'isobrasi sare' ast

Ba onon dar mavridi ruzi k'iiomat [ki bisior nazdik ast] kh'ushdor bidekh', on gokh' ki [az shiddati vakh'shat] ch'onkh'o ba gulugokh' merasad, dar kh'ole ki sarshor az andukh' shudaand. [Dar on ruz] Sitamgaron na dusti mekh'rubone dorand va na shafe'e, ki sukhanash pazirufta shavad
[Allokh' taolo] Kh'arakoti badi chashmkh'o va on chiro, ki dar dilkh'oi afrod nukh'ufta ast, [ba khubi] medonad
Allokh' taolo ba adolat dovari mekunad va ma'budone, ki [mushrikon] ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo ibodat mekunand, kh'ech' guna dovari nadorand. Ba rosti, ki Allokh' taolo shunavovu binost

Oio mushrikon dar zamin gardish nakardaand, to bubinand saranch'omi kasone, ki pesh az onon budand, chi guna budaast? On ak'vomi guzashta nerumandtar az inkh'o budand va osoru binokh'oi beshtare dar zamin padid ovardand, ammo Allokh' taolo ononro ba [sababi] gunokh'onashon azob kard, dar kh'ole ki dar barobari [azobi] Allokh' taolo kh'ech' [ior va] mudofe'e nadoshtand
In [kaifar] bad-on sabab bud, ki Paiombarashon nishonakh'oi ravshan baroiashon iroa mekardand, vale onon inkor mevarzidand va Allokh' taolo niz azobashon kard. Be gumon, U tavonmandi sakhtkaifar ast
Mo Musoro bo mu'ch'izoti khud va daleli k'ote' firistodem
Ba suii Fir'avn va Kh'omon va K'orun, vale [onon] guftand: <<[U] Ch'odugare durug'gust>>

Ammo kh'angome ki Muso mu'ch'izoti ilokh'i va daloili makh'kamro az ch'onibi Mo bar onon nishondod, [Fir'avn va ioronash sarkashi kardand va] guftand: <<Pisaroni kasonero, ki ba Muso imon ovardaand, bikushed va zanonashonro [baroi kanizi] zinda nigokh' dored>>, vale nairangi kofiron makh'kum ba fanost

Fir'avn guft: <<Biguzored, to Musoro bikusham va [chun kasero nadorad] noguzir ast Parvardigorashro ba iori bikhonad [va man az vai kh'arose nadoram]. Metarsam, ki u dinatonro digargun sozad io dar in sarzamin tabokh'i ba bor ovarad>>
Muso guft: <<Man az [sharri] kh'ar mutakabbire, ki ba ruzi kh'isob bovar nadorad, ba Parvardigori khesh va Parvardigori shumo panokh' mebaram>>

Va mardi mu'mine az khonavodai Fir'avn, ki imonashro pinkh'on medosht, guft: <<Oio mekhokh'ed in mardro [fak'at ba khotiri in ch'urm] bikushed, ki meguiad: <<Parvardigoram Allokh' taolo ast>> va [dar ta'iidi sukhanash niz] daloili ravshane az suii Parvardigraton baroi shumo ovardaast? Agar durug'gu boshad, [gunokh'i] durug'ash bar ukh'dai khudi ust va agar rost gufta boshad, [dasti kam] barkhe az azobkh'oe, ki va'da medikh'ad, ba shumo khokh'ad rasid

Be tardid, Allokh' taolo kasero, ki isrofkoru durug'gust, kh'idoiat namekunad. Ei k'avmi man, imruz farmonravoi dar ikhtiiori shumost va dar in sarzamin sulta dored, vale agar sakhtgirii Allokh' taolo domangiramon shavad, chi kase moro iori khokh'ad kard>>? Fir'avn guft: <<Man fak'at on chiro salokh' medonam, meguiam va shumoro ba rokh'i rost kh'idoiat mekunam>>
On mardi mu'min guft: <<Ei k'avmi man, metarsam azobe kh'amchun azobi ak'vomi peshin [ki az paiombaronashon sarpechi kardand] bar saraton biioiad
Monandi shevai [azobi] k'avmi Nukh' va Odu Samud va kasone ki ba'd az onon budand, dar kh'ole Allokh' taolo sitame baroi bandagonash namekhokh'ad
Va ei k'avmi man, bar shumo az ruze metarsam, ki mardum ba fariod az iakdigar iori mekhokh'and

[Kh'amon] Ruze, ki kh'amagi [az tars] ba ak'ib boz megarded va dar barobari [much'ozoti] Allokh' taolo kh'ech' mukh'ofize nadored va kh'ar kiro Allokh' taolo gumrokh' kunad, kh'ech' kh'idoiatgare nakhokh'ad dosht

Pesh az in niz Iusuf bo daloili ravshan nazdaton omad, ammo shumo az on chi baroiaton ovarda bud, paivasta dar shak buded, to zamone, ki az dunio raft [va bar tardidaton afzuda shud]. On gokh' gufted: <<Allokh' taolo kh'argiz pas az vai paiombarero mab'us nakhokh'ad kard>>. Allokh' taolo isrofkori badgumonro in guna gumrokh' mesozad

Kasone, ki dar mavridi oioti ilokh'i, be on ki dalele doshta boshad, ba much'odala barmekhezad, [raftorashon] nazdi Allokh' taolo va mu'minin sakht nopisand ast. Allokh' taolo in guna bar dili kh'ar mutakabbiri khudkoma mukh'r [-i g'aflat] mezanad
Fir'avn [ba vazirash] guft: <<Ei Kh'omon, baroi man binoi balande bisoz, shoiad ba rokh'kh'oe birasam

Rokh'kh'oe dar osmonkh'o [ki maro to Arshi ilokh'i bibarad], to ba ma'budi Muso bingaram [va az U ogokh' shavam], kh'archand, man k'at'an uro durug'gu mepindoram>>. Bad-in son zishtii kirdori Fir'avn [dar nazarsh] orosta gasht va az rokh' [-i kh'ak'] bozmond va nairangi Fir'avn ba ziion va tabokh'i anch'omid
On mardi mu'min guft: <<Ei k'avmi man, az man pairavi kuned, to shumoro ba rokh'i rost kh'idoiat kunam
Ei k'avmi man, in zindagii dunio bakh'rae [andak va zudguzar] ast va okhirat saroi ch'ovidon ast
Kh'ar ki kori bade murtakib shavad, ba tanosubi on kaifar khokh'ad did va mardon va zanoni mu'min va nekukor ba bikh'isht vorid meshavand va dar on ch'o az ne'mati beshumor barkhurdor khokh'and shud
Ei k'avmi man, chi shuda, ki man shumoro ba rokh'i nach'ot da'vat mekunam, vale shumo maro ba otash faro mekhoned?

Maro da'vat mekuned, ki Allokh'ro inkor kunam va chizero, ki [dar k'udrat] bo Allokh' taolo sharik gardonam, ki kh'ech' ittiloe az on nadoram, dar kh'ole ki man shumoro ba suii [Parvardigori] shikastnopazir va omurzgor faro mekhonam
Noguzir on chi maro bad-on da'vat mekuned, dar dunio va okhirat [tavoni ich'obati] duoero nadorad va bozgashti mo ba peshgokh'i Allokh' taolo ast va isrofkoron [dar kufru gunokh'] duzakhi kh'astand
Ba zudi sukhanoni maro ba iod khokh'ed ovard va man kori khudro ba Allokh' taolo voguzor mekunam, zero Allokh' taolo nisbat ba [kirdori] bandagon binost>>
Pas, Allokh' taolo uro az osebi dasisai onon kh'ifz namud va azobi sakht domangiri fir'avniion shud
Kh'amon otashe, ki [dar k'abrkh'oiashon] bomdodu shomgokh' bar on arza meshavand va ruze, ki k'iiomat barpo gardad [farmon merasad]: <<Fir'avniionro dar sakhttarin azob vorid kuned>>

On gokh' ki dar otashi duzakh kashmakash [much'odala] mekunand, mardumoni zerdast ba rokh'baroni gumrokh'gar meguiand: <<Mo pairavi shumo budem, oio mumkin ast bakhshe az azobi otashro az mo dur kuned?>>
Rokh'baroni gumrokh'gar meguiand: <<Be tardid, kh'amai mo dar otash khokh'em bud. Allokh' taolo miioni bandagonash dovari kardaast>>
Va kasone, ki dar otashand, ba nigakh'bononi duzakh meguiand: <<Az Parvardigoraton bikhokh'ed, ki baroi iak ruz in azobro az mo bardorad>>

Onon posukh medikh'and: <<Magar paiombaronaton nishonakh'oi ravshan bar shumo iroa nakardand>>? Duzakhiion meguiand: <<Bale>>. Va ma'muron meguiand: <<Pas, [be natich'a] darkhost kuned, ki darkhosti kofiron [mardudu] tabokh' ast>>
Be gumon, Mo paiombaroni khud va akh'li imonro dar zindagii dunio va ruze, ki guvokh'on [ba shakh'odat] barmekhezand, iori mekunem
Ruze, ki uzrkhokh'ii sitamgaron sude ba kh'olashon nakhokh'ad dosht. Onon az rakh'mati ilokh'i ba durand va dushvorii azobi okhiratro [dar pesh] dorand
Mo ba Muso [mak'omi] kh'idoiat bakhshidem va Bani Isroilro vorisoni Tavrot k'aror dodem
[Kitobe, ki] Baroi khiradmandon kh'idoiatu pand ast
Pas, [ei paiombar, bar ozori mushrikon] shikebo bosh, [ki] iak'inan, va'dai Allokh' taolo rost ast va baroi gunokh'at omurzish bikhokh' va Parvardigoratro shomgokh' va bomdod ba poki sitoish kun

Kasone, ki dar mavridi oioti ilokh'i, be on ki dalele dar ikhtiiorashon boshad, ba much'odala barmekhezand, dar dilkh'oiashon [g'ururu] takabburest, ki kh'argiz bad-on nakhokh'and rasid, pas, [az sharri eshon] ba Allokh' taolo panokh' bibar, ki ba rosti, U shunavovu binost
Musallaman, ofarinishi osmonkh'o va zamin buzurgtar az ofarinishi insonkh'ost [pas, barpo kardani k'iiomat baroi Allokh' taolo dushvor nest], vale beshtari mardum namedonand
Kh'argiz nobino va bino barobar nestand, va mu'minoni nakukor bo badkoron iakson nakhokh'and bud, [vale] iddai kame az shumo pand mepazired
Kh'ech' tardide dar in nest, ki ruzi k'iiomat faro merasad, vale beshtari mardum imon nameovarand
Parvardigoraton farmud: <<Maro bikhoned, to [duoi] shumoro ich'obat kunam. Kasone, ki az ibodati Man sarkashi mekunand, ba zudi bo khori ba ch'akh'annam vorid meshavand>>

Allokh' taolo ast, ki shabro baroiaton padid ovard, to dar on oromish iobed va ruzro ravshanibakhsh [k'aror dod, to ba talosh pardozed]. Ba rosti, Allokh' taolo nisbat ba mardum [lutfu] bakhshish dorad, vale beshtari mardum sipos nameguzorand
In ast Allokh' taolo Parvardigori shumo, [ki] ofarinandai kh'ar mavch'ude [ast]. Kh'ech' ma'bude [ba kh'ak'] ch'uz U nest, pas, chi guna [az parastishi U] munkh'arif meshaved?
Ba kh'amin surat kasone, ki oioti ilokh'iro inkor mekunand, niz [az kh'ak'] munkh'arif megardand

Allokh' taolo ast, ki zaminro k'arorgokh' va osmonro sarpanokh'aton muk'arrar dosht va shumoro shakle bakhshid va shaklkh'oiatonro zebo biofarid va az ne'matkh'oi pokiza ba shumo ruzi dod. In ast Allokh' taolo - Parvardigori shumo, pas, purbarakatu buzurgvor ast Allokh' taolo, ki Parvardigori ch'akh'oniion ast
Allokh' taolo zinda [va poianda] ast va ma'bude [ba kh'ak'] ch'uz U nest, pas, Uro bo khulusi e'tik'od bikhoned. Sitoish va sipos makhsusi Allokh' taolo-Parvardigori ch'akh'oniion ast

[Ei paiombar] Bigu: <<Man az parastishi afrode, ki shumo ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo [ba niioish] mekhoned, nakh'i shudaam, zero nishonakh'oi ravshane az ch'onibi Parvardigoram ba man rasidaast va farmon ioftaam, ki [tankh'o] dar barobari Parvardigori ch'akh'oniion taslim bosham>>

Ust, ki shumoro az khok va sipas [taii marokh'ili mukhtalif] az nutfa va on gokh' khuni basta [ch'anini ibtidoi] ofarid, sipas shumoro [ba surati] kudake [ba dunio] meovarad va imkon medikh'ad, to ba kh'addi rushd [va kamoli neru] birased. Sipas [solkh'o zindagi mekuned, to] solkhurda meshaved. Barkhe az shumo duchori margi zudras khokh'and shud va [ba gurukh'e digar imkon medikh'ad], to ba ach'ali muaiian birased, boshad, ki biandeshed
Ust, ki zinda mekunad va memironad va kh'angome ki chizero mekhokh'ad, tankh'o ba u meguiad: <<Mavch'ud shav>>, pas, [bedirang] mavch'ud meshavad
Oio nadidi kasone, ki dar borai oioti ilokh'i much'odala mekunand, chi guna [az rokh'i kh'ak'] munkh'arif megardand?
Kasone, ki kitobi [osmoni] va paiomi paiombaroni moro durug' shumurdand, ba zudi [natich'ai kirdorashonro] khokh'and donist
On gokh' ki g'ul va zanch'ir bar gardanashon k'aror girifta va kashida meshavand
[Ibtido] Dar obi ch'ushomada va sipas dar otashi duzakh afrukhta meshavand
On gokh' ba eshon gufta meshavad: <<Butkh'oe, ki shariki [Allokh' taolo] k'aror medoded, kuch'o kh'astand?

[Kh'amon ma'budone, ki] ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo [ibodat mekarded]. Onon guiand: <<Az [nazari] mo nopadid shudand, gui mo kh'argiz pesh az in chizero [ba parastish] namekhondem>>. In guna Allokh' taolo kofironro gumrokh' mekunad
In [azob] az on ch'ikh'at ast, ki ba nokh'ak' dar zamin shodmoni va sarmasti mekarded va fakhr mefurukhted
[Aknun] Az darkh'oi ch'akh'annm vorid shaved va ch'ovidona dar on ch'o bimoned. Va [ba rosti, ki] ch'oigokh'i mutakabbiron chi bad [ch'oigokh'e] ast!

[Ei paiombar, bar ozori mushrikon] Shikebo bosh, ki va'dai ilokh'i kh'ak' ast va agar barkhe az much'ozotkh'oero, ki ba onon va'da dodaem, [dar zindagi] ba tu binamoem io [pesh az nuzuli azob] ch'oni turo bigirem, dar kh'ar kh'ol ba peshgokh'i mo bozgardonda meshavand [va rokh'i gureze az azob nadorand]

Pesh az tu niz paiombarone firistodaem, ki [sarguzashti] barkhe az eshonro baroiat kh'ikoiat kardaem va barkhe digarro kh'ikoiat nakardaem va kh'ech' rasule nametavonist biduni farmoni ilokh'i mu'ch'izae iroa kunad va on gokh' ki farmoni Allokh' taolo [baroi podosh va kaifar] faro rasad, ba kh'ak' va adolat dovari khokh'ad shud va botilandeshon ziionkor khokh'and bud
Allokh' taolo ast, ki chakh'orpoionro baroiaton ofarid, to az barkhe baroi savori va az barkhe baroi tag'ziia istifoda kuned

Va baroi shumo dar onkh'o sudkh'oi digare niz kh'ast va niz baroi on ki savor bar onkh'o ba mak'sade, ki dar dil dored, birased va bar onkh'o va bar kishtikh'o [ba kh'ar ch'o ki mekhokh'ed] muntak'il meshaved
Allokh' taolo nishonakh'oi [k'udratu tadbiri] khudro ba shumo nishon medikh'ad, pas, kadom iak az nishonakh'oi ilokh'iro inkor mekuned?

Oio mushrikon dar zamin gardish nakardaand, to bubinand saranch'omi kasone, ki pesh az onon budand, chi guna budaast? On ak'vomi guzashta shumorashon az inkh'o afzuntar bud va osoru binokh'oi beshtare dar zamin padid ovarda budand, ammo [ kh'angomi nuzuli azob] dastovardashon sude ba kh'olashon nadosht

Kh'angome ki paiombaronashon bo nishonakh'oi ravshan ba surog'ashon omadand, ba donishu kordonii khud sarmast [va az tavkh'id ruigardon] shudand va kh'amon azobe, ki maskharaash mekardand, domangirashon shud
Pas, chun azobi Moro didand, guftand: <<Tankh'o ba Allokh' taolo imon ovardem va ma'budonero, ki shariki U k'aror doda budem, inkor mekunem>>

Ammo imon ovardanashon ba kh'angomi mushokh'idai azob kh'ech' sude nadosht. In sunnati ilokh'i [ki dar kh'angomi azob tavbai kase pazirufta namegardad, kh'amvora] dar mavridi bandagoni Allokh' taolo ch'ori budaast va dar in ch'o kofiron ziionkor shudand
Kh'o, mim
[In K'ur'on] Az sui Allokh'i bakhshandai mekh'rubon nozil shudaast
Kitobest, ki oiotash ba zaboni arabi baroi mardume, ki medonand, ba shevoi va ravshani baion shudaast
[Kitobe] Bashoratdikh'anda va bimdikh'anda ast, vale beshtari mardum ruigardonand va [kh'ak'oik'ro] nameshunavand

Mushrikon guftand: <<Dilkh'oi mo nisbat ba on chi moro da'vat mekuni, dar pushishe [az betafovuti] k'aror dorad va dar gushkh'oiamon sangini ast va miioni mo va tu fosila ast, pas, tu ba kori khud mashg'ul bosh va mo niz ba kori khud>>

[Ei paiombar, ba onon] bigu: <<Man fak'at bashare kh'amchun shumo kh'astam [bo in tafovut], ki ba man vakh'i meshavad: <<Ma'budi shumo ma'budest iagona, pas, ba U rui ovared va az U omurzish bikhokh'ed va voi ba kh'oli mushrikon!>>
Onon, ki zakot namepardozand va okhiratro inkor mekunand
[Vale] Mu'minoni nekukor podoshe bepoion dorand
Bigu: Oio on [Kholik'i tavonmand]- ero, ki zaminro dar du ruz ofarid, inkor mekuned va baroiash kh'amtoione k'oil meshaved? In [Ofaridgori iaktost, ki] Parvardigori ch'akh'oniion ast
U taii chakh'or ruz bar ruii zamin kukh'kh'oi ustuvorro padid ovard va dar on khairu barakati farovon nikh'od va rizk'u ruzii onro durust ba andozai niiozi tak'ozokunandagon muk'addar namud
On gokh' ba osmon pardokht, dar kh'ole ki [kh'anuz] ba surati gaz [dud] bud. Va ba osmonu zamin guft: <<Khokh'- nokhokh' az dari taslim daroed>>. On du guftand: <<Bo mail az dari taslim daromadem>>

Sipas on tudai gazro ba surati kh'aft osmon dar du ruz ofarid va ba kh'ar osmone barnomaashro vakh'i kard va osmoni dunioro bo charog'kh'oe [az sitoragon] orostem va [az sharri shaiotin] kh'ifz namudem. In ast tak'diri [Parvardigori] shikastnopaziri dono>>
[Ei paiombar] Agar onon [az pazirishi islom] rui gardonand, bigu: <<Ba shumo dar borai soik'ae naziri [on chi] k'avmi Odu Samud [-ro az poi darovard] kh'ushdor medikh'am>>

On gokh' ki paiombaroni ilokh'i paiopai ba surog'ashon meomadand, [bo in paiom] ki: <<Ch'uz Allokh'ro naparasted>>, onon [dar posukh] meguftand: <<Agar Parvardigoramon mekhost, [paiomi kh'idoiatgare bifiristad] farishtagone nozil mekard. Mo paiomero, ki shumo ma'muri [iblog'i] on kh'asted, bovar namekunem>>

Ammo [k'avmi] Od ba nokh'ak' dar zamin takabbur mevarzidand va meguftand: <<Chi kase nerumandtar az most>>? Oio namedonistand Allokh' taolo [on Kholik'i iakto]-e, ki ononro ofarida, nerumandtar az onon ast? Vale [bo sitezu gardankashi] oioti Moro inkor mekardand

Saranch'om tundbode sardu sakht dar ruzkh'oe shum ba onon firistodem, to azobi rasvoi [va sangin]-ro dar zindagii dunio ba onon bichashonem, vale azobi okhirat rasvokunandatar ast va [az kh'ech' su] iori nakhokh'and shud
Va ammo k'avmi Samudro niz kh'idoiat kardem, vale onon kurdiliro ba kh'idoiat tarch'ekh' dodand va ba [sazoi] dastovardashon soik'ai azobi khorkunanda ononro faro girift
Va kasonero, ki imon ovarda va [az gunokh'u nofarmoni] parvo mekardand, nach'ot dodem
[Ei paiombar, iod kun az] Ruze, ki dushmanoni Allokh'ro ba suii otashi duzakh ekh'zor mekunand va [az parokandagi] bozmedorand
To chun ba duzakh merasand, gushu chashmu pustashon a'molashonro guvokh'i medikh'and

Onon ba pusti khud meguiand: <<Charo alaikh'i mo guvokh'i doded>>? [Dar ch'avob] Meguiand: <<Allokh' taolo [kh'amon Kholik'i tavonmande], ki kh'ama mavch'udotro guio karda, moro niz ba sukhan darovardaast va Ust, ki nakhustin bor shumoro ofarid va [saranch'om kh'amagi] ba peshgokh'i U bozgardonda meshaved>>

Shumo, ki [gunokh'onatonro] pinkh'on namekarded, na az on bobat bud, ki tasavvur mekarded, gushu chashmu pustaton alaikh'i shumo guvokh'i namedikh'and, balki gumon mekarded, ki Allokh' taolo bar bisiore az a'mole, ki mekuned, ogokh' nest
In pindori shumo dar borai Parvardigoraton bud, ki much'ibi kh'alokati shumo gardid va [saranch'om] ziionkor shuded
Agar shikeboi va takh'ammul kunand [io nakunand], otash ch'oigokh'ashon ast va agar talabi rizoiiat kunand, pazirufta nakhokh'and shud

Mo kh'amnishinone [az shaiotin] bar onon gumoshtem, ki [korkh'oi] guzashta va [orzukh'oi] oiandaro dar nazarashon orostaand va [bad-in son] farmoni much'ozot dar mavridi onon takh'ak'k'uk' ioft va ba azobi ak'vomi gumrokh'e az ch'inu ins, ki pesh az onon budand, giriftor shudand. Be gumon, onon ziionkor budand
Kofiron [ki dar barobari kh'ak' och'iz gashta budand] guftand: <<Ba in K'ur'on gush nakuned va [kh'angomi tilovati] on ch'anch'ol kuned [va sukhanoni bekh'uda bigued], boshad, ki piruz garded>>
Pas, iak'inan, ba kofiron azobi sakhte mechashonem va ononro bar asosi [ch'azoi] badtarini korkh'oiashon kaifar medikh'em
In ast sazoi dushmanoni Allokh' taolo: otashe, ki dar on sukunati ch'ovidon dorand, ba kaifari on ki oioti Moro inkor mekardand

Kofiron [ba kh'angomi azob] meguiand: <<Parvardigoro, [afrode] az du gurukh': ch'in va insro, ki omili gumrokh'iiamon budand, ba mo nishon bidekh', ki lagadkubashon kunem, to az kh'ama zaliltar shavand>>

[Ammo] Kasone, ki guftand: <<Parvardigori mo Allokh' taolo ast>>, on gokh' [az bandagii g'airi U sar boz zadand va bar e'tik'odi khud] poi fishurdand, farishtagon bar onon furud meoiand [va meguiand]: <<Natarsed va andukh' nadoshta boshed va bashorat bod bar shumo on bikh'ishti mav'udaton!
Mo dar zindagii dunio va okhirat dustdori shumoem va dar bikh'isht kh'ar chi dilaton bikhokh'ad va darkhost kuned, dar ikhtiiori shumost
Ba unvoni paziroi az ch'onibi omurzgore mekh'rubon>>
Kist khushguftortar az on ki ba suii Allokh' taolo da'vat kunad va ba shoistagi amal menamoiad va meguiad: <<Taslim [-i avomiri ilokh'i] kh'astam>>?
[Kh'argiz] Neki va badi iakson nest. Kh'amvora ba shevae, ki bekh'tar ast, posukh bidekh', ki dar on surat kase, ki baini tu va u dushmanist, kh'amchun dusti mekh'rubon gardad
Tankh'o shikeboion va onon, ki bakh'rai buzurge [az imonu akhlok'] dorand, ba chunin mak'ome merasand
Va kh'ar gokh' az ch'onibi shaiton vasvasae turo faro girift, ba Allokh' taolo panokh' bibar, ki iak'inan, U shunavovu donost

Az nishonakh'oi [tavonu tadbiri] U shabu ruz va khurshedu mokh' ast. Dar barobari khurshedu mokh' sach'da nakuned, balki agar tankh'o Uro meparasted, bar Allokh' taolo, ki onkh'oro ofaridaast, sach'da kuned
Va agar [gurukh'kh'oe az niioishi U] takabbur varzand, [farishtagon va] muk'arraboni dargokh'i Parvardigorat shabu ruz biduni khastagi Uro ba poki mesitoiand

Az ch'umlai nishonakh'oi [k'udrati] ilokh'i in ast, ki zamini khushku farsudaro mebini, ki chun boron bar on furu merezem, ba ch'unbish darmeoiad va [giiokh'onash] rushd mekunad. On [Parvardigori tavonmande], ki zaminro zinda mekunad, murdagonro niz zinda khokh'ad kard. Ba rosti, ki U bar kh'ar kore tavonost

[Guftoru raftori] Kasone, ki dar mavridi oioti Mo kach'ravi [va onro takh'rif] mekunand, bar Mo pushida nakhokh'and bud. Oio kase, ki ba otashi [duzakh] meaftad, bekh'tar ast io on ki dar ruzi rastokhez emin [az azob] ast? Kh'ar chi mekhokh'ed, amal kuned, ki be tardid, Allokh' taolo ba on chi mekuned, binost
Kasone, ki in K'ur'onro, ki baroi [kh'idoiat] - ashon omadaast, inkor kardaand [dar k'iiomat azob khokh'and shud]. In [kalomi ilokh'i] kitobe ast shikastnopazir
Sukhani botil az peshu pas ba on rokh' nameiobad va az ch'onibi [Parvardigori] kh'akimi sutuda nozil shudaast
[Ei paiombar, kofiron] Ba tu kh'amon [sukhanoni botile] -ro meguiand, ki ba paiombaroni pesh az tu niz meguftand. Be gumon, Parvardigorat omurzish va [dar aini kh'ol] kaifare dardnok dorad

Agar K'ur'onro [ba zaboni] g'airiarabi nozil karda budem, kofiron meguftand: <<Charo oiotash [arabi nest va] ba ravshani baion nashudaast? Kitobe g'aioriarabivu paiombare arab>>? [Ei paiombar, ba onon] Bigu: <<In kitob baroi mu'minon moiai kh'idoiatu shifost va onon, ki imon nameovarand, dar gushkh'oiashon sangini ast va K'ur'on baroiashon nomafkh'um ast. [Guio] Ononro az rokh'i dur sado mezanand>>

Va ba rosti, [Mo] ba Muso kitob dodem, pas, dar on ikhtilof shud.Va agar peshtar [dar mavridi mukh'lat ba gunakh'goron va kh'isobrasi dar k'iiomat] sukhane az ch'onibi Parvardigorat baion nashuda bud, iak'inan, [dar kh'amin dunio] miionashon dovari meshud [va azob nozil megasht] va ba rosti, ki onon [iakh'udiion va mushrikon] dar borai [kh'ak'k'oniiati] in [K'ur'on] sakht dar tardidand
Kh'ar ki ba shoistagi amal kunad, ba sudi khudi ust va kh'ar ki badi kunad, ba ziioni khesh bad kardaast va Parvardigori tu kh'argiz ba bandagon sitam namekunad

Ogokh'i az [lakh'zai vuk'ui] k'iiomat tankh'o marbut ba Allokh' taolo ast va khuruch'i kh'ar mevae az shukufaash va bordorivu vaz'i kh'amli kh'ar moddae bo ogokh'ii Ust va on ruz, ki Allokh' taolo ba mushrikon nido medikh'ad, ki: <<Afrode, ki [dar k'udrat] shariki Man tasavvur mekarded, [va ba on tavassul mech'usted] kuch'o kh'astand>>? Onon meguiand: <<Aknun dar barobari tu e'tirof mekunem, ki kh'ech' iak az mo [ba durustii e'tik'odi mushrikonai khud] guvokh' nest>>
On chi dar guzashta [takiagokh'i khud] mekhondand, az nazarashon nopadid meshavad va darmeioband, ki [az otashi azobi ilokh'i] kh'ech' rokh'i gureze nakhokh'and dosht
Inson dar tamannoi khair khastanopazir ast, va [-le] agar badi ba u birasad, ma'iusu dilsard khokh'ad shud

Va agar pas az ranch'e, ki ba inson merasad, rakh'mate az ch'onibi khesh ba u birasonem, [mag'rurona] meguiad: <<In kh'ak'k'i man ast va gumon namekunam k'iiomat barpo shavad va agar [kh'am boshad va] ba suii Parvardigoram bozgardonda shavam, nazdi U [sarvatu podoshkh'oii] nekue khokh'am dosht>>. Musalaman, kofironro az amalkardashon ogokh' khokh'em sokht va azobe sakht ba onon mechashonem

Kh'ar gokh' ba inson ne'mate mebakhshem, [bo sarmasti] rui megardonad va mutakabbirona [az kh'ak'] dur meshavad va kh'angome ki ranch'e [kh'amchun fak'ru bemori] ba surog'ash meoiad, [ba dargokh'i ilokh'i] duo va darkhosti farovon dorad

[Ei paiombar, ba kofiron] Bigu: <<Ba man bigued, [agar K'ur'on] az ch'onibi Allokh' taolo [rasida] boshad va shumo inkorash kuned, kist gumrokh'tar az on ki [bo vuch'udi oshkor budani kh'ak'] dar sitezi bepoion ba on k'aror dorad?>>

[Dar in dunio va kh'angomai k'iiomat] nishonakh'oi [tavonu tadbiri] khudro dar ofok'i [ch'akh'on] va dar [vuch'udi] khudashon ba onon nishon khokh'em dod, to baroiashon ravshan shavad, ki K'ur'on kh'ak' ast. Oio kofi nest, ki Parvardigorat bar kh'ar chize guvokh' ast?
Ogokh' boshed, ki onon dar mavridi didori Parvardigorashon [dar k'iiomat] tardid dorand! [Va] Ogokh' boshed, ki Allokh' taolo bar kh'ar chize ikh'ota dorad!
Kh'o, mim
Ain, sin k'of
Allokh'i shikastnopaziri kh'akim bar tu va paiombaroni pesh az tu chunin vakh'i mefiristad
Kh'ar chi dar osmonkh'o va zamin ast, mutaallik' ba Ust va U balandmartaba va buzurg ast

Nazdik ast osmonkh'o [az shukukh'u azamati ilokh'i] az farozi iakdigar bishkofand va farishtagon Parvardigorashonro bo sitoish tak'dis mekunand va baroi sokinoni zamin [ki tavba kardaand] omurzish metalaband. Ogokh' boshed, ki Allokh' taolo omurzandai mekh'rubon ast
[Ei paiombar] Allokh' khud murok'ibi [raftori] kasonest, ki g'airi Uro [dustu] korsozi khud barguzidaand va tu korguzor [va mas'uli raftor]-i onon nesti

Mo K'ur'onro in guna ba zaboni arabi bar tu vakh'i kardem, to akh'li Makka va sokinoni atrofashro bim dikh'i va ba onon dar mavridi ruzi makh'shar, ki tardide dar vuk'uash nest, kh'ushior dikh'i [On ruz] gurukh'e bikh'ishtiand va gurukh'e dar otashi suzon

Agar Allokh' taolo mekhost, kh'amai mardumro ummati vokh'id [va iaktoparast] k'aror medod, vale [ba inson ikhtiior dod, pas] kh'ar kiro bikhokh'ad, ba rakh'mati khesh darmeovarad; va mushrikon kh'ech' korsoz va iovare nakhokh'and dosht
Oio onon ba ch'oii U kasi [digarro ba unvoni dustu] korsoz barguzidaand? Kh'ol on ki korsoz [-i ch'akh'oniion] Allokh' taolo ast va Ust, ki murdagonro zinda mekunad va bar kh'ar kore tavonost
[Bigu: <<Ei mardum] Kh'ar ikhtilofe baini shumost, dovariash bo Allokh' taolo ast. Chunin ast Allokh' taolo Parvardigori man. Bar U tavakkal kardam va ba peshgokh'ash bozmeoiam>>

U ofarinandai osmonkh'o va zamin ast. Baroi shumo kh'amsarone az [ch'insi] khudaton k'aror dod va az chakh'orpoion niz ch'uft ofarid, bad-in surat, te'dodi shumoro afzoish medikh'ad. Kh'ech' chiz kh'ammonandi Allokh' taolo nest va U shunavo va binost
Kalidi [ganch'inai] osmonkh'o va zamin dar ikhtiiori Ust. [Ne'matu] Ruziro bar kh'ar kas, ki bikhokh'ad, gusturda medorad va io tang megirad. Ba rosti, ki U bar kh'ar chize donost

Az din kh'amonro baroi shumo muk'arrar kard, ki ba Nukh' amr karda bud va niz on chi ba tu vakh'i kardem va on chi ba Ibrokh'im va Muso va Iso amr kardem, in ki: <<Dinro barpo nigokh' dored va dar mavridi on firk'a-firk'a nashaved [va ikhtilof navarzed]>>. [Pazirishi] Da'vati tu bar mushrikon garon omadaast.
