Allokh' taolo ast, ki kh'ar kasro bikhokh'ad [tavfik'i ibodat medikh'ad va] ba suii khesh barmeguzinad va kh'ar kiro [ki tavba kunad va ba dargokh'ash] boz oiad, ba suii khesh kh'idoiat khokh'ad kard

Kh'angome ki daloili makh'kami nubuvvati paiombar bar kofiron arza shud, onon az ruii bartarikhokh'i [va kh'asodat]-e ki bainashon bud, rokh'i tafrik'a tai namudand va agar farmoni Parvardigorat [dar mavridi mukh'lat va ta'khiri azob] to zamone muaiian az pesh muk'arrar nashuda bud, [be dirang] miionashon dovari meshud va ammo pas az kofiron [va ba daleli inkoru ikhtilofi onon] vorisoni kitob [Tavrot va Inch'il niz] dar mavridi K'ur'on sakht dar tardid va badgumoni kh'astand

[Ei paiombar, mardumro] ba suii in [oini ilokh'i] da'vat kun va chunon ki farmon ioftai, poidori kun va az kh'avaskh'oi onon pairavi nakun va bigu: <<Ba kh'amai kitobkh'oe, ki Allokh' taolo nozil kardaast imon doram va farmon ioftaam, ki dar barorbari shumo ba adolat raftor kunam. Allokh' taolo Parvardigori movu shumost. [natich'ai] a'moli mo baroi most va [natich'ai] a'moli shumo baroi shumo. Kh'ech' [dushmanivu] ch'idole baini movu shumo nest. Allokh' taolo kh'amai moro [dar k'iiomat] ch'am' khokh'ad kard va bozgashti [kh'ama] ba sui Ust>>

Kasone, ki pas az pazirishi umumi, dar borai [kh'ak'k'oniiati dini] Allokh' taolo dalel meovarand, mantik'ashon nazdi Parvardigorashon [botil va ] bepoia ast. Khashm [-i ilokh'i] girebongirashon meshavad va azobe sakht [dar pesh] dorand
Allokh' taolo ast, ki K'ur'on va mik'iosi adolatro ba kh'ak' nozil kardaast va tu chi medoni? Shoiad k'iiomat nazdik boshad

Kasone, ki k'iiomatro bovar nadorand, [bo tamaskhur va] ba shitob onro mekhokh'and. Va kasone, ki [ba ruzi ch'azo] bovar dorand va medonand, ki kh'ak' ast, az on dar kh'arosand. Ogokh' boshed! Onon, ki dar mavridi k'iiomat ch'adalu inkor mekunand, dar gumrokh'ii bepoione k'aror dorand
Allokh' taolo nisbat ba bandagonash borikbin [va mekh'rubon] ast. Ba kh'ar kas, ki bikhokh'ad, ruzi mebakhshad va U tavonoi shikastnopazir ast
Kase, ki kishti okhiratro bikhokh'ad, kishtashro barakat mebakhshem va kh'ar ki [tankh'o] kishti dunioro bikhokh'ad, dar ikhtiiorash k'aror medikh'em, vale dar okhirat bakh'rae nakhokh'ad dosht

Oio [mushrikon] ma'budone dorand, ki biduni ich'ozati Allokh' taolo [k'avonini] dine baroi onon muk'arrar kardaand? Agar kh'ukmi k'at'i [baroi mukh'lat dodan ba gunakh'koron] dar miion nabud, [be dirang] miionashon dovari meshud va sitamgoron azobe dardnok [dar pesh] dorand

[Dar ruzi k'iiomat] sitamgoronro az dastovardashon kh'aroson mebini va [khokh'i did, ki kaifari on korkh'o] domangirashon ast, vale mu'minoni nakukor dar bog'kh'oi bikh'ishtand, kh'ar chi bikhokh'and, nazdi Parvardigorashon dorand. Fazlu bakhshishi buzurg kh'amin ast

In kh'amon [fazilate] ast, ki Allokh' taolo ba bandagoni mu'min va nekukorash bashorat medikh'ad. [Ei paiombar] Bigu: <<Dar barobari in risolat, podoshe az shumo namekhokh'am, ch'uz [rioiai dusti va] mukh'abbati kheshovandi va kh'ar ki [dar in rosto] ik'domi nekue kunad, bar podoshash dar on [mavrid] meafzoem. Ba rosti, ki Allokh' taolo omurzgori k'adrshinos ast

Oio mushrikon meguiand: <<[Mukh'ammad] ba Allokh' taolo durug' nisbat dodaast>>? Agar Allokh' taolo bikhokh'ad, bar dili tu mekh'r menikh'ad, va [-le] Allokh' taolo botilro makh'v mekunad va kh'ak'ro bo sukhanoni [va tamkh'idoti] khesh ba kursi menishonad, ki U ba rozi dilkh'o donost
Ust, ki tavbai bandagonashro mepazirad va az badikh'o darmeguzarad va on chi mekuned, medonad
U [darkhosti] mu'minoni nekukorro mepazirad va az fazli khesh bar [podoshi] onon meafzoiad va kofiron azobe sakht dar pesh dorand
Agar Allokh' taolo ruzii [barkhe az] bandagonashro kushoish medod, dar zamin sitamu sarkashi mekardand, vale ba andozae, ki bikhokh'ad muk'arrar medorad, ki U ba [kh'oli] bandagonash ogokh' va binost
Ust, ki boronro pas az navmedi [-i mardum] mefiristad va rakh'mati kheshro megustarad va U korsozu sutuda ast
Az nishonakh'oi [tavonu tadbiri] U ofarinishi osmonkh'o va zaminu mavch'udoti zindaest, ki dar onkh'o parokanda kardaast va kh'ar gokh' iroda kunad, bar ch'am'ovarii onkh'o niz tavonost
Kh'ar musibate, ki ba shumo rasad, ba khotiri korkh'oest, ki anch'om dodaed va [Allokh' taolo] az bisiore [az gunokh'onaton] guzasht mekunad
Shumo kh'argiz dar zamin [va osmon Allokh'ro] ba tang nameovared va dar barobari Allokh' taolo khech' korsozu iovare nakhokh'ed dosht
Az nishonakh'oi [tavonu tadbiri] ilokh'i, kishtikh'oi kukh'paikarest, ki dar dariokh'o ravonand
Agar Allokh' taolo bikhokh'ad, bodro sokin megardonad, to [kishtikh'o] bar pakh'nai dario bekh'arakat bimonand. Ba rosti, dar in [amr] baroi kh'ar shikeboi siposguzor nishonakh'oest
Io [agar bikhokh'ad sarnishinoni] on kishtikh'oro ba kaifari a'molashon nobud mesozad, dar kh'ole ki U az bisiore [az gunokh'on] guzasht mekunad
[To much'ibi ibrat boshad] Va kasone, ki dar mavridi oioti Mo ba much'odala barmekhezand, bidonand, ki [agar azobi ilokh'i faro rasad] rokh'i gureze nakhokh'and dosht
[Ei mardum] On chi ba shumo doda shudaast, ne'matkh'oi [guzaroi] duniost va on chi nazdi Allokh' taolo ast, baroi mu'minone, ki bar Parvardigorashon tavakkal mekunand, bekh'tar va poiandtar ast
Va [niz baroi] onon, ki az gunokh'oni buzurgu besharmikh'o kanora megirand va ongokh', ki khashmgin meshavand, guzasht mekunand
Va onon, ki [da'vati] Parvardigorashonro paziro meshavand va namoz barpo medorand va umurashon dar miionashon ba mashvarat nikh'oda meshavad va az on chi ruziiashon kardaem, infok' mekunand
Va kasone, ki kh'ar gokh' sitame ba onon birasad, [ba difo' va] intik'om barmekhezand

Va ch'azoi kh'ar badi kaifare kh'ammonandi on badi ast [na beshtar], pas, kh'ar ki guzasht kunad va korro ba islokh' [va oshti] ovarad, podoshash bar ukh'dai Allokh' taolo ast. Be gumon, U sitamgoronro dust namedorad
Albatta, kasone, ki pas az sitame, ki didaand, intik'om megirand, kh'ech' [bozkhostu] sarzanishe bar onon nest
Rokh'i [bozkhostu] sarzanish tankh'o bar sitamgorone kushoda ast, ki ba nokh'ak' dar zamin bartarich'ui mekunand. Onon azobi dardnok [dar pesh] dorand
Ammo kh'ar ki shikeboi va guzasht kunad, nishon az k'udrati iroda [-i U] dorad

Kh'ar kiro Allokh' taolo gumrokh' kunad, pas, az Allokh' taolo kh'ech' [iovaru] korsoze nakhokh'ad dosht va [dar ruzi k'iiomat] sitamgoronro mebini, ki chun azobro mushokh'ida kunand, meguiand: <<Oio rokh'i bozgashte [ba dunio] kh'ast?>>

[Dar on ruz] Sitamgoronro mushokh'ida khokh'i kard, ki bar otash arza meshavand va dar kh'ole ki az [shiddati] khori furutan shudaand, bo tagi chashm menigarand va [dar on kh'ol] mu'minon meguiand: <<Ziionkoron [-i vok'ei] kasone kh'astand, ki [ba tama'i dunio] khud va khonavodakh'oiashonro dar k'iiomat ba ziion andokhtaand. Ogokh' boshed! Sitamgoron giriftori azobe poidorand
Va onon dar barobari Allokh' taolo korsoze nakhokh'and dosht, ki ioriashon kunad va kh'ar kiro Allokh' taolo gumrokh' kunad, rokh'e [baroi nach'ot] nakhokh'ad dosht
[Ei mardum] Pesh az on ki ruze faro rasad, ki bozgashte az ch'onibi Allokh' taolo nadorad, da'vati Parvardigoratonro bipazired. Dar on ruz na panokh'gokh'e khokh'ed dosht, na [fursate baroi] inkor

Pas [ei paiombar] agar [mushrikon az da'vati tu] rui megardonand [tavfik'ro az khud salb mekunand]. Mo turo nigakh'boni onon nafiristodem va tu vazifae ch'uz rasonidan [-i vakh'i] nadori va chun rakh'mate az ch'onibi khud ba inson bichashonem, bad-on sarmast meshavad va agar ba sazoi raftori guzashtai khud duchori musibate shavad, [ba ch'oii bedori nosiposi mekunad]. Ba rosti, ki inson bisior nosipos ast
Farmonravoii osmonkh'o va zamin az oni Allokh' taolo ast. U kh'ar chi bikhokh'ad, meofarinad, ba kh'ar ki bikhokh'ad, [farzandi] dukhtar mebakhshad va ba kh'ar ki bikhokh'ad, [farzandi] pisar
Io pisaru dukhtarro -kh'ar du bo kh'am medikh'ad va kh'ar kiro bikhokh'ad, nozo megardonad, ki U donoi tavonost

Darkhuri kh'ech' bashare nest, ki Allokh' taolo bo u sukhan biguiad, magar bo vakh'i io az farosui kh'ich'obe io [in ki Allokh' taolo] farishtae bifiristad, ki ba farmonash kh'ar chi bikhokh'ad, vakh'i kunad. Be tardid, U balandmartabai kh'akim ast

[Ei Paiombar] bad-in guna K'ur'onro [tavassuti Ch'abrail va] ba farmoni khesh bar tu vakh'i kardem. [Pesh az on] Tu ogokh'i nadoshti, ki kitobu imon chist, vale Mo onro nure sokhtem, ki kh'ar kase az bandagoni kheshro, ki bikhokh'em, bad-on kh'idoiat kunem va musallaman, tu ba rokh'i rost [Islom] kh'idoiat mekuni
Rokh'i ilokh'i, ki on chi dar osmonkh'o va zamin ast, az oni Ust. Ogokh' boshed, [kh'amai] umur ba suii Allokh' taolo bozmegardad
Kh'o, mim
Savgand ba kitobi ravshangar
Mo onro K'ur'one ba zaboni arabi padid ovardem, boshad, ki khiradvarzi kuned
In kitob, ki balandmartaba va kh'ikmatomuz ast, dar Lavkhi makh'fuz nazdi Mo sabt shudaast [va dastkhushi tag'iir nakhokh'ad shud]
Oio ba sirfi in ki shumo [mushrikon] gurukh'e isrofkored [va paiomi ilokh'iro inkor mekuned, nuzuli] K'ur'onro az shumo bozdorem?
Chi bisior paiombarone, ki dar miioni peshiniion firistodem
Vale kh'ar paiombare ba suii onon meomad, maskharaash mekardand
Mo afrodi nerumandtar az mushrikoni Makkaro kh'alok kardaem va dostoni [ibratangezi] peshiniion guzasht
[Ei paiombar] Agar az mushrikon bipursi: <<Osmonkh'o va zaminro chi kase ofardiaast?>> Kh'atman, meguiand: <<[Allokh'i] Shikastnopaziri dono>>
Kh'amon [Parvardigore] ki zaminro makh'alli ozmoishi shumo k'aror dod va baroiaton dar on rokh'kh'oe padid ovard, to rokh' iobed

Va kh'amon kase, ki az osmon boronro ba mik'dori muaiiane firistod, on gokh' sarzamini khazonzada va khushkro ba vasilai on kh'aiot bakhshidem. Shumo niz kh'amin guna [az gurkh'o] berun ovarda meshaved
Parvardigore, ki tamomi makhluk'otro ofarid va baroiaton az kishtikh'o va chakh'orpoion vasilai savori padid ovard

To bar pushti onkh'o k'aror gired va on gokh' ki bar onkh'o k'aror girifted, ne'mati Parvardigoratonro iod kuned va bigued: <<Poku munazzakh' ast kase, ki in [vasila]-ro dar khidmati mo gumosht va mo khud tavoni in korro nadoshtem
Va mo ba peshgokh'i Parvardigoramon bozmegardem>>
Mushrikon az miioni bandagoni Allokh' taolo baroiash sakh'me [az farzand] k'aror dodand. Ba rosti, ki inson oshkoro nosipos ast
Oio [mepindored] Allokh' taolo az miioni ofaridagonash dukhtaronro intikhob karda va pisaronro ba shumo ikhtisos dodaast?

Ammo kh'ar gokh' ba iake az onon kh'amon chizero, ki bashorat dikh'and, ki baroi Allokh'i rakh'mon k'oil kh'astand [tavalludi dukhtar], dar kh'ole ki khashmi khudro furu mekhurad, chekh'raash [az andukh'] tira megardad
Oio kasero, ki dar zevar [va rokh'ati] parvarish meiobad va dar [kh'angomi] ch'idol [k'odir ba] baioni mak'sudash nest [ba Allokh' taolo nisbat medikh'ed]?

Mushrikon farishtagonro, ki bandagoni [Allokh'i] Rakh'monand, muannas [zan] pindoshtand. Oio ba kh'angomi ofarinishi onon kh'uzur doshtand? Sukhanonashon sabt megardad va [dar ruzi k'iiomat] bozkhost khokh'and shud
[Onon baroi tavch'ekh'i shirki khud] meguiand: <<Agar [Allokh'i] Rakh'mon mekhost, mo farishtagonro parastish namekardem>>. Onon dar mavridi in [sukhan] beittiloand va ch'uz sukhani durug' nameguiand
Oio pesh az K'ur'on kitobe ba onon dodaem, ki bad-on istidlol kunand?
Balki meguiand: <<Niiogonamon niz kh'amin oinro doshtand va mo [niz] rokh'i ononro dunbol mekunem>>

Pesh az tu niz kh'ar [paiombari] kh'ushdordikh'andaero ba kh'ar shakh're firistodem, sarvatmandoni sarkashi on shakh'r meguftand: <<Niiogonamon niz kh'amin oinro doshtand va mo [niz] rokh'i ononro dunbol mekunem>>

[Paiombarashon] Meguft: <<Agar oine kh'idoiatbakhshtar az on chi niiogonaton doshtand, ovarda bosham [boz kh'am az onon pairavi mekuned]? Onon [dar posukh] meguftand: <<[Ore] paiomero, ki ma'muri [iblog'i] on shudaed, inkor mekunem>>
Mo niz az onon intik'om giriftem, pas, bingar, ki saranch'omi takzibkunandagon chi guna bud
[Iod kun] Kh'angomero, ki Ibrokh'im ba padar va k'avmash guft: <<Az on chi shumo meparasted, bezoram
Magar az kase, ki maro ofaridaast, ki U kh'idoiatam khokh'ad kard>>
Ibrokh'im, iaktoparastiro dar miioni naslkh'oi pas az khud sukhane mondagor k'aror dod, boshad, ki [ba peshgokh'i ilokh'i] bozgardand
In mushrikoni Makka va padaronashonro [az ne'matkh'oi dunio] barkhurdor kardam, to in ki K'ur'on va paiombare ravshangar ba surog'ashon omad
Va on gokh' ki K'ur'on bar onon iroa shud, guftand: <<In ch'odust va onro inkor mekunem>>
Va guftand: <<Charo in K'ur'on bar marde buzurg az du shakh'r [Makka va Toif] nozil nashudaast?>>

Oio onon rakh'mati Parvardigoratro tak'sim mekunand? Moem, ki ruzi [va maishati] ononro dar zindagii dunio miionashon tak'sim kardaem va ononro nisbat ba kh'am ba darach'ote bartari bakhshidaem, to az khadamoti [mutak'obili] iakdigar istifoda kunand va rakh'mati Parvardigorat az amvole, ki ch'am' mekunand, bekh'tar ast

Agar [nigaroni az onon] nabud, ki kh'ama mardum [dar duniotalabi va inkori Allokh' taolo] iak gurukh' shavand, sak'fi khonai kasonero, ki ba Allokh'i rakh'mon imon nadorand, az nuk'ra k'aror medodem va niz pallakh'oe [dar on menikh'odem], ki bitavonand az [tabak'oti] on [khona] bolo ravand
Va baroi khonakh'oiashon darkh'oe [az tillo] meguzoshtem va takhtkh'oe [k'aror medodem], ki bar on takia zanand
Va tach'ammul [va zinatkh'oe] farovon [baroiashon farokh'am mekardem] va tamomi inkh'o bakh'rai [nochizi] zindagii duniost va okhirat nazdi Parvardigorat baroi parkh'ezkoron ast
Kh'ar ki az iodi [Allokh'i] rakh'mon dil bigardonad, shaitone bar u megumorem, to kh'amnishinash boshad [va kh'amvora firebash dikh'ad]
Shaiotin in gurukh'ro az rokh'i [Allokh' taolo] bozmedorand, vale onon gumon mekunand, ki kh'idoiat ioftaand
To on gokh' ki [dar k'iiomat] nazdi Mo biioiad, [ba shaitoni kh'amnishinash] meguiad: Ei kosh, miioni manu tu fosilae ba durii shark'u g'arb bud! Chi kh'amnishini bade budi!>>
[Allokh' taolo mefarmoiad] <<Imruz [pushaimoni] sude ba kh'olaton nakhokh'ad dosht; zero sitam kardaed va kh'amagi dar azob shariked>>
[Ei Paiombar] Oio metavoni [paiomi khudro] ba gushi noshunavoion birasoni io nobinoion va gumrokh'oni oshkorro [ba rokh'i rost] kh'idoiat kuni?
Agar kh'am turo pesh az azobi onon az dunio [bibarem] dar kh'ar kh'ol [az eshon intik'om khokh'em girift
Io azobero, ki ba onon va'da dodaem, [dar davroni kh'aiotat] ba tu menamoem. Be tardid, Mo bar onon ik'tidor [-i komil] dorem
Pas, ba on chi ba tu vakh'i meshavad, tamassuk bich'u, ki be gumon, bar rokh'i rost k'aror dori
Tardide nest, ki K'ur'on baroi tu va k'avmat moiai andarz [ va sarbalandi] ast va [dar ruzi k'iiomat dar borai imonu amal ba on] bozkhost khokh'ed shud
Az paiombarone, ki pesh az tu firistodem, bipurs, ki oio g'air az [Allokh'i] Rakh'mon ma'budone baroi parastish k'aror dodaem [musallaman, chunin nest]
Mo Musoro bo mu'ch'izoti khesh ba sui Fir'avn va saroni k'avmash firistodem va ba onon guft: <<Man firistodai Parvardigori ch'akh'oniionam>>
Va chun oiot [va mu'ch'izoti] Moro bar onon iroa kard, kh'amagi ba onkh'o khandidand
Kh'ar mu'ch'izae ba onon iroa dodem, iake az digare buzurgtar bud va [chun kh'amaro takzib kardand] ba azob giriftorashon kardem, boshad, ki [az kufr] bozgardand

[Pas, kh'angome ki gushakh'oe az azobi ilokh'iro chashidand] guftand: <<Ei ch'odugar, az Parvardigorat binobar akh'de, ki bo tu dorad, bikhokh' [to azobro az mo dur kunad], ki mo [digar] rokh'ioftaem>>
Va chun azobro az onon bardoshtem, paimon shikastand

Fir'avn dar miioni k'avmi khud nido sar dod va guft: <<Ei k'avmi man, oio farmonravoii Misr dar ikhtiiori man nest va in nakh'rkh'o az domanai k'asri man ch'araion nadorad? Oio [k'udratu azamatamro] namebined?
Man az in mardi bemik'dor, ki [kh'atto] nametavonad ba ravshani sukhan biguiad, shoistataram
Charo [ba nishonai sarvari] dastbandkh'oi zarin [az osmon] bar u afkanda nashudaast [to sobit shavad, ki paiombar ast]? Io charo farishtagon kh'amrokh'ash naiomadaand?>>
U k'avmi khudro ba [bekhiradi va] sabuksari kashond va kh'amagi muteash shudand. Kh'ak'k'o, ki onon [nisbat ba avomiri ilokh'i] nofarmon budand
Pas, chun moro ba khashm ovardand, az onon intik'om giriftem va kh'amagiro [dar dario] g'ark' kardem
On gokh' ononro dar shumori peshgomoni [kufru nofarmoni] va ibrate [baroi oiandagon] k'aror dodem
Va chun dostoni [tavalludi] pisari Mariam matrakh' shud, k'avmi tu [ki gumon kardand, metavonand monandi masekh'iion chand ma'bud doshta boshand] ba nogokh' shodi va kh'aiokh'u ba rokh' andokhtand
Va guftand: <<Ma'budoni mo bekh'tarand io Iso>>? Onon in sukhanro tankh'o baroi ch'idol bo tu unvon kardaand. Ba rosti, ki gurukh'e sitezach'u kh'astand
Iso fak'at bandaest, ki bar u ne'mat [-i risolat] arzoni doshtem va uro namunae [az k'udrati ilokh'i] baroi Bani Isroil k'aror dodem
Agar mekhostem, [kh'amai shumo insonkh'oro nobud mekardem va] ba ch'oiaton farishtagone padid meovardem, ki dar zamin ch'onishin [-i shumo] shavand
[Tavalludi] Iso [ba mu'ch'izai kh'aiot bakhshidanash] dalele baroi k'iiomat ast. Pas, kh'argiz dar mavridi k'iiomat shak nakuned va pairavi man boshed, ki rokh'i rost kh'amin ast
[Ogokh' boshed, ki] Shaiton shumoro [az rokh'i Allokh' taolo] boznadorad, charo ki u dushmani oshkori shumost

Va chun Iso [mu'ch'izotu] nishonakh'oi ravshan bar onon iroa kard, guft: <<Man baroi shumo kh'ikmat ovardaam, to [bad-on rokh' iobed] va barkhe az mavoridi ikhtilofatonro ravshan kunam, pas, az Allokh' taolo parvo kuned va mute'i [dasturkh'oi] man boshed
Allokh' taolo Parvardigori man va shumost, pas, Uro biparasted, ki rokh'i rost kh'amin ast>>
On gokh' gurukh'kh'oi [mukhtalifi] Bani Isroil miioni khud [dar borai Iso] duchori ikhtilof shudand, pas, voi bar sitamgoron az azobi ruzi dardnok!
Oio ch'uz in intizor dorand, ki k'iiomat, dar kh'ole ki g'ofiland, nogakh'on bar onon faro rasad?
Duston [-i dunioi] dar on ruz dushmani iakdigarand, magar parkh'ezkoron
[Allokh' taolo ba onon mefarmoiad] <<Ei bandagoni [parkh'ezkori] Man imruz tarsu andukh'e nakhokh'ed dosht
Kh'amon bandagone, ki ba oioti Mo imon ovardaand va taslim [-i farmoni Mo] budand
Shumo va digar mu'minone, ki kh'amchun shumo kh'astand, ba bikh'isht daroed, to [az ne'matkh'oi ch'ovidonash bakh'ramand garded va] shodmon shaved
Zarfkh'o va ch'omkh'oi zarin peromunashon megardonand va kh'ar chi dilkh'o bikhokh'ad va didakh'o lazzat barad, dar on ch'o kh'ast va shumo dar bikh'isht ch'ovidonaed
In kh'amon bikh'ishtest, ki dar barorbari raftoraton ba shumo dodaand
Dar onch'o mevakh'oi farovone dar ikhtiior dored, ki az onkh'o mekhured
Be tardid, much'rimon dar azobi duzakh ch'ovidonand
[Dar kh'ole ki azob] az onon kosta nameshavad va dar ia'su noumedi furu raftaand
Mo ba onon sitam nakardaem, balki onkh'o khud ba kheshtan sitam mekardand
[Duzakhiion] Nigakh'boni otashro sado mezanand va fariod bar meorand: <<Ei Molik [kosh] Parvardigorat kori moro iaksara kunad [va bimironad]>> U meguiad: <<Na, shumo [dar in azob] mondagored>>
Ba rosti, kh'ak'ro baroi shumo ovardem, vale beshtaraton az on karokh'at doshted
Onon azmi [khudro baroi tavtea alaikh'i tu] ch'azm kardand, Mo niz irodai mukh'kame [bar nokom guzoshtani eshon] dorem
Oio mepindorand, ki Mo sukhanoni sirri va nach'voiashonro nameshunavem? Ore, farishtagoni Mo dar kanorashon [kh'astand va kh'ama chizro] sabt mekunand
[Ei paiombar, ba mushrikon] bigu: <<Agar [ba farzi makh'ol Allokh'i] Rakh'mon farzande dosht, man nakhustin parastishgar [-i U] budam>>
[Ma'budi iaktoe, ki] Parvardigori osmonkh'o va zamin va Arsh ast, az tavsifi [ch'okh'ilonai] onon munazzakh' ast
Pas, [ei paiombar] ononro [ba kh'oli khud] biguzor, to iovagui kunand va ba bozi sargarm boshand, to saranch'om bo ruzi mav'ud [k'iiomat] muvoch'ekh' shavand [va sazoi a'molashonro bubinand]
Ust, ki dar osmon va zamin ma'bud ast va U kh'akimi donost

Purbarakat va buzurgvor ast kase, ki farmonravoii osmonkh'ovu zamin va on chi miioni onkh'ost, az oni Ust va ogokh'i az [lakh'zai barpoii] rastokhez tankh'o dar ikhtiiori Ust va [kh'amagi] ba peshgokh'i U bozgardonda meshaved
Kasone, ki [mushrikon] ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo [ba niioish] mekhonand, k'odir ba shafoat nestand, magar afrode, ki ba [kalimai tavkh'id va] kh'ak' az rui ilm guvokh'i medikh'and
Agar az mushrikon bipursi, chi kase ononro ofaridaast, musallaman, meguiand: <<Allokh' taolo>>. Pas, chi guna [az kh'ak'] bar megardand?
[Shikoiat va] Sukhani paiombar [in bud]: <<Parvardigoro, inon k'avme kh'astand, ki imon nameovarand>>
Pas, [ei paiombar] az onon darguzar va [baroi rakh'oi az sharrashon] bigu: <<Salom bar Shumo>>! Ba zudi khokh'and donist [ki azobashon chi guna ast]
Kh'o, mim
Savgand ba kitobi ravshangar
Mo K'ur'onro dar shabi muborak [va farkhundai k'adr] nozil kardem, [zero] ki Mo [kh'amvora] kh'ushdordikh'anda budaem
Dar on [shab] kh'ar amri mukh'imme faisala meiobad [va tadbir meshavad]
[In] korest [ki] az ch'onibi Mo [surat megirad] be gumon, Mo firistandai [paiombaron] budaem
Ba unvoni rakh'mate az Parvardigorat. Be tardid, U shunavoi donost
Parvardigori osmonkh'ovu zamin va on chi miioni onkh'ost. Agar [ba in kh'ak'ik'at] iak'in dored [ba Allokh' taolo va Paiombarash imon biiovared]
Kh'ech' ma'bude [ba kh'ak'] ch'uz U nest, zindagi mebakhshad va memironad. Parvardigori shumo va niiogoni shumost
Vale mushrikon tardid dorand va sargarmi [lazzatkh'oi dunio] va bozi kh'astand
Pas, [ei paiombar] muntaziri ruze bosh, ki osmon, dude oshkor [padid] ovarad
Ki [tamomi] mardumro faro megirad. In azobe dardnok ast
[On gokh' kofiron meguiand] <<Parvardigoro, [in] azobro az mo bartaraf kun, ki imon ovardaem>>
Chi guna [va az kuch'o] pand mepazirand, dar kh'ole ki [peshtar] paiombari ravshangar ba suiashon omada bud?
Ammo az u rui gardonidand va guftand: <<[U] omuzishioftai devona ast>>
[Baroi ozmoishi shumo] Zamone andak azobro barmedorem, va [-le] shumo [ba kufri khesh] bozmegarded
Ruze sakht bar onon metozem. [Ore] Mo [az kofiron ba khotiri kufru takzibashon] intik'om megirem
Pesh az onon niz k'avmi Fir'avnro ozmudem va paiombari buzurgvor ba suiashon omad
[Va ba onon guft] Ki <<[kori Bani Isroil in] bandagoni Allokh'ro ba man voguzored, ki man baroi shumo paiombari aminam
Va [niz] bar Allokh' taolo bartari mach'ued, ki man baroiaton daleli ravshane ovardaam
Va az in ki sangsoram kuned, ba Parvardigori khud va Parvardigori shumo panokh' mebaram
Agar ba man imon nameovared, pas, az man kanora bigired [va rakh'oiam kuned]
On gokh' ba dargokh'i Parvardigorash duo kard, ki: <<[Bor ilokh'o] Inon gurukh'e tabokh'korand>>
[Ba Muso vakh'i kardem, ki] <<Bandagonamro shabona [az Misr] berun bibar, zero [sipokh'i Fir'avn] shumoro ta'k'ib khokh'ad kard
Va darioro orom pushti sar biguzor, ki onon sipokh'e kh'astand ki g'ark' khokh'and shud
Chi bisior bog'kh'ovu chashmasorkh'oro, ki rakh'o kardand [va raftand]
Va kishtzorkh'ovu k'asrkh'oi naku [va zebo]
Va ne'mate, ki dar on [shodmon] budand
[Sarnavishtashon] In guna [bud] va [tamomii] on ne'matkh'oro ba gurukh'e digar voguzoshtem
Osmonu zamin bar [nobudii] onon k'atrai ashke narekht va mukh'late [baroi tavba] niz naioftand
Be tardid, Bani Isroilro az azobi khorkunanda nach'ot dodem
Az Fir'avn, ki [rokh'bari] sarkashe dar zumrai isrofkoron bud
Mo bo donishi Khud Bani Isroilro bar mardumi zamona bartari dodem
Va nishonakh'oe [az k'udrati khesh] dar ikhtiiorashon guzoshtem, ki ozmoishe ravshan dar on bud
In mushrikon meguiand:
<<Ch'uz margi nakhustini mo kh'ech' [zindagii digare] nest va kh'argiz barangekhta nakhokh'em shud
Va agar rost megued, niiogonamonro [zinda kuned va] biiovared>>
Oio eshon bekh'tarand io k'avmi [nerumandi] Tubba' va peshiniioni onkh'o, ki chun bazakh'kor budand, kh'alokashon kardem?
Va Mo osmonu zamin va on chiro, ki miioni onkh'ost ba bozicha naiofaridaem
Onkh'oro ba kh'ak' [va bo kh'adaf] ofaridaem, vale beshtarashon namedonand
Be tardid, ruzi dovari [k'iiomat] va'dagokh'i kh'amai onon ast
Ruze, ki kh'ech' duste baroi dusti khud sudmand nest va [az kh'ech' su] iori nameshavand
Magar kase, ki Allokh' taolo [bar u] rakh'm kunad, ki U shikastnopaziri mekh'rubon ast
Be gumon, darakhti Zak'k'um
g'izoi gunakh'koron ast
[Mevaash az shiddati kh'arorat] kh'amchun misi gudokhta dar shikamkh'o mech'ushad
Monandi ch'ushishi obi garm [ch'ushidaistoda]
[Khitob merasad] <<On [sitamgor]-ro bigired va ba miioni duzakh darafkaned
On gokh' az azobi obi dog' bar sarash furu rezed>>
[Dar on kh'ol ba u gufta meshavad] <<Bichash, ki tu [dar miioni k'avmi khud] izzatmand va buzurgvori
In kh'amon [sarnavishti dardnoke] ast, ki dar mavridash tardid doshted>>
Iak'inan parkh'ezkoron dar ch'oigokh'i amne kh'astand
dar [miioni] bog'kh'o va [kanori] chashmasorkh'oi bikh'isht
Liboskh'oe az deboi nozuk va deboi zakhim mepushand, dar kh'ole ki ruiorui iakdigar [ba sukh'bat] nishastaand
Chunin ast [vaz'i onon] va kh'uriioni g'izolchashm [-i bikh'ishti]-ro ba kh'amsarii onon darmeovarem
Dar on ch'o kh'ar mevae, ki iroda kunand, be dag'dag'a dar ikhtiiorashon ast
Dar bikh'isht ta'mi margro nakhokh'and chashid, ch'uz kh'amon margi nakhustin va [Parvardigori mekh'rubon] az much'ozoti duzakh barkanorashon doshtaast
[In] Bakhshishest az [ch'onibi] Parvardigorat va in kh'amon komiobii buzurg ast
[Ei paiombar] Mo K'ur'onro ba zaboni tu ravon [va oson] sokhtem, boshad, ki [mushrikon] pand girand
Pas, dar intizori [va'dakh'oi ilokh'i] bosh, ki be gumon, onon [niz] muntazirand
Kh'o, mim
Nuzuli [in] kitob az ch'onibi Allokh'i shikastnopaziri kh'akim ast
Ba rosti, ki dar osmonkh'o va zamin nishonakh'oe [az k'udrati ilokh'i] baroi mu'minon [padidor] ast
Va [niz] dar ofarinishi khudaton va mavch'udoti zindae, ki [dar zamin] parokanda mesozad, baroi akh'li iak'in nishonakh'oe [az tavon va tadbiri Allokh' taolo oshkor] ast

Va dar gardishi paiopaii shabu ruz va rizk'e, ki Allokh' taolo [ba surati boron] az osmon mefiristad va bo on zaminro pas az khazon va khushkiash zinda mesozad va [niz] dar gardishi bodkh'o baroi khiradvarzon, nishonakh'oe [az k'udrati Parvardigor] ast
[Ei paiombar] Inkh'o oiot [va nishonakh'o]-i ilokh'ist, ki ba kh'ak' bar tu mekhonem [Ba rosti, mushrikon] pas az [sukhani] Allokh' taolo va oiotash kadom sukhanro bovar mekunand?
Voi bar kh'ar durug'gui gunakh'kor!
[On kofire] ki oioti ilokh'iro, ki bar u khonda meshavad, meshunavad, vale mutakabbirona bar mukholifat isror dorad. Gui onkh'oro nashunidaast. Pas, uro ba azobe dardnok bashorat bidekh'
[Kh'amon ki] chun bar gushae az oioti Mo vok'if shavad, onro ba maskhara megirad. Onon azobe sanginu dardnok [dar pesh] dorand

Peshopeshi eshon [dar okhirat] duzakh ast va dastovardashon va [iovaronu] korsozone, ki ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo barguzidaand, kh'ech' sude ba kh'olashon nakhokh'and dosht va azobe sakh'mgin [dar pesh] dorand
In [K'ur'on much'ibi] kh'idoiat ast va kasone, ki oioti Parvardigorashonro inkor mekunand, azobe az sakhttarin azobkh'oi dardnoki [duzakhro dar pesh] dorand
Allokh' taolo ast, ki dariokh'oro dar khidmati shumo gumosht, to kishtikh'o ba farmonash dar on ravon shavand va [shumo bitavoned] az fazli U [ruzi] bich'ued, boshad, ki sipos guzored
On chi dar osmonkh'o va zamin ast, az [rakh'mati] khesh dar khidmati shumo gumosht, ki dar in [amr] baroi andeshamandon nishonakh'oe [az lutf va k'udrati ilokh'i] ast

[Ei paiombar] ba mu'minon bigu: <<Az kasone, ki ba ruzkh'oi Allokh' taolo [ruzkh'oi piruzi bar kufru intik'om az mushrikon] umede nadorand, darguzarand, to [Allokh' taolo ba mavk'ei khud kh'ar] gurukh'ero dar barobari on chi ki anch'om dodaand, sazo dikh'ad>>
Kh'ar ki kori shoistae anch'om dikh'ad, ba sudi khud va kh'ar ki kori bade kunad, ba ziioni khud kardaast. On gokh' [baroi mukh'osiba va ch'azo] ba peshgokh'i Parvardigoraton bozgardonida meshaved
Ba Bani Isroil Tavrot va [ilmu] dovari [baini mardum] va nubuvvat bakhshidem va az ne'matkh'oi pokiza ruziashon dodem va ononro [ba mavkh'ibati tavkh'id] bar mardumi zamona bartari bakhshidem

Va dar amri [bozshinosii kh'ak' az botil], oioti ravshane dar ikhtiiorashon k'aror dodem, vale onon ba daleli kh'asad va bartarikhokh'i, ki bainashon bud, ikhtilof varzidand va be tardid, Parvardigorat ruzi k'iiomat dar mavoridi ikhtilofashon miioni onon dovari khokh'ad kard
On gokh' turo bar ravishe [ravshan va komil] az amri [din] k'aror dodem, pas, pairavi kh'amon rokh' bosh va az kh'avaskh'oi nodonon pairavi nakun
Onon dar barobar [-i azob]-i Allokh' taolo baroi tu kh'ech' foidae nadorand. Sitamgoron [iovaru] korsozi iakdigarand va Allokh' taolo korsozi parkh'ezkoron ast
In [K'ur'on] moiai basirati mardum ast va kh'idoiatu rakh'matest baroi akh'li iak'in

Oio kasone, ki murtakibi korkh'oi noshoista shudand, pindoshtaand, ki kh'amtirozi mu'minoni nekukor k'arorashon medikh'em, ba gunae ki zindagi va margashon [bo onon] iakson boshad? Chi bad dovari mekunand!
Allokh' taolo osmonkh'o va zaminro [kh'adafmand va] ba kh'ak' ofarid, to [kh'ama ozmoish shavand] va ch'azoi dastovardkh'oi kh'ama [bandagon] doda shavad, biduni on ki zulme ba onon shavad

Oio on kasero didai, ki ogokh'ona kh'avoi nafsashro ba ch'oii ma'budi khud nishonda [va taslimi on shuda] ast? Allokh' taolo niz uro gumrokh' sokht va bar gushu dilash mukh'ri [g'aflat] nikh'od va bar didaash pardae kashid. [Agar Allokh' taolo kh'idoiatash nakunad] pas, az Allokh' taolo chi kase kh'idoiatash khokh'ad kard? Oio pand namegired?

[Mushrikon] meguiand: <<Ch'uz zindagii dunioi mo kh'ech' [khabare] nest. Zindagi mekunem va memirem va in gardishi ruzgor ast, ki moro ba komi marg mebarad>>. Onon dar mavridi in [amr] be ittiloand va fak'at az kh'adsu gumon pairavi mekunand
Va chun oioti ravshangari Mo [dar mavridi k'iiomat] bar onon khonda meshavad, daleli [inkor]- ashon fak'at in ast, ki meguiand: <<Agar rost megued, niiogonamonro [zinda kuned va] bozgardoned>>

[Ei Paiombar, ba onon] bigu: <<Allokh' taolo ast, ki shumoro kh'aiot mebakhshad va marg medikh'ad. On gokh' shumoro dar ruzi k'iiomat, ki kh'ech' tardid dar on nest, ch'am' mekunad, vale beshtari mardum [in kh'ak'ik'atro] namedonand>>
Farmonravoii osmonkh'o va zamin az oni Allokh' taolo ast va ruze, ki k'iiomat barpo shavad, akh'li botil ziionkor khokh'and bud

[Dar on ruz] kh'ar gurukh'ero [az vakh'shati kh'isobu ch'azo khoru] ba zonudaromada mebini, kh'amaro baroi [giriftani] nomai a'molashon faro mekhonand [va ba onon khitob meshavad]: <<Imruz shumo dar barobari on chi kardaed, ch'azo mebined
In nomai [a'moli shumo nazdi] most, ki ba kh'ak' bar shumo guvokh'i medikh'ad. Mo [tamomi] amalkardatonro [dak'ik'an] sabt mekardem
Mu'minoni nekukorro Parvardigorashon farogiriftai rakh'mati khesh k'aror khokh'ad dod. In kh'amon komiobii oshkor ast
Vale [ba] kofiron [khitob meshavad]: <<Magar na in bud, ki dar barobari oioti Man, ki bar shumo arza meshud, gardankashi mekarded va gurukh'e bazakh'kor buded?

Va chun gufta meshud: <<Va'dai Allokh' taolo kh'ak' ast va [dar vuk'ui] k'iiomat kh'ech' tardide nest>>, megufted: Namedonem k'iiomat chist, fak'at tasavvure [dar] in mavrid] dorem, va [-le] ba iak'in narasidaem>>
Raftori zishtashon bar onon oshkor meshavad va azobe, ki maskharaash mekardand, domangirashon khokh'ad shud

[Ba onon] gufta meshavad: <<Imruz [dar azobi duzakh] rakh'oiaton mekunem, chunonki shumo [niz dar dunio nisbat] ba didori imruz bee'tino buded va ch'oigokh'aton otash ast va kh'ech' iovare nakhokh'ed dosht
In [giriftori] az on rust, ki oioti ilokh'iro maskhara mekarded va zindagii dunio firebaton doda bud>>. Imruz [kofironro] az otash berun nakhokh'and ovard va az onon darkhosti puzish nameshavad
Pas, sitoish makhsusi Allokh' taolo ast, Parvardigori osmonkh'o va zamin va tamomi ch'akh'oniion
Buzurgi dar osmonkh'o va zamin az oni Ust va U shikastnopaziri kh'akim ast
Kh'o, mim
Nuzuli [in] kitob az ch'onibi Allokh'i shikastnopaziri kh'akim ast
Osmonkh'o va zamin va on chiro, ki baini onkh'ost, ba kh'ak' [va kh'adafmand] va baroi muddati muaiiane ofaridaem, va [-le] kofiron az on chi ba eshon kh'ushdor shuda, ruigardonand

[Ei paiombar, ba mushrikon] bigu: <<Oio ba butkh'oe, ki ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo [ba niioish] mekhoned, tavach'ch'ukh' kardaed? Ba man nishon dikh'ed, chi chiz az [ach'zoi] zaminro ofaridaand. Oio dar [ofarinishi] osmonkh'o shirkat doshtaand? Agar rost megued, az kitobkh'oi osmonii peshin io bozmondae az donish [-i guzashtagon dalel] biiovared>>
Kist gumrokh'tar az on ki ba ch'oii Allokh' taolo afrodero [ba niioish] mekhonad, ki to ruzi k'iiomat niz posukhashro namedikh'and va az darkhostashon bekhabarand?
Va chun [dar k'iiomat] mardum ekh'zor shavand, on ma'budon [-i botil] dushmanonashon khokh'and bud va ibodatashonro inkor khokh'and kard
Va chun oioti ravshangari Mo bar kofiron khonda meshud, onon dar mavridi sukhani kh'ak'k'e, ki bad-eshon rasidaast, meguiand: <<In ch'odue oshkor ast>>

Io meguiand: <<[Mukh'ammad] K'ur'onro khud ch'a'l karda [va ba Allokh' taolo nisbat doda] ast>>. [Ei paiombar, ba onon] Bigu: <<Agar man onro ch'a'l karda [va ba Allokh' taolo nisbat doda] bosham, pas, shumo nametavoned dar barobari [azob va khashmi] Allokh' taolo az man difo' kuned. Allokh' taolo ba on chi shumo dar boraash sukhanchini mekuned, ogokh'tar ast va ba unvoni guvokh' baini manu shumo kofist va U omurzgori mekh'rubon ast>>

Bigu: <<Man padidai navzukh'ur dar miioni paiombaron nestam va namedonam sarnavishti man va shumo chi khokh'ad shud, tankh'o az on chi ba man vakh'i meshavad, pairavi mekunam va fak'at kh'ushdordikh'andai oshkoram>>

Bigu: <<Ba man bigued, agar K'ur'on az suii Allokh' taolo [rasida] boshad va bo in ki shokh'ide az Bani Isroil mushobikh'atashro [bo Tavrot] guvokh'i doda va imon ovarda boshad va Shumo dar barobarash inkor va takabbur kuned, [oio gumrokh' va sitamgar nested]? Be gumon, Allokh' taolo sitamgoronro kh'idoiat nakhokh'ad kard>>

Kofiron ba mu'minon meguiand: <<Agar K'ur'on shoistagi dosht, onon [ki bardagon va fak'irone nochizand] dar pazirishash bar mo sabk'at namegiriftand>>. Va chun bad-on kh'idoiat naioftaand, meguiand: <<In K'ur'on durug'i k'adimi ast>>

Dar kh'ole ki pesh az K'ur'on kitobi Muso rokh'namo va rakh'mat bud va in [K'ur'on] kitobest, ki [Tavrotro] ba zaboni [shevoi] arabi tasdik' mekunad, to ba sitamgoron kh'ushdor dikh'ad va baroi nekukoron bashorat boshad
Kasone, ki guftand: <<Parvardigori mo Allokh' taolo ast>>, on gokh' [az bandagii g'airi U sar boz zadand va bar e'tik'odi khud] poi fishurdand, tarsu andukh'e nakhokh'and dosht
Onon akh'li bikh'ishtand va ch'ovidona dar on ch'o khokh'and bud. In podoshi a'molest, ki anch'om dodaand

Ba inson suporish kardem, ki dar mavridi padaru modarash ba shoistagi neki kunad, [ba vizha] modar, ki ba dushvori bori kh'amli uro bar ukh'da dorad va bo dushvori vaz'i kh'aml mekunad va [davroni] bordori va shirkhoragiash [ch'am'an kh'ududi] si mokh' ast. [U parvarish meiobad] to ba kh'addi rushd birasad va dar chikh'ilsolagi [ki tavoni ch'ismi va zekh'niash komil ast] meguiad: <<Parvardigoro, ba man tavfik' bidekh', to shukri ne'matero, ki ba man va padaru modaram arzoni doshtai, ba ch'o ovaram va kori shoistae anch'om dikh'am, ki az on khushnud gardi va farzandonamro shoista gardon. Ba dargokh'at [tavba namuda va] bozgashtaam va taslimi [farmonat] kh'astam>>
Onon kasone kh'astand, ki Mo nekutarin korkh'oiashonro mepazirem va az gunokh'onashon meguzarem va dar zumrai akh'li bikh'ishtand. In va'dai rostest, ki ba on navid doda shudaand

Va on ki ba padaru modarash guft: <<Uf bar shumo! Chi guna ba man va'da medikh'ed ki [az gur] berun ovarda khokh'am shud, dar kh'ole ki pesh az man naslkh'oi farovone raftand [va boz nagashtand]?>> Padaru modarash ba dargokh'i ilokh'i zori mekunand [ki farzandashonro kh'idoiat kunad va ba u meguiand] <<Voi bar tu! Imon biiovar, ki va'dai ilokh'i rost ast>>, [ammo] u posukh medikh'ad: <<In [va'dakh'o] fak'at afsonakh'oi peshiniion ast>>
In afrod, dar zumrai gurukh'kh'oe az ch'innu ins kh'astand, ki peshtar farmoni azobi ilokh'i dar mavridashon takh'ak'k'uk' ioftaast. Be gumon, onon ziionkor budand

Kh'ar gurukh' [bikh'ishti io duzakhi] darach'ote bar kh'asbi a'molashon dorand [to kh'ak'k'e zoe' nagardad]. Va Allokh' taolo a'molashonro ba tamomii puragi medikh'ad, be on ki dar kh'ak'k'ashon sitame shavad

Ruze, ki kofiron bar otash arza meshavand [ba onon khitob meshavad]: <<Ne'matkh'oi pokizai khudro dar zindagii dunio az bain burded va az onkh'o bakh'ramand shuded, pas, imruz ba khotiri bartarich'uii nokh'ak' va inkh'irofe, ki dar zamin doshted, bo azobe dardnok much'ozot meshaved>>

[Ei paiombar, sarguzashti Kh'ud] barodari k'avmi Odro iod kun, on gokh' ki dar sarzamini <<Akh'k'of>> [regzore dar Iaman] k'avmashro kh'ushdor medod, dar kh'ole ki kh'ushdordikh'andagoni [digare niz] dar guzashtakh'oi nazdik va dur omada budand [va chunin meguft], ki: <<Tankh'o Allokh'ro biparasted, ki man az azobi ruzi buzurge bar shumo metarsam>>
Onon guftand: <<Oio omadai, ki moro az [parastishi] ma'budonamon bozgardoni? Agar rost megui, azobe, ki ba mo va'da medikh'i, pesh ovar>>
[Kh'ud] guft: <<[Vak'ti nuzuli azobro] Fak'at Allokh' taolo medonad va man paiomero, ki ma'mur [-i iblog']-i on shudaam, ba shumo merasonam, vale shumoro gurukh'e nodon mebinam>>

Va chun on [azob]-ro, ki ba surati abre dar ch'ikh'ati [dashtu] darrakh'o [-i kh'osilkhez]- ashon pesh meomad, mushokh'ida kardand, [bo shodmoni] guftand: <<In abrest, ki [rakh'mate] bar mo meborad>>. [Kh'ud guft: na] Balki kh'amon [azobe] ast, ki baroi rasidanash shitob doshted; tundbodest, ki azobe dardnok bo khud dorad

[Tufonest, ki] Kh'ar chizero ba farmoni Parvardigorash dar kh'am mekubad>>. On gokh' chunon [kh'alok] shudand, ki ch'uz khonakh'o [-i vairon]-i onon, asare ba chashm namekhurad. Mo gunakh'koronro in guna kaifar medikh'em

Ba k'avmi [munk'arizshudai] Od chunon sarvatu k'udrate doda budem, ki ba shumo [makkagiion kh'argiz] nadodaem va bo on ki ba onon niz chashmu gush va dil doda budem, ammo gushu chashm va dilkh'oiashon sude ba kh'olashon nadosht, zero oioti ilokh'iro inkor mekardand va [saranch'om] azobe, ki maskharaash mekardand, domangirashon shud

[Bisiore az mardumi] shakh'rkh'oi peromuni shumo [makkagiion]-ro kh'alok kardem, va [-le k'ablan] nishonakh'o [va daloili tavkh'id]-ro ba shaklkh'oi mukhtalif dar miion ovardem, boshad, ki [az kufru gumrokh'i] bozgardand

Pas, charo butkh'oe, ki [mushrikon ononro] baroi tak'arrub [ba Allokh' taolo] ma'budoni khud giriftaand, [ba kh'angomi balo] ioriashon nakardand? Balki az nazarashon nopadid shudand va [saranch'omi] durug'kh'ovu tukh'matkh'oiashon kh'amin bud

[Ei paiombar, ba iod ovar] kh'angome ki gurukh'e az ch'inro suii tu firistodem, ki K'ur'onro bishunavand, pas, chun nazdi paiombar kh'uzur ioftand, [ba iakdigar] guftand: <<Khomush boshed [to ba oioti K'ur'on gush faro dikh'em] va chun [tilovatash] ba poion rasid, nazdi k'avmi khud bozgashtand, to ba onon [dar mavridi avok'ibi sarpechi az farmoni kh'ak'] kh'ushdor dikh'and
Guftand: <<Ei k'avm, mo [oioti] kitobero shunidem, ki pas az Muso nozil shudaast va kitobkh'o [-i osmoni]-i pesh az khudro tasdik' mekunad va ba [suii] kh'ak'k'u rokh'i rost kh'idoiat menamoiad

Ei k'avm, [sukhanoni tavkh'idii] in da'vatgarro, ki ba suii Allokh' taolo faro mekhonad, bipazired va ba u imon ovared, to [Allokh' taolo] barkhe az gunokh'onatonro bibakhshad va shumoro az azobe dardnok dar amon bidorad

Va kh'ar ki [sukhanoni] da'vatgarero, ki ba suii Allokh' taolo faro mekhonad, napazirad [va ba vai imon naovarad, kh'argiz Allokh'ro] dar zamin ba tang nameovarad va dar barobari Allokh' taolo [iovar va] korsoze nakhokh'ad dosht. Chunin kasone dar gumrokh'ii oshkorand>>

Oio mushrikon nadidaand [va namedonand], Allokh' taolo, ki osmonkh'o va zaminro ofarid va az ofarinishi onkh'o darmonda nashud, k'odir ast, ki murdagonro niz zinda kunad? Ore, U bar kh'ar kore tavonost

Ruze, ki kofiron bar otash arza meshavand [az onon pursida meshavad]: <<Oio in otash kh'ak' nest [va kh'ak'ik'at nadorad]?>> Onon meguiand: <<Ore, savgand ba Parvardigoramon [ki chunin ast]>>. [On gokh' Allokh' taolo] Meguiad: <<Pas, ba sazoi on ki [k'iiomatro] inkor mekarded, azobro bichashed>>

Pas, [ei paiombar] tu niz kh'amchun paiombaroni ululazm [ki kh'amvora sobitk'adam budand, dar barobari ozoru takzibi k'avmat] shikebo bosh va dar mavridi [darkhosti azobi] onon shitob nakun. Ruze, ki [in kofiron] azobi mav'udashonro [dar ch'akh'oni okhirat] bubinand, [kaifarashon chunon tuloni ast, ki] gui fak'at bakhshe az ruzro [dar dunio] ba sar burdaand. In K'ur'on paiomi [umumi baroi ch'innu ins] ast. Oio ch'uz nofarmonon kh'alok meshavand?
Allokh' taolo taloshi kofironro, ki [mardumro] az rokh'i Allokh' taolo bozmedorand, tabokh' mekunad

Va onon, ki mu'min va nakukor budand va ba oioti kh'ak'k'e, ki az ch'onibi Parvardigorashon bar Mukh'ammad nozil shudaast, imon ovardaand, badikh'oiashonro mezudoiad va umur [-i dunio va din]-ashonro somon mebakhshad [va islokh' mekunad]
In [podosh va ch'azo] bad-on sabab ast, ki kofiron pairavi botil shudand va mu'minon pairavi [oioti] kh'ak'k'i Parvardigorashon. Allokh' taolo baroi mardum masalkh'oiashonro chunin baion mekunad

Chun bo kofiron ru ba ru shuded, ononro gardan bizaned, to on ki [bisiore az ononro] bikushed, on gokh' asironro ba band kashed, sipas io bar onon minnat guzored [va biduni kh'ech' chashmdoshte ozodashon kuned] io [az onon] fidia bigired [va rakh'oiashon kuned], to sanginii ch'ang furukash kunad. In [kh'ukmi ilokh'i] ast va agar Allokh' taolo mekhost, khud az onon intik'om megirift, vale [farmoni ch'ang dod] to shumoro barobari iakdigar ozmoish kunad va kasone, ki dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo kushta shudand, [Allokh' taolo kh'argiz] natich'ai taloshashonro tabokh' namekunad
Allokh' taolo [ba rokh'i rost] kh'idoiatashon khokh'ad kard va umurashonro somon khokh'ad bakhshid
va ononro ba bikh'ishte, ki [avsofashro] baroiashon baion kardaast, vorid khokh'ad namud
Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, agar [dinu paiombari] Allokh'ro iori kuned, u niz shumoro iori mekunad va gomkh'oiatonro [sobitu] ustuvor medorad
Va bar kofiron nagunsori va kh'alok bod! Allokh' taolo a'molashonro tabokh' megardonad
Zero on chiro, ki Allokh' taolo nozil kardaast, khush nadoshtand, pas, Allokh' taolo niz a'molashonro tabokh' namud.

Oio dar zamin gardish nakardaand, to bubinand saranch'omi kasone, ki pesh az onon budand, chi guna budaast? Allokh' taolo [khonakh'oiashonro] bar sarashon vairon kard [va ononro nobud sokht] va in kofiron [niz kaifare] kh'ammonandi on [dar pesh] khokh'and dosht
Zero Allokh' taolo [iovaru] korsozi mu'minon ast, va[-le] kofiron kh'ech' korsoze nadorand

Allokh' taolo mu'minoni nakukorro ba bog'kh'oe [az bikh'isht] vorid mekunad, ki ch'uiborkh'o az zeri [darakhtoni] on ch'ori ast va kofiron [tankh'o dar dunio] bakh'ramand meshavand va kh'amchun chakh'orpoion mekhurand va otash [-i duzakh] ch'oigokh'ashon ast
Va chi bisior shakh'rkh'oe, ki sokinonash az [mardumi] shakh'ri tu, ki berunat kardaand, tavonmandtar budand. Mo kh'alokashon kardem va [dar barobari azobi ilokh'i] kh'ech' iovare nadoshtand
Oio kase, ki bar shevai ravshane az ch'onibi Parvardigori khesh ast, kh'amchun kasone ast, ki zishtii raftorashon dar nazarashon orosta shuda va az kh'avaskh'oi khesh pairavi mekunand?

Vasfi bikh'ishte, ki ba parkh'ezkoron va'da doda shuda, [chunin ast, ki] dar on ch'uiborkh'oe ch'ori ast, ki ta'mi obash tag'iirnopazir ast va ch'uiborkh'oe az shir, ki ta'mash digargun nameshavad va ch'uiborkh'oe az sharob, ki moiai lazzati nushandagon ast va ch'uiborkh'oe az asali nob va dar on ch'o kh'amai [anvoi] mevakh'o dar dastrasashon ast va [az kh'ama bartar] omurzishi Parvardigorashon. Oio [bikh'ishtiion] chun sokinoni ch'ovidoni duzakhand, ki obe chunon ch'ushon ba onon menushonand, ki rudakh'oiashonro mutaloshi [pora-pora] mekunad?

[Ei paiombar] barkhe az munofik'on ba [guftori] tu gush faro medikh'and va chun az kh'uzurat khorich' meshavand, ba akh'li donish [bo tamaskhur] meguiand: <<[Fakh'mided] Lakh'azote pesh chi meguft?>> Allokh' taolo bar dilkh'oiashon mukh'ri [g'aflat] nikh'odaast va onon az kh'avaskh'oi khesh pairavi kardaand
Allokh' taolo bar kh'idoiati parkh'ezkoron meafzoiad va parkh'ezkoriashon [-ro k'uvvat] mebakhshad

Oio kofiron ch'uz in intizor dorand, ki k'iiomat nogakh'on bar onon faro rasad, dar kh'ole ki nishonakh'oi on oshkor shudaast? Pas, on gokh' ki k'iiomat faro rasad, pand giriftanashon chi sude khokh'ad dosht?

[Ei paiombar] bidon, ki ma'bude [ba kh'ak'] ba ch'uz Allokh' taolo nest va baroi gunokh'i khesh va [gunokh'i] mardon va zanoni mu'min omurzish bikhokh' va [ba iod doshta bosh, ki] Allokh' taolo makh'alli raftuomad [-i ruzona] va oromidan [-i shabona]-i shumoro medonad

Mu'minon meguiand: <<Charo surae [dar borai ich'ozati ch'ikh'od] nozil nameshavad?>> Ammo kh'angome ki oioti sarekh'e dar mavridi ch'ang nozil megardad, [munofik'onu] bemordilonro mebini, ki kh'amchun kase, ki az [sakhtii] marg dar kh'oli bekh'ushi shuda boshad, ba tu menigarand, [margu azobi ilokh'i] bar onon shoistatar ast

Itoatu guftori shoista [bekh'tar ast] va chun tasmimi k'at'i [-i ch'ikh'od] girifta shavad, agar [dar taakh'kh'udi khud] bo Allokh' taolo sodik' boshand, baroi onon [az nifok' va sarkashi] bekh'tar ast
[Ei munofik'on] Oio [ch'uz in] intizor dored, ki agar [az K'ur'onu sunnati paiombarash] rui bigardoned, dar zamin tabokh'i kuned va az kheshovandonaton bibured?
Inon kasone kh'astand, ki Allokh' taolo [bo duri az rakh'mati khesh] la'natashon kardaast, pas, [gushi dili] eshonro kar va chashmi [dili] ononro kur sokhtaast
Oio dar K'ur'on tadabbur namekunand io bar dilkh'oiashon k'uflkh'o[-i g'aflat] nikh'oda shudaast?

Kasone, ki pas az ravshan shudani [rokh'i] kh'idoiat ba rokh'i peshini khesh bozgashtaand [va murtad shudand], shaiton [a'moli zishtashonro] baroiashon orosta va [bo orzukh'oi daroz] firebashon dodaast

In [ch'akh'lu gumrokh'i] bad-on khotir ast, ki munofik'on ba mushrikone, ki az vakh'ii ilokh'i karokh'at doshtand, guftand: <<Mo dar barkhe az umur az shumo pairavi mekunem>> va Allokh' taolo pinkh'onkoriashonro medonad
Pas, on gokh' ki farishtagoni ilokh'i bar chekh'ra va pushtashon mezanand va ch'onashonro megirand, [kh'oli in munofik'on] chi guna khokh'ad bud?

In [kaifar] az on rust, ki onon pairavi rokh'e shudand, ki Allokh'ro ba khashm meovarad va az anch'omi korkh'oe, ki much'ibi khushnudii ilokh'i meshavad, karokh'at doshtand. Pas, [Allokh' taolo niz natich'ai] korkh'oiashonro tabokh' sokht
Oio bemordilon [-i munofik'] pindoshtaand, ki Allokh' taolo kh'argiz kinakh'oiashonro oshkor nakhokh'ad sokht?

[Ei paiombar] agar mekhostem, ononro ba tu nishon medodem, ki [botini] eshonro az zokh'irashon bozshinosi; va musallaman az shevai sukhanashon ba khubi ononro khokh'i shinokht va [bidoned, ki] Allokh' taolo az korkh'oiaton ogokh' ast
Kh'atman, [kh'amai] shumoro ozmoish mekunem, to az miionaton much'okh'idon va shikeboionro bozshinosem va akh'voli shumoro meozmoem [to rostguion mushakhkhas gardand]

Kasone, ki pas az ravshan shudani rokh'i kh'idoiat bar onon, kufr varzidand va mardumro az rokh'i Allokh' taolo bozdoshtand va ba mukholifat bo paiombar barkhostand, kh'argiz ziione ba Allokh' taolo nakhokh'and rasonid va [Allokh' taolo niz natich'ai] a'molashonro tabokh' khokh'ad sokht
Ei mu'minon, ba Allokh' taolo va paiombar itoat kuned va [bo kufru riio] a'moli [shoistai] kheshro tabokh' nakuned
Kasone, ki kufr varzidand va [digaronro niz] az rokh'i Allokh' taolo bozdoshtand va dar kh'oli kufr murdand, Allokh' taolo kh'argiz ononro nakhokh'ad omurzid

Pas, [ei mu'minon az ruiorui bo dushmanon] susti navarzed va [az tarsi ch'ang ononro] ba sulkh'u oshti da'vat nakuned, dar kh'ole ki shumo bartared va Allokh' taolo bo shumost va az [podoshi] a'molaton nakhokh'ad kost

Ba rosti, ki zindagii dunio bozicha va sargarmi ast; va agar imon biiovared va parkh'ezkori kuned, [Allokh' taolo] podoshatonro [bekamu kost] khokh'ad dod va [tamomi] amvolatonro namekhokh'ad [balki mefarmoiad, ki zakotashro bipardozed]
Agar [tamomi] onro az shumo bikhokh'ad va [bar in dastur] isror kunad, bukhl mevarzed va [in kor] kinakh'oiatonro oshkor mesozad

Ogokh' boshed! Shumo kasone kh'asted, ki baroi infok' dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo da'vat meshaved, vale barkhe az shumo bukhl mevarzand va kh'ar ki bukhl bivarzad, ba ziioni khesh bukhl varzidaast va Allokh' taolo beniioz ast va [in shumo kh'asted, ki] niiozmanded va agar [az islom ba suii kufr] bozgarded, Allokh' taolo gurukh'i digarero ch'oiguzinaton khokh'ad kard, ki kh'amchun shumo [ba bukhl mubtalo] naboshand
[Ei paiombar] Ba rosti, ki Mo piruzii oshkorero [dar sulkh'i Kh'udaibiia] baroiat muk'addar kardem
To Allokh' taolo gunokh'i guzashta va oiandaatro biiomurzad va ne'matashro bar tu tamom gardonad va ba rokh'i rost kh'idoiatat namoiad
Va Allokh' taolo ba piruzii shikastnopazire ioriat kunad
Ust, ki bar dilkh'oi mu'minon oromish nozil kard, to bar imonashon biiafzoiand; va sipokh'iioni osmonkh'o va zamin az oni Allokh' taolo ast; va Allokh' taolo donovu kh'akim ast

[Ore, chunin kard] To mardonu zanoni mu'minro ba bog'kh'oe [bikh'ishte] vorid kunad, ki ch'uiborkh'o az zeri [darakhtoni] on ch'ori ast; ch'ovidona dar on ch'o khokh'and bud; va gunokh'onashonro bizudoiad [va biiomurzad]; va in nazdi Allokh' taolo [baroi mu'minin] komiobii buzurge ast

Va munofik'onu mushrikonro - dar umum az zanu mard, ki nisbat ba Allokh' taolo badgumonand, much'ozot kunad; noguvori [va azobi ilokh'i] bar eshon bod! Allokh' taolo bar onon khashm girifta va az rakh'mati khesh durashon karda va duzakhro baroiashon omoda namudaast; va [ba rosti, ki duzakh] chi bad ch'oigokh'e ast!
Sipokh'iioni osmonkh'o va zamin az oni Allokh' taolo ast; va Allokh' taolo shikastnopaziru kh'akim ast
[Ei Paiombar] Mo turo guvokh' va muzhdadikh'anda va kh'ushdordikh'anda firistodem
To [shumo mardum] ba Allokh' taolo va Paiombarash imon biiovared va [dini] Uro iori kuned va buzurgash dored va bomdodu shomgokh' Allokh'ro tasbekh' gued

Be tardid, kasone, ki bo tu bai'at mekunand, dar kh'ak'ik'at, bo Allokh' taolo bai'at mekunand; dasti Allokh' taolo boloi dastkh'oi onon ast. Kh'ar ki [pas az bai'at] paimonshikani kunad, ba ziioni khesh paimon shikastaast; va kh'ar ki ba paimonash [dar asosi iorii dini Allokh' taolo va paiombarash] vafo kunad, ba zudi [Allokh' taolo] podoshi buzurge ba u khokh'ad dod

Bodiiashinoni mutakhallif [ki az shirkat dar safari Makka va sulkh'i Kh'udaibiia khuddori kardaand, baroi tavch'ekh'i kori khud] khokh'and guft: <<[Mukh'ofizati] Amvol va khonavodaamon moro giriftor kard; baroiamon omurzish bikhokh'>>. Onon chize, ki dar dilkh'oiashon nest, bar zabon meovarand. Bigu: <<Agar Allokh' taolo iroda kunad, ki ba shumo ziion io sude birasad, kist, ki dar muk'obili [khosti] Allokh' taolo az shumo difo' kunad? Ore, Allokh' taolo az on chi mekuned, ogokh' ast>>

[Uzraton in nabud;] Balki gumon mekarded, ki Paiombaru mu'minon [-i kh'amrokh'ash az in safari khatarnok] kh'argiz nazdi khonavodai khesh boznakhokh'and gasht; va in [andesha] dar dilkh'oiaton orosta shud va gumoni bad burded [ki Allokh' taolo dinashro iori nakhokh'ad kard; pas, ba khato rafted] va kh'alok shuded
Kh'ar ki ba Allokh'u paiombarash imon naovarad, pas, [bidonad, ki] mo baroi kofiron otashe suzon omoda kardaem
Farmonravoii osmonkh'o va zamin az oni Allokh' taolo ast; kh'ar kiro bikhokh'ad meomurzad va kh'ar kiro bikhokh'ad, azob mekunad; va Allokh' taolo omurzandai mekh'rubon ast

[Ei mu'minon] Kh'angome ki ozim [-i Khaibar va] ba giriftani g'animat meshaved, mutakhallifon [az safari Makka] khokh'and guft: <<Ich'ozat dikh'ed, mo niz ba dunboli shumo biioem>>. Onon mekhokh'and, kalomi ilokh'iro tag'iir dikh'and. [Ei Paiombar] Ba eshon bigu: <<Shumo kh'argiz ba dunboli mo nakhokh'ed omad [zero in g'animatkh'o makhsusi kasone ast, ki dar Kh'udaibiia kh'uzur doshtand va dar borai in kh'ukm] Allokh' taolo k'ablan chunin farmudaast>>; on gokh' khokh'and guft: <<[Na] Balki shumo nisbat ba mo kh'asad mevarzed>>. [Kh'argiz chunin nest] Balki ch'uz iddai kame [az onon avomiri ilokh'iro] darnameioband

[Ei Paiombar] Ba mutakhallifon bigu: <<Ba zudi ba muk'obila bo gurukh'e ch'angovar faro khonda khokh'ed shud, ki ononro az poi darovared, magar in ki taslim shavand; agar itoat kuned, Allokh' taolo podoshi nakue ba shumo khokh'ad dod; va agar kh'amchun guzashta sarpechi kuned, shumoro bo azobe dardnok much'ozot khokh'ad kard>>

Bar nobino va lang va bemor gunokh'e nest [ki dar ch'ang shirkat nakunand]; va kh'ar ki az Allokh' taolo va paiombarash itoat kunad, [Allokh' taolo] uro ba bog'kh'oe [az bikh'isht] vorid mekunad, ki ch'uiborkh'o az zeri [darakhtoni] on ch'ori ast; va kh'ar ki sarpechi kunad, ba azobe dardnok much'ozotash khokh'ad kard

Allokh' taolo az mu'minone, ki dar kanori on darakht [dar Kh'udaibiia] bo tu bai'at kardand, khushnud shud va donist, ki dar dilashon chi meguzarad; az in ru oromish bar onon furu firistod va ba piruzii nazdik [dar Khaibar] podoshashon dod
va [kh'amchunin] g'animatkh'oi farovone, ki ba dast meovardand; va Allokh' taolo kh'amvora shikastnopazir [va] kh'akim ast

Allokh' taolo g'animatkh'oi farovonero ba shumo va'da dod, ki [dar oianda] ba onkh'o dast khokh'ed ioft; pas, in [piruzi va g'animatkh'oi Khaibar]-ro baroi shumo zudtar farokh'am sokht va dasti [taaddi va tach'ovuzi] dushmanro az shumo kutokh' namud, to baroi mu'minon nishonai [az lutfi ilokh'i] boshad va shumoro ba rokh'i rost kh'idoiat kunad

Va [kh'amchunin g'animatkh'oi] digare [dar intizori shumost], ki kh'anuz ba onkh'o dast naioftaed va Allokh' taolo bar onkh'o ikh'ota dorad [va az onkh'o ogokh' ast]. Ba rosti, ki Allokh' taolo bar kh'ar kore tavonost
Agar kofiron ba ch'angi shumo biioiand [az tavakkal va salobati shumo] pusht karda va megurezand; pas, az on niz kh'ech' korsoz va iovare nakhokh'and ioft
In sunnati ilokh'i ast, ki peshtar niz ch'ori budaast; va kh'argiz dar sunnati ilokh'i tag'iir va tabdile nakhokh'i ioft

Ust, ki dar Kh'udaibiia dasti ononro az shumo kutokh' namud [va mone' az on shud, ki shumoro ba ch'ang vo dorand]; va pas az piruz sokhtani shumo dar Makka niz dasti shumoro az onon bozdosht [ki ononro nakushed va ba asorat nagired]; va Allokh' taolo kh'amvora ba on chi mekuned, binost

Onon kasone budand, ki kofir shudand va shumoro az [vurud ba] Masch'id-ul-kh'arom bozdoshtand va niz az rasidani k'urbonikh'oi shumo ba k'urbongokh'ash [dar Mino] ch'ilavgiri kardand; va agar mardonu zanoni mu'mine [baini mardumi Makka] nabudand, ki [dar surati oshkor shudani dargiri mumkin bud] ononro nadonista poimol kuned va nokhosta murtakibi gunokh' shaved, [farmoni kh'amla ba Makka medodem; vale Allokh' taolo chunin kard] to [az makkagiion] kh'ar kiro bikhokh'ad, farogiri rakh'mati khesh k'aror dikh'ad; va agar [mu'minonu kofiron dar Makka] az iakdigar ch'udo budand, kofironashonro bo azobe dardnok much'ozot mekardem

[Ba iod ovar] On gokh' ki kofironi [Makka dar Kh'udaibiia] k'alban dastkhushi taassub, [on kh'am] taassubi ch'okh'iliiat shuda budand, Allokh' taolo oromishi [khotire az ch'onibi] khesh bar paiombarash va bar mu'minin furu firistod va ononro ba asl [va asosi tavkh'id va] parkh'ezkori [lo ilokh'a illa-Allokh'] poiband sokht; charo ki [nisbat ba mushrikon] ba on sazovortar va shoistatar budand; va Allokh' taolo ba kh'ar chize donost

Allokh' taolo ru'ioi rasulashro ba durusti takh'ak'k'uk' bakhshid, ki ba khosti ilokh'i, dar kh'ole ki sarkh'oiatonro taroshida muikh'oiatonro kutokh' kardaed, dar emini va biduni tars [az dushman] ba Masch'idu-l-kh'arom vorid khokh'ed shud. [Allokh' taolo] Chizkh'oero medonist, ki shumo namedonisted; va ilova bar fatkh'i Makka piruzii nazdiki [Khaibar]-ro [niz baroiaton] muk'arrar namud
Ust, ki paiombarashro bo [kitobi] kh'idoiat va oini kh'ak' firistod, to [kh'ak'k'oniiati bartarii] onro bar kh'amai adion oshkor gardonad; va Allokh' taolo ba unvoni guvokh' kofi ast

Mukh'ammad rasulullokh' va [sakh'obai mu'min va fidokorash kh'amon] kasone, ki kh'amvora bo u kh'astand, dar barobari kofiron [-i sitezach'u] mukh'kamu sakhtgirand va bo iakdigar mekh'rubon; eshonro dar kh'oli ruku' va sach'da mebini, ki paivasta fazlu khushnudii Allokh'ro mech'uiand; nishoni [imonu parkh'ezgorii] onon dar chekh'rakh'oiashon az asari sach'da va ibodat kh'uvaidost; in vasfi eshon dar Tavrot ast; va tavsifashon dar Inch'il [niz] kh'amchun giiokh'e ast, ki ch'avonaashro barmeovarad va onro neru mebakhshad, to mukh'kam gardad va bar sok'akh'oiash ustuvor biistad; chunon ki much'ibi shigiftii kishovarzon shavad; dar natich'a, Allokh' taolo bo [tak'viiat va peshrafti] mu'minon kofironro ba khashm darmeovarad. Allokh' taolo ba mu'minoni nakukor [sakh'oba va pairavonashon] va'dai omurzish va podoshe buzurg dodaast
Ei mu'minon, dar barobari Allokh' taolo va paiombarash [dar kh'ech' kore] peshi nagired; va az Allokh' taolo parvo kuned, ki Allokh' taolo shunavovu donost

Ei mu'minon, sadoiatonro balandtar az sadoi Paiombar nakuned; va kh'amchunon ki barkhe az shumo bo barkhe digar baland sukhan meguiad, bo u ba sadoi baland sukhan nagued. Mabodo be onki bidoned, a'molaton tabokh' gardad
Onon, ki sadoi khudro nazdi rasulullokh' poin meovarand, Allokh' taolo dilkh'oiashonro baroi parkh'ezkore ozmuda [va kholis gardonida] ast. Baroi onon omurzishu podoshi buzurge [dar pesh] ast
[Vale] Onon, ki az pushti utok'kh'o [-i kh'amsaronat] turo sado mezanand, beshtarashon bekhiradand
Va agar sabr mekardand, to khud baroi mulok'otashon khorich' shavi, baroiashon bekh'tar bud; va Allokh' taolo omurzgoru mekh'rubon ast
Ei mu'minon, agar shakhsi munkh'arife khabare baroiaton ovarad, takh'k'ik' kuned, to mabodo nadonista ba gurukh'e [begunokh'] oseb birasoned va az kardai khud pushaimon shaved

Bidoned, ki rasulullokh' miioni shumost [va salokh'atonro bekh'tar medonad]; agar dar bisiore az umur az [mailu nazari] shumo pairavi kunad, duchori zakh'mat meshaved; vale Allokh' taolo imonro makh'bubi shumo namud va onro dar k'albkh'oiaton biiorost [to islom biiovared] va kufru nofarmoni va sarkashiro dar nazaraton nokhushoiand gardond. Onon [ki orosta ba in avsofand] puiandagoni rokh'i kh'idoiat va kamoland
[In inoiat] Ba unvoni fazilatu ne'mate az ch'onibi Allokh' taolo [muk'arrar shudaast] va Allokh' taolo donoi kh'akim ast

Agar du gurukh' az mu'minon bo kh'am dargir shudand, miionashon oshti bark'aror kuned va agar iak gurukh' bar digare tach'ovuz kard, bo gurukh'i mutach'oviz bich'anged, to ba farmoni Allokh' taolo boz oiad; agar bozgasht, bainashon sulkh'e odilona bark'aror kuned va ba adolat raftor kuned, ki Allokh' taolo odilonro dust dorad
Albatta, mu'minon barodari iakdigarand; pas, miioni barodaron oshti bark'aror kuned va az Allokh' taolo parvo kuned; boshad, ki mavridi rakh'mat k'aror gired

Kh'argiz naboiad gurukh'e [az shumo] gurukh'i digarero maskhara kunad; chi baso inon az onon bekh'tar boshand; va zanon niz naboiad zanoni digarro maskhara namoiand; chi baso inon az onon bartar boshand; va az iakdigar aibch'ui nakuned; va iakdigarro bo lak'abkh'o [-i zisht] khitob nakuned [ki in kor misdok'i nofarmoni az avomiri ilokh'i ast]; va badtarin vizhagi [baroi iak musulmon] in ast, ki pas az imon ovardan [fisk'u] nofarmoni kunad; va onon, ki tavba nakunand, [nisbat ba nafsi khesh] sitamgorand

Ei mu'minon, az bisiore az gumonkh'oi bad biparkh'ezed; charo ki barkhe az gumonkh'o gunokh' ast; va dar borai iakdigar tach'assusu g'aibat nakuned; oio kh'ech' iak az shumo dust dorad, ki gushti barodari murdaashro bikhurad? [Kh'atman] Onro khush nadored [g'aibat niz ba kh'amin zishti ast]; az Allokh' taolo parvo kuned, ki Allokh' taolo tavbapaziru mekh'rubon ast

Ei mardum, mo shumoro az [omezishi] mardu zane ofaridem va ba ch'amoatkh'o va k'abilakh'oi mukhtalif tak'sim kardem, to iakdigarro bozshinosed. Be tardid, buzurgvortarini shumo nazdi Allokh' taolo Parkh'ezkortarini shumost; va Allokh' taolo [ba on chi mekuned] dono va ogokh' ast

A'rob [-i bodiianishin dar kh'uzuri paiombar] guftand: <<Imon ovardaem>>. [Ei paiombar, ba onon] Bigu: <<Shumo imon naiovardaed; vale bigued: <<Islom ovardaem>>; va kh'anuz imon dar k'albkh'oiaton nufuz nakardaast. Agar az Allokh' taolo va paiombarash itoat kuned, az [podoshi] a'moli shumo kh'ech' nakhokh'ad kost. Ba rosti, ki Allokh' taolo omurzgoru mekh'rubon ast>>

Mu'minon [-i kh'ak'ik'i] kasone kh'astand, ki ba Allokh' taolo va paiombarash imon ovardaand va [lakh'zae dar imonashon] tardid nakardand va bo molu ch'onashon dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo ba muboriza barkhostand; inonand, ki [dar e'tik'od va amal] sadok'at dorand

[Ei paiombar, ba bodiianishinon] Bigu: <<Oio mekhokh'ed, Allokh'ro az dini khesh ogokh' kuned? Dar kh'ole ki Allokh' taolo kh'ar chiro, ki dar osmonkh'o va zamin ast, medonad; va Allokh' taolo ba kh'ar chize ogokh' ast>>

Onon bar tu minnat menikh'and, ki islom ovardaand; bigu: <<Minnati islomi khesh bar man naguzored; balki agar [dar oshkor kardani imon] sadok'at dored, in Allokh' taolo ast, ki bar shumo minnat dorad, ki ba suii imon kh'idoiataton namudaast>>
Be tardid, Allokh' taolo asrori osmonkh'o va zaminro medonad va ba on chi mekuned, binost
[K'of]; savgand ba K'ur'oni arch'mand [ki rastokhez omadani ast]
Mushrikon az in ki kh'ushdordikh'andae az miioni khudashon ba surog'ashon omadaast, ibrozi shigifti mekunand va meguiand: <<Moch'aroi ach'ibe ast
On kh'angome ki murdem va khok shudem [dubora barangekhta khokh'em shud?]. In bozgashte baid ast>>
Be tardid, zarrote, ki zamin az badani onon mekokh'ad, [kh'amaro] medonem; va kitobe nigokh'bon dar ikhtiior dorem [ki kh'archi bar onon muk'addar gashta, dar on sabt ast]
Vak'te ki [K'ur'on, ia'ne kalomi] kh'ak' bar onon rasid, takzibash kardand; pas, dar kh'olati sargardoni [va pareshoni] kh'astand [va dar borai K'ur'on kh'aironand]
Oio kofiron osmonro bar farozashon namenigarand, ki chi guna onro barafroshtem va [ba zevari sitoragon] orostem va ori az [kh'ar guna] nuk'su khalal ast?
Va zaminro gusturdem va kukh'kh'oi sobit dar on pai afkandem va az kh'ar nav' giiokh'i zebo [shodiangeze] dar on ruionidem
[Onkh'oro ofaridem] To baroi kh'ar bandai tavbakor much'ibi binishu pand boshad
Va az osmon borone purbarakat firistodem va bo on bog'kh'o [-i meva] va [mazorei] dona [kh'o]-i daravkardani ruionidem
Va darakhtoni sarkashidai khurmo bo khushakh'oi barkh'amnishasta
Baroi ruzii bandagon; ba vasilai on [boron] sarzamini khazonzada va khushkro kh'aiot bakhshidem; khuruch' az k'abrkh'o [dar k'iiomat] niz kh'amin guna ast
Pesh az onon niz k'avmi Nukh'u akh'olii <<Ras>> [chokh'] va k'avmi Samud [paiombaronashonro] durug'gu shumurdand
Va [kh'amchunin k'avmi] Odu Fir'avn va k'avmi Lut
va akh'olii <<Aika>> [k'avmi Shuaib] va k'avmi <<Tubba'>>; kh'ar iak [az onon] paiombaroni [ilokh'i]-ro durug'gu shumurdand; pas, va'dai azobi man [bar onon] takh'ak'k'uk' ioft
Oio mo dar ofarinishi nakhustin furu mondem [to az bozofarinii on och'iz boshem]? [Kh'argiz] Balki onon az ofarinishi ch'adid dar [kh'airat va] tardidand
Mo insonro ofaridem va az vasvasakh'oi zamirash ogokh'em; va az shokh'ragash ba u nazdiktarem
Vak'te du farishta, ki bar samti rostu chap murok'ib nishastaand, [raftorashro] sabt mekunand
Kh'ar sukhane, ki bar zabon meovarad, dar kanorash [farishtai] murok'ibe omodaast
Sakhtikh'oi marg, ba rosti, darrasid. [Ei insoni g'ofil] In kh'amon chizest, ki az on megurekhti
Va [baroi duvumin bor] dar <<sur>> damida meshavad [va k'iiomat barpo megardad]. On ruz [ruzi takh'ak'k'uk'i] va'da [-i azob] ast
Va kh'ar kas dar kh'ole [ki du farishta kh'amrokh'iash mekunand, ba arsai makh'shar] meoiad; iake rokh' menamoionad va digare [bar a'molash] guvokh' ast
[Ba u gufta meshavad:] <<Tu az in [ruz] dar g'aflat budi va mo [bo azobi duzakh] pardai [g'aflat]-ro az muk'obilat bardoshtem; aknun didaat tezbin shudaast
[Farishtai] Kh'amnishini vai meguiad: <<In kh'amon [nomai a'moli u] ast, ki nazdi man omadaast>>
[Allokh' taolo ba on du farishta khitob mekunad:] <<Kh'ar sitezach'ui kh'ak'sitezero dar duzakh biiafkaned
[Kh'ar] Monei khairu mutach'oviz va badgumonro
Kh'amon kase, ki dar kanori Allokh' taolo ma'budi digare k'aror medod. Uro dar azobe sakht biiafkaned>>
[Shaitoni] Kh'amnishinash meguiad: <<Parvardigoro, man uro ba tug'ion nakashidam, vale u khud dar gumrokh'ii bepoione bud>>
[Allokh' taolo] Mefarmoiad: <<Dar peshgokh'i Man sitez nakuned, ki pesh az in ba shumo kh'ushdor doda budem
Farmoni much'ozot nazdi Man tag'iirpazir nest; va Allokh' taolo [dar kaifaru podosh] ba bandagonash sitam namekunad>>
Ruze, ki ba duzakh meguem: <<Oio [az sitamgaron] anboshtashudai?>>. [Va u] Meguiad: <<Oio besh az in kh'am kh'ast?>>
[Dar on ruz] Bikh'ishtro baroi parkh'ezkoron pesh meovarand [to ne'matkh'oiashro] az nazdik [bubinand]
[Ba onon gufta meshavad:] <<In kh'amon podoshest, ki ba shumo va'da doda meshud, ki baroi kh'ar tavbakore ast, ki [ba suii Parvardigorash bozmegardad va] poiband [ba paimonu akh'komi ilokh'i] ast
Kh'amon kase, ki dar nikh'on az [khashmi Allokh'i] rakh'mon metarsad va bo k'albe tavbakor [ba peshgokh'ash] bozmegardad
Bo salomat ba bikh'isht daroed; in ast ruzi ch'ovidonagi>>
Dar on ch'o kh'ar chi bikhokh'and, dar ikhtiior dorand va kh'atto beshtar az on niz dar ikhtiiori most

Va chi bisior ummatkh'oero, ki pesh az mushrikoni Makka kh'alok kardem, ki onon [ba marotib] az inkh'o k'avitar budand; pas, dar gusha va kanori shakh'rkh'o ch'ustuch'u kardand [ki bubinand oio az azobu kh'alokati baroiashon] kh'ech' panokh' va gurezgokh'e vuch'ud dorad
Be gumon dar in [sukhan] baroi sokh'ibdilon io kasone, ki bo kh'uzur [-i k'alb ba nidoi tavkh'id] gush faro medikh'and va kh'ushiorand, andarz ast
Mo osmonkh'o va zamin va on chiro, ki miioni onkh'ost, dar shash ruz ofaridem va [kh'argiz] ranch'u khastagi ba Mo narasid
[Ei Paiombar] Dar barobari sukhanoni mushrikon shikebo bosh; va pesh az baromadani oftob va k'abl az furu shudanash Parvardigoratro ba poki sitoish kun [va namoz biguzor]
Va niz [dar pose] az shab va pas az kh'ar namoz uro ba poki sitoish kun
Va [ei Paiombar] on gokh' ki munodi [-i k'iiomat] az makone nazdik nido medikh'ad, gush farodor
Ruze, ki kh'amagon bongi sakh'mnoki rastokhezro ba kh'ak' meshunavand, [on ruz] ruzi khuruch' [az gurkh'o] ast
Moem, ki kh'aiot mebakhshem va marg medikh'em; va bozgasht [-i kh'amagon] ba suii Most
Ruze, ki zamin az [farozi] onon shikofta meshavad, insonkh'o shitobon [berun meoiand]. In ekh'zore ast, ki baroi Mo oson ast

Mo ba on chi [kofiron] meguiand, donotarem; va tu [ei Paiombar] bar onon musallat nesti [ki bikhokh'i ba imon ovardan vodorashon kuni]; pas, kasero, ki az azob [va kh'ushdori] Man metarsad, ba [vasilai] K'ur'on andarz bidekh'
Savgand ba bodkh'oi khokafshon
Va savgand ba abrkh'oi sanginbor
Va savgand ba kishtikh'oi sabuksair
Va savgand ba farishtagon, ki umuri ilokh'iro [miioni mardum] tak'sim mekunand
Ki on chi ba shumo [dar mavridi podosh va azob] va'da doda shuda, kh'ak'ik'at dorad
Va [ruzi] ch'azo, kh'atman, ba vuk'u' mepaivandad
Savgand ba osmon, ki [bo sitoragon orosta shuda va gui] doroi rokh'kh'ost
Ki shumo [dar mavridi Paiombaru K'ur'on] ikhtilofi nazar dored
Kh'ar ki [az rokh'i kh'ak'] bozgardonda shavad, az [imon ba] Paiombar va K'ur'on niz bozgardonda khokh'ad shud
Marg [va la'nat] bar durug'guion!
Kh'amon kasone, ki dar vartai ch'akh'l g'ofiland
Onon [paivasta va az ruii inkor] mepursand: <<Ruzi ch'azo chi zamone ast?>>
Kh'amon ruze ast, ki ba otash much'ozot meshavand
[Va ba onon gufta meshavad:] <<Azobi khudro bichashed; in kh'amon otashest, ki ba shitob mekhosted>>
[Dar ruzi k'iiomat] Musallaman, parkh'ezkoron dar bog'kh'oe [az bikh'isht] va [kanori] chashmasorkh'o ba sar mebarand
On chi Parvardigorashon ba onon ato kardaast, darioft medorand; zero dar [zindagii] guzashta nakukor budaand
Onon andake az shabro mekhuftand [va bak'iiaro ba namoz va niioish mashg'ul budand]
Va sakh'argokh'on omurzish mekhostand
Va dar amvolashon baroi soil va makh'rum kh'ak'k'e [muaiian az sadak'a va zakot] bud
Dar zamin nishonakh'o [-i k'udrati ilokh'i] baroi akh'li iak'in padidor ast
va dar vuch'udi khudaton; oio namebined?
Va rizk'u ruziaton va on chi [az kaifaru podosh va khairu shar, ki] ba shumo va'da doda meshavad, dar osmon ast
Pas savgand ba Parvardigori osmonu zamin, ki va'da [-i k'iiomat va podosh va azob] kh'amchun sukhan guftanaton kh'ak'ik'i va k'at'i ast
[Ei Paiombar] Oio dostoni mekh'mononi giromii Ibrokh'im ba tu rasidaast?
Chun bar u vorid shudand va salom guftand, u guft: <<Salom>> [va zeri lab guft:] <<Gurukh'e noshinosand>>
On gokh' nazdi khonavodai khud raft va [gushti birioni] gusolai farbekh'e [baroi paziroi] ovard
[U g'izoro] Nazdi onon guzosht va [chand lakh'za ba'd] guft: <<Oio namekhured?>>
[Pas, chun dast ba g'izo nazadand] Az onon ekh'sosi tars kard; guftand: <<Natars [mo farishtaem]; va uro ba [tavalludi] pisari dono bashorat dodand
Kh'amsarash bo fariod [-u shigifti] pesh omad va dar kh'ole ki ba ruii khud mezad, guft: <<Pirazani nozo [farzand mezoiad]?
[Farishtagon] guftand: <<Parvardigorat chunin farmudaast; va be gumon, U kh'akimu donost>>
[Ibrokh'im] Guft: <<Ei farishtagon [-i Allokh' taolo], koru ma'muriiati shumo chist?>>
[Farishtagon] Guftand: <<Mo baroi [much'ozoti] k'avme much'rim [va gunakh'kor] firistoda shudaem
To sangkh'oe az gil [-i sakhtshuda] bar sarashon furu borem
[Sangkh'oe] Ki nazdi Parvardigorat baroi isrofkoron nishon guzoshta shudaast
Pas, mu'minonero, ki dar on [shakh'rkh'oi k'avmi Lut] budand, [pesh az nuzuli azob] berun ovardem
Vale fak'at iak khonavodaro ioftem, ki [nisbat ba avomiri ilokh'i] taslim budand
Va dar on [shakh'rkh'o] baroi mardume, ki az azobi dardnok [-i ilokh'i] tars dorand, nishonae ravshan bar ch'oi guzoshtem
Dar [dostoni] Muso [niz nishona va ibratest]; on gokh' ki uro bo dalele ravshan nazdi Fir'avn firistodem
Vale [Fir'avn] bo takia bar k'udratash [kh'ak'ro] napaziruft va guft: [<<In mard io] Ch'odugar ast io devona>>
Uro kh'amrokh' bo sipokh'iionash giriftem va ba dario afkandem [va kh'alok kardem]; dar kh'ole ki [dar lakh'zai marg khudro ba khotiri nofarmoni va kufrash] sarzanish mekard
Dar [dostoni k'avmi] Od [niz darsi ibratest]; on gokh' ki tundbode be khairu barakat bar onon firistodem
[Tundbode] Ki bar kh'ar chiz vazid, khoku khoshokash kard

Dar [dostoni k'avmi] Samud [niz darsi ibrate ast] on gokh' ki [tavassuti paiombarashon Solekh'] ba onon gufta shud: <<Andake [az lazzatkh'oi zindagi] bakh'ramand shaved [ki tankh'o se ruz fursat dored]>>
Onon az farmoni Parvardigorashon sarpechi kardand; pas, dar kh'ole ki [ba chashmi khud azobro] medidand, soik'a ononro faro girift
[Chunon bar zamin aftodand, ki] Na tavoni barkhostan [va gurez] doshtand va na ioroi difo'
Pesh az on k'avmi Nukh'ro, ki gurukh'e nofarmon budand [kh'alok kardem]
Mo osmonro ba tavon [-i khud] bino nikh'odem va kh'amvora onro vus'at mebakhshem
Va zaminro [baroi zindagi] gusturdem va chi nek gusturonandae kh'astem!
Va kh'ama chizro ba surati zavch' [ch'uft] ofaridem; boshad, ki [tavach'ch'ukh' kuned va] pand gired
[Ei Paiombar, ba mardum bigu:] <<Pas, ba suii Allokh' taolo bishtobed, ki man az ch'onibi U baroi shumo kh'ushdordikh'andae oshkoram
Va dar kanori Allokh' taolo ma'budi digare k'aror nadikh'ed, iak'inan, man az [ch'onibi] U baroi shumo kh'ushdordikh'andae oshkoram>>
Kh'ar paiombare, ki bar peshiniionashon mab'us shud, kh'amin guna guftand: <<[U io] Ch'odugar ast io devona>>
Oio iakdigarro ba in [kufru takzib] suporish karda budand? Na, balki mardume sarkash budand
Pas, [ei paiombar] az onon rui bigardon, ki tu [ba khotiri kufri onon] kh'argiz sazovori sarzanish nesti
Va [paivasta ba onon] tazakkur bidekh', ki, kh'atman, tazakkur baroi mu'minon sudbakhsh ast
Va ch'innu insro fak'at baroi in ofaridam, ki Maro ibodat kunand [va az bandagii digaron sar boz zanand]
Na az onon ruzi mekhokh'am, na in ki Maro khurok dikh'and
[Zero] Allokh' taolo ast, ki ruzirasoni nerumand va bark'aror ast
Sitamgoron [-i mushrik niz] kh'amchun ioron [-i guzashta]-i khesh sakh'me az azob dorand; pas, ba shitob [onro] az Man nakhokh'and
Pas, voi bar kofiron az [azobi] ruzi mav'udashon!
Savgand ba kukh'i Tur
va savgand ba kitobi navishtashuda
Dar sakh'ifakh'oi kushuda
Va savgand ba <<Baitu-l-ma'mur>> [ki farishtagon dar on ba ibodati Parvardigor mashg'uland]
Va savgand ba [osmoni baland kh'amon] sak'fi barafroshta [bar zamin]
Va savgand ba darioi oganda [az ob]
Ki be tardid, azobi Parvardigorat ba vuk'u' khokh'ad paivast
Va kh'ech' bozdorandae onro boznadorad
Ruze, ki osmon ba sakhti dar ch'unbish va iztirob aftad
Va kukh'kh'o ba kh'arakate shadid ravon shavand
Dar on ruz voi ba kh'oli takzibkunandagon
Kh'amon kasone, ki dar bekh'udagui sargarmi boziand
Ruze, ki bo khushunat ba suii otashi duzakh ronda meshavand
[Ba onon gufta meshavad] <<In [kh'amon] otashest, ki onro durug' mepindoshted
Oio in [otashu azobi] ch'odust io [kh'anuz kh'am onro] namebined?
Ba otash daroed [va bisuzed], ki shikeboi va noshikeboii shumo [dar barobari shu'lakh'oi suzonash] baroiaton iakson ast; tankh'o dar barobari on chi kardaed, much'ozot meshaved>>
Ba rosti, ki parkh'ezkoron dar bog'kh'oi bikh'isht dar nozu ne'matand
Va az bakhshishkh'oi [bedareg'i] Parvardigorashon va az in ki az azobi duzakh nigokh'ashon doshtaast, shodmonand
[Ba onon gufta meshavad] <<Ba podoshi kirdoraton [dar dunio inak] guvoro bikhured va bioshomed>>
Dar kh'ole ki bar takhtkh'oe radifshuda takia zadaand va kh'uroni g'izolchashmro ba kh'amsarii onon darmeovarem

Mu'minone, ki farzandonashon dar imon pairavi onon budand, farzandonashonro [niz dar bikh'isht] ba onon mulkh'ak' khokh'em kard va az [podoshi] amalashon zarrae namekokh'em; charo ki [sarnavishti] kh'ar kas dar garavi dastovardi khudi ust
[Dar bikh'isht az] Kh'ar nav' meva va gushte, ki bikhokh'and, paidarpai dar dastrasashon k'aror medikh'em.
Dar on ch'o ch'omkh'oi sharobe az dasti iakdigar megirand, ki na much'ibi bekh'udagui ast va na gunokh';
Va navch'avonone [ki baroi khidmat] peromunashon dar raftu omadand, gui [az zeboi va sapedrui] kh'amchun marvoride dar sadaf kh'astand
[Bikh'ishtiion] Ba iakdigar ru meovarand va az [dunio va akh'voli guzashtai] khud suol mekunand
Meguiand: <<Mo dar dunio dar khonavodai khud [az azobi ilokh'i] metarsidem
Allokh' taolo [bo ne'mti islom] bar mo minnat nikh'od va az azobi suzon [-i duzakh] kh'ifzamon kard
Mo dar zindagii dunio kh'amvora Uro [parastish mekardem va ba rububiiat] mekhondem. Be tardid, U nakukoru mekh'rubon ast
Pas, [ei Paiombar, bo oioti K'ur'on ba mardum] andarz bidekh', ki ba lutfi Parvardigorat [tu bar khilofi iddaoi kofiron] na kokh'ini va na mach'nun
Oio meguiand: <<[Mukh'ammad] Shoirest, ki muntazirem, to margash faro rasad [va az sukhanonash rakh'oi iobem]?>>
Bigu: <<Muntazir [-i margi man] boshed; man niz bo shumo muntazir khokh'am mond [to azobatonro ba chashm binam]>>
Oio ak'lkh'oiashon ba [baioni] in [sukhanoni botil] kh'ukm mekunad, io [asosan] mardume sarkash kh'astand?
Oio meguiand: <<[Mukh'ammad] K'ur'onro ch'a'l kardaast?>>. [Kh'argiz chunin nest] Balki [g'ark' dar takabburand, ki] imon nameovarand
Agar rost meguiand, sukhane monandi on biiovarand
Oio onon az kh'ech' ofarida shudaand io khud ofarinandai kheshand?
Oio onon osmonkh'o va zaminro ofaridaand? [Na] Balki onon iak'in nadorand [ki Allokh' taolo ofarinandai mutlak' ast]
Oio ganch'inakh'oi [ne'mat va kh'idoiati] Parvardigorat nazdi eshon ast? Oio [bar kh'ama chiz] tasallut dorand?
Oio nardbone dorand, ki ba vasilai on [guftori farishtagoni vakh'iro] meshunavand? Pas, kh'ar ki shunidaast, boiad dalele ravshan biiovarad
Oio Allokh' taolo farzandoni dukhtar dorad va shumo pisar?
[Ei paiombar] Oio az onon podoshe darkhost mekuni, ki [az pardokhtash dar ranch'and va kharch'ash] baroiashon [garonu] sangin ast?
Oio az ilmi g'aib ogokh'and va [khabarkh'oi nikh'onro] menavisand?
Oio k'asdi nairang[va nak'shai palide baroiat] dorand? Vale kofiron khud giriftori nairang [va tadbiri ilokh'i] kh'astand
Oio onon ma'bude g'air az Allokh' taolo dorand? Allokh' taolo az on chi bo U sharik k'aror medikh'and, poku munazzakh' ast
[In kofiron, kh'atto] Agar porae az osmonro niz dar kh'oli suk'ut bubinand, [boz kh'am imon nameovarand va] meguiand: <<Abre mutarokim ast>>
Pas, ononro [ba kh'oli khud] rakh'o kun, to bo ruzi mav'udashon, ki [bo nakhustin damidani sur] madkh'ushi marg megardand, muvoch'ekh' shavand
Ruze, ki nairangashon sudmand nakhokh'ad bud va [az kh'ech' su] iori nameshavand
Sitamgoron [dar dunio niz ba dasti mu'minon] ba azobi digare giriftor khokh'and shud; vale beshtarashon namedonand
[Ei Paiombar] Dar barobari kh'ukmi Parvardigorat shikebo bosh; zero tu takh'ti nazar va kh'ifozati Moi; va kh'angome ki [az khob io ba k'asdi ibodat] barmekhezi, Parvardigoratro ba poki sitoish kun
Va niz [dar pose] az shab Uro sitoish kun [va namoz biguzor] va ba kh'angomi nopadid shudani sitoragon [dar sapedadam niz namozi subkh' biguzor]
Savgand ba sitora, on gokh' ki nopadid shavad
Ki iori shumo [Mukh'ammad] kh'argiz gumrokh' nashuda va ba rokh'i tabokh'e naaftodaast
Va az ruii kh'avoi nafs sukhan nameguiad
[In K'ur'on] Vakh'i [-i ilokh'i] ast, ki [ba u] ilk'o meshavad. In [K'ur'on] ch'uz pand baroi ch'akh'oniion [inson va ch'in] nest
[Ch'abrail, ki farishtae ast] Purtavon ta'limash dodaast
[Kh'amon farishtai] Khushmanzare, ki [bo chekh'rai kh'ak'ik'iash dar barobari Paiombar] istod
Dar kh'ole ki u dar ufuk'i bolo [dar osmon] k'aror dosht
Sipas [Ch'abrail] nazdik shud; va nazdiktar
Pas, [fosilai u bo Paiombar] ba andozai tuli du kamon kamtar bud
On gokh' [on farishtai buzurgvor] on chiro, ki boiad ba bandai Allokh' taolo vakh'i mekard, vakh'i namud
On chiro, ki [paiombar] did, k'albash durug' napindosht
Oio bo u dar borai on chi mebinad, much'odala mekuned?
Dar kh'ak'ik'at, paiombar iak bori digar niz on farishtaro [ba surati komil] mushokh'ida karda bud
Dar kanori [darakhti buzurg] <<Sidratu-l-muntakh'o>> [dar osmoni kh'aftum]
ki oromishgokh'i bikh'isht kh'amon ch'ost
On gokh' ki kh'olate on darakhtro pushonida bud
Chashmi [paiombar ba chapu rost] munkh'arif nashud va [az kh'ad] tach'ovuz nakard
Ba rosti, ki u barkhe az buzurgtarin nishonakh'oi Parvardigorashro [dar on ch'o] mushokh'ida kard
[Ei mushrikon] Oio <<Lot>>-u <<Uzzo>>-ro didaed?
Va <<Mannot>> on savumin [buti bearzish]-ro? [Oio kh'ech' sudu ziione ba shumo merasonand?]
Oio [iddao mekuned, ki] farzandi pisar baroi shumost va dukhtar baroi Allokh' taolo?
Dar in surat, tak'sime noodilona ast

In butkh'o fak'at ismkh'oe [bema'no] kh'astand, ki khud va padaronaton bo onkh'o [ma'budkh'oi durug'ini khudro] nom nikh'odaed va Allokh' taolo kh'ech' dalele [bar kh'ak'k'oniiati in kor] nozil nakardaast. [Mushrikon dar e'tik'odotashon] Fak'at pairavi gumonu khostakh'oi dili kheshand; kh'ol on ki [much'iboti] kh'idoiat az ch'onibi Parvardigorashon bar onon rasidaast
Oio inson kh'ar chi [az shafoati in ma'budoni botil] orzu kunad, baroiash muiassar ast?
Dunio va okhirat az oni Allokh' ast [va ba kh'ar kas, kh'ar chiro salokh' bidonad mebakhshad]

Chi bisior farishtagone, ki dar osmonkh'o kh'astand, ki shafoatashon ba kh'ech' vach'kh' sudmand nakhokh'ad bud; magar pas az on ki Allokh' taolo baroi kh'ar ki bikhokh'ad va khushnud boshad, ich'ozat dikh'ad
Kasone, ki ba okhirat bovar nadorand, bar farishtagoni ilokh'i nomi dukhtar meguzorand [va ononro dukhtaroni Allokh' taolo medonand]
Onon dar mavridi in amr [komilan] beittiloand [va] fak'at az kh'adsu gumon pairavi mekunand; dar kh'ole ki baroi [shinokhti] kh'ak'ik'at gumon kofi nest
Pas, [ei Paiombar] tu niz az kase, ki az iodi Mo rui gardonida va fak'at [lazzatkh'oi] zindagii dunioro mekhokh'ad, rui bartob
Nikh'oiati darku fakh'mashon kh'amin ast. Be tardid, Parvardigorat ba kh'oli kasone, ki az rokh'i U munkh'arif shudaand ogokh'tar ast; va niz ba kh'oli rokh'ioftagon

Kh'ar chi dar osmonkh'o va zamin ast, az oni Allokh' taolo ast, [rokh'i khairu sharro ba inson iroa kard] to badkoronro dar barobari raftorashon kaifar dikh'ad va nakukoronro [bo ne'matkh'oi bikh'isht] podoshi naku ato namoiad

Kh'amon kasone, ki az gunokh'oni kabira va korkh'oi zishtu besharmona duri mekunand; magar lag'zhishkh'oi kamakh'amiiat [va gunokh'oni sag'ira, ki bo tavba va ibodat bakhshida meshavand], ki omurzishi Parvardigorat gusturda ast; az kh'amon dam, ki shumoro az zamin padid ovard va on gokh' ki ba surati ch'anin dar shikami modaronaton buded, ba [tabiati] shumo ogokh'tar [az khudaton] ast; pas, khudsitoi nakuned, ki U ba kh'oli parkh'ezkoron donotar ast
Oio on kasero, ki [az kh'ak'] rui bartoft, didai?
Va andake infok' kard va [sipas] khuddori namud
Oio ilmi g'aib dorad va [oiandaro] mebinad?
Oio bokhabar nashudaast az matolibi kitobi osmonii Muso
va [ta'limoti] Ibrokh'im, ki kh'ak'k'i [risolat va bandagii Mo]-ro ba tamomi ado kard?
