Ki kh'ech' gunakh'gore bori gunokh'i digarero bar dush nakhokh'ad kashid
Va in ki inson fak'at samarai talosh [-u niiati] khudro khokh'ad dosht
Va in ki be gumon taloshi u [dar mukh'osibai a'molash dar ruzi k'iiomat] manzur khokh'ad shud
On gokh' podoshashro ba tamomi khokh'and dod
Va in ki bozgasht [-i kh'amai umur] ba suii Parvardigori tust
Va Ust, ki mekhandonad va megirionad
Va Ust, ki memironad va [dar okhirat] zinda mekunad
Va kh'am Ust, ki zavch'i naru modaro meofarad,
az nutfae, ki [dar rakh'im] rekhta meshavad
va padid ovardani duborai onkh'o [dar k'iiomat niz bar ukh'dai] Allokh' taolo ast
Va Ust, ki [shumoro] beniioz mekunad va sarmoia mebakhshad
Va Ust, ki Parvardigori [sitorai] <<Shi'ro>> ast
Va Ust, ki k'avmi Odro dar guzashta kh'alok kard
Va k'avmi Samudro [niz nobud kard] va [kh'ech' iak az ononro] bok'i naguzosht
Va k'avmi Nukh'ro, ki sitamgortar va sarkashtar budand, pesh az on [kh'alok namud]
Va shakh'rkh'oi zerurushuda [-i k'avmi Lut]-ro dar kh'am kubid
Va ononro [bo azobe farogir] - chunon ki boiad pushonid
Kh'ol [ei inson] dar mavridi kadom iak az ne'matkh'oi Parvardigorat tardid ravo medori [va much'odala mekuni]?
In [paiombar niz] kh'ushdordikh'andaest az [gurukh'i] kh'ushdordikh'andagoni peshin
K'iiomat nazdik meshavad
Va kh'ech' kas - ch'uz Allokh' taolo - nametavonad oshkorash kunad [va sakhtikh'oiashro bartaraf sozad]
[Ei mushrikon] Oio az in sukhan dar shigifted?
Va dar kh'oli g'aflat va g'urur [ba oioti K'ur'on] mekhanded va [az shunidani kh'ushdorkh'oiash nametarsed va] ashk namerezed?
Va shumo bozikunandagoned
Pas, [kh'amagi] baroi Allokh' taolo sach'da kuned va [tankh'o] Uro biparasted
K'iiomat nazdik shud va mokh' [az kh'am] shikoft
Agar [kofiron] mu'ch'izae bubinand, ru megardonand va meguiand: <<[In] Ch'odue [botilu] zudguzar ast>>
Onon [oiot va nishonakh'oi ilokh'iro] durug' mepindorand va az kh'avoi nafsi khesh pairavi mekunand; va kh'ar amre [az podoshu kaifarkh'oi k'iiomat] dar zamoni makhsus ba khud k'aror dorad

Kasone, ki pesh az fatkh'i [Makka] infok' kardand va ch'angidand, [bo digaron] barobar nestand. Darach'ai onon volotar az kasonest, ki pas az fatkh' infok' kardand va ch'angidand, vale Allokh' taolo ba kh'ar du gurukh' nakutarin [podoshkh'o]-ro va'da dodaast va Allokh' taolo ba on chi mekuned, ogokh' ast
Kist, ki ba Allokh' taolo vome naku dikh'ad [va infok' kunad], to Allokh' taolo niz onro baroiash chandin barobar sozad va [dar okhirat] podoshe fokhir doshta boshad?

[In podoshi buzurg dar] Ruzest, ki mardonu zanoni mu'minro menigari, ki nurashon peshi ru va dar samti rostashon ba shitob kh'arakat mekunad [va ba onon khitob meshavad]: <<Imruz bashorati bog'kh'oe [az bikh'isht] bar shumo bod, ki ch'uiborkh'o az zeri [darakhtoni] on ch'ori ast va ch'ovidona dar on ba sar khokh'ed burd. In ast kh'amon komiobii buzurg>>.

Ruze, ki mardonu zanoni munofik' ba mu'minon meguiand: <<Ba mo nazare biiafkaned, to partave az nuraton bargirem>>. Ba onon gufta meshavad: <<Ba ak'ib bozgarded va kasbi nur kuned. On gokh' miionashon devore k'aror megirad, ki dare dorad, daruni on [ki ba sui mu'minon ast] ru ba rakh'mat ast va berunash [ki ba samti munofik'on ast] ru ba azob ast

[Munofik'on] ba mu'minon meguiand: <<Magar mo [dar dindori va parastish] kh'amrokh'i shumo nabudem?>>. Onon posukh medikh'and: <<Bale, vale shumo [bo duruiagi va tazvir] khudro ba fitna andokhted [va kh'alok karded] va dar intizor [-i shikasti mu'minon va bozgasht ba shirku kufr] buded va [dar borai iori rasonidani Allokh' taolo ba mu'minon] tardid doshted va orzukh'o [-i durug'in] firebaton dod, to on ki farmon [-i margaton az ch'onibi] Allokh' taolo dar kh'ole faro rasid, ki shaiton shumoro dar barobari U gustokh karda bud>>
Imruz na az shumo [munofik'on] g'aromat mepazirand va na az kofiron. Ch'oigokh'aton otash ast, ki [ba rosti] shoistai shumost va chi bad saranch'ome ast!

Oio kh'angomi on faro narasidaast, ki dilkh'oi mu'minon ba iodi Allokh' taolo va kalomi kh'ak'k'e, ki nozil shudaast, furutan shavad va kh'amchun kasone naboshand, ki k'ablan akh'li kitob budand va chun [az bi'sati paiombaronashon] zamone tuloni bar onon guzasht, dilkh'oiashon sakht shud va bisiore az onon az dinashon munkh'arif shudand?

Ogokh' boshed, ki Allokh' taolo zaminro pas az khazonu khushkiash zinda mesozad. [Ei mardum] Musallaman, Mo nishonakh'o [-i tavonu tadbiri khud]-ro baroi shumo ba ravshani baion kardaem, boshad, ki biiandeshed
Be gumon, mardonu zanone, ki infok' mekunand va ba Allokh' taolo k'arze naku medikh'and, savobashon duchandon megardad va [dar okhirat] podoshe fokhir [-u nek] khokh'and dosht

Kasone, ki ba Allokh' taolo va paiombaronash imon ovardand, rostguion [-i rostkirdor] kh'astand va shakh'idon nazdi Parvardigorashon ba sar mebarand va [dar okhirat] podoshu nurashon makh'fuz ast. Va kasone, ki kufr varzidand va oioti Moro durug' shumurdand, duzakhiand

Bidoned, ki zindagii dunio, bozicha va sargarmi va zevar ast va fakhrfurushi dar barobari iakdigar va afzuntalabi dar amvolu farzandon. [In zindagi] Dar masal kh'amchun boronest, ki giiokh'on [-i ruiida ] az on kishovarzonro ba shigift meovarad; sipas [in giiokh'i shodob] pazhmurda shavad, on gokh' mebini, ki zard meshavad va sipas khoshok megardad va dar okhirat [nasibi munofik'onu kofiron] azobi shadid ast va [nasibi mu'minon] omurzishu khushnudii ilokh'i ast. [Dar kh'ar kh'ol] Zindagii dunio chize ch'uz [lazzatu] barkhurdorii foni [va firebanda] nest

[Ei mardum] Baroi rasidan ba omurzishi Parvardigoraton va bikh'ishte, ki pakh'noi on kh'amchun pakh'noi osmonu zamin ast, az iakdigar peshi bigired. [In bikh'isht] Baroi kasone omoda shudaast, ki ba Allokh' taolo va paiombaronash imon ovardaand. In [podosh noshi az] fazli ilokh'i ast, onro ba kh'ar ki bikhokh'ad [va shoista bidonad], ato mekunad, ki Allokh' taolo fazlu bakhshishi bekh'ad dorad
Kh'ech' osebe dar zamin va io dar vuch'udi shumo rui nakhokh'ad dod, magar on ki pesh az ech'odash dar daftari [ilmi ilokh'i] rak'am khurdaast. Ba rosti, ki in kor bar Allokh' taolo oson ast
[In nuktaro tazakkur dodem] To bar on chi az dastaton meravad, afsus nakhured va bad-on chi ba dast meovared, sarmast nagarded, ki Allokh' taolo kh'ech' mutakabbiri fakhrfurushero dust namedorad
Kh'amon kasone, ki bukhl mevarzand va mardumro ba bukhl vo medorand va kh'ar ki [az infok'] rui bigardonad, [bidonad, ki] Allokh' taolo beniiozi sutuda ast

Mo paiombaroni kheshro bo nishonakh'oi ravshan firistodem va kh'amrokh'ashon kitobu mizon [-i tashkhisi kh'ak' az botil] nozil kardem, to mardum ba adolat barkhezand. Va okh'an [va soiri fuluzot]-ro padid ovardem, ki dar on kh'am nerue shadid vuch'ud dorad va kh'am manofee baroi mardum. [Chunin kardem] To Allokh' taolo bidonad, chi kasone biduni on ki Parvardigorashonro bubinand, [bo ch'angafzorkh'oi okh'anin] U va paiombaronashro [dar maidonkh'oi ch'ang] iori mekunand. Be tardid, Allokh' taolo nerumandi shikastnopazir ast
Mo Nukh' va Ibrokh'imro [ba risolat] firistodem va dar miioni farzandonashon [mavkh'ibati] paiombari va kitob muk'arrar doshtem. Barkhe az onon rokh' ioftand va bisiore az onon nofarmoni kardand

Sipas ba dunboli onon paiombaroni digaramonro [mab'us kardem] va sipas Iso pisari Mariamro firistodem va Inch'ilro ba u ato namudem va dar dili pairavonash ra'fat va mekh'ruboni nikh'odem, vale [duniogurezi va] rakh'boniiatero, ki bid'at nikh'odand, Mo bar onon muk'arrar nadoshtem va kh'archand kh'adafashon ch'albi khushnudii ilokh'i bud, vale kh'ak'k'i onro [chunonki boiad] rioiat nakardand. Az in ru, Mo ba afrode az eshon, ki imon ovardand, podoshashonro ato kardem, vale bisiore az onon [ba berokh'a raftand va] nofarmon budand

Ei mu'minon, az Allokh' taolo parvo kuned va ba paiombarash [kholisona] imon biiovared, to Allokh' taolo az rakh'mati khesh bakh'rai duchandon ba shumo ato namoiad va baroiaton nure padid ovarad, ki dar partavi on gom bardored va shumoro bibakhshoiad. Ba rosti, ki Allokh' taolo omurzandai mekh'rubon ast

[Inro baion kardem] To akh'li kitob bidonand, ki ba fazlu bakhshishi ilokh'i dastrasi nadorand [va nametavonand onro ba kase ikhtisos dikh'and io az kase bozdorand] va in ki tamomi bartari ba dasti Allokh' taolo ast va ba kh'ar ki bikhokh'ad [va shoista bidonad] ato mekunad. Be gumon, Allokh' taolo fazlu bakhshishi bekh'ad dorad

Allokh' taolo sukhani on zanro shunid, ki bo tu dar borai shavkh'arash sukh'bat mekard va ba Allokh' taolo shikoiat meburd. Allokh' taolo guftugui shumoro meshunavad, charo ki Allokh' taolo shunavoi binost

Kasone az shumo, ki kh'amsaroni kheshro [az likh'ozi kh'urmati kh'ambistari kh'amchun] modari khud talak'k'i mekunand, [bidonand, ki] on zanon kh'argiz modaronashon nakhokh'and bud; modaroni eshon fak'at zanone kh'astand, ki onkh'oro ba dunio ovardaand. Onon sukhane nopisand va nokh'ak' meguiand va [agar tavba kunand] Allokh' taolo bakhshoiandai omurzgor ast

Kasone, ki zanonashonro zikh'or mekunand, sipas az on chi guftaand, bozmegardand, boiad pesh az omezishi ch'insi bo kh'am bardaero ozod kunand. In kh'ukmest, ki ba on [pandu] andarz doda meshaved va Allokh' taolo ba on chi mekuned, ogokh' ast

Pas, kase, ki [bardaero] naiobad, pesh az omezishi ch'insi du mokh' paiopai ruza bigirad va kase, ki nametavonad [ruza bigirad, dar on surat] boiad shast miskinro taom dikh'ad. In [kaffora] baroi on ast, ki ba Allokh' taolo va rasulash imon biiovared va inkh'o kh'ududi [akh'komi] ilokh'i ast va baroi kofiron azobi dardnoke [dar pesh] ast

Kh'amono kasone, ki bo Allokh' taolo va rasulash dushmani mekunand, khor [-u zalil] meshavand, kh'amon guna ki peshiniioni onkh'o niz khor [-u zalil] shudand va ba rosti, Mo oioti ravshane nozil kardem va baroi kofiron azobi khorkunandae [dar pesh] ast

Ruze, ki Allokh' taolo kh'amai onkh'oro [az gur] barmeangezad, sipas onkh'oro az on chi kardaand, bokhabar mesozad, [kh'amon a'mole, ki] Allokh' taolo kh'isobi onro nigakh' doshta, ammo onkh'o faromushash kardaand va Allokh' taolo bar kh'ama chiz guvokh' [va nozir] ast

Magar nadidai, ki Allokh' taolo on chiro, ki dar osmonkh'o va on chiro, ki dar zamin ast, medonad? Kh'ech' nach'voe miioni se nafar naboshad, magar on ki U chakh'orumini onkh'ost va na miioni panch' nafar, magar on ki U shashumini onkh'ost va na kamtar az in [adad] na beshtar, magar on ki kh'ar kuch'o boshand, U kh'amrokh'i onkh'ost. Sipas ruzi k'iiomat onkh'oro az on chi kardaand, bokhabar mesozad. Be gumon, Allokh' taolo ba kh'ama chiz donost

[Ei paiombar,] magar nadidai kasonero, ki az nach'vo nakh'i shudand, sipas ba on chi az on nakh'i shuda budand, bozmegardand va ba gunokh' va tach'ovuz va nofarmoni az paiombar bo kh'am nach'vo mekunand va kh'angome ki nazdi tu meoiand, ba nach'vo ba tu durud mefiristand, ki [kh'atto] Allokh' taolo bo on [kalimot] ba tu durudu salom naguftaast; va [onkh'o] dar dili khud meguiand: <<Charo Allokh' taolo moro ba [kaifari] on chi meguem, azob namekunad?>> Ch'akh'annam baroiashon kofi ast, [ki] ba on vorid meshavand; va chi bad [saranch'om va] ch'oigokh'e ast!

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, kh'angome ki bo iakdigar nach'vo mekuned, ba k'asdi gunokh' va tach'ovuz va nofarmoni az rasul nach'vo nakuned va ba neki va parkh'ezgori nach'vo kuned va az Allokh' taolo bitarsed, ki ba sui U kh'ashr khokh'ed shud.

Ch'uz in nest, ki sukhani pinkh'one [ki much'ibi gunokh' va dushmani megardad] az sui shaiton ast, to kasonero, ki imon ovardaand, [bo onkh'o giriftor kunad va dar natich'a] andukh'gin sozad va [kh'ol on ki u] ch'uz ba farmoni Allokh' taolo nametavonad kh'ech' zarare ba onon birasonad; pas, mu'minon boiad bar Allokh' taolo tavakkal kunand

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, kh'angome ki ba shumo gufta shavad: <<Dar mach'olis ch'o boz kuned>>, pas, [ch'o] boz kuned [ki bo in kor] Allokh' taolo baroi shumo kushoish meovarad va kh'angome ki gufta shavad: <<Barkhezed>>, pas, barkhezed. Allokh' taolo mak'om [-u darach'ot]-i kasone az shumoro, ki imon ovardaand va kasonero, ki ilm doda shudaand, bolo mebarad va Allokh' taolo ba on chi mekuned, ogokh' ast

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, kh'angome ki mekhokh'ed bo rasulullokh' nach'vo kuned, pesh az nach'voiaton sadak'ae [dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo] bidikh'ed. In [kor] baroi shumo bekh'taru pokizatar ast. Ammo agar chize naiofted, be gumon, Allokh' taolo omurzandai mekh'rubon ast

Oio [az fak'r] tarsided, ki pesh az nach'voiaton sadak'akh'oe dikh'ed? Kh'ol ki chunin nakarded va Allokh' taolo az shumo darguzasht, pas, namoz barpo dored va zakot bipardozed, va az Allokh' taolo va Paiombarash itoat kuned va Allokh' taolo ba on chi mekuned, ogokh' ast.

[Ei paiombar] Oio nadidi kasonero, ki bo k'avme dusti kardand, ki Allokh' taolo bar onon khashm [-u g'azab] kardaast; onkh'o na az shumo kh'astand va na az onon [iakh'udiion]; va ba durug' savgand iod mekunand [ki musulmonand], dar kh'ole ki khud medonand [ki munofik'and].
Allokh' taolo azobi sakhte baroi onkh'o omoda kardaast, charo ki be gumon, a'moli bade anch'om medodand
Onkh'o savgandkh'oi khudro sipar [-i balo] k'aror dodand va [mardumro] az rokh'i Allokh' taolo bozdoshtand; pas, azobi khorkunandae [dar pesh] dorand.
Kh'argiz amvolu farzandonashon chize az azobi Allokh'ro az onkh'o daf' nakhokh'ad kard. Onkh'o akh'l [-i otash]-i duzakhand va ch'ovidona dar on memonand

Ruze, ki Allokh' taolo kh'amagii onkh'oro barmeangezad, on gokh' onkh'o baroi U [niz] savgand iod mekunand, kh'amon guna ki [imruz dar dunio] baroi shumo savgand iod mekunand va gumon mekunand, ki bar chize [sudmand] kh'astand. Ogokh' boshed [va bidoned], ki onkh'o durug'guionand
Shaiton bar onkh'o chira shuda va iodi Allokh'ro az khotirashon burdaast. Onkh'o kh'izbi shaiton kh'astand va ogokh' boshed [va bidoned], ki kh'izbi shaiton ziionkorand
Be gumon, kasone, ki bo Allokh' taolo va paiombarash mukholifat [va dushmani] mekunand, dar zumrai khortarin [afrod]-and
Allokh' taolo muk'arrar doshtaast, ki <<iak'inan, manu rasulonam piruz meshavem>>. Be gumon, Allokh' taolo nerumandi shikastnopazir ast.

[Ei paiombar] kh'ech' k'avmero nameiobi, ki ba Allokh' taolo va ruzi k'iiomat imon doshta boshand va bo kasone, ki bo Allokh'u rasulash [dushmani va] mukholifat mevarzand, dusti kunand; agarchi padaronashon io farzandonashon io barodaronashon io kheshovandonashon boshand. Onkh'o kasone kh'astand, ki Allokh' taolo imonro dar [safkh'ai] dilkh'oiashon navishtaast va ba rukh'e az ch'onibi khud onkh'oro tak'viiat [va ta'iid] namudaast va onkh'oro ba bog'kh'oe [az bikh'isht] vorid mekunad, ki az zeri [darakhtoni] on ch'uiborkh'o ch'ori ast, ch'ovidona dar on memonand. Allokh' taolo az onkh'o khushnud ast va onkh'o [niz] az Allokh' taolo khushnudand. Onkh'o kh'izbi Allokh' taolo kh'astand. Ogokh' boshed! Be tardid, kh'izbi Allokh' taolo rastagorand
On chi dar osmonkh'o va on chi dar zamin ast, baroi Allokh' taolo tasbekh' meguiand va U piruzmandi kh'akim ast

Ust, ki kasone az akh'li kitobro, ki kofir shudand, bo nakhustin barkhurd [va girdovarii lashkar] az diiorashon berun rond. Gumon namekarded, ki onkh'o khorich' shudand va khudashon [niz] gumon mekardand, ki dizhkh'o [-i mukh'kam]a-shon onkh'oro az [azobi] Allokh' taolo mone' meshavad; pas, [azobi] Allokh' taolo az ch'oie, ki gumon namekardand, ba surog'ashon omad va dar dilkh'oiashon tarsu vakh'shat afkand, [ba gunae ki] khonakh'oi khudro bo dasti khud va bo dasti mu'minon vairon mekardand; pas, ei sokh'iboni binish, ibrat gired
Agar Allokh' taolo tarki vatan [va ovoragi]-ro bar onon muk'arrar nadoshta bud, iak'inan ononro dar [kh'amin] dunio azob mekard va baroi eshon dar okhirat azobi otash [-i ch'akh'annam] ast

In [ovoragi va azob] ba khotiri on ast, ki onkh'o bo Allokh' taolo va paiombarash mukholifat [va dushmani] kardand va kh'ar kas bo Allokh' taolo mukholifat [va dushmani] kunad, be gumon, Allokh' taolo sakhtkaifar ast
On chi az darakhti khurmo burided va io onro istoda bar reshaash bok'i guzorided, ba farmoni Allokh' taolo bud, to fosik'onro khor [-u rasvo] sozad.

Va on chi Allokh' taolo az [amvoli] onkh'o ba paiombarash bozgardonida [va bakhshida] ast, pas, bar on [amvol] na aspe tokhted va na shuture; vale Allokh' taolo rasulonashro bar kh'ar kas, ki bikhokh'ad, chira megardonad va Allokh' taolo bar kh'ar chiz tavonost

Va on chi Allokh' taolo az [amvoli] akh'li obodikh'o ba paiombarash bozgardonida [va bakhshida] ast, az oni Allokh' taolo va rasul va kheshovandoni u va iatimon va benavoion va darrokh'mondagon ast. To [in amvol] dar miioni sarvatmandoni shumo dast ba dast nashavad; va on chi ki rasulullokh' ba shumo dod, bigired va az on chi ki shumoro az on nakh'i kard, dast bardored va az Allokh' taolo parvo kuned, ki Allokh' taolo sakhtkaifar ast

[In amvol] Baroi fuk'aroi mukh'och'ire ast, ki az khona va amvolashon berun ronda shudand, az Allokh' taolo fazl va khushnudi metalaband va Allokh' taolo va paiombarashro iori mekunand. Onkh'o rostguionand

Va [niz] kasone, ki pesh az onon dar diiori islom [Madina] ch'oi girifta va imon ovardaand, afrodero, ki ba suiashon kh'ich'rat mekunand, dust dorand va dar dilkh'oi khud az on chi [ba mukh'och'iron] doda shuda, ekh'sosi kh'asad [va niioz] namekunand va eshonro bar khud muk'addam medorand, kh'atto agar khud niiozmand boshand; va kasone, ki az bukhl [-u kh'irs]-i nafsi khesh dar amon bimonand [va dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo infok' kunand], onon rastagorand

Va [niz] Kasone, ki pas az onkh'o [pas az mukh'och'ironu ansor] omadaand, meguiand: <<Parvardigoro, mo va barodaronamonro, ki dar imon bar mo peshi giriftand, biiomurz va dar dilkh'oiamon nisbat ba kasone, ki imon ovardaand, kinae k'aror madekh'. Parvardigoro, be gumon, Tu dilsuzi mekh'ruboni>>

Oio munofik'onro nadidi, ki paivasta ba barodaroni akh'li kitobashon, ki kufr varzidaand, meguiand: <<Agar shumoro [az sarzaminaton] berun kunand, mo [niz] bo shumo berun khokh'em omad va kh'argiz [sukhani] kasero dar mavridi shumo itoat nakhokh'em kard va agar bo shumo ch'ang shavad, albatta ioriton khokh'em kard?>>. Allokh' taolo guvokh'i medikh'ad, ki onkh'o durug'gu kh'astand

Agar onkh'o [iakh'udiion]-ro [az vatanashon] berun kunand, eshon kh'amrokh'i onon berun nameravand va agar bo onkh'o ch'ang shavad, ioriashon nakhokh'and kard va agar [kh'am] ioriashon kunand, albatta, pusht [ba maidon] karda, firor mekunand va digar iori nameshavand
[Ei mu'minon] Shumo, kh'atman, dar dilkh'oi onon besh az Allokh' taolo moiai kh'arosed, zero onon mardumone kh'astand, ki namefakh'mand

Onkh'o [iakh'udiion] kh'argiz dastach'am'i bo shumo namech'angand, magar dar rustokh'o [va dizhkh'o]-i mukh'kam io az pushti devorkh'o. Ch'angashon dar miioni khudashon sakht ast. Tu onkh'oro muttakh'id mepindori, dar khole ki dilkh'oiashon parokanda ast, zero onkh'o k'avme kh'astand, ki nameandeshand
[Dostoni in iakh'udiion] Monandi [dostoni] kasonest, ki andake pesh az onon budand [va dar vok'eai Badr] sazoi kor [-i bad]-i khudro chashidand va baroi eshon azobi dardnoke [dar pesh] ast

Kh'amchun [dostoni] shaiton ast, kh'angome ki ba inson guft: <<Kofir shav>>; pas, chun kofir shud, [ba u] guft: <<Man az tu bezoram, [charo ki] man az Allokh' taolo - Parvardigori ch'akh'oniion - metarsam>>
Pas, saranch'om [-i kor]-i onkh'o in shud, ki onkh'o kh'ar du dar otashi [duzakh] khokh'and bud. Ch'ovidona dar on memonand va in ast kaifari sitamgoron.

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, az Allokh' taolo parvo kuned va kh'ar kas boiad bingarad, ki baroi fardo chi pesh firistodaast va az Allokh' taolo bitarsed. Be gumon, Allokh' taolo ba on chi anch'om medikh'ed, ogokh' ast
Va kh'amchun kasone naboshed, ki Allokh'ro faromush kardand, pas, Allokh' taolo [niz] ononro duchori khudfaromushi sokht. Onkh'o [badkoru] nofarmonand
Kh'argiz akh'li ch'akh'annam va akh'li bikh'isht iakson nestand. Akh'li bikh'isht rastagorand
Agar in K'ur'onro bar kukh'e nozil mekardem, iak'inan, onro az tarsi Allokh' taolo khokistar va az kh'am poshida medidi; va in masalkh'oro baroi mardum mezanem, boshad, ki biiandeshand.
U Allokh' taolo ast, ki ch'uz U ma'bude [rostin] nest; donoi g'aib va oshkor ast; U bakhshandai mekh'rubon ast

U Allokh'est, ki ch'uz U ma'bude [bakh'ak'] nest; [Ust] farmonravo, munazzakh', beaib va nuk's, tasdik'kunandai paiombaronash, murok'ib [-i a'moli bandagonash], k'udratmandi shikastnopazir, shukukh'mandu shikastdikh'andai mutlak', volomak'omu shoistai azamat. Allokh' taolo az on chi [baroi U] sharik meovarand, poku munazzakh' ast

U Allokh' taolo ast: kholik'i kh'asti, ofaridgori on az nesti [va] shakldikh'andai makhluk'ot; nomkh'oi nek baroi Ust. On chi dar osmonkh'o va zamin ast, tasbekh'i U meguiand va U k'udratmandi shikastnopazir [va] kh'akim ast.

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, agar baroi ch'ikh'od dar rokh'i Man va talabi khushnudii Man az [vatani khud] berun omadaed, dushmani Manu dushmani khudatonro dust magired, ki ba onkh'o mekh'ruboni kuni; va kh'ol on ki onon ba dini kh'ak'k'e, ki baroi shumo omadaast, kufru inkor varzidaand va paiombar va shumoro ovora kardaand; charo ki ba Allokh' taolo - Parvardigoraton - imon dored. Shumo pinkh'oni bo onkh'o paivandi dusti bark'aror mekuned, dar kh'ole ki Man ba on chi ki pinkh'on medored va on chi ki oshkor mesozed, donotaram; va kh'ar kas az shumo, ki chunin [kore] kunad, iak'inan rokh'i rostro gum kardaast.
Agar onkh'o bar shumo dast ioband, dushmanonaton khokh'and bud va ba ozoraton dastu zabon mekushoiand va dust dorand, ki shumo [niz] kofir garded
Ruzi k'iiomat kh'argiz kheshovandonaton va farzandonaton ba kh'olaton sude nakhokh'and dosht. Allokh' taolo dar miioni shumo ch'udoi meandozad va Allokh' taolo ba on chi anch'om medikh'ed, binost

Iak'inan baroi shumo dar [zindagii] Ibrokh'im va kasone, ki bo u budand, sarmashk'i khube vuch'ud dorad; on gokh' ki ba k'avmi khud guftand: <<Mo az shumo va az on chi g'air az Allokh' taolo meparasted, bezorem; ba shumo kofir shudaem va miioni mo va shumo dushmani va kinai kh'ameshagi padid omadaast, to vak'te ki ba Allokh'i iagona imon ovared>>, magar on sukhani Ibrokh'im, ki ba padarash [Ozar] guft: <<Man baroiat omurzish talab mekunam va dar barobari Allokh' taolo baroi tu ikhtiiori chizero nadoram>>. Parvardigoro, bar Tu tavakkal kardem va ba suii Tu rui ovardem va bozgasht [-i kh'ama] ba sui Tust.
Parvardigoro, moro dastkhushi [fitnai] kofiron k'aror madekh' va moro biiomurz ei Parvardigori mo; kh'amono Tu piruzmandi kh'akimi>>

Musallaman baroi shumo dar [zindagii] onkh'o [Ibrokh'im va ioronash] sarmashk'i khube ast, baroi kasone, ki umed ba Allokh' taolo va ruzi k'iiomat dorand; va kh'ar kas ruigardon shavad, [bidonad, ki] Allokh' taolo beniiozu sutuda ast

Chi baso Allokh' taolo miioni shumo va kasone [az mushrikin], ki bo onkh'o dushmani doshtaed, [paivandi] dusti [va mukh'abbat] bark'aror kunad; va Allokh' taolo tavonost; va Allokh' taolo omurzandai mekh'rubon ast.

Allokh' taolo shumoro az neki kardan va rioiati adolat nisbat ba kasone, ki dar [amri] din bo shumo nach'angidaand va shumoro az diioraton berun nakardaand, nakh'i namekunad. Be gumon, Allokh' taolo adolatpeshagonro dust medorad

[U] Tankh'o shumoro az dusti bo kasone nakh'i mekunad, ki dar [amri] din bo shumo ch'angidaand va shumoro az diioraton berun kardaand va bar berun rondani shumo [ba digaron] kumak kardaand; va kh'ar kas bo onon dusti kunad, ononand, ki sitamgoronand.

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, kh'angome ki zanoni mu'mini mukh'och'ir ba nazdi shumo meoiand, onkh'oro biozmoed; Allokh' taolo ba imonashon donotar ast. Pas, agar onkh'oro [zanoni] mu'min iofted, eshonro ba suii kofiron boznagardoned. Na on zanon bar eshon [kofiron] kh'aloland va na on [mardon] bar in zanoni kh'alol; va kh'ar chi [shavkh'aroni kofir] kharch'i [in zanon] kardaand, ba onkh'o bidikh'ed; va bar shumo gunokh'e nest, ki pas az on ki makh'riiakh'oiashonro pardokhted, bo onon izdivoch' kuned; va ba [nigakh' doshtani paivandi zanoshui bo] zanoni kofir dil nabanded; [va chun zanoni shumo nazdi onon ravand, rakh'oiashon kuned] va on chiro kharch' kardaed, [az eshon] mutoliba kuned; va [kofiron niz] on chiro kharch' kardaand, mutoliba kunand. In kh'ukmi Allokh' taolo ast, ki dar miioni shumo dovari mekunad; va Allokh' taolo donoi kh'akim ast

Agar iake az kh'amsaroni shumo ba suii kofiron raft, on gokh' shumo [dar ch'ang bar onon piruz shuded va] ba intik'om az kofiron barkhosted, pas, ba kasone, ki kh'amsaronashon [ba suii kuffor] raftaand, kh'ammonandi on chiro, ki kharch' kardaand, [az g'anoim] bipardozed; va az Allokh'e, ki shumo ba U imon dored, parvo kuned

Ei paiombar, kh'angome ki zanoni mu'min nazdi tu omadand, to bo tu bai'at kunand, ki chizero bo Allokh' taolo sharik nasozand va duzdi nakunand va murtakibi zino nashavand va farzandoni khudro nakushand va farzandero ba durug' ba shavkh'aronashon nisbat nadikh'and va dar korkh'oi nek az tu nofarmoni nakunand, bo onon bai'at kun va az Allokh' taolo baroiashon omurzish bikhokh'. Be gumon, Allokh' taolo omurzandai mekh'rubon ast

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, bo k'avme, ki Allokh' taolo bar onon khashm [-u g'azab] giriftaast, dusti nakuned. Onkh'o az okhirat ma'iusand, kh'amon guna ki kofiron az gurkhuftagon [murdagoni dar guriston dafnshuda] ma'iusand
On chi dar osmonkh'o va on chi dar zamin ast, tasbekh'i Allokh' taolo meguiand va U piruzmandi kh'akim ast
Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, charo chizero megued, ki [ba on] amal namekuned?
Nazdi Allokh' taolo sakht nopisand [va much'ibi khashm] ast, ki chizero bigued, ki [ba on] amal namekuned.
Be gumon, Allokh' taolo kasonero, ki chun binoi okh'anin saf basta [va] dar rokh'i U paikor mekunand, dust medorad

Va [ei paiombar, ba iod ovar] kh'angomero, ki Muso ba k'avmash guft: <<Ei k'avmi man, charo maro ozor [va aziiat] merasoned, dar kh'ole ki medoned, be gumon, man firistodai Allokh' taolo ba sui shumo kh'astam?>>. Pas, chun onon [az kh'ak'] munkh'arif shudand, Allokh' taolo dilkh'oiashonro munkh'arif sokht; va Allokh' taolo k'avmi nofarmonro kh'idoiat namekunad.

Va [iodovar bosh] kh'angome ki Iso pisari Mariam guft: <<Ei Bani Isroil, be gumon, man firistodai Allokh' taolo ba suii shumo kh'astam. On chi az Tavrot, ki pesh az man buda tasdik' mekunam va [niz] muzhdadikh'anda ba rasule kh'astam, ki ba'd az man meoiad va nomash <<Akh'mad>> ast>>. Pas kh'angome ki u [Akh'mad] bo mu'ch'izakh'o [va daloili ravshan] ba sui onon omad, guftand: <<In ch'odui oshkor ast>>.
Chi kase sitamgortar az on kase ast, ki bar Allokh' taolo durug' bubandad, dar kh'ole ki ba [dini] islom da'vat meshavad? Va Allokh' taolo gurukh'i sitamgoronro kh'idoiat namekunad.
Onkh'o mekhokh'and nuri Allokh'ro bo dakh'oni khud khomush kunand, vale Allokh' taolo komilkunandai nuri khesh ast; kh'archand kofiron khush nadoshta boshand.
Ust, ki paiombarashro bo kh'idoiatu dini kh'ak' firistodaast, to onro bar kh'amai adion piruz gardonad, kh'archand mushrikon nokhushnud boshand
Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, oio [mekhokh'ed] shumoro ba tich'orate rokh'namoi kunam, ki shumoro az azobi dardnok nach'ot dikh'ad?
Ba Allokh' taolo va paiombarash imon biiovared va bo amvol va ch'onkh'oiaton dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo ch'ikh'od kuned. Agar bidoned, in [kor] baroi shumo bekh'tar ast.

[Agar chunin karded, Allokh' taolo] gunokh'onatonro mebakhshad va shumoro dar bog'kh'oe [az bikh'isht] vorid mekunad, ki ch'uiboron az zeri [darakhtoni] on ch'ori ast va dar khonakh'oi pokiza dar bikh'isht ch'ovidon [ch'oi medikh'ad]. In komiobii buzurge ast.
Va [ne'mati] digare, ki onro dust dored, [niz ba shumo inoiat mefarmoiad, ki kh'amono] iori az suii Allokh' taolo va piruzii nazdik ast; va mu'minonro [ba in piruzi] bashorat dekh'.

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, iovaroni [dini] Allokh' taolo boshed; kh'amon guna ki Iso - pisari Mariam - ba kh'avoriiun guft: <<Chi kasone iovaroni man [dar da'vat] ba sui Allokh' taolo kh'astand?>>. Kh'avoriiun guftand: <<Mo iovaroni [dini] Allokh' taolo kh'astem>>. Pas, gurukh'e az Bani Isroil imon ovardand va gurukh'e kofir shudand. On gokh' mo kasonero, ki imon ovarda budand, bar dushmanonashon neru [va tavonoi] dodem, va saranch'om piruz shudand
On chi dar osmonkh'o va on chi dar zamin ast, tasbekh'i Allokh' taolo meguiand; [Allokh' taolo] ki farmonravo, munazzakh' [va] piruzmandu kh'akim ast

Ust, ki az miioni besavodon paiombare az miioni khudashon barangekht, ki oiatkh'oiashro bar onkh'o bikhonad va eshonro pok gardonad va ba onon Kitob [K'ur'on] va kh'ikmat biiomuzad; agarchi pesh az in dar gumrokh'ii oshkor budand
Va [in paiombar] bar gurukh'i digare az onon [niz mab'us shudaast], ki kh'anuz ba onkh'o [naslkh'oi peshin] napaivastaand; va U shikastnopaziri kh'akim ast
In fazli Allokh' taolo ast, ki onro ba kh'ar kas, ki bikhokh'ad, mebakhshad; va Allokh' taolo doroi fazli azim ast

Masali kasone, ki [amal ba] Tavrot ba onon taklif shud, vale onro [chunonchi boiadu shoiad] rioia nakardand, kh'amchun kharest, ki kitobkh'oero kh'aml mekunad [ammo az on chize namefakh'mad]. Chi bad ast masali gurukh'e, ki oioti ilokh'iro takzib kardand! Va Allokh' taolo gurukh'i sitamgoronro kh'idoiat namekunad
Bigu: <<Ei iakh'udiion, agar gumon dored, ki [tankh'o] shumo dustoni Allokh' taolo kh'asted, na mardumi digar, pas, agar rost megued, orzui marg kuned>>
Vale onkh'o ba khotiri on chi az pesh firistodaand, kh'argiz on orzuro nakhokh'and kard; va Allokh' taolo [az kh'oli] sitamgoron ogokh' ast

[Ei Paiombar] Bigu: <<On marge, ki az on firor mekuned, iak'inan, ba shumo khokh'ad rasid, sipas ba suii [Allokh' taolo on] donoi g'aib va oshkor bozgardonda meshaved; on gokh' shumoro az on chi anch'om medoded, ogokh' mesozad>>

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, kh'angome ki dar ruzi ch'um'a baroi namoz azon gufta shavad, ba suii [namozu] zikri Allokh' taolo bishitobed va kharidu furushro rakh'o kuned. Agar bidoned, in baroi shumo bekh'tar ast
Pas, kh'angome ki namoz poion ioft, [baroi kasbi rizk'u ruzi] dar zamin parokanda shaved va az fazli Allokh' taolo talab kuned; va Allokh'ro bisior iod kuned, to rastagor shaved

[Ei Paiombar, barkhe az in mardum] Kh'angome ki tich'orat io sargarmie bubinand, [az atrofi tu] ba suii on parokanda meshavand va turo istoda [bar minbar] rakh'o mekunand. Bigu: <<On chi dar nazdi Allokh' taolo ast, bekh'tar az sargarmi va tich'orat ast; va Allokh' taolo bekh'tarin ruzidikh'anda ast>>

Kh'angome ki munofik'on nazdi tu oiand, [savgand mekhurand va] meguiand: <<Mo guvokh'i medikh'em, ki, iak'inan, tu firistodai Allokh' taolo kh'asti>>; va Allokh' taolo medonad, ki be gumon, tu firistodai U kh'asti va Allokh' taolo guvokh'i medikh'ad, ki munofik'on, iak'inan, durug'gu kh'astand
Onkh'o savgandkh'oi khudro sipar k'aror dodand, pas, [mardumro] az rokh'i Allokh' taolo bozdoshtand. Rosti, ki onon chi bad mekunand!
In bad-on khotir ast, ki onkh'o imon ovardand, sipas kofir shudand, on gokh' bar dilkh'oiashon mukh'r nikh'oda shuda, pas, darnameioband

Va kh'angome ki onkh'oro bubini, ch'ism [va chekh'ra]-ashon turo ba shigift ovarad va agar [sukhan] guiand, [ba khotiri fasokh'ati kalomashon] ba sukhanonashon gush medikh'i. Guio, onkh'o chubkh'oi takiadoda ba devorand, kh'ar bongero alaikh'i khud mepindorand. Onon dushman [-i kh'ak'ik'i] kh'astand; pas, az onon bar kh'azar bosh. Allokh' taolo onkh'oro bikushad! Chi guna [az kh'ak'] munkh'arif meshavand?

Va kh'angome ki ba onkh'o gufta shavad: <<Biioed, to rasulullokh' baroi shumo omurzish bikhokh'ad>>, sarkh'oi khudro takon medikh'and va onkh'oro mebini, ki [az sukhanoni tu] ruigardon meshavand va takabbur mevarzand
Baroi onkh'o iakson ast, ki baroiashon omurzish bikhokh'i io nakhokh'i; Allokh' taolo kh'argiz ononro namebakhshad. Be gumon, Allokh' taolo k'avmi nofarmonro kh'idoiat namekunad

Onkh'o kasone kh'astand, ki meguiand: <<Ba onon, ki nazdi Rasulullokh' kh'astand, [chize] infok' nakuned, to [az girdi u] parokanda shavand; kh'olo onki ganch'inakh'oi osmon va zamin az oni Allokh' taolo ast, vale munofik'on darnameioband

Onkh'o meguiand: <<Agar ba Madina bozgardem, iak'inan sokh'iboni izzat furumoiagonro az on ch'o berun mekunand>>; dar kh'ole ki izzat az oni Allokh' taolo va firistodai U va mu'minon ast; vale munofik'on namedonand
Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, amvolu farzandonaton shumoro az iodi Allokh' taolo g'ofil nakunad; va kh'ar kas, ki chunin kunad, onon ziionkorand

Va az on chi ba shumo ruzi dodaem, [dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo] infok' kuned, pesh az on ki marg ba surog'i iake az shumo oiad va biguiad: <<Parvardigoro, ei kosh [margi] maro muddati kame ba ta'khir meandokhti, to [dar rokh'i tu] sadak'a dikh'am va az nakukoron bosham>>
Va[-le] kh'ar kas ach'alash faro rasad, kh'argiz Allokh' taolo [onro] ba ta'khir nameandozad, va Allokh' taolo az on chi mekuned, ogokh' ast
On chi dar osmonkh'o va on chi dar zamin ast, kh'ama tasbekh'i Allokh' taolo meguiand. Farmonravoi az oni Ust va sipos [-u sitoish niz] az oni Ust va U bar kh'ama chiz tavonost
Ust, ki shumoro ofarid; pas, [gurukh'e] az shumo kofirand va [gurukh'e] az shumo mu'min kh'astand; va Allokh' taolo az on chi mekuned, ogokh' ast
Osmonkh'o va zaminro ba kh'ak' ofarid va shumoro [dar rakh'imi modaronaton] shaklu surat bakhshid. Pas, shaklu suratatonro naku [va zebo] gardond, va bozgasht [-i kh'ama] ba suii Ust
On chiro, ki dar osmonkh'o va zamin ast medonad va on chiro pinkh'on medored va on chiro ki oshkor mekuned, [niz] medonad; va Allokh' taolo az on chi dar sinakh'ost, ogokh' ast
Oio khabari kasonero, ki pesh az in kofir shudand, ba shumo narasidaast? Onkh'o [ta'mi] kaifari kori khudro chashidand va azobi dardnoke khokh'and dosht

In bad-on sabab ast, ki paiombaronashon bo mu'ch'izot [va daloili ravshan] ba suii onon omadand, pas, [onkh'o az rui takabbur] guftand: <<Oio bashare [monandi mo] mekhokh'ad kh'idoiatamon kunad?>>. On gokh' kofir shudand va rui gardondand va Allokh' taolo [az onon va imonashon] beniioz bud; va Allokh' taolo beniiozi sutuda ast

Kasone, ki kofir shudand, gumon burdand, ki kh'argiz barangekhta nakhokh'and shud. Bigu: <<Ore; ba Parvardigoram savgand, iak'inan [kh'ama] barangekhta khokh'ed shud; on gokh' az on chi mekarded, ba shumo khabar khokh'and dod va in [kor] bar Allokh' taolo oson ast>>
Pas, ba Allokh' taolo va Paiombarash va nure, ki nozil kardaem, imon biiovared; va Allokh' taolo az on chi mekuned, ogokh' ast.

Ruze, ki kh'amai shumoro [dar makh'shar] gird meovarad. On ruz ruzi ziionkore ast va kh'ar kas ba Allokh' taolo imon ovarad va korkh'oi shoista anch'om dikh'ad, gunokh'oni uro mebakhshad va uro ba bog'kh'oe [az bikh'isht] vorid mekunad, ki ch'uiborkh'o zeri [darakhtoni] on ch'ori ast; ch'ovidona dar on memonand. In komiobii buzurg ast.
Va kasone, ki kofir shudand va oioti Moro takzib kardand, onon akh'li otash [-i duzakh]-and va ch'ovidona dar on memonand; va chi bad [saranch'om va] ch'oigokh'e ast!

Kh'ech' musibate [ba inson] namerasad, magar ba kh'ukm [-u farmoni] Allokh' taolo; va kh'ar kas ba Allokh' taolo imon ovarad, [Allokh' taolo] k'albashro kh'idoiat mekunad; va Allokh' taolo ba kh'ama chiz donost.
Az Allokh' taolo itoat kuned va rasulro [niz] itoat kuned. Pas, agar rui bigardoned, [bidoned, ki] firistodai Mo vazifae ch'uz iblog'i oshkor nadorad.
Allokh' taolo ast, ki kh'ech' ma'bude [ba kh'ak'] ch'uz U nest; pas mu'minon boiad bar Allokh' taolo tavakkal kunand.

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, ba rosti, ki [ba'ze] az kh'amsaronaton va farzandonaton dushmanoni shumo kh'astand; pas, az onkh'o barkh'azar boshed; va agar afv kuned va chashm bipushed va bibakhshed, be gumon, Allokh' taolo omurzandai mekh'rubon ast.
Ch'uz in nest, ki amvolu farzandonaton vasilai omurzishi [shumo] kh'astand; va Allokh' taolo ast, ki podoshi buzurg nazdi Ust.

Pas to on ch'o ki metavoned, az Allokh' taolo parvo kuned va [kh'ak'ro] bishnaved va farmon bared va infok' kuned, ki baroi khudi shumo bekh'tar ast; va kasone, ki az bukhlu kh'irsi nafsi khesh dar amon bimonand, ononand, ki rastagorand.
Agar ba Allokh' taolo k'arzi naku dikh'ed, onro baroi shumo afzun mekunad va shumoro meomurzad; va Allokh' taolo k'adrshinosi burdbor ast.
[U] Donoi nikh'onu oshkor [va] buzurgu balandmartaba ast

Ei Paiombar, kh'argokh' khosted zanonro talok' dikh'ed, pas, onkh'oro dar zamoni [og'ozi] idda talok' dikh'ed va kh'isobi iddaro nigakh' dored va az Allokh' taolo, ki Parvardigori shumost, parvo kuned. Na shumo onkh'oro az khonakh'oiashon berun kuned va na onkh'o berun ravand; magar on ki kori zishti oshkore murtakib shavand; va in kh'ududi [akh'komi] Allokh' taolo ast va kh'ar kas az kh'ududi Allokh' taolo tach'ovuz kunad, musallaman, ba khud sitam kardaast. Tu namedoni, shoiad Allokh' taolo pas az on, vaz'i tozae farokh'am ovarad [ki ba sulkh'u oshti munch'ar shavad]

Pas, chun [onkh'oro talok' doded va] iddaashon ba sar rasid, eshonro ba tarzi shoistae nigakh' dored io ba tarzi shoistae az onkh'o ch'udo shaved; va du mardi odil az khudatonro guvokh' bigired va shakh'odatro baroi Allokh' taolo barpo dored. In [kh'ukme ast], ki kh'ar kas ba Allokh' taolo va ruzi k'iiomat imon dorad, ba on pandu andarz doda meshavad; va kh'ar kas, ki az Allokh' taolo bitarsad, rokh'i nach'ote baroi u k'aror medikh'ad

Va uro az ch'oie, ki gumon nadorad, ruzi medikh'ad; va kh'ar kas bar Allokh' taolo tavakkal kunad, pas, kh'amon uro kofi ast. Be gumon, Allokh' taolo farmoni khudro ba anch'om merasonad. Musallaman, Allokh' taolo baroi kh'ar chize andozae k'aror dodaast.

Va kasone az zanonaton, ki az odati mokh'ona ma'ius shudaand, agar [ba bordorii onon] shak karded, iddai onon se mokh' ast va [niz] onkh'o, ki kh'aiz nashudaand va iddai zanoni bordor in ast, ki vaz'i kh'aml kunand va kh'ar kas az Allokh' taolo bitarsad korashro baroiash oson mesozad
In farmoni Allokh' taolo ast, ki bar shumo nozil kardaast; va kh'ar kas az Allokh' taolo parvo kunad, Allokh' taolo gunokh'kh'oiashro az u mezudoiad [va mebakhshad] va podoshi uro buzurg megardonad

Onon [zanoni mutallak'a]-ro dar kh'addi tavoni khud kh'ar ch'o ki khudaton sukunat dored, [va dar tavonii shumost] sukunat dikh'ed va ba onkh'o ziion narasoned, to [arsaro] bar onon tang kuned [va pesh az poioni idda mach'bur ba tarki manzil shavand] va agar bordor kh'astand, nafak'ai onkh'oro bidikh'ed, to vaz'i kh'aml kunand. Pas, agar [farzandatonro] baroi shumo shir medikh'and, muzdashonro bipardozed va [in korro] ba neki va bo mashvarati kh'amdigar anch'om dikh'ed; va agar ba tavofuk' narasided, pas zani digare [ba darkhosti shavkh'ar] uro shir dikh'ad

Onon, ki doro [va sarvatmand] kh'astand, boiad az doroi [va sarvati] khud infok' kunand va kase, ki tangdast ast, boiad az on chi ki Allokh' taolo ba u doda infok' kunad. Allokh' taolo kh'ech' kasro ch'uz ba on andoza, ki ba u [tavon] dodaast, mukallaf namekunad. Allokh' taolo ba zudi ba'd az sakhti [va tangdasti] osoni [va kushoish] k'aror medikh'ad

Chi bisior [akh'olii] shakh'rkh'o, ki az farmoni Parvardigorashon va [farmoni] paiombaronash sarpechi kardand; pas, Mo ba shiddat az onkh'o kh'isob kashidem va ba azobe sakht [va sakh'mnok] azobashon kardem.
Pas onon kaifari kori khudro chashidand va saranch'omi korashon ziion bud.
Allokh' taolo azobi sakhte baroiashon mukh'aiio kardaast. Pas, ei khiradmandone, ki imon ovardaed, az Allokh' taolo parvo kuned. Kh'amono Allokh' taolo zikr [K'ur'on]-ro ba suii shumo nozil kardaast

[Va niz] Paiombare [firistoda], ki oioti ravshani Allokh'ro bar shumo mekhonad, to kasonero, ki imon ovarda va korkh'oi shoista anch'om dodaand, az torikikh'o ba suii nur berun ovarad; va kh'ar kas ba Allokh' taolo imon ovarad va kori shoista anch'om dikh'ad, [Allokh' taolo] uro ba bog'kh'oe [az bikh'isht] vorid mekunad, ki az zeri [darakhtoni] on ch'uiborkh'o ch'ori ast; ch'ovidona dar on bimonand. Ba rosti, Allokh' taolo rizk'u ruziashro naku gardonidaast

Allokh' taolo ast, ki kh'aft osmonro ofarid va az zamin [niz] kh'ammonandi onkh'oro [ofarid] va farmoni [Allokh' taolo] paivasta dar miioni onkh'o nozil meshavad, to bidoned, ki Allokh' taolo bar kh'ar chiz tavonost va in ki ilmi Allokh' taolo bar kh'ama chiz ikh'ota dorad

Ei Paiombar, charo chizero, ki Allokh' taolo bar tu kh'alol kardaast, ba khotiri khushnudii kh'amsaronat [bar khud] kh'arom mekuni? Va [bidon, ki dar kh'ama kh'ol] Allokh' taolo omurzandai mekh'rubon ast.
Ba rosti, ki Allokh' taolo shikasti savgandkh'oiatonro [bo dodani kaffora] bar shumo ravo doshtaast; va Allokh' taolo dustdori shumost va U donoi kh'akim ast.

Va kh'angome ki Paiombar ba ba'ze az kh'amsaronash sukhanonero ba roz guft, pas, chun [on kh'amsar] onro [ba digare] khabar dod va Allokh' taolo u [Paiombar]-ro bar on ogokh' kard, k'ismate az onro baroi u baion kard va az k'ismate [digar] khuddori namud. Pas, kh'angome ki [paiombar] uro az on khabar dod, [on zan] guft: <<Chi kase inro ba tu khabar dodaast?>>. [Paiombar] Guft: <<[Allokh'i] donoi ogokh' maro khabar dodaast>>

[Ei kh'amsaroni paiombar] agar shumo du nafar ba dargokh'i Allokh' taolo tavba kuned [ba sudi shumost]; be gumon, dilkh'oiaton [az kh'ak'] munkh'arif gashtaast va agar shumo du nafar bar alaikh'i u kh'amdast [muttafik'] shaved, [bidoned] ki Allokh' taolo dustu iovari ust va [niz] Ch'abrail va mardumoni shoista - az mu'minonu farishtagon - [niz] ba'd az on pushtibon [madadgori u] kh'astand

Chi baso agar shumoro talok' dikh'ad, Parvardigorash kh'amsarone bekh'tar az shumo baroiash ch'oiguzin kunad, [ki] dushizagon io zanoni musulmon, mu'min, farmonbardor, tavbakor, ibodatgar [va] ruzador boshand

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, khud va khonavodaatonro az otashe, ki kh'ezumi on mardumu sangkh'ost nigakh' dored; [otashe, ki] bar on farishtagoni khashin va sakhtgir [gumorida shudaand], ki kh'argiz az Allokh' taolo dar [mavridi] on chi ba onon farmon doda, nofarmoni namekunand va kh'ar chi farmon meioband, anch'om medikh'and.
Ei kasone, ki kofir shudaed, imruz uzrkhokh'i nakuned. Ch'uz in nest, ki dar barobari on chi mekarded, ch'azo doda meshaved

Ei kasone, ki imon ovardaed, ba suii Allokh' taolo tavba kuned, tavbae kholisona. Umed ast Parvardigoraton gunokh'onatonro az shumo bizudoiad va shumoro ba bog'kh'oe [az bikh'isht] vorid kunad, ki ch'uiborkh'o az zeri [darakhtoni] on ch'ori ast. Dar ruze ki Allokh' taolo paiombar va kasonero ki kh'amrokh'i u emon ovardaand khor namekunad. Nurashon peshopeshi onon ba samti rostashon dar kh'arakat ast, meguiand: <<Parvardigoro, nuri moro ba tamom [va kamol] birason va moro biiomurz. Be gumon, Tu bar kh'ar chiz tavonoi>>.
Ei Paiombar, bo kofironu munofik'on ch'ikh'od kun va bar onkh'o sakht bigir va ch'oigokh'ashon ch'akh'annam ast; va chi bad ch'oigokh'e ast!

Allokh' taolo baroi kasone, ki kofir shudaand, kh'amsari Nukh' va kh'amsari Lutro masal zadaast, ki on du dar nikokh'i du tan az bandagoni solekh'i Mo budand, pas, ba on du khiionat kardand va [on du bandai solekh'] natavonistand, chize az [azobi] Allokh'ro az on du [zan] daf' kunand va [ba onkh'o] gufta shud: <<Kh'amrokh'i voridshavandagoni ba otashi [ch'akh'annam shumo niz] vorid shaved>>

Allokh' taolo baroi kasone, ki imon ovardaand, kh'amsari Fir'avn [Osiia]-ro masal zadaast, kh'angome ki guft: <<Parvardigoro, khonae baroiam nazdi khud dar bikh'isht bisoz va maro az Fir'avn va kirdorash nach'ot bidekh' va maro az k'avmi sitamgar rakh'oi bakhsh>>

Va [niz] Mariam - dukhtari Imron - ro [masal zadaast], ki sharmgokh'i kheshro [pok] nigakh' dosht, pas, Mo az rukh'i khud dar on damidem va [u] kalimoti Parvardigorash va kitobkh'oi Uro tasdik' kard va az farmonbardoron bud
Purbarakatu buzurgvor ast kase, ki farmonravoii ch'akh'oni kh'asti ba dasti Ust va U bar kh'ar chiz tavonost
[Kh'amon] Kase, ki margu zindagiro ofarid, to shumoro biozmoiad, ki kadom iake az shumo nakukortar ast; va U piruzmandu bakhshanda ast
On ki kh'aft osmonro bar farozi iakdigar ofarid. Dar ofarinish [-i Allokh' taolo] kh'ech' benazmi va khalale namebini. Bori digar nigokh' kun; oio nuk'se mebini?
Bori digar [ba olami kh'asti] nigokh' kun; [nuk'se nakhokh'i did va] chashmi tu, dar kh'ole ki khasta va notavon ast ba suii tu bozmegardad
Ba rosti, Mo osmoni dunioro bo charog'kh'o orostem va onkh'oro baroi rondani shaiotin k'aror dodem va baroi onon azobi [otashi] suzon omoda sokhtem
Va baroi kasone, ki ba Parvardigorashon kofir shudand, azobi ch'akh'annam ast; va chi bad ch'oigokh'e ast!
Kh'angome ki dar on andokhta shavand, az on na'rae [vakh'shatnok] meshunavand, dar kh'ole ki on mech'ushad
Az shiddati khashm nazdik ast [ch'akh'annam] pora-pora shavad. Kh'ar gokh' ki gurukh'e dar on andokhta meshavand, nigakh'bononash az onon mepursand: <<Oio bimdikh'andae ba surog'aton naomad?>>
Meguiand: <<Bale; bimdikh'anda ba sui mo omad, on gokh' mo uro takzib kardem va guftem; <<Kh'argiz Allokh' taolo chize nozil nakardaast. Shumo ch'uz dar gumrokh'ii buzurg nested>>
Va [boz] meguiand: <<Agar mo meshunidem io taak'k'ul mekardem, dar [zumrai] duzakhiion nabudem>>
Pas, onkh'o ba gunokh'i khud e'tirof mekunand. Pas, duri [az rakh'mati Allokh' taolo] bakh'rai duzakhiion bod!
Be gumon, kasone, ki dar nikh'on az Parvardigorashon metarsand, onon omurzishu podoshi buzurge dorand
[Khokh'] Guftori khudro pinkh'on dored io onro oshkor sozed, [ba kh'ar kh'ol] U ba on chi dar dilkh'ost, ogokh' ast
Oio kase, ki [kh'amai mavch'udotro] ofaridaast, [kh'oli bandagonro] namedonad? Dar kh'ole ki U borikbin va ogokh' ast
U kase ast, ki zaminro baroi shumo rom gardonid, pas, dar gusha va kanori on rokh' biraved va az ruzii U bikhured; va bozgasht [-i kh'ama] ba suii Ust
Oio khudro az [azobi] kase, ki dar osmon ast, dar amon medoned, ki [farmon dikh'ad] zamin shumoro furu barad va nogakh'on ba larzish daroiad?
Io khudro az kase, ki dar osmon ast, dar amon medoned, ki tufoni sakhte bar shumo firistad? Pas, ba zudi khokh'ed donist, ki kh'ushdori Man chi guna ast!
Kh'amono kasone, ki pesh az onon budand, [niz da'vati paiombaronro] takzib kardand; pas, [bingar, ki] uk'ubati Man chi guna bud!

Oio ba parandagone, ki bar farozi sarashon ast, nigokh' nakardand, ki gokh'e bolkh'oi khudro megushoiand va gokh'e furu mebandand? Ch'uz [Allokh'i] Rakh'mon [kase] onkh'oro [bar farozi osmon] nigokh' namedorad; be gumon, U ba kh'ar chiz binost
Oio on kase, ki lashkari shumost, metavonad shumoro dar barobari Allokh' taolo iori dikh'ad? Kofiron ch'uz dar fireb [va g'ururashon] nestand
Io on kase, ki shumoro ruzi medikh'ad, agar ruziashro bozdorad, [chi kase metavonad niiozi shumoro ta'min kunad?]. Vale onkh'o dar sarkashi va firor az kh'ak'ik'at lach'och'at mevarzand
Oio kase, ki ba ru aftoda [va nagunsor] kh'arakat mekunad, ba kh'idoiat nazdiktar ast, io on ki rostu ustuvor bar rokh'i rost gom barmedorad?
Bigu: <<U kase ast, ki shumoro ofarid va baroiaton gushu chashmon va dil k'aror dod; [ammo shumo] andake siposguzori mekuned>>
Bigu: <<U kasest shumoro dar zamin parokand va ba suii U kh'ashr meshaved>>
Va meguiand: <<Agar rost megued, in va'da [-i k'iiomat] chi zamone ast?>>
Bigu: <<Ilm [-i k'iiomat] tankh'o nazdi Allokh' taolo ast va man fak'at bimdikh'andai oshkoram>>

Pas, chun on [va'da va azobi ilokh'i]-ro az nazdik bubinand, chekh'rai kasone, ki kofir shudaand, siiokh'u andukh'gin megardad va [ba onon] gufta meshavad: <<In kh'amon chize ast, ki darkhost mekarded>>

[Ei Paiombar] Bigu: <<Ba man khabar dikh'ed, agar Allokh' taolo maro va kasonero, ki bo man kh'astand, nobud kunad, io bar mo rakh'mat ovarad, pas, kist, ki kofironro az azobi dardnok panokh' dikh'ad?>>
Bigu: <<U [Allokh'i] Rakh'mon ast? ba U imon ovardaem va bar U tavakkal kardaem, pas, [ei kofiron] ba zudi khokh'ed donist, ki chi kase dar gumrokh'ii oshkor ast>>
[Ei paiombar] Bigu: <<Ba man khabar dikh'ed, agar obi [oshomidanii] shumo [dar zamin] furu ravad, chi kase metavonad baroi shumo obi ravonu guvoro] biiovarad?>>
Nun. Savgand ba k'alam va on chi menavisand
Ki tu [ei paiombar] ba ne'mat [va fazli] Parvardigorat devona nesti
Va baroi tu podoshe bepoion [dar pesh] ast
Va iak'inan tu akhlok'i bisior naku va voloe dori
Pas, ba zudi khokh'i did va onkh'o [niz] khokh'and did,
ki kadom iak az shumo devona ast
Parvardigorat bekh'tar medonad, chi kase az rokh'i U gumrokh' gashta va [niz] U ba kh'idoiatioftagon donotar ast
Pas az takzibkunandagon itoat makun
Onkh'o dust medorand [va mekhokh'and], ki narmi [va madoro] kuni, to onon [niz] narmi [va madoro] kunand
Va az kh'ar furumoiae, ki bisior savgand [-i durug'] iod mekunad, itoat makun
[On ki] Bisior aibch'ust va ba sukhanchini omadushud mekunad
Va bisior monei kori khair va mutach'ovizu gunakh'gor ast
Guzashta az on, khashinu betabor va badnom ast
Bad-on khotir, ki sokh'ibi molu farzandoni bisior ast
Kh'angome ki oioti Mo bar u khonda shavad, meguiad: <<[Inkh'o] Afsonakh'oi guzashtagon ast>>
Ba zudi bar binii u dog' [-i nangu rasvoi] menikh'em
Mo onkh'oro ozmoish kardem, kh'amon guna ki sokh'iboni bog'ro ozmudem, kh'angome ki savgand iod kardand, ki subkh'gokh'on [ki mustamandon naboshand] mevakh'oi bog'ro bichinand
Va [-le] <<inshoallokh'>> naguftand
Pas, azobe [farogir] az suii Parvardigorat bar [bog'i] onkh'o furud omad, dar kh'ole ki kh'ama dar khob budand
Pas, on bog' [-i sabzu khurram pas az otashsuzi] kh'amchun shabi siiokh' shud
On gokh' subkh'gokh'on iakdigarro nido dodand
Ki agar mekhokh'ed, darav kuned, ba suii kishtzor [va bog']-i khesh biraved
Pas [ba suii kishtzor] kh'arakat kardand, dar kh'ole ki okh'ista bo kh'am meguftand:
<<[Murok'ib boshed] Ki imruz kh'ech' [niiozmand va] benavoe dar on [bog'] vorid nashavad!>>
Va subkh'gokh'on bo tasmimi ch'iddi bar ch'ilavgiri [az vurudi mustamandon ba samti bog'] berun shudand
Pas, kh'angome ki on [bog']-ro didand, guftand: <<Iak'inan mo [ishtibokh' omadaem va] rokh'ro gum kardaem
balki kh'ama chizro az dast dodaem
Iake az bekh'tarin [va khiradmandtarin]-i eshon guft: <<Oio ba shumo naguftam, charo [shukru] tasbekh' [-i Allokh'ro] namegued?>>
Guftand: <<Parvardigori mo poku munazzakh' ast. Musallaman, mo sitamgor budem>>
On gokh' malomatkunon ba iakdigar ru ovardand
[va] Guftand: <<Voi bar mo, ki tug'iongar [va sarkash] budem!
Umedvorem, ki Parvardigoramon [moro bibakhshad va] dar ivaz chize bekh'tar az on [bog'] ba mo dikh'ad, [charo ki] be gumon, mo ba sui Parvardigori khud rui ovardaem>>
Azobi [Allokh' taolo dar dunio] chunin ast va agar medonistand, azobi okhirat musallaman buzurgtar [-u beshtar] ast.
Ba rosti, baroi parkh'ezkoron nazdi Parvardigorashon bog'kh'oi purne'mat ast
Oio mo musulmononro kh'amchun much'rimon [va gunakh'goron] k'aror medikh'em?
Shumoro chi shudaast? Chi guna dovari mekuned?
Oio shumo kitobe [osmoni] dored, ki dar on faromegired?
Va [oio] on chiro intikhob mekuned, dar on [kitob] baroi shumo [navishta shuda] ast?
Io in ki bar [ukh'dai] Mo akh'du paimoni ustuvore to ruzi k'iiomat dored, ki kh'ar chiro kh'ukm kuned, [kh'ak'] baroi shumo boshad?
[Ei Paiombar,] az onkh'o bipurs kadom iak az onon dar barobari in [iddaokh'o] mutaakh'kh'id ast?
Va io in ki [ma'budon va] sharikone dorand? Pas agar rost meguiand, boiad sharikon [va ma'budoni] kheshro biiovarand
Ruze, ki [sok' oshkor gardad va] kor sakhtu dushvor shavad va [mardum] ba sach'da faro khonda meshavand, vale [kofiron va munofik'on] nametavonand [sach'da kunand]

[Dar kh'ole ki] Didagonashon [az tarsu nadomat] furu aftoda va zillatu khori vuch'udashonro faro giriftaast va, iak'inan, pesh az in [dar dunio] dar kh'ole ki tandurust budand, ba sach'da faro khonda meshudand

Pas, [ei Paiombar] Maro bo on kase, ki in sukhan [K'ur'on]-ro takzib mekunad, voguzor. Mo ononro andak-andak [va] ba gunae ki darnaioband [va az ch'oe ki mutavach'ch'ekh' nagardand], ba suii azob khokh'em kashond
Va ba onon mukh'lat medikh'am. Ba rosti, ki tadbiri Man ustuvor [va kh'isobshuda] ast
[Ei Paiombar] Magar tu az eshon muzde darkhost mekuni, ki [az adoi on dar ranch'and va] bar eshon sangin ast?
Io [asrori] g'aib nazdi onkh'ost va onon [on chiro meguiand, az rui on] menavisand
Pas, [ei paiombar] baroi farmon [va kh'ukmi] Parvardigorat sabr kun va monandi sokh'ibi mokh'i [Iunus] mabosh, ki bo dile sharmsor az khashmu andukh' [Allokh'ro] nido dod.
Agar ne'mat [-u rakh'mate] az sui Parvardigorash ba iorii u naomada bud, iak'inan, dar kh'ole ki nakukh'ida bud, [az shikami mokh'i] ba sakh'roi khushkida berun afkanda meshud
Pas, Parvardigorash uro barguzid va az solekh'on k'aror dod
Va [ei paiombar] nazdik ast onon, ki kofir shudand, kh'angome ki oioti K'ur'onro meshunavand, turo chashmzakhm zanand va [ba khotiri khashmu kh'asadashon] meguiand: <<Kh'atman, u devona ast>>
Dar kh'ole ki in [K'ur'on] ch'uz pande baroi ch'akh'oniion nest.
[Ruzi] Vok'e'shudani [rastokhez]
On vok'e'shudani chist?
Va tu chi doni on vok'e'shudani chist [va chi guna ast]?
[K'avmi] Samud va [k'avmi] Od [k'iiomati] darkh'amkubandaro takzib kardand
Va ammo [k'avmi] Samud ba bongi sakh'mgin kh'alok shudand
Va ammo [k'avmi] Od bo tundbode sarkash va sard ba kh'alokat rasidand

[Allokh' taolo] kh'aft shabu kh'aft ruz paiopai on [azob]-ro bar onkh'o musallat namud. Pas, [agar on ch'o budi] [on] k'avmro [dar asari on tundbod] monandi tanakh'oi pusidai darakhtoni khurmo bar zamin aftoda [va kh'alokshuda] medidi
Pas, oio az onkh'o kasero mebini, ki bok'i monda boshad?
Va Fir'avnu kasone, ki pesh az u budand va [mardumi] shakh'rkh'oi vaironshudai [k'avmi Lut] murtakibi gunokh'oni [buzurg] shudand
Pas, onkh'o az [farmoni] firistodai Parvardigorashon sarpechi kardand, on gokh' [Allokh' taolo] ononro ba azobi sakhte giriftor kard
Kh'angome ki ob tug'ion kard, Mo shumoro dar kishti savor kardem
To pande baroi shumo k'aror dikh'em va gushkh'oi shunavo onro bishnavand va ba iod bisporand
Pas, on gokh' ki iak bor dar sur damida shavad
Va zaminu kukh'kh'o az ch'o kanda shuda va iakbora darkh'am kubida [va mutaloshi] shavand
Dar on ruz vok'eai [azimi] k'iiomat ba vuk'u'] mepaivandad
Va osmon shikofta meshavad va dar on ruz sust megardad [va furu merezad]
Va farishtagon bar kanorakh'oi on [osmon] k'aror megirand va on ruz kh'asht [farishta] arshi Parvardigoratro bar sari khud kh'aml mekunand
Dar on ruz shumo [kh'amagi baroi kh'isobrasi ba peshgokh'i Allokh' taolo] arza meshaved va kh'ech' chiz az [korkh'oi] shumo pinkh'on nakhokh'ad mond
Ammo kase, ki nomai [a'molash]-ro ba dasti rostash dikh'and, meguiad: <<Biioed, noma [-i a'mol] -i maro bikhoned
Man iak'in doshtam, ki bo kh'isob [-i a'mol]-i khud muvoch'ekh' khokh'am shud>>
Pas, u dar iak zindagii pisandida [va rizoiatbakhsh] khokh'ad bud
Dar bikh'ishte barin
Ki mevakh'oiash [baroi chidan] dar dastras ast
[Va ba onkh'o gufta meshavad]: <<Ba [khotiri] on chi dar aiiomi guzashta pesh firistodaed, bikhured va biioshomed, guvoroiaton bod>>
Va ammo kase, ki noma [-i a'mol]-ashro ba dasti chapash dikh'and, meguiad: <<Ei kosh, kh'argiz noma [-i a'mol] - amro ba man namedodand
Va namedonistam, kh'isobam chist!
Ei kosh, [bo marg] kh'ama chiz tamom meshud [va poioni kor bud]!
Molu doroiiam maro beniioz nakard [va sude nabakhshid]
K'udratu farmonravoiiam [niz] az [dasti] man raft [va ba kulli nobud shud]>>
[Ba farishtagon gufta meshavad] <<Uro bigired va dar bandu zanch'ir kuned
Sipas uro ba [otashi] duzakh biiafkaned.
On gokh' vairo dar zanch'ire bibanded, ki tulash kh'aftod ziro' ast
Be gumon, u kh'argiz ba Allokh'i buzurg imon nameovard
Va kh'argiz [mardumro] bar taom dodani benavo[-ion] tashvik' namekard
Pas, imruz dar in ch'o dusti samimi [va mekh'rubone] nadorad [ki ioriash kunad]
Va g'izoe ba ch'uz chirku khun nadorad
[G'izoe, ki] Ch'uz gunakh'goron onro namekhurand>>
Pas, savgand ba on chi mebined
Va ba on chi namebined
Be tardid, in [K'ur'on sukhani Allokh' taolo ast, ki iblog'ash ba paiombar bar ukh'dai] firistodai buzurgvor [Ch'abrail] ast
Va inkh'o guftori shoire nest, [ammo shumo kofiron] kamtar imon meovared
Va [niz] guftori kokh'ine nest, [ammo shumo] kamtar pand megired.
Az suii Parvardigori ch'akh'oniion nozil shudaast
Va agar [paiombar] sukhanon [-i durug'] bar Mo mebast
Musallaman, Mo dasti rosti uro megiriftem
Sipas [shokh'] ragi k'albashro k'at' mekardem
Va kh'ech' iak az shumo nametavonist mone' [-i azob]-i u gardad
Iak'inan, in [K'ur'on] pandu tazkire baroi parkh'ezkoron ast
Va Mo iak'inan, medonem, ki barkhe az shumo takzibkunandagon [-i in kalomi ilokh'i] kh'asted
Va kh'amono in [K'ur'on] bar kofiron moiai kh'asratu nadomat ast
Va be gumon, in [K'ur'on] kh'ak'ik'ati rostin ast
Pas, [ei paiombar] bo [zikri] nomi Parvardigori buzurgat [Uro] tasbekh' gui
Darkhostkunandae [ba tamaskhur] tak'ozoi azobero kard, ki vuk'uash [dar k'iiomat] kh'atmi ast
[In azob] Baroi kofiron ast [va] kh'ech' daf'kunandae nadorad
Az suii Allokh' taolo [ba vuk'u' mepaivandad, ki] sokh'ibi marotib va darach'oti volost
Farishtagon va Rukh' [Ch'abrail] ba suii U uruch' mekunand, dar ruze, ki mik'dorash [dar mik'iosi bashari] panch'okh' kh'azor sol ast
Pas, tu [ei paiombar, dar barobari tamaskhuri eshon] sabri naku pesha kun
Be gumon, onkh'o on [ruz]-ro dur mebinand
Va Mo onro nazdik mebinem
[Kh'amon] Ruze, ki osmon chun misi gudokhta shavad
Va kukh'kh'o monandi pashmi rangin [mutaloshi va parokanda] shavad
Va kh'ech' dusti samimi [va kheshovande] az [kh'oli] dusti samimi [va kheshovandash] namepursad
[Dar kh'ole ki] Onon ba iakdigar nishon doda meshavand, gunakh'gor [dust dorad va] orzu mekunad, ki farzandoni khudro dar barobari [rakh'oi az] azobi on ruz bidikh'ad
Va [kh'amchunin] kh'amsaru barodarashro
va k'abilaashro, ki [kh'amesha] ba u ch'o va panokh' medod
Va [kh'amchunin] kh'amai onkh'oero, ki ruii zamin kh'astand, [fido kunad] to nach'ot iobad
[Ammo] Kh'argiz chunin nest! Be gumon, on shu'lakh'oi [otashi] suzon ast
[Ki] pust az sar barmekanad
Kasonero, ki [ba farmoni Allokh' taolo] pusht kardand va [az kh'ak'] rui gardonidand, [ba sui khud] faro mekhonad
Va [niz kasonero, ki] amvolro ch'am'ovari va zakhira kardand [va kh'ak'k'i onro napardokhtand]
Iak'inan, inson kamtok'at [-u kh'aris] ofarida shudaast
Kh'ar gokh' badi [va musibate] ba u rasad, betobi mekunad
Va kh'ar gokh' khubi ba u rasad, bozdoranda [va bakhil] megardad
Magar namozguzoron
Kh'amon kasone, ki bar namozkh'oiashon kh'amesha poidori mekunand.
Va kasone, ki dar amvolashon kh'ak'k'i [muaiianu] ma'lume kh'ast
Baroi mustamand va makh'rum
Va [kh'amon] kasone, ki ruzi ch'azoro tasdik' mekunand
Va kasone, ki az azobi Parvardigorashon metarsand
[Charo ki] Be gumon, az azobi Parvardigorashon dar amon natavonand bud
Va kasone, ki sharmgokh'kh'oiashonro nigakh' medorand
Magar bo kh'amsaronu kanizone, ki moliki onkh'o kh'astand, ki [dar in surat] sarzanishe bar onkh'o nest
Pas, kh'ar kas farotar az inkh'oro bikhokh'ad, onon mutach'ovizon kh'astand
Va kasone, ki amonatkh'o va paimonkh'oiashonro rioia mekunand
Va kasone, ki ba shakh'odatkh'oi khud mutaakh'kh'idand
Va kasone, ki bar namozashon poidori mekunand
Inon dar bog'kh'o [-i bikh'isht] giromi doshta meshavand
Pas, [ei paiombar] kofironro chi shudaast, ki ba suii tu meshitoband?
[Va] Az rostu chap gurukh'-gurukh' [kh'uch'um meovarand?]
Oio kh'ar kadom az onkh'o [bo on a'moli nopisandashon] tama' dorand, ki dar bikh'ishti purne'mat [-i ilokh'i] darovarda shavand?
Kh'argiz chunin nest! Be gumon, Mo onkh'oro az on chi [khud] medonand, ofaridaem
Pas, ba Parvardigori mashrik'kh'o va mag'ribkh'o savgand mekhuram, ki Mo iak'inan k'odirem
Bar in ki [kasoni digare] bekh'tar az eshonro ch'oiguzin kunem va Mo [baroi anch'omi in kor] darmonda va notavon nestem
Pas, [ei paiombar] ononro ba kh'oli khud voguzor, to dar botili khud furu ravand va bozi kunand, to ba ruze birasand, ki bad-eshon va'da doda shudaast
[Kh'amon] Ruze, ki shitobon az k'abrkh'o khorich' meshavand, gui ba suii butkh'o medavand
[Dar kh'ole ki] Chashmkh'oiashon [az sharmu vakh'shat] ba zer aftoda va zillat [-u khori] ononro pushidaast. In kh'amon ruzest, ki ba eshon va'da doda meshavad
Be gumon, Mo Nukh'ro ba suii k'avmash firistodem [va guftem]: <<K'avmi khudro - pesh az on ki azobi dardnok ba surog'ashon oiad - kh'ushdor dekh' [va bitarson]
[Nukh'] Guft: <<Ei k'avm, man baroi shumo bimdikh'andae oshkor kh'astam
Ki Allokh'ro biparasted va az U parvo namoed va mutei [dasturkh'oi] man boshed

[Pas, agar chunin karded, Allokh' taolo] gunokh'oni shumoro meomurzad va shumoro to zamoni muaiiane mukh'lat medikh'ad, zero kh'angome ki ach'ali ilokh'i faro rasad, ta'khir nakhokh'ad dosht, agar medonisted>>
Va Nukh' [pas az nasikh'atu da'vat] guft: <<Parvardigoro, ba rosti, ki man k'avmi khudro shabu ruz [ba imon] da'vat kardam
Vale da'vati man ch'uz ba gurezashon [az kh'ak'] naafzud

Va man kh'ar chi da'vatashon kardam, to saranch'omi ononro biiomurzi, angushtoni khudro dar gushkh'oiashon furu kardand va liboskh'oiashonro [ba khud] pechidand va [dar mukholifat] isror [-u pofishori] kardand va ba shiddat gardankashi va takabbur namudand
On gokh' onkh'oro bo sadoi baland [va oshkor] da'vat kardam
On gokh' oshkoro baroiashon guftam va dar nikh'on baroi [kh'ar kadom az] onon baion kardam
Pas, guftam: <<Az Parvardigori khesh omurzish bikhokh'ed [ki] be gumon, U bisior omurzanda ast
To az osmon [boroni] paiopai bar shumo bifiristad
Va shumoro bo amvolu farzandoni bisior iori kunad, ba shumo bog'kh'oi [sarsabz] bidikh'ad va baroiaton ch'uiborkh'o[-i ch'ori] k'aror dikh'ad
Shumoro chi shudaast, ki baroi Allokh' taolo azamat [-u shukukh'] k'oil nested?
Dar kh'ole ki shumoro dar marokh'ili gunogun ofarid
Oio namebined, chi guna Allokh' taolo kh'aft osmonro bar farozi iakdigar ofarid?
Va mokh'ro dar miioni osmonkh'o moiai rushnoi k'aror dod va khurshedro charog'i [furuzone] gardonid?
Va Allokh' taolo shumoro kh'amchun giiokh'e az zamin ruionid
Sipas shumoro ba on [zamin] bozmegardonad va bori digar shumoro berun meovarad
Va Allokh' taolo zaminro baroi shumo gusturda sokht
To az rokh'kh'oi pakh'novari on [ba suii mak'sadi khud] raftuomad kuned>>
Nukh' guft: <<Parvardigoro, onkh'o az man nofarmoni namudand va az kase pairavi kardand, ki molu farzandash chize ch'uz ziionkori bar u naafzudaast
Va [on peshvoioni gumrokh'] nairangi buzurge ba kor burdand
Va guftand: <<Ma'budoni khudro rakh'o nakuned va [ba khusus] <<Vadda>> va <<Suvo'>> va <<Iag'us>> va <<Ia'uk'>> va <<Nasr>>-ro [rakh'o nakuned]
Ba rosti, onkh'o bisiorero gumrokh' kardand va [tu ei Parvardigor] sitamgoronro ch'uz gumrokh'i maafzoi>>
[Saranch'om onon] Ba kaifari gunokh'onashon [kh'amagi] g'ark' shudand, pas, dar otash [-i duzakh] darovarda shudand va dar barobari [azobi] ilokh'i iovar [-u madadgore] baroi khud naioftand
Nukh' guft: <<Parvardigoro, kh'ech' iak az kofironro bar ruii zamin bok'i maguzor
Charo ki agar onkh'oro bok'i guzori, bandagonatro gumrokh' mekunand va ch'uz [nasle] badkor va kofir ba vuch'ud nameovarand

Parvardigoro, maro va padaru modaram va kh'ar on kasero, ki bo imon voridi khonai man meshavad va [tamomi] mardoni mu'min va zanoni mu'minro biiomurz va sitamgoronro ch'uz kh'alokat [va nobudi] maafzo>>
[Ei paiombar] Bigu: <<Ba man vakh'i shudaast, ki gurukh'e az ch'inniion [ba in K'ur'on] gush faro dodaand, pas, guftand: <<Be gumon, mo K'ur'one shigiftovar shunidem
Ki ba rokh'i rost kh'idoiat mekunad. Pas, mo ba on imon ovardem va kh'argiz kasero bo Parvardigoramon sharik k'aror namedikh'em
Va in ki sha'nu azamati Parvardigoramon bas [azimu] baland ast. U [kh'argiz baroi khud] kh'amsaru farzande intikhob nakardaast
Va in ki safekh' [-u nodon]-i mo [shaiton] dar borai Allokh' taolo sukhanoni noravoe meguft
Va mo [chunin] gumon mekardem, ki kh'argiz insu ch'in bar Allokh' taolo durug' namebandand
Va in ki mardone az odamiion ba mardone az ch'inniion panokh' meburdand va [bad-in vasila] bar gumrokh'i va sarkashii eshon meafzudand
Va in ki onon [kofiron] gumon mekardand - kh'amon guna ki shumo [ch'inniion] mepindoshted - ki Allokh' taolo kh'ech' kasro [dubora] zinda namegardonad
Va in ki mo osmonro ch'ustuch'u kardem, pas, onro pur az mukh'ofizoni nerumand va tirkh'oi shikh'ob ioftem
Va in ki dar [osmon] baroi shunidan ba kamin menishastem, [ammo] aknun kh'ar ki bikhokh'ad ba gush boshad, tiri shikh'obe dar kamini khud meiobad
Va in ki mo namedonem, oio baroi akh'li zamin sharre iroda shuda, io Parvardigorashon khairu kh'idoiati eshonro khostaast
Va in ki dar miioni mo afrode solekh' va afrode nodurust, mo gurukh'kh'oe mutafovit [va gunogun] kh'astem
Va in ki mo iak'in dorem, ki kh'argiz nametavonem dar ruii zamin Allokh'ro och'izu notavon kunem va kh'argiz bo gurez nametavonem, Uro notavon sozem [va rokh'i firore nadorem]
Va in ki mo kh'angome ki [sukhani] kh'idoiatro shunidem, ba on imon ovardem. Pas, kh'ar kase, ki ba Parvardigorash imon ovarad, na az nuk'son mekh'arosadu na az sitam [bim dorad]
Va in ki gurukh'e az mo musulmon va gurukh'e kofir [va zolim] kh'astand. Pas, kh'ar kas, ki islom ovarda, ononand, ki rokh'i rastagoriro ch'ustuch'u karda [va barguzida]-and
Va ammo kofiron [va sitamgoron] kh'ezumi [otashi] ch'akh'annam khokh'and bud
Va in ki agar onkh'o bar rokh'i rost poidori kunand, albatta, bo obi farovon serobashon mekunem
To onkh'oro bo on [ne'matkh'o] biozmoem. Va kh'ar kas az iod [-u zikri] Parvardigorash ru bartobad, [Allokh' taolo] uro ba azobe sakht giriftor mesozad
Va in ki masoch'id az oni Allokh' taolo ast, pas, kasero bo Allokh' taolo [ba parastishu iorikhokh'i] nakhoned
Va in ki kh'angome ki bandai Allokh' taolo [Mukh'ammad] k'iiom kard, to Uro bikhonad [va ibodat kunad], nazdik bud, ki [az izdikh'om bar girdi u] bar sari kh'am furu rezand>>
[Ei paiombar, ba onkh'o] Bigu: <<Man tankh'o Parvardigoramro mekhonam va kasero bo U sharik namesozam>>
Bigu: <<Be gumon, man nametavonam ba shumo ziione birasonam va na khairu sude>>
Bigu: <<[Agar man niz bar khilofi farmonash raftor kunam] kh'ech' kas maro dar barobari U kh'imoiat namekunad va panokh'gokh'e ch'uz U nameiobam

[Vazifai man] Tankh'o iblog'e az ch'onibi Allokh' taolo va [rasonidani] paiomkh'oi ust. Va kh'ar kas az Allokh'u paiombarash nofarmoni kunad, be gumon, otashi ch'akh'annam az oni Ust, ch'ovidona dar on khokh'ad mond>>
[Kori kofiron kh'amchunon idoma dorad] To zamone, ki on chiro ba onkh'o va'da doda shuda, bubinand. On gokh' khokh'and donist, ki chi kase iovarash notavontar va ch'am'iiatash kamtar ast
[Ei paiombar] Bigu: <<Man namedonam, oio on chi ki ba shumo va'da doda shuda, nazdik ast io Parvardigoram zamone [dur] baroi on k'aror medikh'ad>>
[Allokh' taolo] Donoi g'aib ast va kh'ech' kasro bar [asrori] g'aibi khud ogokh' namesozad
Magar rasulone, ki ononro pisandida [va barguzida] ast. Pas, be gumon, az peshi ruii u va pushti sarash nigakh'bone [az farishtagon baroi mukh'ofizat az vai] megumorad
To bidonad, ki [paiombaron] risolatkh'oi Parvardigorashonro iblog' kardaand va [Allokh' taolo] ba on chi nazdi onkh'ost ikh'ota dorad va kh'ar chizero ba adad barshumurdaast
Ei ch'omabakhudpechida!
Shabro - ch'uz andake - ba po khez [va ibodat kun]
Nimae az onro io andake az on kam kun
Io andake bar [nisfi] on biafzo va K'ur'onro bo tartil [-u taammul] bikhon
Iak'inan Mo ba zudi sukhane sangin bar tu nozil khokh'em kard
Be gumon, shabzindadori [bar nafs] dushvor ast va baroi guftor [va niioish] munosibtar va ustuvortar ast
Va iak'inan tu dar ruz mashg'uliiati bisior dori
Va nomi Parvardigoratro iod kun va tankh'o ba U dil biband
[Kh'amon] Parvardigori mashrik'u mag'rib, ki ma'bude [ba kh'ak'] ch'uz U nest. Pas, Uro korsoz [-u nigakh'boni khud] barguzin
Va bar on chi [mushrikon] meguiand, shikebo bosh va ba shevai naku [va shoista] az onon duri kun
Va maro bo in takzibkunandagoni barkhurdor az ne'mat voguzor va ba onon kame mukh'lat dekh'
Be gumon, nazdi Mo k'aid [-u bandkh'o]-i sangin va [otashi] duzakh ast
Va taome gulugir va azobe dardnok
Ruze, ki zaminu kukh'kh'o ba larza daroiad va kukh'kh'o [mutaloshi shavand va] kh'amchun tudai regi narm [ravon] gardand
Iak'inan, Mo paiombare ba suii shumo firistodem, ki bar shumo shokh'id [va guvokh'] ast, kh'amon guna ki ba suii Fir'avn paiombare firistodem
On gokh' Fir'avn az on paiombar nofarmoni [va bo u mukholifat] kard va Mo uro ba sakhti much'ozot kardem
Pas, agar kofir shaved, chi guna khudro [az azob] dar amon medored, [dar] ruze, ki kudakonro pir mekunad?
[Dar on ruz] Osmon shikofta meshavad [va] va'dai U, kh'atman, ba vuk'u' mepaivandad.
Be gumon, in [oiot] pand [-u kh'ushdore] ast, to kh'ar ki bikhokh'ad, ba sui Parvardigori khud rokh'e dar pesh girad

[Ei paiombar] Iak'inan Parvardigorat medonad, ki tu va gurukh'e az onkh'o, ki bo tu kh'astand, nazdiki du savumi shab [az ce du kh'issai shab] va [io] nisf [io] iak savum [seiak]-i onro ba [namoz] barmekhezed. Va Allokh' taolo shabu ruzro andozagiri mekunad. [U] Medonad, ki shumo nametavoned shumorishi onro [dak'ik'] mukh'osiba kuned, pas, shumoro bakhshid. Pas, aknun kh'ar chi [baroi shumo] muiassar boshad, az K'ur'on bikhoned. [Allokh' taolo] Medonad, ki barkhe az shumo bemor khokh'and shud va gurukh'e [digar] baroi ba dast ovardani fazlu ne'mati Allokh' taolo dar zamin safar mekunand va gurukh'e [niz] dar rokh'i Allokh' taolo ch'ikh'od mekunand, pas, on chi muiassar boshad, az on bikhoned va namoz barpo dored va zakot dikh'ed va ba Allokh' taolo k'arzi naku dikh'ed va [bidoned, ki] on chi az korkh'oi khair peshopesh baroi khud mefiristed, [onro] nazdi Allokh' taolo ba bekh'tarin vach'kh' va buzurgtarin podosh khokh'ed ioft va az Allokh' taolo omurzish bikhokh'ed, ki kh'amono Allokh' taolo omurzandai mekh'rubon ast
Ei ch'omabarsarkashida!
Barkhez va bim dekh'!
Va Parvardigoratro buzurg shumor!
Va ch'omaro pokiza bidor!
Va az palidi duri kun!
Baroi in bazlu bakhshish makun, ki afzuntalabi kuni
Va baroi [khushnudii] Parvardigorat shikebo bosh
Pas, kh'angome ki dar <<sur>> damida shavad
On ruz ruzi sakht [va dushvore] ast
Bar kofiron oson nest
[Ei paiombar] Maro bo kase, ki uro tankh'o [va biduni amvolu avlod] ofaridaam, voguzor
[Kh'amon kase, ki] moli farovone baroiash k'aror dodam
Va farzandone, ki kh'amesha [dar khidmati u va] bo u kh'astand
Va kh'amai vasoil [va imkonoti] zindagiro dar ikhtiiorash k'aror dodam
Boz [kh'am] tama' dorad, ki [bar on] biafzoiam
Kh'argiz [chunin nakhokh'ad shud]! Be gumon, u nisbat ba oioti Mo dushmani dorad
Va ba zudi uro ba mashak'k'atu sakhti meandozam
Zero u [baroi muboriza bo K'ur'on] andeshid va mukh'osiba kard
Pas, marg bar u bod! Chi guna andoza [va mukh'osiba] kard?
Boz [kh'am] marg bar u bod! Chi guna andoza [va mukh'osiba] kard?
Sipas nazar afkand
On gokh' chekh'ra dar kh'am kashid va ru tursh kard
Sipas [ba kh'ak'] pusht namud va takabbur varzid
On gokh' guft: <<In [K'ur'on] chize ch'uz ch'odue, ki [az digaron] omukhta shuda, nest
Va in [chize] ch'uz guftori bashar nest>>
Ba zudi uro ba duzakh darkhokh'am ovard
Va tu chi doni, ki duzakh chi guna ast?
[Otashi suzonest, ki] Na [chizero] bok'i meguzorad va na [chizero] rakh'o mekunad
Pustro [digargun karda] mesuzonad
Bar on [otash] nuzdakh' [farishta] gumorida shudaast.

Mo ma'muroni duzakhro fak'at az farishtagon k'aror dodem va shumori onkh'oro tankh'o baroi ozmoishi kofiron muaiian kardaem, to akh'li kitob iak'in kunand va kasone, ki imon ovardaand, bar imoni khud biiafzoiand va akh'li kitob va mu'minon giriftori shakku tardid nashavand va to kasone, ki dar dilkh'oiashon maraz ast va [niz] kofiron biguiand: <<Allokh' taolo az in masal [va tavsif] chi khostaast?>>. Bad-in guna, Allokh' taolo kh'ar kasro bikhokh'ad, gumrokh' mesozad va kh'ar kasro bikhokh'ad, kh'idoiat mekunad va [shumori] lashkariioni Parvardigoratro [kase] ch'uz U namedonad va in ch'uz pandu andarze baroi insonkh'o nest
Ore, savgand ba mokh' [ki kh'argiz chunin nest, ki onon tasavvur mekunand]
Va [savgand ba] shab kh'angome ki pusht kunad
Va ba subkh' kh'angome ki ravshan shavad
Ki on [otashi duzakh] iake az [azobkh'oi] buzurg [va kh'avlnok] ast
Baroi inson bimdikh'anda ast
Baroi kase az shumo, ki bikhokh'ad [bo korkh'oi naku] pesh aftad, io [bo gunokh' kardan] ak'ib bimonad
Kh'ar kas dar garavi a'moli khesh ast
Magar askh'obi iamin [mu'minon]
Ki dar bog'kh'o [-i bikh'isht] kh'astand va mepursand
az gunakh'goron:
<<Chi chiz shumoro ba duzakh darovard?
[Duzakhiion] Meguiand: <<Mo az namozguzoron nabudem
Va benavo[-ion]-ro it'om namekardem
Va paivasta kh'amrokh'i iovaguion [va akh'li botil] kh'amsado meshudem
Va kh'amvora ruzi ch'azoro takzib mekardem
To zamone, ki marg ba surog'amon omad
Pas, shafoati shafoatkunandagon ba onkh'o sude namebakhshad
Pas, onkh'oro chi shudaast, ki az pand [-u tazakkur] rui gardondaand?
Gui, ki gurkharone ramidaand
Ki az [muk'obili] sher gurekhtaand
Balki kh'ar kadom az onkh'o [tavak'k'u' dorad va] mekhokh'ad, ki [ba u] nomae kushoda [va ch'udogona az suii Allokh' taolo] doda shavad
Kh'argiz, chunin nest [ki onon mepindorand]! Balki onkh'o az [azobi] okhirat nametarsand
Na, chunin nest, ki onkh'o meguiand, on [K'ur'on] iak tazakkur va iodovari ast
Pas, kh'ar kase, ki bikhokh'ad az on pand girad
Va iod namekunand [va pand namegirand], magar in ki Allokh' taolo bikhokh'ad. Ust, ki sazovori parvo kardan va omurzidan ast.
Ba ruzi k'iiomat savgand mekhuram
Va ba nafsi malomatgar savgand mekhuram
Oio inson mepindorad, ki [pas az marg] kh'argiz ustukhonkh'oiashro ch'am' nakhokh'em kard?
Ore, Mo k'odirem, ki [kh'atto khututi sari] angushtonashro iaksonu murattab kunem.
Balki inson mekhokh'ad, ki [ozodona va biduni tars az okhirat] dar gunokh'u badkori mudovimat kunad
[Az in ru] Mepursad: <<Ruzi k'iiomat kai khokh'ad bud?>>
Pas, kh'angome ki chashm khira shavad
Va mokh' tira [va be nur] gardad
Va khurshedu mokh' iak ch'o ch'am' shavand
On ruz inson meguiad: <<Rokh'i gurez kuch'ost?>>
Kh'argiz! Kh'ech' gurezgokh'e nest
On ruz k'arorgokh' [-i nikh'one] ba suii Parvardigori tust
Va dar on ruz insonro az tamomi korkh'oe, ki az pesh io pas firistoda, ogokh' mekunand
Balki inson ba khubi bar kheshtan ogokh' ast
Agarchi [dar difo' az khud] uzrkh'oiashro dar miion ovarad
[Ei paiombar, kh'angomi nuzuli K'ur'on] zabonatro baroi [takror va khondani] on shitobzada kh'arakat madekh'
Musallaman, ch'am'ovari va khondani on bar [ukh'dai] Most
Pas, kh'ar gokh' [tavassuti Ch'abrail] onro [bar tu] khondem, az khondani u pairavi kun
Sipas baion kardanash bar [ukh'dai] Most
Kh'argiz chunin nest [ki shumo mushrikon mepindored]! Balki dunio [-i zudguzar]-ro dust medored
Va okhiratro rakh'o mekuned
On ruz chekh'rakh'oe toza [va shodob] ast
Ba suii Parvardigorash menigarad
Va dar on ruz chekh'rakh'oe abus [va darkh'amkashida] ast
Iak'in dorad, ki osebe kamarshikan ba u merasad
Ore, chun [ch'on] ba gulugokh'ash birasad
Va gufta shavad: <<Chi kasest, ki afsun bikhonad? [Va uro nach'ot dikh'ad]
Va iak'in kunad, ki zamoni ch'udoi [az dunio] ast.
Va [kor bolo girad va] sok'kh'o[-i poiash az sakhtii ch'on dodan] ba kh'am pechad.
Dar on ruz masiri kh'ama ba suii Parvardigorat khokh'ad bud
Pas, [munkiri meod] na tasdik' karda va na namoz guzoridaast
Balki [K'ur'onro] takzib kard va [az imon] ru gardond
Sipas khiromon ba suii khonavodaash bozgasht
Voi bar tu! Pas, voi bar tu!
Boz kh'am voi bar tu! Pas, voi bar tu!
Oio inson gumon mekunad, ki [be kh'adaf va biduni kh'isob va ch'azo] ba khud rakh'o meshavad?
Oio [u] nutfae az mani nabud, ki [dar rakh'im] rekhta meshavad?
On gokh' ba surati khuni basta daromad va [Allokh' taolo uro] ofarid va durustu ustuvor sokht
Sipas az u du zavch'i naru moda padid ovard
Oio [chunin Ofaridgore] k'odir nest, ki murdagonro [dubora] zinda kunad?
Iak'inan, zamoni tulonie bar inson guzasht, ki chize [mukh'immu] k'obili zikr nabud
Ba rosti, Mo insonro az nutfai mukhtalit [omekhta]-e ofaridem, uro meozmoem. Pas, uro shunavovu bino k'aror dodem
Kh'amono Mo rokh'ro ba u nishon dodem, khokh' siposguzor boshad io nosipos
Ba rosti, Mo baroi kofiron zanch'irkh'o va bandkh'o va otashi suzon mukh'aiio kardaem
Be gumon, nakukoron [dar bikh'isht] az ch'ome menushand, ki omekhta ba kofur ast
[Az] Chashmae, ki bandagoni [khosi] Allokh' taolo az on menushand, [kh'ar vak'tu] kh'ar ch'o bikhokh'and on [chashma]-ro ch'ori mesozand
[Bandagoni nakukor] Ba nazr vafo mekunand va az ruze metarsand, ki [azobu] sharri on farogir ast
Va g'izoro bo in ki [niioz va] dust dorand, ba mustamandu iatim va asir mebakhshand
